因为每到这个时候，月亮的魔力量会达到巅峰！: Because the magical power of the moon reaches its peak at this time!

算了算时间，现在他们也该集合了吧。: That reminds me, they're probably gathering right about now.

我知道你想！谁不想呢！: I know you want to! Who wouldn't?!

你去找她，说不定她就同意你加入她们了呢！: If you go find her, maybe she’ll agree to let you join them!
挡在我面前干什么？: Why are you blocking my path?
哦？又是个想加入魔法团的小可爱。: Oh? Another Little Darling who wants to join the Magic Group.
小可爱，你为什么想加入我们暗月魔法团？: Little Darling, why do you want to join us?
哦？漂亮姐姐？是我吗？呵呵……: Oh? A beautiful girl? Is it me? Haha...
呵呵……小可爱你夸我名字取得好也没用哦。: Haha... Little Darling, I’m afraid praising me won't get you very far.
月亮的魔力，是多么的诱人。: The magic power of the moon is so enticing.
呵呵，想加入我们魔法团可没这么简单。: Haha, but joining our Magic Group is not so easy.
你需要得到我与[c][ffff00]四位副团长[-][/c]的同意才可以。: First, you must obtain the approval of myself and the [c][ffff00]Four Vice Captains[-][/c].

小可爱你的运气倒是不错。: However, Little Darling, you are in luck.
又快到我们一年一度相聚的日子了。: It’s approaching the annual day of the festival.
他们应该在各自的家乡等待我的召唤。: They are probably each in their hometowns awaiting my summon.
不过，我还没有决定今年的地点。: However, I have not yet decided the location for this year.
我听说克雷斯特汉姆的月光有着古怪的魔力，便来到了这里。: I came to Glast Heim because I heard that the moonlight is especially brilliant here.
只是我刚到这里准备着手研究，就被你打断了。: But just as I was preparing for my research here, you interrupted me.
小可爱，看来你得为我[c][ffff00]负责[-][/c]了哟。: Little Darling, it seems you must [c][ffff00]repay me[-][/c].
别紧张，就是让你帮我一起研究一下这里的月之魔力。: Don't be nervous. I just want you to help me research the Moon's Charm here.
我想，对月之魔力感兴趣的你，应该很高兴才对。: I think that somebody with such an interest in the Moon's Charm as yourself must be delighted by this.
听说这里的[c][ffff00]植物[-][/c]因为这古怪的月之魔力都发生了变: I hear that the [c][ffff00]plants[-][/c] here have changed strangely as a result of the Moon's Charm.

我要看看，是不是月之魔力导致的。: I want to see whether it’s a result of the Moon's Charm.

让我来看看这变异的黄草。: Let me see these Mutated Yellow Plants.
古老而又强大的魔力……: An ancient and strong magic power...
决定了，今年我们暗月魔法团的[c][ffff00]中秋之夜[-][/c]就在这里: It’s decided. The Darkmoon Mages' [c][ffff00]Mid-Autumn Night[-][/c] shall be held right here!

我们暗月魔法团的邀请函可是很[c][ffff00]特别[-][/c]的。: The Darkmoon Mages' invitation letters are rather [c][ffff00]unique[-][/c].
首先，邀请函里必须要有美貌的团长，我。: First, the invitation letters must contain their beautiful captain, me.
那就拍摄一张在月光笼罩下美丽的我。: Then take a photo of my beautiful self under the moonlight.
小可爱的拍照技术很不错嘛~: Little Darling is handy with a camera.
美丽的我与这里的月光相得映彰。: I look simply gorgeous in this moonlight.
以后多给姐姐拍拍照。: Be sure to take lots of photos for me in future.

在每年的邀请函中我都会注入举办地的月之魔力。: We imbue the local Moon's Charm into the invitation letter every year.
用这个[c][ffff00]魔力采集瓶[-][/c]去采集一些月之魔力吧。: Use this [c][ffff00]Magic Collecting Bottle[-][/c] to collect some Moon's Charm.

准备好了吗？让本皇子带你去对付克罗！: Are you ready? I'll take you to confront Kroll!

不……不想离开……: No... I don't want to go!

真的吃不下了，对不起……: I really can't eat anymore. Sorry...
主人来啦！让我们继续冒险吧！: Master is here! Let's continue with our adventure!
难得有这么心平气和的时候了，要聊聊天吗？: I rarely feel this calm. Would you like to have a chat?
主人成长的速度真是惊人呢！: My master is improving so fast!

别再发呆了，我们赶紧跑吧！！: Don't just stare blankly! Let's run!

地下呆久了，偶尔出来晒晒太阳也不错。: After spending so much time underground, it's nice to enjoy the sun here and there.
想和主人更亲近~: I want to be closer with my master!
饿扁啦……主人有吃的吗？: I'm starving... Master, do you have any food?
哇！！这会让我的毛毛更闪亮吗？: Wow! Would this make my fur more shining?
好开心，下次我也要给主人惊喜！: I'm so happy! Next time I'll give my master a surprise!
咩~主人身上的味道好舒服~: Baa... My master's scent comforts me...
好多人！可以跟我一起玩吗~: So many people! Can you play with me?
咩！有我在的地方就有幸运！: Baa! Wherever I am, there's good luck!
一点小心意~希望主人能喜欢呢！: A small gift. I hope my master likes it!
好饿好饿！再不给吃的我要闹啦！: So hungry... Feed me now or I'll make trouble!
不、不能再吃了……我不要变成肥咩……: I can't eat anymore... I don't want to be a fat sheep...
看招！本咩不是好欺负的！: Take that! This sheep is no pushover!
嘿嘿，主人，我也很厉害吧？: Heheh, master, don't you think I'm strong?

主人不要死，呜呜呜，你醒醒呀……: Master, don't die! Woo... Wake up!
咩，摸摸我的头嘛……主人都好久不理我啦！: Baa... Touch my head... Master, you haven't played with me for so long!
主人，你受了好重的伤……我们快离开这里吧！: Master, your injury is bad... Let's leave!

再不摸摸我，身上的毛毛就要打结啦！: Touch me now or my hair will tie knots!

是给我的吗？谢谢主人！: Is this for me? Thank you, master!

哟西，我要努力去制作巧克力了！: Ah, I have to work hard to make some chocolates!
到底怎样才能制作出让人难以忘怀的巧克力呢？: How can I make unforgettable chocolates?

也许应该请奥尔里昂吃一口朵朵拉制作的巧克力。: Maybe we should ask Orleans to try the chocolate made by Dodola.

如果你能做到，我就愿意品尝你朋友的巧克力！: If you can do it, I'll be willing to taste your friend's chocolate!

你去告诉奥尔里昂，让他好好照照镜子，别做白日梦了！: Tell Orleans to look himself in the mirror. Tell him to stop daydreaming!

如果奥尔里昂大人同意让她加入考试，我也很开心！: If Mr. Orleans agreed to let her take the exam, I am also very happy!

没有……我在这里又找了一百年……: No... I've been looking for it for another one hundred years here...

等到那个时候，我们一家人就可以幸福地生活下去……: By that time, our family will be able to live together happily...

触碰符咒的瞬间，感觉到手指一阵刺痛，眼前出现过去的幻象。: When touching the amulet, you feel a sting on fingers and past illusions appear.

告诉我的妈妈，等我准备好了，我会回家的。: Tell my mother that when I am ready, I will go home.
我的女儿，她愿意回家了吗？: My daughter, is she willing to go home?
卢西娅的事情远比她想的复杂，我也是有苦衷的。: Lusya's matters are far more complicated than she thought. I have my difficulties.
那海草的汁水对卢西娅恐怕没有作用，你快让她们两个一起回到我这边吧。: The seagrass juice may have no effect on Lusya. Go and ask both of them to return to me.
妈妈，你愿意容纳卢西娅了吗？她失去了母亲已经很可怜了，你不能将她排斥在我们人鱼族: Mother, are you willing to accept Lusya? She has lost her mother and is very poor, you cannot exclude her from our obeaunes.
不要接近她，她暴走了！: Don't come close to her. She went ballistic!
好孩子，我已经安抚了卢西娅，她会好好休息一会，但这不是长久之计。: Good girl, I've already appeased Lusya. She will take a good rest, but this is not a long-term solution.
我知道有一个办法可以救她，但是我们人鱼的力量不足以做这件事情。: I know there is a way to save her, but our obeaunes' strength is not enough to do it.
太好了，请你先去这神殿右边的长廊尽头，拿取法杖“万神的注视”。: Great! Please go to the end of the gallery on the right side of the temple and take the staff Gods' Gaze.
石化状态的法杖，虽然全都是泥土，也掩盖不了它的力量。: The fossilized staff. Although it is covered by soil, its power cannot be covered up.
泥土里有一根法杖，是否将它拔起来？: There is a staff in the soil. Pull it up?
万神的注视被拔起时，引起了海底的震动，不少魔物都被吸引了过来。: When the Gods' Gaze is pulled up, it causes the vibration of the seabed and many monsters are attracted.
快将法杖拿给茜梅德，卢西娅还等着被拯救。: Bring the staff to Cymerid now. Lusya is still waiting to be saved.
拿到了吗？万神的注视，真怀念啊……过去的英雄用这柄神杖的场面。: Did you get it? The Gods' Gaze, I'm thinking of... The scenes of the heroes using this staff in the past.
年轻人，看来这柄法杖选择了你。: Young man, it seems that this staff chose you.
只有你可以用它召唤众神的目光，在神光之下，一切的邪恶将不复存在。: Only you can use it to summon the gaze of the gods. Under holy light, no evil will exist.
卢西娅看上去已经好了很多，问问她感觉怎么样。: Lusya looks a lot better. Ask how she feels.
……啊（卢西娅艰难地发出了声音，她看上去好多了）: Ah... (Lusya makes a sound hard. She looks much better)
发生了很多很多，卢西娅你没事，真是太好了。: So many things happened. Lusya, You're okay, It's great.
（对着茜梅德）母亲，对不起，给你惹了这么多麻烦。: (To Cymerid) Mother, I'm sorry to have caused you so much trouble.
我真是太天真了，自以为能拯救卢西娅，实际上什么都做不了。: I was so naive that I thought I could save Lusya. I couldn't really do anything.
（慈爱的）好了，卢西娅没事就好了，你们两去玩吧，我要跟这位人类好好聊一聊。: (Gentle) Well, Lusya is okay now. You two can go to have some fun. I want to have a chat with this human.
年轻人，万神的注视既然选择了你，你就要好好利用，不要辜负它对你的信任。: Young man, Since the Gods' Gaze has chosen you, You must make good use of it and not let it down.
这法杖的力量非凡，会让人走上力量的巅峰。: The extraordinary strength of this staff will make people reach the peak of strength.
但是，一定要用来保护和关爱，而不是破坏。: But you must use it for protection and care, instead of destruction.
最后你救了那个小美人鱼吗？太棒了！: You saved the little obeaune at last? Awesome!
万神的注视，看来你的善良也有了回报，让我研究研究这柄法杖，我想我会搞清楚它的秘密: The Gods' Gaze. It seems that your kindness has paid off. Let me study this staff. I think I will find out its secret.
有时候我也想跟你一样出门去冒险，但是我很宅，还是适合做技术活吧~: Sometimes I also want to venture out like you do, but I like to stay home and I'm more suitable for technical work.
你知道吗，有一柄剑，名叫提尔锋。: Do you know that there is a sword called Tyrfing?
传说中这把剑无比锋利，只要出手必定能让敌人血溅三尺。: Legend has it that this sword is extremely sharp. As long as it attacks, it will be able to make the enemy bleed.
但这柄剑同样也会噬主，每代剑主人都不得善终。: But this sword will also harm the owner. No owner of it had acquired a peaceful end.
也许，你应该去斐扬，调查关于这柄剑的故事。: Maybe you should go to Payon and investigate the story about this sword.
就是你，在到处打听提尔锋的事情吗？: Are you inquiring about the Tyrfing everywhere?
为了公会的荣耀？好吧，看来是我错怪你了，我以为你也只是那些贪婪而无知的人。: For the glory of the guild? Well, it seems that I have misunderstood you. I thought you were like those greedy and ignorant people.
提尔锋一直被我的部下保管，直到前段时间，有一个外乡人来到我们这边。: The Tyrfing had been kept by my men. Some time ago, an outcomer came to us.
他说他的家乡被魔物破坏，想向我们借一下提尔锋。: He said that his hometown was attacked by the monsters and wanted to borrow the Tyrfing from us.
我们可怜他的身世，将提尔锋借给了他，希望他可以合理利用这柄剑，毕竟这剑上的诅咒，: We pitied his experience and lent him the Tyrfing, Hoping that he can make reasonable use of this sword. After all, the curse on this sword will harm the owner.
没想到，所有的事情都是他编造的，他的目的只是为了骗取提尔锋。: Unexpectedly, everything was made up by him. His purpose was only to gain the Tyrfing.
而他现在……已经被提尔锋迷失了心智，成为了一个魔物。: And now he... Has lost his mind and become a monster.
他就在斐扬的树林中央，拿着提尔锋，他叫做查明利。: He was in the middle of the woods in Payon, holding the Tyrfing. His name is Chaminry.
这，就是提尔锋！人不可貌相，没想到你可以从查明利手上拿回提尔锋！: This is the Tyrfing! Men cannot be judged by their looks. I didn't expect that you could get the Tyrfing from Chaminry!
请把这把剑拿给我的手下政赫。: Please bring this sword to one of my men called Zanher.
是……提尔锋吗？没想到它又回来了。: The... The Tyrfing? Didn't expect that it would be back.
你真强，能打败提尔锋的宿主！: You are so powerful that you could defeat the Tyrfing's host!
已经生锈了，想必这剑也饱饮了鲜血，我需要一些封印之木，将他的锈迹除去。: It's rusty. I guess it's full of blood. I need some seal wood to remove its rust.
斐扬的森里里就有许多封印之木，请你帮我取来。: There is a lot seal wood in the forest in Payon. Please help me to get some.
好样的，我的朋友，让我去除这剑上的锈迹，重新将它封印起来。: Good job, My friend. Let me remove the rust on the sword and seal it again.
实际上我保管提尔锋的这段时期，自己也有好好研究一下这剑。: In fact, During the time when I kept the Tyrfing, I also had studied it.
我发现，这剑的构造与世界上其他的剑，有所不同。: I found that the construction of this sword was different from other swords in the world.
正是这不同之处，让这柄剑特别锋利。: It is this difference that makes this sword particularly sharp.
如果我能够分析出这剑的构造。: If I can analyze and know the structure of this sword,
我就能将诅咒从这把剑上分离出来，也许它可以成为一把真正的利器。: I can separate the curse from it. Maybe it can be a real great weapon.
这，太感谢你了，但是我需要东西，并不容易拿到。: Eh, thank you so much. But I need something that is not easy to get.
我需要统领的佩剑！如果有统帅的佩剑，我也许可以分析出提尔锋的构造。: I need the Commander's sword! If I have it, I may be able to analyze and know the structure of the Tyrfing.
可是，统帅……太凶了……我不敢……: But the Commander... Is too fierce... I don't dare...
什么，要我的佩剑？也不是不可以……: What? You need my sword? It's not impossible...
但是，既然有胆子说出这样的话，就要有必死的觉悟。: However, since you have the courage to say this, you must be prepared for death.
想拿到我的佩剑，就要用实力来取得！: If you want to get my sword, You must achieve it with your strength!
很不错！年轻人，你真是让我刮目相看，哈哈哈哈！: Not bad! Young man, You really surprised me. Hahaha!
原来是这样，原来这就是锻造的真谛！: Well, this is the true essence of forging!
当我看见统帅的剑，才明白过来，原来我从前对提尔锋的理解，只是停留在表面！: When I saw the Commander's sword, I came to understand it. It turned out that I had just known a little about the Tyrfing.
我想我明白了，这是提尔锋的构造！: I think I understand. This is the structure of the Tyrfing!
你看见了其中精妙的结构吗？: Have you seen the subtle structure?
我觉得你可能对于武器的理解，还有待提高……不过，这个图纸，你还是留下来吧，总会有: I think that you may have to improve your understanding of weapons. However, You can keep this Blueprint. It may be useful some time!
这，是什么？乱七八糟的鬼画符？: What... What is this? Messy symbols?
这鬼画符是提尔锋的图纸？让我仔细看看，这人写的字可真丑，完全看不出来在写什么。: Are the messy symbols a Blueprint of the Tyrfing? Let me take a closer look. The words written by this man are really ugly. I don't know what they are at all.
等等，这，我好像看明白了，这个结构……: Wait, this, I seem to understand this structure...
哈哈哈哈哈哈，我的朋友，你真是不简单。: Hahaha, My friend. You're so good.
只要你出马，我们总有好运气，我明白这个构造了，不管是什么人锻造了这柄剑，他一定花: As long as you take actions, we always have good luck. I understand this structure. No matter who forges this sword, he must have spent many efforts.
我会为你量身打造出新的提尔锋，尽请期待吧！: I will create a new Tyrfing for you. Wait for it!
好吧，等你对提尔锋有兴趣的时候，再来跟我聊聊吧。: Well, come and talk to me again when you are interested in the Tyrfing.
咦，冒险者，你有巅峰碎片吗？如果有的话，记得来找我哦！: Hey, adventurer, do you have peak Shards? If so, remember to come to me!
如果你不认识我，那说明你还嫩了点。: If you don't know me, it means that you are still too young.
在雪地里闪闪发亮的冰晶。: Shiny ice crystals in the snow.
我是神器凛冬结晶。: I am the artifact Winter Crystal.
哼，我知道你为什么而来，全写在你脸上了。: Hey, I know why you came. It's obvious.
传说中的猎神乌勒尔有一头守护左右的冰兽生活在极北之地。: The legendary Hunting God Uller has a guardian ice beast living in the extreme north.
我的情报网收到这头冰兽在[c][ffff00]姜饼城[-][/c]附近出没，这可: My intelligence network received a message that this ice beast appeared in the vicinity of the [c][ffff00]Gingerbread City[-][/c]. This is a first-hand news.
对，你可以去那儿碰碰运气，[c][ffff00]毕竟冰兽可是守护凛冬结晶的神兽[: Yes, you can go there and try your luck. [c][ffff00]After all, the ice beast is the guardian mythical beast of the Winter Crystal[-][/c].
和那儿的姜饼城守护者萨尔曼聊聊~那可是我的人~~: Talk to Sahlman, the guardian of the Gingerbread City there. He is my man.
这么说，你准备前去圣诞村~是吗？别忘了和我的甜心萨尔曼问好。: So you are ready to go to the Christmas Village, right? Don't forget to say hello to my sweetheart Sahlman.
都告诉你这么多了，真是个没眼力劲的家伙，就你这个样子，是不配拥有神器凛冬结晶的。: I've told you so much. You're really not a smart guy. A man who is like you is unworthy to own the artifact Winter Crystal.
那么祝你好运，不要看着我，我是不可能陪你去的，我可不想跑去那么寒冷的地方。: Well, Good luck. Don't look at me, I can't go with you. I don't want to go to such a cold place.
噢！我听到我的女神柯贝妮在呼唤我了！！: Oh! I heard my goddess Courteney calling me!!
柯贝妮…她迷人的蓝眼睛就和璀璨的星空一样深邃。: Courteney... Her Enchanting blue eyes are as deep as the starry sky.
咳咳，我都忘了你在这儿了，不好意思。: Eh-hem, I forgot you were here. I'm sorry.
嗯，最近的确有一头巨大的冰兽出没在姜饼城附近的雪原上！: Well, recently there was a huge ice beast in the snowfield near the Gingerbread City!
我告诉你，它还带走了一个姜饼城的小女孩！: Listen, it took away a girl of the Gingerbread City away!
是的，就在那座桥边上！你可以去那儿调查一下。: Yes, it's just by the bridge! You can go there and investigate.
整个桥边都被厚厚的冰冻住了，这里似乎比城里要寒冷刺骨十倍。: The entire bridge was frozen in thick ice. And it seemed to be ten times colder than in the city.
地面完全没有打斗的痕迹，[c][ffff00]也没有任何挣扎的痕迹与血迹[-][: There is no trace of fighting on the ground. [c][ffff00]And no trace of struggling or blood[-][/c].
怎么样？有什么新发现吗？: How about it? Is there any new discovery?
没有挣扎的痕迹！？这可就奇怪了。: No trace of struggling!? This is strange.
你知道更奇怪的是什么吗？我调查过了城里的几户人家，都说不清楚女孩是从哪里来的。: Do you know what is more strange? I have investigated several households in the city and they have no idea where the girl come from.
我看见她前几日和城里的孩子苹果在一起玩耍，不如你去问问那孩子。: I saw her play with the kid Apple in the city a few days ago. You'd better ask the kid.
我讨厌小孩子！我听不懂他们说的话！: I hate kids! I don't understand what they say!
嘿嘿，我前几天的确和一个和我差不多年龄的女生一起堆过雪人~: Hey, I do have built a snowman with a girl of my age just a few days ago.
这我就不知道了，她好像…什么都记不太清，但那女生一点都不怕冷呢，喜欢光着脚在雪地: I don't know about this. She seemed to... Remember nothing. But the girl was not afraid of cold. She liked to run barefoot in the snow.
她告诉我她的名字叫…温特…嗯…是叫温特没错。: She told me her name was... Winter... Um... Yes, it was Winter.
嗯…这么说，也没什么特别的事，就是她堆雪人的时候常走神，然后重复一句话。: Hmm... Well, There was nothing special. Just when she was building the snowman, she was often absent-minded and repeating the same words.
雪城之桥，冰封记忆，蔚蓝之光，凛冬结晶。: Bridge of snow town, Frozen memory, Blue light, Winter crystal.
这就对了！这是句古老的魔法咒语！: That's right! This is an ancient magic spell!
那女孩一定是在她被带走的地方念了这个咒语！才召唤出了冰兽！: The girl must have Casted this where she was taken away, which summoned the ice beast!
这举动虽然危险，但我建议，你也去那里念这几句咒语！: Although this move is dangerous, I suggest that you go there to Cast this spell too!
不，这一点也不好，你可能为此丢掉性命，朋友。但至少我会为你祈祷。: No, this is not good. You may lose your life for this, friend. But at least I will pray for you.
如果忘记咒语是什么，我还能帮你提个醒，别的我就做不了什么了。: If you have forgotten what the spell is, I can remind you. I can't do anything else.
[c][ffff00]雪城之桥，冰封记忆，蔚蓝之光，凛冬结晶[-][/c]。: [c][ffff00]Bridge of snow town, frozen memory, blue light, winter crystal[-][/c].
我好像…什么也想不起来…: I don't seem to remember anything...
我也不知道，但似乎我的记忆都藏在那些冰晶里了。: I don't know, but it seems that my memories are hidden in those ice crystals.
那些雪面上闪闪发亮的冰晶！那是长久不化的雪形成的结晶。: Those glittering ice crystals in the snow! Those are crystals formed from long-lasting snow.
它们好像都在告诉我，关于我的故事！: They seem to be telling me about my story!
求求你，帮我找一些来，或许我能想起什么，我好像忘了非常重要的事。: I beg you to help me to get something. Maybe I can recall something. I seem to have forgotten something very important.
我…我想起来了，我就是凛冬结晶！: I... I remember. I am the Winter Crystal!
我陪伴了猎神大人百年，有一天他突然对我说要踏上旅途。: I stayed with the Hunting God for a hundred years. One day he suddenly told me that he would embark on a journey.
猎神大人再也没有出现过，我很孤独，我非常想念他…: The Hunting God never appeared again. I was lonely. I missed him very much...
你是谁…你是不是猎神大人！！是不是猎神大人回来了！: Who are you... Are you the Hunting God!! Has the Hunting God come back!
满嘴的谎话！！让冰兽来戳穿你！！: Liar!! Let the ice beast pierce you!!
唔…或许我不该这么做…: Eh... Maybe I should not do this...
猎神大人在踏上旅途的那一天叮嘱我要为正义拉弓，要守护普隆德拉。我怎么全忘了…: On the day when the Hunting God started his journey, he asked me to draw the bow for justice and guard Prontera. How could I forget them...
虽然你不是猎神大人，但你是能驯服冰兽的人。: Although you are not the Hunting God, You are the one who can tame the ice beast.
你是有资格拥有我的人，我在此将凛冬结晶托付与你，请带着猎神乌勒尔的信念勇敢的踏上: You are the one who is qualified to own me. I will entrust you with the Winter Crystal. Please take the belief of the Hunting God Uller to embark on the adventure bravely.
那你就走开！我在等猎神大人。: Then go away! I'm waiting for the Hunting God.
冒险者，你惧怕死亡吗？敢于直面死亡的恐惧吗？: Adventurer, do you fear death? Dare to face the fear of death?
如果没有直面死亡的勇气，是无法找到神器万物安息的，很遗憾，你不适合接受这个挑战。: If you do not have the courage to face death, You cannot find the artifact All In Peace. Unfortunately, You are not suitable to accept this challenge.
非常好，看来你还是有点骨气的，不过可不能只是说说而已。: Very good, it seems that you have some courage. But you cannot just talk about it.
我接到消息说斐扬有大量动物和魔物离奇死亡！: I received a message that a large number of animals and monsters died strangely in Payon!
对，我知道，很可怕是不是！这一定是万物安息的诅咒！: Yes, I know, it's terrible! This must be the curse of the All In Peace!
那可是千年圣战中，大盗贼尤伦使用的拳刃，光听名字就让人不寒而栗，传说所到之处必定: That is the katar used by the Thief Uren in the Jehad. It is chilling and frightful to listen to its name. Legend has it that it brings death and catastrophe wherever it goes.
不能让这样的危险之物波及无辜的普通人！: We cannot allow such a dangerous thing to harm innocent ordinary people!
我需要你立刻动身前去斐扬，见斐扬卫队的吉野，他会告诉你下一步该怎么做。: I need you to leave immediately for Payon. Meet Yoshino of the Payon Guards. He will tell you what to do next.
你是来帮助我们的吗？: Are you here to help us?
太可怕了！！斐扬城旁的洞穴口好多动物都死了，到处都是死亡的味道。: Terrible!! Many animals died at the entrance to the cave near Payon. The smell of death is everywhere.
尸体招来了可怕又巨大的蛆虫，如果你是个勇士，请帮帮我们，去除这些蛆虫。: The dead bodies attracted terrible and huge maggots. If you are a warrior, please help us to remove these maggots.
然后调查一下那里，我们根本没办法接近，只能委托给你了！: Then investigate there, we can't get close to it. We can only ask you for help!
这些大脚熊死了有一些时日了，看的出它们奋力反抗过，但还是十分痛苦的死了。打斗的痕: These bigfoot bears have been dead for some time. Obviously they had been struggling to resist, but still died painfully. The traces of the fighting stretches into the cave. I should go in and check it out!
许多腐臭的血迹，十分可怕。: Many rancid blood traces. So terrible.
似乎有人在向我搭话。: It seems someone is trying to talk to me.
我干了蠢事，求你救救我。: I did a stupid thing and I beg you to save me.

没人喜欢跟你一起玩，回家找你姐姐去吧，像个女孩子一样学绣花去吧。: No one likes to play with you. Go home and find your sister. Go and learn embroidering like a girl.
那么，我也帮你们找些玩伴吧~: Then let me help you find some playmates too.
我不摘樱花了，让这两只手走吧。: I won't pick the sakura anymore. Let the two hands go.
你，你，你怎么跑这么快，等等我。: You, You... How could you run so fast? Wait.
……樱花姐姐，你这么喜欢我呀。: ... Sister Sakura, you like me so much.
（对着小樱眨眼睛）我不会跟别人说的，你可以再亲一下！: (Eyes blinking to Sakura) I will not tell anyone else. You can kiss one more time!
怎么会害羞的跑掉了，早知道就装作看不见了。: Get away? I should have pretended to be unable to see.
我没事，我没有多少力气了。: I'm fine. I don't have much strength now.
不要伤害秀明，他真的不是坏人。: Don't hurt Chomin. He is really not a bad person.
（指着一个地方）那边……去那边: (Pointing to a place) Over there... Go over there.
又是一年樱花开，你也有点小大人的样子了啊。: Sakura are blooming again. You look like a little adult now.
已经长成了能迷倒女孩子的小少年。: You have grown into a young boy who can enchant girls.
（举起手想要触碰秀明的脸）我听见有些女孩在讨论你……: (Raising a hand to touch Chomin's face) I heard some girls talking about you...
大概……是生命的鲜活吧。: Probably... is the freshness of life.
（颤抖的声音）你怎么，怎么变透明了？: (Tremulous voice) How did you... become transparent?
我是个灵，变透明是很正常的……: I am a spirit, so becoming transparent is normal...
帮你把裙子提起来，飘下来了。: Help you lift the skirt up. It went down.
发生了什么事情，真的不想告诉我吗？: What happened? Don't you really want to tell me?
有了那本书，我就可以恢复你的灵力。: With that scroll, I can restore your spiritual power.
你不会这么虚弱了。: You will not be so weak.
把一切交给我吧，我会让你恢复的。: Let me handle everything. I will make you restore.
我会补充你的灵力，不会让你离开。: I will supplement your spiritual power and will not let you leave.
这些都是无意识的灵力，你吸收了，就能恢复了。: These are unconscious spiritual power. If you absorb them, You will be able to recover.
你好多了，身体没那么虚弱了……: You are much better. Your body is not that weak...
你先用这些灵力维持一下，等我从姐姐那里拿到书，我会让你变回原来的样子。: Use these spiritual power to hang on. When I get the scroll from my sister, I will recover you.
你都看见了，不要怪罪秀明。: You see it. Don't blame Chomin.
我不想吞噬天水之国的灵，她们，都是我的朋友。: I don't want to swallow the spirits in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water. They are my friends.
救救秀明，只有你们能救他了。: Please save Chomin. Only you can save him.
秀明的式神，他发现我在这里了，我必须走了。: Chomin's shikigami. He found me here. I must go.
救救秀明！请你一定要救救秀明！: Please save Chomin! Please be sure to save him!
越来越多的式神聚集过来，小樱将式神都引开了。: More and more shikigamies are gathering together and Sakura draws them away.
小樱已经远去，赶快向千代子说明情况吧！: Sakura is already gone. Please explain the situation to Chiyoko.
你查明小樱和秀明想搞什么鬼了吗？: Did you find out what Sakura and Chomin wanted to do?
一定是这个灵鼓动我弟弟，才让他偏离了正道。: It must be this spirit that inspired my brother to make him stray from the right path.
我早就知道秀明身边一直有个灵，只是小樱她周身闪着白光，并不是恶灵。: I knew that there was always a spirit being with Chomin. It was just that Sakura had a white light in her body. She was not a wraith.
我没有干涉他们相处，没想到秀明居然准备使用咒法书里的阵法。: I didn't interfere with them. I didn't expect that Chomin would try to use the array in the spell scroll.
只是，我原本以为秀明只是为了哄那个灵开心。: I thought that Chomin was just trying to make that spirit happy.
如果他做了这么充分的准备，事情也许会变得不可挽回！: If he is well prepared, things may become irreversible!
我明白，我都明白，你先去找你的朋友吧。: I understand. Go and find your friend first.
那个叫做摩根的人，虽然他是个女装变态，但我能看出来他的实力强劲。: The man named Morgan. Although he is a perverted man, I can see that he has a great power.
又是你，喂，我已经帮助秀明拿到了书。: You again? Hey, I've helped Chomin get the scroll.
你还过来打扰我跟小姐姐跳舞。: You still come to disturb me dancing with girls.
所以，你知道了樱灵和伊达秀明的往事。: So, You know the past of Sakura and Ida Chomin.
你又想让我帮忙了吗？喂喂，我也是很忙的，怎么有什么辛苦的累活，都想到我了。: You want me to help again? Hey, I am very busy. Why you always come to me for hard works.
阿黄，你不要这样，哎呀，真恼火，让我先去换套衣服。: Huang, don't be like this. Ah, it's really annoying. Let me change my clothes first.
还是去桥前见我吧，每次被你抓住在这里跳舞！: Meet me in front of the bridge. You always catch me here dancing!
别一副愁眉苦脸的样子，当初想要帮助伊达秀明的时候，不是挺坚决吗？: Don't be sullen. When you wanted to help Ida Chomin, weren't you determined?
你没错，有一颗乐于助人的心，从来都是一件好事情。: You are right. Having a helpful heart is always a good thing.
你只是太年轻啦，容易被人利用而已。: You are just too young and easy to be taken advantage of.
跟我一样多喝点酒，多跳点舞，就不会出现这种情况了。: Drink a little more wine and dance more like me, this kind of situation will not happen.
喝点酒，睡会觉，就没时间被人利用了！: Drink some wine and sleep, There will be no time to be taken advantage of.
我会帮助你的，吉芬的法师不会眼睁睁地看着一位年轻的冒险者这么苦恼。: I will help you. Geffen's mage will not be just watching a young adventurer being so distressed.
哎……你别忙着高兴，你需要继续跟伊达秀明周旋。: Hey... Don't be happy this soon. You need to continue to hold Ida Chomin.
我呢，需要回吉芬取一点材料。: I need to go back to Geffen and take some materials.
刚说完摩根又拿出了女装和化妆品打扮了起来。: Just finished talking, Morgan starts to dress up with women's dress and cosmetics.
你不要随随便便被伊达秀明解决掉了！: Don't be settled by Ida Chomin!
是吗？又换上女装跳舞去了吗？哼！: Really? Dress like a woman and continue to dance? Humph!
看来，天水之国的命运只能掌握在你我手中了。: It seems that the destiny of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water is on us.
秀明对巫术的研究非常深，尤其是一些式神之术。: Chomin has a deep research on magic, especially the magic about shikigamies.
我的式神比他更厉害！: My shikigami is more powerful than his!
我之前用来跟踪秀明的式神被你们毁掉了，要不然也不会出现这么严重的事情。: The shikigami I used to track Chomin was destroyed by you, or else it would not be such a serious matter.
哼，让我招个式神，去查一查秀明的踪迹。: Hum, let me summon a shikigami to find out about where Chomin is.
如果不是千代子大人，我还是个迷茫的游魂呢。: If it weren't for Chiyoda, I would still be a lost soul.
我的式神去了船坞附近，也许你可以在那边找找秀明的踪迹。: My shikigami has gone to the vicinity of the dock. Maybe you can look for Chomin there.
要小心行事，秀明很谨慎。: Be careful. Chomin is very cautious.
（式神指着前面的两个箱子）嘤嘤嘤~: (The shikigami points to the two boxes ahead) Woo woo!
千代子的式神慢慢升到天空中，往神社的方向飞去。: Chiyoko's shikigami slowly rises into the sky and flies toward the shrine.
这个，是海船运过来的东西，这个跟秀明有什么关系。: This is something shipped by a sea vessel. What does this have to do with Chomin?
让我打开看看……: Let me open it and see...
秀明想要在天水之国进行一场无比庞大的聚灵仪式。: Chomin wants to perform an extremely large spirits gathering ritual in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water.
天水之国樱花树下所有的灵，都将聚集到小樱的体内。: All the spirits under the sakura trees of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water will be gathered in the body of Sakura.
这木箱子里装的是咒法需要的材料。: This wooden box contains the materials required for the spell.
龟壳、龙角和虎皮。这三样东西象征了三个方向。: Turtle shell, dragon horn and tiger skin. These three things symbolize three directions.
恐怕，秀明的阵法就布置在天水之国的北边、东边和西边。: I am afraid that Chomin's arrays are located on the north, East, and west of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water.
这三个地方，是神社、神社前的桥梁、和樱花林！: These three places are the shrine, the bridge in front of the shrine, and the sakura woods!
神社这里我会仔细调查，你去另外两个地方吧。: I will investigate the shrine here carefully. You can go to the two other places.
桥梁之下，好像吊着一个药瓶，不妨用鱼竿吊起来看看。: Under the bridge, There seems a potion. You can use a fishing rod to lift it.
不仅没有钓上来，反而把绳子扯断了，药瓶落去了海水里！: The potion has not been lifted up, instead the rope has been broken and the potion has fallen into the sea.
也许，可以请人鱼帮忙在海水里寻找。: Perhaps you can ask the obeaune to help to look for it in the sea.
……（卢西娅甩动着自己的尾巴高兴地看着你）: ... (Lusya swings her tail and looks at you happily)
帮忙找药瓶: Help to look for the potion
水中跳出来一只美人鱼！: A obeaune jumps out of the water!
…（手里抓住了一个小东西，但却没有给你）: ... (A small thing is held in her hand. But she doesn't give it to you)
（手舞足蹈地在责备你）: (Blames you with arms waving and feet stamping)
小美人鱼气鼓鼓地看着你，不想说话的样子。: The little obeaune looks at you angrily and doesn't want to talk.
摘一朵樱花送给小美人鱼，让她消消气吧。: Pick a sakura and give it to the little obeaune to cool her down.
摘下的樱花在微风中轻轻抖动，粉色的花瓣娇俏动人。: The sakura shakes gently in the breeze. The pink petals were charming.
（依然在生气，转身不搭理你）: (Still angry. Turns around and ignores you)
……（拿走了你手心的花朵，快乐的扭动起来）: ... (Takes the blossom in your palm and wriggles happily)
卢西娅把手心里的药瓶递过来，害羞的跳入海水中，回到海底神殿里。: Lusya hands the potion over, jumps into the sea shyly and returns to the Underwater Temple.
千代子的式神似乎在这里，问问它有什么新的发现。: Chiyoko's shikigami seems to be here. Ask it what new discoveries it has made.
大人，那里有个隐藏的法阵。: My lord, there is a hidden array.
我帮你去除上面的障眼法！: Let me help you to remove the camouflage above!
我是春天的地藏灵，刚刚冬眠醒来，看见了这个美丽的世界。: I am the Ksitigarbha Spirit in spring. I just woke up from hibernation and I saw this beautiful world.
夏季的夜晚，浮在水面上的莲散发出幽静的香气，蟋蟀在池塘边和青蛙争鸣……: On summer nights, the lotus floating on the water emits a quiet scent. The crickets and frogs are singing by the pond...
人有聚有散，月有圆有缺。: People may meet and part, just like the moon being bright and dim.
许多人不喜欢冬天，觉得寒冷，但我认为冬天才是最温柔的季节。: Many people don't like winter since they feel cold. But I think that winter is the most gentle season.
他们四个是樱花城的地藏灵，秀明利用他们的灵力制作了封印。: The four of them are the Ksitigarbha Spirits of the Sakura City. Chomin used their spiritual power to make the seals.
如果能回答他们的问题，他们也许会愿意解开封印。: If you can answer their questions, They may be willing to unlock the seal.
真不知道这些神灵，为什么会帮助秀明。: Really don't know why these gods would help Chomin.
我……连问题都听不懂……: I... I can't even understand the question...
你看天水之国的樱花是不是很美，这种美妙的颜色，我们应该给它取什么名字呢？: The sakura in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water are beautiful, right? What words should we use to name this beautiful color?
我觉得这个名字不太合适啊。: I don't think this name is appropriate.
樱粉，樱粉，樱花的粉色，这个名字真好听，那么这种颜色就叫做樱粉吧。: The sakura pink. It means the pink of the sakura. Sounds great. Let's call this color sakura pink.
什么解开封印？如果是你的话，我愿意解开封印。: Unlock the seal? If it is you, I am willing to unlock the seal.
蝉鸣、夜雨、荷花和艳阳组成的夏天，是我最爱的风景……: The summer that consists of chirpings, night rain, lotuses and sun is my favorite scenery...
有些时候，秀明和小樱会陪我一起度过这段时间。: Sometimes Chomin and Sakura would spend this period with me.
想要解除封印就回答我的问题吧！: Answer my question if you want to unlock the seal!
你知道夏天容易下雨，什么可以用来挡雨呢？: You know it often rains in the summer, Then what can be used to make a shelter?
你确定吗，如果用这个应该会被淋湿吧！: Are you sure? This cannot keep the rain out!
你懂得很多啊，油纸糊的雨伞是天水之国的特色雨具，秀明还送了我一把呢。: You know a lot. The umbrella made from oil paper is a special rain gear in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water. Chomin has given me one.
回答正确问题，我帮你解除封印。: I will you unlock the seal if you correctly answer my question.
是为了封印而来吗？我没有问题想问你，不会解开封印的。: Are you here for the seal? I have no question to ask you and won't unlock the seal for you.
……我知道秀明想做什么，他对我们一直很好，我，愿意帮助他。: ... I know what Chomin wants to do. He has been very good to us. I am willing to help him.
你说得对，但是我不能违背我对朋友做出的承诺。: You are right. But I cannot violate my commitment to my friends.
击败我，封印自然会解除。: After you defeating me, the seal will be unlocked.
不再说话，闭上眼睛一动不动: Stops talking and keeps eyes close
我会解除封印，而你……: I will unlock the seal and you...
……不要让秀明做出不可挽回的事情！: ... Don't let Chomin do irreversible things!
我很喜欢这里，因为天水之国的樱花在冬天也会开放。: I like here very much because the sakura in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water also bloom in the winter.
你知道谁是天水之国航线的掌舵人吗？: Do you know who is the helmsman of the route of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water?
真是一个奇怪的船长，但是他从来不会耽误时间，对吧。: Really a strange captain, but he never delays, Right?
看来，你不是真的喜欢天水之国。: It seems that you don't really like the Kingdom of Heavenly Water.
那么，我也不耽误你的时间了。让我们一起解开封印吧。: Well, I won't delay you. Let us unlock the seal together.
樱花树下，四季之印。解！: Under the sakura tree, the seals of the four seasons. Unlock!
四个灵的封印已经解除，快去找千代子吧。: The seals of the four spirits have been unlocked. Go to Chiyoko.
你已经解决了其他两个阵法吗？: Have you solved the other two arrays?
我这里出现了一点问题，神社的阵法我已经找到了，在神社右边的灯里。: I have a little problem here. I have found the array at the shrine, in the lamp on the right side of the shrine.
可是，我不能把神社里的灯打碎，我从家族继承的神社。: However, I cannot break the lamp in the shrine. The shrine belongs to my family.
不，保护神社是我的使命。: No, protecting the shrine is my mission.
不要破怪神社的灯。: Don't shatter the lamp of the shrine.
地里传来轻微的震动，秀明的阵法应该在灯下的土地里。: There is a slight vibration from the underground. Chomin's array should be in the land under the lamp.
如果变成蚂蚁也许可以爬进泥土里，把灯下的阵法破坏。: If you turn into an ant, You may crawl into the earth and destroy the array under the lamp.
变成蚂蚁！你真聪明，我怎么没想到呢？: Turn into an ant! You are so smart. How didn't I think of it?
额……不要这样嘛，为了秀明，我什么都愿意做。: Eh... Don't be like this. For Chomin, I am willing to do anything.
不过~还是你变成蚂蚁吧。: But, it's better that you turn into an ant.
寻找到了秀明留下的法器，从土地里破坏了神社的阵法。: Found the instruments left by Chomin and destroyed the array in the shrine underground.
我们已经把秀明仪式需要用到的阵法都破坏了，剩下只需要慢慢找到他就可以了。: We have already destroyed the arrays that are needed for Chomin's ritual. The only thing left is to find him.
没有那个变态摩根，我们更顺利了，他果然是来拖后腿的！: Without that perverted Morgan, we were even smoother. He was really hindering us.
你愿意帮我找到秀明吗？: Will you help me look for Chomin?
我想，我应该好好跟他谈一谈……: I think I should talk to him...
这个震动……不太对劲，好像是，是……: This vibration... Is not quite right. It seems that it is...
这是一瓣散落在地上的樱花。: This is a sakura petal on the ground.
这竟然是秀明的木箱，带回去给千代子看看吧！: This is Chomin's box. Bring it back to Chiyoko!
闪着不详光芒的结界入口。: The enchantment entrance with ominous light.
空间的力量，可小可大。: The power of space can be big or small.
现在只要再给我[c][ffff00]500,000Zeny[-][/c]手续费，: Now just give me [c][ffff00]500, 000 Zeny[-][/c] as service charge, You can start on your road to the peak. Do you want to give them to me now?
你的Zeny似乎不够呢，你还是攒够了Zeny再来找我吧。: Your Zeny don't seem to be enough. Gain enough Zeny and then come back to me.

搜集了些从女人身上长出来的胡须，一定是长的很像男性化的女人。: This collection of female beards must surely have come from a manly woman.
在太古时代刚开始时，就有了石头的根，对路面上的石头，试着挖掘一下吧。: At the beginning of ancient times, the root of stone lay along the roadside. Try to dig it up.
一块动人的宝石，只有极少人能知晓它的用途。: A moving gem, only a few people know its use.
雷神拖尔,丢铁锤时所带的钢铁手套,很坚固看起来很有实用性,不过不能装备。: Thor, the steel gloves worn when the hammer was thrown. Although solid and practical, They can't be equipped.
在某一个时代为了拷问女人,所做的残忍拷问器具,到现在也好像能听到那女人们的惨叫声: In certain eras, cruel iron maidens was made to evoke the screams of women.
不知用途的锯齿轮子,虽然一定能用在某个地方,不过谁都不知道这到底要用在那里是个大: It is not known what the purpose of this saw is for. It can probably be used in a certain place, but no one knows what will happen afterwards...
好想偷个懒，安静的睡个觉——给人就是这样的感觉呢。: Really makes you want a lazy and quiet snooze.
把鱼所拥有的灵魂抓起来,封印在瓶子里面,透明的蓝色光芒非常漂亮。: The soul of a fish sealed in a bottle. The transparent blue light is very beautiful.
把鸟流下来的口水，搜集在长长的瓶子里。: Bird saliva collected in a long bottle.
把强而有力的熊的筋，搜集捆绑在一起，拥有很强的弹力造型。: Strong sinews of bear bundled together for extra elasticity.
象征着太阳神的明珠，闪烁着黄金光芒非常刺眼。: Symbolizing the pearl of the sun god, its flashing golden light is very dazzling.
灵魂所吐出来的呼吸声,活人碰到这声音时,全身会毛骨悚然而且还会冻冰呢。: The sound of a soul's chilling breath. When it touches a living being, it petrifies and freezes to the bone.

经过极为长久岁月带有魔力的树枝，它的神秘力量可以召唤来任何有生命的东西。召唤出的: After an extremely long time it developed magical branches with a mysterious power that can summon anything living. The summoned monster can survive for up to 10 minutes. (Can only be used in guild territory.)

把揉好的粳米粉捏成恰当的大小，塞满馅之后做成半圆形状再用松针覆盖的糕。恢复最大H: Rice flour kneaded to the appropriate size, filled with stuffing, made into a semi-circular shape, and covered with pine needles. Can restore up to 10% of HP. During PVP periods, there will be reduced HP Regen. During CD periods, the effect will be greater.

虽然模样和香气有点怪怪的，可是吃下这个的话会有种绝对不会死的决心。VIT + 5: Strange as it looks and smells, eating this would bring an unforgettable feeling. VIT ＋5, Max HP ＋500. This effect lasts 30 minutes.

可以在婚礼流程种丢给其他玩家。: This can be thrown to other players during a wedding.

波利岛好玩吗？哇！你拍了好多照片啊，快让我看看。: Is the Poring Island funny? Wow! You took a lot of photos. Let me see.
如果有机会，我也想去波利岛参加大乱斗。: If there is a chance, I also want to go to the Poring Island to participate in the fight.
这些照片送给我一张吧，明天来找我，我会告诉你关于姜饼城的故事~: Give one of these photos to me. Come back to me tomorrow. I will tell you about the story of the Gingerbread City.
是不是很期待姜饼城之旅呀，冒险者，你准备好了要去姜饼城吗？: Are you looking forward to the trip to the Gingerbread City, adventurer. Are you ready to go to the Gingerbread City?
那你还等着什么呢？我可没空一直等你哦。: Then what are you waiting for? I don't have time to wait for you.
哎呀，我忘记跟你说了，记得帮我收集一些凝固的雪花哦，如果不知道去哪里收集可以请教: Heck, I forgot to tell you. Remember to collect some solidified snowflakes for me. If you don't know where you can collect them, consult Mr. Puzs. He is very enthusiastic!
姜饼城的雪景如此纯白，让人觉得仿佛置身在童话世界，冒险者你觉得呢？: The snow of the Gingerbread City is so white that people feel as though they are in a fairy tale world. Adventurer, how do you think about it?
你找我有什么事情吗？: What can I do for you?
这件事啊，姜饼城有3个地方有最美的凝固的雪花。冰河的石头旁，白色教堂的花圈下，玩: Well, the Gingerbread City has the most beautiful solidified snowflakes in 3 places. They're next to the glacier stones, Under the white church wreath and the entrance to the Toy Factory.
去这三个地方就可以找到凝固的雪花了！: Go to these three places and you can find the solidified snowflakes!
地上有一株神秘的草，它的根部好像有凝固的雪花在发光。: There is a mysterious grass on the ground. Its roots seem to have solidified snowflakes glowing.
在神秘草株的根部发现了凝固的雪花，快把雪花带给美羽吧！: Found solidified snowflakes at the roots of the mysterious grass. Bring the snowflakes to Meenu!
我看见了什么！凝固的雪花，没想到你真的找到了！我太感动了！: What's this! Solidified snowflakes! You really found them! I am so touched!
你还喜欢姜饼城吗？冒险者，在你离开的日子里，圣诞老人打开了通往姜饼城的通道。: Do you like the Gingerbread City? Adventurer, Santa Claus opened the passage to the Gingerbread City when you were not here.
我有点担心你见不到那里的美景呢，如今你能回来，我真是太开心了。: I was a bit worried that you couldn't see the beautiful scenes there. Now you've come back. I'm so happy.
好希望可以一直听到你带来的冒险的新消息。: I hope I can always hear news about your adventures from you.
明天，请你来找我，我有一件重要的事情想跟你说。: Please come to me tomorrow. I have an important thing to tell you.
其实并不是我有事情找你，是卡卡罗，他说好久没见到你了，有些想念你，有些话希望跟你: In fact, it wasn't me that looks for you. It was Kakaro. He said that he hadn't seen you for a long time. He missed you and wanted to talk to you.
你有时间吗？如果有时间，可以去找卡卡罗哦。: Do you have the time? If you do, You can go to find Kakaro.
去跟他聊一聊吧，大家都很久没见到你了，很想你呢！: Go and talk to him. They haven't seen you for a long time and are all missing you!
嘿，冒险者，真高兴又能见到你。前几天我听美羽说你重新开始冒险了，我还不相信，没想: Hey, adventurer, I'm so happy to see you again. A few days ago I heard from Meenu that you restarted your adventure. I still didn't believe it. I didn't expect it to be true.
想当初你跟塞尼亚一起来冒险者公会报道，还是我接待了你们。: On that day, You and Cenia came to the Adventurer's Guild and I received you.
她选择成为一个剑士，你也有了自己的归属。: She chose to become a swordsman and you have your own choice.
没想到你这么快就放弃成为一个冒险者了，是我们公会能提供给你的帮助不多吗？还是冒险: I didn't expect you to give up to be an adventurer so soon. Did our guild provide you with too little help? Or is it too hard to adventure?
我有一些问题想要问你，等你做好了准备以后来回答我的问题吧。: I have some questions to ask you. When you are ready, come back and answer my questions.
你准备好了回答我的问题吗？: Are you ready to answer my questions?
冒险者，我听见了你的心声！这样我就放心了，期待在普隆德拉经常见到你。: Adventurer, I heard your voice! This way I feel relieved! I'm looking forward to seeing you in Prontera.
快把这个消息告诉美羽吧，我相信如果他知道了，肯定也会非常高兴的。: Tell Meenu this message. I believe if she knows it, she will be very happy.
你决定了吗，要重新开始冒险？真是太棒了！: Did you decide to restart your adventure? That's great!
也不枉我像你介绍了这么多新鲜的事物。: It's worthy for me to have introduced so many new things to you.
我们会努力的把RO世界建设的更好，希望你在这里的每一天都开开心心~: We will work hard to build the RO world better. I hope you will be happy every day here.
真可惜，真希望可以经常在普隆德拉见到你。: What a pity! I really hope I can see you often in Prontera.
吾乃玩具之主宰者，大奥数法师，狂骨。: I'm Frenzy Bone, the master of toys.
是来参加狂欢节最后一个项目的吗？没想到前两个游戏你都顺利通过了。: Do you come to participate in the last game of Carnival? I didn't expect that you successfully passed the previous two games.
不要以为我会让你这么容易就通过狂欢节！: Don't think that I will make it easy for you to complete all the games of Carnival!
我的移形换影游戏可不是那么容易通过的。: My shift game is not so easy to pass.
那么，向我证明你的能力，我需要20个小丑把戏才能布置游戏。: Well, prove your ability to me. I need 20 Clown Games to arrange the game.
嗯……没想到你的实力如此高，很好，你这样的挑战者，就是我狂骨想要的人！: Hmm... I haven't expected that your strength is so great. Good! You are the challenger I want!
那么废话不多说，我们就开始游戏吧！: Let's stop talking nonsense and start the game now!
我会快速的在地图上移形换影，记住我所有出现的位置。: I will quickly shift on the map. Remember all my positions.
按照我的脚步和顺序重复我的路径，如果可以记住所有的路，重复我的步骤。: Repeat my path in my footsteps and order. If you can remember all the paths, repeat my steps.
我就认同你的能力！: Then I will recognize your ability!
你需要再听我讲述游戏规则吗？: Do you need to listen to me again about the rules of the game?
看来你已经胸有成竹，来吧！: It seems that you are ready to go. Come on!
那么，挑战者，我将向你演示游戏的玩法，希望你可以好好学习，经过一次学习以后，我们: Well, Challenger, I will show you how to play the game. I hope you can learn it hard. After that, We will officially start the game!
看好了，这是我站的第一个位置。: Look, this is my first position.
这是我站的第二个位置，现在你可以试着站在我走的点上！: This is my second position. Now you can try to stand at the position which I was at!
很棒！已经正确的记住了第一个位置。: Great! You have found the first position.
看清楚了我的身影吗？你应该了解怎么玩游戏了吧。: Have you seen me? You've understood how to play the game now, right?
[c][ffff00]如果不记得我的位置，也可以四处乱走找一找，如果找到了也算你: [c][ffff00]If you can't recall my position, you can go around and look for it. If you find it, it counts! [-][/c]
毕竟运气也是实力的一部分！: After all, luck is also a part of strength!
不要随意走动，看清我的行动！: Don't walk around! Look at my actions!
最后一个挑战了，这次我将进行[c][ffff00]5次移形换影[-][/c]，务: The last challenge. This time I will perform [c][ffff00]5 shifts[-][/c]. Be sure to look at my positions!
嗯，我果然没有看错你。去告诉玩具小姐姐，你已经完成了所有的游戏挑战，成为了玩具狂: Well, You didn't disappoint me. Go and tell Miss Toy that you have completed all the game challenges and become the king of Toy Carnival!
没想到啊，你这么快就完成了挑战，看来你的观察能力和记忆力都是万中挑一的！: I didn't expect that you would complete the challenge so quickly. It seems that your observation ability and memory are the best of the best!
这是你应得的奖励，希望你喜欢我们的狂欢节哦~: This is your reward. Hope you like our Carnival.
原来这就是奇点球啊……: So this is the Miracle Ball...
想要更多华丽的场景和可爱的时装？哼哼~~: Want more gorgeous scenes and cute clothes? Hum!

1.成为导师的条件：Base等级达到85级，且完成了导师任务的冒险者。\n2.成:
1. Conditions for becoming a mentor: Base level reaches 85 and complete the Mentor Quest. 
2. Conditions for becoming a student: Base level is between 10 and 85 and have no mentor yet. 
3. Mentor Quest: The player whose Base level reaches 85 has no mentor can go to the [Adventurer Announcement Advanced Mentor] Terch to accept the Mentor Quest. 
4. Number of students: Each mentor can have up to three adventurers at the same time as his own students. 
5. Student graduation: When the student's Base level reaches 85, he can go to Prontera to find the [Adventurer Announcement Advanced Mentor] Tataji to accept the Graduation Ceremony Quest. 
6. Later when the level is changed, if the level is not reached, the mentor-student relationship will be retained. But after all the mentor-student relationships are cancelled, you will not be able to continue to be a mentor.

战利品规则：\n1.战利品预览仅是预览，具体冒险结束后获得的奖励与预览存在一定出:
Rules of loot: 
1. The loot preview is just a preview. The rewards obtained after the adventure are not the same with the ones in preview. 
2. Each zone's adventures can be repeated, Consuming Adventure Meatballs and daily fight duration to start the adventure and gain specific rewards and pet EXP in the zone. 
3. Adventure loot in each area is affected by the adventure efficiency. Adventure efficiency is determined by the level of the adventure zone, the pet's level and number, Intimacy, the relationship between the pet and the zone, and also by the development status of the adventurer. The higher the efficiency, the more rewards you can gain in each adventure.

使用妙勒尼山脉特有的红茶作为原料，通过文火煎制的暖心饮料，加入妙勒尼山脉特有的蜂: Drink the warm drink stewed over a gentle heat with the special black tea and honey on Mjolnir Mountains and you will recover 1500-2000 HP.
在滚烫的暖心红茶里加入爱心型的小冰块，瞬间让红茶变为冰凉的口感，成为最适合夏日的: Add heart-shaped ice cubes in the warm black tea to cool the drink, Making it the best drink for summer. Drinking it restores 10% of Max HP
在滚烫的暖心红茶里加入普隆德拉牛奶厂生产的浓醇牛奶，奶味和茶味紧密的结合在一起，: Add Prontera's milk to the warm black tea, the milk and tea are closely combined to create an attractive taste. Drinking it restores 20% of Max HP
使用妙勒尼山脉特有的绿茶作为原料，用最甘甜的泉水泡制出来，清甜的泉水搭配绿茶特有: The slightly bitter green tea is made of the special green tea leaves on Mjolnir Mountains and the sweetest spring water. Drink it and you will recover 100-150 Sp.
在滚烫的暖心绿茶里加入星星型的小冰块，苦涩的茶味被冰爽的口感冲淡了，只留下沁人心: Add star-shaped ice cubes to the warm green tea. The bitter taste is diluted by the ice, Leaving only a refreshing sense of coolness. This drink helps restore 10% of Max SP.
在滚烫的暖心绿茶里加入原味冰淇淋，甜蜜的冰淇淋飘在浓茶上，一口喝下去只有浓郁的奶: Add ice cream into the Hot Green Tea. You will only taste the flavor of thick cream left in the tea. Drink it and you will recover 20% Max SP.
研磨斐扬南部黄金季节的小麦成粉，搭配伊斯鲁德海边生长的野生可可豆，制成美味的麦香: The delicious Wheat Cocoa is made from the wheat of the best season in Payon that is ground into flour and the wild cacao grew along the sea of Izlude. Drink it and you will recover 10% Max HP and Max SP.
将大陆上最知名的糖果屋熬制的焦糖混入美味的可可中，只要一口就能让冒险者步入天堂，: Mix the tasty coco with the caramel made in the most famous candy house on the continent. After taking only a sip of it, adventurers will feel like walking in the heaven and even the cloud there will look like caramel. Drink it and you will recover 20% Max HP and Max SP.
经过了12小时的发酵制成的能量饮品，混合在最烫的热可可里，尝一口就能让人“哇”叫: Mix the hottest coco with the energy drink which has been fermented for 12 hours. Anyone who take a sip of it will be wowed. Drink it and you will recover 50% Max HP and Max SP.
撒上特殊吸魔甜粉的绵绵冰，软绵绵的口感能让人的心都融化，食用后能够使受到的所有魔: The ice covered with Magic Absorbing Sugar. It is so soft that people eat it will feel like being melted. Eat it and M.Dmg you suffer will all be reduced to 1 point for 8 seconds. All ice takes 1 minute of CD.
参入特殊体能强化剂的绵绵冰，软绵绵的口感能让人的心都融化，食用后能够使受到的所有: The ice mixed with a special energy enhancer. It is so soft that people eat it will feel like being melted. Eat it and Physical Damage you suffer will all be reduced to 1 point for 8 seconds. All ice takes 1 minute of CD.
加入无敌小颗粒的绵绵冰，软绵绵的刨冰加上小颗粒脆脆的口感，食用后能够使自身受到的: The ice mixed with invincible granules. It combines the softness of ice and the crispy mouthfeel of granules. Eat it and the Damage you suffer will all be reduced to 1 point for 3 seconds. All ice takes 1 minute of CD.
将浓浓的芒果酱淋在龙鳞形状的华夫饼上，能让人拥有巨龙的防御能力，3分钟内所有伤害: By pouring mango sauce on the dragon-scale waffle, This food gives you the defense of giant dragon. Within 3 minutes, All damage reduces by 10%. This effect cannot stack up with other dragon-scale waffles, and is not influenced by death.
将浓浓的草莓酱淋在龙鳞形状的华夫饼上，能让人拥有巨龙的防御能力，3分钟内所有伤害: By pouring strawberry sauce on the dragon-scale waffle, This food gives you the defense of giant dragon. Within 3 minutes, All damage reduces by 20%. This effect cannot stack up with other dragon-scale waffles, and is not influenced by death.
将各种果酱淋在龙鳞形状的华夫饼上，能让人拥有巨龙的防御能力，3分钟内所有伤害降低: By pouring various fruit sauces on the dragon-scale waffle, This food gives you the defense of giant dragon. Within 3 minutes, All damage reduces by 30%. The effect cannot stack up with other dragon-scale waffles, and is not influenced by death.
斐扬酒家的老板使用翠竹酿制的清酒，加入新鲜竹叶的汁水，饮用后能获得物理攻击增加5: The clear wine brewed with green bamboo by the boss of Payon Tavern mixed with fresh juice of bamboo leaves. Drink it and your Atk will be upped by 5% for 15 minutes. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other sake. Death will not affect the effect.
斐扬酒家的老板使用翠竹酿制的清酒，原汁原味的纯露，饮用后能获得物理攻击增加10%: The original juice of the clear wine brewed with green bamboo by the boss of Payon Tavern. Drink it and your Atk will be upped by 10% for 15 minutes. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other sake. Death will not affect the effect.
斐扬酒家的老板使用翠竹酿制的清酒，使用特殊方式提纯的高浓度饮品，饮用后能获得物理: The clear wine brewed with green bamboo and purified in a special way by the boss of Payon Tavern. Drink it and your Atk will be upped by 15% for 15 minutes. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other sake. Death will not affect the effect.
吉芬的魔药师使用艾草压榨出的青汁，小瓶包装，饮用后能够获得魔法攻击增加5%的增益: A small bottle of grass juice made by magic pharmacists in Geffen. Drink it and your M.Atk will be upped by 5% for 15 minutes. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other grass juice. Death will not affect the effect.
吉芬的魔药师使用艾草压榨出的青汁，中等分量，饮用后能够获得魔法攻击增加10%的增: A middle-sized bottle of grass juice made by magic pharmacists in Geffen. Drink it and your M.Atk will be upped by 10% for 15 minutes. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other grass juice. Death will not affect the effect.
吉芬的魔药师使用艾草压榨出的青汁，豪饮一大口后能够获得魔法攻击增加15%的增益效: The grass juice made by magic pharmacists in Geffen. Drink a mouthful of it and your M.Atk will be upped by 15% for 15 minutes. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other grass juice. Death will not affect the effect.
涂抹着能够短时间提高速度的奶油，如果吃下这块蛋糕，可以让人在10秒内提高100%: The cake covered with the cream that has the effect of speedup for a short period. Eat it and your speed will be upped by 100% for 10 seconds. CD: 1 minute.
洒满了能够激发行动能力的糖霜，如果吃下这块蛋糕，可以让人在2分钟以内提高20%的: The cake covered with the sugar that can promote one's mobility. Eat it and your speed will be upped by 20% for 2 minutes. CD: 3 minutes.
外表可爱的小蛋糕，里面却恶作剧般地填满奇怪的小糖果，吃下去能让人怒意爆发，持续6: The seemingly cute piece of cake full of strange candies. Eat it and you will feel angry. Your auto attack will cause 200 points of True Dmg for 60 seconds continuously.
猫薄荷草制作的甜浆，饮用后能散发出猫薄荷的味道，吸引一名佣兵猫忠心地跟随，连续使: Tea made from catnip. Drink it and you will emit a smell of catnip so that a KittyCat will follow you loyally. The type of KittyCat will change randomly if you drink the tea continuously. The cat will not hold a position in the Party.
英灵最喜欢的蜂蜜佳酿，饮用后能召唤一个”弓手英灵“跟随攻击，持续5分钟，召唤者枚: Ghost's favorite honey. Drink it and you can summon an "Archer Ghost" to be your companion for 5 minutes. If the summoner makes auto attack three times, the Ghost will do 200 of True Dmg toward the target. The Ghost will not disappear after death.
能让人有真视能力的糖浆，饮用后在指定的10米范围内寻找并暴露敌方隐匿目标，持续3: The syrup that can better your vision. Drink it and you will find enemies hidden in 10 meters for 30 seconds. CD: 2 minutes.
饮用后能够获得领导能力的糖浆，一旦服用可以吹响战斗集结的号角，即刻将参加公会战的: The syrup that provides you with leadership. Drink it and you will be able to blow the battle horn. Then your Party members in the Guild Battle will be Teleported to your side.
能让人拥有隐身能力的糖浆，饮用后立即进入隐匿状态不被敌人发现，在隐匿的状态下降低: The syrup that can make one invisible. Drink it and you will be hidden, so will not be found by enemies. Meanwhile your Move Spd will be reduced for 30 seconds.
纯净的金色糖浆，饮用后能免疫所有异常状态，包括定身、石化、冰冻、眩晕等持续10秒: Pure golden syrup. Drink it and you will immunize debuff including Slow Atk, Stone Curse, Freezing and Stunning Attack for 10 seconds. CD: 60 seconds.
冰波利形状的糖果，吃下去有冰冰的感觉，1分钟以内使自己受到水属性伤害－100%，: The candy in the shape of Marin. Eat the icy candy and the Water Dam you take will be reduced 100% in 1 minute. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other kinds of candy. Death will not affect the effect.
熔岩波利形状的糖果，吃下去有火焰燃烧的感觉，1分钟以内使自己受到火属性伤害－10: The candy in the shape of Magmaring. Eat the candy that has a flaming mouthfeel and the Fire Dam you take will be reduced 100% in 1 minute. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other kinds of candy. Death will not affect the effect.
土波利形状的糖果，吃下去有古怪的泥土感，1分钟以内使自己受到地属性伤害－100%: The candy in the shape of Drops. Eat the candy that has a strange earthy taste and the Earth Dam you take will be reduced 100% in 1 minute. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other kinds of candy. Death will not affect the effect.
顽皮波利形状的糖果，吃下去能获得顽皮的能力，风一般的速度根本追不上，1分钟以内使: The candy in the shape of Naughty Poring. Eat the candy and you will become extremely naughty that even the wind cannot catch up with you. The Wind Dam you take will be reduced 100% in 1 minute. The effect cannot be stacked up with that of other kinds of candy. Death will not affect the effect.
翻糖蛋糕制作的守护者，薄薄的糖衣包裹着绵软口感的小人偶，吃下去会变成具有范围减速: Fondant Guardian. Eat the soft small figure covered with thin fondant and you will turn into a guardian who is capable of Ranged Deceleration for 5 minutes. Death will not remove the effect.
翻糖蛋糕制作的小勇士，薄薄的糖衣包裹着绵软口感的蛋糕，吃下去会变成进攻的小勇士，: Fondant Hero. Eat the soft cake covered with thin fondant and you will turn into a hero who is good at attacking. A auto attack will lead to another 250 points of True Dmg at an Attack Speed upped to 200% for 5 minutes. Death will not remove the effect.
创造这个世界的天地树之果叶，有着幻想般的新鲜口味，对于身体有着意想不到的效果，使: Berries and leaves of Yggdrasil that creates the world. They taste fantastically fresh and have unexpected effect on your body. Use it and your HP will all be recovered immediately. Also the time of using CD in PVP will get longer.
以红色药水为主要原料，精炼提纯制成的高精度药水，使用纤细的玻璃瓶保存。: It is the highly qualified potion refined mainly from the Red Potion and saved in a fine glass bottle.
以赤色药水为主要原料，精炼提纯制成的高精度药水，使用纤细的玻璃瓶保存。: It is the highly qualified potion refined mainly from the Orange Potion and saved in a fine glass bottle.
以黄色药水为主要原料，精炼提纯制成的高精度药水，使用纤细的玻璃瓶保存。: It is the highly qualified potion refined mainly from the Yellow Potion and saved in a fine glass bottle.
以白色药水为主要原料，精炼提纯制成的高精度药水，使用纤细的玻璃瓶保存。: It is the highly qualified potion refined mainly from the White Potion and saved in a fine glass bottle.
以蓝色药水为主要原料，精炼提纯制成的高精度药水，使用纤细的玻璃瓶保存。: It is the highly qualified potion refined mainly from the Blue Potion and saved in a fine glass bottle.
危险的炼金制品，如果点火后丢出，落地的范围会变成火海。: Dangerous alloy. If you throw it after ignition, You will cause a sea of flame.
受到这瓶药水攻击的对象，全身都会受到严重的伤害，不准对人投掷。: The one injured by the potion will suffer from serious harm all over the body, so don't throw it on persons.
装有噬人植物的玻璃瓶，投掷在地上时会瞬间长出噬人植物，对靠近自己的生物，会主动攻: A glass bottle filled with a carnivorous plant. Throw it on the ground and you can grow a carnivorous plant that will attack and eat any creature near it.
投掷出去时会自动在瓶子里启动刺锤装置，如果有人不小心踏上去，就会变成牺牲者。: Throw it and a hammer will be set in the bottle. The one who stamps on it carelessly will be killed.
闪动着迷人光芒，让人眼睛陶醉的药物之瓶。: A glittering bottle of potion that enchants people.
一种具有特殊香味的刺激性液体，具有易燃、易挥发的特性，经常作为溶剂配制各类型的药: A pungent liquid with a special fragrance. It is a flammable and volatile liquid that is often used as a solvent to make a potion.
经过了大炼金术士加持的特殊药剂，可以帮助生命体重新领悟技能，重置生命体的技能点。: A potion blessed by the Great Alchemist. It can help you rediscover yourself and reset your Skill Pts.
透明又坚固的特制玻璃瓶，可以抵御强酸与强碱的腐蚀，最适合用于保存各种炼金药剂。: A firm and transparent glass bottle. It can resist corrosion caused by any strong acid and alkali and is suitable for storing alchemistic potions.
经过铁匠的锤炼而成的贵重金属，使用后，可以将身上的所有破损装备和武器修复，并对其: A precious metal made by Blacksmith. Use it and all your damaged items and weapons will be repaired. They will also be protected for 1 second.

吟游诗人代代传唱的神话中经常出现的幻之生物。比起生物，称呼其为【幻想】本身更为直: It is the imaginary creature often mentioned in the minstrel's myth. Compared to "creature", [fantasy] is a better word to describe it. In legend, she will turn into a giant Rainbow Bridge to link [Asgard], the place where Gods and Goddesses live, With [Midgarts], the world of human beings.
能够刺穿风暴的烈枪，采用了最顶级的红铜枪柄和雪花白银枪尖，十分锋利。: A spear that can cut through storms. It is very sharp consisting of the best red metal body and silver tip.
盗贼克克里曾向世人宣布要偷取大法师梅林随身携带的匕首，却被精明的梅林识破他的诡计: Kerry, the thief, declared that he would steal the dagger of Merlin, the Warlock, but always failed because Merlin was too astute to cheat. As he wanted to give up, he got a secret present from Merlin. Merlin gave his dagger to Kerry. From then on, the dagger always stayed with Kerry till Fagris, the legendary robber, stole it. After that, the dagger was never found. (Better used as the weapon skin)
精灵大长老德库里的盾牌，传说中德库里是一名崇尚和平的长老，任何与他争斗的人都会被: Elf Elder Decurry's shield. Legend has it that Decurry was a peace-loving elder, and anyone who fought with him would be influenced by his love for peace. But there is another legend that Decurry's shield had the blessing of the God of Nature. As long as he held up the shield, No attack could harm him, so he was fearless. This shield is also called Peace Maker by the elves. (Recommended to use it as a weapon appearance.)
“喵”不要听见喵咪叫的绵软软，实际上可能实在骂你哦……（铲屎的多久没洗头发了，臭: "Meow!" The cat meows softly, in fact, it may be cursing you... (How long have you not shampooed? Stinky!)
高级的乌绒和金线织就的魔法帽，注入了月神之力，赐予最优秀的冒险家！: A magic hat woven from advanced velvet and gold threads, with the power of the Luna. It's for the best adventurer!
我就是要淹死在草莓布丁里，怎么滴吧~【作者：天使不哭~】: I just want to drown in the strawberry pudding, so what? [Author: Tian Shi Bu Ku]
金色的荷包蛋加上培根真的很美味啦~~~！【作者：周魃】: The golden poached eggs and bacon are really delicious! [Author: Zhou Ba]
秋天到了，冬天还远吗？软绵绵的棉花糖耳罩带来初恋般的温暖..【作者：媛小猫】: Autumn has come. Is winter far away? Soft cotton candy earmuffs bring the warmth like first love... [Author: Yuan Xiao Mao]
呐~我把月亮送给你好不好~~~: Well~How about I give you the moon~~~
感觉能冲破一切阻碍的发型！: A hairstyle that seems to be able to break all barriers!
拥有能将飓风撕裂般强度的发型！: A hairstyle that got strength to split the hurricane!
如逆风而上一般不羁的发型！: A hairstyle that's as unruly as going against the wind!
叮~你已经复活啦~~请继续战斗下去吧！: Tinkle~ You have been revived~~!Please keep on fighting!
同女神小姐姐一般温柔优雅的发型！: A hairstyle that's as gentle and graceful as a goddess!
愿幸运与你同在~: May good fortune be with you~
哼~你要是敢欺负我的话就把你的武器变成青蛙哦！: Humph~If you dare to bully me, I will turn your weapon into a frog!
曾经参加过的战斗都不会忘记，曾经并肩作战的队友会一直在心底，脸上虽然没有表情，但: Those battles will not be forgotten and those teammates will always be in the bottom of heart. Although there is no expression on his face, scar is telling the story.
猫奴必备“背”带上主子和口粮出发去冒险！【作者：跌倒的西瓜汁】: Cat slaves must bring their cats and food in adventures! [Author: Tumbled Watermelon Juice]
黑暗料理包裹是每一个黑暗料理师都梦寐以求的装备。铁匠运用尼伯龙根打造的黑暗炒锅，: Dark Cuisine Pack is the equipment that every dark cuisine cook dreams of. The Dark Pan made from Nibelungen by a blacksmith combines the arcana of alchemists with the poison of assassins in which the knife named "Tail" and a flag representing Dark Cuisine are inserted. [Author: CrazyRyo]
奥尔露恩代替英灵殿赐予冒险者的奖励，亡者引渡，淡蓝色的灵魂火焰划过的路径，即是英: The award for adventurers given by Orloum instead of Valhalla. The path shown by light blue soul flame to guide the dead is where the ghosts will go. Valhalla also welcomes the ones who can see the flame.
是电是光是那一道火花，那是爱恋的视线，是倾慕的汪洋，一道凝结的光射穿美食之国的门: It is the sparks of love and worship in eyes that go through the gate of the nation of cate. [Author: Jacqueline the Sheila]
古城克雷斯特汉姆覆灭，巴罗门特决定牺牲自己动用伊米尔心脏碎片的力量改变古城的宿命: Glast Heim was destryoed. Varmunt decided to change the fate of Glast Heim by using the power of Yimir Heart Shards at the cost of his life, but Fortune Kim didn't allow him to change history. So he summoned elite adventurers in order to stop the tragedy from happening. They froze Varmunt's time and erased his memory everytime, Causing me to relive the safe moment in a Time Rift over and over again.
奥莉薇亚有着一双灵气十足的大眼睛，麦斯是她的青梅竹马，一天麦斯带奥莉薇亚出城看星: Olivia had a pair of big eyes. Mads was her childhood friend. One day, Mads brought Olivia outside the city to see stars, but encountered a thunderstorm. Both their carriage and themselves fell into a cold lake. Mads died due to the accident, while Olivia became blind. When she woke up in a hospital, a priest told her that she was so lucky that there was a suitable pair of eyes for her. When she restored her eyesight, the priest gave her a bronze mirror. Olivia could not stop crying when she saw herself in the mirror. If you have the item, give it to Olivia on Toy Factory 2F.
蕾拉和她年仅六岁的妹妹正在参加婶婶的葬礼，在葬礼上，蕾拉对一个从未谋面的英俊的弓: Lola had a crush on an unknown handsome archer at her aunt's funeral when she and her six-year-old sister attended the funeral. Lola was an introverted girl and did not speak a word to him. The young man left a Goatskin Quiver at the funeral. Lola carried it without telling anyone. After the funeral, Lola took advantage of the bag to inquire about the young archer, but could not know where he was. A month later, Lola's younger sister died. She met the archer that she missed so much at her sister's funeral. When Lola returned the bag to the young man, she said, "Sorry, I kept it carefully, but still lost one." If you have the item, Give it to Lola on Toy Factory 2F.
妮可儿在一户富裕人家长大，妈妈却独宠哥哥十分排挤她，不仅虐待她，还让她为家中做许: Nicole grew up in a wealthy family, but her mother only spoiled her elder brother. She not only mistreated Nicole, but made her do many household chores as well. However, a poor woman living at the entrance of the village was very kind to Nicole and often gave her some cherries secretly. One day, the woman gave Nicole a Crystal Rose, Telling her that there was a Snow Elf who could satisfy one desire living in it and Nicole could wish to be happy forever. Nicole's mother hit her cruelly for she came back home late. Nicole cried and her tears dropped on the rose. A Snow Elf really flew out of the rose. Nicole forgot what the woman told her because of hatred and wished that her family would all die. On the second morning, when Nicole woke up, she found her father, Mother and elder brother were still alive. She suddenly felt regretful and cried, Asking the Snow Elf if her wish could not become true, but she was told it was too late. The cherries the woman gave her yesterday scattered on the ground, Turning the snow red. If you have the item, Give it to Nicole on Toy Factory 2F.
唐纳的母亲是个穷苦的纺织工，随着圣诞节即将到来，唐纳要求母亲给自己买一个兔子玩偶: Donner's mother was a poor weaver. As Christmas was coming, Donner asked his mother for a rabbit doll. The rabbit doll on sale was too expensive for his mother to buy, so she told Donner that she would make a doll as cute as the rabbit by herself. But Donner only liked the one on sale. He began to cry and scream. His mother felt so helpless that she had to steal the rabbit doll, but she was discovered by the retailer. The retailer did not ask her for money, but hacked one of her arms. On Christmas Eve, Donner got the rabbit doll he wanted, but did not know that his mother could never weave again. Samuey, An apprentice of Talen, a toy designer on Toy Factory 1F, Is searching for 10 Shards of this kind.
格兰迪是领主家的小童工，领主很喜欢这个机灵的小家伙。每次格兰迪做完工，领主都会奖: Grundy was a child labor of a lord. The lord liked the clever boy very much. Every time Grundy finished his work, the lord would give him a handful of sweet jelly beans as a reward. But Grundy did not like hard work. He wanted the reward even when he did no work, so asked his shadow to work for him. Grundy and his shadow were exactly alike and even the lord could not distinguish between them. The shadow replaced Grundy gradually day by day. One day, the shadow mixed a poisonous jelly bean when he gave Grundy the reward. Samuey, An apprentice of Talen, a toy designer on Toy Factory 1F, Is searching for 10 Shards of this kind.
一个叫卡伦的农村女孩在她母亲死后被一个富有的老妇人收养了。从前，卡伦只有破旧的木: After her mother died, Caren, a girl born in a village, Was adopted by a wealthy old woman. Before, Caren only had worn-out wooden shoes, but after being adopted, she got a pair of highly qualified personalized red dance shoes bought by her foster mother. Caren often wore the red dance shoes in solemn churches ignoring etiquettes. She even wore the shoes to join parties when her foster mother got sick. One day, An old woman told Caren something strange at the entrance of a church. Then Caren could not take off her shoes and only had to dance continuously regardless of time or weather. Caren had to ask an executioner for help. She wanted him to hack her feet. The executioner did what Caren wanted him to do, but the dance shoes never stopped. The dancing shoes disappeared at night together with Caren's feet. Samuey, An apprentice of Talen, a toy designer on Toy Factory 1F, Is searching for 10 Shards of this kind.
马克的爷爷卧床不起，病情严重，他绝望地唤出了恶魔，说若能使爷爷病愈，他便献给恶魔: Marc's grandfather was so seriously ill that Marc had to summon Demon and said he would gave Demon 1, 000 kilograms of gold dust if his grandfather recovered. Demon cured Marc's grandfather with magic. After his grandfather recovered, Marc did not thank Demon with real gold dust. Instead, He burned yellow dust on an altar and murmured, "Demon, I already fulfilled my promise. " Demon told little Marc in his dream that he would find real gold dust at the seaside. When Marc woke up, He felt so happy and ran to the seaside directly. However, What he met was violent pirates. Marc was caught and sold. His selling price was just... 1, 000 kilograms of gold dust. Samuey, An apprentice of Talen, a toy designer on Toy Factory 1F, Is searching for 10 Shards of this kind.
托尼跟着哥哥出海打渔，织了一张和桌子一般大的小网。出海一天只捕到了一条鱼，垂头丧: Tony went fishing with his elder brother. They made a small net as big as a table. They only got one fish after fishing the whole day and went back home disappointedly. They put the fish in water at home. Suddenly the fish began to speak. The fish told little Tony, "the larger your net is, the more fish you can get. " After that, Tony began to weave a fishing net carefully at home. 姜饼城圣诞树上装饰用的铃铛，摇晃时会发出清脆的响声，是姜饼城的游客最喜欢的旅游纪: Bells on the Christmas tree of Gingerbread City, with a crisp sound, the favorite souvenir of tourists to Gingerbread City. Children are missing in the city, adventurers accepted Santa Claus' request to find out the truth, the suspect is the circus clown, Gal. Adventurers followed little girl Jenny to watch Gale's show. Jenny was impressed by the clown's performance. She treated Gale with a candy made by her parents. Unexpectedly, Gale ate candy and shed tears of excitement. It turned out that Gal knew Jenny's grandmother Betty. Decades ago, when they were young, Betty and Gal agreed to meet in Gingerbread City every year. Betty would give Gal her favorite candy, and Gale would bring Betty a well-prepared show. Then, because of the plot of the puppet wizard Biyu, Betty's family bankrupted, Her parents died in an accident, she had no energy to to meet Gale again. So Gale, Deceived by Bijou , Lost his soul in the long waiting time. A few decades later, Betty' s daughter, Jenny, Gave his a candy that brushed his mind, and he recalled the appointment with Betty. But Gale mistook Jenny for Betty. He thought that his beloved girl finally found him, and happily invited Jenny to watch his best performance. Wonderful show kept going on on the Gingerbread City, Watching Jenny's smile, Gale found peace in heart. But this was part of Bijou's scheme, she plots to kidnap Jenny, Threatening Santa Claus to hand over Yimir Heart Shards. Through investigation and analysis, adventurers learned about Betty and Gale's story. With Betty's help, They found Jenny and other children, and crushed Bijou 's plan. And Gale, Seeing Betty, Recalled their agreement, Broke free from the control of Bijou and found his humanity back. In an auspicious light, Gale's soul was released, and Bijou was driven out of Gingerbread City. Whenever bells on the Christmas tree ring, adventurers always think of Betty and Gale, Thinking of the snow in Gingerbread City and the story about candy.

在这个过程中，我不知怎么来到了一个仙境，仙境的拉面之神说他对我父亲的配方非常好奇: During my journey, I came to a fairyland where the god of that land was very curious about Father’s recipe and asked me to stay and learn how to make ramen.
这段时间，我去了许多地方。: I had been to a lot of places before that time.
我走过妙勒尼山脉，看见神奇的动物在山涧中饮水；我走过梦罗克的沙漠，听过吟游诗人哼: I travelled through Mjolnir Mountains and saw rare animals drinking from mountain creeks; I ventured in Morroc's deserts and heard minstrels humming ballads; I wandered past Izlude's beach and smelled the ocean from the winds.
我跟着最杰出的猎人一起狩猎，跟着最聪明的商人一起旅行，跟着最青涩的初心者一起学习: I hunted with the best hunters, Travelled with the most brilliant merchants, and learned new technologies with novices.
如今，我来到了普隆德拉修行。: Now, I am practicing in Prontera.
我希望可以早日学会制作拉面，离开仙境重新踏上寻找父亲的旅程。: I wish to learn how to cook ramen ASAP, so that I could return to my journey of finding father.
离别之际，我想留一点什么给这个美好的世界。: Before I leave, I want to contribute something to this lovely world.
所以我想把父亲的拉面配方交给有缘人，让他的拉面可以在RO大陆上传播开来哦！: So I have decided to give father’s ramen recipe to the right person, so that he can promote father’s ramen on the RO continent.
冒险者，我郑重的问你，你愿意学习我父亲的[c][ffff00]神隐拉面[-][/: Adventurer, I ask you sincerely, Would you like to learn my father’s [c][ffff00]Aori Ramen[-][/c]?
好吧……我离开的日子是[c][ffff00]2018年2月11日[-][/c]，: Well... I will be leaving on [c][ffff00]Feb. 11, 2018[-][/c]. But before that time, I will keep teaching Adventurers how to make ramen. If you ever change your mind, Just let me know!
哟西！突然之间就充满了干劲呢！让我们动手吧！: Great! I am so energized all of a sudden! Let’s get started!
制作拉面第一步要素是准备好面粉，只有精制面粉才能制作出最爽口的面条。: When making ramen, the first most step is to prepare good flour, Only fine flour can produce the tastiest noodles.

哇，这小麦的味道可真香啊，让我准备准备，把它们制作成最好的面粉。: Wow, These wheat smell so good. Let me make them into the best flour.
我听说普隆德拉南门疯兔的肉质非常鲜美，可以请你帮我找一点[c][ffff00]疯: I hear the meat of Lunatic near the Prontera South Gate tastes great, can you get some [c][ffff00]Lunatic meat[-][/c] for me?
我看见你提着肉走过来了，快让我看看这些肉的肉质！: I see you coming with the meat, let me see how good it is!
唔，下一步我们需要[c][ffff00]魔法蘑菇[-][/c]哦！可爱的蘑菇，既: Hmm, Next we need some [c][ffff00]Magic Mushrooms[-][/c]! Cute mushrooms, Pretty and yummy, and very nutritious.

什么？！要我给你魔法蘑菇？我不给！: What?! You want Magic Mushrooms? No way!
这蘑菇可是很珍贵的，我才不给你呢，除非你能帮我做一件事情。: These mushrooms are invaluable. I won’t give them to you unless you do me a favor.
太棒了，不瞒你说我有点喜欢艾娅女士，却不好意思跟她说话。: Great. I’m kind of into Lady Aiya, but too shy to tell her.
如果你能帮我拍一张艾娅女士的照片，我就把魔法蘑菇给你！: If you can take a picture of Aiya for me, I will give you the mushrooms.
哦！艾娅女士真是太美了，我一定要珍藏她的照片。: Oh! Lady Aiya is so beautiful. I cherish her picture forever.
冒险者，胡雷特厨师给你蘑菇了吗？: Adventurer, did you get the mushrooms from Cook Tug Hulett?
嗯～我已经等不及了，只需要一点纯正的海盐，我们就可以开始制作拉面了！: Yeah. I really can’t wait to start making ramen right away. But we need some pure sea salts!
你别着急，海盐我就有一些，但是我还有个小小的考验给你，如果你能回答我的问题，我就: Don’t worry, I have sea salts. But before I give them to you, I need you to pass a small test first.
准备好了就来找我哦！: Come back to me when you are ready!
好的，要记住我[c][ffff00]2018年2月11日[-][/c]就走了哦！: OK, but remember, I’m leaving on [c][ffff00]Feb. 11, 2018[-][/c]!

冒险者，我觉得你没有用心听我说的话哦。: Adventurer, I don’t think you have paid any attention to my story.
嗯嗯，我开的拉面馆叫什么名字呢？: Yes. What’s the name of my ramen restaurant?

回答正确！你很用心嘛，那么我不为难你了，让我为你制作拉面吧。: Answer correct! You are a good listener. Now no more trials, let me make ramen for you.
尝一尝吧，这是我的心意。: Please have a try, I made it for you.
1.成为导师的条件：Base等级达到80级，且完成了导师任务的冒险者。\n2.成:
1. Conditions for becoming a mentor: Base level reaches 80 and complete the Mentor Quest. 
2. Conditions for becoming a student: Base level is between 10 and 80 and have no mentor yet. 
3. Mentor Quest: The player whose Base level reaches 80 has no mentor can go to the [Adventurer Announcement Advanced Mentor] Terch to accept the Mentor Quest. 
4. Number of students: Each mentor can have up to three adventurers at the same time as his own students. 
5. Student graduation: When the student's Base level reaches 80, he can go to Prontera to find the [Adventurer Announcement Advanced Mentor] Tataji to accept the Graduation Ceremony Quest.
赠送规则：\n1.近30天内玩家每次充值都能获得等值*10000的赠送额度，每次:
Gifting rules: 
1. Each time the player recharges in the last 30 days, He will get a quota of equivalent value *10000. Each successful gifting will deduct an amount eual to the Zeny price of the item. 
2. Gifting requires a certain amount fee. The higher the value of the gift, the more the required fee. 
3. Only one gift can be gifted at the same time. Gifts worth less than 100, 000 Zeny cannot be gifted. 
4. The gifted item is delivered by the Gingerbread deliveryman. After the item is delivered, the player has five minutes to receive or reject it. 
5. If the gifting fails, the item will be returned to the player's transaction record. The player can continue to choose to gift or receive. 
6. The gifting button is reserved for up to 3 days.

There was a grand wedding in Al De Baran. The groom Norman was the right-hand man of the Clock Guard's head, Mosman Time. Adventurers were invited to this romantic wedding. The groom was poisoned at the wedding ceremony. The sorrowful wedding revealed the conspiracy of the serpent Jörmungandr, Implicating the past of the gods thousands of years ago. The giant wolf Fenrir  was locked on the moon by the trick of Freya. After the Ragnarok, the power of gods was greatly weakened, and the seal of Fenrir  on the Moon was weakened as well. Fenrir ’s younger brother Jörmungandr hoped to build a bridge to the moon to save his brother. However, Jörmungandr was severely injured in the Ragnarok. His divine power was weakened to only one ten-thousandth of his heyday. By chance, He discovered that Al De Baran's gold Clock Tower contained a huge power, which seemed to be similar to the giant Yimir's. He hid in the gold clock and waited for an opportunity. Until one day, a young businessman named Norman appeared in the Clock Tower, Saying about solving problems for Mosman. This voice disturbed his sleep and made him realize that the time had come. He created a false memory for Norman, Making Norman think he had a younger brother named Reed. And he also turned himself into a human, Acting as Norman's brother, and successfully entered the Clock Guard. He used the trust that Norman had in him, Constantly collecting information related to the gold clock, and finally succeeded in instigating the internal betrayal of the Clock Guard, Summoning the ancient Baphomet and intending to kill Mosman Time. He didn't expect that the monster - the ancient Baphomet was not under his control, Instead the monster wanted to devour him. In the crisis, Norman saved his life in desperation, and therefore was seriously injured. Jörmungandr was moved by Norman's actions. He was being excluded by the gods since he was young and his most important brother was also locked up on the moon, No one really treated him well. For Norman, Jörmungandr had defeated the ancient Baphomet in cooperation with humans and sent it back to the past. Unfortunately, Norman's injuries were too heavy. He died soon. Jörmungandr was very remorseful, He began to think about his own use of the gold clock to build a bridge. The development of things did not give him much time to think. What he did in the Clock Tower created a black hole of time in the already precarious space. Jörmungandr from another space came through the black hole. In that world, Jörmungandr didn't choose to build a bridge to save his brother, Instead he selfishly devoured the power of the gold clock. Jörmungandr from the other space lost his senses and became a monster who was only seeking for power. He named himself Recurrent Nightmare, and walked around in different spaces, Constantly swallowing all the powerful things. Recurrent Nightmare used the black hole caused by the Jörmungandr to come to this space. He mocked the adventurers of the space and Jörmungandr, who still had the feelings. Jörmungandr looked at another him in a complex mood. He realized that if Norman weren't there, Maybe he would become such a monster. He decided to help humans defeat another him from another space. The adventurer who had received help from Jörmungandr defeated Recurrent Nightmare, Drove it back into the black hole of time, and sealed the black hole. When all the things had been settled, Jörmungandr obeyed his promise with Norman, Gave up using the gold clock to save the demon wolf and left Al De Baran, Embarking on a new journey to seek for other ways to save his brother. All the adventurers who were brave in this battle have been awarded with the Clock Guard medals to commemorate this crisis in Al De Baran and this serpent.

法师协会请求最顶尖的侏儒首饰匠打造的项链，为了纪念古城之战，赠送给在这场战争中做: A necklace crafted by the best dwarf jeweler in the request of the Mages Guild for the adventurers who had made outstanding contributions in the War of Glast Heim and to commemorate the war. This was a war with disparity in strength. The enemies faced by the mankind were the cold and ruthless gods above the clouds. Himmelmez, Freya's envoy, led the Hand of Goddess to summon the Dark Lord, intending to destroy the human land. The mankind had always been ants comparing to the gods, Also been a source of their power of belief. The humans were fuels, Ashes and dolls that were obedient to the gods, and humble bugs that could be sacrificed at any time. This was a war without retreat. Glast Heim was full of monsters and fog. It is the home of human prosperity. There were children, flowers, aged wines that were stored under the old castle, promises between couples and lives of brothers. The fate of mankind was in the hands of a young Mage called Laurell Weinder. Laurell Weinder was not a big man, just an ordinary boy who was born in Izlude. He had a mother who loved him, a sweetheart he loved secretly, a small dream of being a Archmage. He was used by the Hand of Goddess. They stripped his soul and gave it to the Dark Lord as a sacrifice so that this cruel and tyrannical demon lord would come to earth and trample on the dignity of mankind. For this noteless Mage, to guard the truth and eternal love, and for the dignity and freedom of mankind, adventurers from all over the land united and stood before the sinful monster, although they were shuddering. This was a war the they must win. The adventurers risked their soul being crushed, they shuttled through Laurell Weinder's spiritual world to appease his restless soul. This ordinary Mage also showed his tenacity. Although his soul was imprisoned by the Dark Lord, he still tenaciously resisted. As adventurers struggling to hold, two selfless warlocks, Reyen and Morgan, poured the magic of their whole body into Laurell Weinder's soul, helping him to break free from the chains of the Dark Lord. This soul, which was treated as a joke by classmates and teachers, sacrificed like an animal by the goddess's henchman and tortured to being split, burst forth an amazing light. This splendid light even made the Dark Lord trembled. This turmoil also attracted the attention of Valkyries. Her Einherjar, the Black Army, joined the war. With the help of the Einherjar, mankind defeated the unbeatable enemy - the Dark Lord, and sealed it in the abyss of hell and completely shattered Himmelmez's plot. This necklace, known as Soul Peace, was to commemorate this great guarding war, for the staff that was burned in Geffen, for the broken arrows in Payon, for the shattered blades in Prontera, for the warriors who lost lives in this war and to calm the anger of these souls. Hoped that all human beings would always remember this history and wouldn't forget the feats of mankind even hundreds of years later.

辛德瑞拉总算安静下来了，我也可以松口气了。: Cinderella has finally quieted down. I feel much relieved.

这是送给宾格的礼物？: This is a gift for Binger?
替我谢谢奥德赛，可是他为什么没有来呢？: Please pass my gratitude to Odyssey. Why isn't he here?
