你去小溪捕捉一些小鱼，我会把它们制作成鱼罐头！: Catch some small fish from the street. I'll make them into canned fish.
就等你这个了，所有制作的工具我都准备好了！: I've been waiting for you. All the tools are ready.
先把小鱼...再装进罐头...嘿，用彩带包装一下吧…: Put the fish into the can... Then wrap it up with some ribbon...
成了！冒险者，这就是我们汪星人出品的鱼罐头！: Done! Adventurer, this is the canned fish made by we dogs.
请你带去礼物和我们的歉意，喵星人和汪星人其实可以和平共处的。: Please send the gift along with our apologies. Cats and dogs can live together in peace.
什么？痒痒药剂竟然是他们干的？: What? They put the tickle potion?
我...算了，既然有鱼罐头的话，就算是爱记仇的喵星人也会原谅他们的。: I... Never mind. The narrow minded cats will forgive them for the canned fish.
礼物我收下了，他们的歉意我也收下了。: I accept the gift along with their apologies.
我得给辛德瑞拉看看鱼罐头，辛德瑞拉一定很开心！: I'll show Cinderella the canned fish. I'm sure she loves it.
从此忠厚老实的汪星人和机灵的喵星人一起和平共处。: From now on, the loyal and honest dogs and the agile and smart cats live together in peace.

经过吉芬法师们的调查，女神之手的阴谋渐渐被揭露出来，希默梅斯聚集了一批邪恶的魔物: Warlock Geffen's investigations unveil the plots of the Hand of Goddess. Himmelmez gathered a bunch of evil monsters at Glast Heim, who wanted to sacrifice Laurell Weinder's soul and call out Dark Lord to destroy the whole land. In order to fight against their plot, All the forces, Including arrogant warlock, Light archer, Brave royal knight group, On the continent work together as the Glast Heim Alliance. The best troop on the continent gathered in the Glast Heim to fight a death battle against bloodthirsty monsters of Glast Heim. The alliance came across a tricky situation when they entered the Glast Heim. The area was covered with shadows and heavy fogs. Many monsters lurked inside the deep fog to attack any intruding human beings. The female warlock, LISA, Used the Maces blade found by the adventurers in the Glast Heim, and built a Teleport that led to the culvert of the Glast Heim. The alliance can use it to find traces of Laurell Weinder. Many alliance soldiers got into traps set by the monster, Dark Illusion, when they entered the culvert. Dark Illusion has eaten most of Laurell Weinder's soul, and hid in the culvert to consume more souls. LISA, the hero warlock, Used magic to Teleport everybody back into safety.
同盟军的先锋部队在古城调查时发现了一对误入暗黑手札的恋人，他们被封印在这本暗神官: The vanguard troop of the alliance found a couple entered the Dark Notes by mistake when they investigated the Glast Heim. They were sealed in the notes of Evil Druid and couldn't escape. The vanguard troop started their rescue right away. The rescued two people offered information from the center of Glast Heim. When they struggled in the notes, They peeped at some desperate priests holding sacrifice in the heart of the Glast Heim's grave. Warlock LISA used Dark Notes at once, and helped the alliance troop build a Teleport to the grave of Glast Heim. The vanguards of the alliance went to investigate in the grave of Glast Heim. They walked through the gloomy grave, and finally found the desperate priests holding sacrifice. The vanguard troop destroyed the sacrifice ceremony together. The sacrifice was stopped, but Dark Illusion was awaken too. Dark Illusion seethed when he found the sacrifice was destroyed. He wanted to destroy the vanguard, but warlock Reyen arrived in time to stop the attack. LISA successfully completed the task of building Teleport. Everyone retreated and the energy was saved for the final battle.
虽然阻止了绝望祭祀的献祭，但庞德的灵魂依然在黑暗之王的掌控之中，黑暗之王利用庞德: Although the sacrifice of the desperate priest was stopped, Laurell Weinder's soul was still under the control of Dark Lord. Taking advantage of Laurell Weinder's weakness, Dark Lord split his soul into pieces. Warlock Morgan found Laurell Weinder's soul was in his unstable spiritual world. The vanguard troop risked their life to enter Laurell Weinder's spiritual world. Understanding the setbacks and despair the ordinary warlock encountered during study, Dark Lord took advantage of his despair. Members of vanguard troops continued to encourage Laurell Weinder in his spiritual world. This ordinary warlock managed to make part of his soul break away from the control of Dark Lord. The vanguard troop entered the death zone of Dark Illusion after getting back part of Laurell Weinder's soul. The victory was in view since they rescued part of Laurell Weinder's soul through the filthy zone! The deep side of the death zone was where Dark Lord was at, who wanted to occupy Laurell Weinder's body. He led his monster troop to attack the whole men's world starting from his stronghold Glast Heim. Dark Lord wasn't summoned completely. But his power was above human beings, and the alliance couldn't fight back. As human's future went into the gloomy direction, the spirits of Valkyrie arrived in time to fight against Dark Lord with the best human troop. They managed to drive the evil monster back to the abyss.

默斯曼为了感谢冒险者的帮助赠送给冒险者的谢礼。冒险者们受邀参加艾尔帕兰一场盛大的: It's a gratitude gift from Mosman to adventurers who helped him. Adventurers attended a grand wedding of Al De Baran, Where the bridegroom was killed at the scene. Adventurers took the responsibility to investigate the incident. Meanwhile, the "Secret Books" were stolen which recorded the method to use Gold Clock. The clock guardian, Holland, intervened the adventurers when they were after the thief. It made adventurers doubt about Holland. After following Holland secretly, it turned out that he was the thief within. Holland not only helped the thief to steal "Secret Books", but also prepared to stir a rebel within the guardians and took the life of Mosman. After further investigation on Holland, adventurers found the big boss behind him was Jörmungandr, one of the three gods of plague. He wanted to use the power of gold clock to save his brother, Fenrir, the demon wolf chained on the moon. If his plot worked, Not only Al De Baran, but also the whole continent would fall into danger.
时钟守护者诺曼的怀表。耶梦加德为了获得黄金时钟的力量，伪装成守护者诺曼的弟弟。他: Clock Guardian Norman's Pocket Watch. Cloaking as the little brother of Guardian Mosman, Jörmungandr wanted to get the power of Gold Clock. Working in Al De Baran for many years, He knew many secrets about Gold Clock. He asked Holland to stir up the clock guardians for a rebel within. It made Mosman get injured heavily, During which the Miracle Ball was stolen. Jörmungandr used the Miracle Ball in the clock tower to call upon the Ancient Baphomet. He thought the Ancient Baphomet would help him kill Mosman Time, the leader of the clock guardians. He didn't expect that Baphomet wanted his godly body. Without following his command, Baphomet revolted and wanted to devour Jörmungandr's soul. In the fatal moment, Mosman risked his life to save Jörmungandr. Mosman's action woke up the goodness inside Jörmungandr, so he worked with adventurers to defeat the Ancient Baphomet.
轮回梦魇的眼球。因为耶梦加德过度使用奇点球和黄金时钟的力量，导致黄金时钟内部产生: Recurrent Nightmare's eyeballs. Since Jörmungandr overused the power of Miracle Ball and Gold Clock, there were Time Rifts inside the Gold Clock. At another timeline, Jörmungandr passed through the black hole. In that world, Jörmungandr didn't choose to use Gold Clock to save his brother, but devoured the power himself. The power made him lose his mind and turned into a bloodthirsty monster, who named himself Recurrent Nightmare, Travelling through different worlds. Jörmungandr worked with adventurers to defeat himself in another world -- Recurrent Nightmare. He helped human to seal the black hole, and promised that he won't use the Gold Clock again and leave quietly.

1.成为导师的条件：\nBase等级达到80级，且完成了导师任务的冒险者。\n2:
1. Conditions for becoming a mentor: 
Base level reaches 80 and complete the Mentor Quest. 
2. Conditions for becoming a student: Base level is between 10 and 80 and have no mentor yet. 
3. Mentor Quest: The player whose Base level reaches 80 has no mentor can go to the [Adventurer Announcement Advanced Mentor] Terch to accept the Mentor Quest. 
4. Number of students: Each mentor can have up to three adventurers at the same time as his own students. 
5. Student graduation: When the student's Base level reaches 80, he can go to Prontera to find the [Adventurer Announcement Advanced Mentor] Terch to accept the Graduation Ceremony Quest.
关于冒险熟练度：\n1.当冒险熟练度达到100%时，冒险者将无法继续进行与获取冒:
About Adventure Proficiency: 
1. When the Adventure Proficiency reaches 100%, You won't be able to continue or accept adventure quests and rewards. 
2. Each time you complete an adventure quest or upgrade your Base, Your Adventure Proficiency will be increased.
（24小时内仅能对Base等级<80级的同一名学生使用一次）冒险者协会指定教材，: (It can be used only once on the same student whose Base level is <80 within 24 hours) A prescribed textbook for the Adventurer's Guild, used by Mentors on students to greatly increase their EXP. Since its content are too sophisticated for novices, it takes lots of time to fully understand the knowledge in the book.
卡普拉公司研发的时空胶囊，胶囊可以加速时间的流转，瞬息间完成委托看板的任务。时间: The Time Gashapon developed by Kafra Company. It can speed up the flow of time and complete the Mission Board quests in an instant. Time is a wonderful thing!
冒险者协会为了保护初心冒险者而制作的特殊道具，只能由导师向学生使用，能够使学生在: A special item made by the Adventurer's Guild to protect novices. It can only be used by the mentors on the students, enabling them to obtain a huge stats bonus in a short period of time, which makes them free to adventure when the mentor is not there!
冒险者协会下发的空白改名卡，将喜欢的名字写在上面会召唤信鸽。信鸽会自动飞往普隆德: A blank renaming card issued by the Adventurer's Guild. Writing the name you like on it to summon a pigeon. The pigeon will automatically fly to Prontera. The manager who receives the new name will help you modify your name. ღ
寄往英灵殿的神圣卡片，如果想要修改公会名，可以将喜欢的名字写在卡片上寄给英灵们，: A sacred card sent to Valhalla. If you want to rename your guild, You can write the name you like on it and send it to Valhalla. They will help you modify its name. ღ
代表了奉献，付出与耐心的勋章，用于嘉奖辛勤指导初心冒险者的导师们的道具，可以在导: A medal which represents dedication, contribution and patience. It is an item used to reward the hard-working mentors. You can use it to exchange for some rare rewards in the Mentor Shop.
划开伤口并摄取敌人血液的蛇形长矛。: Snake-shaped spear that can slit the wound and take the enemy's blood.
精铁打造的双手矛，短小易持却威力强大，搭配枪筒也可做长矛使用。: Well-made double-handed spear. Small and short, but it has great power, which can be used with the gun barrel.
受诅咒的弑蛇长剑，剑柄的倒钩如同蛇尾般散发着危险气息。: The cursed long sword that killed snakes. The barb of the handle gave out a sense of danger like the snake's tail.
向黑暗与巨蛇借来的魔力，会让敌人永远徘徊在无尽的轮回中失去自我。: The magic power borrowed from the serpent in the darkness can make enemies lost in endless reincarnations.
能像蛇一般以闪电的速度攻击，锋利的刀口杀伤力如同巨蛇的咬合一般致命。: The attack speed was as quick as the snake-like lightning. The sharp cut was as fatal as a snakebite.
盗贼克克里曾向世人宣布要偷取大法师梅林随身携带的匕首，却被精明的梅林识破他的诡计: Kerry, the thief, declared that he would steal the dagger of Merlin, the Warlock, but always failed because Merlin was too astute to cheat. As he wanted to give up, he got a secret present from Merlin. Merlin gave his dagger to Kerry. From then on, the dagger always stayed with Kerry till Fagris, the legendary robber, stole it. After that, the dagger was never found.
采用远古巨蛇锋利的尖牙来制作的拳刃。: Katar made of sharp teeth of the ancient giant serpent.
蛇骨打造的弓箭能将任何盔甲像纸一样击穿。: Bow and arrow made of snake's bones, which could break through any armor like a piece of paper.
锤身用黄金打造，攻击时震耳欲聋的锤声都能瞬间将敌人击晕。: The body of the hammer was made of gold. The deafening attack sound of the hammer would make the enemies pass out.
威力如同巨蛇一般强劲的战斧，在战斗中毫不费力的将敌手击碎。: The power of the battle axe was as strong as the giant serpent. It can crush the enemy effortlessly in the battle.
厚厚的红蛇鳞十分尖硬，能抵御强大的攻击力并将其弹开。: The thick Snake Scales of the red snake can defend strong attack power and bounce it back.
由大主教赐福的精钢盾，上部纹有鲜艳的十字架，象征了主神的神圣不可侵犯，下部刻有使: On top of the fine steel shield granted by the Archbishop, Was a grained colorful cross. It stands for the inviolable divinity of the main gods. The downside was carved with the church of the owner, and blessed words from the Archbishop that "the shield holder will be enlightened with god's light and defend the invasion of dark."
利用星辰中提炼出的珍贵矿石做制作而成，重量只有普通盾牌的1/10，白天看上去漆黑: It was made of precious minerals refined through stars. The light was 1/10 of a common shield. It looks dark in the daytime, but resonates with the stars at night and creates a grand light wall to effectively defend enemy's attack.
精灵大长老德库里的盾牌，传说中德库里是一名崇尚和平的长老，任何与他争斗的人都会被: Elf Elder Decurry's shield. Legend has it that Decurry was a peace-loving elder, and anyone who fought with him would be influenced by his love for peace. But there is another legend that Decurry's shield had the blessing of the God of Nature. As long as he held up the shield, No attack could harm him, so he was fearless. This shield is also called Peace Maker by the elves.
“时间过的真快，脸上显露出离别的神色，但新的邂逅很重要的对吧？所以只要看向前方轻: "How time flies. The face reveals a farewell expression. But the new encounters are important, right? So just look ahead and set off lightly! March along the broad road! "
赤色大蛇的鳞片赋予拳套疯狂暴击的力量: The scales of the red giant serpent granted the knuckles berserk power
侏儒和罗姆使用了神秘铸铁打造的拳套，可配合使用者的手掌大小自由伸缩，相传和罗姆曾: Knuckles made of mystic iron by dwarfs and Roma, which can adjust the size based on the user's palms. According to legend, Roma had once used the gloves in battle with Gallio, the Archmage. Roma erased Gallion's gale magic by lightly waving the gloves, and he himself was shocked by its power, therefore the gloves were called "Wind Splitter" by the later generations.

万圣节最常见的水果味硬糖，被红色包装纸牢牢包住，很受小朋友们的喜爱。 恢复50%: The most common hard fruit candy in Halloween. Wrapped tightly in red covers, it's popular among children. Restore 50% HP

看起来是一个普通的南瓜，打开之后是香气扑鼻的奶油焗南瓜泥。恢复20％Sp（SP恢: It looked like an ordinary pumpkin, but when you opened it up, You could smell the sweet aroma of mashed pumpkin with fresh cream. Recover 20% SP (SP Regen ＋10%, For 30 min)

繁殖季里，重金属蝗虫集合起来大合奏，巨大的音量和快节奏的摇滚乐，驱散了森林附近其: During the breeding season, Metallers gather together for a tutti. Their huge volume and fast-paced rock music dispels other monsters around the forest. Some of these Metallers are stronger than the others and they look different.
猎蝇中的精英战士，典型的蛾蝶类魔物，锋利向外的尖牙和卓越的飞行能力，让它成为了初: An elite Dustiness warrior which is a typical moth monster. Its sharp outward fangs and excellent flying ability make it a nightmare for junior adventurers.
精英螳螂魔物，攻击性非常强的昆虫魔物，与其他肉食性的螳螂不同，对敌人毫不手软没有: An elite Mantis which is an extremely aggressive insect. Unlike other carnivorous Mantis, it shows no mercy to the enemies.
蛾蝶类魔物防御超高的小型魔物，飞行时身上散落的有毒鳞粉，看上去非常美丽，却能腐蚀: A moth monster which is small and with high defense. It scatters poisonous powder during flight, which looks beautiful but can erode the surrounding living things.
黑魔女中的佼佼者，不要因为看上去可爱就招惹她们，由顽皮的黑猫变成的可爱人类小女孩: The best of the Black Witches. Don't be provoke them because they look cute. A human girl like monster which is transformed from a naughty black cat and loves pranks. If you don't give it candy, it will make troubles! If you give it candy, it will still do that!
缔造钟楼迷宫的三个炼金术士被当时的元老院排挤迫害，最终这些元老院成员被复仇的炼金: The three alchemists who created the Clock Tower Labyrinth were persecuted by the Senate at the time. Eventually, the Senate members' souls were trapped by the revengeful alchemists. They were made into clocks and wandering in the labyrinth forever. Some of the Senate members' spiritual power are very great, which makes them sober sometimes and confused in other time. They have become more painful souls.
巫婆中的元老，因为研究禁咒被大陆的魔法界驱赶的黑魔女族，遭到诅咒成为了魔物。骑着: Senior Bathories who were Black Witches and driven away by the Mages in the land because of their study of banned spells. They were cursed and turned into monsters. They ride broomsticks in the Clock Tower Labyrinth and are a nightmare for many children of Al De Baran.
传说是钟楼迷宫的制作者研究时空魔导器的副产物。由于制作中采用了很多失传的魔道技术: The legend has it that it's a by-product of the Clock Tower Labyrinth creators researching the space-time magic device. Because they used a lot of lost magic, it has a high magic resistance. Most of the Alarms are quiescent and weird, but some of them are particularly offensive.
邪灵魔导师的大长老，因习得某个禁断的魔法而被神和恶魔一起诅咒，从此便徘徊在生与死: The grand elder of Elders who were cursed by the gods and demons for acquiring a forbidden magic. From then on, it lives between life and death.
不知是何原因，由著名冒险者莱汀女士编撰的《米德加尔魔物志》里，把这种游弋在洞穴水: For some reason, in the book "Midgarts Monsters" compiled by the famous adventurer Ms. Letin, this dangerous creature swimming in cave waters were marked as "women’s public enemy". Some of them are big, which are very dangerous at first sight. Please pay attention to them, women.
伊特瓢虫的王者，有一对金色的翅膀，虽然飞不起来，依然看上去很帅气。: The king of Brilights which has a pair of golden wings. Although it does not fly, it still looks very handsome.
森灵的亚种，因被之前众神大战的魔力暴走所污染，身体的组织在进化过程中产生了异变，: A sub-species of Wormtails. They were contaminated by the frenzied magic power during the battle of gods. Their body organization has mutated in the process of evolution. Some of these mutations have caused tremendous changes in their bodies which make them become powerful monsters. Don't underestimate them.
兽人女战士中的大姐大，教育孩子、管教老公、操持家务，她们一概不管，既然是大姐大这: The head of the Orc Ladies warriors. They don't educate their children, Discipline their husbands and do housework. Since they are heads, Their henchmen will do these for them. They only need to cut off the enemy heads in the battlefield.

虽然还远远藏匿在宁静的树下，但是啊，你们的感情会长成一颗斐扬的明星，一颗燃烧的新: Though your affection is hidden deeply under the tranquil tree, it will be as bright as the stars in Payon and as scorching as burning fire in the future.
性格和感觉对于你们而言会更加重要，尝试更多的与对方交流吧~~！: Personalities and feelings are more important for you two. Try to communicate with each other further~~!
虽然相距很远，但是RO给了你们更多的相处机会，不管如何，你们心中始终充溢着幸福的: Though living far away from each other, You have many chances to get along with thanks to RO. Whatever happens, You two always feel very happy.
对于还没有开口表达的东西，就默默藏匿在心头吧~: Just keep those you didn't speak out to yourself~
摘下一颗春天的樱桃偷偷放进对方的背包中，给TA一个十足的惊喜吧！: Pick a sakura in spring and put it in your love's bag secretly to surprise your love!
初识时往往带着试探与伪装，尝试倘开心扉与对方好好交流一次吧。: People often try to sound others out and disguise feelings at the beginning. Try to open you heart and communicate.
偷偷用最新款玩具捉弄对方，在打打闹闹中烦恼好像也没有了~: Make fun of your love with the new toy secretly. You are likely to forget worries in the process~
学会珍惜眼前人是最好的态度，因为你并不能预知下一刻会发生什么。: You'd better cherish your friends and love because you never know what will happen next.
总是在默默付出，虽然你没有察觉，但是对方其实也心怀感激呢~: You always give more than you take. Though you may not notice, Your love feels grateful for you~
彼此已经习惯了对方的存在，一定要珍惜哦！: You are accustomed to each other. Cherish your friendship!
搭配一套情侣装是不是很有意思呢？如果有兴趣，我推荐你们去询问一下伊娜小姐的意见。: Isn't couple clothing attractive? If you are interested in it, I recommend chatting with Miss Ina.
怪物像汹涌的潮水席卷而来，握紧手中的武器，与对方并肩作战吧！: Monsters are attacking you ferociously. Take your weapons and Party up to fight!
跟TA一起往往会带来好运，不是吗？: Usually you are quite lucky staying with your love, aren't you?
有时候会感觉渐行渐远，但实际上只是缺少了一些必要的沟通。: Sometimes you may feel alienated from each other, but actually you just lack some necessary communication.
在冒险中互相帮助，成为肩并肩的战友，能够使你们的感情快速升温哦！: Helping each other in adventures can consolidate your relationship quickly!
新奇的东西总是让人充满兴趣，但是熟悉的伙伴才是能够长久依赖的所在。: Novel things are often interesting, but only partners you know well are whom you can depend on.
你们渴望与彼此更进一步，但是又害怕过于依赖，所以我说呢，去吧，不要顾虑那么多！: You desire for a deeper relationship but fear of overdependence on each other. I would say, go! Don't think too much!

无耻的贵族，我并没有触犯王国的法律，你凭什么打人…唉唉唉！别打脸！: Shameless nobles! I never broke the King's law, what right do you have to hit me? Ow! Ow! Not the face!
(擦了擦鼻血)这群无耻贵族！这座雕像明显就是一个伟大的剑士，他们硬是说是他们伊斯: (Wiping a bloody nose) Those shameless nobles! This statue was obviously that of a great Swordsman, but they say it was an ancestor of the Isite family. But as far as I know, there ancestors were all merchants. How could he be a Swordsman?
他们不允许我调查这个雕像的真相，怕我戳穿他们的谎言，他们家族的名声会一落千丈，这: They won't let me investigate the truth, because they're scared I'll pierce through their lies, and their reputation will suffer. This statue is well-known throughout the kingdom! No, I won't let it go! Adventurer, Could you help me teach them a lesson?
哦，多谢你冒险家，我这打没白挨。我的研究有了进展！但是只剩下唯一的难点了。虽然很: Oh, Thank you adventurer! I didn't get beat up for nothing. I'm making progress with my research, There is just one troublesome spot left. I'm embarrassed, but could you help me find Shun? I think he knows a bit about this type of material.
史丹利这小子，整天想搞个大新闻，行了，交给我吧。你帮我去找点水来。: All Stanley wants to do is make himself known. Alright, I'll take care of it. Go get some water for me.
水给我吧！稍等片刻…哦，解析出来了，是[c][ffff00]寒松石[-][/c]: Give me the water. Wait just a moment... Analysis complete. It's [c][ffff00]Chillpine Stone[-][/c], it's a rare stone! You can tell him about this result.
啊，你终于回来了。怎么样？那块石头究竟是什么？: Oh, you're back, finally! Well? What kind of stone is it?
原来如此！我早该想到的！难怪摸到手里凉凉的…寒松石的出现时间是在普隆德拉王国建国: I see! I should have known that! No wonder it feels so cool to the touch... Chillpine Stone appeared when the kingdom of Prontera was first formed. It was a great Swordsman of that time. It must have been... Him!
上古五位强大无比的英雄，其中之一，被尊称为“雷霆剑士”的[c][ffff00]卡: On of the five strongest heroes of ancient times, the one known as the "Lightning Swordsman, " [c][ffff00]Calen Rosso[-][/c]! This is amazing news! I need to go to the Historians Society to tell them right away! Thank you, Young adventurer!
这个我就不能告诉你了。。感到好奇了对吗？历史就是这么让人沉迷，好了，不多说了，我: I can't tell you that... You're curious, Aren't you? History can be enchanting. Alright, I can't talk, I must be leaving! Farewell, adventurer, Until we meet again!
我们已经掌握了[c][ffff00]巴风特[-][/c]的行踪，现在只需要一个合: I have tracked the movements of [c][ffff00]Baphomet[-][/c]. Now we just need to find the right time, and we can stop its plan.
[c][ffff00]巴尔洛将军[-][/c]正在皇宫门口等着你。: [c][ffff00]General Barlaud[-][/c] is waiting for you in front of the palace.
他会告诉你下一步计划。: He will tell you the next step.
看上去很有精神啊，年轻人。: You look very energetic, young one.
巴风特一定会在金字塔的魔王封印处出现，普隆德拉的支援军已经在那里埋伏好了。: Baphomet will appear at the Demon's Seal in the Pyramid. Prontera's reinforcements are already set up for an ambush.
只是魔物的狂暴和不断出现的裂隙让梦罗克城深陷危机。: The berserk monsters and constantly-appearing Rifts have put Morroc in a dire crisis.
这次不会再让巴风特轻易得逞。: This time, we won't let Baphomet get what it wants.
赌上大陆卫队的荣耀，也必须要把金字塔的封印守下来。: With the power of the Continent Guard, we will protect the seal of the Pyramid.
因为“魔王的最终封印”就在我们这座梦罗克城之下，大陆卫队已经派出了分队在城外的入: Since the "Final Seal of the Demon" is just below Morroc, the Continent Guard has sent in a force to strengthen defenses outside the entrance of the city.
替我转告他们，巴风特就快现身了，请加强警惕，尤其是那些被即将苏醒的魔王召唤而来的: Tell them that Baphomet is getting ready to appear, and to be on guard. Especially against the alien creatures that have been summoned by the Demon.
情况比想象中的更糟糕。: The situation is worse than we imagined.
梦罗克城周边的魔物狂暴的程度超出了我们的预料。: The berserk monsters around Morroc are stronger than expected.
这样下去的话还没等到巴风特出手，大陆卫队就坚持不住了。: If things continue like this, the Continent Guard won't be able to last until Baphomet arrives.
为了大陆，请击退这些[c][ffff00]狂暴的摩卡[-][/c]。: For the sake of the continent, please hold off these [c][ffff00]Berserk Muka[-][/c].
这些摩卡已经刺伤了大陆卫队的很多卫兵了。: The Muka have already injured many Continent Guard soldiers.
可奇怪的是那些刺客公会的人却完全不害怕他们。: But what's strange, is that the members of the Assassins Guild aren't afraid of them at all.
巨石怪从未如此的靠近过城市。: The Golems have never been so close to the city.
虽然他们的动作很慢，可是普通的武器对他们完全没有效果。: They may be slow, but normal weapons have no effect on them at all.
暂时安全了，感谢你冒险者。: We're safe, for now. Thank you, adventurer!
我们在附近巡逻的时候发现了一位[c][ffff00]受伤的女孩[-][/c]。: We found a [c][ffff00]Wounded Girl[-][/c] when we were patrolling nearby.
请赶快为她带一些草药和水回来。: Please bring her some medicine and water, quickly!
谢谢，我感觉好多了。: Thank you, I feel much better.
我在刺客公会附近遭到了异世界魔物的袭击。: I was attacked by alien monsters near the Assassins Guild.
连刺客公会都遭遇到了袭击吗？: Has even the Assassins Guild been attacked?
暂时还不能确定，我醒来后就在这里了。: I'm not sure. I only remember waking up here.
冒险者，请去击败[c][ffff00]异世界魔物[-][/c]，我就在南面的石像: Adventurer, please defeat these [c][ffff00]Alien Monsters[-][/c]. I encountered them near the stone statue to the south.
看来刺客公会也被卷入了这场入侵，他们虽然从不主动出击，但是战斗能力确实远远在大陆: It seems the Assassins Guild was dragged into this. They didn't attack first, but they are much more capable of fighting than the Continent Guard.
刺客公会在梦罗克以南的一座小岛上，我们会送你过去。: The Assassins Guild is on a small island, south of Morroc. We will take you there.
陌生人，[c][ffff00]刺客公会[-][/c]并不需要保护，我们有能力自保: Stranger, the [c][ffff00]Assassins Guild[-][/c] doesn't need protection. We can protect ourselves!
这世界上，没有可以威胁到刺客公会的存在。: Nothing in this world can threaten the existence of the Assassins Guild.
好吧，确实有些麻烦的事情，[c][ffff00]科罗塔[-][/c]会告诉你具体: But, there are some troubles. [c][ffff00]Jaime[-][/c] will tell you the details.
其实首领也非常着急，只是他不会表露出来而已。: Our leader is actually pretty nervous, but he'll never let it show.
北面的遗迹出现了[c][ffff00]大量的巨石怪[-][/c]。: [c][ffff00]Large numbers of Golems[-][/c] have appeared in the ruins to the north.
他们坚硬的外表让很多暗杀者都束手无策。: Their tough exteriors leave many of our Assassins helpless.
首领特地把[c][ffff00]艾勒梅斯[-][/c]也叫了回来。: Our leader even brought in [c][ffff00]Eremes[-][/c] to help.
艾勒梅斯的战斗能力在刺客公会首屈一指。: Eremes is one of the most talented fighters in the Assassins Guild.
他就在遗迹执行任务，冒险者，请协助[c][ffff00]艾勒梅斯[-][/c]阻: He is carrying out a mission in the ruins. Adventurer, please help [c][ffff00]Eremes[-][/c] stop the rampaging monsters.
你就这样来了？: This is all you came with?
他们没让你带点酒给我吗？: They didn't tell you to bring some liquor for me?
这里的情况很糟糕，魔王苏醒的传说要成真了吗？: It's bad here. Has the legend of the Demon King's awakening really come true?
这些烦人的巨石怪狂暴化越来越严重。: These annoying Golems are growing more and more berserk.
别在那里慢吞吞的了，赶紧击溃他们。: Stop being so slow. Hurry and break them!
很好，冒险者。暗影会庇护你。: Good work, adventurer. The shadows will protect you.
在这个遗迹周围我还发现了一只来自[c][ffff00]异世界的巨石怪[-][/c: I discovered an [c][ffff00]Alien Golem[-][/c] in the ruins nearby. I don't believe that the Continent Guard can handle it.
冒险者，别害怕，我会暗中保护你。: Don't be afraid, adventurer. I will protect you from the shadows.
我非常赏识你的战斗技巧，只是动作太慢了。: I admire your combat skills, but you move so slowly.
不管怎么样，魔物的数量已经减少了很多。: Regardless, the number of monsters has diminished quite a bit.
我刚到这片遗迹的时候发现了一块[c][ffff00]结晶[-][/c]，带回去给: I discovered a [c][ffff00]Crystal[-][/c] when I first got to these ruins. Take it back to our leader.
回去的路上小心，我怀疑这里的巨石怪就是被这块结晶吸引来的。: Be careful on the way back. These Golems are likely attracted to the crystal.
果然是这些碎片。: So, it is these shards after all.
你带着这些碎片吧，年轻人，必要的时候可以借助它的力量。: You should take these shards with you, young one. You can use their power when needed.
面对毁灭，有时候必须向黑暗借助力量。: Faced with destruction, sometimes one must make use of dark powers.
魔王的骚动引起了梦罗克周围魔物的不安，食物和水也逐渐成了住在梦罗克周围人们的一大: The Demon has aggrevated the monsters around Morroc. Food and water have gradually become scarce for the people of Morroc.
最近在东边出现了大批的狼群。: A large pack of wolves recently appeared in the west.
请赶走那些狂暴的[c][ffff00]沙漠之狼[-][/c]。: Please drive away the berserk [c][ffff00]Desert Wolves[-][/c].
为了彻底击垮那群狼，我们需要找到[c][ffff00]狼王[-][/c]。: To fully eliminate that pack of wolves, we need to find the [c][ffff00]Wolf King[-][/c].
每个狼群总能找到一个狼王，请找到它并击败它。: A Wolf King can always be found in a pack of wolves. Find it and defeat it.
我会记得你曾帮助过[c][ffff00]刺客公会[-][/c]。: I will remember that you helped the [c][ffff00]Assassins Guild[-][/c].
回去告诉巴尔洛，刺客们会记住他的帮助。: Go back and tell Barlaud that the Assassins Guild will remember his help.
就连刺客公会都措手不及了吗？！: Even the Assassins Guild was caught off guard?
听说你带来了[c][ffff00]女神之泪[-][/c]？: I hear you brought the [c][ffff00]Goddess's Tear[-][/c]?
商会的艾尔克一定会激动的掉眼泪吧。: Eric, of the Merchants Guild, will be so happy he'll cry.
这可是生命之水啊，请交给[c][ffff00]艾尔克[-][/c]吧，感谢商会和: These are the Waters of Life. Please give them to [c][ffff00]Eric[-][/c], to thank the Merchants Guild and yourself for your contributions to Morroc.
梦罗克商会自从成立以来就在四处打听，到处寻觅这[c][ffff00]生命之水-女: The Morroc Commerce Guild has put our ears to the ground since its establishment in search of these [c][ffff00]Waters of Life-Goddess's Tear[-][/c].
等到魔王封印危机解除后，我们会让梦罗克焕发出不一样的神采。: Once the Demon's Seal crisis is resolved, we will deck out Morroc in a different kind of splendor.
巴风特也不是一般的魔物，普通的武器无法对它造成巨大的伤害。: Baphomet is no ordinary monster. Normal weapons won't deal much damage to it.
冒险者，[c][ffff00]神工匠哈沃德[-][/c]是一位锻造奇才，他平时四: Adventurer, [c][ffff00]Whitesmith Hayward[-][/c] is a smithing legend. He normally roams around the land, only rarely returning to the Desert Capital.
这几天有人说在城外看到了他。: Someone said they saw him outside the city recently.
你可以找到他，让他强化你手中的武器，用来对付那头羊首恶魔！: You could find him, and have him strengthen your weapons. Then use them to deal with that goat-headed demon!
当然这一切都是免费的，哈沃德曾经也是商旅会的一员。: Of course, all of that would be free. Hayward is also a member of the Merchants Guild.
忽克连那小子没有给你锻造出强大武器吗？: Hollgrehenn didn't forge you any powerful weapons?
既然是艾尔克的委托，那没问题。: Since this is Eric's request, it will be no problem.
别高兴的太早，锻造用的材料还是得你自己收集。: Hold your horses. You still have to collect the forging materials.
梦罗克城的周围到处都是裂隙魔物。: Rift monsters are appearing all around Morroc.
穿越空间是需要强大的力量的，所以从裂隙钻出来的魔物会比这片大陆上的魔物强壮的多。: It requires an enormous amount of power to pass through time and space, so the monsters that emerge from these Rifts are much stronger than the normal monsters on the continent.
而从这些魔物身上也能获取到更为强大的结晶，这是我将为你打造武器的关键材料，请尽可: But you can obtain more powerful crystals from these monsters. This is crucial, as I need to forge a weapon for you. Please [c][ffff00]collect as many crystals as possible[-][/c].
我将为你制作的是一种高度浓缩的附魔力量，我还需要一些[c][ffff00]特殊的: What I will make for you has a high concentration of Enchantment Power. I will also need some [c][ffff00]Special Metal Forges[-][/c] to contain this liquid.
简单的说，我需要一些[c][ffff00]魔法瓶[-][/c]来装这些附魔。: To put it simply, I need some [c][ffff00]Magic Bottles[-][/c] to carry these enchantments.
这附魔的威力非常大，大面积的泄露的话会发生危险。: The enchantments are extremely powerful. If they leak, they will cause a great deal of danger.
[c][ffff00]娣洁[-][/c]身边一定有，只是你得想点办法才能弄过来。: [c][ffff00]Deje[-][/c] is bound to have some, but you have to come up with a way to get them.
什么？附魔吗？[c][ffff00]魔法瓶[-][/c]我可是有很多哦。: What? Enchantments? Oh, I have lots of [c][ffff00]Magic Bottles[-][/c].
不过吉芬的魔法师们可不大方，你至少也得拿点东西来和我换吧，嘻嘻。: But, we Mages of Geffen aren't running a charity. What do you have to trade?
魔王虽然可怕，可是没有金钱更可怕呀。: The Demon may be terrifying, but what's even scarier is not having any money.
我只有三个小小的要求，如果你能帮助我的话，就给你魔法瓶。: I only have three small requests. If you can help me, I will give you the Magic Bottles.
嘻嘻，第一我需要一些[c][ffff00]狼皮[-][/c]，这可值很多的钱；第: Teehee! First I need some [c][ffff00]Wolf Skin[-][/c]. That's worth a lot of money. Secondly, I need some [c][ffff00]Scattered Shards[-][/c] from the crumbling statue in the southwest. Those are very valuable, as well. As for the last thing, I'll tell you when you are finished!
如果娣洁再壮实点就能带更多回去。: If Deje is stronger, you can take more back.
娣洁仿佛看到了金钱攻击，嘻嘻。: Deje attacks as if she has seen Mammonite, teehee.
看起来你很厉害吗，好吧最后一个要求对你来说也很简单。: You seem pretty strong, right? My last request should be pretty easy for you!
这片沙漠四处出现裂隙，而刚才我在附近看到了一只来自[c][ffff00]异世界的: There are Rifts all over this area of the desert. Just now, I saw an [c][ffff00]Alien Nine Tail[-][/c]. Its skin would be very stylish headwear.
娣洁可不敢去挑战它，你能为我打败它吗？: Deje doesn't dare challenge it. Can you beat it for me?
嘻嘻，冒险者，我觉得你即使没有哈沃德的帮助也一定能击败[c][ffff00]巴风: Hehe, adventurer. I bet you can defeat [c][ffff00]Baphomet[-][/c] even without Hayward's help!
这个给你，这是一种非常安全的魔法容器，无论哈沃德灌入多少附魔力量，都不会让魔力外: This is for you. This is an extremely safe magic container. No matter how many enchantments Hayward puts in it, no magic will leak out. But this sort of container is still fragile to drops, so be careful when carrying it.
好吧，看来你也是费了一番功夫才得到这魔法瓶，我现在就将附魔力量注入容器。: Okay, you seem to have gone through a lot to get this magic bottle. I'll put the enchantments in the bottle now.
拿稳了冒险者，当你遇到危险时，就将瓶子内的液体涂抹一点在你的武器上，你的武器将发: Hold it steady, adventurer. When you encounter danger, rub some of the liquid onto your weapon. Your weapon will emit immense power, but don't use too much!
一旦浓度过高，武器的强大力量就不是普通人类可以驾驭得了的。: If you use too much, the power of the weapon won't be one that an ordinary human can handle.
这真是太不可思议了！力量不断涌出。: This is amazing! Power is constantly flowing out.
我给你最后的忠告，[c][ffff00]请谨慎使用[-][/c]，一不小心你的小: My final warning to you is to [c][ffff00]use it carefully[-][/c]. If you aren't careful, you might lose your life!
是吗，果然不愧为[c][ffff00]神工匠[-][/c]，希望你慎用这来之不易: Really? No wonder they call him a [c][ffff00]Whitesmith[-][/c]. You put so much effort into getting this, please use it carefully.
请替我告诉[c][ffff00]巴尔洛[-][/c]，商旅会也会全力备战巴风特的: Tell [c][ffff00]Barlaud[-][/c] that the Merchants Guild will prepare for Baphomet's attack.
哈沃德吗？我也曾听说过他，如果他愿意加入大陆卫队我会更安心。: Hayward? I've heard about him. If he's willing to join the Army Guard, it would put my mind at ease.
现在不是说这些的时候，普隆德拉的骑士团在金字塔发现了[c][ffff00]巴风特: This isn't the time to talk about this. The Prontera Knight Squad discovered [c][ffff00]Baphomet[-][/c] at the Pyramid. Head there immediately!
普隆德拉的勇士！一切拜托了。: Brave warrior from Prontera, please help!
他们说的勇士就是你吗？: Are you the brave warrior they spoke of?
我们终于见面了，希望你真的像他们所说的一样厉害。: Finally, we meet. I hope you're as good as they say.
现在的情况非常紧急，巴风特已经进入了封印之间，我需要你尽快进入封印之间阻止巴风特: The situation is urgent. Baphomet has entered the Sealed Room. We need you to enter the Sealed Room and stop Baphomet as soon as possible.
去找[c][ffff00]尼尔德亚[-][/c]，他会带你进入封印之间的。: Go find [c][ffff00]Nealdea[-][/c]. He will take you to the Sealed Room.
你就是[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]吧，现在的情况: You must be [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]. It's not looking good. Baphomet has already closed the portal to the Sealed Room.
去问问[c][ffff00]卡德摩斯[-][/c]，他是梦罗克大陆卫队的人，应该: Go speak with [c][ffff00]Cadmus[-][/c]. He is a member of the Morroc Continental Guard. He should know a way.
当初建造封印地点的时候为了防止出现这种情况，特地在金字塔其他的地方建造了两座祭坛: The reason the Sealed Room was built was to prevent this sort of thing from happening. Two altars were built in other areas of the Pyramid just for this. If you want to enter the Sealed Room, you must first activate these two altars.
是你？好久不见。: Oh, it's you. Long time, no see.
你是来激活祭坛的吧。: You're probably here to activate the altars.
如你所见，我受了一点伤，祭坛周围布满了[c][ffff00]木乃伊[-][/c]: As you might have noticed, I've been injured. [c][ffff00]Mummies[-][/c] have surrounded the altars. If you want to activate them, you must first clear a path.
那些该死的木乃伊被清理了吧？哼！死了还给我们带来麻烦。: Have you cleared out those damned mummies? Hmph. They're dead, but they're still causing trouble.
现在祭坛上沾满了木乃伊身上所褪下的绷带，这些绷带带有诅咒，我听说这周围有黑狐存在: The altar is covered in Mummy bandages, which are all cursed. I've heard there are Matyrs around. [c][ffff00]Their blood[-][/c] can lift this sort of curse.
你回来的真快！太好了，现在就把这些血液撒在祭坛上吧。: You're back soon! That's great. Spread this blood on the altar.
干的不错，现在的祭坛只要注入能量就可以激活了。去试试吧。: Not bad. The altar has been infused with energy, and can be activated. Try it.
哈哈，想打开封印之间？没那么简单！: Haha, you want to open the Sealed Room? It's not that easy!

好吧，冒险者，我不得不告诉你关于那个神秘的组织，他们的目标就是我引以为傲的“斐扬: Alright adventurer, I suppose I must tell you about that mysterious group. Their goal is our pride and joy, the "Treasure of Payon".
请原谅我无法向你透露更多关于“斐扬秘宝”的情况: Forgive me, but I can't reveal more about the Treasure of Payon to you.
为了守护这座城市，我们绝对不能失去它，但是，凭借我一个人的人力量对抗这些邪恶力量: Defeat is unacceptable if we are to protect the city! But I would never be able to stand up to those evil forces alone!
曾经虎王的威胁已经让这里的居民身陷危机了！: The threat of the Eddga put the lives of the people here in danger!
冒险者，如果可以的话，我请求你和从普隆德拉远道而来的朋友击退那些邪恶的组织，保护: Adventurer, if you are able, please ask your friends from Prontera to help fight these evil forces. Protect our capital of the mountains.
你去哪了？看起来和这里的住民沟通的很顺畅啊…: Where did you go? It seems you have gotten along well with the residents!
是吗？！那真是太惊人了，看来这片城市里还隐藏了更深的秘密: Really? Well that's surprising. It seems this city has even more secrets.
就在几天前，他也来到了斐扬，现在正在东边的森林里调查，不知道他的进展如何了: Several days ago, he came to Payon investigating the forest to east. I wonder how he is doing...
请找到艾勒梅斯，他可是强力的伙伴哦: Please locate Eremes. He is a powerful ally.
莎西尔是我儿时的伙伴，她为了成为一名厉害的猎人来到斐杨，已经在这里定居了，长得很: Shecil is my childhood friend. She moved to Payon to become a skillled Hunter. She is quite the beauty, but she's got a strange temper.
难道你也被派遣到斐杨来解决这里的异常吗？: Have you been sent to Payon to help with the strange happenings as well?
我想说这里的酒真的是这片大陆的财富啊: I just want to say, the wine here is the greatest treasure of the land!
…………可是我不想在我喝酒的时候周围到处都是鬼魂！: ...But I wish there weren't ghosts around me when I'm drinking!
请击退这些鬼魂，至少让我这一杯喝完: Please defeat these ghosts, and let me finish this glass in peace!
喝完了，我们可以谈谈正事了，根据我这几天的调查，这里似乎发生了一些很离奇的事情: I'm finished. Now we can talk about what's going on. Based on my investigation the past few days, some very strange things have happened here.
自从虎王被击败后这里就开始居住斐杨的村民了，虽然时常也会发生一些和魔物的冲突，但: Ever since the Eddga was defeated, Payon residents have started living here. There are occassional monster attacks, but they haven't posed a serious problem.
但是近几年，居民离奇的神隐了，然后就出现了周围这些鬼魂，更可怕的是出现了一些僵尸: But, in recent years the residents have become extremely secretive, and Munaks have appeared. Even more terrifying, there have been zombies seen! This "undead legion" has kept things from becoming peaceful here.
请协助我调查这里的诡异情况: Please help me investigate the strange situation here.
这些破损的建筑看上去确实是人为的，一定是有人袭击了这里的村民: These damaged buildings do seem to be man-made. Someone must have attacked the village.
这里曾是虎王的领地……这里真是美丽啊，这湖水还泛着淡淡的香味，我从未再普隆德拉城: This used to be the territory of the Eddga... It's so beautiful. The lake's waters has a light aroma. I've never seen such clear lake water anywhere in Prontera.
这里被破坏的更严重，看来袭击这里的人不是普通人，但是拥有那么强大力量的人为什么要: This suffered even more damage. A normal man couldn't do this. But why would someone so powerful wish to attack Payon?
从哪里出现的！被埋伏了？: Where did they come from? An ambush?
怎么了？看起来你脸色不太好啊: What's wrong? Your face doesn't look so good.
这样看来，这并不是某种自然现象，而是人为引起的，并且还可以控制不死的力量: This must be the work of a human. Someone that can control the undead. This isn't a natural phenomenon.
刺客公会的人说起过你，欢迎来到斐杨: The person from the Assassins Guild mentioned you. Welcome to Payon.
我已经在斐杨很多年了，这里的村民都很朴实，他们很害怕人们把危险带上这片净土上: I've lived in Payon for years. The villagers here are all simple. They are worried about someone bringing danger to them.
而十几年前斐杨森林的魔物突然狂暴，斐杨城的安全受到了严重的威胁，就在危机蔓延之时: A dozen years or so ago, the monsters of Payon suddenly went berserk. They threatened Payon's safety. Just as danger reached Payon, the Commander went forth, personally leading the guards and archers into Payon Forest to quell the berserk monsters.
然而魔物的实力远超大家的预料，卫兵们几乎全军覆没，只有少数的弓箭手还存活着，但是: But the monsters were far more powerful than they imagined. Almost all of the guards were lost, and only a few archers survived. But the Commander unleashed a startling strength in that battle.
为了测试这些魔物的强度我希望你能切身的感受一下，请赶走森林里的大脚熊，这些魔物即: In order to test the strength of these monsters, I hope you can experience this yourself. Please drive away the Bigfoots in the Forest. To this day, these monsters still retain some of their berserk genes.
完成的很好，这里的魔物要比我在其他地方见到的更强壮: You performed admirably. The monsters here are stronger than any I've seen anywhere else.
据生还者说与虎王的战斗持续了数个月，最终统帅在森林的中央与虎王决战: The survivors said that the battle with the Eddga lasted for months, until the Commander had a fight to the death with the Eddga in the middle of the Forest.
统帅的周身上下涌出了强大到无法想象的力量，亲眼看到的弓箭手说简直像一头红色猛兽: The Commander's body was filled with unimaginable power. The archers who witnessed it said he looked like a red beast.
是的，我想…应该是统帅的气势已经让大家心生畏惧了…: That's right. I think... The Commander's power must have terrified everyone.
哪怕是强大到像虎王这样的魔物，只是瞬间就重伤逃走了，从此以后虎王就再也没有对斐杨: Even the powerful Eddga was instantly wounded by this and fled. From that day forth, the Eddga ever posed a threat to Payon again.
统帅经过那次大战都也是元气大伤，一直在府里修养身体，大家都很担心统帅哪一天会倒下: The Commander's powerful energy was damaged in that battle, and he has been recuperating ever since. Everyone is worried that soon the Commander will fall, and there will be nobody to protect Payon.
你是这样认为的吗？当然我之前也是这样坚信着统帅的，只是最近我发现了一些奇怪的地方: Is that what you think? In the past I believed in the Commander like you, but recently... I've discovered some strange things about him.
是的，我想当你亲眼所见时也会这样想，请你去调查一下斐杨森林的中央区域，那里就是当: That's right. I think when you see them yourself, you'll agree. Please investigate the center of Payon Forest, where the Commander fought the Eddga.
果然有些奇怪，已经过去那么多年了，这里为什么寸草不生: This is strange. It's been years, but still not a single blade of grass grows here.
原来还是有一些植物的，这些是幽光草，夏尔顿到底要这些奇怪的植物做什么呢？难道这些: Oh, there are some plants. This is Glow Grass. What does Charleon really want with these strange plants? Do these plants also hold some sort of secret?
我想我已经了解到一些事情了，这个熟悉的感觉，还有不死魔物的出现，寸草不生的土地…: I think I've seen enough. There's this familiar feeling, the rising of the undead, the bare dirt, and a red monster...
如果你知道了那么就把东西乖乖交出来: If you know that, then hand it over!
看来你也是要帮着那个老头吗！？: So you want to help this old man, too?
那你也成为不死军团的一员吧: Then you shall become a member of the undead legion!
只可惜，不死军团是无穷无尽的！: Unfortunately for you, the undead legion never stops growing!
又是这些魔物，和我们之前看到的一样，大运: These monsters again. They're the same as the ones we saw before, Dawin.
希望你没有被吓到，勇敢的孩子: I hope you weren't frightened, brave child.
勇敢的孩子，噢~不~应该说是大陆的英雄: Brave child, er, no... Hero of the land
这里就是统帅和虎王决斗的地方吗？: Is this where the Commander fought the Eddga?
不可思议，我和金胜还有统帅是从小一起长大的，统帅从小就很善于战术布置和出谋划策，: I can't believe it. Kinshin and I grew up with the Commander. He was skilled in battle tactics and strategies from a young age. In actual fighting though, he was scrawny and weak. Never training. A few decades ago, Kinshin and I left to train, and he stayed behind to maintain the peace in Payon.
想到在我们不在的这段时间里他变了那么多，居然取得了比我和金胜更强的力量，这太惊人: It's surprising to see how much he has changed since we've been away. He's actually stronger than both Kinshin and I now!
事情可能有蹊跷: Might not be as it seems.
你见过这些粉尘吗？我在发现了这周围散发着红色光芒的粉尘，虽然只有一点点但是我想统: Have you seen this dust before? There's a red, glowing dust emitted around here. There is only a little bit, but I think that the Commander's strength must be related to this dust.
这里狂暴的野猪就是最好证明，请带回一些野猪的毛皮，我要带回斐杨好好研究一下: The berserk Savages here are the best proof of this. Please bring back some Savage Fur. I'll take it back to Payon to research it.
有了这些我们就能了解到统帅不为人知的秘密了: With these, we can learn the Commander's secrets.
冒险者，在回斐杨的途中我和金胜发现一些令人不安的事情，有一个徘徊在森林里的黑衣人: Adventurer, on the way back to Payon, Kinshin and I discovered some disturbing things. There is a man in black wandering around the Forest. He has the ability to bring people back from the dead, and make them attack every living thing it sees.
原来你就是那个拯救了梦罗克的英雄吗？值得尊敬，我叫金胜，出生在这片绿意盎然的土地: You must be the hero that saved Morroc. Much respect. My name is Kinshin. I was born in this land of abundant greenery.
但是这里什么时候出现了这么多将军魔碑的?这会让来到斐杨的客人害怕: But when did so many Greatest Generals appear here? This will scare the guests of Payon.
我有个不情之请，请你击退这些将军魔碑！: I have a difficult favor to ask of you. I'd like you to defeat these Greatest Generals!
这里魔碑都是古代的将军们的墓碑，其中还包括了曾经斐杨的长老，我的爷爷，金初羽将军: These Generals are the tombstones of ancient generals, and include my grandfather, Kinchoice, the elder of Payon.
这些魔物寄生在墓碑上，让死者不得安宁: These monsters are parisites of the tombstones, so that the dead can't rest.
请为我平息初羽将军的灵魂，他就再西北边的山崖旁: Please put General Kinchoice's soul to rest for me. He is near the cliffs in the northeast.
我一定会找出这次事件的幕后黑手: I must find who did this.
我和金胜之前就发现了东北房的破旧建筑里有些诡异，我们打算先行过去调查一下之后再回: Kinshin and I discovered some strange things in a run-down building in the northwest. We're going to investigate before heading back to Payon.
感谢你的协助，冒险者，后会有期！: Thanks for your help, adventurer. We shall meet again!
你们到底是想在斐杨森林了解什么事情呢？: What do you want to learn about in the Payon Forest?
我们要做什么和你没关系！这就是你的不死军团吗？别吓唬人了: This is none of your business! Is this your undead legion? They aren't so scary.
你又有什么目的，为什么要来带斐杨: What is your goal? Why did you come to Payon?
看来你们真是毫不知情啊，你们的统帅所拥有的斐杨秘宝究竟是什么东西你们知道吗？: You really don't know anything, do you? Do you know what it is, the Treasure of Payon that your Commander has?
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，看来还是有聪明人的，乖乖交出来的话说不定我还能允许你们做我的部: Hahahaha! It seems you're not stupid after all. Hand it over and I might even let you serve me.
怎么可能！又是巨人之心碎片搞得鬼，但是你又是谁你的目的是什么: Never! You will never get it! Who are you? Why do you want it?
我就让你们知道你们所面对的是何等的力量: I will show you what kind of power you are dealing with.
我是芙蕾雅大人的十二神使之一: I am one of the twelve God Envoys of Master Freya.
芙蕾雅大人拥有十二名守护者，我们被称为十二神使，负责保护芙蕾雅大人同时完成芙蕾雅: Master Freya has twelve protectors known as the twelve God Envoys. We are responsible for protecting Master Freya, and also carrying out his orders.
我奉命收集散落在大陆各处的伊米尔之心碎片，你们这些凡人的力量在我面前不值一提: I was tasked with collecting the Yimir Heart Shards that were scattered across the land. You mortals are like mere ants before me!
消灭你们甚至不需要我动手，噢~等等，看来东面的废墟有客人到了: I could destroy you without moving. Oh, wait a second. It seems there is a guest to the east.
我去陪他们玩玩，你们就和我的不死军团聊聊吧~哈哈哈哈哈: I'm going to go play with them. I'll let you all talk with my undead legion.
看来这里不死属性的魔物都在他的控制之中！: All of the undead monsters here are under their control!
看来必须和统帅谈一谈了: It seems I should talk with the Commander
这里交给我们把，你快去解救东面的人: We'll take care of this. You go save the person to the east!
冒险者我们中了埋伏，幸好有你: Adventurer, we were ambushed. Luckily, you were here.
我有点受伤，刚才我们看到了黑衣人了，是一个女子: I'm a little injured. Just now, we saw the person in black. It was a woman.
金胜追了过去，我有些担心他，冒险者请你先过去支援金胜: Kinshin chased her, but I'm worried about him. Adventurer, go ahead and help Kinshin.
一群被控制的僵尸缓缓站立了起来: A swarm of controlled Munaks slowly stand up.
找到我又如何？人类的力量如此弱小，我是带给你们死亡的神！: So what if you've found me? Humans are so weak! I am a god who will bring death upon you!
那可要感谢你们所崇拜的统帅，曾经在这片森林里为了和这些魔物决战，使用了伊米尔之心: You should thank the Commander you adore so much for that. He used an Yimir Heart Shard in this forest to fight a monster, and that made me aware that the Shard was here! Once I arrived, I discovered the Shard's dust filling the forest!
为了找到碎片还让我浪费很长的时间，你们这些蝼蚁！: You ants have wasted enough of my time. I must find the Shard!
混蛋！我不管你到底是为了什么，我一定要打败你: Bastard! I don't care why you're doing this, I will destroy you!
虽然还没有完成，但是只好放手一搏了: I'm not finished. I'll have to give it my all.
尝尝我多年的修炼成果吧！: Feel the power of my years of training!
这是什么！可恶我居然被蝼蚁所伤！: You ants have actually hurt me?
不过此刻我想你们的统帅应该已经被消灭了！: But your Commander should have perished by now!
冒险者，我的身体暂时恢复不了，霸凰拳耗尽了我所有的体力: Adventurer, my body won't heal right now. That Asura Strike sapped all my energy.
请立刻赶回斐杨城保护统帅: Please return to Payon and protect the Commander
乖乖交出伊米尔之心，我就能获得无穷的力量了: Be good and hand over the Yimir Heart, and I can gain infinite power.
你认为你有胜算吗？: Do you think you stand a chance?
夏尔顿拿出了幽光药剂: Charleon takes out a Glow Potion
现在有胜算了吗？！哈哈哈哈哈哈: Do you think you have a chance now? Hahaha!
夏尔顿，我对你太失望了，我再给你最后一次机会，如果再失败你就葬身在这里吧: Charleon, I am disappointed in you. I will give you one last chance. If you fail again, you shall be buried here.
死亡的气息弥漫周围: Death and darkness fill the surroundings
我在死亡国度相见吧！: I'll see you in the Town of the Dead!
对不起冒险者，我的确向你们隐瞒了关于伊米尔之心的事情: I'm sorry, adventurer. I hid the truth about the Yimir Heart from you.
你答应过我和金胜的事情你做到了没有！: Have you done what you promised Kinshin and me you would?
大运………………金胜的离去我很遗憾，但是你们有没有为我想过: Dawin... I'm sorry about the loss of Kinshin, but have you thought about me?
在你们离开后，村子大小事务全部是我一个人在打理，虎王的袭击远远比你们想的更可怕: After you left, I had to take care of everything in the village. The attack of the Eddga was far more terrifying than you could imagine.
我亲眼见到猎人的弓箭射向狂暴的魔物，但是一点作用都没有，钢制弓箭都无法穿透那些魔: I was there to see the Hunters' arrows hit the berserk monster and do nothing. Even steel arrows couldn't pierce its hide.
我除了使用这些“远古神力”我别无他法，而我也受到了惩罚: There was no other way but to use these ancient powers, and I have paid the price for it.
我只是沾染了一点粉尘，在力量消退后几十年都全身无力，我也不想事情发生到这个地步: I only rubbed on a little bit of the dust, and I've been sapped of strength in the decades that followed after my power faded. I didn't want things to go this far.
统帅交出了伊米尔之心: The Commander hands over the Yimir Heart.
那么多年没有相见了，没想到是这样一个情况下见到了…………: We haven't seen each other for so long. I never expected we would reunite like this.
不管发生什么事，我都将守护者这座城市，哪怕是献出我的生命: No matter what happens, I will protect this city, even if it costs me my life.
你对斐杨的恩情我会记在心里的，请转达我对你那几位朋友的歉意: I will remember how you helped Payon. Please give my apologies to your friends.
对于金胜先生的事我也感到非常的遗憾: I'm filled with remorse about Mr. Kinshin.
大运先生又一次进入了斐杨森林了，请去与让他道别吧，我们准备回普隆德拉吧: Mr. Dawin has entered Payon Forest again. Please bid him farewell. We're getting ready to return to Prontera.
金胜，你就在这边和你爷爷安息吧: Kinshin, you rest here with your grandfather.
对不起，大运，金胜的事情我。。。: I'm sorry, Dawin. About Kinshin, I...
我无法原谅你，更无法原谅自己: I can't forgive you, but nor can I forgive myself.
我不知道我这几十年的修行到底有什么意义，我谁都保护不了: I don't know what my decades of training have been for. I can't protect anyone.
是吗…………终究还是没和好啊，有点可惜呢: Really... It's a shame they weren't able to patch things up in the end.
嘿，冒险者你很不错，想不到你已经成长得这么厉害了。: Hey, adventurer, You're getting pretty strong. I never imagined you would grow to become so powerful.
看来初级的附魔已经不能满足你的需要了吧？嘿嘿嘿……: It seems that basic enchantments aren't enough for you, are they? Hehe.
是啊，你永远无法想象附魔的力量…..嘻嘻嘻……: Yes, You could never imagine the power of these enchantments, Teehee.
想要了解更多的话，就去找吉芬的雷藏吧！: If you want to know more, seek out Reyen in Geffen!
冒险者，你来了。这次有什么事情吗？: Hello, adventurer. What do you need this time?
附魔啊…唔，吉芬的图书馆中有关于这个的资料，我可以为你去查一查。: Enchantments? Oh, the Geffen library has some materials about this. I could look into it for you.
在此期间，你能帮我清理一下吉芬附近的哥布灵吗？: While I do that, can you eliminate some of the goblins around Geffen for me?
他们的数量又开始增长了，再这么下去，恐怕会对吉芬产生威胁。: Their numbers are growing again. If we let it continue, They might pose a threat to Geffen.
这么快就回来了？冒险者你的实力进步很快啊！: That was quick! Adventurer, Your strength is growing quickly!
关于附魔，我倒是查到了一些资料。。: I looked up some information about enchantments.
根据古籍上的记载，附魔是众神创造出来，为了让人们得到更加强大力量的一种秘法。: According to ancient texts, enchantments were created by the Gods, as a type of magic that could make people more powerful.
附魔分为初级附魔，中级附魔还有高级附魔，不同等级的附魔会有不同的效果。: Enchantments are divided into Basic Enchantments, Intermediate Enchantments, and Advanced Enchantments, and different levels of enchantments have different effects.
而中级、高级的附魔在一定程度上借用了众神的力量，使得武器在初级附魔的基础上更加强: Intermediate and Advanced Enchantments make use of the Gods' power to a certain extent to make a weapon more powerful than a Basic Enchantment can.
高级附魔后的武器甚至可以比拟众神使用的武器。: Weapons that receive Advanced Enchantments can even be as powerful as the weapons that the Gods use.
不过我想你可以去找哈沃德，他应该会知道具体附魔效果。: But I think you should go see Hayward. He should know the specific enchantment effects.
哟~冒险者，你好像很久没来找我啦！: Hullo, adventurer! You haven't come to see me in a long time!

你一定想不到现在兽人们酝酿着什么阴谋！: You'll never guess what those Orcs are up to now!
我们勇敢的骑士深入兽人部落拿回来的情报上说，这些兽人在准备着一场规模空前的袭击。: The intelligence that our brave knights retrieved from the Orc tribe says the Orcs are preparing for an attack like we've never seen before.

只有消灭他们三个领头的，就能让那些兽人无法下手。冒险者你能够帮助我吗？: If you kill their three leaders, they can't attack. Can you help me, adventurer?

不过可以肯定的是，他就在桥对面的篝火附近，至于他的确切位置，很抱歉，我也不知道。: But what is certain, is that he is near the bonfire on the other side of the bridge. I'm sorry I can't be more precise.

我是梦罗克商旅会的运货人，就在前几天，我运货路过这里却遭到了兽人的抢劫！这些蛮横: I'm a transporter of the Morroc Merchants Guild. A few days ago, I was robbed by Orcs on the way here! Those brutish brigands!

天啊！鬼知道这些兽人脑子里是怎么想的！这群肮脏的强盗！我为什么要抄捷径走这条路线: Who knows what those damn Orcs were thinking?... Filthy bandits! Why did I try to take that shortcut?! Coles, you are such a moron!

所以冒险者，你能够帮帮我这个可怜人吗？: So could you help a pitiful man like me, adventurer?

干得漂亮冒险者！这是给你的奖励。: Well done, adventurer! Here is your reward.

找到了！他现在应该在囚车附近修理那些囚车呢。: Found him! He should be at the prisoner carts nearby fixing them.
