善良的乌加特把他带出了危险的沼泽，花了很长时间为这位客人治疗魔物造成的伤势。: The kind Ugarte led him out of the dangerous swamp, and spent a long time healing the wounds the monsters had inflicted on the man.
这位客人的伤势好了之后，却乘着先祖熟睡之际，悄悄离开了他。临行前客人感念这段时间: After the wounds had healed, the man quietly left while Mike was sleeping. Before he left, knowing that Ugarte had taken such good care of him, the guest left behind a thick piece of parchment and a letter.
先祖醒来后发现客人不见了，他阅读着客人留下的信件，他才明白，原来那位客人是侍奉于: Once Ugarte woke up, he read the letter the guest had left, and discovered that his guest was a dwarf bound to the service of the Gods. He had forged many powerful weapons for them, Including Odin's Eternal Spear.
他感念先祖的照料，留下了由卢恩文写成的铸造书卷以及一小块世界树的枝干，并且告诉先: Recalling Ugarte's care, he left behind a smithing scroll written in Runic, as well as a branch from the World Tree. He told Mike that major chaos would soon erupt, and he hoped that he could pass down this art throughout the land. Forever.
不久后，正如侏儒所料，灾难开始了，而早有准备的先祖准备了充足的食物躲避了战火的洗: Not long later, just as the dwarf said, disaster struck. But, my ancestor who was prepared, gathered some food and avoided the fires of war.
在地下这几年，他把羊皮卷上的铸造技术研究了大半，他所铸造的武器与装备坚固无比，魔: In the following years he remained underground, studying various smithing techniques. The weapons and armor he made was stronger than anything else. Magic flowed through them, possessing them with great strength.
灾难之后新的秩序建立，他也来到了幸存者的聚集地，凭借他强大的铸造技术站稳了脚跟，: After the war, a new order was established. He established himself amongst the survivors for his strong smithing techniques, creating a powerful family that has been around for a millennium--the Ugarte family.
作为大陆上首席的铸造家族，我们乌加特家族也为大陆的危机贡献出了自己的力量。: As the top family of smiths in the land, the Ugarte family has helped use its strength in many crises.
梦罗克魔王入侵大陆之时，我们家族拿出了祖先留下的世界树枝干，请所有家族的铸造师，: When Morroc was invaded by the the Demon King, our family used the World Tree branch that was passed down for generations to summon all the smiths of the family. We created an unbreakable suit of armor for the spellsword Thanatos, which was called the Protector of Thanatos.
达纳托斯凭借这身铠甲承受住了魔王的致命一击，最终成功封印了魔王。: It was with this suit of armor that Thanatos endured an otherwise lethal blow from the Demon King, and was finally able to seal it away.
为大陆做出了巨大贡献的乌加特家族的名声也在大陆之上广为流传，各国对我们家族的技术: The renown of the Ugarte family, who had made enormous contributions to Midgarts, began growing throughout the land. Countries all over desired our family's skills, but nobody dared challenge the dignity of Thanatos. Our family's prestige throughout Midgarts allowed our family to survive in safety.
家族千年来积累了大量的财富，而我们也为大陆上的冒险者们提供优良的武器。: Our family has accumulated massive wealth for generations, as provide high-quality weapons for adventurers all across the land.
而现在，我们家族的生意遍布整个大陆，几乎每个城市都有着家族的族人存在，家族的名望: Our family's business now stretches all across Midgarts. There is a member of our family in almost every city, and our business has reached its peak. We are undoubtedly one of the most powerful families in Midgarts.
乌加特家族是使用天生不能导入魔力的普通材料制造武器防具，经由乌加特家族技术制造的: The Ugarte family uses ordinary materials that can't normally be magically enhanced to create weapons and armor. This solves the issue of normal materials not being able to hold magic, and allows these weapons and equipment to be enchanted.
而哈沃德通过稀有的魔力材料以附魔的形式铸造，简单来说就是铸造与附魔同时进行的一种: Hayward uses rare magical materials and enchantments to smith. To put it simply, he uses a technique of simultaneous smithing and enchanting. We call it "Enchantment Smithing."
我们家族在铸造这一领域的成就让哈沃德也盛赞不已，称我们家族是大陆第一的铸造家族。: Our family's achievements in this area have earned Hayward's praise as well. He has called our family the best smithing family in the land.
我们家族的工艺是根据侏儒的铸造书卷，经过一代代乌加特人的苦心研究演变而来。侏儒的: Our family's techniques are based on the smithing scroll from the dwarf. These techniques have evolved through research over generations. In the dwarf's smithing scroll, the materials of weapons and armor are incomparably precious, using things like World Tree branches, Star Iron, which never rust.
加上侏儒特有的卢恩文铭刻魔力，才造就了威力强大的神器，人类显然无法找到如此珍贵的: Only by adding rune engraving magic unique to dwarves can one create powerful weapons fit for the gods. Humans can't find such precious materials.
乌加特人经过一代又一代的研究，终于研究出用普通的铁，钢等金属铸造出精良的武器。: Through our research, the Ugarte family has found ways to use ordinary iron and steel to forge outstanding weapons.
他们用普通的材料铸造出的武器锋利无比，不易损坏，并且通过他们家族工艺铸造的武器可: They use normal materials to create weapons that are incomparably sharp and rarely break. Their family techniques are used to create weapons that can be enchanted, refined, and upgraded in other ways.
精炼大师忽克连曾说过：乌加特家族的武器是最适合精炼的武器。: Hollgrehenn, the refining master himself, once said that Ugarte weapons are the best weapon for refining.
“可以成长的武器防具”这才是乌加特家族铸造工艺的代表。: "Weapons and armor that can grow" represents the smithing techniques of the Ugarte family.
我很满意你之前的表现，现在我有一个额外的要求，你可以把它当作第五项考核。: I'm quite pleased with your previous performance. Now, I have an additional favor to ask. Think of it as the fifth test.
你知道，冒险者经常要面对孤独的长途旅程，这时候如果有一些酷炫有趣的玩具物品陪伴，: You know, adventurers often have to face long, lonely journeys. If you had some cool, fun toys with you, a boring, lonely trip could become exciting.
我听说新型玩具[c][ffff00]艾娃[-][/c]和物品[c][ffff00: I've heard the new toy, [c][ffff00]Eva[-][/c], and the the [c][ffff00]Dead Branch[-][/c] item, are extremely popular. Please bring them to me.
请带给我一个[c][ffff00]艾娃[-][/c]，如果你怕麻烦的话，可以去各: Please bring me an [c][ffff00]Eva[-][/c]. If it's a hassle, you can always shop around the major toy merchants. They have what I want.
请带给我一些[c][ffff00]枯树枝[-][/c]，听说树精身上就有这种东西: Please bring me some [c][ffff00]Dead Branches[-][/c]. I've heard that Willows have them. Of course, you can also buy some at the Exchange. Go on!
回来了吗？快让我看看这有趣的东西！: You're back. Let me see them!
干得真不错，你果然已经理解了冒险者的生活。: Not bad. You do understand the adventurer life.
真是遗憾，你的身上并没有我想要的东西呢！: That's too bad, you don't have what I want!
事实上，一切超自然的现象都不能用常理来解释！: Actually, no supernatural phenomenon can be explained using common sense!
在获得一定利益的同时,也必然存在同等的风险！: When you want benefits, expect some risks as well!
真是令人遗憾，现在的年轻人可真不值得信赖！: Such a shame. Young people nowadays really can't be relied on.
我的研究已经到了紧要关头，这个研究与斐扬人民生死攸关，极其重要，如果你能给我带来: My research is at a pivotal point. This research involves the life and death of the people of Payon. It's extremely important. If you can bring me some Blue Gemstones, I will tell you the results of my research!
哈哈哈，多亏了你的馈赠，我终于在今天成功的到达了那一步。: Haha, thank you for your gift! I have finally successfully reached that step.
真是令人信赖的年轻人，那么作为回报，我就把刚刚得到的研究成果告诉你。: What a reliable young person. As a reward, I will tell you the results of my research.
一直以来，地下洞穴的魔物都是斐扬居民的困扰，这些魔物拥有不死的寿命和极强的防御力: For a long time, the monsters in the dungeon have plagued the people of Payon. These monsters are undead and have extremely high defense, which means it is difficult to eliminate them.
自从上次地下洞穴的魔物暴乱发生以后，斐扬人已经很少说起地下魔物了，不过对于科学研: Ever since the monsters in the dungeon went berserk, the people of Payon rarely speak of them. But when it comes to scientific research, only by facing the problem head-on will we find a solution.
在数百个日夜里我始终在重复地做着同一件事，就在刚才从你给我的蓝色魔力矿石里，我意: For hundreds of days and nights, I have been doing the same thing over and over again, and in the Blue Gemstone that you brought me, I unexpectedly extracted some Star Power!
正是这一丝星辰之力，使得这附近的不死魔气淡化了许多，我坚信对于不死魔物，星辰之力: It is this sliver of Star Power that calmed the undead monsters nearby. I am confident that Star Power is their weakness!
可现在有一个问题摆在眼前，这似乎有点难度……: But now we face another problem, and it seems difficult.
众所周知，星辰之力是极其神秘的力量，这种力量纯净无暇，强大无比，是一切邪恶的克星: Everyone knows that Star Power is extremely mysterious, and is pure and incomparably powerful. It is the bane of evil. But it is also due to this that very rarely can people truly master it.
关于这个，一直是一个谜团，或许只有专业的占星师才能知道吧。: This has always been a mystery. Perhaps, only a professional Diviner knows.
很抱歉，对于占星师来说，星辰之力是连接占星者与浩瀚星空的纽带，我们可不能随便的就: I'm sorry, but for a diviner, Star Power is what binds diviners with the vast cosmos. We would never reveal the secrets of Star Power so easily.
不过我听说有一种不死心脏，可以极大的增强人体的感应能力，对于占星师来说这可是个宝: But I've heard about something called an Immortal Heart, which can enhance a person's senses. This is a treasure for a diviner. If you can bring me some Immortal Hearts, I can tell you the secrets of Star Power.
这可真是一种神奇的东西呢，有了这些东西说不定我就可以回复自己的能力呢！: This is miraculous. With these things, I might be able to recover my power!
我可以告诉你，即使是现在的占星师，也无法完全掌握纯净的星辰之力，而只能利用少量的: I can tell you that even diviners can't fully control pure Star Power, using only small amounts of Star Power to conduct divinations. Such a small amount of Star Power would be minor for monsters.
不过曾经有一位占星师，她成功的将星辰之力接入人体并加以控制。: But there was once a diviner who successfully infused Star Power into her body, and could control it.
她是我们占星师的祖师巴罗娜，当时的她突破了人体的极限，将星辰之力从浩瀚的星空中接: She was the ancestor of diviners, Barluna. At the time, she broke through the limits of the human body. She infused the Star Power into her body before transferring it to a member of the Wisdom family.
智家人由此获得了纯净温顺的星辰之力，而巴罗娜则因为星辰之力的强大破坏力而身体崩坏: From this, the Wisdom family member was able to gain pure, Docile Star Power. But Barluna collapsed from the destructive force of the Star Power and soon passed away.
所以，如果你想要获得纯净的星辰之力就只能去找智家的人了。: So if you want to obtain pure Star Power, you must find one of the Wisdoms.
不过前不久的地下魔物暴乱，似乎智家的人都在暴乱中神秘失踪了。关于这件事，你可以去: Not long ago, there was a rampage of underground monsters, and it seems all of the Wisdom family mysteriously disappeared. You will have to go to Yoshino, of the Payon Guard, who was in charge of clearing out the monsters to learn more.
当时的情形十分紧迫，眼看地下狂暴的魔物就要窜出地面，负责守护的智家长老汇聚了所有: With a crisis about to occur, and berserk monsters soon to come aboveground, the elder Wisdom responsible for defenses gathered all of his people's Star Power to detonate in the hole. A blast.
后来的情形没有人知道，只是最近我听负责巡逻的士兵报告说，在地下洞穴里出现了和智家: Nobody knows what happened afterwards. Though, recently I've heard that an undead monster resembling the elder Wisdom has appeared in the dungeon.
现在的地下洞穴非常危险，冒险者，请你一定要三思而后行。: The dungeon is extremely dangerous now, adventurer. Please don't go in there without preparation.
没想到事情的原委竟然是这样的。: I never thought that this was how things would have started.
不过按照常理，人体内如果蕴藏着某种力量，这种力量并不会因为人体死亡而消亡，而是会: If a person's body possesses a certain power, that power shouldn't dissipate when they die. It should become a crystal that is kept deep within their body.
这说明如果能够消灭已经沦为魔物的智家长老，从他们体内就能够取得相当纯净的固化星辰: That means that if you can slay the elder Wisdom who became a monster, you could extract pure, crystallized Star Power from his body. This would be a breakthrough for the research around this.
我很高兴你能有这样的信心，只是不死魔物生性狡诈，只有新鲜的血液才能吸引到它们。所: I'm glad that you're so confident, but undead monsters can be tricky. Only fresh blood can attract them. So please, go collect some fresh Bigfoot blood outside the city first.
你完成得非常出色，我也很放心把这个任务交给你。: You did brilliantly. I can give you this task with complete confidence.
好了，现在是时候进入地下洞穴了，记住使用新鲜的血液来引诱不死魔物。一旦取得星辰结: Alright, now it is time to enter the dungeon. Remember to use the fresh blood to attract undead monsters. Once you get the Star Crystal, please fall back immediately.
哈哈哈，我的推测果然没有错，有了这些星辰之力，我就可以顺利进行不死魔物研究了，这: Haha! My hypothesis was correct! With this Star Power, I can research undead monsters more easily. This is undoubtedly a milestone achievement!
冒险者，非常感谢你的帮忙，斐扬人民会记住你为斐扬所做的一切努力！: Thank you so much for your help, adventurer. The people of Payon will remember everything that you have done for us!
我可算是遇到一个难题了，你能帮助我吗？: I seem to have encountered a difficult problem. Can you help me?
现在的年轻人都这么没有同情心吗？这还真是一件令人沮丧的事呢！: Do young people nowadays have no empathy? So depressing!
太感谢你了冒险者，我是来自梦罗克商旅会的酒商，我本想拉着特制的美酒来斐扬卖个好价: Thank you so much, adventurer. I'm a wine merchant from the Morroc Merchants Guild. I originally wanted to bring this specially-made wine to Payon to sell for a good price, but who could have known...
斐扬人根本不喝葡萄酒，他们只习惯喝本地酿制的清酒，如果不想点办法，我可真要血本无: The people of Payon don't know anything about wine. They only drink their locally-made rice liquor. If I don't come up with something, I'll have to go back empty-handed!
以眼下的情况，只能酿制一些本地的清酒才能迎合斐扬人的口味，减少一些损失。所以，你: Based on what's happening, it seems I have to make some local rice liquor to meet their needs, and reduce some of my losses. So I'd like to ask you to get some Wine Grass used for fermentation. The Elder Willows in Payon South drop it.
这还真是一种奇怪的东西呢，谁又能知道斐扬人都喜欢用这种东西来酿酒呢！: This stuff is so weird. Not sure why the people of Payon use this to make their liquor...
冒险者，这次多亏有你的帮忙，接下来我就可以用酒香草来酿制一些纯正的清酒了。: Adventurer, thank you for your help. Next, I can use the Wine Grass to ferment some rice liquor.
不过如果用甘甜可口的葡萄酒汁混合清香迷人的酒香草调制而出的新型美酒，又会不会得到: But, if I mix my sweet and delicious wine with the Wine Grass to create something light and appetizing, would the people of Payon like it? Of course, this will be what I research next!
冒险者，如果你也是个外来者，即使你已经对斐扬有所了解了，但我想你仍需要去作出更加: Adventurer, as an outsider, and even though you know a bit about Payon, there is more to learn more about it. This city in the mountains has its own beliefs and spirit!
我想你可以去拜访阅历丰富的冒险者索罗·图克，他可是很乐于帮助我们这些外来者呢！: I think you could go visit the experienced adventurer, Solo Took. He is happy to help outsiders like us!
咦，竟然是一个冒险者，我正在斐扬度假，你是怎么找到我的？: Oh, it's an adventurer! I'm vacationing in Payon, how did you find me?
原来是他，不得不说那个家伙还真是个冒险主义者，竟然不远千里从梦罗克来到斐扬经商。: Oh, him. I have to say that fellow really does have an adventurous spirit. He actually came all the way from Morroc to Payon as a merchant!
那么冒险者，请告诉我，你的来意是什么？: Now then, adventurer, why are you here?
相比庄严肃穆的普隆德拉，斐扬这里更加显得钟灵秀美，古色古香，这也是我选择来斐扬度: Compared to the stately and regal Prontera, Payon is more elegant, with an antique charm. This is why I chose to come here for my vacation.
当然，任何一个悠久古老的地方都会形成自己独特的文化信仰，这种信仰无论好坏，作为外: Of course, any place with a long history will form its own unique culture and belief system. As outsiders, this sort of faith, whether it is good or bad, is something that we can only learn and adapt to.
那么关于斐扬的信仰，我倒是可以给你一些线索。: I can give you some clues about the faith of Payon.
斐扬人永远不会向困难低头，他们开拓探索自立自强，关于这点你可以去找猎人成勇，他会: The people of Payon will never crumble with difficulties. They fight hard, and work to strengthen themselves. You can seek out the Hunter Cheyon to learn more.
英勇的战斗是斐扬人与生俱来的本能，只有无所畏惧的勇者才会得到斐扬人的尊重，如果你: Courage during battle is something the people of Payon are just born with. Only Braves who fear nothing can earn the respect of the people of Payon. If you are strong enough, please go to the Deputy Commander. He will test your courage!
斐扬人热爱创造，渴求知识，也非常欢迎智者的来访，如果你是深邃的智者那么请你去与魔: The people of Payon love to create, and seek knowledge. They welcome the visits of Professors and profoundly intelligent individuals. Please talk with the monster scholar, Bricue, who is a well-known scholar in Payon.
团结勇敢的斐扬人在不断探索中建立了斐扬城，在与野兽的搏斗中提升了狩猎技术，并成功: The unified and brave people of Payon have built Payon through constant exploration. Battles with wildlife have improved their hunting abilities, helping them survive.
因而对于斐扬人来说，不管在多么艰难的处境中，如果没有狩猎的本能和对于探索的渴望，: No matter how dire the situation, if they don't have the instinct to hunt and a desire to explore, they won't be accepted in Payon!
年轻的冒险者，你是否也愿意向大家展示高超的狩猎技巧呢？: Young adventurer, are you willing to show everyone your hunting skills?
那么请去斐扬树林清理一些凶恶的野猪。: Please go to Payon Forest and clear out some of those despicable Savages.
冒险者你非常勇敢，你积极进取的冒险精神会一直鼓舞着斐扬的人们开拓探索。: You're so brave, adventurer. Your adventurous spirit will inspire the people of Payon to keep exploring.
事情的发展似乎有点出乎意料了，这可真是令我头疼。: Things have developed a bit unexpectedly. This is a real headache now.
虽然我很不愿意承认，但地下洞穴的魔物已经成为了斐扬的重大威胁。谁也不清楚下一次的: I really hate to admit it, but the monsters in the dungeon have become a severe threat to Payon. Nobody knows when the next disaster will happen. Failure may be upon us soon.
所以，我们决不能放任魔物肆虐成长，更不能让它们靠近地面，因而定期的魔物清理是极其: We can't allow the monsters to grow any stronger, nor can we let them reach the surface. That's why periodically quelling their number is so necessary.
冒险者，请你去地下洞穴消灭一些嗜血狂暴的僵尸，它们已经快不受控制了。: Adventurer, please head into the dungeon and eliminate some bloodthirsty, Berserk Munaks. They're almost out of control.
真是让我感到意外，你英勇的表现赢得了来自斐扬各行各业的掌声，你是斐扬当之无愧的勇: How unexpected. Your bravery deserves praise from all of Payon. You are without a doubt, a Brave of Payon.
在斐扬，我希望你能清楚地认识到作为一名杰出的冒险者，不仅要具有足够丰富的冒险经验: I hope you can clearly understand that to be a true adventurer, not only must one have a wealth of adventuring experience, you must also possess the ability to use your mind.
那么我将问你几个问题，而你必须要做出你的回答，我希望你能深思熟虑后做出选择。: I will ask you a few questions, and you must give the correct answers. Please choose your answers carefully.
你的选择让我感到遗憾，你可能并没有做好应对危机的准备。: Your choice is unfortunate. You might not be prepared to deal with the crisis.
你回答得很棒，我想即使是在真正的考验面前，以你的智慧也能从容应对！: Respectable answers. I think that during a real challenge, you would be able to handle it easily with your wisdom.
真是令人惊讶，你用完美的表现赢得了所有斐扬人的尊重呢！: Astonishing! You have won the respect of the people of Payon with your perfect performance.
现在的你在斐扬可算是出名啦，就连斐扬的统帅也要指名见你呢！快去找他吧。: You're famous in Payon now! Even the Payon Commander has said he wants to see you. You should go speak with him.
冒险者，你的表现真是太精彩了，你用出色的实力和过人的智慧征服了整个斐扬，即使是我: Adventurer, your performance has been outstanding. You have impressed all of Payon with your power and intelligence. I can feel that you have brought new life to Payon. I see the powerful faith that Payon is proud of in you!
在此之前，我甚至一度迷惘，作为斐扬的统帅，我却不知道将斐扬带往何处！: Before this, I was even at a loss for time. I didn't know which direction I should lead Payon, as its Commander!
自从地下洞穴的灾难发生以后，斐扬的人们都变得小心翼翼起来，他们不敢去野外探索，不: Ever since the disaster in the dungeon occurred, the people of Payon have become cautious. They no longer explore the wilderness, go out at night, or even mention the names of monsters. I have to say, it is quite unfortunate.
但你的出现打消我的疑惑，我坚定地相信，只要有你的帮助，斐扬一定可以走出地下魔物的: Your arrival has made me cast aside my doubts. I firmly believe that with your help. Payon can free itself from the shadows of the monsters, and continue to thrive in this ancient land.
冒险者，为此我有一个请求，请你一定不要拒绝。: Adventurer, to achieve this, I would like to ask a favor. Please don't refuse!
请你去地下洞穴消灭不死魔物的首领智通！: Please go to the dungeon and slay the leader of the undead monsters, Tom Wisdom!
他曾是斐扬的守护者，死后却成了极其凶恶的魔物，只有消灭它才能彻底阻止地下魔物的暴: He was once a protector of Payon, but turned into a vicious monster after he died. Only by slaying him can we completely stop the berserk monsters. You could think of this as releasing him from his tortured existence.
前几天有巡逻士兵在洞口附近看到他的踪迹，我相信他一定就在那，你可要小心了。: A few days ago, some patrolling soldiers saw signs of him near the entrance of the dungeon. I'm sure he's there. Be careful.
我已经等了太久，邪魔控制了我的身体，他让我彻底沦为了一个杀戮的魔物，我真的好痛苦: I've waited so long... I can't stand this... My body is controlled by an evil spirit...
我不想成为斐扬的敌人，冒险者，请你帮助我……请消灭我……啊，他又在进入我的脑袋了: I don't want to become an enemy of Payon. Adventurer, please help me... Kill me and end this... Argh, it's entering my mind again... I can't control it... Ah!
终于解脱了……这种感觉……冒险者，很感谢你的帮忙，请你一定要守护好斐扬！: I'm finally free... This feeling... Thank you for your help, adventurer. Please... Protect Payon!
没想到他竟然变成了这样……我很感谢他曾经的守护，但斐扬不能一直活在过去的阴影里，: I never would have imagined he would become like that... I thank him for protecting us, but Payon can't keep living in the shadows. The people of Payon must overcome their fears!
冒险者，这次真是太感谢你了，你拯救了斐扬，也给斐扬指明了未来要走的路。: Thank you so much, adventurer. You have saved Payon, and pointed us in the direction we must take.
所有勇敢的人都值得称赞，这是斐扬人的信仰！: All courageous people are worthy of praise. That is the belief of Payon!
斐扬人热爱生活，平凡的生活中往往蕴藏着伟大的真理！: The people in Payon value life. An ordinary life often contains a great truth!
冒险者，你带来了足够的[c][ffff00]蓝色魔力矿石[-][/c]吗？: Have you brought enough [c][ffff00]Blue Gemstone[-][/c], adventurer?
很抱歉，你并没有足够的[c][ffff00]蓝色魔力矿石[-][/c]呢！: Sorry, but you don't have enough [c][ffff00]Blue Gemstone[-][/c]!
冒险者，你带来了足够的[c][ffff00]不死心脏[-][/c]吗？: Have you brought enough [c][ffff00]Immortal Hearts[-][/c], adventurer?
真是遗憾，你的身上并没有足够的[c][ffff00]不死心脏[-][/c]呢！: How unfortunate. You don't have enough [c][ffff00]Immortal Hearts[-][/c]!
冒险者，我很想把调查的任务交给你，但是现在看来，为了你的实力还是不太够。: Adventurer, I would love to send you out on this investigation, but you aren't quite strong enough.
为了你的安全，我建议你还是强大一些再来找我吧！: For your own safety, I'd suggest coming back when you're stronger.
不错不错，现在的你确实足够强大了。: Not bad, not bad. You really are strong enough now.
冒险者，兽人村的布朗队长正在找你呢！你快去和他会合吧！: Adventurer, Captain Brown at the Orc Village is looking for you. Go meet up with him!
冒险者，你成长得很快，你的实力足够帮到我了。: Adventurer, you have improved quickly. You are strong enough to help me.
冒险者吗，我们已经削弱了这只怪物，请立刻击败它: Adventurer! We have weakened this monster. Please kill it!
哥布灵森林的旅行吗？我想你一定不会喜欢: A trip through the Goblin Forest? I doubt you'll like it.
你是想要箭袋图纸吗？: Do you want a Quiver Blueprint?
那你可找对人了，箭袋图纸的灵感来源于哥布灵的制造工艺: Then you're in the right place! My inspiration for a Quiver Blueprint came from the Goblins' manufacturing techniques.
相应的我也会向你收取45枚青绿宝石来交换: And I'll be taking 45 Zircons from you in exchange.
如果你后悔了，随时可以来找我: You can come to me at any time if you change your mind.
好的！请收箭袋图纸，现在它归你了！: Alright! This Quiver Blueprint is all yours now!
看来你身上并没有45枚青绿宝石，那么交易终止！: It seems you don't have 45 Zircons. Trade canceled!
你也曾发现一些有趣的影像吗？和你一样，我也很期待重温那些美好的片段: You've discovered some interesting images before too? Like you, I love to relive those beautiful moments.
特制的学生帽也是非常的时尚: This custom-made Boy's Cap is really chic.
探索这片大陆是我此生最幸福的事情，而我也会将我的最高杰作蜡烛头饰，带到这个世界的: Exploring this area of Midgarts is the greatest joy in my life. And I will bring my masterpiece, the Candle headwear, To all corners of the world!
防风皮革眼睛可是沙漠中的明视灯！: Leather Goggles, because your eyes are all you can rely on in the desert!
说到衣物那可就是我的专长了，为了调查僵尸魔物身上的服装我都在2F呆了好几天了: My specialty is in clothes. I've spent days in on the second floor investigating the clothing Munaks wear.
可惜在我众多设计中最受大家欢迎的居然是一顶帽子: Unfortunately, the most popular design of mine is a hat.
由于和它配套的是一套简单的学生制服，所以大家都称他为学生帽: Since the outfit comes with a simple boy's school uniform, everyone calls it a Boy's Cap.
我知道你一定很想要它，如果你能为我带来60颗紫宝石的话，我倒是愿意用学生帽图纸来: I know you must want it. If you can bring me 60 amethysts, I would be willing to trade you for a Boy's Cap Blueprint.
什么！真是个没有眼光冒险者: WHAT?! You don't know what you're missing out on.
如果数量不够的话我可是不会答应交换的: I'm not going to trade with you if you don't have enough.
孩子，别担心，我只是在用我的方式休息而已: Don't worry, child. I am just resting in my own way.
我从遥远的东方来到这里冒险，没想到危险系数还是超过了我的想象: I have come on an adventurer here from the distant east. It is more dangerous here than I imagined.
我在这里发现了一种非常稀有的黄宝石，我将用蜡烛头饰图纸来与你交换: I've discovered a rare Topaz here. I will trade a Candle headwear Blueprint to you for some.
所以你愿意用30颗黄宝石来交换蜡烛头饰图纸吗？: So are you willing to trade 30 topazes for a Candle headwear Blueprint?
真是一桩好买卖啊！哈哈哈哈，请拿好你的蜡烛头饰图纸: What a great deal! Hahaha. Here's your Candle headwear Blueprint.
不~不~不！应该是30颗，你的数量还不够哦: No no NO! It should be 30! You don't have enough!
为了维持生计，我们需要更多的黄宝石来换取食物和水: To maintain our livelihood, we need more topazes to trade for food and water.
这里虽然是盛产黄宝石的地方，但却与危险同在: This place may produce a lot of topazes, but it is also very dangerous.
如果我说我愿意用防风皮革眼睛图纸来换取你60颗黄宝石，你愿意吗？: If I said I was willing to trade a Leather Goggles Blueprint for 60 topazes, would you agree?
沙蜂从不依靠任何人！: The Desert Hornets rely on no one!
真是大方的冒险者！请拿好图纸: You're so generous, adventurer! Please take your Blueprint.
就算是沙蜂也不能接受不平等的交易: I can't accept an unequal trade, even if you are a Desert Hornet.
从右边的传送点出去就可以找到休朗克，快去，他需要支援！: You can find Toukyou through the portal on the right. Hurry, he needs reinforcements!
该死的…为什么总是这样…: Damnit, why is it always like this...
啊，被看出来了吗…可能是因为昨晚没有休息好，不用担心，冒险者…: Oh, you can tell that? It's probably because I didn't sleep well last night. Don't worry, adventurer.
……好吧，老实说，从斐扬洞穴出来后，我已经好几月没有休息好了。: ...Okay, I'll tell you the truth. I haven't slept well in months, ever since I came back from Payon Cave.
那一夜对我来说是挥之不去的噩梦，在此之前，我从来没有想过我会这么狼狈…: That night is like a nightmare I can't get rid of. I never imagined I would be so flustered before that.
帮忙？说到这个，确实有需要你帮忙的事情。: Help? Well, now that you mention it, I could use your help.
正如你所见，我夜晚一直睡不好…我听说有一种特殊的药剂能够帮助睡眠，我希望你能帮我: As you can see, I haven't been able to sleep well... I've heard of a special potion that can help one sleep. I would like you to find it for me.
我建议你问一问医者诺雅，她是斐扬首屈一指的药剂师，她应该会有什么线索。: I suggest that you ask Doctor Noya for it. She is the best alchemist in Payon. She should have some clues.
嗯哼~我来猜猜看…你是又有事情想问我了是吗~~: Uh huh. Let me guess, You have something you want to ask me again?
好吧好吧。这次又想知道些什么呢？: Alright, alright. What would you like to know this time?
有助于安眠的药剂…配方的话，我这里就有。: A potion to help with sleep? I do have the recipe for that.
不过由于我和凯文·雷诺最近都很忙，很久没去采药了。: But Kevin Reno and I have both been too busy to pick ingredients lately.
配置药剂所需要的材料并不复杂。只是…可能你要花费一些时间去收集了。: The ingredients needed aren't too complicated, it's just... They might take some time to collect.
它们分别是：安神花、大脚熊血液和雪勒结晶。: They are: Calming Flower, Bigfoot Blood, and Scell.
在斐扬树林中生长着一种稀有的药材，名叫安神花。: There is a rare medicinal ingredient in Payon Forest known as Calming Flower.
这种药材喜爱阴凉，药性温和，是治疗失眠的好材料，一般生活在竹林中。: The medicine grows in the shade and can warm the body. It's a good ingredient to help with sleep. It is usually found in bamboo groves.
你去斐扬树林寻找看看吧。: You should search for it in Payon Forest.
为了配合安神花使用，我需要大脚熊的血液。: I also need some Bigfoot Blood to go with the Calming Flower.
虽然安神花药性温和，但是对待不同体质的病人还是要降低一些它的阴凉药性。: Calming Flower is warming, but for some people, it needs to be neutralized with a cooling medicine.
充满活力的大脚熊身上的血液正是可以中和安神花的绝佳药材。: The blood of vigorous Bigfoots is the best medicine to neutralize Calming Flower.
所以请你从大脚熊身上收集一些血液来吧。: So please collect some blood from Bigfoots.
干的不错，血液已经足够使用的，也许还用不到这么多呢。: Well done. That's enough Bigfoot Blood. I probably didn't need this much.
大家都知道雪勒结晶是魔物身上的东西。: Everyone knows that Scell is something that monsters drop.
不过在我看来这世间万物都有自己的用处。雪勒结晶对我来说就极其有用。: But in my opinion, all things have a special use. Scell is extremely useful for me.
它所蕴含的魔力能够强化中和后的药剂效果。: The magic it contains can enhance the effects of the neutralized potion.
所以冒险者，找80个雪勒结晶来吧。我记得那些徘徊在南部的长老树精身上就有。: So adventurer, find 80 Scells for me. Okay? I remember that Elder Willows to the south drop them.
你已经从那些徘徊在南部的长老树精身上收集到80个雪勒结晶了吗？: Have you collected 80 Scells from the wandering Elder Willows to the south?
收集齐了？我来看看数量对不对…: You've got them all? Let me count them...
够了够了，冒险者！没想到你取到这么多，看来我又可以在家研究一阵子了。: That's enough, adventurer! I never imagined you would get so many. With this, I can research for quite a while.
这点雪勒结晶可不太够，你还是从长老树精身上再收集一些过来吧。: These aren't enough Scells. Go collect some more from Elder Willows.
托你的福，材料在最短的时间收集齐了。: Thanks to you, the ingredients have been collected quickly.
在最短的时间内配置药剂，能够减少药性的流失，我想这大概是我配置的药性最好的一瓶安: Concocting the potion fast can reduce loss of its potency. I think this is the best Sleeping Potion I have ever concocted.
好了，把药剂拿去给你的病人吧。: It's ready. Take the potion to your patient.
看来你已经带着药剂回来了呢。把药剂给我试试吧。: It seems you've brought the potion back. Let me try it.
喝了之后，的确是有些困意了呢…: I do feel a bit sleepier after drinking it..
唉…这安神药剂并不是万能的啊…: But this Sleeping Potion isn't a cure-all...
我听说我们智家的人都在洞穴中变成了怪物，这其中就有我的三叔……而这几个月来我一直: I heard that the Wisdom family members have all become monsters in the dungeon, including my uncle. I've been having nightmares for months...
我梦到黑暗力量折磨着他，他痛苦地对着我嘶吼，他的灵魂受到了束缚，他无法解脱！: I've dreamt that a dark power was torturing him. He called out to me in pain, but his soul was bound with no way to be free!
他只能不人不鬼的沉沦在黑暗魔力之下，无日无夜，无生无灭。: He is trapped by that dark magic, neither man nor ghost, forever...
我想令我三叔的灵魂得到解脱，但是仅凭我的星辰之力，连靠近洞穴都做不到。: I want to free my uncle's soul, but with the little Star Power I have, I can't even get close to the dungeon.
冒险者，所以我想请你去一趟斐扬洞穴，祭拜我的三叔——也就是智家五长老的智仁长老。: Adventurer, that's why I'd like you to go to Payon Cave and visit my uncle. He is the fifth-eldest of the Wisdom family, Elder Ren Wisdom.
如果…我的三叔他真的变成了一个怪物，那么冒险者，请帮助我的三叔，让他的灵魂解脱，: If my uncle really has become a monster, then please help him, adventurer. Free his soul.
谢谢你冒险者，在无尽的黑暗中，我迎来了光明…告诉智善，要好好活着…: Thank you, adventurer. I welcome the light in this infinite darkness... Tell Loveholic to live a full life.
我的三叔…谢谢你冒险者，你帮了我大忙了…这是我的一点心意，请收下…: My uncle... Thank you, adventurer! You have helped me so much. This is a gift from me. Please take it...
看来你已经点好了呢。: It seems you have picked one.
普隆德拉一直在关注斐扬的情况，可不得不说，斐扬的形势可真是糟透了。: Prontera has always taken note of the situation in Payon. The situation in Payon really is terrible.
斐扬卫队的吉野今天向我报告称，斐扬洞穴的魔物似乎又有蠢蠢欲动的迹象了！: Yoshino of the Payon Guard reported to me today that the monsters in Payon Cave are showing signs of agitation!
如果让那些嗜血的魔物冲上地面，后果将无法想象。所以，冒险者，我需要你去证实报告的: If those bloodthirsty monsters are allowed to attack above ground, the consequences will be unimaginable. So, adventurer, I need you to verify the report!
那么你先去向吉野了解基本的情况，顺便向他传达我的指令。: First, go to Yoshino and learn about what's going on. Also give him orders from me.
既然是雷吉大人的命令，我一定会全力协助你进行事件的调查！: Since it's an order from Master Reggie, I will do everything I can to help with your investigation!
当时斐扬的村民夏菲正连夜从梦罗克回到斐扬，在路经地下洞穴附近时，她看到了非常恐怖: At the time, the Payon villager Shafie was having nightmares that Morroc had returned to Payon. Just as she was passing near the dungeon, she saw something terrifying!
是的，她看到一双黝黑干瘪的利爪从洞口里伸了出来，在利爪上还有鲜红的血液一滴滴往下: That's right! She saw a pair of black, withered claws reach out of the dungeon, with bright blood dripping from them. At the same time, a piercing scream and sounds of battle came from the dungeon. It scared her stiff!
所以她立刻跑来向我报告，她坚定地认为洞穴里的魔物已经突破了洞口的封印，并且已经伤: So she immediately ran back to report to me. She is sure that the monsters in the dungeon have broken through the seal, and have harmed an innocent villager.
她当时的情绪非常激动，我试图去安慰她，但她似乎听不进一切的劝导，无奈之下我只能向: She was very upset. I tried to calm her down, but she wouldn't listen to me. The only thing I could do was report this to Master Reggie!
现在这件事已经在城里引起了巨大的争议和恐慌，斐扬的居民需要了解事情的真相！: This has caused so much panic and chaos in the city. The people of Payon need to know the truth!
所以，冒险者，请你去找到夏菲并且弄清楚整件事情的始终。: So, adventurer, please find Shafie and figure out what happened.
他又回来了……对……没错的……肯定是他回来了！！: He's back again... Yes.... That's right... He's definitely back!
如果……如果不是他……魔物们又怎么会逃得出地下洞穴！！: If... If it wasn't him... How could the monsters get out of the dungeon?
你们不知道……你们不知道他的可怕……斐扬城怎么可能……怎么可能逃得出他的魔掌！！: You don't know... You don't know how terrifying he is! How can Payon escape his grasp?
看来她已经迷失了，与其向她询问，不如直接去地下洞穴里调查清楚，那里会有最直接的结: Panic has taken her over. It might be best to just go to the dungeon and investigate. That's the quickest way to get answers!
这里似乎有魔物打斗的痕迹……: There are signs of a fight between monsters...
所谓的魔物事件……原来只是魔物间的争斗，那么这样看来，所有的事情似乎也可以解释得: This monster incident... Was just a fight between monsters. Some type of massive battle. That could explain everything. I have to report this back to Reggie Jones.
真想不到事情的起因竟然是这样的，冒险者，感谢你的帮忙。: I never would have imagined that is what started everything. Thank you for your help, adventurer.
虽然事件已经平息，但仔细地想一想，如果不是日益严峻的魔物威胁，斐扬的民众们又怎么: The matter has been settled. But, if it wasn't for the increasing monster threat, why would the people of Payon be so easily spooked and panicked?
现在的我们的确还不具备有效对抗魔物的手段……这是最让我感到沮丧的！: Currently, we don't possess an effective way to fight off monsters... This is what depresses me the most!
但如果……如果我们有那个东西的话，说不定就可以遏制魔物的狂暴，甚至是消除魔物的威: But if... if we had that thing, maybe we could suppress the berserk rage of the monsters, or even eliminate the threat all together!
它像是一种法阵，又像是一道封印，谁也没见过它的真正形态，但唯一可以确定的是它对魔: It seems like an enchantment, as well as a seal. Nobody has ever seen its true form, but one thing for certain is that it has a powerful ability to suppress monsters!
这是最让人感到疑惑的！因为谁也没有见过，或者说，自从智家的人消失了之后就没有人见: This is the most confusing part! Nobody has seen it, or at least, not since the Wisdom family disappeared.
是的，那个名盛一时的家族，因为守护斐扬而没落的家族！冒险者，如果你可以找到智家的: That's right. That family that was well-known and fell protecting Payon! Adventurer, if you could find the descendants of the Wisdom family, perhaps we could find that mystical enchanted seal!
据说前斐扬卫队的队长霍克姆曾经与智家有着亲密的联系，可他现在却在极力掩藏着这种关: It's said that the previous Payon Guard, Captain Hawkham, once had close ties to the Wisdom family. He is actively trying to hide this relationship. Perhaps there is something we don't know.
年轻的冒险者，我有什么可以帮到你呢？: Young adventurer, what can I help you with?
请原谅我不能告诉你，相比于素未谋面的冒险者，我选择为逝去的故人保守秘密！: Forgive me, but I can't tell you. Unlike others, I'd rather protect the secrets of the dead!
我很理解你的心情，但我无法相信你的本意，如果你能证明自己的初心，那么我倒是可以考: I understand, but I can't trust you just yet. If you can prove your intentions, I might consider trusting you!
只有那些坚毅勇敢、嫉恶如仇的冒险者才能得到我的认可！所以，请去尽力消灭那些邪恶的: Only courageous adventurers who hate evil can earn my trust! So please eliminate those evil Greatest Generals. This is the only way to prove yourself.
还真是顽强的冒险者，你的表现相当精彩！我觉得我有必要重新审视你！: Adventurer, maybe I can trust you. You did this so fast!
那么关于智家，他们是我最真挚的朋友，在斐扬的时候，我们经常一起喝酒，一起狩猎，甚: Regarding the Wisdom family, they were my closest friends. When they were in Payon, we would often drink, hunt, and even fight vicious monsters together...
后来斐扬地下洞穴的魔物暴动，负责守护洞穴的整个智家都被卷入灾难之中，只有几个年轻: When the monsters in Payon Cave went berserk, the entire Wisdom family, which was tasked with protecting the dungeon, was swept up in the calamity. Only a few young people managed to survive...
身为智家的老朋友，我一直在尽力保护着这些年轻人，他们还太小了，很容易会受到邪恶力: As an old friend of the Wisdom family, I've tried to protect these young people as best I can as they are easily harmed by this evil power!
冒险者，请原谅我的谨慎，现在我就告诉你智家后人的位置！: Forgive me for being so cautious, adventurer. I'll tell you the location of the Wisdom family descendants now.
冒险者，你是特地来找我的吗？: Adventurer, so you're here to see me.
自从智家遭遇灾难，就有很多人在寻找我的下落，他们有的贪图智家的财富，有的觊觎智家: Ever since the Wisdom family vanished, many people have sought my whereabouts. Some are after the Wisdom family's wealth, and some wan the Wisdom family's magic. But, I know that you didn't come here for any of that.
我想你可能说的是星辰封印，那是我们智家研究出来的一种专门用于克制魔物的秘术！: I think you might be talking about the Star Seal. That is a secret magic that the Wisdom family developed just to suppress monsters!
自从上次在地下洞穴被众长老使用之后，这项秘术就失传了，即使是我也不知晓它的使用方: Ever since it was used by the elder last time in the dungeon, the spell was lost. Even I don't know how it is used.
或许在当今世上，还记得星辰封印的就只有在地下洞穴里的那些沦为行尸走肉的族中长老吧: Today, the only ones who remember the Star Seal may be those walking corpses in the Dungeon!
即使是深入危机重重的地下洞穴，也要找到失落的星辰封印！: Even if you venture into the dangerous dungeon, you still have to find the lost Star Seal!
这似乎是……一份残卷！太好了，即使是一份残缺的封印卷轴，对于阻止魔物暴动的作用也: A damaged page... It is only a part of the seal scroll, but should be able to stop monsters from rampaging.
冒险者，你成功了！快让我看看这神秘的星辰封印！: You did it, adventurer! Let me see this mysterious Star Seal!
虽然只是一份残卷，但我会把它交给吉芬的魔法公会，希望可以复原出完整的封印法阵！: It's only a page, but I will give it to the Geffen Mage Guild. I hope they can restore the full seal enchantment!
冒险者，你这次的表现真是太出色了，我会向冒险者公会申请，表彰你对斐扬做出的贡献。: Adventurer, you are outstanding. I will ask the Adventurer's Guild to commend you for your contributions to Payon.
这一出来不知道什么时候才能回去……: Who knows when I'll be able to go back...
这里似乎并没有什么线索……看来还需要继续寻找！: There aren't any clues here... I'll have to keep searching!
魔法可以创造一切，也可以毁灭一切！: Magic can create everything, and destroy everything!
守卫斐扬是我们的责任！: Our duty is to protect Payon!
看来你也不能解决我的疑惑呢！: It seems you can't solve my doubts either!
今天我在斐扬树林狩猎的时候，平常那些温顺的野兽竟然全都陷入了暴走一般，疯狂地攻击: Today when I was hunting in Payon Forest, the normally docile beasts suddenly all entered a berserk state, and attacked the surrounding hunters in a mad rage!
如果不是我跑得快的话，很有可能就被狂暴的兽群湮没了……现在想想都还心有余悸呢！: If I wasn't able to run so fast, I might have been trampled by the rampaging beasts... It makes my heart race just thinking about it!
恐怕现在没有人能回答你，当时的情形真的是太可怕了……: There isn't a clear answer. The scene was so terrifying.
这件事情已经在斐扬城引起了巨大的轰动，我听说统帅和老猎人迪文已经前往斐扬树林去调: This incident has caused a great commotion in Payon. I've heard that the Commander and the old Hunter Sasil Devine went into Payon Forest to investigate!
所以冒险者，请你也前往斐扬树林并尽力协助统帅查清事情的真相吧，斐扬的居民们需要合: So, adventurer, please head to Payon Forest and help discover the truth. The people of Payon deserve an explanation!
这真是令人震惊呢，现在的野兽不但比之前体型更大，而且更加凶恶狂暴，好像嗜血的魔物: This is astonishing. Not only are the beasts bigger than before, they are more vicious and violent. They are like bloodthirsty monsters, becoming hostile towards humans!
虽然现在已经控制了局势，但不得不承认，这些狂暴的魔物已经成为了斐扬的巨大威胁，为: The situation is under control now, but I must say, these berserk monsters have become a huge threat to Payon. For Payon's future, we must fix this.
所以冒险者，请你帮助我们消灭一些狂暴的野猪，它们已经快不受控制了！: So, adventurer, please help us destroy these berserk Savages. They are nearly out of control!
真是令人信赖的冒险者，很高兴有你的帮助呢！: You're very reliable, adventurer. I'm happy to have your help!
事情似乎有了一些转机……: The situation seems to have changed...
刚刚迪文向我报告称发现了一些重要的线索，她是经验丰富的老猎人，对野兽的行为也有相: Just now, Devine reported to me that she found some important clues. She's an experienced hunter, and she has a profound understanding of these beasts' behavior. Please help her in this investigation.
能够得到统帅的信任，看上去是很棒的冒险者呢！: You must be a great adventurer if you have been able gain the Commander's trust!
真是很直接的性格呢！那么关于线索，事实上野兽与人类在某些方面都有着共同的特征，它: You get straight to the point, don't you? Right, clues! You know, beasts and humans have some things in common. They have their own ways to communicate, their own habits, and they don't typically go berserk, unless...
除非它们因为受到某些外力的压迫，丧失了本身的意志，而做出不受控制的行为！比如说人: Unless they are forced by some external force. Like if someone is controlling them!
请你帮助我从狂暴的大脚熊身上取得一些魔物的内核吧，相信事情很快便能得到解释！: Can you help me get some cores from berserk Bigfoots? I'm sure an explanation will be found soon!
你的行动比我想象中要快呢，快把魔物的内核交给我，揭开谜底的感觉真令人兴奋！: You were faster than I thought. Give me the Monster's Core. Unraveling a mystery is so exciting!
没想到事情越发变得蹊跷了……: I never thought things would become even stranger...
那些魔物的内核中，似乎都蕴藏着一种邪恶的阴暗物质，这种物质我在斐扬地下魔物的体内: The cores of those monsters seem to contain an evil, dark material. This sort of material was also found in the monsters in Payon Cave.
仔细地想一想，似乎从一开始我们就被有目的的吸引到这里来，如果这是精心设计的圈套的: Reflecting back on this, it seems like we have been purposefully drawn here from the beginning. Maybe it's a trap, but I can't tell why we're here...
不好了，情况危急……有人打晕守卫，破坏了地下洞穴的封印……现在洞穴里的魔物已经快: Emergency! Someone knocked out the guard and destroyed the dungeon seal... The monsters in the dungeon are almost to the surface!
把我们的注意力吸引到斐扬树林来，他们的真正目的竟然是……地下洞穴！难道那些人又再: They drew our attention to Payon Forest, but their real goal was Payon Cave! Could those people have returned?
女神之手！他们是邪恶的极端分子，他们存在的意义只是为了制造无故的事端，妄图以此破: The Hands of the Goddess! They are purely evil. The exist purely to create disturbances for no good reason, to try to disrupt humanity's peace and unity. They are an even greater threat to humanity than the monsters!
冒险者，我不得不拜托你，在斐杨树林的魔物平息之前，请你火速回到斐扬城，向雷吉·琼: Adventurer, I have to ask you to quickly return to Payon before the monsters in Payon Forest are put down. Report my orders back to Reggie Jones. Tell him that he has to control the situation in the dungeon!
冒险者，还好你及时赶到，现在的情形真的是太糟了！: Adventurer, I'm glad you made it here so quickly! The situation is terrible!
大量的卫兵被派去阻止魔物向地面扩散，所有的魔法师被邀请去修复洞穴的封印法阵，但似: Most of the guard has been sent to stop the monsters from reaching the surface. All of the Mages have been asked to repair the seal enchantment on the dungeon, but everything seems to be having little effect.
甚至有居民在地下洞口的附近地面发现了魔物的踪迹，斐扬卫队的吉野正在处理这件事。冒: Some residents even found monster tracks near the entrance to the dungeon. Yoshino, of the Payon Guard, is handling this. Adventurer, please help Yoshino investigate the truth, and stop anything bad from happening!
这些狡猾的魔物，竟然从我们的搜寻中逃了出去，这次真是多亏了你，冒险者！: These cunning monsters, they escaped! Thankfully you're here, adventurer!
现在洞口的形势已经被我们成功地控制起来，没有更多的魔物可以从洞口冲上地面，但地下: We've successfully contained the dungeon. No more monsters will be able to reach the surface, but the situation in the dungeon isn't looking good!
冒险者，斐扬的魔法师已经竭尽全力去修复洞穴的封印法阵，但他们现在似乎陷入了一个困: Adventurer, the Mages of Payon have exhausted their strength repairing the seal. They seem to have gotten in trouble. Please help them!
可恶！现在就只差一步，我们就可以完成整个封印法阵的修复！: Damnit! Just one more thing and we can fully restore the seal enchantment!
女神之手并不懂封印法阵的运作原理，他们只是单纯地破坏了法阵的阵眼，让法阵因为失去: The Hands of the Goddess don't understand the principles behind seal enchantments. They just destroyed the focus, so the enchantment can't operate due to losing its power source!
所以我们修复法阵的关键，就是找到一种可以充当阵眼的能量源！: The key to repairing the enchantment is to find an energy source that can be the focus!
我需要一些坚硬外皮，它蕴藏着极大的纯净能量，是作为阵眼的最佳选择。但它却很珍贵，: I need some Hard Skins. They contain large amounts of pure energy, and are the best choice to be a focus. But they are rare, and only drop from some fierce, tough monsters.
你可真有办法，我已经很久没有见过这么多高品质的坚硬外皮了！: You've got some tricks up your sleeve. It's been a long time since I've seen so many high-quality Hard Skins!
有了这些宝贵的坚硬外皮， 现在我们便开始修复封印法阵！: With these precious Hard Skins, we can begin to repair the seal barrier.
哈哈哈，果然成功了！这次雷吉·琼斯这个家伙可不会再来叨扰我了。: Haha, we did it! This time, Reggie Jones isn't going to bother me anymore.
我们也是时候离开了，我可不想再待在这个阴森的地方呢！: It's time for us to leave. I don't want to stay in this dark place!
听到你的消息真令人兴奋，但地下魔物的危机还没有完全解除！: I'm excited to hear your news, but the crisis isn't over yet!
女神之手唤醒了强大的不死魔物，它的力量足以毁灭一切，只有消灭它才能彻底扼杀女神之: The Hands of the Goddess have awakened a powerful undead monster. It is powerful enough to destroy everything. Only by destroying it can we completely foil the Hands of the Goddess' plot, and keep Payon safe! Adventurer, can you help us?
我很高兴你能有这样的决心，但现在我们还不能确定它的具体位置，请去地下洞穴的妖道身: I'm glad you're so confident, but we can't confirm its location. Please get some information about it from the Bonguns in the Dungeon.
冒险者，你成功遏制了女神之手的阴谋，保护了斐扬的居民，我为你而自豪！: Adventurer, you've successfully stopped the Hands of the Goddess' plot, and protected the people of Payon. I'm proud of you!
好了，我们的任务已经完成，等回城之后，我一定会向统帅表彰你的出色表现！: Alright, our mission is complete. When we get back to the city, I'm going to report your excellent performance to the Commander!
冒险者你带来了足够的[c][ffff00]坚硬外皮[-][/c]吗？: Have you brought enough [c][ffff00]Hard Skins[-][/c], adventurer?
很遗憾，你的身上并没有足够的[c][ffff00]坚硬外皮[-][/c]呢！: That's too bad, you don't have enough [c][ffff00]Hard Skins[-][/c]!
冒险者，请帮助我们把坚硬外皮放到阵眼的中心位置,这样就可以激活整个法阵了！: Adventurer, please help us put the Hard Skins in the center of the focus. This will activate the enchantment!
这些魔物的线索似乎都在指引着同一个地点！: The clues from these monsters all seem to be pointing to the same place!
啊，亲爱的冒险者，见到你真高兴！: Oh, my lovely adventurer! I'm so happy to see you!
现在的冒险者可真没礼貌呢，哼！: Adventurers nowadays are so rude! Hmph!
我是国家地质杂志斐扬特派专员，专门负责斐扬地区地理人情的收集和记录，以便提供给有: I'm a special journalist sent by Midgarts Geographic to collect and record the geography and culture of the Payon region, so the information can be passed on to adventurers who need it!
最近，我们正针对斐扬的地下洞穴展开一场全面的采访和调查，我们希望能通过独家的报道: Recently, we launched a full-scale survey and investigation into the Payon Cave. We hope that our exclusive report and recording can reveal this mysterious place to the people of Midgar!
这是一件需要极大精力和细致调查的事情，我本来信心满满，但当我来到这儿我却发现这是: This is a meticulous investigation that requires a great deal of energy. I started full of confidence, but when I got here, I discovered that there is no way to complete this task.
斐扬的人们似乎并不欢迎外来者，在与他们的交谈中，我总能发现一些戒备的意味。: The people of Payon don't seem to welcome outsiders. I notice they are always guarded in our talks.
如果不能取得当地人的信任，便无法获得有价值的真实材料，那么这样的采访将是毫无意义: If I can't earn the local people's trust, I can't get valuable information. So survey would be meaningless.
所以，冒险者我不得不拜托你，以你在斐扬的声望和影响力，请你代替我去取得一些有关地: Adventurer, I have to ask you for help. With your prestige and influence in Payon, please help me get some information regarding Payon Cave!
真是令人遗憾，不过我知道你还会回来的。: That's too bad. But I know you'll be back.
很高兴你能接受我的请求，说起来这也是件非常容易的事情呢！: Thank you! I know this will be easy for you.
我已经和斐扬的几个采访者预约了时间，请你去找他们吧！希望你能获得不错的资料哦！: I've already set a time to interview some people in Payon. Can you go see them? I hope you can get some good info!
我打算制作一些新服饰，但我现在缺少一些轻盈的绒毛，我听说城外的大脚熊身上就有这种: I want to make some new clothes, but I'm short on Light Fur. I've heard that the Bigfoots outside the city have this. Could you get some for me?
这么快就收集好了，你可真是令人信赖呢！: You gathered that so quickly! Impressive!
那么冒险者，你为什么会来到这里？: So, adventurer. Why are you here?
这片古老的土地的确有着别样的历史呢！斐扬的居民世世代代生活在此，他们亲密友善，相: This ancient land really does have a unique history. The people of Payon have lived here for generations. They were close and friendly with everyone.
直到有一天，神秘的地下洞穴被发现，斐扬的年轻人对那里充满了向往！但他们不知道，地: Until one day. A mysterious dungeon was discovered, and the young people of Payon felt the desire to explore it! But they didn't know that the dungeon was a dark purgatory that would only bring them death!
冒险者，说到这里我不得不提醒你，即使在现在，地下洞穴依然是十分危险的地方，你可千: Adventurer, I have to remind you that even now, the dungeon is still extremely dangerous. Make sure you stay safe!
冒险者，你是专门来找我的吗？: Adventurer, did you come here to see me?
与人为善、相爱相助是我一贯的信仰和理念，那么我可以怎样帮助你呢？: Treating people with kindness and helping others with love is my philosophy. So how can I help you?
那真是个可怕的敌方……我从来没有见过那样惨烈的魔物袭击事件，洞穴里的魔物突然袭击: Oh, a terrible place... I've never seen such brutal monster attacks. The monsters of the dungeon suddenly attacked Payon. That night was terrifying!
丑陋的魔物占据了斐扬的街道，无数的居民倒在血泊里，我曾一度以为斐扬将要毁灭在魔物: Those ugly monsters occupied the streets of Payon, and countless people fell, bloodied. I thought that Payon would be destroyed.
所幸的是最终的一幕并没有出现，因为在智家长老和统帅府的守护下，魔物终于被打退了。: Luckily, that didn't happen. The Wisdom family elder and the Commander protected the city and fended off the monsters.
尽管现在地下洞穴的魔物已经处于控制之中，但形势仍然不太乐观，我们要时刻提防魔物的: Even though the monsters in the dungeon are under control, not all is great. We have to maintain our guard against the threat of the monsters.
所以，冒险者请你消灭一些地下洞穴的僵尸，我们需要你的力量。: So adventurer, I'd like you to destroy some of the Munaks in the dungeon. We will need your strength.
非常感谢你，勇敢的冒险者！: Thank you so much, brave adventurer!
咦，年轻的冒险者，你也来借酒消愁吗？: Hey, young adventurer. Here to drown your sorrows too?
原来是这样，不过想要和斐扬人打成一片，不会喝酒可不行哦！: Oh, I see. But if you want to be like a native of Payon, you must be able to hold your liquor!
真是不错的酒量呢！年轻人，你已经表明了你的诚意，接下来我会告诉你想知道的。: You really can hold your liquor! You have shown me your sincerity, so I'll tell you what you want to know.
说起来这是一件尘封的往事呢，那时候的智家在六大长老的带领下已经是闻名一时的斐扬望: It's something that happened long ago. Back then the Wisdom family, led by its six elders, were renowned throughout all of Payon. Though, they always remained humble.
我时常可以看到智家长老和斐扬的普通士兵一起来我这里喝酒，他们有说有笑，就像兄弟一: Sometimes, I saw the Wisdom family elder here drinking with Payon soldiers. They laughed and joked, as close as brothers.
那时候已经是地下洞穴魔物暴乱的关键时刻，斐扬城的居民把所有希望都寄托在统帅府和智: At the time, it was a critical moment after the Payon Cave monsters had gone berserk. The people of Payon placed all of their hopes in the Commander and the Wisdom family.
但事情的发展似乎并不顺利，地下洞穴的黑暗力量一天天变得强大，就在事态无法挽回之际: But things went south. The dark powers from the dungeon grew stronger with each passing day. Things seemed hopeless. Then, the Wisdom family imploded the entire dungeon, sacrificing themselves to seal the monsters inside.
那已经是很久远的事情了……可眼下地下洞穴的魔物竟又有些蠢蠢欲动的迹象了，冒险者，: All that happened so long ago... But now, the monsters in the dungeon are showing signs of stirring again. Adventurer, please protect the people of Payon.
很感谢你的帮忙，出色的冒险者！你是斐扬的骄傲。: Thank you for your help, extraordinary adventurer! You are the pride of Payon!
这真是相当充实的资料呢，没想到现在的斐扬城竟然有这样久远的历史呢。非常感谢你，冒: So many materials. I never imagined that Payon would have such a long history. Thank you, adventurer!
如果你能给我拍摄一些地下洞穴的照片，那么我想这次的调查就可以完美结束啦！: If you could take some pictures of the dungeon, then I think my survey would be finished!
这里似乎有些不对劲……: There seems to be something wrong here...
真是相当劲爆的新闻呢，没想到斐扬曾经的守护者竟然沦为了邪恶的魔物！: What explosive news. I never would have imagined that the former defenders of Payon would become evil monsters!
感谢你的帮忙，冒险者！回去之后，我会在《国家地质杂志》上刊登这些精彩的内容，等我: Thank you for your help, adventurer! After I get back, I'll publish this amazing content in Midgarts Geographic. Wait to hear my good news!

哇！！老师万岁！！老师你真是太厉害了: Wow! Long live my mentor! You're amazing!

果然还是老师懂我！！我刚才也觉得这蛋壳帽一点都不符合我的审美标准，那么我就要开口: My mentor knows me best! I felt like that Eggshell wasn't my style at all! Then I'll tell you what I want!
我们家族流传着一张古老的图纸，能制成传说中的帽子，不过这些材料我都没听过！: Our family has passed down an ancient Blueprint that can be used to make a legendary hat. But I've never even heard of the materials needed!
老师？你怎么了？我可是老师您的徒弟，总得特别一点你说是不是？: What's wrong, Mentor? I'm your apprentice, so I have to be unique, right?
老师你那么厉害，一定会帮我弄来的……: You're the best, Mentor! I'm sure you can help me.
没有勇士之帽我浑身无力，感觉好绝望！这考试怕是进行不下去了: Without a Musketeer Hat, My body feels limp! I feel so hopeless! I won't be able to pass the test like this!
我现在觉得我充满了力量！！我可以安心去考试了: I'm filled with power now! I can go take that test!
你是来看你的小学徒加达尔考试进行的如何的吗？看来你还真是关心他呀。: Are you here to see how your apprentice Gadar is doing with his test? It seems you really do care about him.
他刚才自信满满的回来了，还戴着顶帅气的勇士之帽，那是不是你干的？: He came back, Filled with courage, and wearing a Musketeer Hat. Was that from you?
你这个机灵鬼，我就不揭穿你了。总之我已经告诉了他考试的内容，他现在应该在调皮的波: You're smart. I won't tell on you. I've already told him what the Trial is. He should be taking his first test with the naughty Poi. You can go check on him there.
老师？你怎么来了？是因为不放心我吗？: Mentor, what are you doing here? Is it because you're worried about me?
哈哈那大可不必，正好！我刚在波伊那儿领取了枯树枝，就让您瞧瞧我的厉害吧！: Haha there's no need for that! You're just in time! I just got a Dead Branch from Poi! Let me show you my skills!
哎！？老师我怎么没见过这种怪！？: Huh?! Mentor, I've never seen a monster like this!
什么！？刚才枯树枝召出来的是这么强的怪物吗！真是千钧一发！: What?! That monster the Dead Branch summoned was so powerful! That was a close one!
好不甘心啊，又让老师救了我一命！我一定要好好磨练自己。: No, this won't do! My mentor saved me again! I have to keep training!
原来枯树枝是这么危险的东西，那这项考试岂不是很危险。是不是该向宝雅姐姐反映一下情: I didn't know Dead Branches were so dangerous. This is a really dangerous test! Shouldn't we tell Poya about this?
什么！？考试用的枯树枝竟然招出了小恶魔？: What?! The Dead Branch used in the test summoned a Deviruchi?
的确，波依这项考试比较容易出现意外情况，谢谢你的反馈。: You're right. Accidents happen far too easily in this test with Poi. Thanks for your feedback.
在你等待加达尔完成我这里的考试期间，你可以帮他预约转职考试的场地。: While you wait for Gadar to finish my tests, You can make a reservation for his job change venue.
对，导师的职责不仅仅是教自己的学徒，还包括转职考试的预约，这样才能保证有专门的场: That's right. A mentor's responsibilities aren't just to teach their students. It also includes reserving the job change test. That way you can make sure there is a special venue for it, and someone to make sure nothing goes wrong with the test.
预约需要在希盖伊兹那里进行，快去找他吧。: You'll need to go to Higgy Eez for the reservation. You should hurry.
你来的正好: Oh, just the person I wanted to see!
对，你之前走得急，我都忘了告诉你，导师还有一项重要的职责就是帮自己的学徒完成转职: Yes, you left so quickly I forgot to tell you. An important responsibility all mentors have is to reserve the time for their apprentices' job change. Are you here to reserve a test time for your apprentice?
很好，现在，请你告诉我，需要预约考试的学徒姓名。: Good. So, tell me the name of the student to be tested.
好，现在你已经成功帮你的学徒预约了考试，你可以去把这个消息告诉宝雅和你的学徒了。: Alright, You have reserved a test time for your apprentice. You can tell Poya and your apprentice.
这么快就预约好了啊，行动力一如既往的强。: That was quick. You are as efficient as ever, adventurer.
加达尔表现的很好，这孩子很有天赋，很快就通过了二试和三试。: Gadar performed well. He's got a real gift. He passed the second and third tests very quickly.
是啊，不愧是你的徒弟。他成长的很快。所以他现在已经拿着介绍信前往转职大厅了。不过: Yes, He is your apprentice after all. He has grown up fast. So he has already gone to the Adventure Hall with his letter. But since you've already reserved a time for his test, There's nothing to worry about now.
看来你真的挺喜欢这孩子，这么不放心的话，不如在考试前送些装备给他。他这会儿应该已: You must really like this kid. If you are still worried, maybe you should go give him some equipment before his test. He should be at the Adventure Hall by now. Go see him!
到处都没有看到加达尔，他好像不在这里: I don't see Gadar. He doesn't seem to be here!
你是来找你的学徒加达尔的吗？: Are you looking for your apprentice, Gadar?
你来晚了一步，考核已经结束了。: You've just missed him. The test is over.
不过我能看的出来，这孩子还是很有潜力的，他这次可能是没发挥好。现在估计躲在哪个角: But I can tell that the kid has potential. He might not have done his best. He's probably hiding in some corner, depressed.
他应该还没有走远，鼓励他再来挑战吧！: I don't think he will have gone far. Encourage him to try again!
！！看到一个很像加达尔的人往教堂方向去了: !! I saw a person who looked like Gadar heading towards the church.
戴着勇士之帽的初心者？没看到哎。: A Novice with a Musketeer Hat? Haven't seen him.
不过你说他可能躲在角落伤心，那也就只有教堂后面的墓地了，因为那儿常年没什么人。: But if he's found a corner to cry, he's probably in the graveyard behind the church. There's never anyone there.
又是这只蠢狸猫在到处吓唬人: This dumb Smokie again, always trying to scare people.
我不会让你靠近我的老师！: I won't let you near my mentor!
老师你放心！你救了我两次，我这次牺牲自己也要保护你！: Don't worry, Mentor! You've saved me twice, I'm going to sacrifice myself to protect you this time!
什么！？这其实是一只狸猫？！: What?! This is just a Smokie?!
原来是这样，可恶的狸猫，快现形，不然我就把你打趴下。: I understand. Darn Smokie! Reveal yourself, otherwise I'll beat you up!
一阵烟雾散去，一只熟悉的小身影出现了。: A cloud of smoke dissipates, revealing a familiar figure.
看它的体型，正是一只小狸猫！: Look at it! It's a tiny Smokie!
老师，对不起，我有个坏消息要告诉你…我考试失败了。: I'm sorry, Mentor. I have some bad news for you... I failed the test.
我知道，我让你失望了，但是我并没有打算放弃，我打算去买把合手的武器，再次去挑战！: I know I let you down, but I'm not going to give up. I'm going to buy a better weapon and try it again!
什么！？您已经帮我找到了！？: What?! You've already found one for me?
老师你实在是太懂我了，我这次一定不会辜负你的期望！！: You know me so well, Mentor! I won't let you down this time!
你来的正好，是为了你的学徒加达尔吗？: You're here just in time. Is it about your apprentice, Gadar?
你的学徒加达尔已经正式通过考试，成为了一名弓箭手。: Your apprentice has officially passed the test and become an Archer.
作为他的导师，你得一起见证这光荣的一刻。: As his mentor, you have to witness his moment of glory.
实际上，这次请你过来是有点事情想请你帮忙。: I've asked you here because I have something I need your help with.
你知道克特之森么？就是冒险者们时常提起的犬妖森林。: Do you know the Kordt Forest? It's what the adventurers often call the "Kobold Forest".
前几天，一队外出执行任务的圣光教会中的牧师们从犬妖森林回来。他们死伤惨重，几乎是: A few days ago, a group of Priests sent on a mission by the church came back from the Kobold Forest. They had suffered heavy casualties, and seemed to have exhausted all their power just to make it back to Prontera.
你可别小看这些牧师，他们隶属于圣歌教会裁判所，学习的是破坏力超强的神圣魔法。: Don't underestimate those Priests. They are part of the Church Tribunal, and have extremely powerful and divine magic.
就是这样一支小队，在犬妖森林伤亡惨重，汤玛斯大主教很重视这件事情。: For this sort of group to suffer heavy casualties in the Kobold Forest was something Archbishop Thomasville didn't take lightly.
汤玛斯大主教认为，犬妖森林里应该存在一些“不祥”的东西。: Archbishop Thomasville believes that something unknown exists in the Kobold Forest.
总之，请你先去大主教那里吧。他会给你详细的信息。: Anyways, please visit him first. He will explain the details.
的确，我在回来的神职者们身上发现了一些不寻常的线索。: It's true. I've seen some interesting clues on the bodies of the Priests who made it back.
作为神职者，坚定的信仰是我们选拔神职者的重要指标，回来的那些神职者们更是神职者中: As holy workers, unwaivering faith is important for us to select more holy workers. The holy workers that came back were some of the best we've seen.
但是在他们身上，我却看到了信仰崩塌的迹象。: But, I've sensed their faith is crumbling.
是的，这是一种非常恶毒的诅咒，它能使人信仰崩塌，令人们产生一种对美好的事物极度厌: That's right, this is a vile curse. It can make one's faith crumble, and make one extremely cynical, destroying all positive feelings.
连信仰坚定的信徒们都如此，真不敢想象生活在那里的人们现在怎么样！: Even those with the most steadfast faith felt this way. I can't imagine what the people living there must be like!
想要调查这件事情，我建议你应该去一趟吉芬，找到雷藏，犬妖森林的一切应该瞒不过他。: If you want to investigate, I suggest you take a trip to Geffen and find Reyen. I'm sure he is aware of everything going on in Kobold Forest.
你好冒险者，我们有很长时间没见面了吧。欢迎再次来到吉芬。你这次来是想了解克特森林: Hello, adventurer. It's been a long time since we've seen each other. Welcome back to Geffen. Are you here to ask about the Kordt Forest?
我当然知道，在吉芬有什么事情能瞒过我？在我看到那一队离开的牧师，我就知道犬妖森林: Of course I know! I know everything that goes on in Geffen. When I saw the group of Priests leaving, I knew there was a problem with Kobold Forest.
他们的身上带着腐朽的恶臭，那是诅咒的气息。: They had a foul scent, the scent of a curse.
很好奇我为什么不救他们是吗？对付这种诅咒，汤玛斯比我更加适合。而我现在应该做的，: Why I didn't save them? Thomasville is better than me when dealing with that sort of curse. What I should be doing now is seeing what's going on in Kobold Forest.
几天前，我们曾经收到一封魔法信件，根据信件上所说，犬妖森林混入了一些“不该存在”: Several days ago, I received a magic letter. According to the letter, something that "shouldn't exist" has made its way into Kobold Forest.
这封魔法信件在接收到了一半就中断了。所以我紧急派遣了两名成员前往犬妖森林。想要调: I only received half of the letter, as it was cut off. So I quickly sent two mages into the Kobold Forest. If you want to know more, you should find them.
去找他们吧。他们是你的老相识，庞德和凯特莉娜。找到后记得告诉他们，不要轻举妄动，: Go search for them. They are old acquaintances of yours, Laurell Weinder and Katerina. Once you find them, remember to tell them not to get carried away, and to report to me if anything is strange.
刚刚我收到了雷藏大人的魔法信件，知道你要来，早早地就来到这里等你。: I just received a magic letter from Master Reyen. I knew you were coming, so I came here to wait for you.
犬妖森林的情况现在是一团糟，为了尽快弄清楚事实真相，冒险者，我们需要你的力量。: The situation in the Kobold Forest is chaotic. We need your strength, adventurer, to get to the truth as soon as possible.
比起以前，现在的你显得更加成熟而自信了呢。: Unlike earlier, you're mature and confident now.
犬妖森林确实和以往的犬妖森林不一样了。这里充满了危险，你不知道犬妖和那些狂暴野猫: The Kobold Forest really has changed. It's full of danger now. You don't know when Kobolds and Wild Roses will charge and attack you.
我的实力自然不需要有任何顾虑，但是庞德毕竟修习魔法的时间还短，而我使用魔法动静会: With my power, I naturally don't need to worry about anything, but Laurell Weinder hasn't been practicing magic long. The magic I use is noisy, and alert more Kobolds.
所以冒险者，我需要你清理一下周围的犬妖。: So, adventurer, I need you to clear out some of the Kobolds around here.
还不赖嘛，这次雷藏大人倒是给我找了个不错的帮手呢。: Not bad at all. Master Reyen found a good little helper for me.
怎么样？是不是对犬妖们的疯狂还心有余悸？: How are you? Still shaking in your boots from those berserk Kobolds?
正如你所看到的这样，犬妖森林已经失去了以往的宁静，有什么东西正在侵蚀这片土地。: Like you saw, the Kobold Forest has lost its past serenity. Something is corrupting the land.
我虽然不是圣属性的神职者，但是我也能感受到空气中传来的诅咒的恶臭。: I can smell the foul odor of a curse in the air.
为了搞清楚诅咒的来源，我需要一些泥土样本。你能帮我采集一些来吗？: In order to figure out the source of the curse, I need some mud samples. Can you get some for me?
这么快就回来了。干的不错冒险者。: That was fast. Well done, adventurer.
我想我快要揭开诅咒的真面目了。: I think I will be revealing the truth of the curse soon.
在触碰到泥土的一瞬间，我的魔力甚至有一瞬间的失控。: The moment I touched the mud, I lost control of my magic for a moment.
等等…我需要时间来研究这股诡异的力量…你在身旁稍等片刻…: Hold on... I need time to study this strange power... wait here for a moment...
这股力量…古怪黑暗的魔力…奇怪…: This power... Peculiar dark magic... Strange...
不好，我释放出了泥土的气息，竟然招来了魔物！: Oh no! I unleashed the power in the mud, and summoned a monster!
我的魔力正处于魔力洪流中，不能撤出。冒险者，保护我！: My magic is caught in the magical current, and can't be used. Protect me, adventurer!
好险！谢谢你冒险者，刚才要不是你，恐怕我就会沦陷在魔力洪流之中了。: That was close. Thank you, adventurer! If it wasn't for you, I fear I would have been lost to that magical current.
这种诅咒之力，我从未给见过，刚刚我解析魔力的构成，发现这是一种新型的元素排布方式: I've never seen a curse as powerful as this one. I analyzed the structure of the magic, and discovered a new elemental layout.
这种元素排布方式很可能不是我们世界的。: This elemental layout is very possibly not of this world.
是的，众神之战后唯一一次异世界入侵也只有梦罗克魔王了。: Yes, the only time after the War of the Gods that another world invaded was with the Demon King Morroc.
这种诅咒拥有极强的侵蚀能力，瞬间夺取心智，使其变得无比狂暴。这与魔王非常相似。: This curse has a powerful and corrosive ability that can quickly usurp one's thoughts and turn them berserk. This is very similar to the Demon King.
如果是这样的话恐怕事情就不是我们能够处理的了。: If this is the case, I'm afraid this isn't something we can handle.
把研究的结果告诉庞德吧。: Tell the results of this research to Laurell Weinder.
凯特莉娜真是棒，研究结果我已经知道了。谢谢你冒险者。: Katerina is amazing! I understand fully. Thank you, adventurer.
你愿意帮忙真是太好了！你知道，我被派遣到这里已经有好几天了。: It's great that you're willing to help. I've been here for several days already.
在周围狂暴的犬妖的进攻下，我们在这里寸步难行。我学习魔法的时间不长，凯特莉娜还要: We've had a hard time advancing due to the attacks of berserk Kobolds. I haven't been studying magic for very long, and Katerina has had to focus on protecting me, so our progress is quite slow.
如果我们想顺利的调查下去，我们只能先解决掉一些周围的狂暴野猫了。: If we want to finish the investigation, we need to first eliminate some of the Wild Roses around here.
干得很好冒险者，这样我们能够更加深入的进行调查了。: Great job, adventurer. Now we can dig deeper into the investigation.
其实，在刚刚进入这片森林的时候就有神秘的人物找上了我们。一封书信直接通过弓箭送进: Actually, a mysterious figure found us when we first entered the forest. A letter was shot into our camp on an arrow.
信中的希望能够与我们吉芬联手阻止犬妖森林的那些狂暴的犬妖。: The person in the letter hoped to work with Geffen to stop the berserk Kobolds in Kobold Forest.
凯特莉娜并不信任这个神秘人物，所以，我们并没有按时赴约。: Katerina didn't trust this mysterious figure, so we didn't meet with them.
但是，我总觉得我们应该去见一见那位神秘人，凭借我们的实力，我们想离开，犬妖森林应: But I feel like we should meet with them. With our strength, nobody in Kobold Forest would be a threat to us.
但是现在的情况，我和凯特莉娜根本不能轻易的离开这个地方。所以冒险者，你能帮我去信: For now though, Katerina and I can't leave easily. So, adventurer, can you go check it out for us?
我们敬你是先知们的后人才忍你到今天，没想到你竟敢联系外人对付首领！你难道忘了吉芬: We've only let you stay this long because you are a descendant of the Seers. We never thought you'd contact an outsider to deal with the leader! Have you forgotten how Geffen treated us before?
快跟我们回去见首领，你最好祈祷首领能原谅你的罪过！: Come and see the leader with us. You should pray that the leader can forgive you!
我所做的一切，都是为了整个犬妖族群！总有一天你们会明白，首领的想法是错误的！: Everything I've done has been for the good of Kobold kind! One day, you will understand. The leader is wrong!
嘿，我不想听你辩解！跟我走！: I don't want to hear it! Come with me!
谢谢你冒险者，要不是你…恐怕…: Thank you, adventurer. If it wasn't for you, I'm sure...
首先我得自我介绍一下…我是提尔·剑齿，是第七任犬妖先知的直系后人。: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Tyre Sabertooth, and I'm the direct descendant of the seventh Kobold Seer.
给那些吉芬魔法师送信的就是我。在犬妖们的追捕下我已经三天没有进食了。: I was the one that sent letters to the Geffen Mages. I haven't eaten for three days, since I've been chased by the Kobolds.
不介意的话，冒险者，帮我找点吃的来吧。: If you don't mind, adventurer, could you find me some food?
总算稍微恢复了…谢谢你冒险者。: That feels a bit better... Thank you, adventurer.
我们犬妖森林很久以前就遭到梦罗克魔王的诅咒袭击，在我们伟大的先知的坚持下才勉强支: Our Kobold Forest was attacked by the curse of the Demon King Morroc long ago. With our great Seers' persistence, we managed to survive.
现在我们族群中已经没有了先知了，我们没有能力对抗诅咒了。: We don't have any Seers anymore, so we don't have any way to deal with the curse.
后来，我们曾经希望受到吉芬的庇护，但是却被拒绝了。: We hoped to be protected by Geffen, but they refused.
后来一个叫做女神之手的组织愿意帮助我们。但是作为代价，他们拿走了我们犬妖一族的神: Then, a group called the Hands of the Goddess were willing to help us. But in return, they took Yasukaha, the sacred stone of the Kobolds.
是的。一颗“亚苏卡哈”能够保证我们族群生存下去，我们还是愿意接受的。: Yes. Yasukaha could protect our people's survival. We were still willing to accept that deal.
没想到，女神之手欺骗了我们！几年后，诅咒卷土重来，我们没有了神石，日子更加难过了: But the Hands of the Goddess tricked us! Several years later, the curse came back, and without the stone, our lives were even worse.
首领他决定要使用我们犬妖一族禁用的巫术，复活我们曾经所有的先知！: The leader decided to use forbidden sorcery to bring all of our former Seers back from the dead!
这是非常危险的行动，身为先知后人的我们知道陵寝早已污浊不堪。: This was extremely dangerous. As descendants of the Seers, we knew that the tombs had been corrupted long ago.
所以我才联系吉芬的魔法师，希望他们能够帮助我阻止首领的计划。: That's why I contacted the Geffen Mages, in hopes that they could help me stop our leader's plan.
我能告诉你的就是这么多了。我希望你能带给他们这些消息。我现在真的非常需要吉芬的帮: That's all I can tell you. I hope you can bring this message to them. I really need Geffen's help now.

能出什么问题呀，你也真是够大惊小怪的。: What could go wrong? Don't be such a scaredy-cat.

还是小心为妙吧。: I still think you should be careful.
闭嘴，你这个胆小鬼，我先把这两个石碑合到一起看看。: Shut up, coward. I'm going to put the pieces together and read it.

黑暗将会把你们咬碎撕烂！！: Darkness will rip you to shreds!

石碑发出阵阵黑色浓烟，烟雾散去，是一只巨大丑陋的梦魇！: The stele emits a plume of dark smoke which dissipates to reveal a gigantic, Ugly Nightmare!

朋友你好呀~我这里有个宝贝给你看呦~: Hello, friend! I have something precious to show you...
