因为我可是货真价实的人类啊！我之前是吉芬魔法学院里的学生，我是被黑巫教的女巫瑟西: It's because I really am a human! I used to be a student at the Geffen Magic Institute. It was the Black Shaman Cult witch Circe who turned me into this!
这可就说来话长了，事情要从我出生开始说起。: It's a long story. It begins when I was born...
呃...之前不小心受了黑巫教执事娜姬恩的蛊惑。: Uh... I was accidentally beguiled by the Steward of the Black Shaman Cult, Najan.
咳...当然，绝对不是因为她长得漂亮。: Cough... Of course, it wasn't because she was beautiful.
这件事真的很复杂，你可以先把我变回人类，我再慢慢讲给你听吗？我这个样子太显眼了，: This sort of thing is pretty complicated. Can you turn me back into a human first, and then I can tell you the story? I'm too obvious like this. The Black Shaman Cult is likely to attack us.
很简单，有梦魇的麟粉就能制作解药，你能帮我带一些过来吗。: It's simple, Nightmare Scale Powder can produce the antidote. Can you bring some to me?
稍等，让我先把解药吃了。: Wait a moment, let me drink this antidote.
变回人类的感觉真是太棒了，这该死的野猪身体行动起来实在是太不方便了。: It's great to be human again. That damned Savage body was so hard to move around in.
事情是这样子的，我有个令我自豪的姐姐名叫佩内罗妮，是魔法研究所的研究员，我是因为: Here's what happened: I have an older sister I'm proud of named Peneloni. She's a researcher at the Magic Institute. It was under her influence that I came to Geffen to study magic, in hopes that one day I could become a great researcher like her.
姐姐跟我的关系一直很不错，可是就在上个月，她突然一声不吭的了结了自己年轻的生命。: We've always had a good relationship, but last month, Without warning, she suddenly ended her young life.
姐姐平时性格开朗，绝对不是那种会想不开的人，我觉得这中间一定有什么隐情。: She's a happy person who would never not be able to work through something. I felt like there was some secret in this.
对，在姐姐去世不久后，就有一个叫娜姬恩的女人出现在我面前，告诉我，只要加入黑巫教: Yes, not long after my sister died, a woman named Najan appeared before me and told me that if I joined the Dark Shaman Cult, they would help me find out the truth of my sister's death.
对，我跟着这个女人来到了吉芬地下，但我也很快就意识到了事情的不对劲。我姐姐生前在: Yes, I went with the woman to Geffen Dungeon. But I soon realized that something was wrong. When my sister was alive, she had been researching a potion that could majorly enhance magical potency.
我发现黑巫教的人想要得到这种药水，并献给他们的主教瑟西。: I discovered that the Black Shaman Cult wanted to get this potion and give it to their leader Circe.
所以我猜测姐姐并非是自杀，而是因为拒绝了黑巫教的要求，才被黑巫教的人残忍的杀害了: So I guess that my sister hadn't committed suicide, she had refused the Black Shaman Cult's demands and been murdered by them for it. Since they hadn't gotten the potion from my sister, They tricked me there in hopes of getting clues from me.
狠毒的瑟西为了防止我逃跑，把我变成了一头野猪。但是机智的我还是乘他们不注意的时候: The malevolent Circe turned me into a Savage to keep me from running away. But being cleverly, I was able to escape while they weren't paying attention. Circe has dispatched people to look for me and kill me.
不好！！真是怕什么来什么！黑巫教的杀手追过来了: Oh no!!! Speak of the devil! The Black Shaman Cultists have come!
刚才真是太险了，没有你我可能就要跟姐姐一样葬身在黑巫教的手下了。: That was so dangerous. Without you, I might have suffered the same fate as my sister.
你真是个出类拔萃的冒险者，我相信你绝对有能力帮我逃离这里！但是在这之前，我还是想: You really are one of the best adventurers! I'm sure you will be able to help me escape! But before that, I want to make sure that my sister's potion doesn't fall into the hands of the Black Shaman Cultists. Can you help me?
姐姐生前有个好友叫林斯顿，他是魔法研究所在吉芬地下的特派员，我想请你把这整件事都: My sister had a friend named Linston. The Magic Institute sent him to the Geffen Dungeon. Please tell him my story. He might be able to help us.
你也看到了，我现在的处境十分危险，我得先找一个安全的地方躲起来。等你说明情况，再: You saw, I'm in a lot of danger here. I need to find a place to hide. Come find me once you have explained the situation.
你说的这一切都是真的吗？那事态确实有点严重。: Is everything you're saying true? Things seem a bit serious, Then.
还有更糟糕的事情呢！佩内罗妮开发的那种药水，样本现在至今下落不明，如果让黑巫教的: Things are even worse! The whereabouts of the sample of the potion that Peneloni developed are unknown now. If the Black Shaman Cult finds it, There will be trouble.
佩内罗妮生前跟我提起过为了确保这种药水的安全，把样本的线索藏在了他弟弟那里，但具: When she was alive, Peneloni told me that in order to keep the potion save, she had hid a clue to the potion with her younger brother, but even I don't know what it is.
我得去通知魔法公会的人，瑟西这个女魔头又开始蠢蠢欲动了，冒险者，你还是得回去找雷: I need to tell the people of the Mage Guild that Circe is getting restless again. Adventurer, You go find Rea and see if he can remember anything.
什么？！你说姐姐把线索留给了我？那也难怪黑巫教的人要紧追着我不放了。: What?! My sister left a clue with me? That must be why the Black Shaman Cultists won't let me go.
我怎么完全没有记忆啊，我只记得姐姐之前很紧张小心得交给我一串她一直戴着的项链，嗯: I can't think of anything at all. All I remember is my sister nervously giving me a necklace that she always wore. Oh... Could there be some secret with the necklace?
那串项链在我逃跑的时候被一个名叫瓦丹的黑巫教教徒给拽断了，现在应该就在那名教徒手: A cultist named Van Dan ripped the necklace off my neck when I escaped. He must have it, now. Gods! This is horrible!
冒险者，你能帮我去把那串项链给拿回来吗？: Adventurer, can you help me get that necklace back?
硬抢肯定是不行的，得用计谋，把项链给骗出来。: I doubt you can bust in there and grab it. You'll have to use some trick to get it back.
吉芬地下有种价值连城的魔法石，可以用来强化武器，我们就拿这种魔法石跟那个小偷教徒: Geffen Dungeon has a Magic Stone that is worth entire cities! It can be used to enhance weapons. We can trade that type of stone with the thief for the necklace. But that stone is difficult to find, so we'll make a fake one!
对，这种魔法石最大的特征就是它如鲜血一般的红色的外表，在月光的照耀下晶莹剔透还闪: Yes, the most unique thing about the stone is its blood-red appearance. It is translucent in the moonlight, and gives off a multicolored light.
吉芬地下生长着两种奇幻色彩的草，分别是火焰草和琉光草，把这两种草磨成颜料涂在普通: There are some colorful herbs growing in the Geffen Dungeon known as Flame Grass and Light Grass. If we crush them into a paste and rub them on an ordinary rock, we can make a fake.
嘿嘿，厉害吧，我以前做过这样的恶作剧，连姐姐都没分辨出来，被我骗到了呢。: Hehe, They sure are! I pranked my sister with this before. Even she couldn't tell it wasn't real!
好了，就拜托你去收集火焰草和琉光草了，快去快回。: Alright, I need you to go get some Flame Grass and Light Grass. Hurry!
回去找雷亚做假魔法石: Go back to Rea to make the fake Magic Stone.
很好，这正是我需要的。: Perfect, this is what I needed.
稍等一下，我现在就开始制作假的魔法石！: Just a second, I'll start making the fake Magic Stone!
好了！大功告成了，你看，就跟真的魔法石一样吧。: Ready! It's finished! Look! It looks just like a real Magic Stone.
用这种魔法石肯定能从贪婪的瓦丹手中换到项链！这件事情就拜托你了，冒险者。: I'm sure you can trade the necklace for this stone from that greedy Van Dan! I know you can do it, adventurer.
天哪！！黑巫教的杀手又来了！！真是一波接着一波！！: Gods! The Black Shaman Cultists are here to kill me again! It's like wave after wave!
黑巫教的人真是太可怕了，多亏有你在，我还是先躲起来吧你一定要拿回项链啊！: Those Black Shaman Cultists are scary! Luckily you were here. I'm going to go into hiding. I need you to bring the necklace back!
蠢货，你是怎么闯进来的？你知不知道这是瑟西大人的圣地？: Fool, how did you get in here? Do you know this is the sacred ground of Master Circe?
你说你是个旅行商人？你要卖给我什么？: You say you're a traveling merchant? What do you want to sell?
什么？！你说你这里有魔法石，快给我看看。: What?! You're telling me you have a Magic Stone? Show it to me!
还真是稀有的魔法石，这光泽...这血红的颜色...太美了！把它献给瑟西大人真是再: It really is a rare Magic Stone. This luster... This blood-red color... It's beautiful! This would be the best gift for Master Circe!
噢该死，我没这么多金子把它买下来。: Oh, damn. I don't have enough Zeny to buy it.
什么？你说只要我脖子上的这条破项链就能跟你换这块魔法石？这是我在抓捕一个叛逃教徒: What? You said you'll trade me this Magic Stone for this cruddy necklace I'm wearing? I snatched it off a disciple who betrayed us when he ran away. What's so special about this necklace?
你真的愿意拿这么贵重的魔法石跟我换？: You're really willing to trade me that precious Magic Stone for this?
换！傻子才不换！嘿嘿，到时候如果你后悔了可别来找我，我不会把魔法石还给你的！: I do! Of course I do! Hehe, don't come crying when you regret the trade! I won't give you this Magic Stone back.
今天可真是走大运了，遇到个蠢商人，看来他是不知道魔法石的价值。: Today's my lucky day, to meet such a foolish merchant. He must not have known the value of this Magic Stone.
冒险者你真有一手，是我姐姐的项链！谢谢你帮我找回来。: You're really something, adventurer. That's my sister's necklace! Thank you for getting it back.
让我仔细瞧瞧这项链…咦？项链上好像刻着一行奇怪的咒语: Let me look at it more closely. Hm? There is a strange incantation engraved here.
嗯？你没看见？怎么可能，你再仔细看看，就刻在这里啊。: Hm? You can't see it? How could that be. Look closer, it's right here.
这就妙了，莫非是是姐姐用魔法刻下只有我能看见的咒文。: That's strange. Unless... My sister must have used magic to engrave an incantation that only I can see.
好！那我就来吟诵看看会发生什么事。: Alright! I'll recite it and see what happens.
雷亚，我把药水藏在了吉芬地下的一个密箱里。项链就是这密箱的钥匙。: Rea, I hid the potion in a hidden chest in Geffen Dungeon. The necklace is the key to the chest.
它会在古堡前静待，十字墓碑在右守候，两朵火花为你引路，血色的窗守望的眼。: It sits in front of an ancient castle, with a cross tombstone guarding it on the right. Two sparks will lead your way, with an eye watching from a blood-red window.
你以后会明白的，现在我要用魔法将你的记忆封住，等你念诵我再项链上为你刻的咒文，你: You'll understand later. Now I'm going to seal this memory with magic. When you read the incantation I engraved on the necklace for you, You will remember everything I told you today.
我想起来了，我全想起来了！原来姐姐早就料到了有这一天。: I remember! I remember it all! My sister expected that this would happen.
可是“它会在古堡前静待，十字墓碑在右守候，两朵火花为你引路，血色的窗守望的眼。”: But what is the meaning of "it sits in front of an ancient castle, with a cross tombstone guarding it on the right. Two sparks will lead your way, with an eye watching from a blood-red window?"
你说的没错，目前比较明确的线索就是那个放药水的密箱，在吉芬地下的古堡附近，不如你: You're right. The only real clue we have right now is that the potion is in a chest, and it's near the castle in the Geffen Dungeon. Why don't you go check it out for me first?
哎！？这里好像有个奇怪的木箱: Huh?! There seems to be a strange chest here.
看来你成功的帮我找到了密箱，你真是太厉害了。试试用姐姐的项链把它打开吧。: It seems you have successfully found my chest. You're really something. Try to open it with my sister's necklace.
太好了，我这就去把这个好消息告诉林斯顿，药水的样本就交给你回收，然后我们在林斯顿: Great! I'll tell the good news to Linston. I'll leave you to retrieve the sample potion, and we can meet up with Linston.
这件事你处理的很棒，冒险者，我已经和魔法公会的人反映了一切，还需要你帮我们完成最: You handled this with great skill, adventurer. I've told the Mage Guild about everything. There's one final thing I need you to do.
现在就由我先来把雷亚安全传送回吉芬城。: I'll safely teleport Rea back to Geffen first.
这药水样本留在吉芬地下太危险了，随时都有被人抢走的可能性，但是让雷亚带着我也不放: It is too dangerous for this sample potion to remain in Geffen. It could be stolen by someone at any moment. But I'm nervous about giving it to Rea.
所以我希望你能把这样本带去给魔法公会的大魔导师霍尔特，由他亲手交回研究所是最保险: So I hope that you can bring the sample potion to Master High Wizard Holt in the Mage Guild. Having him give it to the Magic Institute is the safest way.
我已经跟他说明了情况，你快去吧，可不能在这里待太久，说不定黑巫教的眼线已经知道了: I've already told him about the situation. You should head there. You shouldn't remain here for too long. The eyes of the Black Shaman Cult might already know that we have the sample potion.
你竟然想带着药水样本逃跑，你就等着被我撕碎吧。: How dare you try to Flee with the sample potion! I'll rip you the shreds!
你别得意的太早，早晚我会把你的头颅献祭给瑟西大人！！: Don't look too pleased with yourself! One day I'll give your skull to Master Circe!
情况我都听林斯顿说了，你干的很好，冒险者。: Linston told me about everything. You've performed well, adventurer.
你把药水交给我吧，药水的样本在我这里会很安全。: Give me the potion. It will be safe with me.
魔法公会会重视这起事件的，对于雷亚姐姐的牺牲我深表遗憾，但是你并没有让她的努力白: The Mage Guild knows this is important. I express my deepest regrets about the sacrifice of Rea's sister, but you made sure her efforts were not in vain.
同时我也感谢你为守护吉芬的和平作出的贡献，吉芬的魔法师们都会记得你的。: I would also like to thank you for helping maintain the peace in Geffen. All the Mages will remember you.
呀！冒险者！难道你也是被派来调查这里异常情况的？: Ah! Adventurer! Were you sent here to investigate the strange happenings?
根据最近的调查，我发现这里经常有一些落单的冒险者失踪，这件事我已经有些线索了。: My latest survey has discovered that solo adventurers often go missing here. There are some clues.
可当我深入的研究后才发现这件事非常可怕，我需要帮助！冒险者，你愿意加入我的研究吗: But when I investigated more, I found out that something terrible is happening! I need help! Adventurer, Would you be willing to join in my research?
也好，等你有一定实力的时候再回来找我吧。: Alright, maybe you should wait until you're more powerful.
你注意到我左边的墓地吗？那可是德古拉男爵的地盘，有好几个冒险者都在那里失踪了，你: Do you see the tomb on my left? That's the territory of Dracula. Several adventurers went missing there. You know what that means, don't you?
你果然是个聪明人。经过我的调查，那片墓地旁的城堡里住着一位不祥的少女。: You're intelligent, after all. My investigation has found that an unknown girl lives in the castle by the tomb.
对，通过她血红的发色和瞳色还有漆黑的翅膀能分辨出那是一个嗜血的魔物，我认为她就是: Yes. Her blood-red hair and eyes, and black wings tell me that she's a bloodthirsty monster. I believe that she is the one behind the missing adventurers.
我要留在这里警告更多路过的冒险者们，如果你有足够的勇气，或许能找她交涉一下！: I'm going to stay here to warn more adventurers passing by. If you're brave enough, perhaps you could interact with her!
你的胆子也太大了，不想被当成晚餐就别靠近我！: You are bold! Stay away from me, if you don't want to be dinner!
什么？你说教会的人觉得那些冒险者的失踪都是因为我？真是群愚蠢的神职者。: What? You mean the person from the church thinks that I'm the reason behind the missing adventurers? What a bunch of idiot holy men.
如果他们认为是我干的，那就让他们这么认为吧，反正接近我的人都会变得不幸，一切都太: If they want to think that, let them think that. Everyone who gets close to me ends up dead, anyway. It's all too late!
可笑，我为什么要和一个人类费那么多口舌？快离开这里，不然你可要被这些小恶魔揍扁了: It's funny, why am I wasting so many words with a human? Get out of here, otherwise you'll be beaten to a pulp by these little Deviruchis!
很厉害的冒险者！原本只是想吓吓你，看来我得和你谈谈: What a strong adventurer! I was just trying to scare you. It seems I'll have to talk with you.
我原本只是魔法学院的一个普通学生，有一天被一个恶魔掳来这里，没想到变成这番模样！: I used to be an ordinary student at the Magic Institute. One day, I was captured by a demon and brought here. I never imagined I would become like this!
我也痛恨德古拉，所以我怎么会为难这里的冒险者呢，我是在尝试保护他们远离这里，因为: I hate Dracula, so why would I hurt the adventurers here? I'm trying to protect them by telling them to stay away, because there are two of Dracula's servants in that tomb.
我痛恨那只叫做德古拉的恶魔，我其实并没有为难这里的冒险者，就和刚才一样，我是在提: I hate that demon known as Dracula. I haven't hurt the adventurers here. Like just now, I'm reminding them to stay away from here.
因为墓地里住着两个德古拉男爵的仆人。: Because two of Dracula's servants live in the tomb.
对，他们嗜血如命，可不是什么好惹的家伙。不过同样变成为魔物的我能感觉到他们的存在: Yes, they are as bloodthirsty as ever, and no pushovers. But since I'm a monster as well, I can feel their presence. Whenever they appear, I stop them immediately.
但是因为我长期拒绝吸食人血，我的力量越来越弱，不知道自己还能撑多久。: But because I've refused to drink human blood for so long, I'm becoming weaker and weaker. I don't know how much longer I can keep them back.
在这里有一种魔物，叫做梦魇，它的血能代替人血恢复我的力量，所以冒险者，请你带一些: There is a monster here known as a Nightmare. Its blood can restore my power in place of human blood. So adventurer, I'd like you to bring me some Nightmare Blood. I hope it isn't too late.
这么快就回来了？我真是找对人了！: You came back so quickly? I really found the right person!
我现在感觉好多了，真不知道什么时候才能从这无尽的痛苦中解脱出来！: I feel much better. I don't know when I can be free of this endless torment!
我能再拜托你一件事吗？: Can I ask you for one more favor?
帮我告诉教会的人，我希望立刻结束地下秘穴的调查，并且离开这里，德古拉男爵的两个仆: Tell the people of the church that I wish to end the investigation of the underground tomb, and hope that they leave. Dracula's two servants are more terrible than you can imagine!
天呐！这么说，是我错怪她了。: Gosh, it looks like we blamed the wrong person.
沙西莉作为一个嗜血魔物能控制不伤害冒险者，精神和意志一定饱受了极大的考验，实在是: Shahelly's spirit and willpower must have undergone an enormous test to be able to control her thirst for blood and not harm adventurers. It must be difficult.
从长远的角度看，她这样下去迟早会丧失心智，我倒是有一个办法能让她从这种痛苦中脱离: From a long-term perspective, if she continues like this, she will lose her consciousness eventually. I do have a way to end her suffering.
汤玛斯大主教曾经治愈过一些与沙西莉同样情况的冒险者，她使用的是一种叫做光之圣水的: Archbishop Thomasville once cured those adventurers who were in the same situation as Shahelly. It was a divine potion called Holy Water of the Light. Bathing her in this Holy Water could turn her back into a human. Would you be willing to travel for her?
孩子，你有什么需要我帮助的吗？: Child, do you need my help with something?
嗯，我明白你的来意了，伟大的神为千万人存留慈爱，赦免罪孽，但是制作这种圣水所需要: Oh, I understand why you're here. Glorious God has mercy for all people, and can forgive all sins, but making this Holy Water requires materials that are from the darkest, Most terrible warren in the Geffen Dungeon. And ten years ago, That warren was sealed. Today, the warren has been re-opened, but I haven't asked any members of the church to collect materials there.
我这里有一份制作圣水的配方，如果你能收集完材料的话，可以交给利隆达斯，根据配方上: I have a recipe to create Holy Water here. If you can collect the materials, you can give them to Leon, and he can help you make it with the recipe.
我的天！你拿到了配方！那制作就交给我吧。: Amazing! You've got the recipe! I'll make the Holy Water then.
哦！原来是这样！1,2,3，这里…3比1，恩恩……额……等等…: Oh, That's it! 1, 2, 3, Then... Three to one... Yes, Right... Mhm... Hold on.
这里不对！你漏了一样，我看看…哦！是血蝙蝠的牙齿: This part is wrong! You left something out! Let me see... Oh! Familiar Teeth.
血蝙蝠是德古拉仆人赫米拉身边特有的宠物，你得冒着生命危险去激怒赫米拉，他就会放出: Familiars are pets of Dracula's servant Hermira. You'll have to risk your life enraging Hermira, and he will release Familiars to attack you. Are you brave enough?
你站在门口时我就已经嗅到你身上美妙鲜血的味道。: I smelled the delicious scent of blood on your smelly body when you were standing at the door.
气死我了！区区一个人类都敢来羞辱高贵的我们，乖乖成为我宠物的盘中餐吧！！: I'm furious! How dare a human come here to insult us, who are far nobler! You just wait to become my pets' lunch!
你给我等着，等我恢复了力量，我会第一时间割下你的头颅。: You wait! Wait until I recover my strength! The first thing I do will be to take your head!
能看你活着回来真是太好了，血蝙蝠的牙齿收集到了吗？: I'm glad to see you come back alive. Do you have the Familiar teeth?
好了，快给沙西莉拿去吧，望她能尽快重新回到神的怀抱。: It's ready. Give it to Shehelly.
什么！？你说你给我带来了变回人类的圣水？: What? You have brought me Holy Water to change me back into a human?
冒险者，你真的是个值得依托的好人。: Adventurer, You're a reliable, Good person.
你的好意我真的心领了，我现在还不能变回人类。: I appreciate your good intentions, but I can't turn back into a human right now.
因为我还有不得不完成的使命。: Because I have a mission that I must complete?
你都帮了我这么多了，像你这样强大的冒险者说不定真的能帮我解开多年的心结。那就是我: You've already helped me so much. An adventurer as powerful as you might be able to help me free myself from a problem I've had for years. It is my beloved Cilmond. I would like you to destroy him.
因为我被德古拉男爵掳来这里，我的爱人西蒙特紧随其后为了救我，一路杀到这里，与德古: I was brought here as a prisoner of Dracula, and my beloved Cilmond followed to rescue me. He engaged in battle with Dracula, but he couldn't slay Dracula, and died here.
西蒙特死后，他的魂魄不想离我而去，终日徘徊在这里吉芬塔地下。: After he died, his soul didn't want to leave me, so he has remained wandering around the Geffen Dungeon.
没想到，他的魂魄却受到吉芬地下邪恶力量和各种怨灵的影响最终迷失了自我，变成了恶灵: Unfortunately, his soul lost its sense of identity because of the evil power and effects of all sorts of resentful beings in the dungeon, and became a Wraith.
西蒙特永远是我心目中的英雄，也是我最爱的人，所以我不想看他被黑暗吞噬。可是我又不: Cilmond will always be a hero in my heart, and the one I loved the most, so I don't want to see him consumed by darkness. But I can't bring myself to destroy his soul. Would you be willing to do this for me?
这……怎么回事……我怎么会在这里？: What... What's going on? What am I doing here?
不！真不敢相信我居然变成了恶灵，谢谢你让我的灵魂得到解脱。: No! I can't believe I turned into a Wraith. Thank you for freeing my soul.
原来是沙西莉叫你来的，作为一个骑士我连我自己的爱人都没守护好，真是惭愧。: Oh, Shehelly asked you to come! As a Knight, I wasn't even able to protect the one I loved. I'm so ashamed.
尽管如此，我还是想见她最后一面。: Even so, I still want to see her one last time.
你把我的爱人西蒙特带回来了！: You brought my beloved Cilmond back to me!
我亲爱的沙西莉，我是来见你最后一面的，请你不要怪罪我，我要先走一步了。: My beloved Shehelly, I came to see you one last time. Please don't blame me. I must leave before you.
虽然我欠你一段圆满的爱情，但在我的生命里能遇见你真是太好了，我爱你沙西莉。: I owe you a life full of love, but I am so happy to have had you in my life. I love you, Shehelly.
我也爱你，你安心的去吧。: I love you too. Go, be at peace.
谢谢你冒险者，能见到西蒙特最后一面我也算满足了。你是一个值得信任的冒险者！: Thank you, adventurer. I feel content that I was able to see Cilmond one last time. You're an adventurer I can trust!
见到我心爱的西蒙特也更坚定了我为西蒙特复仇的决心。: Seeing my beloved Cilmond has reaffirmed my resolve to avenge Cilmond.
对，我暂时还不能变回人类，我要继续隐居在这里，总有一天德古拉会再度现身，而这里将: Yes! I can't become a human yet. I need to continue to live here. One day, Dracula will show up again, and this is his burial place. You support my decision, don't you?
冒险者们，虽然我不知道你们从何而来，但我仍然要感谢你们的帮助，现在必须尽快进入封: Adventurer, I don't know where you came from, but I still thank you for your help. Please enter the Sealed Room as soon as possible. Baphomet snuck in ahead of you.
哪些没完没了的一群挡住了我们的去路，勇敢的孩子们，请立即击破他们: Those annoying pests have blocked our path. Please break through them, child.
很多，蚁群渐渐的退缩了，继续将它们全部击退吧！: There's a lot of them. The group of ants is retreating. Keep pushing them back!
进展很顺利，接下来我们分开行动，从四个入口包围祭坛。: Things have gone well. Now, We must split up, and surround the Altar from four entrances.
那是什么！？这里的情况看起来非常糟糕，冒险者们，击退哪些狂暴的魔物: What's that?! The situation here is even worse. Adventurers, Quell those berserk monsters!
我感觉到了狂暴的魔物正在减少。: I can sense that the berserk monsters are decreasing.
哈哈，看起来进展顺利: Haha, it seems things are going well.
只剩下最后一只了，快干掉它！: There's only one left. Kill it!
冒险者们，下面的蚁群交给我们，请继续前往中央入口！: Adventurers, let us deal with the ants. Continue into the central hall!
无法进入？那头恶魔净耍些雕虫小技！我们将消弱哪些法阵，请立即击碎它们。: You can't get in? That demon always has tricks up his sleeve! We will weaken those enchantments. Crush them.
不自量力的人类！你们休想师徒靠近我！: You humans overestimate yourselves! Don't try to approach!
我为你们准备了一些“礼物”希望你们能喜欢，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈”: I've prepared some "gifts" for you. I hope you like them! Muahahaha!
看起来有些大家伙在等着我们，海陆曼你还有力气吗？”: It seems there are some big guys waiting for us. Healueman, do you have any strength left?
噢，亚瑞看来你有些怕了啊，我大概只用了20%的力气，哼哼！: Oh, Ayrui, you look scared. I was only using 20% of my strength, Hmph!
那些人偶看起来有些奇怪，先把周围的敌人肃清，靠近哪些魔力人偶时请小心: Those magic figures look strange. Clear out the surrounding enemies first. Be careful when you get near the magic figures!
这些不堪一击的木乃伊，简直在浪费我们的时间！一口气把它们全部解决！: These mummies can't stand up to us! It's just a waste of our time. Eliminate them all at once!
干的不错啊人类！那么接下来你们又该如何应对呢？: Not bad, human! But what should you do next?
这些人偶非常危险，请尝试逐一击破。: These magic figures are extremely dangerous! Try to destroy them with one blow.
击碎法阵时，请小心伏击。: Be wary of an ambush when the enchantment is destroyed.
愿星星的光芒守护着你~那就和你正牵着手的TA一起来一次银河的心之旅吧。: May the light of the stars protect you. May you and the one you hold hands with share a journey of the hearts across the Milky Way.
你好呀，我是小招喵，很高兴见到你，能看到我可是很幸运呢！我代表「招商银行」给亲爱: Hello, I'm Mr. Meow. I'm pleased to see you. If you can see me, You're very lucky! I'm here on behalf of [Merchant's Bank] to bring benefits to RO players.
很显然，这是诅咒的力量。: It's obvious that this is the power of a curse.
古城的内部恐怕酝酿着更大的风暴，我们需要抓紧时间了！: I'm afraid a greater storm is brewing in Glast Heim. We need to hurry!
你好冒险者，我是魔物研究协会的重熙，有关古城郊外的魔物信息你都可以问我哦。: Hello, adventurer. I'm Shigehiro from the Monster Research Organization. You can ask me anything about the monsters outside of Glast Heim.
这里真是危险呢，难怪魔物研究会会请我来保护重熙呢！: It is really dangerous here. No wonder the Monster Research Organization asked me to protect Shigehiro!
我会小心警戒的！这里可不是什么安全的地方。: I will be careful. This place is not safe.
啊…疼疼！该死的家伙，下手竟然这么重！: Ah! It hurts! Damn, that guy hits hard!
别乱动，罗科姆德！唉，真拿你没办法。: Don't move, Rocomd! Ah, what am I going to do with you?
我想我们克雷斯特同盟军一定会大获全胜的！因为我们即使正义！: I know that our Crest Alliance Army will be victorious! Because we are the righteous!
一切听从海陆曼将军的安排！谁敢不听，我可不会手下留情！: Everyone listen to General Healueman's orders! If anyone disobeys them, I won't be kind!
这次我一定不会再让他从我手下逃走！: I definitely won't let him escape this time!
总有些人莫名其妙得要带我回去，我才不要回去呢！我要继续我的位面旅行！: There's always some people that want to take me back, but I don't want to go back! I want to keep traveling through my plane!
克雷斯特汉姆的城外曾是一片生机盎然的土地，而在克雷斯特汉姆荒废以后，这片土地也渐: The Glast Heim Outskirt used to be a land of verdant life, but after Glast Heim was abandoned, the land eventually lost its vitality.
生活在城外原本和善的毕帝特龙族也逐渐变成了凶恶的魔物。: The Petite race living outside the city used to be peaceful and friendly, but eventually turned into vicious monsters.
它们袭击着商队以及前来冒险的人们，造成了很多人受伤甚至死亡。: They attacked caravans and adventurers, causing many injuries and even deaths.
在很久之前，毕帝特龙族以及绿贝勒斯是非常和善的魔物，他们与古城的人们和谐相处。: Long ago, the Petites and Feruses were kind monsters who lived in peace with the people of Glast Heim.
而现在古城荒废之后，毕帝特龙族以及绿贝勒斯在某种原因的影响下逐渐变的狂暴。: But now that Glast Heim has been abandoned, the Petites and Feruses gradually became berserk, affected by something.
这片生机盎然的土地最终演变成了一块危机四伏的土地，过往的行人们对这里畏惧不已。: And this land that was once full of life transformed into a dangerous place that filled travelers with terror.
他们的狂暴化对来往的人们构成严重的威胁，为了行人们的安全，国王陛下派遣我们来到这: They pose a severe threat to the people who pass through here. For travelers' safety, his Majesty the king has sent us here to study these monsters, In hopes that we can find their weakness.
我的同僚在犬妖森林的魔物研究上取得了重大的突破。而我作为魔物研究会的一员，也应该: My colleague has made significant breakthroughs in monster research in the Kobold Forest. And as a member of the Monster Research Organization, I should work harder!
冒险者，我想我对这里的魔物已经有了一定程度的了解。: Adventurer! I think I have a good understanding of the monsters here.
从这些魔物身上，我获得不少资料，现在已经到了验证成果的时候了。: I have gained a fair amount of material from these monsters. Now is the time to verify my results.
为了来往行人的安全，我一定会把这里的魔物狂暴原因研究透彻的。: I will definitely figure out the reason these monsters went berserk, for the safety of people passing through.
所以冒险者，我需要你的帮助。: So adventurer, I need your help.
我就知道你一定不会袖手旁观的！: I knew you wouldn't stand by and do nothing!
根据我的研究发现，影响毕帝特龙族和绿贝勒斯的原因，并不是因为他们身体里的那些神之: My research has discovered that the thing influencing the Petites and Feruses isn't the Hands of God inside them.
而是因为其他的原因，根据我的猜测，恐怕与这些魔物身上的角有关系。: It is another reason. I would guess that it might be related to their horns.
我和我的护卫贝妮会给你一些信息，我们很真诚的希望你能够加入我们的研究。: My guard Beni and I will give you some information. We sincerely hope that you can join our research.
根据我的观察，毕帝特地龙在战斗的时候总是尽量避免自己的角受伤。: Based on my observation, the Green Petites can always avoid getting their horns hurt when they are fighting.
我觉得这种现象表示龙角在他们心中的分量相当重要。: I think this behavior shows that their horns are very important to these Petites.
所以我需要你收集一些毕帝特地龙角给我，我可以仔细的研究一下地龙角的成分，以便做出: So I need you to gather some Green Petite Horns for me. I will be able to research the components of the Green Petite Horns, to make a proper judgment.
竟然这么快就回来了！太棒了冒险者！: You came back so fast! That's amazing, adventurer!
比起毕帝特地龙，毕帝特飞龙有些不同，他们并不在意自己的角是否受伤。: Compared to Green Petites, Sky Petites don't care if their horn is hurt.
因为根据我的观察，他们的角就算受伤也会很快的恢复。: Because based on my observation, Their horn can heal quickly even if it is hurt.
可见飞龙的角与地龙的角是有所不同的，所以冒险者，我需要你收集一些飞龙角，方便我进: We can see from this that Green and Purple Petites are different. That's why I need you to collect some Purple Petite Horns, so I can research them.
干得非常不错，冒险者，你的帮助太重要了！: That's brilliant, adventurer! Your help is so important!
绿贝勒斯的角是最不寻常的，他们的角显得更加强大而富有攻击性。: The Ferus' Horns are the most unusual. Their horns are stronger and more aggressive.
我想绿贝勒斯们也是靠着这么强大的角才能在毕帝特龙族手下挣得生存的空间。: I think that the Feruses rely on their strong horn to fight for their space to survive among the Petites.
我需要绿贝勒斯的角来进行我的下一步研究，冒险者你帮我收集一些来吧。: I need Ferus' Horns to conduct my next research. Adventurer, can you get me some?
我的天！我想我从未见过像你这样高效率的冒险者！太感谢你了。: Gods! I've never seen an adventurer as efficient as you! Thank you so much!
经过我的研究，我发现这些角里面存在这一种纯粹的魔力。: My research has found that there is a certain pure magic in these horns.
这种魔力对我们人族没有任何影响，但是对这些魔物却影响巨大。: This magic doesn't affect humans, but it has a profound influence on monsters.
这些魔力都聚集在这些角上，我想这就是为什么这里的魔物变狂暴且更加具有攻击性了。: This magic is gathered in their horns. I think this is why the monsters here have become berserk and aggressive.
但是在毕帝特龙族中，还有一个更加强大的存在，我称它为毕帝特地龙王。: But of the Petites, there is an even stronger presence. I call it the Green Petite King.
毫无疑问，它的强大就像龙族的王者一样，起码我没有见过其他的龙族像它一样强大。: Undoubtedly, his power makes him seem like a King of the Petites. At least I've never seen a Petite as powerful as him.
它的角上恐怕拥有着更加强大的魔力！冒险者，我需要它的角来继续我的研究。请帮我收集: His horn must have even stronger magic! Adventurer, I need his horn to continue my research! Please bring it to me.
你回来了，看你的样子应该成功的拿到角了吧。快给我吧。: You're back, and you look like you got the horn. Give to to me.
果然不出我的意料，曾经的我一直以为，在神之手这种材料的作用下，这些魔物才会变得狂: As I expected. I believed that with the effects of the Hand of God, These monsters would become berserk.
但是实际上，在毕帝特地龙身上，我并没有发现神之手，这使得我推翻了之前的推断。: But in reality, I didn't discover any Hand of God in the Green Petites. That contradicted my previous hypothesis.
在研究了这些魔物的角之后，我可以很清楚的认识到，不是因为神之手魔物才狂暴的。: After researching these monster horns, I have clearly realized that they didn't go berserk because of any Hand of God.
他们的角中的那股魔力才是真正的罪魁祸首，甚至于神之手也是在这种魔力的作用下才出现: This magic in their horns is the real culprit, and the Hand of God only appears in these monsters because of this magic.
很可怕的魔力，我想这股魔力，应该与古城内部的那股令人不安的力量有所联系。: It is terrifying magic. I imagine this magic is probably related to the disturbing power in Glast Heim.
不管怎么样，研究总算有所突破了，多谢你的帮助，冒险者。: Regardless, I have made a breakthrough in my research. Thank you for your help, adventurer.
嘿，还有什么能比全新的挑战更让我兴奋的吗？: Hey, is there anything more exciting than a brand new challenge?
接下来的战斗我们无法提供帮助，交给你了冒险者！: We can't provide any help in the coming battle. It's all up to you, adventurer!
这是神秘的药水样本…: This is a mysterious Sample Potion...
为了应对女神之手的计划，我们得尽快回到吉芬做些准备了，这里的事情就拜托你了。: We have to return to Geffen and make preparations to deal with the Hands of the Goddess' plot. I'll leave this to you.
我不能让我的父亲就这么睡在冰冷的祭坛上。: I can't let my father rest on this ice-cold altar.
冒险者，我先去安葬我的父亲了…: Adventurer, I'm going to go bury my father...
你一会儿去河边找我吧。我要好好谢谢你。: Find me out near the river. I want to thank you.
冒险者！好可怕，我被袭击了！: Adventurer! It was terrifying! I was attacked!
我本想进行一场轰轰烈烈的时空旅行，那就是去到无数个不同的位面，来发现这些世界中到: I wanted to go on an exciting journey across space and time, to go to different planes and discover the differences between these worlds.
可是突然就有一些时空法师，让我回到我原本的位面，当然，我可是花费了相当高昂的旅行: But suddenly, There were some time mages that brought me back to my original plane. Of course, I spent a lot on preparing this journey, so how could I just give up?
冒险者，你愿意帮我赶走那些可恶的魔法师吗？: Adventurer, would you be willing to help drive those damn Mages away!
是的，正如你所见，是我袭击了他。: Yes, As you can see, I attacked him.
你别看他现在可怜兮兮的样子，其实这个刺客是个隐匿高手，而他在尝试一个很可怕的事情: Don't let his pitiful look fool you. This assassin is a master of hiding, and he is attempting something terrible.
每次在进行位面传送时，他不断在途中尝试使用隐匿来让自己停留在位面与位面之间。: Every time he teleports between planes, he attempts to hide himself so that he stays between planes.
由于我们目前的研究还没有完全的了解清楚时空与位面的秘密，我们无法预估他成功之后的: Since our current research doesn't fully understand the secrets between time, Space, and planes, We can't predict what consequences there would be if he was successful.
而就从目前来看，他的每一次行动都会导致我们的魔法师体内的魔力出现大幅度的动荡。: Currently, every action he takes will cause major turbulence in the magic within our Mages.
正因为如此，有些位面魔法师会突然获得魔法能力的大幅提升，有些则突然魔力丧失。: It is because of this that some planar Mages suddenly received greatly enhanced magic, while some suddenly lost their magic.
好不容易抓住了他，我得时刻盯着他才行。否则一不小心他又会逃跑的。: I finally captured him, and now I have to keep an eye on him, Otherwise he will escape again.
所以我必须限制住他的能力，只是我现在的魔力很不稳定，需要大量神之手来稳固我的魔力: That's why I have to restrict his abilities, but my magic is very unstable, and it takes many Hands of God to stabilize it. This allows me to better restrain him.
你能够帮我从周围的绿贝勒斯和毕帝特飞龙身上收集一些吗？我相信，充满正义感的冒险者: Can you collect some Hands of God from the Feruses and Sky Petites around here? I'm sure that an adventurer filled with righteousness won't let him do whatever he wants.
已经收集好了么？你愿意现在就把30个神之手交给我吗？: You've collected them? Will you give me 30 Hands of God?
太棒了冒险者，有了这些材料，我就能顺利的限制他的能力了！: Fantastic, adventurer. With these materials, I'll be able to better restrict his abilities!
这点数量不太够呢，你还是再找一些神之手来吧。: You don't have enough. Come back when you have more Hands of God.
在进行位面传送的时候，冒险者与魔法师之间会产生非常精密的联系，而这一次发生了更可: When teleporting between planes, an intricate link will occur between adventurers and Mages. And this time, something even worse happened.

没想到刚来就看到你这么狼狈的一面…: I didn't expect to see you in such a difficult position here...
哇…克雷托斯，我开个玩笑而已，不用这么当真吧？: Wow... Kartos, I was joking. Don't take it too seriously.
好了，你们俩闹够了吧？: Enough is enough, both of you!

想要获得龙族的友谊，净化龙蛋中的黑暗力量倒是一个不错的途径。: To build a friendship with the dragons, to purify the dark force in the dragon eggs seems a good choice.

我来压制住这个受伤的绿贝勒斯，冒险者，这个污染的小绿贝勒斯就交给你了！: I'll suppress this injured ferus. Adventurer, You take care of this polluted baby Ferus!
快！趁现在击败那头污染的小绿贝勒斯！: Hurry! Defeat the polluted baby Ferus now!
我来驱逐它身上的黑暗力量！: Let me expel the dark force from its body!
我已经驱逐了它身上的黑暗力量，接下来它只需要好好休息就能恢复过来。: I've expelled the dark force from its body. Let it rest a bit and it will recover...
冒险者，我和艾洛娜先走了！你也快点离开这里。: Adventurer, Elona and I will take our leave. You are advised to leave as well!
希望那些龙族能够感受到我们的善意，如果这样它们还是不能理解，那么我们就要做好苦战: I hope those dragons have felt our kindness. If they continue to misunderstand our intention, we'll have to prepare for a tough battle.
我们忙活了半天，结果不算太坏，也算挽救了龙族的危机。: The outcome of our effort is not bad. We saved the dragons' crisit.
总之，这次要谢谢你的帮助，冒险者。这是你应得的奖励，收下吧！: Thank you for your service, adventurer. This is your reward. You earned it.
再这么下去…这次讨伐就要失败了！不行！我得想想办法…: If this goes on, this expedition is to fail! No! I must think of a way.
出征的军队最忌讳的就是补给不足，很遗憾，我们现在就面临这样的窘境。: An army on campaign fears for nothing more than a shortage of supplies. Unfortunately, we are in such an awkward situation.
我们的后勤部队遭受到了身穿黑色铠甲人的袭击。: Our logistics unit was attacked by those black armored men...
他们没有伤害我们的士兵，但是却夺走了我们的物资。其中包括面包、水、铠甲以及一些武: They didn't harm our troops but took away our materials, Including bread, Water, Armor, and some weapons.
目前同盟军的士兵们还不知道这件事，一旦泄漏出去，恐怕会引起慌乱。: Soldiers of the allies are unaware of this yet. I'm afraid the leak of this news will lead to panic.
好在我们的面包、水还足够消耗几天，我们必须在这几天内把物资给找回来！: Luckily our bread and water can last us a few more days. We must get our materials back before it runs out.
所以冒险者，你能帮助我找回这些物资吗？: Adventurer, will you help us retrieve these materials?
有你帮忙真是太好了！现在我就告诉你我们目前已经搜集到的情报。: Thank you. Now let me share with you the intelligence we've gathered.
根据斥候传来的消息，在我们的物资丢失的那段时间，他们在南部龙区看到了黑色铠甲的身: According to the scouts' report, They saw those black armored men in the south of dragon area as our materials were taken.
那里是龙类魔物的聚集地，我们的斥候不敢太过接近。: That's the gathering spot of the dragon monsters. Our scouts dared not approach.
所以，冒险者请你去那里进行调查。我想那里应该会有我们要的线索。: So... Adventurer, please look into that area. I believe you'll find some clues there.
嘿…果然来了嘛，我就知道，以你们人类的个性是不会放弃的。: He-heh... I knew you humans won't give up easily.
来吧！想从我埃托利亚手里拿回这些东西，就要看你们的本事了！: Come on! You want to get your stuff back from Aetolia? Show me what you've got.
嘿，还不赖嘛！原本想劫走物资让你们知难而退。: Hey! Not bad! I thought you would retreat in the face of the shortage of supplies.
你的实力让我埃托利亚感到惊讶！看来人类中也不乏充满智慧的战士啊，这些物资归你了！: Your strength impressed Aetolia! I didn't expect such an intelligent human warrior. Take these materials.
哇！这些物资…没想到，冒险者你竟然完成得这么出色！: Wow! These materials... I thought it would be difficult even for you, adventurer!
这下不用再为物资的事情发愁了，我们可以安心准备战斗了！: Now we don't need to worry about the materials. We can finally focus on combat!
谢谢你的帮助，冒险者。: Thank you for your service, adventurer.
那真是太遗憾了，竟然没人能够理解我现在的心情。: It's a pity that no one can understand my feelings.
龙蛋中似乎有什么东西要破壳而出……: Something is coming out of the dragon egg!
呃，是的…在传送的过程中出现了一些小小的偏差。更重要的是，我带来的秘密武器丢失了: Err... Yeah... There was a small deflection during the teleportation. More importantly, I lost my secret weapon! My lord... How can we resist that horrible monster without firecrackers? You must help me. In return, I'll give you my favorite thing!
嘻嘻~你想让本王砸你一下喵？ヽ(=^･ω･^=)丿: He-heh... You want me to pound your head?
我们的调查有了一些进展，我们在西南面的湖边发现了一些线索。: Our investigation has made some progress. We found something by the lake in the southwest.
年轻的魔法师正在那里进行调查，可是猎鹰告诉我情况并不好，冒险者，请赶快前往西南边: A young Mage is investigating there. However, Falcon told me it doesn't look good. Adventurer, head to the southwest and probe.
走开！不要靠近我，你这个魔女！: Go away! Don't approach, You witch!
魔女？是啊，你不是渴望无尽的魔法力量吗？我可以让你获得这些你梦寐以求的力量。: Witch? Yeah, You are chasing the endless magic power? I can grant you this long cherished strength.
你已经不止一次出现在我周围了，你到底有什么目的！: You've presented yourself near me more than once. What do you want?
当然是看你有潜力啊，怎么样，接受我赐予你的力量吧！！: I have faith in your potential. What do you think? Accept the strength from me!
我居然会对一个人类感兴趣？一定有问题。: I'm interested in a human? Something must be wrong.
难道你今天还想再逃走？: You think you can get away again?
你们也太高看自己了吧，瓦尔基里的走狗们！: You have too good an opinion of yourselves, Valkyrie's lackeys!
这是什么！！谁在偷袭我！: What's this? Who's sneakily attacking me?
刚才你说谁是贵客？这里好像并不是你的地盘吧！邪恶的魔女！: Whom did you call honorable guests? I don't think this is your territory! Wicked witch!
你们这些可笑的英灵，总有一天我会亲手毁灭英灵殿！: You ridiculous spirits! One day I'll destroy the Valhalla with my own hands!
这个孩子我就带走了，他可是我等待了很久的贡品！: I'll take this child with me. I've waited for this offering for too long!
人类，我希望通过刚才的事情你能了解到你们除了添乱，什么都做不了！: Human, I hope this lesson today can help you understand that you can do nothing but make trouble!
那个魔女说了那个年轻的魔法师是她的贡品，我想不出意外她是想召唤那个沉睡已久的不死: The witch said the young Mage was her offering. I can't believe she is attempting to summon the asleep Undead demon.
一旦被她得逞，事情就会变得更为麻烦，人类，我们现在就要去追击魔女，你好自为之。: If her plan worked, things would be more complicated. Human, we are to chase the witch. You take care.
真是太不可饶恕了！必须尽快找到魔女救出庞德。: This is unforgivable! Find the witch and save Laurell Weinder!
不过事情也不都是那么糟糕，起码能了解到黑色的战士不是我们的敌人！: Things are not all bad. At least now we know those men in black are not our enemies!
这里充满着魔法的源泉。: This place is full of magic fountains.
是我的错觉吗？我感到有些不对劲。: Is it just my illusion? Something is not right...
那是大批龙类魔物正在转移的结果，我想一定是那个魔女正在进行着什么。: Because a large number of dragon monsters are moving. I bet that witch is doing something...
冒险者，我希望你立刻去调查这一切的原因。: Adventurer, I hope you can help us figure out the cause of this.
冒险者，还有海陆曼将军，雷藏老师已经成功地在古城区域内张开了一个安全的结界。: Adventurer, General Healueman and Master Reyen have successfully formed a safe barrier in Glast Heim.
他们正在里面等待着与你们汇合。: They are waiting for you inside.
很好，我们处理完这里的事情立刻就向古城进军。: Great. We'll head to Glast Heim as soon as we are done here.
冒险者，请尽全力救出那位年轻的魔法师。: Adventurer, please save the young Mage at all costs!
持续的震动让所有人都警惕了起来……: The continued vibration made everybody guarded.
这里怎么会出现那么多血迹，有点奇怪。: Why is there so much blood? Strange.
和刚才一样有很多血迹可是却看不到魔物或者人类的尸体。: Loads of blood stains but no monsters nor human bodies.
这里是希默梅思带走庞德的地方，她到底为什么要带走庞德呢？: This is where Himmelmez took Laurell Weinder away. Why did she take Laurell Weinder?
看来你还是不死心啊，人类！: You just won't give up, human!
为什么抓庞德: Why did she catch Laurell Weinder?
那是因为我需要召唤的“宝贝”需要一个年轻并且富含魔法潜质的身体，没想到你们自己送: Because the baby I'm summoning needs a young body full of magical potentials. I didn't expect you to bring yourselves to my door.
我只需要将他的身体作为容器，就能让召唤而来的黑暗之王接受我的控制，到那个时候这个: I need his body as the container to manipulate the summoned Dark Lord. By that time, all the Yimir Heart Shards on this continent will be mine!
我真的是很想知道你们人类的自信到底从何而来！: I just don't understand where you humans get your confidence!
你这个自寻死路的家伙，就让这里的魔物来陪你玩玩，你就只能眼睁睁的看着你的朋友变成: You are courting death. The monsters here will have some fun with you. And you will watch your friend transform into Death!
人类，我或许可以为你的勇气和毅力点个赞吧。: Human, I kind of like your courage and persistence.
那么这一次我可不会让她再逃跑了。: This time she can't get away!
欧~魔女，嘴硬可没有用的。: Ou! Witch, being firm in speech doesn't help.
为什么如此危险的召唤法阵会出现在这里！: Why is this dangerous restoration array here?
冒险者，庞德由我来救出。: Adventurer, I'll go to Laurell Weinder's rescue.
这里有不属于这个世界的魔力，我将使用相位传送将法阵上的庞德转移走。: The mana here doesn't belong to this world. I'll use the phase teleportation to transfer Laurell Weinder away.
看来你就是大运要找的那个魔女了，看来你树敌很多啊。: You must be the witch Dawin has been looking for. Looks like you've got loads of enemies.
说到这里我还想感谢你，由于你的那些所作所为,我们在这里又交到了新的朋友。: Actually, I should thank you. Thanks to what you did, We've made some new friends here.
怎么样，看到这些刚才还被你拿来作为贡品的地龙，你会有一丝的悔过吗？: How is it? Do you have any regrets seeing this Green Petites that were used as your offerings a while ago?
终于抓到你了，我不会再让你胡作非为了！: Finally got you! I won't let you run amuck anymore!
喔~魔女，看起来你现在的处境有些糟糕啊！: Ah... Witch, Your situation is not very good!
我想你们是有些误会了，你们以为就凭人类的力量就可以阻止我？: I think there must be some misunderstanding. You actually think your human power can stop me?
你们根本不知道什么是力量！: You have no idea what the real strength is!
那个魔法师即使被救走了也是个没有灵魂的空壳，他的灵魂早就被我抽离了身体。: The Mage you've rescued has become a soulless shell. I've sucked his soul out of his body!
没有身体也无所谓，只是不受我控制罢了，我突然觉得这对你们来说也挺好的！哈哈哈哈哈: It doesn't really matter he has a body or not. It won't completely obey me. I just realized it might not be a bad thing for you. Ha-hah!
谁敢召唤黑暗之王！！！！！！！: Who dare calling the Dark Lord?
别管这些恶魔，快去追击刚才的魔女！: Don't waste time on these demons. Chase and attack the witch!
所有人，乘他们还没完全苏醒，赶快离开这里！: Everyone, leave before they fully regain consciousness!
真是千钧一发啊，看到你平安回来我就放心了。: It was a close call... I'm so relieved to see your safe return.
你已经准备好见证加达尔的荣耀了吗？: Are you ready to witness Gadar's glory?
加达尔即将转职成为一个勇敢的弓箭手，作为他的导师，你同意嘛？: Gadar is about to transfer to become a brave archer. As his mentor, do you agree?
这真是太不幸了，原本以为只需要对付女神的使者就够了，现在似乎来了个更大的麻烦。: How unfortunate! I thought we were to deal with the goddess's envoys only. Now there seems a bigger problem...
黑暗之王，真是个古老而又令人厌烦的名字。: The Dark Lord is truly an old yet annoying name!
庞德的灵魂被禁锢在那些恶魔身体中，我们必须想办法把他的灵魂引导回来，不然恐怕庞德: Laurell Weinder's soul is imprisoned inside those demons' body. We must try to guide his soul back or he might never wake up again.
冒险者，请收起你那急躁的表情，我会在前哨站等待你们，解决黑暗之王成了我们最重要的: Adventurer, please put away that impatient face. I'll be waiting for you at the front post. To eliminate the Dark Lord has become our priority.
事情变得更加危险了，请回到普隆德拉将你所见到的一切禀告内务官索玛斯，我们需要王国: Things have become more dangerous. Please return to Prontera and report to Home Secretary Somas in details. We need reinforcements from the kingdom.
黑暗之王吗……这些恶魔总是没完没了的渴求它，伊米尔之心的碎片，到底它是带给我们更: The Dark Lord? demons have an everlasting desire for it. The Yimir Heart Shards... Will they lead to a brighter tomorrow or a disastrous future?
冒险者，这里非常危险请尽快离开！: Adventurer, this place is very dangerous. Leave at once.
渺小的人类，你们根本不知道自己正面对的是多么浩瀚的力量！: Petty Humans, You have no idea how vast a force you are confronting!
噢亲爱的冒险者，我快急晕了，我甚至都没注意到你刚才站在我旁边。: Dear adventurer,  this is freaking me out. I didn't even notice when you got to my side!
不完全，今天可是我的大日子，我有一项重要成果要发表，但是我的助手查尔斯却不见了！: Not really. Today is my big day. I have a very important research achievement to publish but my assistant Charles is missing!
对！我让他去帮我做准备工作，但他到这个时候都没回来，我开始有些担心了。: Yes. I sent him to get things ready but he never returned. I have begun to worry.
你真是个好心的冒险者，那就拜托你帮我找找他吧。: You are such a kind adventurer. Please help me find him!
这里虽然什么都没有，但残断的树枝显示似乎有打斗的痕迹。: There seems nothing but those broken branches indicate a fight not long ago.
还是没有查尔斯的影子，但地上有一块沾满血迹被撕烂的布，散发着不详的气息。: I can't find Charles anywhere but here is a blood stained cloth on the ground, giving out an ill omen.
查尔斯用尽全部力气吐出了最后几个字，便离开了人世。: Charles passed away after squeezing out these few words with all his strength...
你可回来了，找到查尔斯了吗？: You are back! Where is Charles?
什么！！！查尔斯被我研究的变异地龙杀害了！！？？: What? Charles is killed by the Green Petite mutant from my study?
实际上,我是个魔物研究学家，我今天本来想做的重大发表就是关于我的变异地龙佩吉。: Actually, I'm a monster researcher. The great discovery I'm supposed to publish today is about my mutated Green Petite Peggy.
我相信地龙是可以被驯服且为人所用的，所以我培育出了佩吉，但显然它并没有我预期中的: I believe the Green Petites can be tamed to serve humans. Hence, I have created Peggy, who is not as obedient as expected.
我意识到了！真是太可怕了，但我们来不及悲痛了。: I have realized it! How frightening! We don't have time to grieve.
现在首当其冲就是找到暴走的佩吉，不要再让它危害别的冒险者了。: We must find the raging Peggy as soon as possible before it harms other adventurers.
你赶快帮我去通知我的恋人拜尔琳，平时都是她在帮我照顾佩吉，她比较清楚那地龙的习性: Please inform my lover Bayer. She's the one taking care of Peggy every day and she knows that Green Petite very well.
天呐！我就知道会有这么一天！可怜的查尔斯。: My lord! I knew this would happen one day... Poor Charles...
不太好，我劝过连姆不下几次让他停止这危险的研究。但他十分固执，甚至还给那该死的地: Not very good. Many times I asked Liam to stop this dangerous research but he's very stubborn. He's even given the goddamn Green Petite a lovely name Peggy! How ridiculous!
抱歉，我失态了。总之事情刻不容缓，你得尽快找到那头变异地龙才行。: Sorry. I was a bit out of control. We have no time to waste. Find that Green Petite mutant as soon as possible!
冒险者，你可不能单枪匹马的去步查尔斯的后尘，你去之前需要几样东西。: Adventurer, You can't play a lone hand following Charles' footsteps. Prepare yourself before setting out.
我了解这地龙的习性，连姆给它注入的基因让它变得十分狡猾谨慎，容易逃走。: I know this Green Petite's habits. The genes Liam injected it with have made it extremely sneaky and cautious. It turns to run away from dangers.
弄四瓶毕帝特地龙血，然后再回来找我，我告诉你下一步该怎么做。: Get four bottles of Green Petite blood and come back. I'll teach you what to do the next.
冒险者，这速度可真没辜负我对你的期待。: Adventurer, You were fast as I expected.
听好了，接下来的事会非常危险。: Listen. This is about to get very dangerous.
我之前也说了，变异地龙佩吉十分狡猾，所以你必须把收集到的地龙血都泼在自己身上。: As I said before, the mutated Green Petite Peggy is very sneaky. You must pour the Green Petite Blood on yourself.
因为残杀它的同类，是唯一惹怒它让它正面跟你交锋的方式。: Killing his peers is the only way to enrage it and make it confront you.
好了，你现在已经完全准备好了，去吧勇士！期待你的凯旋归来。: Good. Now you are ready. Set off, Warrior. I'll be here waiting for your triumphant return.
我就知道你会战胜那只恶龙的！: I knew you would defeat that wicked dragon!
好景不长啊冒险者！！: Good times don't last long, adventurer!
让我们意想不到的是，佩吉逃走后，在这片丛林里繁衍了变异地龙的后代！: To our surprise, Peggy has reproduced another mutated Green Petite in this forest during her escape.
这事儿可是十万火急，已经有好几个冒险者遇害了，因为我研究的变异地龙比普通地龙要凶: This is urgent. Several adventurers are already killed. The Green Petite mutants from my lab is way stronger than their ordinary peers.
你要是愿意帮我追杀这条变异地龙可就帮大忙了！: I would really appreciate if you could help me kill this mutated Green Petite!
太好了！我就是个研究员，根本没实力控制这些凶猛的动物。: Terrific! I'm a mere researcher with no strength to control these fierce beasts...
听好了，你得先去找老猎手艾迪马森问问情况。: Listen. You should visit the experienced hunter Eddie Marson to get the picture.
根据刚得到的情报，他的猎人队伍遭到变异龙的袭击，他是唯一一个活下来的人，所以他恨: According to the latest intelligence we have received, his hunting crew came under the mutated earth dragon's attack. As the only survivor, He hates me with all his heart. I dare not approach him myself.
什么！你问我那只恶梦一般的变异龙？: What? You are asking me about that nightmare dragon mutant?
我只记得我跟几个猎友正在捕猎地龙，忽然天色大暗，一条闪着诡异光芒的变异地龙朝我们: I remember I was hunting Green Petites with a few friends of mine. All of a sudden, the sky became dark and a mutated Green Petite with an odd glow swooped on us...
虽然那地龙很凶猛，但一开始我们还觉得应对有余呢！: The Green Petite was fierce but we thought we could handle this.
可是后来它一声大吼，引来了一群和它一样发着诡异光的小地龙！！: A pack of glowing baby Green Petites came out upon its thunderous roar!
是的！最后我们的猎人队伍全军覆灭，只有我侥幸逃了出来，真希望那只是一场恶梦。: Yes, our team was wiped out except for me... I wish it was just a bad dream...
那诡异的变异地龙还从嘴里喷出奇怪的液体，以我当猎人多年的经验，它是在标记我。: That strange Green Petite blew out some weird liquid at me. Based on my years of experience as a hunter, he has marked me.
对，这样它就能寻着气味追杀我了！！你帮帮我吧！冒险者。: Yes, so it can follow me by the scent and eventually get me killed. Please help me, adventurer!
问题的关键在于那群小变异地龙身上，不杀死它们，你永远找不到机会对付那只大的。: The problem is those small mutated Green Petites. You won't have chance to deal with the big one unless you have all these babies killed first.
首先你得去丛林里割些藤曼给我。: First of all, get some rattans from the forest for me.
这是用来制作陷阱用的，现在，把这些陷阱都布到我周围去。: I'll use these to make traps. Set up these traps around me.
这布局真不错，你简直像是个身经百战的老猎人，年轻人。: The layout is pretty good, Young man. You are like a highly experienced hunter!
我有预感，他们就在附近！: I can feel they are not far from us.

原来村里的孩子们都在关心着我，我实在是太不成熟了。: The kids in the village are all concerned about me... How immature I am!
实话和你说冒险者，我就是个为爱情所困的可怜人，所以才会这么喝酒度日。: To be honest, adventurer. I'm a poor man trapped in love. This is why I drink all the time.
前不久我外出时，在斐杨树林里搭救了一个晕倒在地的姑娘名叫小玉。: A while ago, I saved a young girl named Jade who passed out in the Payon Forest.
我立刻就被她美丽夺目的姿容迷住了，我们很快就坠入了爱河，我和她约好每天黄昏，在城: I was fascinated by her beauty and soon we fell in love. We agreed to meet at sundown every day in the bamboo forest in the east and she became my strength for work.
可是好景不长，不知怎么的，我的身体越来越虚弱，一日不如一日，还时常咳嗽。: But good times never last long. Somehow I noticed my body became weaker and weaker and I coughed a lot.
终于有一天，我卧床不起，那天的黄昏还下着小雨，我就没有按时赴约。等天色渐渐黑了，: Finally one day, I couldn't even get out of bed. It was rainy at dusk that day and I missed our date. When I dragged myself there in the dark, she was nowhere to be found.
之后我的身体渐渐转好了，可是再去那片树林等，却怎么都等不到她的身影了，她一定是生: After, My body slowly recovered but I couldn't find her anywhere in the forest. She must be mad at me.
我就这样每天借酒消愁，直到现在。冒险者，你能帮我找到她吗，至少让我跟她道个歉。: I began to drown my sorrows in wine every day until now. Adventurer, could you help me find her? At least give me a chance to apologize.
前段时间，我在我们常约会的那片竹林弄丢了本来想送给她的簪子，我还没有酒醒，你能替: A few days ago, I lost a hairpin in the bamboo forest. I planned to give it to her as a present... I'm still tipsy now. Could you help me look for it?
这里模糊的有一些奇怪的脚印..看着并不像是人类的脚印: Here are some vague footprints... I don't think they belong to the human.
这时，旁边的南瓜地传来一阵骚动。: Abruptly, some noise came from the pumpkin field nearby.
天呐！吓死我了！！！吓死我了。: Oh no! So scary! So very scary!
我刚才看到好大一个黑影从我眼前窜了过去，钻进了我的稻田里，不会是黄鼠狼吧！: I saw a huge black shadow dashes right in front of me into my field. Could it be a weasel?
稻田中居然钻出一只全身是伤的小狐狸！嘴里居然叼着李准准备送给小玉的簪子。: A badly wounded little fox came out of the field with Lywight's hairpin for Jade in its mouth.
冒险者，你别害怕，你能帮帮我吗。: Adventurer, please don't be scared. Could you do me a favor?
我知道你现在很惊讶，但其实我就是你要找到小玉。你和李准的对话我都听到了。: I know you must be surprised but I'm the Jade you are looking for... I heard your conversation with Lywight.
我现在非常虚弱，虚弱到没有办法变回人形，再这样下去，我会魂飞魄散的。: I'm so weak at this moment that I can take my human form... If this continues, My spirits will fly away.
帮我去斐扬树林的鬼火身上取一些生魂，至少能让我稍微恢复一些。: Please get some souls from the Horong in the Payon Forest to help me recover a little bit.
谢谢你冒险者，我感觉稍微好一点了。: Thank you, adventurer. I feel much better now.
抱歉冒险者，给你添麻烦了。但我现在还是太虚弱，不能变回人形。: Sorry to trouble you, adventurer. I'm still to weak to take my human form.
生魂只是让我恢复了一些体力，斐扬树林里荷花池的水能净化我身上的魔性，才能使我变回: The souls only helped me regain some vigor. The water from the lily pond in the Payon Forest can help purify the devil attribute in me. Then I should be able to transform into a human.
冒险者，你救了我的命，小玉无以回报。: Adventurer, You have saved my life. Jade can never thank you enough.
说来惭愧，我就是只葬身在斐扬树林恶熊掌下的小狐狸，怨念难消，通过收集树林里的鬼火: How embarrasing! I was just a poor little fox killed by a wicked bear in the Payon Forest. My grudge and resentment couldn't dissipate so I started to gather souls from the Horong and gradually became a fox spirit.
对，之后我便不再满足与鬼火的生魂，打起了斐扬村民的主意。人类的灵魂一定能够让我更: Then the souls of the Horong couldn't satisfy me any longer. I turned my head to villagers in Payon. Souls of the human can certainly make me stronger.
是的，我第一个遇到的人类便是李准，我们每天约在黄昏详见，我就每天偷走一些他的魂魄: Yes, the very first human I met was Lywight. Every sundown I stole some of his soul when we met.
李准也变的越来越虚弱，而我变得越来越强壮。可是我发现，我已经在不知不觉中对他产生: Lywight became weaker and weaker while I felt stronger and stronger. However, I realized I have developed true feelings about him. I couldn't harm him more.
所以我打算不再见李准了，并把他的大部分魂魄还给了他。: So I decided to never see Lywight again and returned most of his soul to him.
请你把这枚簪子还给他吧，让他忘了我。: Please give this hairpin back to him and tell him to forget about me.
小玉真的是只狐妖吗？难怪她身上总是散发着一种人类没有的气质。: Jade is a fox spirit? No wonder she always bears a special air that doesn't belong to humans.
但是我没打算放弃她，即使消磨我的生命，我也想和她在一起。: I won't give up on her! I want to be together with her even if that means the loss of my own life.
请你帮我转告她，我会在我们初次相遇的地方等她。: Please tell her I'll be waiting for her at where we first met.
天呐，李准他一个人去了斐扬树林？: My goodness! Lywight has left for the Payon Forest alone?
这太危险了，我们得尽快找到他才行。: This is too dangerous. We must find him quickly!
不远处，听到一阵熊的嘶吼声: Bear's roars came from not too far away.
天呐，这是当年杀死我的那只恶熊！！: Lord! This is the bear that killed me years ago!
小玉你还是来见我了，我太高兴了。: Jade, I'm so glad to see you again!
明明知道越是见面，越会使你痛苦，你为什么还这么执着。: You know the more we meet, the harder it will be. Why don't you give up?
嗯，一切我都听这位冒险者说了。: Hmm... The adventurer has told me everything.
因为我不想让你一个人！！: Because I don't want you to be alone!
小玉用尾巴一扫，一阵迷雾飘过，雾散开时李准已经在小玉身旁睡着了。: Jade flipped her tail and a puff of mist passed. When the fog cleared, Lywight fell asleep by Jade.
冒险者，谢谢你替我复了仇，我的怨气已经消了，是该走的时候了。: Adventurer, thank you for taking revenge for me. My grudge is not gone. It's time to leave.
只要我还在一天，我就不能完全将魂魄还给他，所以我希望你帮我最后一个忙。: As long as I'm still in this world, I can't give back all of his soul. I hope you can do me one last favor.
用将军魔碑身上掉落的石木，制成锋利的箭，刺穿我的心脏，我就能把魂魄全部还给李准了: Make an arrow out of the stone from the Greatest General and pierce it through my heart. This way I can give Lywight all of his soul.
我已经把李准送回斐扬城了，是时候了冒险者。: I've sent Lywight back to the city of Payon. This is time, adventurer.
好了，现在用这只石箭让我解脱吧。: Please use this stone arrow to set me free.
不后悔，能让李准好好的活下去，是我最大的心愿，希望他有一天能遇到他命中注定的姑娘: I won't. I want Lywight to live on with his own life. This is my biggest dream. I hope one day he will meet his destined lady.
石箭穿透小玉轻盈的身躯，发出耀眼的光芒，能看到小玉的身体一点一点的在消失。: The stone arrow pierced through Jade's body and a dazzling beam of light shot out. Jade's body gradually vanished...
小玉带着幸福的笑容，消失在空气中。留下一簇闪闪发光的狐尾毛飘落在手中。: Jade vanished in the air with a blessed smile, leaving a glowing fox tail in his hand.
Does Jade want me to have this?
为什么她要选择消失?: Why did she choose to leave?
你说的可能没错，她只是做出了选择而已。: You are right. She made her choice.
说完这句，李准放声痛哭，斐扬城从此多了一段凄美的爱情故事。: Lywight cried out loud. A sad yet beautiful love story ended in the city of Payon.
一阵耀眼的强光后，一位清秀妙曼的身影出现在眼前。: A dazzling beam of light was followed by a delicate, graceful figure.
胆小？嘿，在这种地方，谁的胆子不小？传闻这里有着鬼怪出现，如果你曾经遇到过…: Coward? Hey! Who can be brave in this place? Ghosts are said to linger around here... If you once met a...
当…当然！如果不是因为杂志社丰厚的报酬，我早就离开这个鬼地方了！: Of course! I would have left this place long ago if the periodical office didn't make me such a sweet offer.
猜猜，这里为什么会有建筑？这里为什么会有鬼怪？: Take a guess. Why is there a building here? Why are there ghosts here?
哈！你一定猜不到！这里可是传说中的月之国！: Ha! I knew you can't get it. This is the fabled Kingdom of Moon.
没听过吧？嘿…他们侍奉月之女神，月神是他们唯一的信仰。: You never heard about it, did you? Ha... Here we worship the Moon Goddess. She's our only belief.
而伟大的月神也对这个国度关爱有加，她甚至派出了自己的守护者——一只带着巨大铃铛的: The great Moon God adores and blesses this land. She has even sent her own guardian, a cat wearing a huge bell, To protect this kingdom.
我们称之为月夜猫的传说中的魔物，就曾是这个国家的守护者！: The legendary monster called Moonlight Flower was once the guardian of this kingdom!
听说每当夜到来之时，灵猫会准时出现在城市中心高大的祭坛顶，对着月亮默默祈祷。: Every night the holy cat was said to appear on top of the altar in the center of the city to pray to the moon.
当然是那些鬼怪告诉我的！我本以为遇到一个善良的鬼魂呢，谁知道刚说完她就要吃了我。: A ghost told me. I thought I met a kind ghost but she wanted to eat me as soon as she finished the story.
如果不是我机灵，用闪光灯照了一下他，恐怕我…: If I didn't smartly turn on my flashlight to her eyes, I would have been dead...
再拍两组照片我就走！这种鬼地方我再也不想来了！: I'll take two more photos. I don't want to come back ever again!
这种风格的建筑…似乎从来没见过呢…: A building of this style... I don't think I've ever seen anything similar.
当然古怪！你看这斑驳的时钟，错落有致的石质台阶，当然还有木头门柱！: Very! Look at that mottled clock, the well-proportioned stone stairs, and the wooden columns.
这种建筑，你在其他地方看的到吗？: Have you seen it anywhere else?
作为历史研究员，我对这些非常感兴趣。: As a historical researcher, I'm very interested in this kind of stuff.
破坏的城墙，死去的树木，以及正在修建的祭台，种种迹象都在告诉我们一件事！这座城市: Broken city walls, Dead trees, and the half built altar are telling us one thing! This city sank into the ground over one night.
而根据我对这里找到的古物年份的观察，这座城市至少被埋入地下至少五百年以上！: According to my brief observation of these ancient objects here, I believe the city has been buried for at least five centuries.
很惊人，不是吗？这是天灾吗？还是人祸？如果是人祸…想要把整个城市移近地底，这样的: Shocking, right? Was it a natural calamity? If it was a man-made misfortune... How powerful he must be to bury an entire city! He is pretty much a god!
这里充斥这九尾狐以及土人这两种奇怪的魔物，加上传闻的鬼怪之谈，这里一定隐藏着巨大: This place is full of Nine Tails and Dokebis. Plus the rumors about ghosts... There must be some secret hidden here!
我不知道，但是终有一天，我会把这里的历史完完整整的还原出来！: I don't know yet but one day I'll restore the entire history completely!
可能无法感受到，但是对于一个魔法师来说，这里紊乱的魔力流动实在令人太不愉快了！: You might not be able to sense it. But for a Mage, These chaotic magical waves are very disturbing.
吉芬图书馆有一本古籍中曾经提到，诸神之战以始祖巨人伊米尔战败而告终，他的身体四分: An ancient book in the Geffen Library mentioned that the War of Gods ended with the defeat of Yimir the ancestor of all giants. His body fell apart and the parts were scattered all over the world.
而这里恰恰是伊米尔之心坠落的地点！: And this is where Yimir's heart landed.
嗯？你是在怀疑我么？这里紊乱的魔力还不能说明一切吗？: Hmm? Are you questioning me? Isn't this chaotic mana a convincing proof?
只有伊米尔之心才能让魔力紊乱到这种程度，毕竟巨人的力量区别于诸神魔法的力量。: Only the Yimir Heart can mess mana to this degree. The gians' power is different from the gods'.
根据我的猜测，承载着始祖巨人力量的心脏碎片，落在了这片安宁的城市当中。: I guess the heart Shard bearing the giant ancestor's strength fell on this peaceful city.
我不知道发生了什么，这里似乎没有被伊米尔之心正面冲撞到，否则这里早就化为焦土了。: I don't know what happened but there's no sign of a frontal collision from the Yimir Heart or this land would be burnt.
我还在这里寻找伊米尔之心的踪迹，如果被心术不正的人找到，那不知道就会引起什么样的: I'm still here looking for the Yimir Heart. If a wicked hand finds it, the consequences would be unpredictable.
曾经繁荣之极的月之国沦落到这种地步，难道不是可悲的事情吗？: Isn't it unfortunate that the once flourishing Kingdom of Moon has declined to this?
这座城市还保存着月之国当初的建筑风格，如果不是当初的月之守护者，恐怕这里什么都不: This city maintains the construction style of the Kingdom of Moon. I'm afraid nothing would stand here if the Guardian of Moon was not here.
没错，就是曾经月神的守护者，她保护着这里不被破坏。: Right! It must be the guardian of the Moon Goddess who's been protecting this place.
无论是谁，终究有守护不了的东西，月之守护者也一样。: There is always something we can't protect, even if you are the guarding of moon.
九尾狐与土人的出现打破了这里人们的美好期望。无数月之国民众被袭击，月之守护者不能: The Nine Tails and Dokebis' presence disturbed the local people's aspiration. Loads of citizens of the Kingdom of Moon were assaulted. And the Guardian of Moon was unable to offer them protection.
也许是保护这里的代价太过高昂，月之守护者一直处于一种沉眠的状态。: Maybe protecting this land is too exhausting. The guardian of moon has been asleep for a long time.
据说在不知名的力量影响下，月之守护者也逐渐迷失了自己。: Influenced by an unknown force, the guardian of moon slowly lost herself.
这里也就变成了现在这番模样。哭泣的鬼魂啊！你为何不肯离去？这里还有什么留恋吗？: And this place became like this. O the crying ghosts, why don't you leave? What can't you let go of?
我只有有感而发…这凄凉美丽的传说，我一定要写一篇诗章，赞美月之守护者！: I was just being sentimental... For this sad yet beautiful story I must compose a poem to praise the guardian of moon.
冒险者？天啊！冒险者竟然可以深入到这种地方来了吗？: Adventurer? My lord! An adventurer has made it this far?
当然奇怪！自从我们智家被那些不死人淹没之后，我已经许久没见过外界的人啦！: Of course! Ever since our house of Wisdom was devoured by those undead, I've never seen an outsider.
在妖君入侵之时，我就担心智家会抵挡不住，所以我早一步来到了这里，希望能找到昔日帮: When the Hyegun invaded, I was worried the house of wisdom might not survive. I came here early in hopes of finding the mysterious man who once helped the house of wisdom.
可是我在这里呆了很久，也没有找到，我想返回智家，却发现智家已经…: But I've been here for quite some time but still got no luck. I'd love to return to the house of wisdom but the house has been...
我们智家曾经流传着这样一个传说，妖君第一次入侵之时，曾经有位神秘任务帮了我们，消: There is a legend passed down in the house of wisdom that a mysterious man helped us during the Hyegun's first invasion and killed the Hyegun.
我听家里老人说过，这位神秘人物与妖君是老对头了，两人曾经数次交手，结果当然是神秘: An elderly in the house told me this mysterious man has been an old enemy of the Hyegun. They fought each other many times and the mysterious man always won.
妖君也被他封印，进攻我们智家的，只是那妖君小小的分身而已。: Hyegun has been sealed by him. The one that invaded the house of wisdom was just a clone of the Hyegun.
所以我才来到这里。现在的我只想尽快找到那位神秘的人物，为我智家报仇！: That's why I'm here. I just want to find the mysterious man to take revenge for the house of wisdom!
哦，天啊！该死的！一定是奔跑时弄丢了…: Oh! My lord! Damn it! I must have lost it on the way.
你应该知道这里有着鬼怪的传说，就在刚刚我遇到了一簇奇怪的鬼火。: You must know this place is haunted. I just encountered a strange cluster of Horong.
看到鬼火的那一瞬间，我吓坏了！但是这簇鬼火并没有袭击我。: I was startled when I first noticed the Horong. Fortunately, it didn't attack me.
反而围着我的身体旋转，但是我感觉我的身体在发烫，像是要燃烧了一样。: Instead, it spinned around me. My body was hot like fire.
我感觉到不对劲，立马撒腿狂奔，一直跑到这里，那鬼火也没跟来。: I felt something was wrong and made off at once until here. The Horong did follow.
我再也不敢去那里了…可是刚刚我发现，我曾经在这里发现了一个古物丢失了！: I dare not go back there but I lost an ancient object...
那是一把精钢匕首！我敢说，它至少拥有五百年历史！你能帮我回去找找看吗？: A steel dagger! I can tell you it is at least five hundred years old! Could you look for it for me?
…奇怪的鬼火…奇怪的墓碑…不过这里也没有匕首…: ... Strange Horong... Strange tombstones... But no dagger...
…你…杀了…父亲…你杀了父亲！: ... You... Killed... Father... You killed father!
精钢匕首…是我父亲的物品…那天我看着父亲离开了家门，就带着这把匕首！: Steel Dagger... My father's... I saw father leave with the dagger!
父亲的身躯就在这里…一定是你杀了父亲！: Father's body is here... You killed father.
冒险者，找到我的匕首了吗？…是那簇鬼火！冒险者！快赶走他！: Adventurer, have you found my dagger? That Horong! Adventurer! Drive it away!
这把匕首是这个鬼火生前父亲的？可是…我是遇到的一个鬼女才拿到的啊。: This dagger belonged to the Horong's Dead father? But... I got it from a Sohee...
我记得…好像是叫金恩…的吧？就在不久前，我在中央的祭坛出遇到了她。: I remember... Her name is Kingen... Not long ago, I met her at the central altar.
冒险者，你现在去找她应该还来得及…也许他知道些什么…: Adventurer, You should be able to find her if you set out now. Maybe she knows something...
金尚…我的儿子…你到底在哪里？: Kinsun... My boy... Where are you?
这是…这是我丈夫卡勒的东西…这不是被我送给了贝鲁特吗？: This is... My husband Kavac's dagger... Didn't I give it to Beirut?
快带我看看那个无名鬼火…也许他就是我失踪的儿子小金尚！: Take me to the nameless Horong... Maybe he's my lost little son Kinsun!
我遇到了一簇鬼火，在这火焰中，我忘记了自己还在等待归来的母亲和父亲。: I met a cluster of Horong. In the fire, I forgot I was waiting for my parents to come back.
我也忘记了饥饿，迷失在跳动的火焰中，火焰燃烧着我的身躯，但是我感觉不任何疼痛。: I forgot about hunger and lost in the dancing flame... The fire burnt my body but I didn't feel pain...
当我清醒的时候，我就成了一团鬼火的模样。: When I woke up, I became a cluster of Horong...
能见到你就好…跟我离开吧…谢谢…这精钢匕首就作为谢礼送给贝鲁特吧。: See good to see you... Come with me... Give this steel dagger to Beirut as a present of gratitude.
哈，你回来了？怎么样？找到金恩了吗？: Ha! You are back! How was it? Did you find Kingen?
原来是这样，能有个完美结局真是太好了…嘿嘿，这精钢匕首能值不少钱呢！: I see... I'm happy for the perfect ending... Heheh. This steel dagger must be worth a fortune.
不过我打算留着它，算是邂逅他们的纪念吧！: I decide to keep it as a token for their reunion.
…还不是那些鬼东西！我在这里呆了也算不短的时间了。该见识的，我也见识过了。: ... Because of those ghosts... I've been here long enough and I've seen pretty much everything.
可是！你绝对想不到，在我拍摄古旧的建筑时，发现了更加凶猛的鬼女！: However, You won't believe this. When I was filming an ancient building, I saw a much fiercer Sohee!
她注意到了我镜头，直接向我扑过来…如果不是我跑的快…: She noticed my camera and threw herself at me... If I ran a bit slower...
这些凶悍的鬼影害得我不能安心工作了，妻子和孩子可就指着我的工资活呢！: These furious ghosts distract me from my work. I must provide for my wife and children with this salary.
说起来…这种鬼女还有一个奇怪的地方…我的双眼无法看到他们。: In fact, this kind of Sohee is quite special... I can't see them with my own eyes.
我的意思是…她只出现在了我照相机镜头内，可能跟我来之前学的幽灵相机有关…: I mean she only appeared in my camera... It might have something to do with the Phantom Camera I studied a while ago.
如果冒险者你学了幽灵相机就会很容易地找到他们。: Adventurer, If you can master the Phantom Camera, You will be able to find them easily.
你赶走那些鬼女了吗？: Did you drive those Sohees away?
这真是…太棒了！冒险者，我一定要把你的故事写到国家地理杂志上！: This is terrific! Adventurer, I will write your story in the Midgarts Geographic!
我曾经在这里遇到一个叫做金恩的鬼女，她给予了对我来说最为珍贵的礼物，那就是精钢匕: I chanced upon a Sohee named Kingen around here and she gifted me a very precious present, a steel dagger. I'd like to tell you her story. Are you interested?
金恩原本就是月之国的子民，在月之国遭逢大变，进入地下之后，金恩的丈夫不得不为了自: Kingen was originally a citizen of the Kingdom of Moon. When her country experienced a sudden change and completely sank into the ground, Kingen's husband had to leave home to search for food for his loved ones.
金恩把家中唯一还算是值钱的精钢匕首给了卡勒，希望这个经过月神洗礼的匕首能够带给他: Kingen gave Kavac the only valuable thing in the house, that steel dagger, hoping this blessed dagger could bring good fortune to him.
可是几天过去了，金恩苦等，却始终不能等到丈夫回来，眼看着存粮渐渐减少，无奈之下，: Several days passed but Kingen's husband didn't return. Their stored up grains were running very low and Kingen had to set out to look for her husband and anything that could fill their stomach.
金恩穿过中心的祭台，往城外走去。运气不错，她找到了一些阴凉的蘑菇，他的儿子小金尚: Kingen travelled through the central altar towards outside of the city. She was lucky enough to find some dried mushroom. Her little son Kinsun could finally have some delicious mushroom soup.
不久后，她依稀见到远处躺着一个熟悉的人，她奔跑过去，只看到了一张被利爪破坏得面目: Soon after, she saw a familiar figure lying on the ground in a distance. She ran over and discovered a human with a ton of scratches from some sharp claws, beyond recognition.
在他身上，她找到了一把精钢匕首。想到小金尚还在家等着她煮美味的蘑菇汤，她忍痛埋葬: She found the steel dagger on him. Thinking about her little Kinsun waiting for her mushroom soup, she buried that body, Bearing the pain, And started her return trip.
金恩回家后看到小金尚不见了，四处寻找未果后，食用了蘑菇，而这蘑菇竟然是有毒的鬼母: When Kingen reached home, little Kinsun was not there! She looked and looked but he was nowhere to be found. She consumed the mushroom which was actually the poisonous Hariti Mushroom.
她成为鬼女整日游荡，寻找着她失踪的孩子。: She became a Sohee, wandering about in search of her lost child.
而她的儿子，小金尚在家等候父母的时候，看到了一团幽蓝的火焰。: And her son Kinsun saw a blue cluster of fire during his wait for his parents' return.
小金尚好奇地看着这团火焰，他忘记了自己还在等待归来的母亲和父亲，忘记了饥饿，他迷: Out of curiosity, Little Kinsun gazed at the fire. He forgot he was waiting for his parents. He forgot hunger. He lost himself in it. The fire burnt his body but he didn't feel any pain.
最终，他自己变成了一团幽蓝的火焰，看上去壮大了一些。: In the end, he became a ghostly blue cluster of fire, bigger and stronger.
跳动的火焰，欢笑着，游荡在空寂的残城之中，放佛在寻找下一个迷失的人类。: The dancing flame was laughing and wandering in the empty broken city, looking for the next lost soul.
不过在好心的冒险者的帮助下，金恩总算找回了他的儿子，而我，也得到了金恩的馈赠。: Thanks to a kindhearted adventurer, Kingen found her son and I received a gift from Kingen.
喏，就是这把匕首。我一定会好好珍惜这把匕首的。: This is the dagger. I'll take very good care of it.
你带来足够的莫拉币了吗？: Have you brought enough Mora coins?
该…该死！下次给我多少钱我都不会来这个鬼地方了！: Damn it! I won't come back no matter how much you pay!
唔…这些古迹掩盖着多少秘密啊…: Hmm... How many secrets are buried in these ancient ruins?
这里确实不太适合修习魔法呢…我要赶紧完成任务，然后返回吉芬！: This is not a suitable place for mana training... I must complete the mission quickly and return to Geffen!
阴暗、潮湿，充满鬼神怪谈的地方，真是让我迷醉啊~~~: Dark, Humit, and full of supernatural tales... How fascinating!
嘿…冒险者，你知道吗？就算是鬼怪，也是拥有感情的哦！: Hey! Adventurer, do you know? Even ghosts have feelings.
你有变傻光线枪吗？: Do you have a Fooling Laser Gun?
喂！喂！可别拿着什么奇怪的东西指着我。: Hey! Hey! Don't you point at me with this odd item!
总感觉有人在找我……: I feel someone is looking for me.
你的把戏一点都不合我的心意……: Your tricks are not my cup of tea.
欧！世界突然变大了！: Oh! The world has suddenly got bigger!
这不是变胖！这是变强！: This is not getting fatter but becoming stronger!
感觉……还差一点: I feel it's not yet the best...
我的体型还有所欠缺！: My body shape can be better!
离我想要的，还差一点！: One step away from my dream!
快了！就快要突破了！: Almost! Soon I can break through!
渺小的人类！感受面具恐惧吧！: Weak humans! Enjoy the masked fear!
我要揍扁你们！猥琐的人类！: I'll kick your ass! Pervert humans!
刚才那个一直射我的人类，我要敲扁你的头！: The human who shot me earlier, I'll smash your head!
既然变大了我，就要对我负责！: Since I'm already bigger, I must be responsible for myself.
我是不是开始学会控制我的新力量了？: Can I control my new power now?
谁？谁还敢叫我小不点？: Who? Who called my the little guy?
你在打量我怀里的宝贝？！: Are you eyeing the treasure in my chest?
看上去你已经开始好怕我了！: You look very scared of me already.
我只是……有点不习惯。: I'm just not used to this...
那么，冒险者，你知道变傻光线枪吗？: So, adventurer! Do you know the Fooling Laser Gun?
对！我好不容易听完了那些该死的故事，从吟游诗人那拿到了变傻光线枪。: Yes! Thank lord I finally finished all his goddamn stories and the Poet gave me this Fooling Laser Gun.
可没想到一到这里就被该死的哥布灵抢走了。: Those bloody Goblins took it from me as soon as I got here!
不过我发现了一件很可怕的事情！: I have noticed a horrible thing!
一些特殊的哥布灵被光线枪照射到后，竟然变成了更强大的魔物！这样下去过不了多久，整: Some special Goblins have become stronger in the laser. Soon this Goblin Forest will have nothing left but bandits who want the laser gun!
那群家伙虽然看上去跟普通的哥布灵没两样，但是总喜欢[c][ffff00]嚷嚷的不: They look just like their ordinary peers but they love to [c][ffff00]make a constant row[-][/c]. You should be able to find them following this line.
欧~看的出来，它们已经获得教训了，谢谢你冒险者！: Hmm... I can tell they've learnt their lessons. Thank you, adventurer!
看这宏伟的古城，沧桑的过去掩埋了多少故事，年轻的冒险者哟，你想听听古城的故事吗？: Look at this grand Glast Heim! How many stories have been buried in the vicissitudes. Young adventurer, would you like to hear some tales about Glast Heim?
你想听听古城的往事吗？作为吟游诗人协会的高级理事，我的要价可不低哦~: Would you like to hear the past of Glast Heim? As a senior member of the minstrels' Guild, My price is fairly high.
{我仍然想听,2},{我有空再听吧,1}: {I'm still interested,2},{I don't have time for this now,1}
那么请先回答我几个小小的问题吧！我可不想我们诗人讲述的故事那么快被世人遗忘。: Please answer a few question for me first. I don't want the storied told by us Poets to be forgotten too soon.
听起来你很自信。那么请回答我第一个问题！: You sound very confident. Question one.
普隆德拉的铁匠忽克连的师傅是谁呢？: Who is the master of Hollgrehenn the blacksmith in Prontera?
嘿嘿，那么回答我第二个问答吧！在艾勒梅斯的故事中，艾勒梅斯的父亲陷入了哪个魔物的: Heheh. Now comes the second question. In Eremes' story, which monster gained control over Eremes' father?
最后一个问题，在索罗·图克的故事中，索罗·图克的妻子叫什么名字？: One last question. In Solo Took's story, what's the name of Solo Took's wife?
看来你已经对我们传唱的故事了若指掌了呢。: Looks like you are pretty familiar with our stories.
看来你对我们吟游诗人传唱的故事并不是很了解呢，你还是了解了解再来找我吧。: I don't think you know much about we minstrels' stories. Learn some more and come back.
那么接下来，我就好好讲述一下黑暗降临的故事。: Now let's talk about the dark shadow's befalling.
暴君休密兹在曾经被巨人族与诸神大战中毁灭的遗址上建立了克雷斯特汉姆。: Humizz the tyrant once built Glast Heim on top of the ruins created during the battle between the giants and the gods.
他开始拓展国外版图 并将王宫内许多人士赶出宫外，把自己身边马屁精们奉为自己的心腹: He began to expand his territory and kicked many officials out of the palace. The subservient were favored and trusted.
他在首都附近盖了一作名为‘竞技场’的综合斗技场 将冒险家们虐杀魔族们的画面公开呈: He constructed an integrated arena near the capital and named it the Colosseo. Adventurers were paid to torture and kill monsters in public to please the people.
休密兹的威望越来越高最后掌握了无所不为的大权。随著王宫改建的开始，他花税金如流水: Humizz's prestige was increasing and eventually he gained full control of everything. The reconstruction of the palace began and he spent the tax revenue lavishly as if it were water. After a series of parties and events, the palace finances became strained.
在得知了自己的身世的情况下，休密兹对欺骗他们的人们展开血腥复仇。: After learning about his birth, Humizz launched a campaign of revenge on those who once lied to him.
历代都会产生国王的名门王族，赖贝布勒克家族，因为被休密兹的肃清行动而牺牲或逃亡国: The aristocratic clan of Rabebrack with kings and lords in each generation was completely wiped out during Humizz's full-scale purge.
休密兹为了恢复与中兴巴特家族的名声，不顾他人眼光调整了人事，甚至还不够，还改变了: To restore the Bart house's reputation, Humizz adjusted personnel despite all the objections. Moreover, he changed the requirements for the heir to the throne
休密兹在新城中完全和外界断绝联络，每天只顾著享乐与游戏，花费大笔的税金，这些税金: Humizz cut off all ties with the outside world and indulged himself in games and pleasure. He continued to be profuse with the tax money, which was paid by the people and the adventurers.
休密兹在晚年甚至借助魔族的力量想要长生不老，大肆绑架人民以供祭祀。: In his late years, Humizz attempted to reach immortality through the demon's power. He kidnapped a large number of commoners and provided them as offerings.
他的所作所为引起了他的表弟可雷霍尔伦·冯·吉奥布罗克的强烈不满。: His behaviors stirred up intense feelings of dissatisfaction in his younger cousin Rehorlen von Gilbrock.
可雷霍尔伦·冯·吉奥布罗克打著驱逐暴君的口号集结了武装叛军。于各地势如破竹击败王: Rehorlen von Gilbrock gathered troops and staged a rebel to overthrow the tyrant. His forces defeated the royal army across the country and eventually surrounded the new city of Glast Heim.
说到这里，我怀疑古城中的恶魔女仆和恶魔侍者就是休密兹招来的恶魔。: I suspect those Succubuses and Incubuses in Glast Heim were summoned by Humizz.
所以我希望你能够从他们身上收集一些恶魔之心。: I hope you can gather some Devil Hearts from them.
如果能证实与休密兹有关，嘿嘿，那么我们吟游诗人又有新的故事可以传唱了。: If we can prove Humizz had something to do with this, we minstrels will have a new story to sing and spread.
嘿，干得好冒险者，不过现在不是研究的时候，我得讲完我的故事。: Hey! Well done, adventurer. However, this is not time for research yet. I must finish my story.
然而灾难的征兆已经逐渐呈现，休密兹多年来为了追求幻魔仪式与长生不老的肉体，使他达: Signs of a calamity began to show. Humizz pursued the phantom ceremony and an immortal body for years and finally signed a contract with demons.
在反叛军濒临城下之时，惊慌的休密兹通过仪式联系到了魔族。: The rebel forces were at the city gate. Humizz, Panic-stricken, contacted the demons.
休密兹招来的一群由魔族们所组成的魔军，向反叛军发起反击。: Humizz summoned a troop of demons and launched a counterattack on the rebels.
虽然牺牲惨烈，可雷霍尔伦领导的叛军还是攻占了克雷斯特汉姆新城。: Lots of lives were lost in the battle. In the end, Rehorlen and his followers occupied the new city of Glast Heim.
当休密兹被叛军逮捕时已经不成人形了。这就是休密兹多年来为了追求幻魔仪式与长生不老: When Humizz was arrested, he was no longer in the human form. Years of pursuit of the phantom ceremony and immortality cost him everything he had.
可雷霍尔伦对休密兹所在的古城深恶痛绝，他清理了一波又一波黑暗魔物。: Rehorlen was so disgusted by the city of Glast Heim. He again and again eliminated monsters.
直到古城再也见不到一只黑暗生物为止，休密兹被囚禁在克雷斯特汉姆新城的塔顶。: Until not a single dark creature was left in Glast Heim. Humizz was imprisoned on the top floor of the tower in the new city of Glast Heim.
可雷霍尔伦搬离了克雷斯特汉姆新城，重返普隆德拉王宫，同时重新宣告普隆德拉为卢恩—: Rehorlen left the new city of Glast Heim for his palace in Prontera and announced Prontera to be the new capital of the Kingdom of Rune Midgarts.
在休密兹被监进小房间几个月之后的某天，负责监视休密兹的警卫队长在巡房之际居然发现: Several months into Humizz's imprisonment, the head of guards in charge of watching Humizz discovered Humizz's disappearance from the cell.
经过上上下下缜密的搜查之后，终于是藉由某种无法言喻的魔之力量躲进了软禁房中的镜子: They searched the place thoroughly and finally found him inside the mirror in the cell thanks to some unspeakable magic power.
好了冒险者，是收取报酬的时候了。我需要一些深渊花，你能帮我找来吗？: Adventurer, it's time to claim my payment. Could you get me some Abyss Flowers?
冒险者，这深渊花的数量不对啊，作为报酬可是不太够呢，你还是再找一些来吧。: Adventurer, I don't think you have enough Abyss Flowers to pay me. Get some more and come back.
离开了古城的可雷霍尔伦却不知道，他所消灭的黑暗魔物，在一股不知名的力量下汇聚在了: Away from Glast Heim, Rehorlen was unaware of the gathering of those dark monsters under some unknown force.
那些肮脏的魔物组成了一个新的魔物——黑暗之王！: Those nasty evil creatures formed a new demon, the Dark Lord!
黑暗之王袭击了看守古城的警卫队，并且封锁了古城。: The Dark Lord assaulted the guards in Glast Heim and blocked the city.
普隆德拉再也收不到古城一丝一毫的消息，派去的探索人员也都毫无声息的消失了。: Prontera stopped receiving any news from Glast Heim. Envoys sent to fetch information never returned.
好了冒险者，故事也快进入尾声了，如果不介意，来猜个拳吧！: Adventurer, we've come to the ending part of the story. Let's play a game if you don't mind.
试试你的手气~，赢了我你可是能得到不少奖励的哦~: Try your luck. If you win, You'll be rewarded handsomely.
那么，现在开始吧！三！二！一！出拳！: Let's start. Three, Two, and one!
嘿，我就说嘛，在这里没有人能在猜拳上胜我！: Hey! I knew no one could beat me in this finger game!
哎呀！真是不走运，让你赢了一局，不过，下次你就没这么好的运气了。好吧，冒险者，和: Ouch... How unlucky! You got this one but it won't happen again. Adventurer, it's been a pleasure.
平局啊…不行，怎么说你也得赢我一把才行…: A tie... No way. You must win at least one round.
好吧，既然你赢了，我就讲完这个故事吧。: Okay. Since you won the game, I'll finish the story.
古城已经沦入了黑暗之王的领地，在黑暗之王的统治之下，古城成为了有名的险地。: Glast Heim fell in the Dark Lord's hand. Under his dark reign, the city became an infamous place of dangers and misfortunes.
无数冒险者想深入其中寻找黑暗之王的踪迹，想净化古城中的暗黑。: Countless adventurers attempted to sneak in to search for the Dark Lord's traces and purify the city of Glast Heim.
但是他们都铩羽而归，直到施密特国王横空出世，几经战斗击败了黑暗之王。: But none of them succeeded until King Schmidt came out. After many fierce battles, he finally defeated the Dark Lord.
施密特王在古城旧址上，再次新建古城，当然，这就是另外一个故事了。: King Schmidt again rebuilt Glast Heim on its ruins. And then it will be a different story.
我曾有幸看到过卢恩王国的史书，加上我道听途说的传说，编织成这样一个故事。希望来听: I was fortunate enough to get to read a historical book of the Rune Kingdom. Plus all the rumors and legends I have heard over the years. I put everything together and came up with this story. I hope you like it.
至于历史的真相如何，那我就无能为力了。: When it comes to the truth in history, There's not much we can do.
好了，冒险者，该说再见了。如果想听故事，记得回来找我！: Okay, adventurer, it's time to say goodbye. Visit me if you want to hear more stories.
我们是来自猫猫岛的猫猫佣兵团，有老板需要雇佣我们吗？: We are the Kitty Mercenary Regiment from the Kitty Isle. Does anyone want to hire us?
本喵作战能力一流，意识超前，对雇主忠心耿耿！这位老板，你需要佣兵吗？: I'm very capable on the battlefield with a sharp sense and extreme loyalty. This boss, do you need a mercenary?
咦，你好像并没有获得雇佣资格证呢。恐怕我无法为您提供服务了。: Hmm? You don't have the certificate for hiring mercenaries. I don't think I can serve you.
雇佣资格证。简而言之，就是通过了我们猫猫岛成员的考核，得到了我们认可的人，我们才: The certificate for hiring. In short, You must pass tests of the members of the Kitty Isle and earn our approval. Before that, We can't serve you.
虽然麻烦，但是可不是谁都能得到我们的服务呢。: It's troublesome but we don't serve everyone.
老板要不要参加考核呢？在我这里就可以直接参加考核哦~: Boss, would you like to take the test? You can do it with me.
那先预祝我未来的老板考核成功！第一项考核来啦！: Good luck, My future boss! Here comes the first test.
众所周知，我们猫猫岛以经商闻名，我们很佩服那些拥有经商能力的人。: As is known by many, our Kitty Isle is famours for our trading. We admire those with a good sense of business.
这是我们猫猫岛的一份贸易单，请你根据贸易单的描述完成考核吧！: This is a trading list of the Kitty Isle. Please read the list and complete the test.
啊！谢谢你，没想到猫猫岛商团的效率真是高啊！: Ah! Thank you. Didn't know the Kitty Isle Commercial Corps were this efficient!
这点材料根本不是我预定的数量，你还是核对一下贸易单再来找我吧。: This is not enough for my order. You better double check the list and come back only when you are ready.
我要的柔毛带过来了吗？: Have you brought me the Feather?
哼，效率还可以，我们家族会考虑加深与猫猫岛商团的合作的。: Hmm! That was fast. We'll think about expanding our cooperation with the Kitty Isle Commercial Corps.

着那些曾经朝气蓬勃，现在没有了神志只有狰狞面孔的斐扬人。: Once full of vigour and vitality, the Payon people became unconscious and fierce.

他们智家终于走到了妖君面前，此时的妖君无比的强大，更是凭借洞窟中的黑暗力量以及刚: The Wisdom clan finally made it to the Hyegun who had become extremely powerful, in charge of an undead legion of the recently passed Payon people and the dark force.

如果我能找出那些魔物的弱点，那么将对克雷斯特同盟军进驻古城减少很多阻力。: If I can find out those monsters' weak spot, the Crest Alliance Army will experience less trouble entering Glast Heim.

越是在凶险恶劣的环境下，越是要提高自身的实力才能确保生存的可能性，而不是盲目地陷: When the environment is unfavorable, we must improve our ability to secure our survival. Falling into the whirlpool of emotions just won't help.

看来你还是没有理解适者生存的道理啊。: I'm afraid you still don't understand the survival of the fittest.

你的表现太棒了，相信从刚才的战斗中你也一定有所收获。: You did great! You must have learned a great deal from the fight earlier.

一会天朗气清，一会又风沙四起，真不知道这些原住民是怎么生存下来的！: It was sunny and bright a while ago and now it's sand blown by the wind. I don't know how the indigenous people have survived this long!
