不管怎么样，人只有在最艰苦严峻的环境下，才能激发隐藏的潜能，发挥出异于常人的实力: No matter what, people's hidden potential can only be aroused in the harshest environment.
对我们终极决斗俱乐部来说，永远只有这般勇往无前地挑战，如果临阵退缩或者心怀胆怯都: We members of the Ultimate Fight Club will never stop advancing or challenging. Fear and timidity are not acceptable!
冒险者，我希望你也能通过这片沙漠的馈赠，追寻心中的理想，一往无前地去面对冒险旅途: Adventurer, I hope you can pass the desert's present and pursue your dream. Advance and face all the challenges and tests your adventurous journey brings you.
很遗憾，看来你并不知道自己心中真正想要的究竟是什么呢。: Unfortunately, You don't really know what you want.
勇敢的冒险者！我想你的选择表明你已经做好准备，去应对任何可能发生的危机！: What a brave adventurer! I believe you are prepared to take on any tasks and crises.
接下来我希望你能在这场对决中审时度势，以从容不乱的态度来应对我和另外一名队友的联: I hope you can judge the hour and size up the situation in this fight and cope with the joint forces of my comrade and I calmly. This is the only way to exert your greatest potential.
很棒的冒险者，我相信在之后的冒险旅途中你一定可以走得更远。: A brilliant adventurer! I'm sure you can go much further on your adventure.

虽然我不知道那个小魔法师的消息，但是古城众多封印的灵魂肯定有人知道。我的火焰纹章: I don't know where the little Mage is but I'm sure some of the souls sealed here in Glast Heim can answer your question. My fire badge will help you locate those truly able souls.
我快要消散了…告诉雷藏，在这片古城之中一定要小心谨慎，这片土地，远远没有想象的那: I'm about to vanish... Tell Reyen to be careful in Glast Heim. This land is way more complicated than he expected.
那位先贤的灵魂已经消散了吗……我一定会小心谨慎的。: The wise lady's soul has vanished? I'll be very careful.
今天真是一个使人快乐的日子: Today is such a joyful day.
幸福的恋人，祝福你们: Happy couple, best wishes to you.
I see a strong white light...
小心这些魂魄，他们已经失去了理智，请谨慎靠近。: Be careful with those spirits. They've lost their consciousness. Please approach slowly.
冒险者，站在最前端的灵魂怨气有些不同，请千万小心！: Adventurer, the one standing ahead of others has a different kind of resentment. Be careful!
可怜的恋人，可悲的结果，让他们安息吧冒险者。: Poor couple... Lamentable result... Let them rest, adventurer.
活人？为什么要破坏我的傀儡？: A living man? Why did you destroy my puppets?
冒险者，我们是不是可以尝试着和它谈谈？: Adventurer, shall we try to talk to it?
有时候真的很佩服人类的异想天开，先断气再来谈吧！: I admire you humans' imagination. Kill yourself and we shall talk!
喵，老板你小心一点呀！看本喵的！: Meow! Boss, be careful! I got this!
喵！专心一点啦老板！你这样我也很难做的！: Meow! Boss, focus! You are making things hard for me!
喵！在本喵面前，老板你是不会有事的！: Meow! As long as I'm here, You will be okay!
老板，你被本喵B套餐的香味惊醒了嘛？: Boss, did the scent of my package B arouse you?
那位炽魂说过，这古城存在着许许多多的封印点。有些灵魂在这里封印了数百年之久。: The fire spirit said this Glast Heim has many sealing points. Many souls have been sealed here for centuries.
我想，这些灵魂应该会知道更多的消息。如果我们能够从他们身上得到这些消息，那么同盟: I think these souls should have more information for you. If we can get such information, the Alliance Army's operation will get smoother.
古城对于我们来说太过神秘，我们不能大规模进驻古城，否则会遇到难以想象的困难。: Glast Heim is too mysterious for us. We can't enter the Glast Heim in large scale or it would be too difficult.
思来想去，冒险者，只有你才能胜任这个任务。: I've been thinking. Adventurer, only you can handle this task.
[c][ffff00]古城当中有着许许多多的物品，不要小看任何一个物品，他们很可: There are many items in [c][ffff00]Glast Heim. Don't underestimate anything. They might bring us some new clues[-][/c].
在魔导师炽魂的火焰纹章中我感觉到了魔力的波动，也许这纹章会给你一些帮助。: In the high wizard Soul's fire badge, I can feel magic waves. This badge might help you.
[c][ffff00]那么冒险者，你可以出发了，为了安全起见，我建议带上你的朋友: [c][ffff00]Adventurer, you may set out! I suggest you to bring a friend with you for your safety[-][/c]!
很可惜呢，你已经有佣兵小伙伴了~恐怕不太需要我呢。: Sadly, You've got another mercenary friend. I don't think you need me.
很可惜呢，你已经雇佣两名佣兵小伙伴了呢，不能再雇佣我了呢~: What a pity! You already have two mercenary partners. You can't hire me.
很可惜呢，由于手续上的原因，你暂时不能再雇佣我了呢，请联系GM解决~: Sadly you can't hire me at this moment due to some procedures. GM will help you.
那家伙又来了，你知道吗？最近大家都在议论呢。: He's back. Do you know? People have been talking.
看来你还不知道？每次他出现后，大家都不敢出门了。: You really don't know? Every time when he's here, no one dares go out.
不知道我在说什么？我说的是那个幽灵！: Still don't know what I'm talking about? I mean that phantom!
就是最近经常出现在[c][ffff00]委托看板附近[-][/c]的家伙。路过的: The guy that often lingers around the [c][ffff00]Mission Board[-][/c]! The passers-by are always scared by them.
别太掉以轻心了，他可不是个简单的人物。: Don't drop your guard. He's not a simple target.
近期不要再靠近那块委托看板了，过几天，城防军可能会派人来拆了那块看板，将附近封锁: Don't approach the mission board these days. The city guards might come in a few days to remove the board and block the area.
也许整个依斯鲁得都会被封锁。: The entire Izlude might be blocked off.
没办法，因为他，镇民都纷纷惶恐地搬走了。也许这座历史悠久的小镇也到了它落幕的一刻: Nothing we can do. Because of him, many villagers have moved away. This little town of a long history might be coming to an end. Quite sad to say so.
得想想办法: We must figure out a plan.
一个模糊的身影渐渐出现在面前，看起来像是一个脸色苍白、神色阴郁的少年，浑身散发着: A vague figure appeared. Looked like a pale, depressed youth, giving off an air that kept people away...
……你看得到我吗？别紧张，我不会伤害你。: ... Can you see me? Don't worry. I won't harm you.
对、对不起！我不是故意的！总有人要来攻击我，所以情不自禁就出手了……: Sorry! I didn't mean it! People often come to attack me... I couldn't help...
听我说……我没有恶意，只是有件紧急的事正让我发愁，没有人愿意听我解释。: Listen... I have no ill intention. I'm worried about an urgent matter... No one is willing to listen to my explanation.
不是我想吓唬那些人，我也不知道为什么自己会在这里。: I don't mean to scare them. I don't really know why I'm here.
为了寻找答案，我跟踪了一支冒险队四处搜索，然后去了一个[c][ffff00]海底: To look for answers, I followed an expedition team and visited a [c][ffff00]Underwater Cave[-][/c].
洞穴的深处似乎隐藏着一座古代遗迹，冒险队打算深入遗迹寻找埋藏的宝藏。但是没多久，: At the depths of the cave is an ancient site. The expedition team wanted to enter and search for treasures. Soon after, they realized something was wrong.
进去的所有人都像着了魔似的，忽然自相残杀起来。: Everyone in there became demonic. They began to fight each other.
我想找人去救他们，可是没有人相信我，他们都见到我就跑。: I want to bring people to save them but no one believes me. Everyone runs away from me.
真的吗？太好了！情况紧急，事不宜迟，我们马上就去[c][ffff00]海底洞穴[: Really? Excellent! It's urgent. Let's go to the [c][ffff00]Underwater Cave[-][/c]!
这里所有的东西都是我的！谁敢抢，我就揍扁他！！！: Everything here belongs to me! Who dares take any, I'll kick your ass!
小心！这些魔物似乎会影响人的思维，冒险队的人就是因此而发狂的，唯独我没有受到影响: Watch out! Those monsters can affect our mind. The members of the expedition team have lost their mind. I'm the only one still conscious.
让我来对付这些魔物，你快去里面救人！: I'll cope with these monsters. You go in there to save them.
{我不能丢下你,4},{那就交给你了,7}: {I can't leave you behind,4},{I'll leave this to you,7}
我一个人足够应付。里面的人很危险，一秒钟也不能耽搁！快去！: I can handle this. The people in there are dangerous. Waste no time! Hurry!
你是谁！也是来抢财宝的吗？滚！不然我杀了你！: Who are you? Are you here to take my treasures? Get lost or I'll kill you!
看来这是我们贪财的报应。: Our greed is getting back on us.
我们原来是梦罗克商旅会的人，偶然去普隆德拉做生意时，听说沉没在海底的神殿中埋藏着: We used to work for the Morroc Commerce Centre. On one business trip to Prontera, we heard about the treasures from an ancient dynasty hidden in an underwater temple. We wanted to take it but we lost our mind before we got there.
谢谢你让我清醒过来，只是，你能想办法再救救我的队友们吗？他们应该还活着。: Thank you for bringing me back. Could you save my teammates? They should be alive.
我在一本海洋生物书上看到，用[c][ffff00]海葵[-][/c]的[c][f: I read it in a book about sea creatures. The [c][ffff00]Coral Essence[-][/c] of the [c][ffff00]Hydra[-][/c] can bring people back to their senses. I must stay here to watch them. Can you find some [c][ffff00]Coral Essence[-][/c]?
除了倒在这里的几个，还有其他队员去探索洞穴别的地方了，他们可能也遇难了。麻烦你多: Except for these few on the ground, other members have split up to visit other parts of the cave. They might be in trouble. Please find more [c][ffff00]Coral Essence[-][/c].
剩下的那些人，也拜托你去救他们了。我还得留在这里为这几名队友处理伤情。: Please save the rest of them. I must stay here to look after these injured members.
谢谢你，这里似乎很危险，我们不准备继续深入了，请转告其他人，尽快离开。: Thank you. This place is dangerous. We won't advance further. Please tell them to leave.
幸好有你的帮忙，不然我们都会葬身此地。现在想想，真是不值得为了那些宝藏而送命，我: Thank you for your help or we would have all died here. Losing our lives for those treasures is not worthy it. We are ready to leave.
非常谢谢你为我们做的这一切。以后，如果你有什么需要，尽管来梦罗克找我们！: Thank you for everything. If you need anything, please visit us in Morroc!
这座洞穴隐藏着可怕的力量，只要呆在这里就很危险，你跟我们一起走吧？: This cave houses horrible strength. Staying here alone is very dangerous. Please come with us!
的确我们现在想帮你也有些力不从心，再逗留下去，可能又会丧失心智。: Honestly, there's not much we can help you with. If we stay here longer, we might lost our mind.
不过，有件东西或许可以帮上你。: However, here's something that might be helpful.
这是我在海底洞穴中唯一发现的一件宝物，据古书记载，这个[c][ffff00]太阳: This is the only treasure I have discovered in the underwater cave. According to some old books, Wearing this [c][ffff00]Sun Rock Ring[-][/c] can reduce monsters' effect. Because I've been holding it, I'm able to hang on a bit longer than others.
经过这次的经历，我已经决定，从今以后摒弃对宝藏的执迷，老老实实做生意。这个辟邪的: I have decided to sever my obsession with treasures. I'll stick to my business. Please keep this headwear.
但愿你能尽快找回你的朋友，平安离开。: I hope you can find your friend leave this place soon!
别过来！那只巨大的绿蛙就在附近，这里很危险，你快逃出去吧！: Don't approach! The giant green frog is nearby. This place is dangerous. You better leave.
让你跑，为什么呆着不跑呢？！: I asked you to leave. Why are you still here?
这头怪物受海底洞穴中的魔力滋养，浑身充满了剧毒，就算是我，渐渐也受到了毒性的侵蚀: This monster has been nourished by the mana in this underwater cave, highly poisonous. I can feel the poison is eroding my body slowly. It's very dangerous.
真拿你没办法。本来我只是想让你来救人，可不是让你来送死的啊。: What can I do with you? I want you to save a life not to court death!
别小看这只大青蛙，说起来，它也是我的老对手了。只要吸入它呼出的毒气，就会四肢无力: Don't underestimate the frog. I've fought it a few times. Its poisonous breath will make you weak in the limbs and it will go on to control your body. [c][ffff00]Hold your breath[-][/c].
注意千万别吸入它放出的毒气，不过也别把自己闷死了！: Don't breath in the air it exhales but don't choke yourself to death.
你……你把它们都干掉了吗？真厉害……你真让我刮目相看。: You... You killed them all? How powerful! How impressive!
没想到结果我还是一点忙都没帮上。不过那只大青蛙会无限复活，没过多久，可能又会在某: I didn't help at all in the end. The giant fog can revive itself. Soon we'll encounter it again somewhere.
我果然是个自以为是的失败者，为了恋慕的心上人而舍弃自己的王国，结果却连表白的勇气: I'm just an opinionated loser. I have given up my kingdom for someone I love but I don't even have the courage to confess my love.
看到自己的好友变成面目可憎的魔物，我却没有勇气全力应战……曾坚信自己的王国会流传: I watched my friend turning into an ugly monster but I had no courage to fight... I once firmly believed that my kingdom would be prosperous forever but now it has become ruins under the water.
我的名字，和我的古王朝，也没有人记得了。: My name and my kingdom will be forgotten.
大家只叫我“死灵”，一个死去的灵魂。: They call me Doppelganger, a Dead soul.
你也觉得我很可笑是吗？: You find it amusing, don't you?
不过，我想到一件事。: However, something just came to my mind.
如果能借用别人的身体，我就可以复活，并且重建我的王朝。: If I could borrow someone's body, I would revive and rebuild my empire.
而我发现，眼前就有一个非常合适的人选，不但拥有强大的精神力，而且身体素质也很不错: I've found a perfect man. He has a very strong head and is well built. Even the huge frog's poison couldn't harm you. I've been waiting so long for such a nice container.
为什么我送给菲力卡的头箍，会在你手里？！！啊啊啊啊……这个光芒……啊啊啊……: The headwear I gave Phillica... How did you get it? Ah... This light... Ah...
我的脑袋一片混乱……我是怎么了……: My head is so confused... What happened to me?
刚才应该是我沾染的毒性发作了，所以忽然暴躁起来。我现在需要去角落静一静……: The poison attacked so I became impatient and fierce... I need to calm myself done at the corner.
有件事我不明白，这个太阳石头箍是我当初在追求菲力卡时送给她的，不过她好像并不怎么: Here's something I don't understand. This Sun Rock Ring... I gave it to Phillica when I was pursuing her but she didn't seem to care for it. I never saw her wear it once.
为什么它会在海底废墟里？菲力卡难道来过我的王国……: Why is it in the underwater ruins? Did Phillica come here?
如果我能再次见到她，将过去不敢说出口的话亲口对她说一次，就好了。: If I could ever see her again, I would tell her the words I couldn't say out. I would, Just this one time.
现在，只剩下这个头箍陪着我了。: Now I have nothing but this headwear.
哼，冒险家，虽然我是被魔物的毒性控制而一时意识失控，不过复国的计划我是不会放弃的: Hmm! Adventurer, the monster's poison seized control of me earlier but I won't give up restoring my kingdom. For the sake of this headwear and Phillica, I'll let you go today. Be careful. We'll meet again.
就这么消失了……看来得向莎西尔.迪文再问问情况。: He's gone... I better ask Shacia Devon for details.
你碰到那个幽灵了？我的警告，你怎么不听呢！: You met that phantom? Why don't you listen to my warning?
冒险家，这个世界还有许多你未知的危险事物。过多的好奇心会葬送你的小命！: Adventurer, in this world there are many dangerous creatures beyond your knowledge. Your curiosity might kill you.
这次出现的幽灵，经过我的调查，就是被禁锢在吉芬魔法塔地下，受到诅咒而永不消亡的死: According to my investigation, the phantom should be the cursed, Immortal Doppelganger chained in the cellar of the Geffen Magic Tower. His sudden leaving from Geffen for Izlude might have something to do with the recent world Rift magic turbulence.
刚说了，别有太多好奇心！: I just told to you keep your curiosity under control!
不过你既然问了，我就勉为其难回答一下，免得你冒冒失失再惹祸上身。: Since you've asked, I'll give you a brief answer so you won't bump into bigger trouble recklessly.
死灵出现的原因有很多传说，但没有人可以确定死灵到底是谁。似乎有人刻意抹去了过去的: There are many legends about the origin of Doppelganger but no one can confirm who he really is. Feels like someone has wiped out that part of history on purpose
我听长老说过，死灵因为触碰了魔法塔中的禁忌，被禁锢在塔中，肉体死亡后，灵魂却没有: An elder told me Doppelganger was chained in the tower as a punishment for breaking a taboo. His body died but his soul stayed.
由于想要获得肉体重生的渴望，他的灵魂一次又一次的死而复活。: His longing for obtaining a physical body and reviving was so strong that his soul revived again and again.
这是一种古老的禁忌魔法，魔法公会到目前还没有找到消除他的办法，只能加强对魔法塔地: This is an ancient forbidden spell. The magic guild hasn't figured out how to remove it. We've been keeping a close eye on the cellar of the magic tower.
好了，我必须把这些情况报告给城防军。近期在外走动要多留神，说不定他还会出现！: Okay. I must report this to the city guard. Stay cautious when outside. He might reappear.
这好像是一把断裂的剑，在地上闪烁着银白色的光芒…: A broken sword with a silver glow on the ground.
随着触碰，银白色的光芒越来越亮…: The silver glow became increasingly bright as your hand touched it.
一股巨大的吸引力从断裂的圣剑中喷涌而出…似乎要把你的身体包裹进去…: A massive suction force shot out of the broken holy sword... As if wrapping your body up...
这时火焰纹章在你的胸口微微发光…: The fire badge in front of your chest glowed vaguely...
哦…火焰纹章的气息…亲爱的烈焰之黛西，你终于从封印中逃出来了吗？: Oh... The smell of the fire badge... Dear Flame Daisy, finally you are out of the seal?
嗯？你不是黛西！你究竟是谁，为什么火焰纹章会出现在你身上！: Hmm? You are not Daisy! Who the heck are you? Why do you have the fire badge?
当我圣洁的灵魂遭到黑暗压制的时候，我看到了你的英勇。冒险者，告诉我，为什么火焰纹: I saw your courage when my holy soul was suppressed by the dark. Adventurer, tell me. Why do you have this fire badge?
她已经消散了吗…没想到当年探索的小队也只剩下我一个人了，也许我也该离开，回归神的: She's gone? The expedition team is all gone but me. Maybe I should leave as well. Go back to the God's arms...
你想知道黑暗之王的消息是吗？: Do you want the Dark Lord's news?
黑暗之王降临古城已经数百年之久，我就是百年前探索古城被封印的神圣骑士。: It's been hundreds of years since the Dark Lord's arrival in Glast Heim. I'm a holy knight sealed in the Glast Heim a century ago.
这百年来，我无时无刻不在想着脱离封印，但是很遗憾，我的力量不足以通过那危机四伏的: I've been striving to get out of the seal every hour and moment for one hundred years but unfortunately I'm not powerful enough to pass through the graveyard in Glast Heim...
没错，黑暗之王就在古城墓地，你那位魔法师朋友的灵魂，肯定在黑暗之王手中！: Yes, the Dark Lord is in the Glast Heim graveyard. Your Mage friend's soul must be in the Dark Lord's hand!
至于怎么召唤出黑暗之王…也许其他封印的灵魂会给你答案，他们有些人封印时间更久…会: How to summon the Dark Lord? Maybe other sealed souls have an answer for you. Some of them have been here even longer and aware of more...
我要回归神的怀抱了…冒险者，黑暗之王就交给你们了…: I'm going back to Lord's embrace... Adventurer, the Dark Lord is your responsibility now...
破旧的权杖上似乎有什么在闪着荧光…: An old mace with some faint fluorescent light...
宝石似乎损坏了…表面上有着一丝裂痕…: The gem seemed broken with a small crack...
裂缝之中似乎有一股神圣的力量正在向外涌动…你不受控制地被向着某个地方牵引…: Some holy power flew out from the crack, dragging you to one direction...
火焰纹章在你的胸口发出朦胧的柔光…好像要告诉你什么…: The fire badge gave off a dim glow on your chest as if telling you something...
火焰的气息…似乎有点熟悉…百年前被封印的新人吗…: The fire smell... Familiar... A sealed newcomer from one hundred years ago?
看来她也熬不过这令人疯狂的封印，消散了吗…冒险者，你带着这火焰纹章来到这里，是想: She couldn't resist this frastrating seal and vanish? Adventurer, You've brought this fire badge to me... Do you have questions to ask?
原来是这样…嗯？真是阴魂不散，你又来这里做什么！: I see... Hmm? You just won't leave me alone. What do you want?
亲爱的安琪，好歹我们曾经同为队友，你为什么不能对我和颜悦色一点呢？: Dear Angel, we were once in the same team. Why can't you be a bit nicer to me?
你已经堕落了，杰理！神是不会原谅你的！: You are already degenerated, Jerry! God won't forgive you!
神？我放弃抵抗追随黑暗之王，得到了不朽的身躯，而你呢？被镇压在这破石头里几百年，: God? I've given up resistance and earned an immortal body from the Dark Lord. What about you? You've been inside this stupid rock for hundreds of years. Where is your God?
迟早有一天，你会在神威炼狱中凄惨嚎叫！: Sooner or later, you will be screaming in hell!
我的耐心已经用光了！安琪，只要你肯堕落成为暗神官，我可以向你保证，你的地位绝对不: My patience has run out! Angel, Join us to become an Evil Druid. I can promise your status won't be lower than mine!
住口杰理！你在痴心妄想，我绝不会向黑暗之王低头的！: Shut up, Jerry! Stop dreaming! I will never bow to the Dark Lord!
不可理喻！或许强大的力量能让你清醒一点！: Nonsense. Maybe my great strength will sober you up a bit!

冒险者，关于你朋友的下落，很遗憾，我不知道他的消息。不过我倒是可以告诉你关于黑暗: Adventurer, about your friend... I'm sorry... I don't know where he is. I can tell you something about the Dark Lord.
想引出黑暗之王的方法只有一个，那就是击败迷幻之王。迷幻之王作为最早出现在黑暗之王: To lure the Dark Lord out, the only way is to defeat the Dark Illusion. One of the earliest monsters that appeared by the Dark Lord, the Dark Illusion might have some connection with the Dark Lord.
也许迷幻之王就是黑暗之王的一部分也说不定…我想你终究是要面对黑暗之王的吧…与迷幻: Maybe the Dark Illusion is part of the Dark Lord... I believe you will have to face the Dark Lord one day... A fight with the Dark Illusion is unavoidable.
好了，冒险者，我能告诉你的就是这么多。这里众多的灵魂总会有人知道你要的消息…带着: Adventurer, this is all I could tell you. So many souls here... Many people know the newsthat you are looking for... Take my gem and leave.

一把弓弦闪烁着寒光的弓，硬生生地插在地上…: A bow with a cold shine on its string was stuck in earth.
看样子像是一把龙骨制成的弓…: It looks like a bow made from dragon bones.

哟…猎物上钩啦…嘿嘿，这下可以好好地活动一下筋骨了！: Ha! The fish has risen to the bait... He-heh... Time to get some exercise!

别瞪着我…开个玩笑嘛，我在这里已经寂寞了数百年，除了与那些古城魔物战斗，我还真找: Stop gazing at me like that... It was a joke. I've been here alone for centuries. I have loads of monsters to fight but no one to talk to.
刚刚感到一股火焰的气息…要知道我被称之为冰霜猎人，最讨厌的就是火焰了，就忍不住试: I felt fire earlier. You know I'm the Frost Hunter who hates nothing more than fire. So I had a try...

哦…差点忘了，那位小魔法师的灵魂被撕扯成三份，一份黑暗之王自己带走了，还有两份被: Oh... Almost forgot... The little Mage's soul was torn into three. The Dark Lord took one himself and his subordinate the Dark Illusion took the other two.
是啊，如果不尽快取回，恐怕那位小魔法师…: Yes. If you can't get them back quickly, I'm afraid the little Mage won't survive...
对了，走的时候，把这把龙骨弓也带走吧…总有一天，我这把龙骨弓会找到适合他的主人…: By the way, the this dragon bone bow with you... One day my bow will find a worthy master.
我？呵呵呵…这三百年的寂寞日子，我早已经呆够了，我会找到当初压制我的那位深渊骑士: I? He-heh... Three years of loneliness is more than enough. I'll find the Abysmal Knight who defeated me last time for another fight and die without regrets.

记住我的名字，冰霜猎人珀尔！: Remember my name. The Frost Hunter Pearl.
一把布满锈迹与豁口的拳刃…拳刃把手都已碎成两段…: A rusty fist blade with cracks... The handle was broken into two.
拳刃通体暗红…也不知到底饮了多少敌人的血…: The fist blade was dark red... It probably ended many lives.

自暴君休密兹新建古城至今数百年，无数冒险者进入这里冒险，而现在古城所剩的灵魂又有: It has been a few centuries since the tyranny Humizz first established Glast Heim. Numerous adventurers have entered the Glast Heim for adventures. How many souls are left here?
有一种人，他们天生与魔法的契合度极高，学习魔法的速度很快，无论是什么魔法都一点就: There is one kind of men born for magic. No matter what spells, They are able to learn and master in no time.
这种人的灵魂比起普通的灵魂纯净数倍，理所当然的，也是黑暗之王口中的美食盛宴，我想: These men's souls are much purer than the average and of course they are preferred by the Dark Lord. I believe your friend is one of them.
如果你想去救你的朋友，那么就拔出这把拳刃，带着我的灵魂一起走。: If you want to save your friend, pull out this fist blade and leave with my soul.
我是十字刺客！我的目标不应该死在你们同盟军的手上！: I'm a Assassin Cross! My target shouldn't die in your alliance's hands.
带我离去，我会亲手送迷幻之王下地狱！: Take me with you and I'll give the Dark Illusion a ride to hell!
斐扬洞穴中的妖君又作乱了，他招来了一些看不见的魔物，统帅愁得眉毛都白了！: Hyegun is causing trouble in the Payon Cave again. He's summoned a bunch of invisible monsters. The Commander-in-Chief is very concerned.

如果你有兴趣，不妨去试试吧。那些鬼影并不经常出现，你需要耐心仔细搜索。: If you are interested, give it a try. Those ghosts don't show up often. You must be patient.
还没有学“幽灵相机”的话，请去普隆德拉找梅菲尔林瑟，在他那里能习得“幽灵相机”冒: If you don't know how to use the Phantom Camera, visit Mayfair Linse in Prontera to master the Phantom Camera skill.

让它们[c][ffff00]连续变大两次，它们就会变身成哥布灵★[-][/c]，: [c][ffff00]Double their size twice and they will transform into Goblin*[-][/c]. Kill them and you have chance obtaining more precious materials they've hidden.
没有智慧只有力量的哥布灵，就是这么蠢！不过别把它们变小啦，它们会痛恨你的！: Goblins with might but not wisdom are very stupid! However, don't make them small or they will hate you.
很不错的冒险者。看来你的收获很令人满意，欢迎回来。: A very good adventurer. Looks like you've gained a fortune. Welcome back.
庞德的灵魂被分成三份了？这可不好办了。如果不尽快夺回庞德的灵魂，就算是我也很难救: Laurell Weinder's soul has been split into three? This is not good. If we can't get his soul back quickly, I might not be able to save him...
想要找到黑暗之王，只能先解决迷幻之王，那么现在我们应该去探听迷幻之王的下落。: To find the Dark Lord, we must remove the Dark Illusion first. Let's go ask about for the Dark Illusion's whereabouts.
根据营地周围的魔法师守卫的描述，这里除了恶魔，还有另外一种魔物——深渊骑士。: According to the Mage guard near the camp, this place is frequented by demons and another kind of monsters called the Abysmal Knight.
每位深渊骑士都有各自的领地，我想他们在古城的地位不会低。从他们身上找点消息吧。: Every Abysmal Knight has his own territory. I believe they have a pretty high status in Glast Heim. Let's start with them.
如果庞德能够成功被救回，我会让他好好感谢你，谢谢你为他所做的一切，冒险者。: If Laurell Weinder can be saved, I'll tell him to give you his gratitude for everything you've done for him, adventurer.
看上去，这次古城行动并不会太过顺利。: Looks like this operation in Glast Heim is not to go well.
我们得准备一下，也是时候让这些魔物见识一下我们克雷斯特同盟军的力量了！: We must get ready. It's time to show these monsters what we Crest Alliance Army can do!
愤怒的火焰必将把你们燃为灰烬！: The flame of fury will burn you all into ashes!
黑暗降临…一切光明都将毁灭！: The Dark will befall... And the light will be destroyed!
在黑暗中，吾将永不腐朽！: In the dark, I shall live forever!
为什么！神抛弃了我们，为什么你不肯和我一起投身黑暗！: Why! The god has abandoned us. Why can't you join me in the dark?
信奉黑暗，才能获得不朽的力量！: Worship the dark and obtain the everlasting strength!
有意思，好久没有这么有意思的猎物了！我要动真格了！: Interesting... I have had such nice prey for a long time. I'm getting serious.
我是特里斯坦三世的女儿，是个公主。: I'm a daughter of Trestan III, a princess!
没时间解释了！追兵来了！: No time to explain! The pursuing troops are coming!
西格莉特，你已经无路可逃了。: Sigletty, You have nowhere to go!
你知道你是在跟国王的手下作对嘛！！: Do you know you are fighting against the king's men?
别以为我会轻易放过你们。: I won't let go of you easily!
抱歉，把你也牵扯进来: I'm sorry for getting you involved in this.
我们现在是一条船上的人了，我就告诉你真相吧。: We are on the same boat now. I'll tell you the truth.
但我的确是国王的女儿，只不过是他的私生女。: I'm a daughter of the king. A bastard daughter.
我十六岁那年，就可以编入王室族谱了。: I will be included in the royal pedigree once I turn 16.
到那时候我就能正式成为公主啦。: And I'll become a real princess.
之所以被人追杀，是有人企图陷害我。: Someone has framed me. That's why I'm being hunted.
我没办法站在这里跟你解释，得找个地方先躲起来。: I can't explain here. We need a safe place to hide.
我有个青梅竹马叫作赛依连·瓦恩萨: I have a childhood sweetheart called Seyren Windsor.
他虽然是雷斯特同盟军的一员，但他也是唯一相信我的人。: He's a member of the Lester Alliance and the only one who trusts me.
你去找他谈谈，他会告诉你详细情况。: Talk to him and he'll tell you everything.
这么说是你救了她，真是不知道该怎么感谢你。: So you saved her? I don't know how I can ever thank you enough.
西格莉特之所以被国王通缉追杀: Sigletty is hunted by the king because...
说西格莉特在她十六岁那年会帮助黑暗之王毁灭世界。: Sigletty will assist the Dark Lord to destroy the world when she turns 16.
这分明就是王室中有人不满私生女当上公主而制造出来的谣言。: Obviously someone in the royal family made up this to stop this bastard daughter from becoming a real princess.
国王以为这是大先知渥尔娃所说。: The king believes the great prophet Walle.
渥尔娃是传说中有名的预言家，她的预言从来就没有出过错。: Walle is a reputed prophet whose prophecy has never been proved wrong.
早在西格莉特的预言出现之前，她就已经消失了近百年之久。: She had vanished for over two centuries when the prophecy about Sigletty came out.
所以我推测这是一条假预言: I believe this is a fake prophecy.
现在唯一的办法就是找到真的渥尔娃，来推翻这条假预言。: The only way to overturn the prophecy is to find the real Walle.
这位先知神出鬼没。但是我得到消息，得知她就沉睡在这古城中。: No one knows where this prophet is. But I heard she's sleeping in Glast Heim.
传言用深渊骑士血和旗帜，能唤醒先知渥尔娃。: Rumor has it that the Blood of Abysmal Knight and flag can arouse Prophet Walle.
你居然这么快就找回来了，真是个勇士。: It was fast. What a warrior!
这件事我身不由己，只能你自己去完成。: This matter is beyond my control. You must fulfil it in person.
把这四面旗帜插在地上: Place these four flags in the ground.
然后泼上深渊骑士的血就可以了: Then pour the Blood of Abysmal Knight on them.
西格莉特公主就拜托给你了。: Princess Sigletty's tomorrow is on you.

真是太失礼了，喵，我可不是猫！！: How rude! Meow! I'm not a cat!
你这个没礼貌的年轻人喵: What a rude young fellow! Meow.
吱，我可也是大先知渥尔娃的侍从—伊童: Hmm... I'm Prophet Walle's attendant Idun.
你说你要找渥尔娃大人？她正在沉睡。: You are looking for Lady Walle? She's sleeping.
我怎么能让你打扰了大人的睡眠喵。: How could I let you disturb my lady's sleep?
喵你说什么喵！居然有人谎造渥尔娃大人的预言！？: Meow! What did you say? Meow! Someone made up a prophecy in Lady Walle's name?
我可不能让你们这群愚蠢的人类毁了渥尔娃大人的声誉。: I can't let you stupid humans ruin Lady Walle's reputation.
你别高兴的太早，实不相瞒: Don't be too pleased. To be honest with you...
渥尔娃大人是因为被黑暗之王抢走了预言之眼，才陷入了沉睡。: Lady Walle fell asleep because the Dark Lord took away her eye of the prophecy.
绝不是因为渥尔娃大人打不过黑暗之王，喵: Lady Walle wasn't defeated by the Dark Lord! Meow.
只不过可恶的黑暗之王太过卑鄙。: The goddamn Dark Lord was nasty and cunning.
他还召唤了一只狂暴的蝙蝠弓箭手日夜看守渥尔娃大人的预言之眼。: He summoned a berserk Gargoyle Archer to watch Lady Walle's Eye of the Prophecy day and night.
一，如果你足够强大，打败这个蝙蝠弓箭手，夺得预言之眼: First, if you are able enough, defeat this Gargoyle Archer and take the Eye of the Prophecy.
二，找个同伴或者自己隐匿过去，偷回预言之眼: Second, find a partner or sneak in to steal the Eye of the Prophecy.
看来前方就是伊童所说的预言之眼的存放之地。: That should be the place where the Eye of the Prophecy has been kept.
可惜光夺回预言之眼还是不够的喵: Getting back the Eye of the Prophecy is not enough. Meow.
预言之眼从渥尔娃大人身体里分离太久，大人现在十分虚弱: The Eye of the Prophecy has been separated from Lady Walle for too long. My lady is extremely weak at this moment.
我们得找到古城古老的苏醒魔咒喵: We must find the ancient awakening spell in Glast Heim.
古城里有块发光的石柱: There is a glowing stone column in Glast Heim.
上面就刻着苏醒魔咒的咒语喵: The awakening spell is carved on the column. Meow.
这块石碑就在古城的西北角: The stele is at the northwest corner of the Glast Heim.

你知道吗？舒适宜人的地理环境能够营造出一种赏心悦目的生活气息，我们希望每一个冒险: Do you know?Comfortable geographic environment makes for pleasant living conditions. We hope every adventurer can live happily in a pleasant environment.
这个世界需要更多的勇者，在勇者的守护下，世界才会更加美好！那么，你想成为勇者吗？: This world needs more Braves and will become a better place under their protection!What do you say? Do you want to be a Brave?
世间的勇者死后进入了伟大的神奥丁冕下建立的英灵殿，成为了一名为神，为世人而战斗的: A mortal Brave will enter Valhalla built by almighty Odin and become an Epic Spirit who fights for gods and mortals.
长久以来，英灵们保护着神庭与天空城的安全，他们无愧于英灵的称号。: Epic Spirits have long been safeguarding the Divine Court and the Castle in the Sky. They are worthy of their title.
在诸神的黄昏后，英灵们死伤大半，当年的英灵殿如今却显得空荡无比。: The majority of Epic Spirits died in the Ragnarok, Leaving Valhalla empty.
当残存的众神得到下一次诸神黄昏已经在酝酿当中的消息时，众神决心提前准备，决心重现: When the remaining gods got the news that the next Ragnarok is brewing, they decided to make preparations in advance and restore Valhalla to its former glory.
英灵的力量是亡者的力量，是只有在人类死后才有机会得到的“神的恩赐”。: The power of Epic Spirit is that of the dead, a "gift from gods" mortals receive after their death.
现今的人们几乎无法得到可以媲美英灵的力量，因为人类的身体根本无法负担起亡者的力量: Mortals now can hardly handle the power that rivals an Epic Spirit because their bodies cannot withstand the power of the dead.This power will cause their body to collapse and die in the end.
但是众神仍然相信人类身上拥有无限可能，经过众神的研究，他们改良了“英灵之力”的力: But the gods still believe mortals have infinite possibilities. They managed to improve the constitution of "the power of Epic Spirit" and created a new "divine power" which even mortals can control with ease.
现在女武神全面入驻人类勇者的集聚地——公会，帮助并选拔人类中的勇者，成为英灵殿的: Now valkyries have settled in guilds where mortal Braves gather to help and select outstanding heroes to become the reserve force of Valhalla.
而成为英灵殿的预备成员可以获得神的恩赐——“神力”，这股力量会使人类突破种族的限: Gods will gift "divine power"to members of Valhalla's reserve force. This power can make a mortal go beyond the limits of their race and become as powerful as an Epic Spirit.
这也是为了防止诸神黄昏的惨剧再度发生。毕竟这个世界需要更多的勇者！: The purpose of this is to prevent the catastrophic Ragnarok from happening again.This world needs more Braves after all!
想不到我有天也能进入冒险者们的聚集地呢！: I never thought I'd enter the gathering place of heroes one day!
我也想得到神的祝福，真想成为公会的一份子啊！: I want to be blessed by gods. If only I could join a guild!
英灵殿的女武神们一直关注着人类，他们把人类中赫赫有名的冒险者们当成英灵殿的预备人: Valkyries of Valhalla have been watching mortals. They make renowned mortal adventurers into the reserve force of Valhalla.
因此，女武神瓦尔基里殿下在这公会中，给予优秀的人类冒险者祈祷的权利。: As such, Valkyrie in this guild grants the right to pray to outstanding mortal adventurers.
在向众神祈祷的同时，冒险者们可以得到力量的提升，这就是祈祷的意义。: Adventurers can receive a significant boost of power as they pray to gods.
众神的恩赐越强大，冒险者力量的提升就尤其明显！如果你想要变得更强，向女武神祈祷是: The greater the gods' boon, the greater the boost of power received by adventurers!If you want to become stronger, Praying to the valkyrie is a good choice!
女武神的降临是王国从来没有想到的，国王陛下命令我来到这里看守。: The kingdom never expected the arrival of valkyries. His highness ordered me to guard this place.
听说众神需要冒险者们进入瓦尔哈拉废墟其中寻找一种名叫“尼伯龙根”的魔金。: I heard gods needed adventurers to enter the ruin of Valhalla in search for a type of magic gold called "Nibelungen".
但是凭借我们人类现有的力量恐怕不足以在瓦尔哈拉废墟中存活。: However, we mere mortals could hardly survive among the ruin of Valhalla.
这时候女武神奥尔露恩冕下降临了，她带来了充满智慧的阿萨神碑。: That was when Valkyrie Orloum arrived, bringing with her the Aeisr Monument that is full of wisdom.
从这里进去就是奥尔露恩冕下的所在地了。: Enter from here and you'll find Lady Orloum.
飞行魔书的死亡激怒了飞行魔书★，它们已经出现在了古城大厅！: The death of Rideword enraged Rideword ★. They have appeared in Glast Heim Hall!
吼哦~别紧张，我的朋友。一只会说话的蜜蜂在这个幻想世界没什么值得惊讶的~嘻嘻~你: Oho~ Relax, My friend.It's no big deal to see a talking bee in this fantasy world. Hee hee~ do you believe the story?Carve the names of you and your beloved under a tree and happiness will be yours.Do you wish to experience this fairytale?
嘟~嘟~噜~~~玩的开心吗？嘻嘻。: Doo~doo~loo~~~ Having a good time?Hee hee.

嗯~竟然胆敢打扰本王优雅的午睡…呼，抬起头来，人类，说出你的渴求。让本王看看是否: You interrupted my graceful afternoon nap... Phew. Keep your head up, Mortal, and tell me what you want.Let me see if I can do something about it!
年轻人，得不到你的帮助，明天将对我不再有意义。: Young one, tomorrow means nothing to me without your help.
冒险者，我不会忘记你今天所做的决定。: Adventurer, I won't forget this. Thank you!
外面的世界依旧如往常一样继续着，我的世界却永远停在了那一天。: The world still goes on as normal, but my world stopped that day.
你猜我有几岁了？: Do you know how old I am?
再猜猜，我聪明的年轻人。: Take another guess, my smart young one.
对，我已经上百岁了，几百年前我的时间就静止了。: Correct. I'm hundreds of years old. Time has been standing still for me for centuries.
是的，说来你可能不信，这一切都是因为我自身的愚蠢和无知。: Yes. Maybe you don't believe it. This is all because of my own foolishness and ignorance.
我知道你是个热心人，首先我需要把我这该死的破怀表给修好。: I know you are a kindhearted person. First, I need to fix this damned pocket watch.
所以我需要你去钟楼里找一些新的指针来。: I need you to grab some hands from the clock tower.
这种东西你能在钟楼的钟怪身上找到。: You may find some from Alarm in the clock tower.
啊哈，有了这些指针，怀表就能修好了。: Aha, the pocket watch can be fixed with these hands.
这下可好了，让我来看看这破表。: Excellent. Let me take a look at this piece of junk.
好了！！修好了，这可不是一般的怀表。: Got it! It's fixed. This is no ordinary pocket watch.
这是解开时间停止之谜的关键。: It's the key to solving the mystery of stopped time.
对，事情要从几百年前说起，那时候我还是钟塔里的修塔工。: Correct. It all began centuries ago when I worked as a serviceman in the clock tower.
打开这块表，年轻人，你将看到当年发生的一切。: Open this watch and you'll see what happened back then.
时间好像回到了几百年前……: You feel time going backwards a few hundred years...
别担心，我亲爱的妹妹，我马上就要获得永生的力量了！: Don't worry, my dear sister. I'm about to receive the power of immortality!

哈哈哈哈，查普曼·艾伯特！你的时间将永远停在这一天。: Chapman Albert, you fool! Time will freeze for you from this day forward!
作为代价，你的妹妹将被我的手下困在时间的夹缝中，永远替你停住你的时间！！: My minions will trap your sister in the time crack to stop the time for you forever. This is the price you must pay!!
当年我和海拉死神签订了时间停止的契约，所以我的时间永远停住了。: I signed a contract with Hella, the goddess of death which caused my time to stand still forever.
你也看到了，因此我的妹妹被海拉的手下关进了时间的夹缝中。: As you can see, my sister is trapped in the Time Crack by Hella's minions.
几百年了，虽然我能不老不死，但我一点也不快乐。: It's been centuries. My immortality has brought me no happiness at all.
我想救出我的妹妹蒂尼，这一切都是因为我的贪婪咎由自取。: I deserve this, but I still want to save my sister Tini.
海拉留下了一枚怀表，只要解开这枚怀表之谜，就能把我妹妹从时间的夹缝中救出来！: Hella left me a pocket watch. Solve its mystery and I can save my sister in the Time Rift!

对的时间对的时钟将指引你开启时间的大门。: The right time and the right clock will guide you to open the gate of time.
每到傍晚六点十五分四十五秒时发光的表盘，还有这句“对的时间对的时钟将指引你开启时: The watch glows at 6:15:45PM each day and says "The right time and the right clock will guide you to open the gate of time" on its back. They must mean something.

傍晚六点十五分四十五秒。: At Six o'clock fifteen minutes forty-five seconds in dawn.

里面一定凶多吉少，我妹妹的安危就靠你了。: It must be dangerous in there. I'm counting on you to get her to safety.

好吧好吧，我知道你来此的目的。: OK, OK. I know why you're here.
我也是被海拉逼迫看守这里，至于怎么通过这些陷阱，我只能给你点提示。: I'm forced to guard this place by Hella. I can only give you clues about how to get past the traps here.
你是来解救我的吗？: Are you here to rescue me?
那我们快离开这个鬼地方吧！！: Get us the hell out of here then!
谢谢你帮我解救了我妹妹！: Thank you for rescuing my sister for me!

好了，把这瓶现形魔药撒在佐伊出没的城堡的四个角落: OK. Place this potion of revelation at four corners of the castle where Zoe was spotted

没想到我们这么快又见面了: I didn't expect to see you again so soon

你居然愿意帮我，你真的是个善良的冒险者。: You are willing to help me? You are a kindhearted adventurer in deed.
希默梅思把我的契约书分成了两半，分别藏在了古城的两个地方。: Himmelmez divided my contract in two and hid them in two locations in Glast Heim.
我已经知道其中半分就藏在某个恶魔侍者的身上。: I know one Incubus holds one half.
对，我已经被黑暗之王打伤，你能帮我把这半分契约找回来吗。: Correct. Now that I've been wounded by the Dark Lord, can you retrieve the first half for me?
这就是那份禁锢我的契约书！: This is the contract that binds me!

希默梅思向来喜欢玩弄别人，她知道我一心想拿回契约书就故意给我留了一道难题: Himmelmez always enjoys toying with others. She knows that I want the contract back more than anything, so she left a riddle for me to solve
她把契约书的线索分别告诉了二个她的宠物魔物。: The told the clues of the contract to two pets of hers.

这不是芙莎提到的罗杰中意的羽毛帽嘛！: This is the Roger's favorite feather bonnet Flea mentioned!

这家伙狡猾得很！能使用分身来分散敌人的注意力喵。: That guy is cunning! He uses clones to distract his foes.

所以他常年拖着条丑陋的狐狸尾巴！！喵哈哈哈: He always drags the ugly Nine Tails behind him!! Meowhahaha!
对，我相信你一定能识破他的障眼法！: Yes. I believe you can see through his disguise!
太好了，这可恶的喵喵大盗也该有人给他点颜色看看。: Excellent, it's about time someone taught this damned Cat Pirate a lesson.

看你的样子也不像是个钟表匠。你就试试吧。: You don't look like a watchmaker. Have a try anyway.
你身上有带变傻光线枪吗？: Do you have a Fooling Laser Gun?

尤兰达…你这淘气的小家伙，究竟去哪儿了？: Yolanda you naughty little guy, where have you gone?
嘻嘻，奶奶这次肯定找不到我了，我要好好玩一玩！: Hee hee, There's no way my grandma can find me this time. I'll enjoy this hard-earned freedom!
不同于普隆德拉的繁华，这里可真是一个悠闲的好地方啊。: Unlike the prosperity of Prontera, the pace of this place is slow, and it's good.
听说洛克萨妮最近抓到了一只溜溜猴做宠物，我什么时候才能也拥有一只呢？: I heard Roxanne captured a Yoyo as her pet. When can I have my own?
哥哥送我一只溜溜猴，嘻嘻，昆蒂娜都没有呢！: My brother gave me a Yoyo. Hee hee, not even Quentina has one!
我想我该离开这儿了，这里虽然安逸，但是缺乏挑战，而冒险就应该勇于探索未知！: I think I should leave here. This place is peaceful, but it lacks challenges. An adventurer like me is supposed to brave the unknown!
很荣幸能够接受到时钟守护者的邀请，要知道我很早就想来艾尔帕兰这座城市了！: I'm honored to be invited by the Clock Guardian. I've always wanted to come to the city of Al De Baran!
哇，这里真的好繁华，不过我还是觉得吉芬更好~嘻嘻！: Wow, this place is so prosperous. But I still prefer Geffen, heheh!
终于离开普隆德拉，来到了这里，艾尔帕兰的强者们，不要让我失望！: I'm finally here from Prontera. Let's see what worthy opponents Al De Baran has to offer.
你的身上并没有变傻光线枪，不要浪费我的时间，快去找一把。: You don't have a Fooling Laser Gun with you. Don't waste my time and go find one.
在假期途中接到加班的通知，还有比这更悲催的事儿吗？: I got recalled from my holiday to do extra work. What a tragedy.
你能帮我找到走失的佣兵猫吗？我一定会付给你满意的价钱。: Can you help me find the missing KittyCat? I'll pay you handsomely.
我可是喵喵岛上最勤奋的猫，它们谁也比不上我！: I am the most hardworking cat on Meow Island. They are no match for me!
这是佣兵猫罗杰最喜欢的羽毛帽……: This is KittyCat Roger's favorite Feather Bonnet...
这是一根太阳时钟上的时针……: This is an hour hand of Sundial...
这是一根太阳时钟上的分针……: This is an minute hand of Sundial...
这是一根太阳时钟上的秒针……: This is an second hand of Sundial...
这是一座拥有智慧的太阳时钟，只不过现在的它已经被损坏了。: This is a sentient sundial, but it's damaged now.
这是钟盘上的12点钟数字。: This is a number on a dial that represents 12 O'clock.
这是钟盘上的6点钟数字。: This is a number on a dial that represents 6 O'clock.
这是钟盘上的3点钟数字。: This is a number on a dial that represents 3 O'clock.
这是钟盘上的9点钟数字。: This is a number on a dial that represents 9 O'clock.
这是太阳密室的入口，通过这里可以前往太阳时钟的内部空间。: This is the Solar Chamber Entrace. One can enter the inner space of Sundial through here.
这只活泼的佣兵猫是卡普拉工作人员芙莎的得力助手。: This lively KittyCat is a great help to a Kafra employee call Flea
钟盘上的特定位置都显示着特定的数字。: The specific locations on the dial display specific number.
我研究普隆德拉北部生态已经很久了，这里很久以前还是一片平静的区域。: I've been studying the ecology of Prontera North for a long time. Long ago, this place was peaceful.
自从北边的蝗虫和苍蝇异变之后，我们只能龟缩在这片区域里——因为有城卫军的守护。: Since the mutation of Rockers and Chon Chons in the north, we've been huddling up here where we're protected by city guards.
但是这样下去不是办法，国王陛下派我研究这里的生态，就是为了解决这个问题。: We cannot live like this forever. The king sent me to study the ecology of this place in order to find a solution.
根据我的研究，这次事件恐怕与森灵一族有关。早年，我曾经见过他们的王，但是现在，我: Based on what I've discovered so far, this event probably has something to do with the Wormtails. I saw their king once years ago. But I haven't heard from the Wormtail King for a long time.
不仅仅是森灵王，就连木灵水灵土灵三位守护者都见不到了。: Not only the Wormtail King, but the 3 guardians of Wood Spirit, Water Spirit and Earth Spirit are also missing.
要解决问题一定要找到他们，可惜我不是那些凶狠魔物的对手…只能寄希望于你们勇敢的冒: They must be found if we want to solve the problem. Sadly I'm no match for the monsters... I can only rely on you brave adventurers!
木灵守护者喜欢树木密集的地方，你可以去树林中找到木灵守护者。: Wood Spirit Guardian likes places with a lot of trees. Go look for this guardian in the woods.
水灵守护者喜欢水，他应该在北部河流沿岸。: Water Spirit Guardian likes water. Search the river bank to the north.
土灵守护者则是喜欢呆在阴暗的角落，你可以去这里找到他。: Earth Spirit Guardian likes places that are dark and damp. You can find him here.
浓郁的木之气息散发，在草地上闪烁着氤氲光辉……: The grassland radiates a condensed aura of wood...
肮脏的人类！你竟然还敢来这里，不怕那些异变的魔物把你们撕碎吗？: Filty mortal! How dare you come here? Do you not fear the mutated monsters that can shred you to pieces?
想寻找我们的王？我们的王是不会见你们人类的！我们曾经天真地以为，人类与我们森灵能: You wish to find our king? Our king would never see you mortals! We once naively believed that mortals can get along with Wormtails. But we were wrong!
发生了什么？好，既然你想知道，就让你看看你们人类所做的好事！你确定要看？: What happened? If you must know, let me show you what you mortals did to us! Do you really want to know?
这是我们森灵一族的宝物，名叫木灵，看看它如今黯淡无光的样子！: This is Wood Spirit, the treasure protected by us Wormtails. Look at it now, Its light has faded!
还有这些吞食了木灵力量衍生出的怪物！它们都是你们人类的杰作！: And these monsters are creatures that consumed Wood Spirit's power! They are all your doing!
想见我们的王，行啊！从他们手中取回木灵！: You wish to see our king? Not a problem! You only have to take back the Wood Spirit from them!
嗯？没想到你真的能取回木灵。想见我们的王，你必须拥有三个物品。: Huh? You really took back the Wood Spirit. I'm surprised. You must have 3 items in order to see our king.
那就是木灵、水灵和土灵，木灵我可以给你，但是其他的只能你自己想办法了！: Wood Spirit, Water Spirit and Earth Spirit. I can give you the Wood Spirit, but I can't help you with the other two!
浓郁的水之气息散发，在河边上闪烁着氤氲光辉……: The river bank radiates a condensed aura of water...
人类？虽然我不讨厌人类，但是你们的所作所为，我也谈不上喜欢。没事的话，不要来打扰: A mortal? I don't dislike mortals, but I don't approve of what you did either. Leave me if you don't need anything!
你想见我们的王？没问题，但是你得先去河边看看，看看那些纯净的河水如今变成了什么样: You wish to see our king? OK, but first go to the river bank and see what the once clear water has become now.
这样，在我王诘问你的时候，你还不至于一无所知。: When our king asks you about this, at least you won't be completely ignorant of the situation.
河水有些浑浊，但是似乎没有什么异常……: The water is muddy, but seems normal...
河水虽然浑浊，但是还是能够看清，令人疑惑的是，为什么河里没有鱼呢？: The water is muddy but still clear enough for one to see what's in it. Strangely, There is no fish in the river.
水中的芦苇干枯发黄，河水中难道有些什么？: The reeds is the water are withered and yellow. Could there be anything unusual in the water?
看来你已经明白了什么。: Looks like you've figured it out.
可能你们还不清楚，这水质问题就是你们人类导致的吧。: You may not know it, but the water quality issue is caused by you mortals.
不过现在知道也不算晚，我真想看看，你要怎么面对我王的诘问。: It's not too late to know it now. I wish I could see your face when our king questions you.
这是我守护的水灵，如今它已经黯淡无光，再也不复往日的活力了。: This is the Water Spirit I've been safeguarding. Now its light has faded and not vigorous as it once was.
拿着它去见我们的王吧，事情总要解决的。: Take it to our king. Someone has to do something about it.
浓郁的土之气息散发，在土堆上闪烁着氤氲光辉……: The mound radiates a condensed aura of earth...
这片土地已经成为了现在这幅模样，再这么下去…人类？你们终于意识到你们做了什么了吗: This land has deteriorated into this. At this rate... A mortal? Have you finally realized what you've done?
看来你们还没有清醒地意识到你们到底做了什么…不过没关系，我王会解答你的问题。: Looks like you haven't realized yet... But it doesn't matter. My king will answer your questions.
我会把你送到土之秘境，去寻找土灵。需要提醒你的是，土之秘境现在已经大不一样了。: I'll send you to the earth realm in search of the Earth Spirit. I should remind you that the earth realm is not what it once was.
也许里面会存在很多土灵，而你要找出其中真正的土灵，并且把它带出来。: There might by a lot of Earth Spirits in there, but you must find the real one and get it out of there.
毫无能量的石头…不好！有什么要出现了！: A stone devoid of energy... No! Something is showing up!
一股晦涩的能量流转，难言的厚重感充斥全身…: Obscure energy flows and a sense of untold burden surges through you...
既然你找到了真正的土灵，那么就给你一个见我王的机会。: Now that you've found the real Earth Spirit, I'll give you a chance to see our king.
把这块土灵带走吧，你要知道，想要见我王，光有土灵是不够的。: Take this Earth Spirit with you. You should know that Earth Spirit alone is not enough if you want to see our king.
能不能拿到水灵和木灵就看你的本事了。好了人类，你可以离开这里了。: It's up to you to get Wood Spirit and Water Spirit. You may leave now, Mortal.
人类你终于来了…让我来告诉你发生了什么吧！: Mortal, You've come at last... Let me tell you what happened!
我们森灵一族自古就生活在这片区域，我族的至宝“森灵之心”，在木、水、土三灵的滋养: We Wormtails have been living here since ancient times. Nourished by the Spirits of Wood, Water and Earth, our crown jewel "Heart of Wormtail" maintained the ecological balance of this area.
普隆德拉建立以来，人族的活动对我们森灵的影响越来越大。: The impact of mortal activities on us Wormtail has been increasing since the founding of Prontera.
你们人类研究魔法之后所剩的魔法残渣倒入了北部河流，污染了水灵。: You mortals dumped the magic residues created by your magic research into the north river and polluted the Water Spirit.
魔法化肥的普及使用污染了土灵，大肆砍伐树林伤害了木灵。: The popularization of magic fertilizer polluted the Earth Spirit, and you hurt the Wood Spirit by cutting down trees recklessly.
它们在你们人类的影响下已经逐渐丧失了活力，以至于影响到了那些以树木河流为生的魔物: They lost their vitality under your influence, causing monsters that lived by the river and trees to mutate into the horrible monsters you see now.
我们森灵一族曾经想要阻止，但是失去了木灵、水灵、土灵的帮助，我们的至宝“森灵之心: We Wormtails once wanted to put a stop to it, but without the help of the Spirits of Wood, Water and Earth Spirit, Our precious "Heart of Wormtail" is tarnished.
这几年我一直在寻找让“森灵之心”恢复活力的方法，但是我失败了。: I've been looking for ways to rejuvenate the "Heart of Wormtail" these years, but to no avail.
冒险者，我知道你来的目的，我也希望能够解决北部区域的异变，同时也希望你能够想办法: Adventurer, I know why you came. I also wish to solve the mutation problem that plagues the north. And I hope you can find a way to help us rejuvenate the "Heart of Wormtail".
你愿意接下这份责任吗？: Do you wish to take this responsibility?
为了以防万一，我还是要验证一下你的实力，我们的至宝不容有失！: I still have to test your strength just in case. We can't take any chances when it comes to our crown jewel!
你的力量很不错，足够保护好我们森灵一族的至宝了。: You are strong enough to protect our most precious treasure.
我知道解决这个问题并非一朝一夕的事情，但是我还是想请你尽快解决。: I know this problem cannot be solved over night, but please make haste nonetheless.
原来是这样…一切的一切，都是我们人类咎由自取…: I see... All this is our own doing...
我会向国王陛下禀告，要求治理北门区域的污染，但是关于“森灵之心”，我实在是帮不上: I'll inform the king and request the pollution of north gate areas be deal with. As for the "Heart of Wormtail", There is nothing I can do to help...
不用担心这里，我相信北门在国王陛下的命令之下会越来越好。: You don't need to worry about here. I believe the north gate will be a better place by the order of our king.
也许某天森灵一族也不再需要“森灵之心”来维持这片土地的生态平衡了…: Maybe one day the Wormtails will no longer need the "Heart of Wormtail" to maintain the ecological balance of this land...
总之谢谢你的帮助。我调查出了北门异变的原因，扎克雷这次可没法跟我比了！: Thank you for your help. I've discovered the cause of mutation around the north gate, and way ahead of Jacquerie!
这“森灵之心”你就带着去冒险吧，也许在冒险的途中，你会找到你想要的答案。: Take this "Heart of Wormtail" on your journey. Maybe you'll find the answers you seek during your adventure.
你好冒险者，我是魔物研究协会的扎克雷，有关北门的魔物信息你都可以问我哦。: Greetings, adventurer. I am Jacquerie of the Monster Research Institute. You may ask me about monster around the north gate.
普隆德拉北门原本也是和南门一样，生活着人畜无害的波利和绿棉虫。: Harmless Porings and Fabres once inhabited the area around the north gate of Prontera, just like they did around the south gate.
它们虽然偶尔会给北门的人们带来一些麻烦，但是绝对不会引起大的骚动。: Occationally, They might cause some minor trouble for people around the north gate, but nothing serious.
但是它们现在发生了显而易见的变化，我甚至觉得它们与南门的生物不再是同一个物种。: But now their change is so dramatic that I think they've mutated into another species.
在很久之前，普隆德拉北门是一片和谐美好的土地，爱捣蛋的波利与绿棉虫与人们相处融洽: Long ago, the north gate of Prontera was a place where humans lived harmoniously with mischievous Porings and Fabres.
而现在因为某种原因，魔物们发生了某种异变，除了更具攻击性之外，它们的样子也有了很: But for some reason, the monsters mutated. They become more aggressive and their appearance is changed too.
它们的异变直接威胁了北门人们的安全，北门的人烟越来越稀少。国王陛下决不允许国都附: Their mutation poses a direct threat to the safety of people at the north gate, depopulating the area. The king couldn't allow dangerous areas like this to exist near the capital.
它们的异变对来往的人们构成严重的威胁，为了行人们的安全，国王陛下派遣我们来到这里: Mutated monsters pose a serious threat to people passing through. For people's safety, the king sent us here to study the monsters in hopes of finding their weakness.
我的同僚在克雷斯特汉姆的魔物研究上取得了重大的突破。而我作为魔物研究会的一员，也: My colleague has made a major breakthrough in studying monsters of Glast Heim. As a member of the Monster Research Institute, I should redouble my effort!
根据我的研究发现，受到影响的魔物只有那些蝗虫和苍蝇，它们现在演变为强大的重金属蝗: Based on my research, I discovered that only Rocker and Chon Chons are influenced, and now they've mutated into powerful Metallers and Dustinesses.
而波利和绿棉虫却没有受到影响，我猜测，是不是波利和绿棉虫身上有什么特殊的地方…: Porings and Fabres are not influenced at all. I wonder if there's anything special about them...
你能帮我从波利的身上收集一些波利的体液给我研究吗？: Can you collect some Poring's Body Fluid from Porings for me to study?
唔，我仔细的研究了波利的体液，发现它们的体液中掺杂着不纯净的能量。: Hmm. After studying Poring's Body Fluid closely, I discovered some impure energy in it.
这股能量非常少，以至于从外表看波利完全没有什么改变。: There is just a trace of it, not enough to cause a change in appearance.
但是这股能量我曾经看到过，是一种叫做“森灵”的魔物身上特有的能量。: I've seen this energy before. It's unique to a type of monsters called "Wormtail".
从那些森灵身上收集一些森灵的粘液，它们可比波利强大太多了，冒险者你要小心。: Collect some Wormtail's Mucus from Wormtails. Be careful, they are way tougher than Porings.
没错了！就是它们身体内的这股能量，不纯净的能量充斥着它们全身。: This is it! This is the energy in their body. The impure energy courses through them.
这种不纯净的能量影响了它们的思维，使它们变得更加暴躁，我想重金属蝗虫与猎蝇也是因: This impure energy influences their mind, making them more aggressive. Metallers and Dustinesses must be influenced by this energy too.
之前森灵身上的能量是纯净的，但是现在它们身上的能量明显是受到污染的。: The energy of Wormtails was once pure, but now their energy is obviously polluted.
如果能弄清楚它们身上的能量为什么会变成这样，也许我们的问题就能迎刃而解了。: If we can discover the cause of the pollution, maybe we'll find the solution to this problem.
也许我该去找一次克里斯蒂安，克里斯蒂安那里应该会有什么消息…这次多谢你的帮助了，: Maybe I should talk to Christian for information... Thank you for your help, adventurer.
做得不错，看来你已经得到了守护者们的认可。: Well done. You've gained the guardians' recognition.
接下来按顺序使用木灵、水灵和土灵，相信就能见到消失已久的森灵王了。: Use the Spirits of Wood, water and Earth in order and you'll see the long lost Wormtail King.
可别把我跟扎克雷那个脑筋死板的家伙比，我才是真正的研究者！: Don't compare me with that block-headed Jacquerie. I am a true researcher!
看，这蓬勃的树木和盎然的生机才是自然界最珍贵的东西。: Look. The flourishing trees and abundant life are what really matters in nature.
这片土地已经遭受了严重破坏，人类，你们是否清醒地意识到问题所在？: This land has suffered greatly. Mortals, do you realize where the problem lies?
曾经多么清澈可口的河水啊，而如今却变成了这幅模样。: The river water was once clear and sweet, but look at it now.
森灵一族必须要维持北部区域的生态平衡，但我们也需要人类的帮助。: The Wormtails must maintain the ecological balance of the northern area, and we need your help.
这是一块失去活力的木灵……: This Wood Spirit is devoid of vitality…
这是一块失去活力的水灵……: This Water Spirit is devoid of vitality...
这是一块失去活力的土灵……: This Earth Spirit is devoid of vitality...
这是森灵族的至宝，但现在好像也失去了灵性。: This is the crown jewel of the Wormtails, but it's lost its power.
这是一道神奇的传送门，通过它可以去往神秘的森灵秘境。: This is a peculiar portal leading to the mysterious Land of Wormtail.
这是一块真的土灵吗？这需要你自己去判断。: Is this really a piece of Earth Spirit? It's for you to decide.
嘿，伙计，能帮个忙不？: Hey, man, can you do me a favor?
你不会想错过一睹花海的机会吧？: You should not miss the chance to the flower sea, right?
我就知道你会帮我，你看着非常面善。: I knew you would help me. You look very kind.
是这样的，我的恋人泰丽莎正在和我赌气。: Well, my girlfriend Theresa is angry with me.
我们已经有三天没说话了，我可受不了这样。: We haven't talked for three days. I can't stand it.
我有个好主意，我知道一片秘密花海。: I have a good idea. I know of a secret flower sea
据说那里有世界上最美的花。: It is said that the most beautiful flower in the world is there.
要是能摘上一束送给泰丽莎，一定能看到她像阳光一般的笑容。: If Theresa could see this flower, she would smile like the sunshine.
我的哥们儿告诉我，南门有株神奇的七色叶。: My friend told me there was a Seven-colored Leaf at the South Gate.
对，那是株在阳光下能折射出七种色彩的奇幻植物。: Yes, it's a fantasy plant that reflects seven colors from the sun.
找到它就能找到通往秘密花海的入口。: To find it is to find the entrance to flower sea.
可我都在这儿傻傻找了两天了，别说七色了，三色的影子也没见到。: I have been looking here for two days, but I haven't found anything!
这不是拜托你，再和我一起找找。: Please help me look for it.
你可以去东边的桥旁找找，那里我还没仔细找过。: You can look at the bridge in the east, I didn't search there carefully.
这株植物如同法尔宾德描述般，阳光下能折射出七种奇幻的色彩。: Just as Farr Binder said, this plant reflects seven magical colors from the sun.

哟嚯~！[c][ffff00]艾尔帕兰[-][/c]最时尚的[c][ffff00: We have [c][ffff00]Al De Baran[-][/c]'s best [c][ffff00]hairdresser[-][/c]! Would you like a new hairstyle?
不知道为什么小野猪好像很喜欢我。: Surprisingly the Savage seems to like me very much.
我的生命，必将会引导真理的降临。: My life will lead the advent of truth.
我能看到无尽空间中，主宰的光辉。: I can see the God's glory in the boundless space.
最不喜欢去哪里：: The last place you'd like to go:
看来你已经满载而归了呢！让我看看你的材料是否足够吧！: Back already? Let me see if you have enough materials!
看来你没有收集到足够的蝗虫腿肉呢，你还是先收集够了再来找我吧！: You do not have enough Rocker Leg Meat, please get that ready!
看来你没有收集到足够的疯兔肉呢，你还是先收集够了再来找我吧！: You do not have enough Lunatic meat, please get that ready!
我只在[c][ffff00]普隆德拉七天[-][/c]，淘气的美羽小姐究竟去哪儿: I'll just stay in [c][ffff00]Prontera for seven days[-] [/c], where has Miss Meenu gone?
自我介绍一下，我来自北方的艾尔帕兰。我叫做扎库斯。: To introduce myself, I'm Zuckuss from Al De Baran.
冒险者，我在寻找一个叫做美羽的少女。你知道她的下落吗？: Adventurer, I am looking for a girl named Meenu. Do you know where she is?
实际上，我奉默斯曼大人的命令想请美羽前往艾尔帕兰。: In fact, I was ordered by Lord Mosman to invite Meenu to Al De Baran.
我曾经见过美羽小姐，但是美羽小姐拒绝了我的请求。: I once met Miss Meenu, but she refused my request.
之后我再也没见到美羽小姐，她好像在躲着我…: Then I never saw Miss Meenu. She seemed to be avoiding me.
呵呵呵呵…或许吧。。唉，我只会在[c][ffff00]普隆德拉七天[-][/c]: Erm.. Maybe. Well, I'll only be in [c][ffff00]Prontera[-] [/c] for 7 days, If we can't find Meenu, I'll be back to Al De Baran.
冒险者，你这么热心，一定会帮我找到美羽小姐的，对吗？: Adventurer, You will help me find Miss Meenu, Right?
咦？怎么是你？我还以为是那个笨骑士找过来了呢！: Huh? You? I thought that it to be the stupid knight!
哼，原来你找我也是为了让我去艾尔帕兰。: Well, Your purpose is to make me go to Al De Baran.
也不是不愿意啦！我只是想逗逗那个骑士。没想到那个骑士竟然找不到我。不好玩不好玩！: No really! I just tried to tease the knight. I didn't expect he cannot find me. Boring!
那个大块头[c][ffff00]只在普隆德拉停留七天[-][/c]？: The big guy [c][ffff00]stayed in Prontera for only seven days[-][/c]?
嘻嘻，那我准备一下就去艾尔帕兰了！: Then I'm ready to go to Al De Baran?!
那个大块头到了艾尔帕兰见到我一定很惊讶，哈哈哈哈，太好玩了！: The big guy must be surprised to see me in Al De Baran. Ha, so funny!
不许告诉那个大块头！不然我不去了！: Don't tell the big guy! Or I'm not going!
嘻嘻，你也一起来艾尔帕兰吧，我们在艾尔帕兰会合哦！: Come to Al De Baran! I'll see you there!
嘻嘻，我刚才默斯曼叔叔那里回来呢！: I just got back from Mosman's house!
正好你也去拜访一下默斯曼叔叔吧。默斯曼叔叔知道很多关于这座城市的事情呢！: You can also visit Uncle Mosman, he knows a lot about the city.
[c][ffff00]对了，记得明天也要来找我哦！[-][/c]: [c][ffff00]By the way, remember to come to me tomorrow![-][/c]
你就是美羽所说的那个冒险者吧？果然实力强大！: Are you the adventurer Meenu mentioned? Really strong!
你是想了解我们美丽的艾尔帕兰吧？那我可要好好说一说了。: You want to know our beautiful Al De Baran? Then I have a lot to tell you.
艾尔帕兰通商贸易发达，被誉为“商业之星”。: Al De Baran is known as "the Star of Commerce" for its developed trade and commerce.
这里还有卡普拉公司的总部，当然也有雷根贝勒公司的运输队驻扎。: There is also Kafra's HQ and, of course, Rekenber's transport team.
艾尔帕兰中具有相当发达的运河系统，它利用各村建立的风车来抽取地下水而形成人工运河: Al De Baran has a well-developed system that uses windmills built in villages to extract groundwater and form artificial canals. So it's also called the Capital of Canal.
值得一提的是，这里的炼金术也非常发达，炼金术士学院也坐落在这里。: Better yet, the alchemy here is quite developed, and the Alchemist College is also located here.
我身后的这座钟楼以及庞大的运河系统都离不开炼金术的帮助。: The clock tower behind me and the vast canal system all depend on alchemy.
钟楼内还存在着一个至宝，是我们守护者守护的对象。: There is also a treasure in the clock tower, the target of our guardians.
在艾尔帕兰中生活久了你就会明白。: You'll understand after you've lived in Al De Baran.
怎么样？要留在艾尔帕兰吗？我们艾尔帕兰非常欢迎冒险者们的驻扎。: How do you think? Want to stay in Al De Baran? We very welcome you adventurers!
哈哈哈哈哈…机会难得，你可以去卡普拉公司总部照张相哦。: Ha-ha... Seize the chances. You can take a picture at Kafra's HQ.
嘻嘻，宠物协会的会长叔叔给我带来了很多好吃的。: The pet association president has brought me a lot of delicacies.
冒险者你还没有见过阿格尼斯叔叔吧？: Adventurer, have you met Uncle Magnus?
你现在去找阿格尼斯叔叔，帮我谢谢他。: Now come to Uncle Magnus and thank him for me.
如果你有兴趣的话，叔叔也会告诉你一些他们协会的秘密哦～: If you're interested, My uncle will tell you some secrets about their association.
哈哈哈哈，美羽也太可爱了，不需要说谢谢的。: Ha-ha, Meenu is too cute, no need for thanks!
对，我就是宠物协会的会长阿格尼斯。冒险者你对宠物感兴趣吗？: Yes, I am Agnes, president of the pet association. Adventurer, are you interested in pets?
人类与魔物其实是可以成为朋友的。驯化后的魔物甚至可以成为人类冒险的好帮手！: Humans and monsters can be friends. Domesticated monsters can even be good helpers for human adventures!
这就是我一直宣传的理念，我的追随者们成立了宠物协会。: That's the idea I've been promoting, and my followers founded a pet association.
只要你有心想要和魔物和平共处，成为真正的伙伴。: As long as you want to live peacefully with the monsters and truly be their partner.
我们宠物协会可以帮助你达到目的。如果冒险者你愿意的话，可以随时来找我。: Our pet association can help with your goal. Adventure, You can come to me at any time if you want.
我可以教你如何驯化魔物！: I can teach you how to tame monsters!
嘻嘻，奥尔里昂叔叔送我一份好好吃的美食哦！: Hee, Uncle Orleans gave me a delicious food!
嘻嘻，你现在也可以去找找奥尔里昂叔叔哦，说不定他也会给你吃一份他做的料理呢！: You can visit Uncle Orleans now, maybe he will give you a meal of his cooking!
嘻嘻，你可以去试试嘛！[c][ffff00]记得明天也要来找我哦！[-][/c]: You can try it! [c][ffff00]Remember to come to me tomorrow![-][/c]
你是谁？你有什么资格来到这个料理的圣堂？: Who are you? Are you qualified to join this cooking sanctuary?
那个小丫头…哼，也是，没有人能够拒绝我的料理！: That little girl... Well, no one can refuse my food!
你想知道？哼，也好，我就让你体会一下自己是多么的无知！: You want to know? Well, I'll let you know how ignorant you are!
料理是一门艺术！经过料理大师的烹饪，各种食材能够最大的发挥自己的作用，成为一道道: Cooking is an ar?! Through the cooking of the chef masters, all kinds of ingredients can play their own role and combine to be a nice dish.
你以为料理仅仅是美味这种程度吗？肤浅！: Do you think the food is just delicious? Ignorant!
因为食材的原因，各种料理有时还会对冒险家有意想不到的作用：治疗伤势、解除中毒等等: Because of ingredients, cooking can sometimes have unexpected effects on adventurers: healing injuries, relieving poisoning and so on.
这使得料理行业在米德加尔特王国备受欢迎，这也是料理协会能够得到皇室支持，迅速发展: This has made cooking industry popular in Midgarts Kingdom, and that's why the Cooking Association can be supported by the Royal Family and develop rapidly.
如果你想学习料理的话，可以去碧莎那里报名。: If you want to learn cooking, You can find Pizza to sign up.
嘻嘻，告诉你一个消息哦~忽克连叔叔也来到了艾尔帕兰呢。: Here's the news, Uncle Hollgrehenn has been to Al De Baran.
嘻嘻，他好像带来了新的东西呢，你可以为找他问问看哦。: He seems to have brought something new. You can ask him about it.
我想你知道是什么东西了之后会很开心的！: I think you'll be happy when you know what it is!
唉，告诉你也没什么。: Well, it's okay to tell you.
看到我身边的炉子了没，现在它可以使用啦。: See the stove near me? Now it can be used.
你可以把你不需要的武器装备放进炉子。: You can put the unwanted weapons into the furnace.
它会把武器装备分解成装备升级的素材。: It will Salvage equipment into materials for equipment upgrading.
那当然！我忽克连一向是童叟无欺！: Of course! I'm a decent man!
以后有不要的装备，就把它带来扔到炉子里去吧！: If you have any equipment you don't want, bring it here and throw it in the furnace.
[c][ffff00]今天是最后一天啦[-][/c]，以后就要你自己去熟悉艾尔帕: [c][ffff00]from tomorrow you're going to learn Al De Baran by your own.[-][/c]
嘻嘻，其实你没事也可以来找我聊聊天的哦~: Actually, You can and talk to me if you're free.
今天你可以去找钟楼找克莱门德叔叔，他会告诉你一些关于钟楼的消息哦。: Today you can find Uncle Cleomedes in the clock tower. He'll tell you something about the tower.
新来的冒险者？好吧，今天我就介绍一下钟楼吧。: New adventurer? Well, let' me introduce the clock tower.
钟塔初建于A.W300-400年左右，整个工程耗费了百年时光。: The clock tower first built during A.W 300-400, the entire construction took a hundred years.
它分为钟楼一层、钟楼二层、钟楼地下三层。: It includes the first, Second, and third floor of the clock tower.
里面栖息着无数危险的魔物，最著名的恐怕就是钟怪了。: There are countless dangerous creatures in it, the most famous of which is the Alarm.
钟楼内还存放着大贤者巴特蒙德的“黄金时钟”。: The clock tower also stores the "Gold Clock" of Battmond, the great sage.
时钟守护者们一直在守护着这个“黄金时钟”。: The clock guardians have been protecting the "Gold Clock".
最近魔物的力量越来越强大了，守护者们也退守到钟楼之外。: Recently, the monster's power has grown stronger, and the guardians have retreated from the tower.
所以冒险者，如果你没有一定实力请一定不要深入钟楼。: So adventurers, If you don't have the strength, please don't enter the clock tower.
救星！你愿意听我说嘛？: Savior! Will you listen to me?
别这么冷淡嘛，这事儿可事关全城。: Don't be so cold. It's a matter for the whole city.
太好了兄弟，虽然我不认识你，但我感受到了你如料理一般的热情。: Great, even if I don't know you, I feel your passion.
最近我做的料理客人总是吃坏肚子……: My dishes always cause sickness lately...
一开始，我以为是自己的技术出了问题。: At first, I thought I had a problem with my techniques.
后来我发现事情并没有这么简单。: Then I found things weren't that simple.
我和几个餐馆的老板交流过，他们店里也出现了同样的问题。: I talked to the owners of several restaurants, and they had the same problem.
于是我们猜测，是城里的运河水出了问题。: So, we speculated that the canal water had a problem.
是的，你能帮我绕着城市取点水的样本来吗？我好调查调查。: Yes, can you help me get some water samples around the city? I need to investigate.
此处取的水似乎散发着一股淡淡的怪味。: The water here gives off a faint odor.
你可真是神速，这城市可是不小啊。: You are very quick. The city is quite large.
只见塔哈在尝了些河水后，两眼发直，神志开始有些不清晰。: Taha's eyes are losing focus after he drank the water.. He's becoming delirious...
什么，我刚才中毒差点失控？: What, I just got out of control?
我刚才喝了西边取的水！: I just drank water from the west!
那块可是有钟楼的排水口，我就说这事情不简单！: The clock tower's drain lies there, I knew things weren't so simple!
这方面我不是专家，但我肯定，是钟楼里的魔物搞得鬼！！: I'm not an expert in this field, but I'm sure it's the monsters in the clock tower!
这件事事关重大。: This matter is of great importance.
这样，我的好友辛迪是【时钟守护者】教团的一员。: Listen, my good friend Cindy is one of the [Clock Guardians].
我认为应该尽快让辛迪知道这件事。: I think Cindy should know about this as soon as possible.
我们已经派人去净化河水了，别担心。: We have sent someone to clean the river water. Don't worry.
但这并不是问题的源头。: But this is not the cause.
这件事，让我想到了最近黄金时钟的力量非常不稳定！: This incident reminded me that the power of the gold clock is very unstable recently!
是的，这座黄金时钟是带给艾尔帕兰人们幸福的时钟。: Yes, this gold clock brings happiness to people of Al De Baran.
很多年以前钟楼内发生过两次异变，使空间变得扭曲可怕。: Many years ago, there were two variations in the clock tower, making the space distorted.
是大贤者巴特蒙德的出现，他调试了黄金时钟，才好不容易平息了钟楼内混乱的时间规则。: Battmond, the great sage, debugged the gold clock so that the chaotic time rules were adjusted in the clock tower.
所以黄金时钟是稳固钟楼和整个艾尔帕兰城的核心，至关重要。: So the gold clock is the key to guarding the clock tower and all of Al De Baran.
我们的使命就是守护这座黄金时钟。: Our mission is to guard this gold clock.
我绝不允许有任何情况影响到黄金时钟的力量。: I'll never let anything affect the power of gold clock.
你有实力与我们【时钟守护者】一同前去调查此事吗？: Do you have the strength to look into this with the [Clock Guardian]?
很好，虽然目前我们还没查出影响黄金时钟的具体原因。: Good, though we don't know what's affecting the gold clock yet.
但还是请你去钟楼里调查一下。: But please investigate the clock tower.
有些时钟的零件散落在地，除此之外似乎没有什么异常。: Some parts of the clock are scattered on the ground. Except that, there seems to be nothing unusual.
齿轮转动的声音似乎有些刺耳不和谐。: The sound of turning gears is a bit jarring.
地上不知为何有些黏黏滑滑的液体，还散发着和之前河水一样淡淡的怪味。: There's a slimy liquid on the ground, giving off the faint odor of the river.
你确定是在钟楼的二楼发现了有异味的地方？: So, you found a smelly place on the second floor of the clock tower?
那里有个时钟守护者曾经建立的集会密室。: There was a secret chamber built by the clock guardians.
是的，蹊跷的是，这间密室只有两个人知道如何入内。: Yes. The odd thing is, only two people in this secret room know how to get in.
一个是我们伟大的领袖默斯曼·岁月！: One is our great leader, Mosman Time!
还有一个是岁月大人的亲信伯纳德·阿诺特。: The other is Bernard Arnault, a close friend of the Lord.
可是伯纳德却在上个月神秘失踪了，没有人知道他去了哪里。: But Bernard disappeared last month, and no one knows where he has gone.
我最后一次看见他，他的神情慌慌张张的。: The last time I saw him, he looked flustered.
眼里还冒着诡异的……黄绿色的光。: HIs eyes were like shining green lights...
确实有必要去调查一下那间密室了，我是没有权限进入的。: We must look in that secret room. I don't have access.
但冒险者你的胆量和实力实在让我佩服，我相信岁月大人会给你这个权限。: But your courage and strength really admiring, I believe the Lord will grant you this authority.
我就告诉你开启密室的方法吧。: I'll tell you how to open the secret room.
我在钟楼地下藏了一个存放密室钥匙的小箱子。: I hid the key in a small box in the basement of clock tower.
将箱子里的钥匙放在你之前调查的那个位置，然后默念魔法。: The key is in a box in the area you investigated before.
我会派另一名守卫者狄娜与你一同前去，我已经告知了她。: I will told another guardian, Tina, to go with you.
记住，先找到箱子。就在神圣的石像旁。: Remember, find the box first next to the sacred statue.
是否取走钥匙？: Do you want to take the key?
是岁月大人派我来协助你调查的。: Mosman sent me to assist your investigation.
现在，我将吟诵打开密室的魔法。: Now I will recite the magic spell opening the secret chamber.
是最长也最短……: It is the longest and shortest...
最珍贵却最被忽略……: The most precious but most neglected.
时间守卫者的密室已经被打开。: The time guardian's chamber has been opened.
事不宜迟，我们进去看看。: Hurry up, let's have a look.
是否要进入密室？: Do you want to enter the secret chamber?
到处散发着怪异的恶臭，地上布满了粘液。: This place is stinky, and the ground is covered with mucus.
什么！？伯纳德你怎么在这里。: What? Bernard, what are you doing here?
哈哈哈哈，你们还不明白吗！！: Oh, don't you get it, huh?
废话，蠢货，我的目的当然就是破坏黄金时钟！: Of course, idiot. I must break the Gold Clock!
你！！！岁月大人如此信任你！: Lord Mosman trusted you so much!
反正现在事情已经暴露了，你们两个……: Things have been exposed, you two...
你们还没意识到，那位大人就要来了！！: You don't realize that the Lord is coming!
到时候你们都得完蛋！哈哈哈！: It's time! You're all done! Haha!
刚才那个叛徒说到什么大人……: What did the traitor say, my lord?
好像此事并没有结束一样。: It seems things did not end.
来的时候我看密室周围的样子总觉得有些不对劲。: I thought something was wrong in the chamber.
我们分头再调查一下。: Let's split up and investigate again.
依旧是黏稠充满怪味的液体，密室周边的空气似乎比其他地方潮湿许多。: Again, the thick and odorous liquid. Air around the chamber seems so humid.
地上居然有一片红色的闪亮鳞片，这会是线索吗？: There is a piece of a red and shiny scale on the ground, is it a clue?
果然，事情似乎没那么简单。: Sure enough, things are not so simple.
此事有必要向岁月大人汇报一下。: You must report this to Lord Mosman.
我还需要留在此处善后，万事就拜托你了。: I should stay here and cope with the aftermath. Everything is up to you.
伯纳德居然叛变了……真是让我心痛。: Bernard turned his back on us. It really hurt me.
不过你在这场危机当中的表现实在是太勇敢了。: But you are so brave in this crisis.
谢谢你与我们一同守卫了艾尔帕兰的秩序。: Thank you for guarding Al De Baran with us.
告诉你一个好消息，河水已经全部被净化完毕了。: The good news is that the river has been completely purified.
这里面也有你不可或缺的功劳，再次感谢你。: Your efforts are indispensable, thanks a lot.
至于伯纳德嘴里提到的人……: As for the one mentioned by Bernard...
和这片红色的鳞片应该有密不可分的联系。: It must has something to do with this red scale.
这背后一定还存在着什么更大的阴谋。: There must be something more to this
我们【时钟守护者】一定会彻查此事的。: We [Clock Guardians] will investigate this matter .
拍好了？艾尔帕兰的美景数不胜数。有空你可以多多拍照。: You got it? Al De Baran has many scenic places. You can take a lot of pictures in spare time.
冒险者欢迎你以后常驻艾尔帕兰！: Adventurers, welcome to stay in Al De Baran!

冒险者请帮我教训教训它们吧！: Adventurers, please help me punish them!

魔力熔炉上的锈迹都不见了，看起来干净了不少。: The rust on the magic furnace is gone, it is much cleaner.

最近我的餐厅生意十分冷淡，这可愁坏我了！: My restaurant rarely has business, what should I do?!

岁月大人是我们的领袖，他时常告诉我们要为了艾尔帕兰的未来而奋斗终生。: The Lord is our leader, he tells us to fight for the future of Al De Baran for life.
这是一条通往时间密室的时空甬道。: This is a space passage leading to the Secret Room of Time.
嘿嘿，为那位大人效劳，是我的荣幸！: Yeah, it is my pleasure to serve the Lord.
你居然这么强大，咳咳，不过这可不算完！: You're so powerful! But this is not the end!

真没想到发生这样的惨剧…: No one expected such a tragedy to happen...

我丈夫的死因一定与雷根贝勒的詹金斯脱不了干系。: Hunnam's death must have something to do with Jenkins in Rekenber.

真的吗！！你可要说到做到…: Really? Oh! You have to keep your words!

你现在回去找找妮薇儿。如果我的猜测没错的话…: Go back and find Niewheal. If I was right...

婚礼上的暴动将会是灾难的开端！: The wedding riots will be the beginning of disasters!

在艾尔帕兰我想你一定听过时间先知的大名。: I think you've heard the name of Time Prophet of time in Al De Baran.

《秘法典籍》的重要性我想你也能明白。: Surely you know the importance of the Secret Books.

是哥哥让你来找我的？: My brother sent you to me?

冒险者，请留步！请容我做一个简短的自我介绍。我叫特奇，是冒险者协会的导师，我的工: Adventurer, please stay! Please allow me to give a brief introduction. My name is Terch, the mentor of the Adventurer's Guild. My job is mainly to guide the new adventurers.

请问你是否有兴趣成为冒险者导师呢？: Are you interested in becoming a mentor?

我们需要找到的是达到[c][ffff00]base80级[-][/c]，并且[c: Who we need are the adventurers who have reached [c][ffff00]Base Lv. 80[-][/c], and [c][ffff00]are currently not following any mentor[-][/c].
去努力吧，年轻人！你的人生还很漫长，不像我，已经是个老头子了，多去冒险吧！: Go and try hard, young man! Your life is still fresh. I'm an old man, you're not like me. Go for more adventures!
不愿意吗？好吧，我很看好你的能力，随时来找我，冒险者，我一直在这里等你！: Unwilling? Well, I am very optimistic about your ability. Come to me at any time, adventurer, I will be waiting for you here!
就是要有这种精神！每一位冒险者刚进入大陆时都充满了迷茫，作为资深冒险者，我们必须: That's the spirit we need! Every adventurer is full of confusion when he first entered the land. As senior adventurers, we must carry the responsibility to teach new ones!
我准备了一些问题，你准备好了就来找我吧！: I have some questions. Come and find me when you are ready!
那么，[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]，你知道当你的: So, [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], do you know what you need to do as a mentor when your student meets obstacles in learning?
{换个学员,6},{体罚学员,6},{鼓励学员,7}: {Change a student,6},{Punish the student,6},{Encourage the student,7}
你知道，如果学员想要增加自己的冒险者等级，可以做些什么？: Do you know what a student can do if he wants to upgrade his adventurer level?
你知道，传送服务是哪个公司为冒险者提供的吗？: Do you know which company is providing Teleport service for adventurers?
不对，冒险者，你的冒险经验还不够丰富啊，好好准备一下再回答我的问题吧。: No, adventurer, your adventure experiences are not enough. Be prepared and answer my question.
我果然没有看错你，冒险者，我已经预感到你会成为一个非常优秀的导师了！: You didn't let me down, adventurer. I foresee that you will become a very good mentor!
冒险者，你通过了我的考核，马上就可以成为一名导师了。: Adventurer, You passed my test and you will become a mentor soon.
但是还有一件事情，我们的导师有许多话想对你说，你愿意去聆听他们的教诲吗？: But one more thing. Our mentors have many things to tell you. Are you willing to listen to them?
如果你准备好了，我就把你送到冒险者同盟的总部。: If you are ready, I will send you to the HQ of the Adventurers League.
我要开启传送阵了！嘿！: I'm going to open the Portal! Hey!
还有什么事情吗？快点处理了就去见见导师们吧，大家都很期待你的加入。: Anything else? Go to see the mentors as soon as possible. Everyone is looking forward to your joining.
上次见到你，只是一个干劲十足的初心者，没想到这么快成为导师了。: The last time I saw you, You were just a motivated novice. I didn't expect you to be a mentor so soon.
做为导师，是一件辛苦的事情，对待学员一定要有耐心！不仅要指导他们变强，还要教育他: Being a mentor is a hard work. You must be patient with your students! You need to not only guide them to become stronger, but also guide them to be honest and kind.
也不要因为成为导师就疏于对自己的锻炼，我会一直监督你的！: Don't neglect your own exercise because you become a mentor. I will always be supervising you!

继续朝前走吧，冒险者，希盖伊兹在等着你。: Keep moving, adventurer. Higgy Eez is waiting for you.
我已经从特奇那里听说了你的考核成绩，他对你赞不绝口！只要完成最后的宣誓，你就可以: I heard about your performance from Terch. He praised you! As long as you swear the final oath, You can become a mentor.
我将会召唤出诺言之球，请你把手放在诺言之球上发誓。: I'm going to summon the Ball of Promise. Please put your hand on it and swear.
请你郑重的对待这件事情！严肃宣誓！: Please treat it solemnly! Swear the oath solemnly!
我感受到了你的誓言里的力量，请你记住今天你所说的话，在往后的日子里履行你对我的承: I feel the power in your oath. Please remember what you said today, Fulfill your commitment to me in the days to come, and live up to my expectations.
从今往后，你就是冒险者导师的一员，去告诉特奇，你已经完成了宣誓吧。: From now on, you are a member of the mentors. Go and tell Terch that you have sworn the oath.
呼，释放诺言之球好累啊……让我喘一口气……: Huh, summoning Ball of Promise makes me tired... Let me take a breath...

你的导师之路还有很长的路要走，去学习，去感受，跟你的学员共同进步吧！: Your still have a long way to go as a mentor. Learn, feel and make progress with your students!
每天看着学员毕业，我都好想哭( >﹏<。): Watching the students graduate every day, I really want to cry ( >﹏<。)
[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]，我是冒险者协会的高: [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], I am the senior mentor of the Adventurer's Guild. Congratulations, you have reached [c][ffff00]Base Lv. 80[-][/c] and you can graduate now.

这个评价很高啊，我们的冒险者导师能得到你这样的肯定，会很高兴的！: This evaluation is very high. We mentors will be very happy when we get this kind of affirmation!
没什么帮助吗？是我们导师的教导能力问题吗？也许我们应该提高冒险者导师的门槛。: No help? Is there any problem with our mentor's teaching ability? Maybe we should raise the threshold of becoming a mentor.
只是有点帮助吗？ 真可惜啊，看来我们还有值得改进的地方！: Is it just a little help? What a pity! It seems that we still have something to improve!
虽然已经达到可以毕业的等级了，但是，也不能认为你可以独自冒险。: Although you have reached the level that you can graduate, but you can't think that you can take adventures on your own.
我有一些关于冒险的常识性问题，全部答对才能获得毕业资格，你准备一下，就可以找我答: I have some questions about some general knowledge of adventure. You need to answer all of them to be qualified to graduate. Get ready and come to answer the questions.
唔……第一题比较简单，如果你想要制作一顶精美的帽子，需要找什么人呢？: Hey... The first question is simple. If you want to make a fine hat, who do you need to come to?
如果你想要获取宠物的好感度，你需要对宠物做些什么呢？: If you want to gain pet's Intimacy, what do you need to do for your pet?
上古时期，打败了魔王梦罗克的英雄叫什么名字？: In ancient times, what was the name of the hero who defeated the Demon King Morroc?
看来你还需要一点锻炼啊，好好准备一下再回答我的问题吧。: It seems that you still need a little more exercise. Be prepared and then come to answer my questions.
答得漂亮，你已经成长为老练的冒险者了，我为你骄傲！: Great, you have grown into an experienced adventurer. I am proud of you!
你已经通过了我的考核，是不是感觉还挺简单的？: You have passed my test. Is it quite simple?
我这个人比较容易心软，作为考官总是想放学生一马。哎呀！下次要出难一点的题目！: I am soft-hearted. As an examiner, I always want to let students pass. Hey! The next time I will have some difficult questions!
你马上就可以毕业了。在此之前，还有一件事情需要你完成，希盖伊兹有些话想对你说，快: You can graduate soon. Before that, There is one more thing that needs you to finish. Higgy Eez has something to tell you. Go and listen to him.

[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]，做好准备了吗？不要: [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], are you ready? Don't be afraid, we are all your strong backing.

我将会召唤出诺言之球，你需要触摸一下诺言之球，然后宣誓。: I will summon the Ball of Promise. You need to touch it and swear the oath.

赠送规则：\n1.近30天内玩家每次充值都能获得等值*10000的赠送额度，每次:
Gifting rules: 
1. Each time the player recharges in the last 30 days, He will get a quota of equivalent value *10000. Each successful gifting will deduct an amount eual to the Zeny price of the item. 
2. Gifting requires a certain amount fee. The higher the value of the gift, the more the required fee. 
3. Only one gift can be gifted at the same time. Gifts worth less than 100, 000 Zeny cannot be gifted. 
4. The gifted item is delivered by the Gingerbread deliveryman. After the item is delivered, the player has five minutes to receive or reject it. 
5. If the gifting fails, the item will be returned to the player's transaction record. The player can continue to choose to gift or receive. 
6. The gifting button is reserved for up to 3 days.

1.每日超过指定战斗时长，经验和掉落开始衰减。\n2.每日凌晨5点恢复300分钟:
1. EXP and loots begin to decrease during the time over combat duration.
2. Combat duration restores 300 minutes at 5 am daily. Unused combat duration can be accumulated for up to 600 minutes.
3. PVP does not count the combat duration, MINI and MVP are free from the decrease rule.
4. If you are in a team during decrease period, only yourself will be subjected to the rule and your teammates will not be affected.
5. If the teammates and you are on the same map, when they fight, the combat duration will be shared with all teammates on this map.
6. Voice technology is provided by iFLYTEK, HKUST.

战利品规则：\n1.战利品预览仅是预览，具体冒险结束后获得的奖励与预览存在一定出:
Rules of trophy:
1.Trophy preview is only for preview, Actual reward is determined after the adventure.
2. The adventure in each area can be repeated, Players spend adventure meatballs and daily combat time to start adventure and therefore receive specific rewards within the area and EXP rewards for pets involved in the adventure.
3.The trophy of each region is affected by adventure efficiency, which is determined by the level of area, Pet's level, Quantity, Intimacy, and pet's relationship with the area; the higher the efficiency, the more rewards you get for each adventure.
4.Rare trophies are affected by pet's abilities; and for each requirement of pet ability you meet, you receive a rare reward of that area..

关于【占卜·星座的指引】，有几个游玩注意事项希望客人您能稍微聆听一下。\n每位冒:
About [Zodiac], there are a few notes for you before playing the game. 
Every adventurer has one chance of divination everyday with the one who holds your hand to obtain the guidance of constellation or the one of love. If you already get the item from the guidance of [Love] or [Zodiac], you will not be able to obtain another one even if playing the game again~ 
Special benefit: Every adventurer has a chance to change the result everyday, Though you need to buy [Invitation from Stars] , a special item in the Zodiac Shop first. As long as the adventurer who starts the divination has the special item, the adventurer who is invited but without the item can also obtain an item of the guidance of constellation. But in this way, Every adventurer only has one chance to change the result. 
Notice: Adventurers can obtain the item of the guidance of constellation again after 5 a.M. When stars change their directions~

从材质上看，是一把造价昂贵的弓，可惜已经损坏了，收藏家格卡莱斯正在收集这种物品，: From the material we can know that it is a costly bow, but unfortunately it has been damaged. Collector Gary Calais is collecting it, he needs 35 of them to fix the bow.
一个神奇的宝珠，拥有将一切心智不坚定的人诱惑并且堕落黑暗的魔力，古城大厅的收藏家: A magical orb with the magic of tempting and depraving all the mindless. Collector Morgul in the Glast Heim Hall is looking for it.
传说勇者莫特利所持有的武器，跟随莫特利挑战过诸多魔物，古城大厅的收藏家摩尔古正在: A weapon held by the brave Motley in the legend, which had been with Motley in challenging many monsters. Collector Morgul in the Glast Heim Hall is looking for it.
如同血色一般，充满诅咒力量的宝石，是德古拉男爵最为喜爱的宝石。古城大厅的收藏家摩: The favorite gemstone of Dracula which is bloody and full of cursing power. Collector Morgul in the Glast Heim Hall is looking for it.
传说看守奥丁神殿之门的兰特克力斯所拥有，奥丁赐予他自由来往神殿与俗世的传送石，古: Legend has it that Randgris who was guarding the gate of Odin Temple once owned it. Odin gave it to him so that he could come to and leave from the temple freely. Collector Morgul in the Glast Heim Hall is looking for it.
利维坦是古今著名的大海盗，他利用一个别致的金沙漏来打开时空之门。轻松的穿梭回过去: Leviathan is a famous pirate in history. He used a unique golden sand clock to open the door of time and space, Easily go back to the past to solve the troubles that would change the future. One day, Leviathan’s ship encountered a storm at sea, and his assistant, who is jealous of him, Broke his golden sand clock. Leviathan instantly turned into sand and drifted away with the storm over the boundless sea with the sand in the sand clock together. Later, his assistant who harmed him died in an accident, but no one had ever seen the famous pirate again. Koumas Staw in the second floor of the Clock Tower, who is a clock and watch fan, Is looking for the item.
艾尔帕兰城内曾有位通晓未来的魔女，通常是神秘地地罩在面网里，不示人以真面目，脸面: In Al De Baran, there was a witch who knew the future, usually mysteriously hiding in a veil, not showing people the true face. In the direction she was facing, her hand always took a crystal ball wrapped in silk, but she never opened it, as if it contained the secrets of future. No one knew what her name was. When someone asked her about where she was from, she always answered, "from the remote future." Koumas Staw in the second floor of the Clock Tower, who is a clock and watch fan, is looking for the item.
马莱不仅是位天才魔法师，还是很杰出的钟表师。凭着才华与天赋做出了一只能时间旅行的: Marlet was not only a genius Mage, but also an outstanding horologist. With the talent, He made a clock that can only travel in time. As long as the pointer was pushed, He can go to the time on the clock. However, Marlet’s wife was insatiably greedy and wanted to maintain her youthful beauty. She broke all the pointers on the clock. The genius Mage and his wife were trapped forever in a closed space where the time never passed. Koumas Staw in the second floor of the Clock Tower, who is a clock and watch fan, Is looking for the item.
