刻满了符文般深奥难解的字符的金色碎片，边缘有着光滑的曲线，由此判定，这是某件圆盘: A golden Shard engraved with rune-like characters, with smooth curves on the edges. From this we can know that this is a Shard of a disc. The Alien investigator Naru is looking for 12 Shards.
材质上是人骨的碎片，根据骨骼的坚硬程度与纹理分布，应该属于人类的头骨碎片。异世界: A Shard of human bone. According to the hardness and texture distribution of the bone, it should belong to a human skull. The Alien investigator Naru is looking for 18 Shards.
某种石质的碎片，上面客满了神秘的阵符，这些符文似乎是某个炼金阵的一部分。异世界调: Some kind of stony Shard, Carved with mysterious runes, which appear to be part of an alchemy array. The Alien investigator Naru is looking for 10 Shards.
上面印着黄色星星的蓝色布条，这些星星似乎代表着某种深邃的含义。异世界调查员纳鲁正: A blue strip with yellow stars printed on it, which seem to represent some profound meaning. The Alien investigator Naru is looking for 15 strips.
似乎由昂贵的黄金所铸造而成的利刃，但是延伸之处有明显断痕，也许它不仅仅是把利刃。: It seems a sharp blade cast from expensive gold, but there is a clear break in the extension. Perhaps it is not just a sharp blade. The Alien investigator Naru is looking for 20 Shards.
一瓶混着金箔的绵密白色细沙，在光的折射下发出闪闪金光。瓶体上贴着贝利兄弟的标签，: A bottle of dense white sand mixed with gold foil, shining under the light, with Bailey Bros label pasted on it. It's an important item to unlock the quest [Sin of Time].
相片上艾波娜幸福的拥着一个丑陋的大块头，那便是时间怪物西罗诺。艾波娜丝毫不在意他: In the photo, Epona is happily holding on to an ugly big man. That's the time monster Syrono. Epona don't care about his appearance. Her eyes are full of love and her mouth is slightly raised and she is squinting at Syrono.
对时钟守护者有过帮助的冒险者才能得到的奖章，有此勋章的人会受到所有时钟守护者成员: A medal that can be obtained by an adventurer who has helped the Clock Guardian. The person who has this medal will be respected by all members of the Clock Guardian.
暴君休密兹花费巨资打造的王冠，上面镶嵌着两种顶级的宝石，更有符文大师在其上铭刻符: A crown built by the tyrant Hermiz, who spent huge sums of money, inlaid with two top-level gems, and with runes engraved by rune masters. It's a priceless treasure.
寄托着莫里森与盖妮爱情的留影水晶，随着盖妮的逝去，留影水晶中的能量也流逝殆尽，成: A recording crystal that enshrines Morrison and Gani’s love. With the death of Gani, the energy in the crystal was also gone, Becoming a luxurious crystal Shardt.
一份来自B格猫的新年贺卡嘿，冒险者们。新年的钟声敲响了，B格猫星人集体祝福大家新: A New Year's card from the Big Cat. Hey, adventurers. The bell of the New Year has rung, and we cats wish everyone a happy new year and a good Year of the Rooster! This is the first Chinese New Year festival we have ever had together. In 2017, We want to be with everyone in a lot of festivals. At present, We still have many shortcomings. We are working hard to work with everyone to build this wonderful world! Thank you for your support and tolerance, Here is a small gift for you. Happy New Year! - <Big Cats>
又名“星尘档案”。它记录着隐匿于龙谷中的神秘组织“漆黑部队”的来历。这些以女武神: Also known as "Stardust File". It records the origin of the mysterious organization "Black Army" hidden in the Dragon Valley. These warriors marked by Valkyrie helmets were once the heroes of the epic "Nibelungen Ring". They returned to the world from Valhalla, and guarded the Dragon Valley secretly. Like stardust, They illuminate the darkness with shimmering light.
古尔顿有着令人羡慕的体质，他丝毫不受瘟疫的影响，国王得知后，请求古尔顿能够舍生取: Gultom had an enviable constitution. He was not affected by the plague at all. After the king learned that, he asked Gultom to take risks to be a hero to save the kingdom from the plague. Gulton accepted. Several Archmages used magic to extract the plague and poured it into Gultom's body.
在古尔顿被王国赶出城市后，卡丽莎不辞辛苦的找到古尔顿，质问古尔顿是否抛弃了她，当: After Gultom was expelled from the city by the kingdom, Carlis took the trouble to find Gultom and questioned whether Gultom had abandoned her. When she saw Gutom's disgusting plague, she realized everything.
国王的反应让古尔顿失望透顶，他摘下了自己的面具，瘟疫瞬间夺取了国王与事务官的生命: The king's reaction made Gultom disappointed. He took off his mask and the plague instantly killed the King and the Royal Affairs Officer. He knew his good friend Clay was on his side and he had already revenged. Carlis's death blew him hard. He begged Clay to give him a fatal blow...
卡丽莎从古尔顿的小屋中离开，没想到王国事务官已经在门口等待着她，事务官以怀疑她身: Carlis left from Gulton's cabin. She did not expect the Royal Affairs Officer to wait for her at the door. The officer hanged her for the reason that she was suspected of carrying plague.
一场突如其来的瘟疫，改变了古尔顿的一生。古尔顿拥有对瘟疫的超强抵抗力，这使得他成: A sudden plague changed Gultom’s life. Galtom had a strong resistance to the plague, which made him the only person who could end the disaster. So the kingdom used the power of the High Wizards to guide almost all the plagues onto Gultom. Galtom made a wreath for Carlis, and Gultom’s mood was undoubtedly very happy. However, it didn't last long. Gultom was suffering from a plague and had to move out from the densely populated city. Carlis was tried hard to look for Gultom, and finally found him in the jungle outside the city. Gultom was frightened, Ask Calis not to come over, but Carlis didn't care... Good guys always have bad luck. And Galtom was wrong. When the danger is over, People will kill all the dangers in the cradle, For fear that they will be hurt again. People are such a creature. When Carlis shouted loudly on the gallows, These indifferent people were not ashamed of it. Most of the people were also sitting on the sidelines, and even clapping their hands. The death of Carlis caused a considerable blow to Galtom. Gultom chose to revenge, and this revenge is reasonable. He released his plague and the repressed plague broke out even more brutally. In a matter of moments, Both the King and the Royal Affairs Officer were killed. At the end of the matter, He let his friend Clay take his life and made the plague disappear.
一个名叫古尔顿的日记，短短几页的纸张记载着骇人听闻的瘟疫爆发事件。古尔顿的友人在: A diary of a man called Gultom. A few pages record the shocking outbreak of the plague. Gultom's friends died in the plague. Gultom suspected that the plague broke out because they had worked in the sewers and were attacked by the Cramps.
一个名叫古尔顿的日记，短短几页的纸张记录着与一位名叫卡丽莎的女孩在一起的愉快时光: A diary of a man called Gultom. A few pages record his happy time with a girl named Carlis. And on the occasion of Carlis’s birthday, he was carefully preparing his present, imagining the happy life of them in the future. But the happy time is always short...
卡丽莎已经很久没有来看望城外的古尔顿了，这使得古尔顿异常伤心，古尔顿决心去质问卡: Carlis had not been visiting Gultom for a long time outside the city. This caused Gulltom to be sad. He determined to question what happened to Carlis, but got a message that made him unacceptable.
古尔顿决心要报复，他放弃携带友人送给他可以抑制瘟疫的面具，他决心要让那些恶毒的伪: Gultom determined to revenge. He gave up the mask that his friend gave him to suppress the plague. He determined to let those vicious hypocrites taste the fear of death.
二王子殿下失踪之后，王宫附近出现了一个诅咒魔人，与他近距离接触的人们都遭受到了诅: After the disappearance of the second prince, a Cursed Deviruchi appeared around the palace. People closely contacted with him suffered a curse, and the people became Gluttony monsters. This led the great prince to make up his mind that no matter what the connection between the second prince and the Cursed Deviruchi is, he must be destroyed! Dayton, the most royal knight of the great prince, accept the order and start off...
三王子殿下失踪了，于此同时，王宫附近出现了一个诅咒魔人，任何他去过的地方，所有物: The third prince had disappeared. At the same time, a Cursed Deviruchi appeared around the palace. Any place he had been to, All the items would be decayed, and the hard-earned money of the people would be turned into dust. The great prince who loved the people would certainly not allow this to happen. He ordered Knight Dayton to relieve the people's pain...
诅咒魔人出现了，他的诅咒带来了一次次争斗，王都因为魔人的诅咒，流血事件不断发生，: The Cursed Deviruchi appeared, his curse brought battles again and again. Many fights happened in the capital because of the curse of him. The great prince decided to order Knight Dayton to punish this evil deviruchi. And the great prince discovered that his fourth brother had been out hunting and there was no news for a long time...
当仅剩的五王子逃出了皇宫，大王子对外宣称发现第四位诅咒魔人，再次命令骑士代顿前往: When the only remained fifth prince escaped from the palace, the great prince declared that he found the fourth Cursed Deviruchi, and ordered Knight Dayton to eliminate the fifth prince. However, Dayton, who was suspicious of the great prince, did not eliminate the so-called Cursed Deviruchi. The fifth prince told Dayton that his three brothers' death were a conspiracy of the great prince. Dayton once killed the three princes and had violated his knight spirit, he decided to be responsible for his crimes. But before that, he still had things to do...
权力是魔鬼，大王子被魔鬼所诱惑，陷害了三位王子，而他的恶行终于被自诩正义的骑士代: The power is a devil and the great prince was seduced by the devil and framed the three princes. And his evil deeds were finally discovered by the righteous knight, Dayton. Dayton could not forgive himself, Nor could he understand the prince he was giving allegiance to. He understood that once the great prince inherited the throne, This was not a good thing for the kingdom. He decided to violate the last rule of the knight spirit - loyalty! After the death of the great prince, Dayton brought back the fifth prince he had hidden, and warned the fifth prince that power was the demon in everyone's heart, and he must defeat this demon! Dayton, who was promised by the fifth prince, Ended his own life in the hall.
王宫的二王子离奇失踪后，王都出现了一个名为“暴食者”的诅咒魔人。骑士代顿奉大王子: After the second prince of the palace were missing, a Cursed demon named Gluttony appeared in the capital. Knight Dayton went to kill him under the order of the great prince. Soon after, the third prince disappeared. At the same time, a Cursed demon named Decayed appeared around the palace. The great prince who loved the people would never allow him to cause disasters in the capital. And Knight Dayton was once again ordered to eliminate him. Then the Cursed demon named Fighter appeared, his curse brought endless fights. Because of his curse, Bloodshed happened in the capital. The great prince decided to let Knight Dayton punish this evil demon. At the same time, the fourth prince had been out hunting and there was no news for a long time. The great prince declared that he found the fourth Cursed demon, and ordered Knight Dayton to eliminate him. Dayton knew that all these were a conspiracy made by the great prince in order to inherit the throne. Dayton, who was suspicious of the great prince, Did not eliminate the so-called Cursed demon immediately. The fifth prince told Dayton that his three brothers died because of the great prince's conspiracy. Power is the demon, the great prince was tempted by the demon and he framed the three princes. Dayton, As the sword of the great prince, Naturally had an unshirkable responsibility. Dayton decided to betray the knight spirit he believed in - loyalty! In order to guard the justice in his heart, He killed the great prince! After the death of the great prince, Dayton brought back the fifth prince he had hidden, and warned him that power is the demon in everyone's heart, and he must defeat this demon! The fifth prince agreed to Dayton’s request with tears. And Dayton ended his own life in the hall.
“米莫斯知道为了守护自己重要的人，只有做好恶性结局的打算，不沮丧逃避，以自己的力: "Mimos knows that in order to protect his important people, he has to be ready to a terrible ending, not frustrated or escaping, bravely marching forward with his own strength. The fighting is endless!"
“没想到在这里也能找到四叶草，我上一次见到还是在家乡的南部森林里找到的，真的超兴: "I didn't expect to find the Four-leaf Clover here. I saw it last time in the southern forest of my hometown. So exciting! Well, I saw Sumina secretly bought a purple dye today. Does she want to dye her hair to the same color as me? I hate it, I don’t like others to learn me." - Elinise
“这些盔甲虽然看上去很笨重，但是我还是相信它会保护我，保护这座城堡，那么亚米拉，: "This armor looks cumbersome, but I still believe it will protect me and protect the castle. Then Amila, come on!" - Amila
“训练时站在我前排的艾琳娜丝真特别，尤其是她的紫色头发，虽然平日里天天需要带着头: "Elinise in my front row during training is really special, especially her purple hair. Although I need to wear a helmet every day, I still want to dye my hair purple." - Sumina
“白骑士团的哈维队长昨天送了这个徽章给我，有点小兴奋呢，虽然我料到他会有所表示，: "The captain Harvey of the White Knights sent me this badge yesterday. I was excited. Although I expected him to show something, this sudden surprise still made me feel surprised."
在神使现身克雷斯特汉姆之前就有一些神智奇特的战士陷入了疯狂，艾里维奇便是其中之一: Before god's envoy appeared in Glast Heim, there were some strange warriors who fell into madness. Alricht was one of them. When everyone joined forces and defeated him, An alchemist who used the Stone of Sage to bind his soul in his armor. Since then Alricht became a mad swordsman who only guards the castle.
柯雷罗在刚刚来到克雷斯特汉姆时就爱上了一位姑娘，在得知了她是一名皇室公主后，放下: Crulero fell in love with a girl when he first came to Glast Heim. After he learned that she was a royal princess, she put down the idea of ​​confession, and the letter in his hand seemed to never be able to sent.
克雷斯特汉姆中有名的工匠设计出的金色箭矢，在著名游侠奥兹玛手中大放光彩。在黑暗魔: A golden arrow designed by the famous craftsmen in Glast Heim, which were shining in the hands of the famous ranger Ozma. In the battle of the dark monsters' invasion, Ozma took his beloved golden arrows and went deep into the territory of the dark monsters to look for the head of them. From then on, There was no news of him.
艾克林曾经希望自己成为一名真正的魔法师，他并没有天赋，所幸艾克林有一手好箭术，日: Ecklen once wanted to be a true Mage. He didn't have the talent. Fortunately, he had a good archery, and the days were still going. Until an adventure, Ecklen got a magic bow that could add powerful magic on the arrow. Ecklen was ecstatic. Every time using the power of the magic bow, a bit of Ecklen's soul would be sucked by the magic bow. Until one day, Ecklen became a walking corpse without soul. And the name of Cursed Magic Bow was also spread with the death of Ecklen.
此箭早已存在，只是无形、无迹，箭矢早已存于天地间，只等待时机凝聚起来，只到国难当: This arrow has existed long ago, but it is invisible and unmarked. Only at the moment when the kingdom's disaster is coming, any warrior can shoot this arrow as long as he has the courage in his heart.
村正曾在名师手下学习剑道，却因为师傅偏爱自己的师兄嫉火中烧，误入歧途亲手杀害了自: Muramasa once studied kendo following a famous master, but he was angry because his master preferred his senior fellow apprentice. He murdered his own master and senior fellow apprentice. Because of the guilt, he commited seppuku and his hate turned into a sinister spirit.
古城中曾有一条无恶不作的八歧大蛇，在城中掳走妇女和儿童作为它的口中食粮，终于触犯: In Glast Heim, there was an evil Hachimata. In the city, Women and children were taken as his food. Finally, the gods were irritated. The gods gave the most brave warrior in the city a Kusanagi to attack this Hachimata, Peel and bone it, and take its snake scales to offer sacrifice to the innocent citizens who were killed by it.
古时，有个有名的盗贼拥有一件神奇的羽衣，披上羽毛即变成鸟，脱下羽毛就能现身。如果: In ancient times, a famous thief had a magical feather coat, which could turn him into a bird when wearing it and turn him back when taking it off. If a rich family's guard was not good enough, Then once he discovered, He would leave two drops of blood on the window sill as a target mark.
古城战火四溢时，须佐之男将一把十握剑交给妻子防身后便出门从军去了，战后回到家中发: When Glast Heim was full of battles, Susanoo gave a Totsuka-no-Tsurugi to his wife to defend herself, and then joined the army. After the war, when he returned home, He found that his wife died of a serious illness. He thought that he was not there when his wife was seriously ill, He was very regretful. Only the Totsuka-no-Tsurugi is alone in the corner.
灾难之神降下灾祸，使古城生灵涂炭，提出要求将八位壮汉的灵魂交出才能平息灾难，国王: The God of Disasters brought down the disaster, and Glast Heim was ruined. He asked them to surrender the souls of the eight strong men to calm down the disaster. The king declared publicly and sent eight powerful and mighty soldiers in the city. The eight soldiers knew that they would never come back, They still resolutely decided to sacrifice for the people in the city. In order to commemorate them, the king built eight majestic stone tablets and named them Eight Heroes' Valor.
生命魔剑是一柄有战斗欲望的剑，剑拔出来之后如果不沾血就不可以入鞘。剑 的拥有者必: The Life Sword is a sword with a desire to fight. If the sword is pulled out, it can't be sheathed if it doesn't taste blood. The owner of the sword must respect the will of the sword, Otherwise the sword will betray the master and kill at will.
代表元素火，象征激情、能量和创造。: Represents Fire, symbolizing passion, energy and creativity.
代表元素土，象征金钱、物质和享受。: Represents Earth, symbolizing money, material and enjoyment.

保护好自己的手当然是为了更好的进攻！: Protect your hands for better attacks!
用芦苇编制而成草帽，主要用在遮阳光与雨水的效果。: The straw hat made from reeds, mainly used in proofing sunlight and rain.
大蝴蝶结，可让女性更可爱、漂亮。 （作为毕业礼物最近在高中生中相当有人气）: A large bow that can make women more lovely and beautiful. (As a graduation gift, it's been quite popular among high school students.)

我也忘了那晚的星空多美，只记得她点缀着你的明媚身影如同薄纱，引着我的温柔趁夜破风: I don't remember how pretty the starlit sky was that night but I can never forget how it adorned your beautiful figure like a thin layer of yarn, Guiding my tenderness to land by night and surge to you.
有生的瞬间能遇见你，竟花光我所有运气。: I use up all my fortune of this life time to chance upon you in this big, wild world.
当赤道留住雪花，眼泪融化细沙，你肯珍惜我吗？: Keep snowflakes at the equator and melt the sand in my tears. Will you cherish me?
前尘往事兵荒马乱，我背负着爱，踉跄而来。: All the past memories… The war with all its stresses and strains… I stagger forth with love.
最温柔的月光，也敌不过，你转瞬的回眸。: The most gentle moonlight is outshone by your brief looking back.
茫茫人海中，错过了该错过的，放弃了该放弃的，于是，终于等到了你。: In the sea of faces, I have missed all that I ought to miss and given up all that I ought to give up to find you.
我们就像一株蒲公英，虽然总有一天会被风吹散，但我也祈祷着，能和你飞去同一片土地。: We are a dandelion clock to be blown apart by the wind. I pray to land on the same land with you one day.
不乱于心，不用于情，不畏将来，不念过往。: No turmoil at heart and no change in love. No fear for the future and no looking back at the past.
最平凡的细水长流，也因牵着你的手，而幸福荡漾。: Even the most ordinary small but steady stream has happiness rippling when our hands are holding tight.
我希望这个世界很小，小到一抬头就能看到喜欢的人笑眼弯弯。: I want the world to become so small that your smiling eyes are there shining whenever I raise my head.
你驻足的每一个地方都是最亮丽的风景，你对我说的每一句话都是最动听的美乐。: The place you stay has the most beautiful scenery and every word you say to me is the most pleasant music.
牵着我的手，闭着眼睛走，你也不会迷路。: Hold my hands and close your eyes. You won't be lost as long as I'm here.
如果我们都是孩子，就可以留在时光的原地，坐在一起一边听那些永不老去的故事一边慢慢: If we were kids, we could stay unchanged in time. We would sit together and listen to those ever lasting stories as our hair slowly turning grey.
不用每日缠绵，时刻联系，你知道他不会走，他知道你不会变，大概就是最美好的爱情吧。: No need for lingering romance or constant contact. You know he's not to leav and he knows you are not to change. This is the best love on earth.
能在同一个季节里，和你走在相同的街道上，对我来说是很值得高兴的事。: This is a very pleasant thing to walk on the same street with you in the same season.
我愿做你袖间的尘土，等阳光照进的日子，便触摸到了幸福。: I want to be the dust in your sleeves. When the sunlight shines, I will know the taste of happiness.
我想用两只手同时牵住你，左手带你走进我的大世界，右手为你创造你我的小世界。: I want to hold you with both of my hands. The left one leads you into my big world and the right one creates a small world just for you and me.
我贪恋的人间烟火，不偏不倚，恰好是你。: The only thing I can't let go in this world is you.
你眼中有柔情千种，如脉脉春风，冰雪也消融。: In you eyes are one thousand kinds of tenderness. Like the spring breeze, Your gaze can melt the coldest snow.
我，只在做一件事的时候才会想你，那就是呼吸。: I'm always thinking of you whenever I'm breathing.
你是一只匆匆掠过的蜻蜓，在不经意间，点破了我沉睡已久的湖心。: You are a dragonfly in a rush. Unconsciously, You've awakened the lake of my heart from the deepest sleep.
遇见你是我生命的藩篱，在此之前，我从未爱过自己。: The moment I met you was the turning point of my life. Until then, I never loved myself.
当世界停止旋转，抬头看，目光如你温暖。: When the world stops rotating, look up. My eyes are tender like yours.
我不想做你的插曲，我只想做你生命中最完美的结局。: I don't want to be an interlude in your life. Together we are the perfect ending.
听说，注定在一起的人，不管绕多大一圈依然会回到彼此的身边。: I heard if two people are destined together, They will reunite eventually after however big a circle.
如果有一天我们变陌生了，那么，我就重新认识你。: If one day we are back to strangers, I'll learn to know you again.
当你的心情很容易被另一个人影响时，你便会知道他对你意义非凡。: If your mood is easily affect by another, you know he's the one.
不必刻意的陪伴，只需偶尔的相视一笑，如此自然，却又仿佛胜过千言万语。: No need for constant company. An natural exchange of glance with a gentle smile is more than words can ever express.
我很想把我的人生翻到最后一页，看看那个陪我到白头的人是谁。: I want to turn the book of my life to the last page and take a look at the one that has grown old with me.
这世上最浪漫的事，是人潮拥挤，而你自然而然地牵紧我的手。: The most romantic thing in this world is us holding hands among huge crowds of people.
早上醒来，看到你和阳光都在，那就是我想要的幸福。: Waking up every morning to you and sunshine is the happiness I've been longing for.
你的一生我只借一程，这一程，便是余生。: I want only one part of your life. The part is the rest and all.
我希望，与你，我们最登对。: I want to be with you. Together we are best matched.
遇见你是命运的安排，而爱上你，是我无法控制的意外。: Fate brought you into my life. Falling in love with you is an unavoidable accident.
你像那天上月亮，永远停在我的心尖。: You are like the moon in the sky, taking the tip of my heart for ever.
当我想你的时候，你会不会也刚好正在想我？: Would you be thinking about me when I think of you?
答案很长，我准备用一生的时间来回答，你准备好要听了吗？: The answer is long and I plan to devote my entire life to answering. Are you ready to listen?
我不能给你全世界，我的全世界可以给你。: I can't give you the entire world but everything of mine is yours.
从爱你的花季，愿一直等到，爱你的暮年。: My love for you begins in the flower season and won't end until the declining years.
来生，愿做一片飘零的雪花，在你的手心，安静地融化。: I want to be a floating snowflake in my next life and melt peacefully in your palm.
如果你累了，可以止步看夕阳，人生的路上我陪你流浪。: If you are tired, stop to watch the sunset. I'm here with you on this journey of life.
我只身打马过草原，不曾邂逅一片花瓣，却偷走了你一路芳香。: I rode a horse alone across the prairie without encountering one single flower petal. But your fragrance was with me this whole time.
我的心里，从此以后，便是你的港湾。: From this moment on, My heart is your habor.
我还是很喜欢你，像风走了八千里，不问归期。: I still love you like the wind travelling eight thousand li without knowing the return date.
冬天，我愿和你雪中漫步，不为浪漫，只求一路白头。: When winter is here, I'll walk with you in the snow, not for romance but to grey together.
你，注定是我今生倾心驻足的风景，一世不舍的眷恋。: You are the scenery I'm destined to stay for the rest of my life. I'm sentimentally attached to you for ever.
爱是一念之差，最幸福的不过是，你曾温柔呼唤，而我恰好有过应答。: Love is a momentary thing. The greatest happiness is that when you gently called my name, I affectionately answered.
你是一首百转千回的情歌，是一首心灵激荡的词章，棹一方船桨，摆一叶方舟，着一张风帆: You are a love song that turns and returns. You are a poem that inspires my heart. I pick up an oar to row a boat with the sail against the wind to catch up your vague figure.
因为你，无论我走到了哪里，我看到的都是美丽风景，我听到都是悠扬的红尘恋歌。: Because of you, wherever I go I have the most gorgeous scenery and the most beautiful love song.
喜欢与你默默对视，喜欢在心的旷野里，与你缠绵相依。: I love to watch you in silence and embrace you in the field of your heart.

南门常见的怪物，是克瑞米的幼虫。新人们稍加小心就可以应付它。不过这些绿色的虫子偶: The common monster in the South Gate is the Creamy Larva. Novices can handle it with a little care. But these green worms occasionally evolve into pupas. If you dream of a Fabre crawling on your body, it will itch for a while.
长年生长在不见天日下的环境而突变的老鼠，对魔法感觉很敏锐。在阴暗潮湿的地方，繁殖: A mouse that has been mutated because of staying in dark environment for many years. It's very sensitive to magic. In dark and humid places, its reproductive capacity is beyond imagination. People formed a sewer cleaning Party to control the number of them.
在阴暗的角落出现的昆虫，基本上就是蟑螂。名副其实的魔物，速度极快又会偷捡玩家的道: The insects that appear in the dark corners are basically cockroaches. As a veritable monster, it's very fast and will steal the player's items. Players who have just changed job should be careful. The result of ignoring it is that you will be surrounded by the brothers it brings...
移动方式是用弹跳的。怪不可貌相，外表萌萌哒，但一旦被惹怒后可会呈现其凶险的样貌。: It bounces to move. Its appearance is cute, but once it is provoked, it will show its sinister appearance. In order to obtain gold coins, Some people specially organize to step on them, and finally got beaten by them.
栖息在湿冷环境中的蝙蝠，飞行速度快，会成群结队地攻击玩家们。在夜晚达成某些隐藏条: A bat that inhabit wet and cold environment. It can fly fast and will attack players in groups. After reaching some certain hidden conditions at night, These bats will become a horrible Dracula.
盗虫的大型版，速度也非常快。作为盗虫一族的带头大哥，盗虫们简直崇拜得不行。为得到: A large version of the Thief Bug, it's very fast. As the leader of the Thief Bugs, it's admired by them. In order to get the approval of it, they will occasionally submit various items they get to it.
长年生活在下水道深处，由于特殊环境而产生了异变的大型盗虫。比一般的浮勒盗虫更强，: A large Thief Bug that is living in the depths of the sewers for many years and mutated because of the special circumstances. It is stronger than the common Thief Bug Female and has a strong active attack. Those who adventure in the depths of the sewers should always pay attention to it.
总在人们身边嗡嗡的叫很是扰人，虽然RO世界里的苍蝇不带病菌，但也总是会被过路的人: Its screaming around people is very disturbing. Although the flies in the RO world do not have germs, They are always smashed by people who pass by. This creature is really unpleasant, After all, Appearance is still the key.
动作快，也很会捡拾道具。虽然很可爱，但是有点烦人。调皮捣蛋的天性让人又爱又恨，尤: Its action is fast, and it will pick up items. Although very cute, it is a bit annoying. Its naughty nature makes people love and hate it. Especially its habit of throwing banana skins at will, last time it made the king slip...
有极高的音乐天赋，非常悠闲地拉着小提琴生活着的生物。喜欢音乐、喜欢风流。最讨厌在: With a very high musical talent, it lives with playing the violin very leisurely. It likes music and is very romantic. It hates to be interrupted while practicing. It worships Vocals, and is always dreaming of becoming a music leader in the world of monsters.
生长在密林中的树木吸取了天地的灵气而幻化成树精，对人畜无害，但受到攻击也会奋力反: A tree growing in the jungle absorbed the aura of the heavens and the earth and turned into an Elder Willow. It is harmless to humans and animals, but will fight back if attacked. Don't think that it is very sleepy, It's just the accumulation of years making it think about the meaning of existence from time to time.
出现在各城市森林的附近，由虫蛹进化而成，酷爱蜂蜜。拥有强烈的逃跑意识，多年练习终: Appeared in the vicinity of the forests of various cities, evolved from pupa. It loves honey. With a strong sense of escape, many years of practice finally made it learn the advanced skill - teleportation. The only purpose after meeting the danger is to escape!
虽然身为植物，但长得实在有点说不过去，在这个颜值碾压一切的时代，唯有努力可以弥补: Although it is a plant, it is a bit unsightly. In this appearance first era, Only effort can make up for its appearance. 拥有尖锐的爪子和有力的下颚。作为野外的动物捕食者之一，也是蛮拼的。虽然会主动攻击: It has sharp claws and a powerful jaw. As one of the animal predators in the wild, it is struggling. 栖息在沉船和海底的生物，受到伊米尔粉尘的影响变得具有主动攻击性。攻击范围大，不会: A creature that inhabits the sunken ship and the seabed. It has the initiative to attack because of the influence of the Yimir dust. 通常没有固定的形体，一般用肉眼是看不见的，不过听说在很多区域可以通过拍照的闪光灯: Usually it has no fixed shape. It's generally invisible to the naked eye, but it's said that in many areas, it can be seen by the flash of the camera. Don't be frightened the moment it suddenly appears, It's just a white sheet...
生前作为海盗，后遭巴风特等魔物散播伊米尔粉尘，残躯的亡体终而复活。或许对于这些已: A pirate before his death, Later spread with Yimir dust by monsters including Baphomet, his was resurrected. Perhaps for these Dead people, Death is not terrible. What is terrible is that they don’t know why they feel alive...
先天带有毒性的魔菇，常出现在阴冷的洞穴中。个性比较忧郁，据考证是因为单身过久的缘: A congenitally toxic mushroom, often appears in cold caves. 防御颇高的水生类魔物，喜欢集群出现在海底洞穴中，平时酷爱拳击运动。没事可别去招惹: An aquatic monster with high defense. They often appear in the Underwater Caves in groups and love boxing. Don't provoke them, otherwise you can't afford to receive double hard blows.
罗达蛙的变异进化版，自从无意间得到人类遗留下的一台收音机后便热衷于收听米德加尔特: An evolutionary version of Roda Frog. It has been keen to listen to all kinds of programs of Midgarts since it inadvertently obtained a radio left by humans. 出现在海底洞穴深处的半鱼半人身魔物，本性很温和，族人间非常团结友爱。由于人类过度: A semi-fish and semi-human monster that appears in the depths of the Underwater Caves. They're very gentle and united and friendly to each other. 生存在海底的魔物，体型不大，但攻击迅速且强力，是水生类中的强者。据考证其后代是由: A monster that lives on the bottom of the sea. Its size is not big, but its attack is quick and powerful. It's a powerful one in the aquatic monsters. 蜂后的护卫，勤劳而勇敢，喜欢收集蜂蜜。虽然它们不经常攻击人类，但如果你偷了它们的: As the mistress's guard, It's hardworking and brave and likes to collect honey. Although they don't attack humans often, If you steal their honey or try to steal their collections, Your safety can't be guaranteed.
食人植物，具有食肉动物的凶残天性，会主动攻击经过的冒险者。同类交流一直很困难，因: A maneating plant, with ferocious nature of carnivores, it will actively attack the passing adventurers. Communication bewteen them has been difficult, because the big mouths with teeth will scare each other, and the serious fetid breath...
领地占有欲望很强的大型虫类，第一次看到它都会被其外型吓到。身体由许多体节组成，每: A large insect with strong territory possession desire. People see it the first time will be scared by its appearance. 在妙勒尼山脉栖息的美丽精灵，拥有美轮美奂的蝴蝶羽翼。性情温良，开朗热情，热爱大自: A beautiful elf inhabiting the Mjolnir Mountains, Featuring a beautiful pair of butterfly wings. Its temperament is mild, Cheerful and passionate. 普通的蚁种之一，主要职责是警卫和战斗。其上颚发达、巨大，可以粉碎坚硬食物，在保卫: One of the common ants, Whose main duties are guarding and fighting. Its upper jaw is advanced and huge that can crush hard food and become a weapon when defending the group. As the most loyal fan, it absolutely obeys all orders of the queen.

吸血蝙蝠的变异进化版，飞行速度更快，喜欢成群结队地攻击玩家们。对其而言，血液是绝: The variant version of Familiar, flying faster. It likes to attack players in groups. For it, blood is an absolute temptation. Don't be scornful because of its small size, its two blood-sucking tusks are no small threat to any creature.

栖息于沙漠的怪异仙人掌，不会主动攻击人。但在沙漠中口渴想拿它来解渴的话，要有变成: A weird cactus that inhabits the desert, which does not actively attack people. 大嘴鸟蛋被打破后变成的怨灵，拿平底锅进行攻击。有着随时变鸡的梦想，但如果和其扯先: A spirit generated after the Peco Peco egg was broken. It takes a pan to attack. It has a dream of becoming a chick, but if you want to talk about the chicken-or-egg question with it, you will definitely be attacked!
在沙漠生存下来的狼，有比一般狼更强的攻击力，并会主动攻击敌人。适者生存，大自然就: A wolf that survives in the desert, which has a stronger attack than the common wolves and will actively attack the enemy. The one who fits the environment survives, nature is so cruel. Although it has small eyes, maybe it's staring at the target...

攻击速度、移动速度超快，对敌人死缠烂打到极点。据说睡觉会美颜变白，所以其只要空下: Its attack speed and move speed are super fast, and it can keep fighting the enemy. It is said that sleeping can make it be white and beautiful, so it often naps. If you wake it up, you will be attacked.
在金字塔深处受诅咒的魔物，复苏后只听命于俄赛里斯。虽然有点呆滞，但其围绕的特殊绷: A monster that was cursed in the depths of the pyramid, it only obeys Osiris after recovery. 上半身裸露、下半身为蛇尾的恶魔，为俄赛里斯之妻。平时在金字塔无微不至地照顾俄赛里: The demon with the upper part exposed and the lower part as snake tail, who is the wife of Osiris. In the usual time, she takes care of the daily life of Osiris in the pyramid. Although the husband is with bandages, Her deep love has not diminished.

It has been searching for the ultimate answer to the meaning of existence throughout his life - what are the monsters living for...
和其兄弟狂暴大脚熊性格截然相反，生性憨厚，喜欢和谐的大自然，因脚掌厚实宽大而备受: Contrary to its brother Berserk Bigfoot, it is very generous and likes the harmonious nature. It is highly concerned because of its thick and wide feet. It is often framed by the bad guys who are greedy. They just want its fur and paw.
不知从何考证，古代将军们的墓碑突然有了灵性。墓志铭“天下大将军”诠释了一切：征战: No one knows the exact time that the tombstones of the ancient generals suddenly had spirituality. The epitaph "The General of the World" explains everything: fought in the battlefield and never be soft-hearted to the invaders! Tried best to kill the enemies, even if it had become a soul!
杂食性动物，体躯健壮，四肢粗短，有厚实的鬃毛和尖锐的獠牙。虽然是猪，但肉很结实，: An omnivorous animal, with a strong body and thick and short limbs, thick mane and sharp tusks. Although it is a pig, its meat is very firm and its body is absolutely strong. If you unfortunately annoy it, its deadly tusks will teach you a lesson!
亡者的幽灵之火，在不经意期间会悄悄跟随在路人身后进行偷袭。切记：如果发现被其缠上: The ghost fire of the dead, which will quietly follow the passers-by and launch a sneak attack. Remember: If you find that you are followed by it, please Flee quickly, Otherwise you will be attacked and killed and become the next soul!
生前只是一颗普通的蛋，被伊米尔粉尘沾上后就变成一颗转啊转的蛋了，具有360度旋转: It was just an ordinary egg before death. After being stained with Yimir dust, it became a spinning egg with anti-stun ability to 360-degree rotation. The meaning of life is to spin! What is the difference between an ordinary egg and a non-spinning egg?
和妖道君青梅竹马，却因家庭因素被迫与心上人形同陌路，后思念过度而早逝。被贴上道符: The childhood sweetheart of Bongun, but because of family factors, she was forced to separate from her heartheart. The farthest distance in the world is that the one is by your side but you can't recognize him...

Being attached by a charm and resurrected, he lost all of his memories. He can only subconsciously look for her... The farthest distance in the world is that the one is by your side but you can't recognize her...
其体型巨大且拥有超强的力量，被激怒后会使用巨锤将敌人砸成肉泥。脾气暴躁，但因拥有: It is huge and has super strength. When it is irritated, it will use a giant hammer to smash the enemy into meat. Grumpy, but because of the enviable thick muscles, it has been selected as the bodybuilding champion of the monster world for many times...

However, there are legends that he was actually an elf. However, He and the elf were obviously different. The elf was always young, and he was always an old man. When he became a White-robed Warlock, his beard and hair became white. Plus his white robe, He was somewhat impressive. However, He didn't belong to this world.
阿莱斯特˙克劳利生于一个双亲都是基督教普里茅斯兄弟会的教友的家庭，该兄弟会也是基: Aleister Crowley was born in a family where both his parents were members of the Christian Plymouth Brotherhood, which is also the basic fundamentalism of Christianity. Therefore, Crowley grew up in a strict biblical environment, but he despised Christianity extremely. He became a mystical scholar when he had grown up. Perhaps because he was unorthodox, people called him the King of Beasts. However, he didn't belong to this world.
移动方式是用弹跳的。怪不可貌相，外表萌萌哒，但一旦被惹怒后可会呈现其凶险的以免。: It bounces to move. Its appearance is cute, but once it is provoked, it will show its sinister appearance. In order to obtain gold coins, Some people specially organize to step on them, and finally got beaten by them.
盗虫家族的王者，拥有极快的速度和极高的攻击力，一旦被盯上的话很难安全脱身。不过曾: The king of Thief Bugs, with a very fast speed and a high attack. Once you're targeted by it, it is very difficult for you to escape. However, the braves who had the strength once teamed up and went to eliminate it. It's said that you will get a lot of gold after defeating it.
虽然身为波利家族的一员，灵魂却早被恶魔所操控。和小恶魔称兄道弟，坏事干得不少。在: Though it's a Poring, its soul has been manipulated by the devil. It's intimate with Deviruchies and did many bad things. In the depths of its fallen heart, it's always looking for the answer to a question - what is the bottom line?
生前是一名纵横大洋的传奇海盗头目，最热爱大海、海盗船和乌鸦…虽然他是一名道德与节: Before his death, he was a legendary pirate leader in the ocean. He loved the sea, pirate ship and crow... Although he was a captain with morality and ethics being doubted, he had the courage a pirate should have to save his crew in dangerous moments. He still do this after resurrection.
伟大而威严的海王，掌管环绕大陆的所有海域，偶尔会在海底深处现身。正如大海的波涛，: The great and majestic Sea King who is in charge of all the waters around the mainland. He will occasionally appear in the depths of the sea. Just like the waves of the sea, his character is unruly. And his artifact Trident has an amazing destructive power and can even trigger a tsunami.
哥布灵家族的绝对王者，管理能力出类拔萃，不仅拥有惊人的攻击力，智力也超群。为维护: The absolute king of Goblins with an outstanding management ability. It has not only amazing attack, but also a superior intelligence. It's always trying hard to maintain the group's prosperity and worshipped by the other Goblins.
蜜蜂们的女王，也是唯一能产卵的雌性蜂。作为蜂群中所有成员的母亲，为整个族群的繁衍: The queen of bees, who is also the only female bee that can lay eggs. As the mother of all bees, it's always trying hard to maintain the group's prosperity. It will not tolerate the behavior of harming the members of them. Please pay attention to this, adventurers!
蚂蚁中的女王，栖息在蚂蚁密穴深处，主要职责是产卵、繁殖后代和统管这个群体大家庭。: The queen of ants inhabiting in the depths of the Ant Hell, whose main duties are to lay eggs, Breed offspring and manage the large group. In the hierarchical ant empire, her appearance and ability are the best!
古代残留的贪欲所化为的巨型魔物。虽然样子很滑稽，但其贪婪凶残的个性无疑是目标的噩: A giant monster emerged from the ancient greed. Although it looks funny, Its greed and fierceness are undoubtedly the target's nightmare. Once locked by its horrible giant mouth, the target cannot avoid the fate of being swallowed.
传说中最强铁匠的徒弟，对自己锻造的东西非常负责，当然有时也会失败…（日语CV：井: The apprentice of the best blacksmith in the legend. He is very responsible for what he forged, and of course he sometimes fails... (Japanese CV: Inoue Kazuhiko)
卡普拉提供了传送、存储、仓库、通信……等等一切你想要的功能，相信我，你根本离不开: Kafra can provide you all the services you want, Such as teleportation, Save, Storage, Communication, Etc... Trust me, You can't be without her ԅ(¯ㅂ¯ԅ)
制作这块看板的木头只有在吉芬的周边地图才能找到，所以看板也蕴含着魔力…作为他的看: The wood from which the Board is made can only be found on the maps near Geffen, so the Board also contains magic... As the hostess of the Board, Sherry is quite friendly to the Adventurers~ (Japanese CV: Ohtani Ikue)
大美女西莉雅的美发技术在大陆首屈一指，最近理发店新提供了染发服务，想变漂亮就从头: The hairdressing skill of Beauty Syllia is unparalleled on the continent. Recently, her Barber Shop launches a dyeing service. Beauty starts from a beautiful hair (◕‿◕✿) (Japanese CV: Eri Kitamura)
希盖曾经参加过数场王国保卫战，直到膝盖中了一箭，受过重伤的他从此担任转职所的高级: Higgy used to participate in every defense war of the kingdom, until his knee got shot. Thereafter, he became a Senior Mentor in the Job center, guiding newbies to select their jobs. (Japanese CV: Inoue Kazuhiko)
喜欢以自己的风格服务顾客，不希望被条条框框所束缚，很不喜欢大姐狄波萝太经常对自己: Likes to serve customers in his own way, and doesn't like to follow rules, Especially the order from his sister Defolty who asks him to act "the same" with others.
作为四处旅行的商队领袖，旅行不但带给他丰富的知识，还结交了一大堆朋友。: Being a caravan leader has given him the opportunity to visit many places in the world, which not only increases his knowledge, but also earns him lots of friends.
出售道具的邻家女孩，总是认真对待每一位光顾的客人。: A girl that sells items, always treating every customer with care and patience.
与乔亚是一对姐妹花，传说买过她们所有出售的装备，将会以身相许！Ｏ(≧∇≦)Ｏ: She and her sister Jorgia are both beauties and it's said that whoever buys all of their items on sale will be honored to marry one of them! Ｏ(≧∇≦)Ｏ
对“金钱就是一切、人生的目的就是赚钱”的观念深信不疑，彻头彻尾的商人少女。于旅行: This die-hard business girl is quite convinced by the notion that "Money is everything, the purpose of life is to earn money". After meeting with Cenia in a trip, she became travel partners with this Swordsman as she thought "traveling together brings opportunities for money". But later they were captured by the Rekenber company and became test objects.
最初的伙伴，爱好自由而四处流浪的剑士，旅行中与相遇的商人阿尔玛雅·娣洁一起遭遇雷: The first companion, a freedom lover and a traveling swordsman, Was captured by the Rekenber company together with his traveling partner Maya Deje and became a test object.
想要转职进阶的话可得先过宝雅这一关哦~平时对新手非常严格，可是关键时候也会出手相: You have to pass the tests of Poya in order to upgrade your job. Poya is very strict to newbies usually but will offer help at crucial moments.
传说在世界各地使用音乐救死扶伤的精灵，是一位十分美丽的女性，被她救助过的冒险家总: As the legend goes, she is a very beautiful lady traveling around the world to save people with music. Those who has received her help doesn't want to leave her at all. (Japanese CV: Izawa Shior)
这位老学者身上总是透露着一些神秘的气息，似乎有些不可告人的秘密就隐藏在他的胡须下: This old scholar looks quite mysterious, As if there are secrets hiding under his moustache. What more, his physique looks nothing like his age...
刚加入冒险者公会没多久，但因为出色的战斗技巧，很快就获得了认可，目前担任小队长一: A new member to the Adventurer's Guild, who was soon promoted to a team leader due to outstanding battle skills.
亚斯兰的祖父曾是普隆德拉城防军的创办者之一，而亚斯兰似乎并不像多提及自己那令人仰: Arslan's grandpa was one of the founders of the Prontera Garrison. But Arslan seems to be reluctant to mention his admirable grandpa.
与奥拉是一对姐妹花，传说买过她们所有出售的装备，将会以身相许！Ｏ(≧∇≦)Ｏ: She and her sister Ola are both beauties and it's said that whoever buys all of their items on sale will be honored to marry one of them! Ｏ(≧∇≦)Ｏ
使人又爱又恨的微笑小姐·安妮，上一刻在天堂下一秒就能让你下地狱，想说爱你不容易。: The unpredictable Smiling Miss Anne can make you feel at heaven in one moment and then kick you into hell in another. It takes courage to love her. (Japanese CV: Kasahara Akira)
其恶趣味很多人都无法接受，尤其视鹿头为珍宝这点，传闻说这是卡鲁船长在海上的大发现: He has many weird tastes that most people can't understand, especially the one that he takes a deer head as a treasure. It's said that the deer head is a big discovery of captain Karoo!
从小在依斯鲁得长大，最大的心愿是让宝贝儿子去大城市干出一番事业~: Born and raised in Izlude. His biggest wish is for his son to live as a successful man in big cities.
一个豪迈的络腮胡大叔，健硕的肌肉上有着无数的伤痕和刀疤，仿佛在向冒险者倾诉他曾经: A generous uncle with thick whiskers, his muscular arms are covered with scars which remind others about his splendid battle feats... (Japanese CV: Ishida Akira)
将自己隐藏在黑暗中的女子，感觉不到一丝气息存在，是个背负着各种不祥传说的人。沉默: She hides herself in the darkness and no one can ever feel her existence. She is the carrier of many ominous stories. She is quiet and when her opponents detect her dangerous aura, They are already one step in the grave. (Japanese CV: Eri Kitamura)
穿着东方风的贵族气质男子，喜欢在下午优雅地喝着红茶。高高在上的皇家气质和某种说不: A noble man dressing like an oriental, he likes to drink black tea in the afternoon. His condescending imperial attitude makes others feel pressured talking to him... (Japanese CV: Sugiyama Noriaki)
一位令人敬重的修女，从其身上能感受到圣母般的慈爱。对所有人都非常关爱，尤其对想转: A respectful nun who reminds others the Mother of God. She loves and cares everyone, Especially those who are choosing to become Acolytes, she will offer them great help and guide. (Japanese CV: Ikue Ohtani)
曾在初心者学院任勤杂工，为人老实，做事认真。每当看到有新冒险者毕业的时候，其脸上: Used to be a handyman in the Novice Academy, very honest and hardworking. His face will bloom with smile whenever he sees new Adventurers successfully graduate.
勇敢正义的亚瑞是城防军中最值得信赖的大叔，从小生活在普隆德拉的他誓死保卫他所热血: The brave and righteous Ayrui is a trustworthy uncle in the Garrison. He was born and raised in Prontera and he swears to protect this land with his life.
从小就法师要成为一名出色的魔法师，在冒险者的帮助下成功的进入到了吉芬的魔法学院，: He was determined to become an excellent Mage at a young age. With the help of adventurers, he managed to enter the Magic Academy in Geffen. He loves Izlude's dusk the most, as it reminds him of his childhood.
最喜欢探索危险难找的地方，其照片记录了很多罕见的奇闻异事，相关作品在国家地理杂志: He loves to venture into isolated places to take pictures of rare scenes. Some of his works are quite popular on the Midgarts Geographic.
曾经有一位深爱着她的母亲。从小就继承了其母亲的勇敢和坚毅~: Her mother loved her very much. And she has inherited her mother's courage and toughness!
从没想过自己会经历幽灵船事件，对其之后的生活产生了巨大的影响…: He never thought he would confront the Ghost Ship, which had turned his life upside down thereafter...
数百年前的海盗，喜欢音乐和讲故事，身亡后被巴风特用伊米尔粉尘复活成为骷髅战士，生: A pirate who came from a few centuries ago. He loved music and story-telling. After his death, he was turned into a skeleton warrior by Baphomet with Yimir Dusts. When he was alive, he had a dream of marrying a beautiful girl...
虽然是女骑士，但性格却异常暴躁，非常看不惯魔法师们慢吞吞的作风，爱喝咖啡的她可是: Even though she is a female, she has a quick temper and dislikes the slowness of Mages. She loves coffee so she is a patron of coffee shops.
雷德可是城防军的“大宝贝”凡是都喜欢亲力亲为，虽然实力一般，可是努力踏实的他还是: Reid is a "big baby" to the garrison. He likes to take care of everything. Though his power is not that outstanding, his hard-work and modesty has made him an indispensable part of the garrison force.
是名真正的勇士，即使年事已高还是英勇善战，面对死亡毫不畏惧！: A true warrior who is still very valiant at such an old age, fearless in front of death!
被称为史上最强炼金术师的雷诺一直在研究着一些不为人知的秘密，他的炼金术早已摆脱了: Reno is recognized as the history best Alchemist and he's been studying some unknown secrets. His alchemy skills have surpassed the material level and he is able to manipulate the muscle nerve's memory. Of course doing this should be strictly subjected to the rules of alchemists. If you ever want to experience this kind of strange feeling, you can get it by handing in a rare "Eternal Rock".
梦罗克大陆卫队驻扎在普隆德拉的传令兵，找寻大陆的勇者抗击裂隙的魔潮。（日语CV：: A Messenger sent to Prontera by the Morroc Continental Guard. He is looking for warriors to help fight against monsters coming from the Rifts. (Japanese CV: Yamaya Yoshitaka)
能在普隆德拉经商的，都是有才华的人，没有突出战斗力那就一定有非凡的经商头脑。: Merchants in Prontera all have a talent. They either excel in fighting, or have an outstanding business mind.
闻名大陆的皇家骑士团团长，以刚正不阿，超卓的战绩威震大陆，普隆德拉王国议会的核心: The captain of the world renowned Royal Knights. He is well known for his unyielding character and excellent battle feats. He is a key member of Prontera's parliament. He never failed a battle in his life and he is very loyal to his kingdom. He is a spiritual pillar to Prontera. (Japanese CV: Narumi Takashi)
魔法师协会高层的一员，目前担任的是指导学习魔法的新人们，有一个笨头笨脑的男朋友，: A member of the senior management of the Magic Guild. She is currently coaching new recruits magic. She has a clumsy boyfriend and when they are doing science researches together, weird things will always happen...
新进的天才少女巫师，有着极度自信的性格，不过这点经常会受到同伴们的不满，她自己本: A newly promoted wizard talent who is very confident. Her confidence sometimes may offend her friends, though herself may not notice it.
总是板着一张扑克脸的阴沉的魔法师，但是据说实力非常强，没人知道被头发遮盖的眼睛里: This gloomy Mage always wears a poker face. But he is said to be quite powerful. No one knows what his hair-covered eyes are targeting at.
从刺客公会秘境中走出的强者，曾经于古城成功刺杀鹗枭男爵而闻名于世，作为刺客，他谨: A powerful man from the Assassins' Guild. He is famous for killing the Owl Baron in Glast Heim. As the president of the Assassins' Guild, he strictly follows the assassin's principles, possesses great composure and seldom laughs. He regards the missions of the Assassins' Guild as his lifetime pursuits.
A.W 1010年，卡普拉公司为了庆祝会社成立百年，引进了里希塔乐的科学技术和: In A.W 1010, to celebrate the company's a hundredth anniversary, Kafra introduced Risitalode's science technology and its own study on the circuits of magic crystals. This is how this product is produced. Current Code: KP-01 (Japanese CV: Ikue Ohtani)
莫德并不在意装备本身的好坏，对莫德来说如何将他所看到的装备尽可能的发挥其威力才是: Mod pays no attention to the quality of the equipment, what he cares is how to make the equipment perform its best.
五彩缤纷的外观并不是梅蒂芬的追求，即使是最普通的颜色梅蒂芬也会加倍用心的调制，最: A colorful appearance is not what Medici pursuits. Even the plainest color is designed with great care, so people can enjoy a wonderful life.
尘世大陆的魔物学者，对各种魔物掉落的晶体抱有最大的兴趣。: A monster scholar who has the most interest in the crystals dropped by monsters.
来自吉芬城的贵族魔法师，在魔法的海洋中拥有无与伦比的天赋，是有史以来最天才的魔法: A noble Mage from Geffen, one of the most talented Mages ever. He is rigid and regards Geffen and the Mage Guild as his life. Now he has become one of the most powerful men in Geffen, Serving as its guard.
雷藏最得意的学徒，从儿时起就跟随雷藏学习魔法，对火焰魔法有着浓厚的兴趣，很多同学: Reyen's favorite student who has been learning from Reyen at a young age. She is very interested in Fire Magic and many classmates call her the "Flower of Fire".
吉芬的载具都归他管，还会使用一些冰霜魔法。: He manages all the mounts in Geffen, and he could also use some frost magic.
被女神芙蕾雅指派到大陆，寻找彩虹项链的大使，拥有者不输与女神的美貌。: The envoy sent to the continent by goddess freya to look for the Rainbow Necklace. She is as beautiful as the goddess herself.
脾气古怪的摩根，似乎拥有着这个世界上所有的智慧，平时看似对所有事情都满不在乎，却: Morgan has a weird temper, and he is a man of great wisdom. Usually, He may seem indifferent, but he is well informed of everything happening around him.
发誓要成为最强勇者的，但由于平凡的能力最终成为了打斗场守门人→_→: He once swore to become the best fighter, but his ordinary performance has finally turned him into the Arena Doorman →_→
热爱动物的梅肯和他的两个兄弟一样，享受安逸的生活，居住在妙勒尼山脉管理着载具。: Macon is an animal lover, just like his two brothers. They enjoy a cozy life on Mjolnir Mountains, taking care of the mounts there.
梅林是三兄弟中话最少的一个，似乎对山脉中的一些秘密也很有兴趣。: Merlin is the quietest one among the 3 brothers. He seems to be quite interested in exploring the secrets of the mountains.
三兄弟中年纪最好，但是似乎看上去最老，可能是梅赫喜欢留胡子的关系吧。: Mahir is the youngest among the 3 brothers, but he looks like the oldest, Probably because of his beard.
梦罗克大陆卫队对裂隙的关注度非常得高，甚至在各地都派遣了监视者来保证大陆的稳定。: The Morroc Continental Guard pays great attention to the Rifts. It has dispatched agents to each place to secure the stability on the continent. (Japanese CV: Narumi Takashi)
会热心教给玩家各类极其有帮助的冒险技能的优秀导师。（日语CV：杉山紀彰）: An excellent Mentor that teaches players various helpful adventure skills. (Japanese CV: Sugiyama Noriaki)
从异界而来的魔物，和其他魔物不同的是它似乎只对吃东西比较感兴趣。: A monster from the Further Beyond, but it's quite different, as it seems to be only interested in food.
答应“给予可以制造传说中的武器的身体”这个邀请而被卷入了一场神秘事件的神工匠。成: A Whitesmith who was drawn into a mysterious activity after accepting the invitation which promised "a body that is able to make legendary weapons". As a student of a famous craftsman, he devoted his life to making weapons. It's said that nothing could catch his attention except for weapons, and he was a downright blacksmith.
嫉恶如仇，是梦罗克的民众为一生的风险对象，以保护梦罗克城以及城中子民为己任，现为: He is a righteous man who has devoted his life to serving Morroc citizens and guaranteeing their safety. Now he has become the Commander-in-Chief of the Morroc Continental Guard, controlling all the armed forces in Morroc.
想要获得比任何人都还要快的极速攻击的暗杀者，平时沉溺与酒以及赌博之中。: An Assassin who pursuits extreme attacking speed that no one can match. But usually he just indulges himself in wine and gambling.
海陆曼对格丽塔的要求非常高，在执行任务时也是毫不留情的指派她去最危险的区域，但是: Healueman is quite strict to Greta, and he always sends her to the most dangerous places to perform tasks. But usually, He will also send Greta her favorite black tea. Greta respects him very mush.
人见人爱的艾尔克，为了治理梦罗克日渐严重的沙漠化而努力着，曾经差一点就成功了…: Elke is loved by everyone. He is committed to preventing the desertification of Morroc, and he almost made it...
巴尔洛的得力助手，诺德尔从不单独行动，富有团队意识的他也是个可靠的领导者。: As a great helper to Barlaud, Norder never acts alone. He has a strong team spirit and he is also a trustworthy leader.
土生土长的梦罗克人，跟随巴尔洛进入梦罗克大陆卫队，为卫队立下无数功劳，是巴尔洛的: A native Morroc who followed Barlaud to the Morroc Continental Guard. He has made great contribution to the Continent Guard and he is one of Barlaud's most trusted men. He is cautious and undisturbed in accidents, Possessing great executive ability.
热情而又充满正义的普隆德拉人，曾在普隆德拉军事学院进修并以优异的成绩进入皇家骑士: A passionate and righteous Prontera man who once studied in Prontera Military Academy and later entered the Royal Knights with an excellent graduation performance. He is a valuable talent in the Royal Knights.
随克雷斯特同盟军一起来到古城，自称是名吟游诗人的男子。他在半途被同盟军所救，自告: He came to Glast Heim with the Crest Alliance Army, and he calls himself a minstrel. He was rescued by the Alliance Army during his journey, Then he offered to come to Glast Heim, Collecting legends from the land covered by darkness. He dresses differently from other minstrels, As if he comes from a kingdom further away.
拥有美丽的外表却从来不笑。女武神为了防止千年前的悲剧再次发生，会帮助人类锻炼来提: She is very beautiful but she seldom laughs. To prevent the tragic in the last millennium from happening again, Valkyrie will help humans improve their fighting power through training, but sometimes the training may be too harsh...
一个表面看上去温文尔雅的美男子，岁月仿佛并未在他身上流逝一样。和其余人不同的是，: A very handsome man who appears to be gentle and polite, and it seems as if time has left no mark on him. Different from others, He still looks quite young and "energetic".
因为执着于金钱，死后依然四处徘徊: Because he can't leg go of money, he still wanders around after his death.
虽然拥有能穿梭于各个世界的能力却并没有什么战斗力的恶魔商人。: Though this demon Merchant can travel through different worlds, its fighting power is quite low.
放在商人类npc旁边作为装饰,不可点击: A decoration next to NPC Merchants, can't be selected

Children's Envoy: 
Aha, adventurer, there is an exciting piece of news for you! The annual celebration on the Midgarts continent is about to start! 
The theme of this year is - Big Adventure! As you know, On this perilous continent, Adventure is a time-transcending topic! 

This time, Let's help a Savage Babe to accomplish its adventures! I can see an urge for adventure in its sincere and sparkling eyes! 

Want to know how to get Angeling Wing, Savage Babe Balloon, Mastela Fruit and Astral·Fashion Weapon? Go now to check the event details~
卡普拉狄波萝太：\n冒险者们，你们好！\n不知不觉大家已经来到米德加尔特大陆半年:
Kafra Defolty: 
Hello, Dear adventurers! 
How time flies, Now you've been staying on the Midgarts continent for half a year.
We really appreciate your company and support, and we feel honored to witness the growth of each one of you! 
On this special day, Kafra has decided to hold a grand ceremony. 
To make sure the ceremony proceed smoothly, We still need your help, adventurers~

(PS: Now the limited luxury headwear for this month is on sale, you can go check with [Miss Ina] near the west gate of Prontera, Hurry up~)
夏季即将结束，为了让大家提前感到秋日般的清凉，普隆德拉王室决定举办第一届「清凉祭:
The summer is about to end and in order to bring the autumn coolness to you earlier, the Prontera Royal Court has decided to hold the first [Coolness Expo]! 

The special guest to this event is the princess of Poring Island - [Pauline]! She is a super optimist that loves delicious food. She also brings for you a must-have for this Coolness Expo - [Magic Ice]. But unfortunately, the ice was stolen by monsters on the way, so you need to get it back by yourselves~

She comes here not only to attend the Coolness Expo, but also to bring you the prediction of the great augur Star Marks: "On the intricate star tracks, Fire and demon combined, the world will be devoured by fire, a monster group [Fire Demon] is about to invade..."

Adventurers, Please, Stop the [Fire Demon] group and get back the [Magic Ice]. Besides, How can the Coolness Expo go without Princess Pauline's favorite food - Watermelon Desserts? To let the princess have her favorite food, Dessert Chef Nannan needs your help! So, adventurer, are you ready to assist dessert master Nannan to make this delicious dessert for the princess? Meet at Coolness Expo, Let adventure food combine with fresh watermelon.
从普隆德拉出发，开启冒险之旅吧？幽灵船的幽灵，海底强大的魔物，时时刻刻在威胁着剑: Let's start our adventure from Prontera! Ghosts on the Ghost Ship and monsters undersea are all threatening the safety of the City of Swordsman, your brave pets already can't wait to fight along with you!
目标，吉芬！城外的哥布林部落，妙勒尼山脉的魔物，在这里等待着你们，也等待着你们的: Target, Geffen! The Goblin Tribe outside the city and monsters on Mjolnir Mountains are all waiting here to fight against you and your pets!
前进！沙漠之都！让你的宠物来这里进行冒险吧！诡异的金字塔，炎热的苏克拉特，神秘的: Forward! Desert Capital! Send your pets here to start their adventures! The creepy pyramid, Scorching Sograt Desert, and mysterious Ant Hell are there for them to explore!
前往东方吧？在群山之中的斐扬正经历一场严峻的考验，凶猛的大脚熊，怪异的僵尸都在威: Go to the east? The mountain-surrounded Payon is going through a tough period, with the Fierce Bigfoots and spooky Munaks threatening the lives of Payon citizens. They need your help!
回归吉芬！这次吉芬迎来了更加强大的对手，郊外的兽人、犬妖，吉芬塔下的恶魔们正在扰: Back to Geffen! This time, Even more powerful enemies are showing up threatening Geffen, Including orcs and Kobolds in the outskirt and monsters under Geffen Tower, the crisis comes again!
古老之城在呼唤！古城传来了不安的讯息，栖息在其中强大的魔物们蠢蠢欲动，似乎有着不: The ancient city is calling! Unsettling news come from Glast Heim. The powerful monsters living there start to show up, as if they are planning something bad.
叮当！艾尔帕兰回想着钟声。那些丑陋的时钟魔物正在艾尔帕兰肆虐，那些受到威胁的民众: Dingdong! The ticks of clocks echo in Al De Baran. Those ugly Clock Monsters are harassing Al De Baran, the threatened citizens need your help!
波利和疯兔正在快乐的嬉戏，如果你也喜爱软萌的波利，就一块和你的宠物一起在这跳支舞: Porings and Lunatics are having fun together. If you also like the cute and soft Porings, why not have a dance here with your pets?
如果你也热爱甜糯的香蕉和欢快的音乐，那可一定不要忘记参加西门可爱的溜溜猴和摇滚蝗: If you are also into sweet bananas and joyous music, Then you can't miss out the concert being held at the west gate by lovey Yoyos and Vocals.
阴冷潮湿的下水道里生活着一群不喜欢阳光与人群的白鼠，魔菇，真是哪里都有家里蹲呢！: In the dark and damp sewer, There lives a bunch of Tarous and Spores, They don't like sunlight and humans and will stay anywhere they can!
咦？怎么走着走着就不知道自己到哪里了？这里是永远让你摸不清方向的迷藏森林！: Oh? How come I lost my direction as I walk along? Because this is the Labyrinth Forest where you will never find the right direction!
讨厌的魔物在这湿冷的船上更是迅速蔓延，和你的宠物一起给这艘破破烂烂的大船来次大扫: The annoying monsters are producing even faster on this damp ship. Please clean this wrecked ship up with your pets!
嘿！小心！别乱按手上的相机，指不定哪个捣蛋的白幽灵会冒出来吓你一大跳呢？: Hey! Be careful! Don't press the camera's buttons recklessly, You don't know when a naughty Whisper will jump out to scare you!
今天晚上吃什么好呢？和你的宠物一起来海底世界捉只螃蟹煮了如何？听着口水都快下来啦: What should we have for supper? How about cooking a Vadon? You can catch it from undersea with your pets. Oh, My mouth is drooling!
美丽的人鱼，剑鱼和马克在一旁的珊瑚边开心的玩着捉迷藏，不如和你的宠物一起加入它们: The beautiful Obeaune, Phen and Marc are playing hide and seek near the corals over there. Why don't you and your pets join them?
成群结队的哥布林们在首领的指挥下有序的劳作着，可别小看这些小家伙们，个个都不是好: Groups of Goblins are working under the lead of their leader. Don't look down upon these little buddies, they are tough to deal with.
这里风景如画，百花齐放，但就在这样的好风景里，也隐藏着一丝危险的气息。: This place is picturesque with flowers blooming everywhere. But even under this beautiful scenery lies a sense of danger.
结构复杂的蚂蚁洞穴中，兵蚁和工蚁们有序的进出忙碌，真是神奇的一道奇观。: In the complex Ant Hell, Deniros and Pieres are working in order, it's an amazing scene.
大沙漠，梦罗克！这里居住着摩卡和呆萌的大嘴鸟。嘿嘿，我知道你和你的宠物都饿了，不: Grand desert, Morroc! Here live Muka and the cute Peco Peco. Haha, I know you and your pets must be hungry, how about we have some baked Magnolia?
金字塔外围已经充满了紧张感，凶恶的沙漠之狼无处不在，还有高大参天的巨石怪。: The atmosphere in the outskirt of the pyramid is quite tense, as the ferocious Desert Wolves and tall Golems are everywhere.
带你的宠物一起来体验金字塔的古老与神秘吧！不过千万要小心蛇女伊丝的目光，可别让你: Bring your pets to experience the ancient and mysterious pyramid! Be careful with the eyes of Isis, don't let them petrify your pets!
凶残的米诺斯从不手下留情，残骸弓箭手正将利刃时刻准备着瞄准！要么，别进去了吧？: The ruthless Minorous never shows mercy. The skeleton archers are aiming at you with Sharp Blades! So, maybe it's better to stay outside?
大脚熊和长老树精是这里的主要居民。表面看似平静的斐杨南部悠闲但却处处潜伏着危险的: Bigfoots and Elder Willows are main residents here. The Payon South looks peaceful on the surface, but you can catch the scent of danger everywhere.
在这里即使是白天，灵异的鬼火和将军魔碑都随处看见。整片森林被鬼魅的力量掌控，让你: Even under daylight, You can still see Horongs and Greatest Generals everywhere. The whole forest has been controlled by the Charming Ghast. Bring your pets to have a challenge here!
那些一蹦一跳的家伙虽然看上去很呆萌，可它们的攻击力不是闹着玩的，但你的宠物肯定能: Those jumpy guys may look cute, but they have powerful attacks. But I'm sure your pets can handle them, Right?
犬妖看上去很弱？恰恰相反，他们的力量即使是吉芬的那些魔导师都很难解决。: The Kobolds look weak? On the contrary, they are so powerful that even Geffen Mages take them as a threat.
体型壮硕的兽人，也许他们体型确实笨重，但是他们的力量无比强大，而且他们还会使用各: The robust orcs. They may be clumsy, but they have great strength. And they know how to take advantage of powerful weapons!
前方危机警报即将拉响！这里充斥这兽人们死而复活的残骸以及惹人生厌的赤苍蝇，太可怕: Warning! Danger ahead! This place is filled with revived dead orcs and annoying Hunter Flies. Awful!
在这阴冷且神秘的地下城中，到处可见着梦魇。傀儡娃娃噩梦般的笑声随时等待着下一个猎: In this mysterious dark dungeon, nightmares are everywhere. The hell-like laughter of Marionettes is always ready to bring up the next prey.
在这片遥远而神秘的丛林中，居住着各种各样的地龙。小地龙一晃一晃的尾巴可真可爱！: In this secluded jungle, There are all kinds of Green Petites. The swaying tails of small Green Petites are so cute!
强大的不死生物充斥着整个古城墓地，虽然阴暗森冷，但是这里却是冒险的天堂，让你的宠: The Glast Heim Churchyard is filled with powerful undead creatures. Though it's dark and cold, it's like a heaven to adventurers. Come and bring your pets to explore here!
曾经富饶的首都被摧毁后，笼罩的是一片残垣断瓦和荒芜，这里恶魔女仆，深渊骑士横行！: Since the prosperous capital was turned into ruins, all those left are debris and wastes. Now Succubus and Abysmal Knights have taken up this place!
时刻保持警惕！这里有隐居在冰冷下水道的是蓝鼠和虎蜥人，时刻保持警惕！: Don't ever let down your guard! There are Cramps and Anolians hiding in the cold sewer, always be careful!
恶魔恶魔恶魔！到处都是恶魔，任何人在这里行进简直是举步为艰，得让你的宠物们好好做: Demon everywhere! This place is filled with demons. No one can pass here without fights. You must have your pets fully prepared.
这里已经完全成了小巴风特和裘卡的地盘，猖狂的残骸浪人挥舞着无情的刀刃四处杀戮，胆: This place has been taken over by Baphomet Jr. And Jokers. The ruthless Wanderer is chopping everything with his blade. This place doesn't suit cowards!
想体验时间与空间的奇幻之旅，那么一定得让你的宠物们来钟楼，与古钟魔或神秘的巫婆一: If you want to experience the mysterious travels between time and space, Then you must bring your pets to the Clock Tower and let them explore the secret of time with Ancient Clocks or Mysterious Bathories.
灰森灵、兽人女战士、梅纳海葵在这肆虐，你的宠物肯定也不想错过这片危险之地！: Stem Worms, Orc Ladies and Penomenas are rampant here, Your pets must love to explore this dangerous land!
这里有音乐的狂热爱好者重金属蝗虫，还有隐藏与树木草叶间的小螳螂们，来这儿呼吸新鲜: There are crazy music lovers Metallers, as well as little Mantis hiding in trees and grasses. Come here to breathe the fresh air.
在普罗花园一直隐藏着时空的裂隙，已经有部分魔物从裂隙中出现，准备好了吗？冒险者！: There is a Time Rift hiding in the Palm Garden, are you ready? Adventurer! (Lv: 15-25)
海底这么美丽的地方竟然也有裂隙生物，请冒险者在海底生态被破坏前赶到那里，修复时空: Even the beautiful sea bottom has a rift, Monsters already ran out, Help! (Lv: 30-35)
妙勒尼山脉地形复杂，在山脉中隐藏的时空裂隙不容易被发现，冒险者们请小心前往进行修: Mjolnir Mountains is very complex. The Time Rift hiding there is not easy to find. (Lv: 40-45)
干旱的沙漠中也出现了不少时空裂隙，在这严酷的环境下战斗的确是一个不小的挑战。（建: Many Time Rifts have also appeared in the dry desert. It's indeed a big challenge. (Lv: 40-50)
斐扬树林在一般情况下就十分容易迷路，更何况最近还在那里出现了时空裂隙，是时候出发: It's very easy to get lost in Payon Forest, and the rifts have made it worse! (Lv: 50-60)
兽人村在一般情况下就十分容易迷路，更何况最近还在那里出现了时空裂隙，是时候出发了: It's already very easy to get lost in Orc Village, and the Time Rifts have made it worse! (Lv: 60-70)
古城郊外有危险的龙类生存，更棘手的是在这种地方竟也出现了时空裂隙，一定要胜利啊！: There are dangerous dragons living in Glast Heim Outskirt, and what's worse, Time Rifts have appeared! (Lv: 60-70)

About [Zodiac]: 
There are a few notes for you before playing the game. 
Every adventurer has one chance of divination each day with the one who holds your hand, to obtain the Zodiac. If you receive an item from the Zodiac, you will not be able to obtain another one, even if playing the game again. 
Special Benefit: Every adventurer has a chance to change the results daily. Though, you need to buy [Invitation from Stars], a special item in the Zodiac Shop first. As long as the adventurer who starts the divination has the special item, the adventurer who is invited but without the item can also obtain an item of the Guidance of the Constellations. But in this way, every adventurer only has one chance to change the result. 
Notice: Adventurers can obtain the item of the Zodiac again after 5 AM, when the stars change their directions.
