怀抱着成为超一流冒险家的梦想，我和塞尼亚结伴来到南门区域的乐园团基地报名。: Together with Cenia, we came to register for the Eden Team near the South Gate, hoping that someday we could become first-class Adventurers.
根据考官的要求，入团需要完成两个委托任务，激情满满地开始完成吧！: According to the examiner's requirements, There are 2 quests to be done in order to be admitted. So go finish the quests with great passion!
考试项目一，委托人是竟然一只神秘魔物，果然长见识了…: Test 1, the client is a mysterious monster, That's eye opening...
波伊可真是只奇怪的波利，拿着不知道从哪偷来的枯树枝找人玩耍。: Poi is a very strange Poring, it has found a Dead Branch from who knows where and wants to play with others.
使用了枯树枝，竟然召唤出一大群魔物。好险，差点丧命…: After using the Dead Branch, a bunch of monsters suddenly appeared. That's close, Almost killed...
据波伊说是因为遭受邪恶的诅咒才变得会说人话...总之完成了这个委托…: It's said that someone cast an evil spell on Poi which had made it talk like humans... Anyway, the quest is done...
考试项目二，委托人是普隆德拉的邮递员班尼，据说挺着急的，得赶紧去看看…: Test 2, the client is mailer Banni in Prontera, This quest is very urgent and needs to be dealt with ASAP...
邮递员班尼和他最心爱的伙伴拉比丝走散了，拉比丝竟然是一只疯兔。: Mailer Banni was separated from his best buddy Lubies, and Lubies is a Lunatic.
在雾月森林没有找到拉比丝，反而引来一群魔物。: There was no sign of Lubies in the Fogmoon Forest, but a bunch of monsters instead.
在雾月湖遇到一只特别的疯兔，可能是拉比丝，但它已经狂暴了…: There was a special Lunatic near the Misty Moon Lake, it may be Lubies, but it's already demonized...
班尼还是不想放弃，想给拉比丝看它最喜爱的蝴蝶结，或许有用吧…: Banni didn't want to give up on Lubies and wanted to show Lubies its favorite Butterfly Knot, thinking this may help...
拉比丝戴上蝴蝶结后，总算恢复平静了，简直太神奇了！: After wearing this Butterfly Knot, Lubies turned calm again, that's so amazing!
顺利把拉比丝带回邮递员班尼的身边，顺利完成任务…: Bring Lubies to mailman Banni and complete the task
通过了乐园团考试，梦罗克的商队需要帮助，暂时还不能前往普隆德拉。: After passing the tests of the Eden Team, we couldn't go to Prontera directly, as the Morroc Caravan needs help.
给受伤的护卫简单包扎一下，然后前往通知商队。: Treat the wounds of the wounded guard and then inform the caravan.
打听到梦罗克方面找到了让异变魔物恢复正常的办法，但还无法大规模实行…: We heard that Morroc has found the way to calm the demonized monsters, but it can't be applied in large scale.
运送几只魔物给卡博尔大叔，顺便向他询问捕捉天使波利的方法。: Escort some monsters to uncle Cabor and ask him how to catch an Angeling.
收集了好多苹果，让卡博尔大叔帮着制作成超浓缩苹果汁…: So many apples, let uncle Cabor make them into super concentrated Apple Juice...
利用苹果汁引诱出了一大群波利，其中竟然有一只长着翅膀的波利！: We attracted a bunch of Porings out with the apple juice and one of them had wings!
原来是误会，只是戴着天使发圈的波利罢了，不过也挺奇怪的…: It turned out to be a mistake, It's just a Poring wearing an Angel Wing, but it's quite weird too...
商队捕捉天使波利的计划失败了，向考官汇报整个经过。: The caravan failed to catch the Angeling, explain the whole thing to the examiner.
被塞尼亚抱怨一番后，终于可以前往普隆德拉转职了，选择什么职业好呢？: After hearing Cenia's complaint, I could finally go to Prontera to select a job, which job is better?
第一次来到首都，塞尼亚介绍起了普隆德拉的故事，大开眼界了…: Arriving at the capital for the first time, Cenia started to tell stories about Prontera, which were quite amazing...
诸神之战过后，普隆德拉恢复了繁荣的景象，是大陆文明的中心。: After the war of gods, Prontera restored its usual prosperity and became the civilization center of the continent.
到达转职大厅之后，等待我们的是选择职业和转职试炼。: After arriving at the Adventure Hall, what we need to do is to select a job and pass the tests.
一番辛苦后，总算顺利完成了转职考试！: After lots of hard work, we finally passed the tests!
终于转职成了剑士，听说以后还可以进阶骑士。: I finally become a Swordsman, and I may upgrade to a Knight in the future.
终于选择成了魔法师，听说以后还可以进阶巫师。: I finally become a Mage, and I may upgrade to a Wizard in the future.
终于选择成了盗贼，听说以后还可以进阶刺客。: I finally become a Thief, and I may upgrade to an Assassin in the future.
终于选择成了服侍，听说以后还可以进阶牧师。: I finally become an Acolyte, and I may upgrade to a Priest in the future.
终于选择成了弓箭手，听说以后还可以进阶猎人。: I finally become an Archer, and I may upgrade to a Hunter in the future.
终于选择成了商人，听说以后还可以进阶铁匠。: I finally become a Merchant, and I may upgrade to a Blacksmith in the future.
塞尼亚也成功就职了剑士，看起来非常开心呢…: Cenia also becomes a Swordsman and seems quite happy about it...
在塞尼亚的建议下，向职业导师学习了新的技能，实力增强不少哦…: Through Cenia's recommendation, I learned new skills from my Job mentor and gained lots of power...
终于完成了就职，感觉自己变强了很多呢…: I finally had a job, and felt much more powerful than before...
应该去买件像样的防具了，这样才能更好的保护自己！: I should buy myself a suitable armor, to better defend myself!
听说下水道出现了一些麻烦，可能需要帮忙，得尽快赶去看看！: Something has gone wrong in the sewer and help is needed. We need to go check ASAP!
找到了下水道的讨伐队，这里的白鼠可真多啊，顺手帮他们清理下吧…: We meet the guard team in the sewer. There are so many Tarous, we decide to help the guards clean some...
下水道突然冒出了很多魔物，帮助讨伐队捕捉一些白鼠研究用吧…: Lots of monsters have suddenly appeared in the sewer, please help the guards catch some Tarous for study...
活捉的白鼠通过叫声引来了更多魔物，再次投入战斗！: The cry of the caught Tarous has attracted more monsters, fight them off!
终于带回了白鼠，可以继续调查下水道问题的根源了。不过被告知还有一名修理工被困在下: The Tarous have been brought back, now we can continue to check the cause for the problems in the sewer. But we heard that a repairman was stuck in the tunnel in the sewer depths...
几经波折找到了下水道深处的修理工，但他受到惊吓过度。帮他清理了那些烦人的盗虫，希: After overcoming many troubles, the repairman was found, but he was quite scared. We helped him drive away those annoying Thief Bugs, Hoping he could recover ASAP.
我们正要离开时，发现地上有一坨黄金？什么？黄金会动？！啊！那不是黄金，是传闻中的: When we were about to leave, we found a pile of gold on the ground? What? The gold can move?! Ah! It's not gold, it's a Golden Thief Bug!
连黄金虫都出现了！看来我需要有更强的装备才能保护自己，似乎铁匠忽克连知道该如何强: Even the Golden Thief Bug has showed up! It looks like I need better equipment to protect myself. Blacksmith Hollgrehenn seems to know how to enhance the Equipment
找到了铁匠忽克连，从他那知道了怎样强化装备，以后得多强化来使自己成长得更快！: I found Blacksmith Hollgrehenn and learned how to enhance equipment from him. In the future, I need to enhance more in order to grow faster!
整装待发，准备再次进入下水道，这次遇见魔物也不怕了…: Fully prepared. I decide to enter the sewer again, but this time, I won't be afraid of strong monsters any more...
唔？塞尼亚独自去南面区域寻找黄金虫了，得赶紧过去帮她！黄金虫可不是那么轻松就能对: Oh? Cenia went alone to the southern area to find the Golden Thief Bug? I need to go help her! The Golden Thief Bug is not that easy to deal with!
终于找到了塞尼亚，她竟然想跟我比赛清理盗虫的速度，但却不小心被盗虫咬伤了。: When I finally found Cenia, she invited me to compete with her on who kills faster, but she accidentally got bitten by a Thief Bug.
魔菇身上的魔粉可以消肿疗伤，得快获取一些给塞尼亚疗伤！: The Magic Powder on Spores can treat her wound, I need to go get some!
塞尼亚说有个摄影师还在下水道，可能会有危险，我们得快点找到他…: Cenia says there is still a photographer in the sewer, he may be in danger, we need to find him...
After finding the photographer, he asks us to take a picture of the Spore and bring it back...
看了摄影师里奥之前拍的珍贵照片，下水道居然有大小两条人鱼！得前往调查一下…: After seeing the precious pictures taken by photographer Reo, we find that there are two Obeaunes in the sewer! We need to go have a look...
人鱼卢西沙憎恨人类，不欢迎我们。人类自私无情地将下水道连通了海底，导致很多人鱼被: Obeaune Lusisa hates humans and doesn't welcome us. Humans selfishly connect the sewer to the sea which has caused many Obeaunes trapped in the dirty and gloomy sewer...
发现小人鱼卢西娅受了伤，用魔粉为她疗了伤。卢西沙并未因此感激我们，但至少已经获取: We found little Obeaune Lusya was hurt and used the Magic Powder to cure her. Lusisa didn't thank us for this, but we at least earned her trust.
和塞尼亚一起决定帮人鱼寻找通往海底的管道，一路还击杀了很多盗虫。: Cenia and I decided to help the Obeaunes find the passage to the sea, and we also killed lots of Thief Bugs on the way.
终于找到了出口，但两只受伤的人鱼也被讨伐队追踪到了，并发生了激烈的战斗…: When we arrived at the exit, the two wounded Obeaunes were detected by the guard team and they had a fierce fight...
卢西沙发出了悲鸣的吟唱弄晕了讨伐队，却因此加速了魔化。她托付我们将小人鱼卢西娅送: Lusisa gave out a sorrowful Cast which stunned the guards but also accelerated her demonization. She entrusted us to escort little Obeaune Lusya back to the sea...
在出口处不得已敲晕了卫兵，终于安全将小人鱼卢西娅送回了海底。: We had to knock down the guards at the exit, Then we managed to send Lusya back to the sea.
卢西沙完全魔化狂暴了...得赶快将这里的情况汇报给西门的老学者和城防队！: Lusisa has been totally demonized... We need to inform the old scholars and city defense at the west gate!
下水道的状况暂时得到了缓和，抽身去西门区域找学者史芬斯好好调查下。: The situation in the sewer is better for now, we need to find some time to consult scholar Sphens near the west gate.
找到了城防军，打听到了学者史芬斯的所在处，去找其学徒雷姆确认下。: We met the city defense and they told us where Sphens was, we need to confirm this with his student Lemon.
找到学徒雷姆，帮他教训了溜溜猴夺回了被偷走的材料，并顺路采集点材料送给学者史芬斯: We found Lemon and helped him punish Yoyo and get back the stolen materials. We also collected some materials for Sphens on the way.
将材料交给学者史芬斯，不过他还需要些枯树枝，尽力帮忙吧！: We gave the materials to scholar Sphens, but he still needs some Dead Branchs, Well, We would do our best!
收集完枯树枝，还需要些野猪毛…耐心点…: After collecting the Dead Branches, we still need to get some Mane... Be patient...
学者史芬斯探知到最近西门的魔力极不稳定，体验了他的变身魔法后前往天空花园一探究竟: Scholar Sphens detected an unstable magic power near the west gate, after seeing his transformation magic, we headed to the Floating Garden to investigate...
前往天空花园时遇见了一位魔法师，他在调查附近的魔力波动…: We met a Mage on our way to the Floating Garden he is investigating the magic vibration nearby...
通过交谈得知魔法公会发现海域魔力有异常，并协助魔法师在各处修复魔法阵。: Through the talks we learned that the Mage Guild detected abnormality in the sea magic power, and we decided to help the Mage fix the Magic Circles.
魔法阵修复完毕后遭受了一些魔物的攻击，还好应付得来…: After fixing the Magic Circle, We were attacked by some monsters, but that's not a problem to us...
魔法公会调查员确认了海底封印已有解除的迹象，他决定前往海底继续调查，并委托我前往: The Mage Guild Inspector confirmed the breaking sign of the undersea seal, he decided to go to the sea bottom to check further and asked me to send a letter to Izlude.
回去将调查结果告知学者史芬斯，并借助坐骑回到了城防军营地，受到委托去南部营地通知: I returned to inform scholar Sphens about the study results and rode back to the garrison camp. I was asked to inform the guards on the south camp.
找到了南部营地的卫兵，告诉他们出发支援的时间快到了。: After arriving at the south camp, I told the guards there that it's about time to send reinforcements.
卫兵当前的重要任务尚未完成，决定帮他封印树精…: The Guard still has an important task to do, and I have decided to help him seal the Willow...
帮雷根贝勒公司的的运输队夺回摇滚蝗虫抢走的物资，并将其送到城防军营地。: Help Rekenber's transportation team get the materials back which have been stolen by Vocals, and send the materials to the garrison camp.
回到营地后得知城防军即将启程支援，与他们相约依斯鲁德再见。: After returning to the camp, the garrison was about to set off to help, We agreed to meet again in Izlude.
终于来到了依斯鲁德，将事情的经过告诉副队长后找夏普利了解下这座迷人的海上小岛。: Finally arrived at Izlude, after telling the vice-captain what happened, go find Shapley to learn about this enchanting sea island.
夏普利介绍了依斯鲁德，并告知他儿子的梦想就是加入魔法公会，希望得到帮助。: Shapley introduced Izlude and said that his son wanted to join the Mage Guild, he hopes to get help.
决定去见见夏普利的儿子庞德。庞德说他最崇拜魔法师，一心想要成为其中一员。: Decided to meet Shapley's son Laurell Weinder. Laurell Weinder says he admires Mages the most and wants to be one of them.
找到了魔法公会的魔法师莱德，得知他们有要事在身且人手不足，顺势就将庞德推荐给了他: Found Mage Ryder of the Mage Guild and learned that the Mages were short-handed, so I recommend Laurell Weinder to him.
庞德的心愿即将实现，非常开心。祝他梦想成真！: Laurell Weinder finally gets the chance to realize his dream, and he is very happy. Good luck to him!
没想到庞德还挺羞涩，一直暗恋着飞艇管理员爱丽丝，替他把刚采的粉花送给这美丽的姑娘: Laurell Weinder has a crush on Alice but he was too shy to tell. Help him give the pink flowers to that beautiful girl.
庞德在前往魔法公会前托我帮他拍下家乡的照片作为留念…: Before heading to the Mage Guild, Laurell Weinder asks me to take a picture for this hometown as a souvenir...
从公会引导员处得知，团队协作能使冒险者更强。先努力通过测试，然后希望能加入公会这: The Guild Guide says that teamwork can make an Adventurer stronger. First work hard to pass the tests, then hopefully join a guild.
帮助公会测试者攻下了由瓦尔基里幻想守护的华丽金属房间，又守护了房内的华丽金属一段: After helping the guild tester take down the Emperium room guarded by the phantom of Valkyrie, and guarding the Emperium for a while, I finally received the qualification to join the guild.
通过测试后，见到了伟大的女武神。她肯定了我的勇气和实力，并告诉了我尘封的历史…: After passing the test, I saw the great Valkyrie. She acknowledged my courage and power, and introduced me to the past...
城防队和之前的魔法师都来找过我，可能是有紧急事件，得前往了解情况。: The garrison and Mage both tried to look for me, they may have something urgent, I need to go check with them.
对于这艘幽灵萦绕的沉船，可充满了好奇，一定得好好探索探索！: I'm quite curious about this sunken ship covered with ghosts, I will definitely explore it thoroughly!
城防军已经先行进入沉船了，得赶快去协助他们。: The garrison has already entered the sunken ship, hurry to help them.
刚进入沉船就帮城防军队员击杀了一些飘啊飘的白幽灵和粘糊糊的海葵。: Killed some drifting Whispers and sticky Hydras for the garrison guards after entering the sunken ship.
帮副队长收集了一些研究需要的海葵材料，希望有用。: Collected some Hydras for the vice-captain, hope it's useful.
发现这里的海葵会分泌一种毒液，得赶紧带上解毒药剂去寻找深入沉船的先锋队！: The Hydras here could secrete Venom, I need to bring the antidotes to the vanguards deep in the sunken ship!
胆小鬼艾德斯被路上的邪骸海盗和白幽灵吓得不敢前进，得先清理下前方的魔物…: The timid Eides was so scared of the Pirate Skeletons and Whispers on the way that he dared not to go forward, need to help him clean the monsters first...
将沉船二层的魔物都清理干净之后，终于和艾德斯把解毒药剂都送到了队员手中。: After killing all the monsters on Sunken Ship 2F, the antidotes were finally given to the members with the help of Eides
帮先锋队的成员解毒后，受研究员马克所托，需要采集一些白鼠的血液样本，还有白布和遗: After sending the antidotes to the vanguards, I was sent by Marc to collect some Tarou Blood Samples, White Cloths and Bones...
发现异常，白布上有三个洞，遗骨成分也不正常，好诡异啊…: It's so weird, There are 3 holes on the White Cloth and the Bones are not right either...
经过研究发现这里的魔物材料都含有微量的伊米尔结晶，事有蹊跷，得赶紧前往三层通知那: Through studies we find that the materials all contain traces of Yimir Crystal. This is not right, I need to inform the vanguards on 3F!
在沉船三层竟然发现了一个会说话的海盗骷髅，它竟然不相信自己已经死了！: I met a talking skeleton on the Sunken Ship 3F who didn't believe he's dead!
看样子需要认真调查一番，去寻找下还有没有其他清醒的骷髅，顺便消灭路上这些扰人的幽: It seems we need to have a thorough investigation. Go find if there are other sober skeletons and kill the disturbing Phantoms on the way!
在破烂的船舱中找到了一本古老的船员日志，哈维决定留下来查看日志找新线索…: We found an old diary in the shabby cabin, Harvey decided to stay and read the diary for some leads...
找到个古老的箱子，好像属于一个叫布拉克的海盗，翻出一张纸条，上面记载了他曾经美好: We found an old chest whose owner seemed to be a pirate named Braque. There was a note which recorded the pirate's wonderful dreams...
又一个会说话的骷髅，但它一直喊着可恶的羊角魔鬼...羊角魔鬼？天啊！难道？传言巴: Another talking skeleton, he kept shouting Evil Goat Horn Devil... The Goat Horn Devil? Oh god! Could it be? that the rumor about Baphomet's revival is true?!
原来这骷髅就是布拉克的哥哥！受他所托将物品带给了布拉克。布拉克讲述了伊米尔粉尘的: So this skeleton is Braque's brother! Upon his request, I delivered an item to Braque. Braque told the story of Yimir Dust, I didn't expect it could carry such horrifying power!
沉船的海葵实在是太多了，经常对前往的卫兵进行攻击， 希望有冒险者前去清理: There are too many Hydras on the sunken ship, they always attack the guards, hopefully someone can go clean them
幽灵！好多幽灵啊！晚上起夜被一大堆幽灵缠住，谁来帮帮我啊。: Phantoms! So many phantoms! I was surrounded by many Phantoms last night when I got out to pee. Who can help me?
据说在沉船一直有大量的骷髅聚集！这一定是魔力暴走的后果，冒险者你有活干了。: I hear that lots of skeletons are gathering on the sunken ship! It must be caused by the rampaging magic, adventurer, there are lots of things for you to do.
竟然会有一种魔物敢在我的面前横着走，还几次挡我路！简直是不可饶恕！你们谁去给它点: How dare a monster walks so arrogantly in front of me and stops me several times! Unforgivable! Who can go teach it a lesson?
前段日子想去海上捕鱼，没想到遇到一群水母骚扰，那些滑溜溜的家伙弄坏了我们所有的渔: A few days ago we went fishing on the sea, but some Marinas got in our way and those slippery things destroyed all of our fishing nets. That's so hateful.
那些叫做气泡虫的魔物实在是太危险了，要是不小心在海滩踩到…后果不堪设想，能去清理: Those Marine Spheres on the beach are too dangerous, You dare not to imagine the consequences if you accidentally stepped on it... Can you go clean them?
每次在沉船附近走过都会听到那种让人不舒服的歌声，一定是那里的多达蛙泛滥了，去驱赶: I can hear a dreadful song every time I pass the sunken ship. There must be too many Roda Frogs there, please drive them away.
我从西门经过时，边上的树木突然动了起来，不但袭击了我，还把我的推车都砸烂了，真希: When I was passing by the west gate, the trees on the roadside suddenly moved and attacked me, They even broke my cart. I really hope someone can teach them a lesson.
我有次在迷藏森林迷路时，发现了一种食肉的植物，会攻击迷失的旅行者，实在是太危险了: Once I got lost in the Labyrinth Forest and found a flesh-eating plant there, it would attack the lost travelers. It's quite dangerous, Can anyone go deal with it?
那些疯狂的摇滚蝗虫，时常聚在一起搞音乐会，那些哪是音乐，简直是噪音！！有没有人去: Those crazy Vocals always gather up to hold concerts. But what they play is not music, but noise!! Can anyone take care of that?
真是太可恶了！那些狼就在那边虎视眈眈的盯着落单的旅行者，每次我们要驱赶它们就躲进: How hateful! Those wolves are just waiting there targeting on separated travelers. Every time we try to drive them away, They will hide into the Labyrinth Forest, We don't know what to do.
前端时间不小心被紫色魔菇袭击了，然后就出现了明显的中毒症状，真是太可怕了，请务必: I was attacked by a purple Spore not long ago and got poisoned. That's quite horrible, please do get rid of those Poison Spores.
幽灵船上有些特殊的骷髅战士，给在那里驻守的士兵造成了不小的麻烦，希望有冒险者前来: There are some special skeleton warriors on the Ghost Ship who have caused great troubles to the guards there. We hope someone can help us with this matter.
最近段时间海里的剑鱼越来越多，給捕鱼带来了很大的麻烦，导致最近都没有渔民愿意下水: Recently, there are more and more Phens in the sea, they have caused big trouble for the fishermen, making them unwilling to fish any more. Who can go help the fishermen?
哥布灵又成群结队出来洗劫过往的商团了，真是让人防不胜防，这次一定要让他们受点教训: The Goblins are robbing the caravans in groups again, we are unable to avoid them. We must teach them a lesson this time! .
紧急任务！！大量波利的怨气汇聚成了一股强大的力量，终于召唤出了“幽灵波利”，冒险: Urgent Task!! The Porings have gathered up their hatred and summoned out a "Ghostring", it's time to prove your power, adventurers!
紧急任务！！那个波利中的犯罪份子又来了！有没有信心能战胜这个狡猾的恶作剧之王？: Urgent Task!! The criminal among the Porings shows up again! Are you confident in defeating this cunning King of Tricks?
紧急任务！！南门口有一直疯疯癫癫的天使波利，有没有信心消灭它呢？: Urgent Task!! There is a crazy Angeling near the south gate, do you have the confidence to kill it?
紧急任务！！在下水道里发现了黄金色的大型盗虫，似乎是盗虫首领，请立即前往支援！: Urgent Task!! A large golden Thief Bug has been detected in the sewer, it seems to be a leader, please go offer your help!
目标…海底的马克……去消灭他们……请务必完成。: The target is... Marc at the sea bottom... Please go kill them... Do finish the task.
最近出现了一种新的哥布灵，竟然有背包喷射器这种奇怪设备，专门抢劫旅行者的东西，谁: Recently there is a new type of Goblin who carries an Injection Bag and robs travelers. Who can go punish them?
最近一直发生旅行者的财物被盗窃的现象，已经确认是有着直升机的哥布灵干的，请勇士前: Recently there are some thieves stealing things from travelers. It's been confirmed that they are Rotar Zairos, please go punish them!!
那些花真的是太恶心了，竟然长着牙齿，还会咬靠近的人。看着都一身鸡皮疙瘩，谁去清理: Those flowers are so gross. They have teeth and will bite anyone nearby. Looking at them gives me goose bumps, who can go clean them?
实在是太可怕了，竟然出现了那么大的蜈蚣！真是骇人！有勇士去把他们干掉吗？: That's really horrifying. Such a big centipede! Horrible! Can anyone go kill them?
最近还真是头疼，陆续有旅行者在森林因为受到彩蝶精灵催眠而受伤，只能麻烦谁去将她们: Recently, there are travelers getting hurt in the forest due to Menblatt's hypnosis spell. Can anyone go drive them away?
只要牵扯上龙，看来都不好对付，上次在山里遭遇了龙蝇，没想到这么厉害！谁能去治治它: As long as a thing is related to dragon, It's always hard to deal with. I ran into some Dragon Flies last time in the mountains, They were quite powerful! Can anyone defeat them?
啊！这真是无法原谅，送去梦罗克的那批木材，全被白蚁啃食殆尽，我的损失！一定要人去: Ah! This is unforgivable! The wood sent to Morroc has all been bitten by the Andres, what a loss! Someone has to punish them!
在讨伐蚂蚁洞穴的战斗中我们受到了重创，主要是那些蚂蚁竟然还有回复型的黑蚁，需要冒: We suffered a lot in the battle with the ants. They have a healing unit which is called Vitata, we need Adventurers help us.
他们是蚂蚁中的战士，能消灭这些魔化的兵蚁就是证明冒险者实力的重要一环，有愿意去的: They are fighters among the ants. Killing those demonized Deniros will be a proof of power. Will anyone go?
蚂蚁地狱的规模现在是越来越大了，不久就会威胁到梦罗克城市，请冒险者去消灭蚂蚁地狱: The Ant Hell is getting bigger and bigger. Soon it will become a threat to Morroc. Please go to the Ant Hell and kill their excavator Giearth
那些可恶的红蝙蝠，看到有火光就会发动攻击，搞的我们都无法探测，谁来驱赶下这些红蝙: Those damn Drainliars will attack every time they see fire, They make us unable to explore. Who can drive these Drainliars away?
要说什么魔物最像战士，那应该就是大嘴鸟了！怎么样？有兴趣去挑战一下吗？: Speaking of the monster that resembles a warrior the most, it must be Peco Peco! So? Are you interested in a challenge?
那些摩卡一直发出恼人的声音，严重影响了我们梦罗克的城市仪表，现招募勇士前往讨伐！: Those Mukas always make annoying noises. They have stained Morroc's city image, now we are recruiting warriors to beat them!
紧急任务！！那群强盗的首领出现了！！现在招募大量冒险者前往讨伐！一定要将其歼灭！: Urgent Task!! The leader of the bandits appeared!! We are recruiting many Adventurers to fight against it! We must kill it!!
紧急任务！！海盗之王又回来了！跟随它一起回来的还有那无尽的怨念，冒险者你们准备好: Urgent Task!! Drake has returned! Together with its endless hatred. Adventurers, are you ready for a fight? We are about to sail off!
紧急任务！！潜伏在大海中的人类克星达拉蛙王又一次出现了，这次一定要将它讨伐！！: Urgent Task!! Humans' archenemy, Toad has reappeared from the sea. This time we must defeat it!!
下水道讨伐队的物资经常被那些可恶的盗虫偷走，这次一定要将它们一网打净。: Those hateful Thief Bugs always steal supplies from the sewer. This time we have to kill them once and for all.
那些绿色的盗虫实在是太强壮了，简直就是打不死的小强嘛,冒险者快来支援一下吧！: Those green Thief Bugs are too strong. They are like unkillable cockroaches. Please help, adventurers!
西门那里的苍蝇简直多得泛滥了！一群一群的苍蝇搞的西门乌烟瘴气，实在是需要人去清理: The west gate is almost devoured by Chon Chons! Swarms of Chon Chons have polluted the west gate, we need someone to clean them
无论怎么说西门也是商人和旅行者的重要通道，那些猴子就专门在那蹲点寻找偷窃目标，这: No matter what, the west gate is still an important path for merchants and travelers. We can't let those monkeys steal things like that. They should be punished!
我倒是不反感那些蝗虫的音乐，但是经常在我的菜园办音乐会就让人无法接受，冒险者来帮: I don't mind those Rockers play music, but they shouldn't hold up frequent concerts in my garden. Please help me drive them away.
世间上的美味纵有千万种，可是最令人难忘的还是那海葵触手刺身，要是能再吃到一次，真: There are countless delicacies in the world, but the most unforgettable one is Hydra Tentacle Sashimi. My life will be perfect if I can taste it again.

击退无故攻击的冰霜猎人珀尔: Repel Frost Hunter Perle who is attacking for no reason
被当做敌人了，先击败诡魅刺客琪拉吧: You're regarded as an enemy. Defeat Disenchanted Kira first

击退所有被吸引过来的瘴气史汀: Repel all the Miasmatic Stings that have been attracted

继续靠近大型机械附近: Continue to approach the huge machine
靠近机械附近的魔物: Approach the monster near the machine
到前排观摩婚礼仪式: Go to the front to watch the ceremony

天水之国是大陆上充满灵气的地方，这里生长着一种常年不谢的花——樱花。这里生长的人: The Kingdom of Heavenly Water is a place full of aura in the land, where there is a flower that never wither all the year round - sakura. The people here enjoy the food and wine made from sakura, and wear skirts and clothes printed with sakura, and spend their entire life under the sakura trees. The sakura trees growing here, slowly, also has aura, becoming spirits that can think. She looked at the sakura in the town and named herself Sakura. However, as a spirit, she could not be perceived by human beings, and she could only live alone in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water. Until one day, she met a boy who could see her. The boy was a descendant of the witchcraft house of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water, named Ida Hideaki. Hideaki, who was rejected by his peers, and Sakura, who did not exist, became companions and accompanied each other. The good times didn't last long, as Hideaki was sick. Watching his gaunt figure, Sakura made a decision in her heart. She used her own spiritual power to supplement the body of Hideaki and treat his disease, which made her weak soul become weaker. Hideaki found Sakura’s change, but he did not know the facts. He tried his best to restore the power of Sakura. In the end, he had to use the house’s banned spell to gather the spiritual power of the underground spirits of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water into Sakura to maintain her life. And the tremendous power made the Sakura lose herself and become an unconscious monster, knowing how to destroy and kill only. With the help of the adventurer, Hideaki lifted the entire banned spell, and made Sakura return to the original gentle and kind look. At this time, Hideaki knew the reason why Sakura became weakened. For her, he asked the adventurer to return the power of Sakura in his body to her and restore her vitality. While Sakura also asked the adventurer to give all her spiritual power to Hideaki to make him regain a healthy body...

两百年前，离开仙山的小狐狸在大陆上游历，因为一块樱花蛋糕与天水之国的巫女伊达杏结: Two hundred years ago, the little fox who left the celestial mountain was travelling in the land. It associated with Ida Chin, the witch of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water, because of a piece of sakura cake. The aura of the little fox attracted the curiosity of the Ida house. After their exploration, they discovered that the little fox was a celestial fox. The Ida house hoped to bind the soul of the little fox to the Ida house and make it the shikigami of the Ida house. While as a friend of the little fox, Ida Chin didn't allow the house to do so. For the freedom of the little fox, Ida Chin sacrificed her life. However, the little fox who lost its body could not return to the celestial mountain. In order to find his own little fox, the god of the celestial mountain came to the Kingdom of Heavenly Water from a distant place, and finally found the fox with the help of adventurers. The god used the magic to resurrect the little fox, but this action violated the rules of the celestial mountain. He lost his qualification and could not return to the celestial mountain. He chose to accompany his fox and travel around the land.

眼见为实，能拍一张普隆德拉皇宫的照片给我么？: Seeing is believing, can you take a picture of Prontera Palace for me?
这就是你们卢恩王国的待客之道么？: Is this how you treat your guest in Rune Kingdom?
没想到普隆德拉的皇宫还是有点东西的嘛！: The Prontera Palace is really cool!
谢谢你啦，这是我从朱诺带来的礼物，感恩的收下吧！: Thank you, this is the gift I brought from Yuno, please take it!
你听说职业转职的新消息了嘛？: Have you heard the news about the job change?
那本小姐可以考考你关于新的职业内容么？: Then can I test you about the new job content?
你这个家伙真是消息闭塞！多关注一下我们世界的最新动态再来找我！: You are really outdated! Pay more attention to the latest developments in our world and come to me again!
答对就能拿到今天的奖励噢。: Answer correctly to get today's rewards.
开始咯！第一题：下面哪个是正确的骑士三转名称？: Let's begin! First question: Which of the following is the correct title for a Knight’s third evolution?
这题已经算容易的了吧，你真的知道新内容嘛？: This question is considered easy. Do you really know the new content?
下面哪种不是新增加的坐骑之一？: Which of the following is not one of the newly added mounts?
你到底有没有仔细看清题目啊？: Have you read the question carefully?
最后一个问题，工匠们的福利，你知道是什么吗?: The last question is, the welfare of the craftsmen, do you know what it is?
看来你已经期待很久了嘛，知道的很详细呢。: Seems like you have been looking forward to the new changes because you know them in great detail.
唉，不知道为什么，自从来到普隆德拉以后，总感觉自己吃不饱。: Oh, I don’t know why, since I came to Prontera, I always feel that I don’t eat enough.
你说这是不是传说中的水土不服啊？: Do you think it is what they said about not adapting?
哪里来的鸽子啊，我怎么没看见？: Where are the pigeons, why can't I see them?
天呐，真的是我的肚子在咕咕叫！: Gosh, it’s really from my stomach!
时间过得很快呢，我就快要回到朱诺了。: Time really flies, I am going back to Yuno.
我没想到普隆德拉之行会留下这么有趣的回忆。: I didn't expect my Prontera’s trip will leave such interesting memories.
回去以后本小姐才不会想起你呢！: I won’t miss you after I go back!
等到朱诺正式开放，你要记得来朱诺城找我玩噢！: When Yuno is officially open, you have to come to Yuno City to visit me!
我给你的最后一个任务就是和我拍一张合影。: The last task I will give you is to take a photo with me.
记得要把本小姐拍得好看些！: Must make me looks good in the photo!
唔，这拍照技术，算你合格吧。: Uh, this photo-taking skill, let you pass.
你是把料理丢在路上了么?: Did you lose your food on the road?
本小姐都忘记饿肚子的话它会抗议这件事了！: I forgot that when I’m hungry, my stomach will protest!
听说有种叫做暖身料理的东西很管饱，你能带给我一个么？: I heard that there’s something called Warm Meal which is very fulfilling. Can you bring one for me?
快点！我的肚子它快撑不住啦！: Quick! My stomach can’t hold it anymore!
好慢啊，本小姐都快饿得变成飞机场啦！: So slow, I am almost as flat as an airport due to starving!
呼，饿肚子的时候果然吃什么都香呢，谢谢你啦~: Phew, when you are hungry, everything is delicious, thank you~
矗立在云巅的天空之城啊，你的曼妙身姿真让人为之倾倒。: Castle in the Sky that is standing tall on top of the cloud, your gracefulness is overwhelming.
嘿，我是艾奇！看到我身边的大家伙了么？这可是我多年的杰作，只有成为跟我一样的职业: Hi, I am Aiky! See the big guy beside me? This is my masterpiece over many years of work. Only when you’ve become a professional Mechanic like me, you can be qualified to have this Mecha.
你好啊冒险者，不用说你也是想来打造机甲的吧？: Hello, adventurer, surely you want to build a Mecha too?
喏…就是我旁边这个大家伙，货真价实哦！: Look... it’s the big guy next to me, it is a real bargain!
啧啧啧，这真是每个机匠的梦想啊！: Tsk tsk tsk, this is the dream of every Mechanic!
好了，那我废话不多说。我可以帮你打造一副机甲。: Ok, then I’ll cut it short. I can build a Mecha for you.
你也看到了，这庞大的家伙可要费不少人力和物力。: As you can see, this big guy takes a lot of manpower and material to build.
你要是愿意的话，我需要这些材料……: If you want it, I need these materials...
999个神之手，用来提升我工作的效率，否则你想拿到机甲至少也得1年后了。: 999 Hand of God are required to improve my work efficiency, otherwise you will need to wait at least one year to get the Mecha.
999个钢铁，加工后做成机甲的装甲，让你的机甲坚固无比！: 999 pieces of Steel, processed and made into armor, so that your Mecha will be very strong!
999个水晶骨，用来给机甲做骨架，活动自如哦！: 999 Crystal Bones are required to make the framework of the Mecha, for it to move freely!
999个天蓝宝石，999个青绿宝石，9999个……: And 999 pieces of Aquamarine, 999 pieces of Zircon, 9999 pieces of......
哈哈，冒险者你果然明智，都猜到我最后想说什么了。: Haha, smart Adventurer, you know what I really meant to say.
好的好的，别急。听我说，1280000Zney，这些材料都可以给你免去哦！: OK OK, don’t rush. Listen, only for 1280000 Zeny, and you don’t need to bring me all those materials!
卖这么久关子才说重点……: Hold off for so long, now only get to the point...
真的已经很优惠了，你看看这机甲的精致程度。怎么样？决定好了吗？: The price is very reasonable, you look at the exquisiteness of this Mecha. How's that? Have you decided?
别想了，这么多材料帮你省了你还犹豫什么呢？光材料费可都不止这个价了。: Don’t think anymore, you have saved so many materials, why are you still hesitating? The cost of materials are more than this price.
好！那么，你确定支付1280000Zeny打造一副机甲吗？: Okay! Are you confirm to pay 1280000 Zeny to build a Mecha?
支付成功！稍等，我这就为你打造一副机甲…: Payment successful! Wait a moment, I will build a Mecha for you...
坐上机甲，去感受我们最先进的科技吧。: Ride the Mecha to experience our most advanced technology.
每个冒险者我只会为他打造一次机甲哦！你已经找我打造过了，别以为我记性不好！: I will only build a Mecha once for every Adventurer! You have already asked me once, don't expect I have forgotten!
虽然我也很想帮你打造一副机甲，可是这已经是最低的价格了，再低我就要亏本了……带够: I wish to build a Mecha for you too, but this is already my lowest price, and I will lose money if I go lower... come back again when you have enough money, adventurer!
矗立在云雾之中的天空之城，拥有无数动人的故事，冒险者，你想听吗？: Castle in the Sky that is standing tall among the cloud, it has countless touching stories. Adventurer, do you want to hear?
在听故事之前，我想问你几个问题，很简单的小问题哦~: Before we start our story, I have a few simple questions to ask you.
第一个问题，在月狼传说的故事中，耶梦加得的哥哥是谁？: First question, in the Legend of the Werewolf, who is the brother of Jörmungandr?
第二题，创立姜饼城玩具工厂的是谁？: Second question, who built the Gingerbread City Toy Factory?
那么请听第三题，我的同僚，姜饼城的默德温·卡普讲了哪个故事？: Please listen to the third question, my colleague, what story did Medwin Kapp of Gingerbread City tell?
看来你已经对我们吟游诗人传唱的故事了若指掌了呢！: Looks like you are pretty familiar with our stories told by Bard!
那么今天，就让我们来讲讲天空之城朱诺的故事吧！: Today, let’s talk about the story of the Castle in the Sky Yuno.
作为修发兹发德共和国的首都，朱诺原本位于一片贫瘠的荒地之上。: As the capital of Schwartzvald Republic, Yuno was originally located on a barren wasteland.
这里荒芜且充满了危险，仿佛无穷无尽的魔物时刻威胁着朱诺人的安全。: In this barren and dangerous land, countless monsters threatened the safety of the Yuno people.
在一次魔物袭击后，看着满目疮痍的城市，学者科鲁特愤然说道：这，不该是朱诺人的命运: After a monsters attack, looking at the devastated city, Scholar Krutt said angrily: This should not be the fate of the people of Yuno!
也许蔚蓝的天空，才是勇敢而又辛劳的朱诺人最终的归宿。: Perhaps the blue sky is the ultimate destination of the brave and hardworking people of Yuno.
他的建议得到了当时朱诺政府的支持——政府早已厌倦这样的环境。: His suggestion was supported by the Yuno government at the time - the government was already tired of such an environment.
从此以后，科鲁特走遍了整个朱诺，搜集能够使整座朱诺城升上天空的办法。: Since then, Krutt has traveled throughout Yuno and collected ways to bring the entire city of Yuno to the sky.
他观察鸟类生物，发明了螺旋机浆，这种巨大的机械能够产生强大的推进力。: He observed the birds and invented propellers, a huge machinery that produces powerful propulsion.
一切都向着美好的方向发展着，直到某个消息打乱了科鲁特的部署。: Everything was moving in a good direction until a message disrupted the planning of Krutt.
想知道是什么消息吗？那就教训一下那些讨厌的鸟人哈比吧。: Do you know what is the message? Then teach those nasty Harpy a lesson.
真是令人惊叹的效率啊！我原以为你会很慢的。: Amazing efficiency! I thought you are a slow mover.
不过，承诺就是承诺，我就继续我的故事了。: But a promise is a promise. I will continue my story.
原来朱诺人赖以生存的能源已经接近枯竭，这让科鲁特十分苦恼。: It turned out that the energy that the Yuno people depended on was almost exhausted, which made Krutt very distressed.
众所周知，一旦没有了能源，那些巨大无比的螺旋机桨根本不会有任何作用。: As we all know, once there is no energy, those huge propellers would not have any effect at all.
政府反应非常迅速，科鲁特被授予寻找全新能源的使命。: The government responded very quickly and Krutt was given the mission of finding new energy source.
他走过国境线，尝试利用强大的风力，但风的力量无形无质无法保存，他很快便放弃了。: He travelled across the country and tried to use the wind power, but the wind power was invisible and cannot be preserved, and he quickly gave up.
他旅行至艾因布洛克原野，尝试寻找稀有的能源矿物，却被凶猛的魔物追得仓皇而逃。: He travelled to Einbroch Field, tried to find rare energy minerals, but was chased by ferocious monsters.
炙热的熔岩洞窟里蓬勃的岩浆让科鲁特惊叹不已，可一旦离开了地面，就无法继续利用这个: The thriving magma in the hot Magma Dungeons surprised Krutt, but once it left the ground, the energy cannot be used.
直到某天，饱经风霜的科鲁特来到了一个神秘的地方。: Until one day, the weather-beaten Krutt came to a mysterious place.
岁月的痕迹在这里清晰可见，科鲁特在这片初古代文明中，找到了改变朱诺的利器。: The traces of the years are clearly visible here, and in this ancient civilization, Krutt found something that could change the fate of Yuno.
讲到这里，冒险者，是收取报酬的时候了。我需要一些[c][ffff00]燃烧的心脏: When we come to this, adventurer, it is the time to collect some reward. I need some [c][ffff00]Burning Heart[-][/c]. Can you get some for me?
我要的50个[c][ffff00]燃烧的心脏[-][/c]收集齐了吗？: Have you collected 50 [c][ffff00]Burning Heart[-][/c] for me?
冒险者，这[c][ffff00]燃烧的心脏[-][/c]的数量不对啊，作为报酬可: Adventurer, these [c][ffff00]Burning Heart[-][/c] are not enough to pay me. Get some more.
「尤配擂斯」，这个初古代文明被科鲁特这样命名着。: JupCupid, this is how Krutt named the ancient city.
在「尤配擂斯」这地方的中心，有一个叫「伊米尔之心」的不明物体。: In the middle of JupCupid,  there is an unknown object called "The Heart of Ymir".
科鲁特发现，它的体积虽然小，但是仿佛蕴含着无穷无尽的能量。: Krutt found that although its size is small, it seems to contain endless energy.
科鲁特惊呼这是神的力量，只有神，才有这种无尽的伟力。: Krutt exclaimed that this is the power of God. Only God can have this endless power.
他把伊米尔之心带回了朱诺，将之镶嵌在能源器的核心之中。: He brought the Heart of Ymir back to Yuno and set it in the core of the energy device.
加速运作的螺旋机桨轰鸣着撕裂了大地，巨大的狂风压垮了地面。: The acceleration of the propellers roared, and an extremely strong wind blew on the ground.
朱诺就这样，矗立在紫色的云雾之中，成为了世人所知的“天空之城”。: That is how Yuno, standing tall among the purple cloud, became the "Castle in the Sky" known to the world.
这就是天空之城朱诺的由来。: This is the origin of the Castle in the Sky Yuno.
在听故事之前，我想请你去总统府拍张照片。: Before listening to the story, I would like to ask you to take a photo of the Presidential Palace.
既然你拍到了总统府的照片，那么今天，我就讲讲现任大总统卡尔的故事吧。: Since you took a picture of the Presidential Palace, today, I will tell you about the story of Karl, the Great President.
大总统卡尔，全名卡尔·希欧多尔·维尔史特拉斯。: Karl the Great President, his full name is Karl Theodore Weierstrass.
他自幼便生活在朱诺城下的小村庄之中，很早之前他就意识到，这个国家是病态的。: He lived in a small village near the city of Yuno since young. He realized early that the country was sick.
尽管名义上修发兹发德是一个共和国，可是其立法机关至今仍不为人所知。: Although on paper Schwarzwald is a republic, its legislature is still unknown to the public.
卡尔认为充斥在国家内部的腐败份子才是这个国家的病因所在。: Karl believed that the corruption at the core of the country was the cause of the sickness.
卡尔开始为拯救这个掌控在一群充满铜臭的商人手中的国家而做着长足的准备。: Karl began to make great preparations for saving the country from the hands of a group of merchants who only care about money.
从一个小小的政务处理员到距离权力巅峰的时刻仅有一步之遥，他花了数十年的时间。: He spent decades to advance from a small government clerk to a step away from having the ultimate power.
雷根贝勒找到了他，这也让他的目标发生了转变。: But Rekenber found him, which also changed his goal.
想知道是发生了什么转变吗？那就教训一下那些讨厌的邪恶向日葵吧。: Do you want to know what are the changes? Then teach those evil Geographers a lesson.
雷根贝勒明确的表示，只要卡尔愿意付出一点点代价，就可以顺利成为总统。: Rekenber made it clear that as long as Karl is willing to pay a small price, he can become a president.
他们目中无人的态度深深地激怒了这个由平民一步步走上来的官员。: Their arrogant attitude deeply enraged the officer who has come so far from a civilian.
同时他也明白了，原来在这个国家雷根贝勒才是实际意义上的政治掌控者。: At the same time, he also understood that Rekenber has the real political power in this country.
卡尔愤怒地拒绝了雷根贝勒的提议，雷根贝勒表示卡尔将永远不能出任总统。: Karl angrily rejected Rekenber’s proposal, and Rekenber threatened that Karl would never be the president.
这点困难击倒不了卡尔，卡尔的演讲会很快开遍了国内。: This obstacle didn’t stop Karl, his speech spread all over the country in a very short time.
他提出的清除祸害政府的腐败因子理念受到民众的大力支持。: His idea of the eliminating the corruption within the government is strongly supported by the people.
尽管有雷根贝勒从中作祟，但是卡尔还是以微弱的优势成功当选为修发兹发德共和国的大总: Despite the interference from Rekenber, Karl was successfully elected as the President of the Schwarzwald Republic with a small majority.
但是大总统深知，雷根贝勒绝对不会善罢甘休。: But the great president knows that Rekenber will never give up.
讲到这里，冒险者，是收取报酬的时候了。我需要一些[c][ffff00]火焰结晶[: When we come to this, adventurer, it is the time to collect some reward. I need some [c][ffff00]Fire Crystal[-][/c]. Can you get some for me?
我要的50个[c][ffff00]火焰结晶[-][/c]收集齐了吗？: Have you collected 50 [c][ffff00]Fire Crystal[-][/c] for me?
冒险者，这[c][ffff00]火焰结晶[-][/c]的数量不对啊，作为报酬可是: Adventurer, these [c][ffff00]Fire Crystal[-][/c] are not enough to pay me. Get some more.
雷根贝勒不断地阻扰着卡尔的政策推行，很多对国民有益的政策都无法实施。: Rekenber continued to obstruct Karl's policy implementation, and many policies that would benefit the people could not be implemented.
而卡尔宣扬的清除祸害政府的腐败因子的承诺也因此仍未实现分毫。: And Karl’s commitment to eliminate the corruption within the government has not yet been achieved.
卡尔忍无可忍，处处掣肘的政治环境让卡尔萌生了对抗雷根贝勒的念头。: Karl wouldn't tolerate it, and the restraining political situation made Karl wanted to fight against Rekenber.
他与卡普拉服务组织联手在修发兹发德运作着一个叫做秘密之翼的组织。: He teamed up with the Kafra Corporation to operate an organization called Wing of Secret in Schwarzwald.
他认为雷根贝勒的野心不止是赚钱，而是想控制整个国家，乃至整个大陆。: He believes that Rekenber's ambition is not only to make money, but to control the entire country, and even the entire continent.
而秘密之翼的目的，就是阻止修发兹发德被单一集团控制，并使得修发兹发德独立，进而使: The purpose of the Wing of Secret is to prevent Schwarzwald from being controlled by a single corporation, destroy the Rekenber Corporation and to make Schwarzwald independent.
如今秘密之翼还在各地活跃着，而大总统也在朱诺进行着自己的计划。: Now the Wing of Secret is still active everywhere, and the Great President is also carrying out his own plans in Yuno.
只是卡尔心里明白，距离驱逐雷根贝勒的目标还有着遥远的距离。: But Karl understands that there is still a long way to go before he can get rid of Rekenber totally.
这就是大总统卡尔的故事。: This is the story of Karl the Great President.
你好，冒险者，我是魔物研究学会的理赛奇·奥卡，有关熔岩洞窟的魔物信息你都可以问我: Hello, adventurer. I'm Richard Occa from the Monster Research Organization. You can ask me anything about the monsters in the Magma Dungeons.
人类早晚会为自己的行为付出代价！: Human will pay for their actions sooner or later!
通往朱诺的路上，或许大家都会注意到附近的熔岩洞窟，炙热的温度让很多冒险者都不敢靠: On the way to Yuno, everyone will notice the Magma Dungeon nearby, with their extremely high temperature stopping many adventurers from approaching.
在这样的环境下，一些拥有着火焰力量的魔物便诞生了，这些魔物原本生性活泼调皮，对人: In such an environment, some monsters with the power of flames were born. These monsters are active and naughty and very curious about humans.
但不知为什么，近些年，熔岩洞窟的魔物对人类的敌意越来越大，甚至开始猛烈地攻击冒险: But somehow in recent years, the monsters of the Magma Dungeon has become more and more hostile towards human, and even begin to attack the Adventurers violently. This has never happened before.
所以，魔物研究会特地派遣我来到这里，研究这些魔物突然狂暴的原因。: Therefore, the Monster Research Organization specially sent me here to study the reason of these monsters suddenly gone berserk.
熔岩洞窟凭借恐怖的高温成为了冒险者们十分惧怕的地方。: The Magma Dungeon have become a fearful place for the Adventurers with their horrible heat.
洞窟中的原生魔物凭借着熔岩与火焰的力量迅速成长，它们原本生性活泼，而现在却对人类: The monsters born in the caves grew rapidly with the power of lava and flames. They were originally active, but recently they are very hostile to human, often attacking innocent Adventurers.
由于生长在岩浆旁，这些魔物本身的火焰力量非常强大，普通的冒险者根本无法抵御魔物的: Because they grew up beside the magma, the flame power of these monsters is very strong. The common Adventurers can't defend the attack of the monsters. This makes people more and more afraid of Magma Dungeon and it has become a forbidden place for human.
我们魔物研究协会绝对不会允许这种事情发生，我一定会竭尽全力研究它们，找到它们攻击: Monster Research Organization will never allow this, I will try my best to study them and find the root cause of their attacks on human!

About [Fortress City Chest]: 
1. Player can receive a Fortress City Chest as reward when their guild capture a base. Reward varies with the base captured.
2. Guild leader/vice leader can open Fortress City Chest to gain artifact shards and materials corresponding to the base captured.
About [Guild Gorgeous Chest]:
1. Every guild can open Guild Gorgeous Chests with Big Cat Gold Coins (15 times) and guild funds (once).
2. Only guild leader and vice leader can open them with guild funds.
3. Opening Guild Gorgeous Chest costs Big Cat Gold Coins. The cost for opening increases with the times of opening.
4. Guild will receive artifact shards and materials corresponding to the Gorgeous Chest opened. Each member will receive extra currency as reward. (New members cannot receive any reward until the next reset). 
n5. A guild can open the Gorgeous Chest corresponding to the base it captured.

[b]参赛规则[/b]\n1）GVG决战于21:30:00开启，22:00:00:
[b]About qualifying for the competition[/b]
1) GVG final battle starts at 21:30 and ends at 22:00.
2)Any guild that manages to defend City No.1 perfectly by 21:25 during Sunday’s GVG is qualified and will go to GVG final battle map at 21:27.

[b]Battleground rules[/b]

*Factions
4 guilds compete with each other in a free-for-all during GVG final battle.

*Winning conditions
1) The guild that manages to collect 5 [Crystal Resources] wins.
2) If no guild is able to collect 5 [Crystal Resources], than the guild with the most crystals collected wins.

*Crystal Resource
1) There are 5 Crystal Resource deposits on the battlefield for guilds to compete over.
[Central Core]: Becomes available for capture 3 minutes after the battle starts. Grants 2 crystal to the guild that captures it. But these crystals will be lost if the core is lost.
[Eastern Crystal Tower] [Western Crystal Tower]: Becomes available for capture 3 minutes after the battle starts. Grants 1 crystal to the guild that captures it. But it will be lost if the tower is lost.
[Green Crystal] [Blue Crystal] [Red Crystal] [Purple Crystal]: Worth 1 crystal when intact. Cannot be repaired if destoryed by another guild.
2) If the gorgeous of a guild is destoryed, for a time all member of that guild will be forced to respawn at the guild platform when they fall in battle.

*How to capture: The guild with most players in the capture circle will continuously gain capture points. The area will be captured by this guild when capture progress bar in full.

*Crystal shard resource
1)One MVP will be spawned on the upper/lower platform every 3 minutes. Player who delivers the killing blow will earn 1 [Crystal Shard Resource] for their guild.
2) Every 4 crystal shards collected will be converted into a [Crystal Resource] that cannot be taken.
为配合EP4.0的多职业切换功能开放，建议选择一个您最主要进行游戏的角色后进入游:
With EP4.0 and multi-job switch feature available, we recommend that you play with your main character:
1. The character which you use to enter the game for the first time is considered your main character. Other characters are all secondary.
2. If main character and secondary one are of different jobs, secondary characters who are T2 or above will have their job and job level carried over to the main character. The job level carried over cannot exceed the main character’s Peak Level. If the main character hasn’t reached peak level, up to T2 Job 40 will be carried over. n3. If the secondary character shares the same job with the main characters, or is any of the T1 Job 40, the main character will receive Job Unlock Voucher for free which is used to unlock the secondary character’s 2 job branches.
4. These rules apply to main characters above T2. If the main character hasn’t reached T2, secondary characters will receive Job Unlock Voucher when they reach T1 Job 40

冒险者来到了天水之国，这里有满城的樱花在初春微冷的阳光下，一层压着一层盛开。樱花: Adventurers came to the kingdom of Heavenly Water, where sakura bloomed under the cold sun of early spring . Among the cherry blossoms, there is a strange couple. The man is the son of the Ida family of the kingdom of Heavenly Water, and the woman is a gentle and kind Elves. The gentle Elves became weak and unable to maintain its own spirit body, and her sweetheart, Ida Hideaki, stole family mantra book preserved by her sister to save her, the Curse Scroll . This book records the witchcraft of the Ida family. Ida Hideaki wanted to gather the souls of the whole city through the witchcraft in the scroll of the mantra to remedy the fragile soul of Sakura.
樱灵之爱: The Love of the Sakura Elves
为了阻止伊达秀明的聚灵巫术，小樱私自与冒险者联系，通过小樱的回忆，冒险者了解到他:
In order to prevent Ida Hideaki from gathering the elves, Sakura contacts the adventurers privately. Through recollections of Sakura., the adventurers learn their past stories. They were attracted to each other by a flower branch, and fell in love with each other over a long period of time. Hideaki had a serious illness when he was young . In order to save him, Sakura secretly transferred her spiritual power to Hideaki's body.
 Sakura was about to disappear because of the loss of psychic power.
小狐狸下仙山的时候，神明担心它的安危，为它制作了能让它安然回家的宝玉。而小狐狸将: When the fox went down to celestial mountain, the god was worried about his safety and made a treasure jade for him to go home safely. And little fox became a good friend with the witch as he sent precious jade to the kind witch.
伊达家族的巫女希望捕获小狐狸成为家族的守护神，而小狐狸只想在大陆上游历，然后回到: The witch of the Ida family wanted to capture the fox and become the patron saint of the family, while the fox wanted to travel on the mainland only and return to the celestial mountain. Ida Chin is both a witch of the Ida family and a friend of the foxes, and she did not know what he could do.
伊达杏向小狐狸表达她希望小狐狸能够留下来陪她，却被思念故乡的小狐狸拒绝了！樱花上: Ida Chin expressed to the fox that she hoped that the fox would stay with her, but was refused by the fox who missed his hometown. There is a drop of crystal dewdrop on the sakura, we do not know whether it is the dewdrop that fog condenses, or the tears of sorrowful witch?
为了复活自己养的小狐狸，神明不惜触犯了仙山的规定，在天水之国使用了法术，被除去了: In order to revive his little fox, the god did not hesitate to violate the regulations of celestial mountain , used spells in the kingdom of Heavenly Water, and was removed from heaven. Although the gods and foxes lost their qualification to return to the celestial mountain, they finally recovered each other and started a new journey.
巫女伊达杏带着小狐狸回自己的神社，却看见了一团恶灵，两人非常惊讶为什么圣洁的伊达: The witch Ida Chin took the fox back to her shrine only to see a group of wraith. They were very surprised why there was wraith in the holy Ida Shrine. In fact, the wraith were the bait released by the other witches of the Ida family to test the identity of fox.
樱花小姐选美大赛评委保管的干燥品，由天水之国特产的樱花制成，是游客最喜欢的纪念品: The Dry Material, which is kept by the the judges of Miss Sakura Contest, is made from Sakura growing in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water. It's a favorite souvenir for tourists as well as the symbolization of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water.
以七种毒蛇蜕下的皮合制成的手套，可以抵御几乎所有腐蚀性物质，唯一的缺点是非常闷热: Gloves made of skins shed by seven kinds of venomous snakes that provide protection against almost any corrosive substance. The only drawback is their stuffiness.
被它刺中并不会流血，那是因为刺中的瞬间，血就已经结冰了。: The wound it creates will not bleed, for the blood is already frozen the moment it pierces the flesh.
寄宿着古老英魂的拳套，戴上它之后，每一招都变得更加迅猛有力，攻击缭乱如舞让敌人无: A pair of ancient knuckles with souls of ancient martyrs residing within.  Each of its strike grows more powerful than the last, and they give their foes a hard time defending against their flurry of attacks.  "Throw everything you’ve got at me." - A certain champion

那些自以为善良的人们放生了太多幼年火焰鸟，会有很大的后患！还是去消灭一些吧。: Those so-called kind-hearted people freed too many captive Fire Fledglings which poses a huge threat to all of us!  You’d better go kill some of them.
还记得骚扰过阿革薇的小恶魔嘛？它们如今进化成了爆炎小恶魔，同时也进化成了大色魔。: Remember the Deviruchi that harassed Agwi?  They’ve evolved into Fiery Deviruchi, and pervy ones at that.

土拨鼠的门牙长的真有意思，我们正在研究这玩意儿能否应用到某项发明中去。: Martins have the most interesting front teeth. We’re studying if they can be used to create some kind of invention.

1.每日超过指定战斗时长，经验和掉落开始衰减。\n2.每日凌晨5点恢复300分钟:
1. When the specified daily combat limit is exceeded, the experience and loot rate will begin to decrease. 
2. The combat duration is restored to 300 minutes at 5:00AM daily, and the unused combat duration can be accumulated up to a max of 600 minutes (Maximum total: 900 min). 
3. PVP is not included in the combat duration. MINI and MVP are not affected by the rules of loot reduction. 
4. If you are in a team during the reduction period, you alone will be bound by the rules of reduction and your Party members will not be affected. 
5. If your Party members and you are on the same map, when Party members fight, the combat duration will be shared with all Party members in the map. 
6. The Mentor who holds a valid Premium can earn 30% of the effective combat duration from different students, up to a maximum of 120 minutes of effective combat duration per day. 
7. Voice technology is provided by iFlytek.

8. When closing the stall, the goods need to be retrieved manually or they remain there.
9. Retrieving goods will unlock frozen reward points.
10. Goods put on sale during publicity period cannot be sold for its original price.

恐怕这个接近朱诺的强大存在就是传说中的世界大蛇耶梦加得，这可糟糕了！: I'm afarid this powerful being coming towards Yuno is the legendary great serpent Jörmungandr, this is bad news!
不好，我感觉被那股强大的力量反噬了！: This is not good, I feel like my spell is being repelled by that powerful being!
区区凡人，竟然窥视神明？付出代价吧！: Puny mortal, how dare you spy on your god? Time to pay your price!
你赶紧去与卡尔大总统会面，将我们已经知道的情报告诉他！: You have to go meet President Karl, let him know what we have learned!
（喃喃自语）在间隔了几百年后，传说中的世界大蛇再次降临朱诺，到底为了有什么目的呢: *Mumbling* Centuries have passed and now the legendary great serpent has come down on Yuno once again, what does it want?
你终于来了，基本情况我已经从波普利的报告书里看到了。: You're finally here, I have already learned of the situation from Popli's report.
没想到异常的源头竟然是传说中的世界大蛇耶梦加得！: I did not expect that the source of the strange occurrence would be the legendary great serpent Jörmungandr!
总统府卫兵进入一级警戒！: Presidential Palace Guard, first class alert!
根据目前的情况，我们的当务之急是确定世界大蛇的具体位置。: Considering the situation at hand, locating the great serpent is our main priority.
在确定了世界大蛇的位置后，我们再进行下一步的应对计划。: We can carry out our next plan after locating the great serpent.
毕竟这是相关朱诺存亡的大事，越多人知道，消息外泄产生恐慌的可能越大。: This is about the life and death of Yuno, afterall. The more people who know about it, the greater the possibility news of the incident will spread and cause widespread panic.
目前能胜任这个艰巨任务的最佳人选只有你了，为朱诺献出你的力量吧！: The only suitable candidate to carry out this difficult mission is you, please fight for Yuno!
哼，懦夫，朱诺只欢迎拥有勇气和荣誉的人。: *snort* Coward, Yuno only welcomes those who come with courage and honour.
切记，要是与世界大蛇遭遇，千万别惊动他，及时联络我和西芙！: Remember, if you ever encounter the great serpent, don't startle it, contact me and Siv as soon as possible!
对了，波普利好像有东西要交给你，与搜寻半神的任务有关。: By the way, Popli has something for you, it is about the mission to look for the demigod.
在开始任务前你先去见波普利一面吧。: Please meet Popli before you start your mission.
看来卡尔大总统把计划都告诉你了。: It seems that President Karl has told you about the plan.
这是用海姆达水晶碎片精炼的海姆达宝石，它可是搜寻世界大蛇最好的探测仪。: This is the Heimdall Stone refined from the pieces of Heimdall Crystals, it is the best detector that can be used to locate the great serpent.
嘘！这可是贤者学院的密宝！一定要好好保存啊!: Shush! This artifact belongs to Sage Academy! Be careful, don't lose it!
海姆达宝石会对耶梦加得的神力产生共鸣，只要附近有耶梦加得的气息，它就会震动。: Heimdall Stone will resonate with the magical might of Jörmungandr, it will vibrate when Jörmungandr is near.
带着它在艾因布洛克原野搜寻世界大蛇的踪迹吧，那里是来到朱诺的必经之路。: Bring this to Einbroch Field to look for the great serpent, it is the way that one must pass to reach Yuno.
地上有奇怪的战斗痕迹。: There is strange evidence of combat on the ground.
满地都是被打倒的鸟人哈比，地上有一片奇怪的鳞片。: The floor is filled with the defeated Harpies and there is a strange scale on the ground.
你手上的这个鳞片是！！！: The scale on your hand is...!!!
这种未知的气息和秒杀大量魔物的力量，这一定是耶梦加得的鳞片没错了！: It's has a mysterious scent and the power to obliterate many magical beings, this is definitely the scale of Jörmungandr!
你说尘世巨蟒的气息消失在了艾因布洛克原野的入口？: Did you just say that the giant serpent's scent is lost at the entrance of Einbroch Field?
看来他很可能已经通过了艾因布洛克原野来到朱诺了。: It appears that he might have already gone past Einbroch Field into Yuno now.
事不宜迟！你需要赶紧确定他在朱诺的位置！: This can't wait! You must fin him wherever he is in Yuno!
If the big serpent gets anywhere near the palace or Heimdall Crystal, it will……
海姆达宝石开始强烈震动，耶梦加得似乎在海姆达水晶附近徘徊！: Heimdall stone is vibrating violently, Jörmungandr is probably near Heimdall crystal!
不好，耶梦加得似乎往皇宫和总统府的方向去了！: Oh no, Jörmungandr seems to be heading towards the imperial palace and presidential palace now!
好奇心太重可不是一个好习惯噢，凡人。: Curiosity might lead to a bad consequence, mortal.
渺小的凡人啊，打扰神明的假期可是重罪噢。: Puny mortal, it is a heavy sin to disrupt your god's vacation.
我可清楚的说过，再次见面的时候，我们就是敌人了，是谁派你来的？: I have made myself clear before, we will be enemies when we meet again, who sent you?
哼，我就知道，他们不过是一群惊慌蝼蚁罢了。: *Chuckles* I knew it, they are just a flock of terrified sheep.
在你面前的就是传说中的尘世巨蟒本人，你接下来说的每一句话与每一个选择都会决定你的: You are standing in front of the giant Serpent himself. Every word you said and choice you have made will determine your faith.
(冷笑)我来朱诺的目的？你有资格过问么？: *smirks* Why am I here in Yuno? Are you qualified to ask me that?
哼，这气势倒是不错嘛，我就破例给你一次机会，如果你能战胜我的分身，我就告诉你答案: Huh? Very imposing, I will make an exception for you, if you can defeat my duplication, I will answer your question.
你果然还是那么强啊，神是不会食言的，我就勉强回答一下你的愚蠢问题。: You are still as powerful as you were. God won't break his promise, I shall answer your stupid question.
我是来朱诺度假的。: I'm just a taking a vacation in Yuno.
钟楼的事件之后，我就前往我的下一个目的地了。: After what happened in the clock tower, I came to my next destination.
可惜我的目的地并不是朱诺，只是路过这里稍作停留，顺便享受一下朱诺的美食而已。: Sadly my destination is not Yuno, I am just passing through and enjoying the delicacies in Yuno on the way.
回去告诉那些管理朱诺的蝼蚁，不用大惊小怪，这里吸引我的只有尝起来还不错的食物而已: Go back and tell that flock of sheep who run Yuno to stop panicking, the only thing that will attract me here is the fine foods in Yuno.
尘世巨蟒现在在朱诺哪里？他到底有什么目的？: Where in Yuno is the giant serpent now? What does he want?
只知道求饶么，相比在艾尔帕兰时，你的心渺小软弱多了呢。: Pleading for your life? You are more cowardly than you were back in Al de Baran.
这样吧，要是你能战胜我的分身，我就再给你这软弱的灵魂第二次机会。: How about this, if you can defeat my duplication, I will grant you a second chance for your weak soul.
哼，看来你命不该绝，重新回到选择之时，慎重决定吧！: Heh, it seems you are not meant to die here. Now it will go back to when you made the choice, choose wisely!
神秘约定？你竟然知道百年之前我与巴特蒙德的约定？: The secret agreement? How would you know about the agreement between me and Battmond hundreds of years ago?
你究竟是从哪里知道的？: How did you find out about that?
哼，那是我和巴特蒙德那个怪物的私事，与你无关。: *Snorts* It's a private matter between me and Battmond and it's none of your business.
继续追问的话，我可不会再手下留情。: If you keep asking, I won't be so merciful.
总之我与巴特蒙德的约定导致我无法对朱诺出手。: Anyways, I can't do anything to Yuno because of the agreement between me and Battmond.
不然以我的力量，你们能阻拦我么？: Otherwise, do you think you could stop me with all of my power?
我只是路过这个漂浮的小土丘，顺路来摄入一些还算咽的下口的食物而已。: I'm just passing through this floating mound and getting some decent food.
哼，不可以么？我的私事轮不到你来指手画脚。: Huh? My private life is none of your business.
别再打扰我了，趁我还没改变主意，从我的面前消失吧！: Stop bothering me. Before I change my mind, be gone!
你竟然独自面对了世界大蛇吗！？你现在还能站在这里真是奇迹啊。: You went and confronted the giant serpent!? It's a miracle that you can still stand here talking.
既然你活着回来了，你是否探查到尘世巨蟒究竟为何来到朱诺？: Since you made it back alive, have you found out why the giant serpent is coming to Yuno?
度...度假？我的天啊，这个节骨眼上你可别和我开玩笑！: Vac… Vaction? My god, please don't make any jokes at this critical moment!
好吧，也只能相信你了，我这就解散总统府卫队的一级警戒。: Alright, I can only choose to believe you, I will cancel the first class alert of Presidential Palace Guard.
世界大蛇，真是位奇怪的神明！好在这次没有与他发起正面冲突！: What a strange god the great Serpent is! Luckily there is no actual conflict with him this time!
这次的事件，你功不可没，朱诺的信任与友谊是你应得的。: Your service and contribution is remarkable in this incident, you deserve Yuno's trust and friendship.
对了，伊芙院长说贤者学院珍藏的海姆达宝石不见了，这与耶梦加得有关么？: Oh right, Sage Academy President said that the Heimdall Stone was missing, does it have anything to do with Jörmungandr?
那可是很贵重的宝石呢，可要好好追查！: It's a really important stone, we need to investigate it carefully!
我代表朱诺再次向你表达由衷的感谢。: On behalf of Yuno, you have our sincere gratitute.
这句解读关系到之前所有的努力，你可别开玩笑啊，再好好想想！: This interpretation matters all the effort we have made before, please take it seriously, think again carefully!
真的是这样么？看来你的记忆力不是一般的糟糕啊。: Is it really like this? It seems your memory is not just normally bad.
你真的查阅古籍了么？只怕是敷衍的随便翻翻而已吧？: Have you really read those books? You just browsed it through carelessly, right?
你父亲因为长期待在雷根贝勒的研究所内，: Because your father has spent a long time in the Rekenber Lab,
身体遭到了化学物质无法逆转的侵蚀。: my body went through an irreversible corruption by the chemical materials.
身体一天不如一天。: My health is getting worse day by day.
他的理智正在被异空间吞噬！: His consciousness is eaten by the foregin dimension!
冒险者怀着满心的期待来到了幻想之地——姜饼城，但此时的姜饼城正陷于危机之中。城中: The hopeful adventurer travelled to the land of fantasy, Gingerbread City. However, Gingerbread City is currently in a crysis that the children of the city have disappeared one by one…
为了追查事件的真相，冒险者陪同小女孩珍妮去马戏团观看表演并结识了马戏团的红鼻子小: In order to discover the truth behind this incident, the adventurer went with the girl, Jenny, to the circus and met Gale the red nose clown. They defeated the performers together who suddenly turned evil and became enchanted.
冒险者和圣诞老公公经过线索分析后察觉到，马戏团的这些表演者正是姜饼城失踪的孩子！: After analyzing the clues, the adventurere and Santa Claus both discovered that those performers are those missing children from Gingerbread City! The mastermind behind it is Bijou the puppet wizard.
六十年前的冬天，年幼的加尔被毕尤带到了姜饼城，从那时候开始，毕尤就计划着利用加尔: In the winter 60 years ago, the young Gale was brought to Gingerbread City by Bijou. Ever since then, Bijou has been planning on using Gale to steal the shard of Heart of Ymir in Gingerbread City.
圣诞老人将事情的真相告诉了姜饼城的居民，并将大家集结在一起，共同对抗加尔和毕尤。: Santa Claus told the truth to the residences of Gingerbread City and united them together to fight against Gale and Bijou. At that moment, the adventurer found out that Jenny has gone missing as well!
冒险者连忙向珍妮的家人打听情况，却意外的从珍妮的奶奶贝蒂口中知道了她小时候曾与加: The adventurer then hurriedly inquired about her information from her family and accidentally discovered from Jenny's grandmother, Betty, that she used to be good friends with Gale when she was little.
借着贝蒂对加尔的了解，冒险者在马戏团帐篷内找到了加尔，但小女孩珍妮依旧不见踪影。: With Betty's help, the adventurer found Gale in the tent of the circus but still could not locate Jenny. At this very moment, Gale managed to escape with the help of Bijou.
经过一番调整与准备，冒险者决定再次前往马戏团营救孩子们。这一次的行动成功了，但珍: After preparation and planning, the adventurer decided to travel to the circus once again to save the children. The operation is a success but Jenny was already taken by Gale before the adventurer has arrived.
获救的孩子告诉冒险者，其实加尔并没有大家想的那么坏，他从来没有伤害过孩子们，而他: The rescued children told the adventurer that Gale wasn't really that evil like people thought he was. He has never hurted the children and everything he has done was to get Betty's attention induced by Bijou.
此时，毕尤意识到贝蒂是唯一可以阻止加尔并破坏她计划的人，她连忙派出傀儡去攻击贝蒂: At this moment, Bijou realized that Betty was the only one who could stop Gale and interrupted her plan. She sent out her puppet to attack Betty in order to drive her away from Gingerbread City.
然而贝蒂在遭受攻击的过程中，找回了自己那段丢失的记忆，她坚持与冒险者一起前往马戏: However, Betty found her lost memory while being attacked, she insisted on travelling with the adventurer to the circus and found Gale with the help of her own memory.
在贝蒂一声声的呼唤下，加尔终于认出了她。贝蒂为没能遵守当年的约定向加尔道歉，并告: With Betty's constant call, Gale finally recognized her. She apologized to him for not being able to keep the promise and told Gale that Bijou murdered her parents which let her never come back to Gingerbread City.
加尔这才知道这一切都是毕尤的诡计，终于清醒了过来。毕尤恼羞成怒发起了攻击，冒险者: Gale finally realized that this is all Bijou's evil plan and finally came around. Enraged by this, Bijou lauched fierce offenses. With the help of the adventurer, they defeated Bijou and save Gingerbread City.
一切都结束了，危机成功解除了，孩子们回到了自己的家里。: Now it has finally come to an end. The crysis is gone, the children have all returned to their home.
而加尔和贝蒂一起离开了，没有人知道他们去了哪里，但可以确定的是，他们会和小时候约: Gale and Betty left together. Nobody knows where have they gone to, but what can be certain is that they will hold their hands, accomopany each other and never depart just like the promise they have made to each other.
柏伊亚岚岛的船长新开了一条前往天水之国的航线，冒险者憧憬着美丽的樱花之都，乘船来: the captian of Byalan Island has established a new route to the Kingdom of Heavenly Water. Astonished by the beautiful city of sakura, the adventurer travelled to Amatsu with the ship.
刚来到天津町，冒险者就遇到了一个老熟人——法师摩根。此时的摩根令冒险家目瞪口呆，: Arriving at Amatsu, the adventurer recognized a familiar face, Morgan the wizard. Morgan was drunk and wearing a female kimono while dancing at the contest site of Miss Sakura, which perplexed the adventurer.
就在冒险者与摩根说话的时候，一个名叫伊达秀明的少年出现了，他出声制止了摩根的喧闹: When the adventurer and Morgan were talking, a young man named Ida Hideaki showed up and tried to stop the trouble-making Morgan. However, scared by this "female ghost" who suddenly appeared, Morgan fainted. Knowing that Morgan and the adventurer aren't ordinary people, Hideaki decided to ask them for help.
摩根看到的这个女鬼其实是个善良的樱之灵，名叫樱。秀明从小就与樱相识，但是最近樱开: The "female ghost" Morgan has seen is actually the kind spirit of sakura called Sakura. Hideaki met Sakura ever since they were little. Recently, Sakura startes to look transparent and sometimes even disappears. Hideaki thought it was due to his weak magic power therfore he wanted the adventurer to help him acquire a spell scroll from the Shrine.
然而这本卷轴由神社的巫女，也就是秀明的姐姐伊达千代子掌管，她唯独不愿意将卷轴借给: However, this scroll is being held by the witch in charge of the shrine, Ida Chiyoko, who is also the sister of Hideaki. She refused to want to lend the scroll to Hideaki.
摩根假扮成巫女继承人去借阅咒法卷轴，却被千代子当场识破。秀明只能令作他法，他利用: Disguised as the successor of the witch, Morgan tried to borrow the scroll from her, however he was seen through by Chiyoko on the spot. Hideaki could only resort to another way by using the adventurer to draw her attention while he sneak in to steal the scroll. The adventurer finally realized that Hideaki had been deceiving him, but the wheel of faith that Chiyoko has been trying to stop started to spin regardless.
秀明带着卷轴逃走后，樱却现身了。她告诉冒险者，她的灵力越来越弱已经快要消失了，秀: After Hideaki escaped with the scroll, Sakura showed up. She told the adventurer that her spiritual power had been weakening to a point that it would dry up, what Hideaki had been doing was to save her.
秀明想要利用卷轴中记载的一个大规模聚灵法术，把整个天水之国的灵聚集起来，将它们的: Hideaki wanted to use the great spirit summoning spell documented on the scroll to gather all of the spirits from the Kingdom of Heavenly Water and use them to replenish Sakura's dying spiritual power.
秀明此时正在为庞大的聚灵仪式做准备工作，冒险者在千代子的帮助下破坏了秀明的法阵。: While Hideaki is preparing for the great ceremony of spirit summoning, the adventurer and Chiyoko showed up and destroyed Hdeaki's magic array. But it was actually a decoy set by Hideaki to keep them occupied while he casted the real spell in the enchantment successfully!
千代子和冒险者终究还是晚了一步，仪式已经开始了！然而樱根本承受不住这么多灵力，她: Despite the attempt of Chiyoko and the adventurer, the ceremony had already begun! However, Sakura didn't have the threshold to take in so many spirits, her spiritual body has absorded so many spirits that she has lost her consciousness and turned into a terrifying force. Chiyoko and the adventuerer can no longer stop that from happening.
秀明这才意识到自己做了件多么大的错事，懊悔不已。就在绝望之际，摩根一改往日散漫的: Hideaki finally realized that he has made a big mistake and deeply regreted it. At this desperate moment, Morgan showed up. Not acting like his usual self, he managed to come back in time and turned Sakura back to normal.
被聚集的灵们在冒险者的帮助下回到了地下，原本枯萎的樱花树们重新争相盛开，天水之国: With the help of the adventurer, the summoned spirits returned to the underworld, the withered Sakura trees start blossoming, the Kingdom of Heavenly Water has become beautiful once again.
一切真相都浮出了水面，原来秀明从小体弱多病，樱一直用自己的灵力为他治疗，这才导致: The truth is finally revealed. It turns out Hideaki has been suffering from a weak body ever since he was little, Sakura has been treating him with her own spiritual power, which leads to the weakening of her power. Hideaki finally realized that he had been hurting Sakura while naively convinced that he was helping her.
摩根手上有个魔法珠，可以为二人实现一个愿望。樱希望用她最后一点灵力为秀明治疗，然: Morgan has a magical orb which can grant only one of their wishes. Sakura wishes to use her remaining spiritual power to treat Hideaki and erase every piece of his memory about her to embrace a better future. Hideaki wishes to return all of the spiritual power to her, even if he could only live for five more years, it would be the happiest time of his life.
他们都将殷切的目光投向拥有决定权的冒险家……是让有情人不惧已知的未来享受当下短暂: They both look at the adventurer earnestly who gets to decide whose wish to grant….. Should they live the rest of their short lives in happiness or should they forget about everything and move on…. What would your choice be?
在默斯曼·岁月与炼金术士公会会长威克斯的帮助下，冒险者暂时击退了耶梦加得，但他却: With help of Mosman Time and Weekes, the leader of the Alchemist Guild, the adventurer finally defeated Jörmungandr and drove him away. But Jörmungandr has claimed that he has captured Norman's younger brother, Red. The great crysis of Al de Baran seems to be just beginning...
圣诞老公公猜测，加尔带走珍妮是因为将她误认成了贝蒂，因为那是他记忆中最不可磨灭的: Santa Claus deduced that Gale didn't kidnap Jenny because he has mistaken her for Betty, but for the unforgetable great memory he had.
善良的樱不愿意牺牲这些灵来延续自己的生命，她希望千代子和冒险者能阻止秀明的聚灵之: The kind Sakura doesn't want to sacrifice all these spirits to prolong her own life, she wants Chiyoko and the adventurer to stop Hideaki from casting the spell.
在克雷斯特同盟军成功驻扎后，冒险者自愿前往古城对同盟军进行支援。: After the Glast army has successfully garrisoned, the adventurer volunteers to travel to Glast Heim to support the army.
冒险者刚来到古城，就得知魔法师学徒庞德的灵魂被黑暗之王带走了，至今毫无消息！: Just after arriving at Glast Heim, the adventurer was informed that the soul of the wizard student, Laurell Weinder, was taken by Dark Lord. He was never heard from ever since.
冒险家在调查的过程中得知，黑暗之王和他的属下迷幻之王以灵魂为食，他们平日便在古城: During the investigation, the adventurer discovered that Dark Lord and his henchman, Dark Illusion fed on souls, they have locked countless shattered souls in Glast Heim.
庞德的灵魂比普通人纯净数倍，正是黑暗之王与迷幻之王口中的美食盛宴。: Laurell Weinder's soul is purer than the ordinary people, which is the finest delicay to Dark Lord and Dark Illusion.

Each rating rewards can be claimed once.

Rules: 
1. Defeat as many monsters as you can before time runs out to earn higher rating. The player with the highest rating will be rewarded when event concludes.
2. Defeated monsters have a chance to drop skill. Use skills against different monsters to significantly promote your efficiency
3. The challenge ends when time runs out or all invading monsters are defeated

Rewards: 
1. Reward for clearing: 
Clear the stage for the first time every day to receive 5x [Gift from Nebula M78]
2. Bonus: When clearing the stage for the first time every day, extra reward will be given based on the number of unlocked [Ultraman Headwear] in your Adventure Handbook
1x [Gift from Nebula M78] for unlocking 1 headwear
2x [Gift from Nebula M78] for unlocking 3 headwears
3x [Gift from Nebula M78] for unlocking 5 headwears
4x [Gift from Nebula M78] for unlocking 7 headwears

婆婆看了我一眼，叹着气连连摇头。接着，她给我讲了这个娃娃背后的故事……: The old woman looked at me, sighing and shaking her head. Then she told me the doll's story...

呼~这就是替身人偶的故事。: And that is the story of the magic doll.

“走不出去。城堡里只有我一个人，外面永远是浓雾。”: “I can't get out...” “I'm the only one in the castle, and outside is a sea of fog."
“不管我怎么尝试离开，最后都会回到这里。”: "No matter how hard I try to leave, I always end up back here in the end."
“我也记不得呆了多久了。时间一长，我甚至放弃了出去的想法。”: "I can't remember how long I've been here.” “It's been so long... Perhaps I should give up on ever getting out...”
“但，诡异的事渐渐发生。”: "But strange things are happening all around me."
“从某一天开始，我时常能听到耳边有人在说话。”: “I've begun to hear voices speaking in my ear."
“家里的物品，也在我睡梦中被移动过。”: “Things are being moved around while I sleep."
“过了几天，家里竟然被画满了奇怪的符号！而画了符号的地方，我就不能靠近了！”: “I have now discovered the castle to be filled with strange symbols!” “And I can't approach areas marked with these strange symbols!”
“时间一长，我还在家里看到了从来没出现过的黑影……”: "For a long time now, I have seen a dark shadow that never reveals itself..."
“黑影越来越多，我走到哪里，它们就跟到哪里……”: "More shadows have appeared, and wherever I go, they follow me..."
“种种迹象让我毫不怀疑，这间城堡在闹鬼。”: "I have no doubt that the castle is haunted..."
“我反抗了。我对着它们吼叫。我砸烂了屋子里的所有东西，但无济于事。”: "I have resisted.” “I have screamed at them.” “I broke everything in the house, but it didn't help.”
“黑影依然跟着我。好像只要我在城堡里，它们就不会散去。”: "The shadows still follow me.” “It seems that as long as I am in the castle, they will not go away.”
“我要出去。不惜一切代价，我要出去！”: "I'm leaving.” “I must escape... at any cost.”
当时我很感兴趣，就问女仆小姐是否有后续。: Naturally, I was very interested and asked the maid if she had any further information.
她想了想，递上了一本档案。上面写着四个字：除灵记录。: She thought about it and handed me a dossier. There were two words on it: Exorcism Proceedings
“四月三日，至古堡。有灵，为男性。被困于此，怨气颇重。”: “April 3rd. We have arrived at the castle.” “There is a spirit... a male spirit.” “Trapped here, his resentment has grown.”
“试符咒，试降灵，试招魂，皆无果。后于暗室寻得其遗体，遂净化。”: “Incantations, séances, invocation... nothing seems to work.” “The remains were found behind the darkroom and sanctified...”

话音刚落，贝尔发现自己的身体不受控制地动了起来。而脚上穿着的，正是那双她心心念念: As his voice rang in her ears, Belle realized that she couldn't control her body. She looked down to see the crystal shoes she had been dreaming about.

童谣是这么唱的：“莉兹，莉兹，非常叛逆。但她的花园真美丽。银色的贝壳和风铃，还有: The nursery rhyme went like this: “Pearl, Pearl, a treacherous girl...” “Her beautiful garden, a secret world...” “With silver shells and chrome wind bells, mysterious flowers that flutter and twirl...”

另一片米德加尔特的你和你们，现在是否安好？: Another piece of Midgarts... Are you okay now?

身处这边的我们，虽然不能亲身去帮助他们，但是至少可以为他们献上祝福。: Maybe we can't help them directly, but we can at least offer our best wishes to them.
你的祝福他们一定会收到。: I'm sure they'll receive your blessings.

拜托你了！冒险者。: I'll leave it to you! Adventurer...
你好，我叫拉米尔，是一位时空观察者。: Hello, my name is Ramir, an observer of time and space.
在与魔王梦罗克那一战之后，我发现了一件可以轰动整片大陆的事情！: After the war with Monster King Morroc, I discovered something that would stir up trouble across the entire continent!
在遥远的时空彼岸，出现了另一个米德加尔特大陆。: On the far side of time and space, another continent of Midgarts has appeared.
那里的山川，河流，树木都和我们这片大陆一致。: The mountains, rivers, and trees... they are all exactly the same as the formations of our continent.
我甚至还通过时空仪器见到了我逝去的爱人。: I even saw my lost lover through my time and space observation instruments...
但是同样的，那边大陆也遭受着魔物的侵袭，所有的冒险者也都在同魔物做着殊死战斗。: But the continent is also being attacked by demons, and all of the adventurers there are fighting desperately against them.
身处在这边的我们虽不能亲自到达那片土地，但是却可以为他们祈祷。: We can't travel to their world, but we can pray for them...
善良的你，许下的愿望一定会实现。: With such kindhearted intentions, I believe your prayer will come true.
我想，彼岸的冒险者也一定会为你祝福的。: I believe the adventurers in the other world will certainly bless you, too.
多亏冒险者的全力解救，我们才能顺利来参加庆典啊！: Thanks to your efforts, we're able to join the celebration!
在地牢里可饿死我了……我要大吃一顿！: I was starving to death in the dungeon... I want a big meal!
到这里就靠你了，冒险者！小心一点，千万别被守卫发现了！: It's thanks to you that we made it this far, adventurer! Be careful not to be caught by guards!
我一把老骨头，也帮不上什么忙了。: I'm just a bag of old bones... I won't be of much help to you.
不过我会用魔法探测这里的机关，给予你指引！: But I will use magic to detect the constructs here and guide you!
正中间的通道已经被封锁了，先去左侧的房间打开机关吧。: The corridor in the middle is blocked. Go to the room on the left first and open it.
干得好！现在先进去看看情况。: Well done! Now, let's take a look at the situation here.
下一个机关就在你右侧的房间里。但正前方有很强的敌人！别和它们正面冲突！: The next construct is in the room on your right. But there are strong enemies ahead! Don't confront them head-on!
我在感应下一个机关位置……找到了！: I'm detecting the next construct's position... I have it!
这样一来，后面的机关就打开了。快去找到可怜的小哥布灵们吧！: And so, the rear construct opens. Go and find those poor Goblins!
That... truly is a pity. I wish an adventurer could help me...
（大口咀嚼）啊呜……真好吃！嗦嗦，要一起参加今年庆典的寻宝冒险吗？: (Chewing) Uh-huh... It's really delicious! Do you want to team up for the treasure-hunting adventure at this year's celebration?
事不宜迟，尽快出发吧！: It's not too late. Let's get started as soon as possible!

你是谁？别过来！！: Who are you? Stay right there!
什么？你一定是大巫师乌拉请来的救兵吧！谢天谢地，我们赶紧离开这鬼地方吧！: What? You must have been sent from the great wizard, Yula. Thank goodness, let's get out of this place!
噗呀……[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]！庆典上有好: Pffff... [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]! There are so many tasty treats to eat during the celebration!
冒险者，我再告诉你个秘密啊~: Adventurer, let me tell you another secret...
我作为活动大使，有那么一点点小特权。可以直接带你去踏青庆典的会场哦！: As a Festmaster, I have some special privileges. I can take you straight to the celebration venue.
怎么样，现在要去吗？: So, how about it? Shall we go now?

噗呀噗呀！在哥布灵王国的庆典上尽情玩耍吧！: Puff! Puff! Enjoy the Goblin Kingdom celebrations!

让快乐的音符响彻大陆吧！: Let the joyous melody ring throughout the land!
妮莉小姐姐盛世美颜！: Nelly really is a real stunner!
雅拉小姐姐天外飞仙！: Yala is out of this world!
最喜欢唱歌了！: I like singing more than anything!

我可是未来的大音乐家！！: One day, I'll be the greatest performer ever known!
我叫贝拉！很高兴遇见你！: I'm Bella! Nice to meet you!
悄悄和你说，我们马上要举办一场盛大的音乐会啦！: Wanna hear a secret? We're going to hold a huge concert soon!
不过现在……嗯……有点人手不足……: But... We're a little short-handed right now...
都说冒险者最热心了~有没有时间来帮帮忙呀~: They say adventurers are the most passionate people in the world... Do you have time to help me?
哦，那好吧。你忙你的吧。: Oh, I see... Take care of your business...
离音乐会已经没有多长时间了，还有很多工作要做……: The concert is right around the corner and there's so much to do...

艾莉儿应该就在附近筹备相关的事宜，你愿意去帮帮她吗？: Ariel should be around here somewhere preparing something... Would you like to help her?
唔……表演曲目……舞台灯光……音响设备……: Uh... Set list... Stage lighting... Audio equipment...
音乐会真是要准备好多东西啊……: There are so many things to prepare for the concert...
你来帮忙吗？真是太好了！: Are you here to help? That's great!
因为要办音乐会嘛，我也想邀请一些演奏大师来参加。: I'd like to invite some premium performers to take part in the concert.
贝拉给了我几个人选，你觉得我去请谁比较好呀？: Bella recommended several candidates to me. Who do you think I should invite?
哎呀，我觉得它可能不大合适……: Gee, I don't think that would be appropriate...

所有听过它演奏的人，都在赞美它的音乐造诣！: Everyone who hears it play instantly praises its musical genius!
冒险者，你能不能去请它来参加音乐会呀？: Adventurer, can you invite it to the concert?

大爷我可是摇滚蝗虫！自由是我的生命！: Hah! I am a Vocal! Freedom is everything to me!
我怎么会老老实实在舞台上给人表演呢！！: How can I honestly express that on stage?
在原野奔跑的摇滚才是本大爷的音乐——！！: Wild and free rock and roll is the only kind of music for me!

整条河都洒满了它们的花粉，但我对这玩意儿过敏！: The entire river is full of their pollen, but I'm allergic to it!
水源被污染，搞得我现在都没水喝了！！: The water is polluted, and now I don't have anything to drink!
你要是把它们打跑，我就答应你去音乐会，行不？: If you drive them off, I promise I'll go to the concert. What do you say?
什么？你真的把它们打跑了？？: What? Did you really manage to get rid of them?
解决了水源问题，别说是一场音乐会了，就是去十场，我也愿意！: I'm so glad the water‘s back to normal... I'd even go to ten concerts.
你去跟艾莉儿说，我答应她！: Go tell Ariel... I promise her!
它答应了吗？太谢谢你了！！: It promised?! Thank you so much!
果然你是最可靠的！: I've never met anyone as reliable as you!
唉……？你这么问的话，确实还有一些事……: Huh...? Well, since you're asking... There are a few things you could help with...
不过天色不早了，今天你快回去休息吧。: But it's getting late now. You should call it a day for now...
明天我在这里等你！: I'll be waiting for you here tomorrow!

如果表演时少了台下的支持，演奏者们会难过的……: The performers might feel down if they don't have the support of the audience on stage.
我知道一个消息，或许是这件事的转机。: I've thought of something that could help...

拜托你去找找他们吧！: I need you to go and find them!
地上好像掉了什么。: Something seems to have dropped on the ground...
一个闪闪发亮的灯牌……是谁丢在这的呢？: A neon sign... Who could have left it here?
