呵呵，明明是我给雅拉小姐姐的礼物！: Oh! Obviously it's a gift for Yala!
呸呸呸，雅拉算什么，这是给妮莉的！: What?! Yala?! This is for Nelly!
拉倒吧，妮莉连雅拉的头发丝都比不上！: Forget it... Nelly hair will never match Yala's!
杰瑞，你要打架吗？: Jerry... Are you getting ready for a fight?
汤姆，你觉得我会怕你吗？: Tom... You think I'm afraid of you?
好像得让他们冷静一下。: It looks like someone needs to calm down...
拍拍灯牌吧……: Take a picture of the sign...
灯牌！还在那个人类手上！: The sign! It's still in that human's hands!
是哦！得要回来才行！: That's right! You have to come back!
这人看起来很厉害……我不喜欢！汤姆你去！: This man looks like trouble... This could be bad! Go on, Tom!
人类，你干嘛拿我们的灯牌？: Humans, why did you take our sign?
音乐会上有很多好看的人吗？: Will there be many good-looking people at the concert?
让我们制作道具可以啦！: Let us make some items for you, then!
不过……你得让我们去音乐会！: But... You have to let us go to the concert!
我和杰瑞都喜欢好看的人！我们想去音乐会！: Jerry and I love looking at beautiful people! We want to go to the concert!
嗯哼，那你帮我们去附近找几棵闪闪草吧！: Uh-huh, help us to find some Flash Grass, then!
有了它，我们的道具才能闪闪发亮！: With a little bit of that stuff, our stuff will really shine!
你这个人类还挺能干的嘛。道具的事情就交给我们吧！: You're pretty competent for a human being! Leave the items to us!
记得带我们去音乐会！: Remember to take us to the concert!
怎么样？找到狸猫了吗？: How's it going? Did you find the Smokies?
哈哈哈，没想到它们这么爽快就答应了！: Ha-ha-ha! I didn't expect them to agree so quickly!
放心，我会带它们去音乐会的！: Don't worry, I'll bring them to the concert!
谢谢你呀，冒险者。你早些回去休息吧。: Thank you, adventurer! You should go back and get an early night.
明天要是有空，欢迎再来找我呀~: If you're free tomorrow, please come back and see me again.
你知不知道一只叫爱莎的彩蝶精灵？: Do you know a Menblatt named Elsa?
她的歌声非常优美，我一直希望她能看看我们的音乐会。: She sings with such beauty... I really hope she can come to the concert!
其实她也和摇滚蝗虫来到了南门。: Actually, she and Vocals have arrived at the South Gate.
我前去邀请，她本来都同意了，却不知道为什么又说不想去。: When I invited her, she agreed to come, but for some reason she's changed her mind.
这下我的安排都白费了，真是伤脑筋……: Now this arrangement I made for her will go to waste... It's driving me insane!
冒险者，你能不能帮我去问问原因？: Adventurer, can you help me to ask her why she won't come?
这里有一些彩蝶精灵的磷粉……爱莎应该在附近。: There's Menblatt powder around here... Elsa should be nearby.
爱莎的声音不知道为什么非常沙哑。: Why is Elsa's voice so hoarse?
呜呜呜……我该怎么办……: Waaah! What am I to do...?
一、一个人类！你有事吗！: A... A human! What do you want?
……你是来特意嘲笑我的吗？: ...Are you here to laugh at me?
你还听不出来吗？我的嗓子已经坏了。: Can't you hear? My voice is ruined!
都这样了你还让我去参加音乐会？！: You still expect me to perform in this state?
糟糕，好像惹她生气了……: Oh dead... She seems to be getting really agitated...
我跟你这种人没什么好说的。: I have nothing to say to people like you.
爱莎跑掉了……去附近找找吧。: Elsa has run off... Search the nearby area for her.
哟，几天不见，这不是冒险者吗？: Hey! I haven't seen you in a while. Aren't you that adventurer?
怎么啦？一脸没精打采的样子。: How's it going? It looks like something's bothering you.
她这几天跑到普隆德拉，没忍住逛吃逛吃，结果吃上火了。嗓子不哑才怪呢。: She went to Prontera for a few days and went a little wild snacking out there. I guess that's why she ended up damaging her throat. It's strange that your voice is fine.
你去七叶草附近打点水，那里的水源有治愈功效，她喝了就能好。: Go and fetch some water from near the Polyphylla around here. It should have a healing effect that will cure her hoarse throat.
不客气！我还要练琴，就先撤啦！: Don't mention it! I need to practice the piano. Let's get out of here!
米德加尔特的歌坛小天后居然因为一顿烧烤陨落了！！说出去会被人笑掉大牙的！: Midgarts's queen of singing, dethroned by spicy snacks... If you tell anyone, you'll be smiling with no teeth!
……你是说，你有治好我嗓子的办法？: ...You mean, you have a cure for my voice?
冒险者，对不起啊……刚刚居然那么凶你，还打你……: Adventurer... I'm sorry... I was so rude just now, and I even...
谢谢你帮了我！麻烦转告艾莉儿，音乐会我一定去！: Thank you for helping me! If it's not too much trouble, could you tell Ariel that I'll come to the concert?
爱莎治好了嗓子，可以来音乐会了！: Elsa's voice is cured and she can come to the concert now!
冒险者，这都多亏了你！: Adventurer, it's all thanks to you!
谢谢你，赶紧回去休息吧~我明天在这里等你！: Thank you. Go back and rest now -- I'll be waiting for you here tomorrow!
我说了你可不要笑话我……: Don't laugh when I tell you this...
之前走的太着急，不知道把表演用的乐谱丢到哪里了！！: I’ve been in such a hurry that I can’t even remember where I left the score for the performance!
应该就在附近的街道，希望没被风吹跑……: I think I may have dropped it on a street nearby... I hope it hasn't been blown away by the wind...
谢谢你！我现在实在走不开，拜托啦！: Thank you! I don't have time to search right now, so I'm leaving this in your hands!
这里掉了一份乐谱，也许就是艾莉儿的。: There's a sheet of music here... Perhaps it belongs to Ariel?
你这小偷，拿着我的乐谱要干什么！: What are you thieves doing with my score?
小偷！小偷！这份乐谱是我掉在这里的！: Thief! Thief! This is my music!
你看这里的署名！萨——列——里，写的清清楚楚！: Look at the signature here! Sa-le-ri... It's there, as clear as day!
原来是这样，我好像有点线索。: That's right... I may some clues, though.
我有个学生叫乔斯。他写了不少曲子，但写的都很……一言难尽。: I have a student named Jos. He wrote a bunch of songs, but they were all very... It's a long story.
但刚刚乔斯跟我说，他作出了最棒的曲子！: Jos told me that he's made his best tune yet!
我很惊讶，可现在一想，那份乐谱的字迹明显和先前不同啊！: It's shocking, but now that I think of it, the handwriting on that score seemed different to his previous ones.
应该就在街角那儿。他到处跟人炫耀呢，估计没走远。: He should be nearby. He's showing off his score everywhere. He's probably not far.
你赶紧去找吧，耽误事就不好了。我还很期待音乐会的呢！: Go and look for him quickly... There's no time to waste! I'm really looking forward to the concert!
嘿嘿嘿嘿……我终于要出名了！: He-he-he! I'm finally going to be famous!
你干嘛？怎么这样看着我？: What do you want? Why are you looking at me like that?
找你有事: There's something I need to talk to you about.
要有礼貌，叫我乔斯大师！真不懂规矩。: Have some manners! Call me Master Jos! You really don't know anything about manners, do you?
嗯？你说这份乐谱？这是我呕心沥血创造出的杰作！！: Huh? You mean this score? Why, this is a masterpiece I have worked very hard to create!
有了它，那些看不起我的人就都没话说了！！: With this, all of my critics will be hushed forever!
你别过来！再过来我动手了！！: Stay away! If you come any closer, I'll be forced to do something rash!
你你你，到底想知道什么？: You... What do you want to know?
我都告诉你！！还请饶我一命！！: I'll tell you everything! Please spare my life!
乐谱哪来的: Where did the score come from?
乐谱……是我捡的……对不起！！！: The score... I found it on the ground! I'm sorry!
我发现它比我写的所有歌都好……没有忍住，就据为己有了……: It's simply better than all the songs I've written... If you must, take it...
我只是很想得到大家的认可……呜呜呜……: I just want everyone to recognize my talent...
乔斯啊乔斯，你怎么如此糊涂！: Jos... You're in such a state!
将别人的曲子说成是自己的，难道你忘记了当初找我学作曲时说的话了吗？: Have you forgotten what you said when you asked to learn how to compose music?
“想自己创作出令人感动的旋律！”: "I want to create deeply moving melodies of my own!"
呜呜呜，是我错了……对不起，萨列里老师！: I know... I was wrong... Sorry Master Saleri!
唉，你赶快把乐谱还给冒险者吧。: Alas, you should return the music to the adventurer as soon as possible.
冒险者，抱歉，我这个学生给你添麻烦了。: Adventurer, I'm sorry that my student has caused you so much trouble.
走吧乔斯，你得回去好好想想。: Come on, Jos. Go on back now and think carefully about what you have done.
太好了，你是在哪里找到的呀？: This is fantastic! Where did you find it?
怎么会……居然发生了这样的事吗。: Oh, my word... I can't believe it.
唉，真叫人难以置信。希望乔斯不要再入歧途……: Well, that's truly outrageous. I hope Jos doesn't go astray again...
还好找到了，不然音乐会要出大岔子……: Fortunately, you found it, otherwise the concert would be in serious trouble...
时候不早了，你一定很累，快回去吧。: It's getting late... You must be very tired. Go back and rest!
我明天还在这，希望能再见到你哦！: I'll still be here tomorrow. I hope to see you again!
今天是准备的最后一天了！真希望音乐会早点到来呀！: The final day of preparation has arrived! I wish the concert would just start already!
嗯嗯……让我检查检查还有什么没收拾好的……: Uh... Let me check if there's anything else I haven't sorted out yet...
糟糕！！门票不见了！！: Oh no! The tickets are missing!
我把音乐会的门票集中放在一个包里，包还在，但是门票都不见了……: I put the concert tickets in a bag... The bag is still there, but the tickets are missing...
而且还莫名其妙多了一封信……: And what's even stranger still is that there's a letter here...
“想知道门票去哪了吗？有胆就到西门来！我在有路标的树下等。”: "Do you want to know where the tickets are?” Come to the West Gate if you dare! I'll be waiting under the signposted tree.
冒险者，这是挑战书吗？怎么办啊！: Adventurer, is this a challenge? How could this be?
一定要弄清楚是怎么回事，把门票找回来！: Figure out what's going on and get the tickets back!
这就是西门有路标的树……: This is the signposted tree by the West Gate...
以前你们搞庆典，开派对，做活动……从来就不叫我……: I never get invited to any of the celebrations, parties, or events...
现在……好不容易开了次音乐会……居然还是不叫我！！！: And now with all the fuss about this concert... And I still don't get invited!
为什么不邀请我？！我不高兴，你们一个也别想去！！: Why wasn't I invited?! I wasn't happy and I didn't want anyone else to be able to go!
不甘心……好不甘心啊……: It's not fair... This just won't do!
我只是想和你们一起去音乐会而已……: I just want to go to the concert like everyone else...
就这么困难吗，呜呜呜……: Why does my life have to be so hard? Waaaah!
我输了，门票给你……: I lost... so... Here are the tickets.
果然，我还是适合一个人吗……: I guess I was just meant to be alone...
冒险者！你回来了，情况怎么样？: Adventurer! You're back! How did it go?
谢谢你把它们都找回来了……: Thanks for bringing them all back...
其实这次音乐会的门票，是打算在全大陆都发送的。: In fact, these tickets will be sent all over the continent.
每个人都可以来听，当然也包括小恶魔西西。: Everyone is welcome to come and listen, including that Deviruchi Cheech, of course.
只不过还没到发送时间，所以……其实现在没有人能拿到票的。: It's just not time to send them out yet, so nobody has a ticket right now!
都是那孩子误会了……一会儿我亲自去跟他说吧。: Obviously, he misunderstood... I'll talk to him in person later.
这几天真是太辛苦你了，冒险者。: Things have been so hard these past few days, adventurer.
如果你不在，很多事情我真不知道该怎么办才好……: If you were not here, there would have been so many things I wouldn't have been able to resolve by myself...
我最大的心愿，就是让幸福的旋律传遍米德加尔特。: My greatest wish is to spread the melody of joy throughout Midgarts.
还有最后一个请求，可以请你答应吗？: I have one last request. I hope you'll accept it...
可以来参加我们的音乐会吗？: Can you come to our concert?
谢谢你。真的非常感谢。: Thank you. Thank you so much.
期待我们在歌声中的再次相遇！: I look forward to meeting you again amid the sound of song!

这可是奥依的妈妈亲手做的！: This is home-made by Ollie's mom!

我相信是你的话！！一定没问题！: I believe that you will solve it! For sure!

很久以前，有一位富豪在斯凯领顿有一座避暑山庄。每年夏天他们一家都会带着仆人来到山: A long time ago, a rich resident of Skellington had a summertime retreat in the mountains. Every summer, the whole of the rich mans family would take their servants to the villa in the mountain for the holidays. The rich man had a daughter who was a complete tomboy who loved adventuring. One summer holiday, the girl met a boy called Batescliffe and it was love at first sight and pledged to marry one another before asking for any permission from either of the families. Upon hearing this, the rich man hit the roof, he sent out people to catch the boy and gouged the boys’ eyes out himself and exiled him forever. The girl was extremely sad and locked herself away in one of the mountain villa’s guest rooms, refusing to come out. The exiled boy was raised by a doctor named Franken. After learning his father’s great medical skill for a number of years, he returned to the mountain villa. When the grown-up girl heard the familiar voice, she opened the door and finally came out of the room. Just as she had expected, her lover of yesteryear had returned to her, she came and took the gift that the boy presented to her. The girl excitedly untied the red ribbon and opened the box to find her father’s freshly decapitated head inside. Dr.Batescliffe killed the rich man who owned the mountain villa but didn’t expect for his lover to die of the shock. Batescliffe used strange, abnormal medicinal practices to fuse her body with a monster, creating a two-faced girl who would turn into a Bloody Murderer at night. Every night, the demon girl would go crazy due to her Drink Blood and was thus locked away deep in the depths of Manor of Whispers’s cellars. Batescliffe sent out invitations across the land, attracting strong, meaty adventurers to come and visit. These strong bodies were used as feed for the demon girl and as materials to maintain her body. This action angered the lord of Niflheim - The Goddess of Death Hella, she came and destroyed by Batescliffe and the demon girl herself, burning the Whispering Manor to the ground. But recently rumors have emerged that the manor which was originally destroyed has reappeared in Skellington. In this cursed villa, the hatred is still present.

你们两个似乎聊得不错。: It seems like you two got along well.

记得要拍清楚哦！: Be sure to take a good shot!

别看她外表是个可爱的小女孩，她可是真正的死亡女神。: Don’t mind her cute, childlike appearance. She really is the goddess of death.

叫九界权威……: It's called the Authority of Nine Worlds...

好了，我还有些事情要做。: Alright, I’ve got some things to do.

看来你对海拉还不够了解……: Looks like you still don't know enough about Hella...
我们从这些事情中已经能掌握不少信息。: We have learned a lot of information from these things.
在你来到这里之前，我苦于事情没有进展，一直在这个酒馆里喝酒度日。: Before you came here, I wasn't making any progress, just sitting here in the inn drinking the days away.
[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]，既然我们的目标一致: [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], since our goals are the same, why don't we work together, just like back in Yuno?
好。我们现在最重要的事情就是要见海拉一面。: Alright. Our most important task right now is to meet with Hella.
看来我们还是要从他这边探听些消息。: Looks like we’ll have to gain some information from him.

你都在我这里喝了那么长时间的酒了，也不差这一点时间。: You've spent so much time here drinking. I’m sure you can spare this little bit of time.
为了这个酒，我可是忙了好几天了。: I’ve been working on this liquor for quite some days.
把酒交给一个叫薇格的女孩。: Give the liquor to a girl named Vik.
她应该就在雾之森林的入口处。: She should be at the entrance to the Misty Forest.
雾之森林魔物横行，我和你一起去。: There are monsters roaming the Misty Forest. I'll go with you.
诶！这里居然有活人！还是两个！: Ah! There are living people here! Two of them!
你们是不是帮华莱士送酒来的？: You’re helping Wallace to deliver the liquor, right?
那边有个奇怪的女孩，过去看看情况。: There’s a strange girl over there. Go and see what’s up with her.
还没看到你们我就闻到了蜂蜜酒的味道~: I smelled the scent of honey liquor before I even saw you guys.
这是华莱士让你们帮忙送来的吧~: This is one that Wallace asked you to deliver, right?
华莱士怎么认识你们的啊？: How does Wallace know you guys?
活人耶！两个耶！实在是太棒了！: Living people! Two of them! This is incredible!
怎么来的尼夫海姆？: How did you come to Niflheim?
嗯~我感觉得到~你的力量很强啊~: Hmm~ I felt it~ your power is great.
要不要看看我的魔法~？新研发的！: Want to see my spell~? A new creation!
怎么样？表演给你看好不好？: How's that? How about I show you?

美味美味的蘑菇炖眼球~你也要来一碗吗？: Delicious mushroom stew~ Want a bowl?

嘘，安静。你说的话会有人听着的！: Shh! Quiet. People might be listening!

谁也别想从尼夫海姆出去，我劝你也早点放弃吧。: Nobody can escape from Niflheim. I advise you to give up now.
欢迎来到死者的国度，尽情享受痛苦和煎熬还有尖叫吧。: Welcome to the Town of the Dead. Enjoy the pain, suffering and screaming.
维护亡灵的秩序是我的职责，来到这里的灵魂将永远无法离开，嘻嘻嘻。: It is my duty to maintain order among the dead. The souls who come here never leave, hehehe.
虽然我已经死了，可我的心还在大海上。: Although I am already dead, my heart still lies on the ocean.

冥河里冰冷的尖刀不断的冒出水面，你看的到吗？那是我的姐妹，她尝试离开，所以被海拉: Icy cold knives are constantly emerging from the water of the River Styx. Can you see? That’s my sister. She tried to escape, so Hella dropped her in.
真是有意思，活着的时候腿受了伤，死了之后居然还是没办法站起来…: Interesting. He suffered a leg injury in life, and still can’t stand even in death.
我不知道来到这里多久了…我的爱人，她现在活得怎么样呢？: I don’t know how long I have been down here... My love, how are you doing now?
姐姐把我从桥上推了下去，然后我就到了这里…: My sister pushed me off a bridge, and I ended up here...

你听到亡灵们的呢喃了吗？那是塞满心酸和悲切的亡者之音。: Do you hear the whispers of the dead? That’s the heavy-hearted and sorrowful sound of the dead.
看看我这里的宝贝，总有一件适合你。: Take a look at my treasures. There’s surely something to suit you.

看看吧，如果你拥有一件趁手的武器，亡灵们将很难向你下手。: Take a look. With a good weapon in hand, you won’t have much problems with the dead.
在死者的国度，没有件合适的防具那你可能活不过第一天~！: In the Town of the Dead, you won't last a day without good armor!
谁规定人在死后就不能把自己打扮的漂漂亮亮了！？: Who says that people can't look beautiful after they die?!
我可以让你的武器变得更加强大，这样的话即使是亡灵也很难伤害你。: I can make your weapons even stronger, so that even the dead will have a hard time harming you.

如果你不想躺进坟墓，我想你需要将防具打造得更为坚实。: If you don't want to end up in an early grave, I think you’d be smart to upgrade your armor.

面对嗜血的亡灵，你需要时刻保持充沛的体力。: In facing the bloodthirsty ghosts, you will need to maintain your strength.
这里有数不清的好东西，你总能挑到一件满意的。: There's lots of great stuff here. You’re bound to find something to your fancy.
如果你没有诚意，那就不要打扰我，我可不想招呼那些穷酸的亡魂。: If you’re not interested, then don't bother me. I don't want to attract those wretched souls.
这里有一些新奇的玩具，你要来看看嘛？: I got some new toys here. Want to take a look?

我的爱人，杰丝敏，我会等她，一直在这等她。: My beloved Jasmine. I will wait for her. I will wait for her here always.

啊，是我妻子派你来的吗？: Ah, did my wife send you?

如果你在夜晚听见马蹄与口哨声，千万不要鲁莽的奔跑！: If you hear the sound of horse trots and whistling in the night, don't run!
你听说过死灵骑士的传说么？: Have you heard about the legend of the Lord of Death?
那你一定明白听到马蹄与口哨声就该藏起来，不然死灵骑士的长枪会精准地找到你的心脏！: Then you will surely know that if you hear the sound of horse clops and whistling you ought to hide, the Lord of Death will strike your heart with his glaive!
那我来告诉你这个古老的故事，曾经在克雷斯特汉姆曾经有一位冷血的骑士，在退役后成为: Let me tell you an ancient story. Once, in Glast Heim, there was a cold-blooded knight. After retiring he became the guard of the Royal Dungeon.
在枯燥的日子里，他开始热衷于在夜晚骑着战马巡逻，并斩杀那些尝试越狱的罪犯。: On those uneventful days, he began patrolling on horseback at night and killed any criminals who tried to escape.
渐渐的，他爱上了杀戮的感觉，那些甜美的追逐，猎杀与临死者的哀嚎。: Gradually, he began to take pleasure in the feeling of killing - the sweetness of pursuit and the cries of the slaughtered and the dying.
他开始故意留下牢房的钥匙，引诱更多罪犯越狱，好让他的猎杀游戏在每个夜晚准时上演！: He began deliberately leaving the keys to the cells to encourage prisoners to escape, just so that he could chase the and kill them for game!
在某一天，骑士终于无法抑制自己的杀戮之心，他将犯人们一个一个拖出来，逐一猎杀。: One day, the knight could finally no longer suppress his urge to kill, and he dragged them out and killed them, one by one.
以长枪穿破胸膛肋骨的碎裂声为伴奏，骑士吹着俏皮的口哨，任由温热的鲜血浸透他的铠甲: The knight would whistle to the sound of his glaive cracking their ribs, as his armor splayed with blood.
我就是曾死在他手下的囚犯之一……: I was one of the prisoners killed by his hand...
如今，他化作死灵骑士来到了雾之森林，乐此不疲的继续着他的狩猎游戏!: Today, going by the name of the Lord of Death, he roams the Misty Forest, continuing to hunt his prey with glee!
人类冒险者，面对那刺穿无数胸膛的染血之枪，你有与他一战的勇气吗？: Adventurer, do you have the courage to face in battle that knight with his blood-stained glaive?
我深深的明白你的恐惧，赶紧躲得远远的吧，别让那个怪物找到你！: I wholeheartedly understand your fear. Get yourself away from this place. Don't let that monster find you!
好，那我就告诉你吸引它现身的办法！: Alright, then I’ll tell you how to lure him into appearing!

死灵骑士喜欢在他所到之处插上旗帜，在尼夫海姆一共竖立着6面旗帜。: The Lord of Death likes to leave flags wherever he goes. So far, he has placed 6 flags in Niflheim.
只要破环他的旗帜，他一定会因暴怒而现身的，到那时候，就看你的实力了！: You just need to destroy his flags, and he will show himself out of fury. When that happens, we will see how strong you are!
想要活命的话，就不要在这个地方久留！: If you value your life, you'd best not stay here for long!
那个家伙复活了，从石英湖里逃了出来！而它的砍刀正对新鲜的血液饥肠辘辘 ……: That guy has come back to life, and escaped from Quartz Lake! And his machete is thirsty for blood...
那家伙原本是一位臭名昭著的杀人犯，喜欢用大砍刀施加酷刑将受害者折磨至死……: That guy was originally a notorious serial killer who enjoyed torturing his victims to death with his machete...
为了抓捕他，牺牲了20位可怜的警卫队员；甚至在自己死刑执行前，他恳求行刑官用最快: 20 guards sacrificed their lives to catch him; at the time of his execution, he even asked the executioner to use the sharpest axe so that he could see his own blood flowing after they cut off his head.
但它化作名为嗜血怪人的恶灵来到尼夫海姆之后，却变得更加疯狂！: But after he came to Niflheim as a monstrous Wraith, the Bloody Murderer turned even more crazy!
它握住那把大砍刀，不停的寻找猎物满足自己对鲜血的渴求。: Taking that machete, he relentlessly searched for prey to satisfy his bloodthirst.
他吸收了刀下冤魂的亡者气息，变得越来越不可束缚。: He absorbed the Death's Breath of the dead that he slew and became more and more unstoppable.
死者国度的主人将滥杀无辜的它封印在石英湖底，交给我来看守。: The Mistress of the Town of the Dead sealed this indiscriminate murderer in the bottom of the Quartz Lake, and entrusted me to keep guard.
但不知怎得，这个邪恶的怪物竟然挣脱了枷锁从湖底逃了出来！: I don’t know how it happened, but the evil monster broke free from his shackles and escaped!
我无法主动通知死者国度之主，在她再次封印这个怪物前，恐怕一场腥风血雨不可避免……: I cannot go to tell the Mistress of the Town of the Dead. I’m afraid that before she can seal him again, he will have already left a trail of death and destruction...
其实，我有一个办法，但是……: Actually, I have an idea, but...
我需要一位人类冒险者的帮助，但我不能强迫你将自己置于危险的境地！: I need the help of an adventurer, but I can't force you to put yourself in danger!
我不会怪你的，但是希望你赶快逃离这里，我会独自留下面对它……: I don't blame you, but I hope that you will flee this place quickly. I’ll have to face him myself...

你的人类之身加上鲜血味道的诱惑，嗜血怪人一定会现身追赶你！: The tempting smell of fresh blood on you will be sure to lure out the Bloody Murderer!
将它引诱到开阔的地方作战，没有黑暗的庇护，它就只是个手持砍刀的笨重莽夫罢了！: Lure him out into an open place and fight him. Without the protection of darkness, he is just a clumsy fool with a machete!
愿艺术女神与你同在。: May the Goddess of Art be with you.
夜莺剧场为你骄傲！: The Nightingale Theater is proud of you!
海拉大人，我们永远忠于你。: Master Hella, we eternally worship you.
可真是个可怜的家伙，我有时候也会忘记事情。: Poor guy. I forget things sometimes too.
就像我刚才忘记蜂蜜罐放在哪里了。: Just like how I forgot where I put the jar of honey.
可自己的名字谁会忘记呢，真是伤脑筋。: But who could forget their own name, that’s stupid.
并把我的名字刻在了废弃的墓碑上！: And engraved my name on a discarded tombstone!
让我永远记不住任何事…: So that I would forget everything...

可我连名字都不记得。: But I don't even remember my name.

你们人真好，虽然我不记得你们是谁。: You guys are great, even though I don't remember who you are.
没想到找到我名字是这么简单的事，: I didn't think finding my name would be such an easy matter,
可我自己总是忘记墓碑上刻的字…: But I always forget the words engraved on tombstones...
破损的墓碑上刻着一串名字。: On the broken tombstone is engraved a name.
我没有恢复记忆，这不是我的名字，它没有这么简短。: I still don't have my memory. This isn't my name, it's too short.
怎么办，这里面没有一个是我的名字。: What should we do, none of these are my name.
都太短了！！不对不对，我到底叫什么！！: Too short!! No, no. What on earth is my name!!
就是这样，我想不起来事情的时候也会很困扰。: I get frustrated as well when I can't think of something.
我理解你，我也经常上一秒还在吃手上拿着的蛋糕。: I know how you feel. Sometimes I’ll be holding a piece of cake that I was eating just a second ago,
下一秒这只蛋糕就不见了，: And then next second it’s gone,
你确定你没有看错或者记错名字吗？: Are you sure you didn't misread or misremember the name?
他说他的名字很长…: He says his name is quite long...
嗯…最长的那个名字是什瓦拉克斯利德…: Hm.. The longest name here is Shalak Sylid...

不行，我可能永远也想不起我的名字了…: It’s no good. I might never remember my name...
我叫凯德姆.费农顿凯金森.克里斯托兰多.什瓦拉克斯利德！！！: My name is Cadam Fern Kaikenson Christolando Shalak Sylid!!!
有了名字就好办多了，我想起了一切！: Now that I have my name, I remember everything!
我以前是斐扬的一名猎人。: Previously I was a Payon hunter.
为了再见到死去的恋人，来到了这死者的国度。: I came to the Town of the Dead in order to see my passed-away beloved.
可这里到处都是亡灵，我根本找不到她。: But there are so many ghosts here, I couldn't find her anywhere.
后来我听说了斯利德宝石能让我见到所想之人。: Then, later I heard that the Sylid Gem can allow you to see anybody you desire.
所以我就努力的在这荒芜之地找呀...找呀…: So I searched and searched in this desolate place for so long...
终于有一天发现了墓室的入口！: Finally, one day I discovered the entrance to the tomb!
我不仅成功的获得了海拉之靴还差一点就拿到了斯利德宝石。: I not only managed to get Hella’s Boots, I almost obtained the Sylid Gem.
可终究还是失败了，我被看守的格洛特夺走了姓名。: But in the end, I failed, and the guardian Glott stole my name.
忘记了一切，忘记了进食睡眠。: I forgot everything. I even forgot how to eat and sleep.
最终累死在斯凯领顿这片虚无的村落里。: Finally, I died of exhaustion in the desolate village of Skellington.
你太可怜了，你是个好人。: I’m so sorry. You are a good person.
格洛特不该夺走你的名字…: Glott was wrong to steal your name...
你会排在其他灵魂之前解脱的，我希望是这样。: You will be freed before the other souls. At least I hope so.
重点呢！重点是墓室的入口如何进去！！: The point! The point is how to get into the tomb!!
在这之前，你们有许多准备工作需要做！: Before this, you guys have much preparation do to!
墓室门口有许多座墓碑。: There are several tombstones at the entrance to the tomb.
那其实是个机关，要在正确的墓碑前点上蜡烛。: It’s actually a device. You have to place a candle in front of the correct tombstone.
墓室的大门才会打开！: Only then will the door to the tomb open!
我在失去记忆前，用尽一切力气将答案写了下来。: Before I lost my memory, I used all my strength to write down the answer.
埋在了一棵枯树下。: I placed it under a dead branch.
应该就靠近墓地的地方。: It must be somewhere close to the cemetery.
应该就是这一棵，地上的泥土有被翻动过的痕迹。: It must be this branch. There are signs of the earth being disturbed here.
破破烂烂的纸张上歪歪扭扭的写着几行字。: A few lines of writing are scribbled on a tattered piece of paper.
依次在刻着“悲惨”“毁灭”“忧愁”的墓碑前点亮明烛，火光会引领你打开墓室的大门。: Light candles in front of the tombstones engraved with "Tragedy", "Destruction" and "Sorrow", and the light will lead you to open the door to the tomb.
一个墓室居然设计的这么复杂…: Quite a complex design for a tomb...

蜡烛的话斯凯领顿很多地方都有~: There are candles in heaps of places in Skellington~
这儿还有一座冥河之灯，这真是太棒了。: And there’s a Light of the Styx here too. Awesome.
好了，我想这里所有的冥河之灯都已经被点亮！: Alright, I think all the Lights of the Styx have been lit up here!
现在你可以在斯凯领顿和雾之森林间自由的穿梭啦！: Now you can travel easily between Skellington and the Misty Forest!
我们该回去问问那个猎人，还需要准备些什么。: We should go back and ask the hunter what else we need to prepare.
有一样东西，你们得回到尼夫海姆去。: Something similar. You need to return to Niflheim.
你们得向尼夫海姆的西德尼厨师买一颗催眠果！: You must find Chef Sidney in Niflheim and buy from him a Fruit of Hypnosis!
墓室里有一只巨大的怪物把守在入口处。: There is a giant monster in the tomb that guards the entrance.
非常凶残可怕，我不建议你们和它正面对峙。: It’s extremely ferocious. I don't recommend you try to fight it.
西德尼厨师很喜欢做一些黑暗料理，其中最有名的。: Chef Sidney likes cooking Dark Cuisine, and he has one particularly famous dish.
就是他的催眠果，可以将体型比自己大好几倍的怪物催眠！: It’s his Fruit of Hypnosis. It can hypnotize monsters many times bigger than oneself!
快去吧，可不要买错了！: Go now, and don't buy the wrong one!
催眠果外表长的像苹果，但却是紫色的。: Fruit of Hypnosis looks like an apple from the outside, but it’s purple.
你需要点什么，味道我可不能保证~啊啦啦啦~: What can I do for you? I guarantee total flavor satisfaction~
看来你准备干一番大事呢~嘿嘿: Looks like you are preparing for something big~ heh heh
没错，这就是我所说的催眠果！: Yep, that's the Fruit of Hypnosis!
一只看着发紫的诡异苹果，闻着让人…有些想…睡觉…: At first glance it looks like a crunchy purple apple, but the scent makes one...very...sleepy...
这应该就是催眠果没有错！: This must be the Fruit of Hypnosis!
一团意味不明的浆糊，冒着紫色的浓烟，似乎有剧毒。: A bunch of thick pastes that emit purple fumes. Seems highly toxic.
凯姆德所说的催眠果像一只紫色的苹果，这好像不是你要找的。: Cadam said the Fruit of Hypnosis looks like a purple apple. This doesn't seem to be it.
很好，最后就是伪装。: Good, it’s camouflage in the end.
没错，墓地周围有许多格洛特的看守。: That’s right, Glott has many guards around the cemetery.
就这样闯进去，简直是送死。: If you just go charging in like that, it’ll be your death.
所以你们需要几张巨大的白布~！: So you need some large White Cloths!
离这里不远处，经常有顽皮的白幽灵出没。: There’s a place not far from here where Whispers often appear.
就从它们身上获取白布吧。: Acquire some White Cloths from them.
抓不到我抓不到我~: You can’t find me, you can’t catch me~
这次不能再让它跑掉了！: We can't let it get away this time!
这么大一张布，一定够用了。: A cloth this size must be enough.
你居然能抓住这么灵活的家伙！: Wow, you were able to catch such an elusive creature!

而通道的入口是一个天地树上的树洞。: The entrance to the passage lies on a Yggdrasil Tree.
要使用它，必须要聆听天地树的声音。: If you wish to use it, you must listen to the sound of the Yggdrasil Tree.

聆听天地树之音。: Listen to the sound of the Yggdrasil.

好了，现在汝已经能听懂吾族语言了。: Alright, now you can understand the language of our tribe.

跳下去吧，生命之力会守护汝。: Jump down. The life force will protect you.

这里居然凭空出现了个活人！: Hey, there’s a living person here!

下楼看看吧。我们老板很有趣哦！可以和他聊聊。: Go downstairs and take a look. The owner is an interesting guy! Have a chat with him.
吾族的使命，是守护。: The mission of our family is to protect.
欢迎来到两个吊死鬼，客人想要点什么？: Welcome to the Two Hanged Ghosts. What can I get for you?
在天地树的顶端真的存在神域么？呜噜噜。: Is there really a city of gods at the top of the Yggdrasil Tree? Bulu.

我，我想成为汶巴拉的少女偶像！: I, I want to become the girl idol of Umbala!

看来你对哈默林的传说很感兴趣啊。那就请听我将哈默林尘封的过去诉说于诗~: I see you're interested in the story of Hamlin. Then let me tell you its tale~
曾经哈默林是一座位于尼夫海姆边界的人类村庄，天然的地理优势使他远离了米德加尔特历: Hamlin was a once a human village that existed here in Niflheim. Its geographical location kept it separate from all the affairs of Midgarts.

从尼夫海姆流窜至哈默林的瘟疫鼠群让村民们的生活苦不堪言！: The plague rats that came in from Niflheim made life miserable for the villagers!
老鼠们偷吃粮食，咬伤孩子，损坏家具。并且强大的繁殖能力让它们的数量越来越多。: The rats ate the food, bit the children and chewed the furniture. And their strong reproductive ability caused them to multiply in numbers.
忍无可忍的哈默林村民张贴出公告，要是有人解决鼠灾，就可以得到1000万zeny的: The desperate villagers of Hamlin put up a poster. If anyone could exterminate the rats, they would be awarded 10 million Zeny.
但地理位置偏远的哈默林，极少有村民以外的人类涉足。村民们在鼠灾的折磨中渐渐变得绝: But being in such a remote location, few outsiders ventured into Hamlin. Amidst the tyranny of the rats, the villagers became desperate and violent.
某一天，一位装扮奇怪的异乡人来到了哈默林，他毫不犹豫地揭下了消灭老鼠的悬赏。: One day, a strangely-dressed outlander arrived in Hamlin. He accepted the contract to exterminate the rats without hesitation.
村民们狐疑地打量他，暗中议论。这个异乡人真有能耐消灭猖狂的鼠灾么？: The villagers looked upon him with suspicion. Could this outlander really exterminate the crazed rats?
异乡人自称来自夜莺剧院，是一位吟游的吹笛人。他答应村长，他独自一人只要一晚就能解: The outlander said that he was a Flute Player from the Nightingale Theater. He assured the villagers that in a single night he would be able to solve the rat problem in Hamlin.
听了他的话，大家嗤笑他的狂妄，这鼠灾若是能一天解决，除非是诸神赐下奇迹！: Hearing this, the villagers all laughed and mocked him. Nothing less than a miracle could solve the rat problem in a day, they said!
那天夜晚，哈默林的家家户户都从窗缝中注视着这位异邦乐师的一举一动。: That night, all the villagers of Hamlin watched every movement of this outlander musician from their windows.
只见那位吹笛人几步登上哈默林最高的屋顶，从自己的长袍中拿出一支造型奇怪的骨笛吹奏: They saw the flute player climb to the top of the tallest building in Hamlin, take out a strange flute of bone from his rucksack, and begin to play.
悠扬清冽的笛声在哈默林的上空回荡，村名们瞪大了双眼，对吹笛人的举动十分不解，他真: The melodious sound of the flute echoed over Hamlin. The villagers watched with puzzled expressions. Was this really going to exterminate the rats?
就在此时，随着笛声，奇怪的事情发生了！: Just then, a strange thing happened along with the sound of the flute!
如果你想知道接下来发生了什么，就去拍一张吉欧尔大桥的照片给我吧~我有特别的用处！: If you want to know what happened next, then go take a photo of the Gjoll Bridge for me. I have a special use for it!
怎么样，把我要的照片带来了么？: So, did you bring me the photo I asked for?
没错，这就是我想要的吉欧尔河的照片！请听我继续诉说哈默林的故事吧~: Perfect, that's the photo of the Gjoll River I was after! Now, listen to the rest of the story of Hamlin~
随着吹笛人的笛声，整个哈默林的老鼠们都从屋子，地洞，草丛中钻了出来，形成了一股浩: As the musician played his flute, all the rats in Hamlin emerged from houses, holes and grass, and formed a single mighty river of rats!
哈默林的村民们在惊乱中发现：老鼠们竟然十分统一地向远处的冥河欧吉尔跑去，成群结队: The villagers of Hamlin looked in astonishment as the rats rushed towards Gjoll and jumped in groups into the River Styx.
随着笛声结束，整个哈默林已经看不见一只老鼠的踪影。村民们在惊叹的同时，载歌载舞拍: When the flute playing was over, not a single rat could be seen in Hamlin. The villagers began singing, dancing and clapping with amazement.
第二天，吹笛人拜访村长，要求得到他的1000万zeny酬劳，沉默的人群中突然冒出: The next day, when the Flute Player visited the village chief to collect his 10 million Zeny reward, one voice from amongst the silent crowd suddenly said: “The rats went and jumped into the river on their own. We saw it ourselves. What does that have to do with you?”
有了第一句声讨，村民们都开始附和。“没错，你只不过在屋顶吹奏了一首普通的乐曲而已: After that remark, the villagers all began to shout in agreement. “That's right, you just played some ordinary song from the top of a house.” “You're nothing more than a swindling flute player!”
吹笛人攥紧了拳头，他无力的反驳淹没在众人的声浪中。在他转身离开后，背后仍是充满恶: The Flute Player clenched his fists. His attempts at rebuttal were drowned out by the shouting of the crowd. As he turned and left, the malicious accusations and gossiping continued behind him. Nobody heard as he gave a soft sigh.
吹笛人离开哈默林后，独自来到了雾之森林。在鬼怪亡魂的驱赶中，他慌不择路的进入了一: After the Flute Player left Hamlin, he went alone to the Misty Forest. Chased by ghosts and monsters, he escaped into a strange cemetery.
“人类，我能清楚感受到你心中的怨恨。”一团幽绿色的鬼火出现在乐师的面前，发出可怖: “Human, I can feel the resentment in your heart.” A group of green Horongs appeared in front of the musician, speaking in a deep and unsettling voice. “Why do you not take revenge on the greedy villagers?”
吹笛人惊慌地望向那团鬼火，半响说不出一句话。自己心中的确萌生了一些可怕的念头。: The startled Flute Player looked at the Horongs, totally lost for words. Terrible ideas came into his mind.
“嗬嗬，你以为我尝不出你灵魂中萌生的恶意吗？”鬼火嗤笑着说道。“为什么你不遵从你: “Haha, you think I can't taste the malice in your soul?” The Horongs smirked and said: “Why don't you listen to your heart? Go and make those thoughts reality. I know you are capable of it, human.”
那一刻，吹笛人的心灵出现了裂隙，幽绿色的火焰吞噬了他的身体！悲鸣响彻在整个雾之森: At that moment, the soul of the Flute Player buckled and his body was swallowed by the green flames! His cry of sorrow resounded throughout the Misty Forest.
想知道故事接下去的发展么？消灭300只凶恶的无颅武士吧，它们在尼夫海姆的地域无恶: What to know what happened next? Go and defeat 300 Dullahans. They have been wrecking havoc all over Niflheim!
哈，看来无颅武士已经领教了你的厉害！: Hah, it looks like you've taught the Dullahans a lesson!

在乐师离开哈默林的那天晚上，村民们终于可以睡一个不受老鼠侵害的好觉。: That night after the musician left Hamlin, the villagers could finally enjoy a good night's sleep without worrying about the rats.
一位孩子问着他的母亲：“妈妈，老鼠们都去哪里了？”母亲笑着回答：“乖孩子，诸神降: A boy asked his mother: “Mommy, where did the rats go?” The mother laughed and replied: “Honey, a miracle has happened. The terrible rats all ran straight into the river to end themselves!”
“那位吹笛人呢？”孩子不解地问到。“他啊，只是个为了赏金而来的骗子！好啦安心睡吧: “What about the flute player?” Asked the boy. “Oh, he was just a swindler, here after the money! Alright, now go to sleep.” The mother tucked him in to bed.
“看来诸神们终于看到我们的苦难，来帮助我们了，真是温柔的神明大人啊。”孩子安心地: “The gods finally answered our prayers.” The boy peacefully closed his eyes.
但至少那位吹笛人的笛声确实很动听啊，孩子心中默想。没有人注意到某个黑影正一步步向: “But that flute player sure played a nice song” thought the boy. Nobody noticed that a dark shadow was approaching the village.
满月当空，清冷的月光洒在静谧的哈默林，摆脱鼠灾的村民们安稳地做着美梦。: On a full moon night, as the village of Hamlin bathed in the tranquil moonlight, the villagers dreamed beautiful dreams, free from the torment of the rats.
从九界怨恨的冥火中涅槃的吹笛人再次登上了哈默林最高的屋顶，他的眼中散发着怨恨，摸: Rising from the smoldering fires of his vengeance, the flute player once again ascended the tallest building in Hamlin. His eyes beamed with hatred as he felt for his bone flute.
一曲哀怨悲伤的曲子像毒蛇一般缠住了睡梦中的哈默林，如泣如诉。: A song of dread and sadness, like a venomous snake, binded the village in its sleep.
奇怪的是，所有的成年人似乎都没有听见这首哀乐，而原本熟睡的孩子们却同时睁大了瞳孔: The strange thing was that none of the Me in the village heard the song, but all the children who were deep asleep awoke at once to it.
吹笛人的手指娴熟地变换按压着笛孔，将他心中的情感注入这首魔曲，乐曲越来越急促哀伤: The flute player played intensely, pouring all his malice into the song, as it became more and more sorrowful.

就在华莱士饶有兴趣地欣赏墙上挂着的画像时，他听到楼梯上传来了轻轻的脚步声。: Just as Wallace was appreciating a wall painting, he heard the soft sound of footsteps from upstairs.

它最擅长的就是用花言巧语与各种诡计欺骗人类，而伪装成猎物亲近的人，是它最喜欢的把: It is expert at deceiving humans with tricks and rhetoric. It loves pretending to get close to its prey!
我曾亲眼目睹过这种野兽袭击人类的事件，但是我让它逃了，该死，这简直是我猎人生涯的: I once witnessed this beast attacking a human, but I let it get away. Damn it, that was shameful for a hunter like me! A young girl and her grandmother disappeared!
但是最近，雾之森林又出现了这只野兽的同类，我相信，它们的身上一定有与当时那件惨剧: But recently a similar type of beast has appeared in the Misty Forest. I believe that it’s carrying some evidence relating it to that tragic event! Will you fight off the beast and collect the evidence? Leave no stone unturned in your investigation of that tragedy!
哈哈哈，真是有胆量的年轻人！如果你从野兽的身上得到了证物，请交给我的两位猎人伙伴: Hahaha, you have some guts, youngster! If you find any evidence on the beast, please give it to my two hunter companions. They will help you to investigate the truth of the matter.
今夜会是个令人难忘的夜晚，好好享受这场猎杀吧！: Tonight will be a night to remember. Enjoy the hunt!
原来如此，那个女孩的名字叫做罗夏薇拉啊，当时那只名为外婆狼的野兽，他的腹中的就是: I see. That girl’s name was Rocha Vera. That beast known as the Grandma Wolf, its belly was...
让我们来理清这件悲剧：善良的女孩罗夏薇拉在探望外婆的路上被狡猾的狼欺骗，恶狼提前: Let me clarify this story: While on the way to visit her grandmother, an innocent girl name Rocha Vera is tricked by a conniving wolf. The beast had already come to Rocha Vera's grandmother’s house and eaten her, and then dressed himself in her clothes.
当单纯的罗夏薇拉来到外婆的小屋，狼外婆残忍地将她变成了盘中餐。: When the young and naive Rocha Vera arrived at her grandmother’s cottage, the Grandma Wolf cruelly made her into his lunch.
这样的事一定不是第一次发生了，我没有及时杀死狼外婆时，一切都晚了 ……: This must be the first time that such a thing has happened. I didn't kill the Grandma Wolf in time, I was too late...
罗夏薇拉或许已经变成了可悲的亡魂永远徘徊于雾之森林。: Rocha Vera may already have become a pitiful soul, wandering the Misty Forest forever.
为了让善良的孩子们不再受到陌生人的伤害，我会拜托吟游诗人将红帽女孩罗夏薇拉的悲剧: To ensure that such innocent children are no longer hurt by strangers, I will ask a Minstrel to sing the tragic story of the little red-hatted girl Rocha Vera. I hope that this will alert everyone to the dangers of these beasts that disguise themselves as humans!
格曼老师的猎枪在追捕那只野兽的时候被夺走了，那可是老师最喜欢的猎枪，你能把猎枪找: When Teacher Bergman was hunting that beast, his shotgun got stolen. That was his favorite shotgun. Would you be able to get it back?
据说那个被野兽吃掉的女孩有写日记的习惯，如果你能将她的日记带给我的话，我们一定能: They say that the girl who was eaten by the beast used to carry a diary. If you could bring it to me, we would surely obtain some useful information.
据说被野兽杀害的老妇人有一条披肩，而野兽将那披肩作为自己的伪装，你能将那披肩找到: They say that the old lady who was killed by the beast had a muffler, and the beast used it as his disguise. Could you find that shawl and bring it to me?
...这把猎枪对于老师来说有特别的意义，并且极有可能带着关键的线索，你能再努力找: ...This shotgun has a special importance to Teacher, and it may also contain a vital clue. Could you do your best to find it?
这本日记是我们了解事件的钥匙，再努力找找看吧！: This diary is the key for us to understand this matter, please do your best to find it!
这件披肩是解开被害者信息的关键线索，希望你能全力找到它！: This muffler is the key to learning about the victim, I hope you will do your best to find it!
如果每个人都这样只说不做，那我们的世界被黑暗占据只是早晚的事。: If everybody just talks without action, then this world will be covered in darkness sooner or later.
没错，这把猎枪就是格曼老师的那一把，上面有什么线索吗？: Yes, this is Bergman's shotgun. Is there any clue to be found on it?
虽然偷看别人的日记不合适，但为了调查真相，好好研究其中的线索吧！: Even though it’s not good to look at other peoples’ diaries, we must search it thoroughly for clues to uncover the truth!
从这件披肩的针线看起来，它的主人一定是一位温柔又能干的人，可惜了 ……: From this muffler, it looks like the owner was a warmhearted and hardworking person. How sad...
据说女孩出门时带了一个可爱的手提包，如果能找到的话，或许我们能得到有用的线索。: They say that the girl carried an adorable handbag with her whenever she went out. If you could find it, perhaps we could uncover other clues.
女孩在失踪的那天，穿的是一套洋装，你能将这件宝贵的遗物找到并交给我么？: On the day the girl disappeared, she was wearing a dress. Could you find this precious item and bring it to me?
随身物件往往能帮助我们推测出主人的事，希望你能再努力找找看。: Personal items often carry valuable clues about their owner. I hope you will do your best to find it.
那件洋装上有重要的线索，也是那个女孩留在这个世界上的唯一几件东西了。: That dress contains a valuable clue, and it is one of the only items left behind by that girl.
你的妈妈难道没告诉过你，撒谎的孩子会被野兽叼走么？: Did you mother never tell you that lying children get eaten by beasts?
希望这个提包的主人，在去世的时候没有经历太多痛苦。: I hope that she didn't suffer too much when she passed away.
看来这件洋装上有重要的线索呢！: It looks like there's an important clue on this dress!
噢，尊贵的客人，您能看见我吗？: Oh, hello sir. Can you see me?
（喃喃自语）原来是巧合啊，我还以为又能接待新客人了。: (Muttering) Darn, I thought we’d had a new guest.
真是恭喜！您现在拥有了光临低语山庄的机会！: How fortunate! You have the opportunity to visit Whispering Mountain Villa!
但是，作为斯凯领顿的豪华山庄，低语山庄可不像廉价的旅店，您需要山庄之主——贝茨克: However, as we are one of the more luxurious mountain villas of Skellington, Whispering Mountain Villa is not like a typical hotel. You must obtain a hand-written invitation from the owner of the villa, Dr. Batescliffe, before you may enter as a guest.
男爵只欢迎有能力的客人来访，只要您能完成两位山庄家仆发布的小小委托，通向低语山庄: The baron only welcomes guests who are competent. If you can complete two small quests issued by the villa servants here, I will personally offer you the invitation to stay in the villa.
恭喜您完成了所有的试炼！: Congratulations on completing all the trials!
想必过程中，您也听到了一些关于低语山庄的流言蜚语。: I imagine that while completing them, you have heard some gossip about Whispering Mountain Villa.
但您要知道，低语山庄总会给您带来意想不到的惊喜！: But you must know that Whispering Mountain Villa will always have pleasant surprises for you!
哈哈，那得您亲自到访才能知道啦。: Haha, that you’ll have to discover on your own.
果实的甜美必须亲口尝过才能知晓，不是么？: The fruits of achievement must be tasted to know their sweetness, no?
从现在起，低语山庄的大门无论何时都为您敞开。: From now on, the doors to the Whispering Mountain Villa are open to you at any time.
我在打扫的时候，把某位房客的日记弄丢了，拜托您帮我找回来吧，千万别让男爵先生知道: While I was cleaning, I misplaced the diary of one of our guests. Please help me find it, and I beg you don't let the baron find out!
我在打扫的时候，把男爵夫人的缎带弄丢了，请您在男爵夫人发觉前帮我找到它吧！: While cleaning, I misplaced the baroness's Wrapping Lace. Please help me find it before she realizes it’s gone!
我真是太粗心了，把山庄的地下室钥匙丢了，拜托您帮我找回来吧！: I’m so careless. I lost the key to the villa basement. Please help me find it!
您就别捉弄我了，再帮我找找吧！: Please don't tease me, help me find it!
哎呀，终于找到这本日记了，我要赶快处理掉！！: Ahh, you found the diary! Now I have to take care of it!!
这可是夫人最喜欢的缎带呢，您真是值得信赖啊！: This is the baron's favorite Wrapping Lace. You really are trustworthy!
太好了，这样地下室的秘密就不会泄露啦！: Excellent, now the secrets of the basement won't be spilled!
请您替我找到一份代号为17的秘密档案，交给我的话必有重谢！: Please help me find a secret file with the code number 17. You will have my deepest gratitude if you give it to me!
您见到主人的手术刀了吗？如果您找到的话请交给我，当心，它十分锋利。: Have you seen the master’s scalpel? If you find it, please give it to me. Be careful, it's extremely sharp.
我必须找回一封字迹潦草的信，请您助我一臂之力吧。: I need to find a scribbled letter. Please help me out.
…这份档案非常重要，请您再加把劲！: ...This file is extremely important. Please do your best to find it!
低语山庄可不欢迎撒谎的客人！: Whispering Mountain Villa doesn't welcome lying customers!
这份档案终于到了主人手里了，多谢你啦！: At last, this file is back in its owners hands. Thank you!
小心点，被割伤我可不会负责噢。: Be careful, I’m not responsible if you cut yourself.
太好了，希望你没有私自拆开它，好奇会害死猫咪噢。: Great. I hope you didn't secretly open it. Curiosity kills the cat!
今天晚上，就要在这里举办我的婚礼了。: My wedding will be held here tonight.
但是我却不知道我的新郎究竟是谁……: But I don't know who my groom is...
我来到这里后，有一些记忆很模糊……: Since I came here, some of my memories have become fuzzy...
只记得自己是在一年前的今天，我的婚礼当天死去来到了这里。: I only remember that on this day last year, I died at my wedding and arrived here.
我记得，我很爱我的新郎。今晚我想要在这里重新举办我的婚礼。: I remember that I loved my fiancé very much. Tonight I would like to have my wedding here again.
可我旁边的这两位身着礼服的先生都说自己是我的新郎。: But the two gentlemen next to me both say that they are my fiancé.
你能帮助我找到我真正的新郎吗？: Could you help me find my true fiancé?
是嘛……没关系……我再想想。: I see... That's okay... I’ll think of something.
他们各自都有四样物品在来到这里的时候遗落，如今都在墓碑怪人们的手上。: They each had four items when they came here, but now they are in the hands of the Tomb Zombies.
这些物品可以为他们作证，谁才是我真正的新郎。: These items could be evidence of who is my true fiancé.
你去问一下他们两个吧。: You should go and ask them.
冒险者，你看起来应该已经知晓了一切。: Adventurer, you look like you've already investigated everything.
那我的新郎究竟是谁呢？你能告诉我吗？: So, do you know who my fiancé is? Can you tell me?
我希望你可以郑重的思考。: I hope you will consider it well.
我的幸福就交由你来选择了。: My happiness rests on your choice.
我相信你的选择冒险者。: I trust in your decision, adventurer.
艾米丽，我会给你幸福的。: Emily, I will make you happy.
别胡闹了！这种事怎么能这样轻易的决定！: Don't be so foolish! How can you make such a decision so easily?!
哈哈哈哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈哈！你失忆是不是假的！: Ah hahahaha! Hahahahaha! You lied about your amnesia, didn't you?
你们两个联合起来骗我是不是！: You two conspired together to trick me, huh?!
既然如此，你们就别怪我了。: In that case, don’t blame me for this.
威尔克好像失去了意识。: Wilk seems to have lost his mind.
深蓝星辰……我头好痛……: The Azure Star... Ugh, my head hurts...
我都想起来了。我的新郎，卡森。: I remembered. My fiancé is, Carlson.
艾米丽，对不起，是我没有保护好你。: Emily, I’m sorry, I couldn't protect you.
不，不是你的错。都是他！都是他！: No, it’s not your fault. It’s all his fault! It’s all his fault!
我直到临死前才知道，他娶我，只是为了我们家的宝物，深蓝星辰。: I only realized when I was on the verge of death. He only wants to marry me to obtain our family’s treasure, the Azure Star.
那是我原本想要交给你的东西，只有我的丈夫才有资格拿到它。: That was something I was saving for you. Only my husband has the right to it.
冒险者，能把宝箱钥匙从威尔克身上拿过来吗？那是我的东西。: Adventurer, could you retrieve the key to the chest from Wilk? That’s mine.
找到钥匙了吗？把它交给我吧。: Did you find the key? Give it to me please.
卡森，这把钥匙，那天就想交给你了。: Carlson, this is the key that I wanted to give you that day.
这是我的答案，你就收下吧。: This is my response. Please take it.
你不是也有重要的东西要给我吗？: Don’t you have something important for me too?
你说的对。谢谢你艾米丽。: You are right. Thank you Emily.
钥匙我收下了，那我的戒指你是不是应该戴上了。: Now that have the key, I suppose you should put on my ring.
这枚戒指，是我家的祖传的，它叫蓝星之戒。: This ring is my family heirloom. It’s name is the Azure Ring.
你愿意戴上它吗？艾米丽，嫁给我吧！: Will you put it on? Emily, marry me!
卡森缓缓的将戒指为艾米丽戴上。: Carlson affectionately puts the ring on Emily’s finger.
冒险者，能请你再帮我们一个忙吗？: Adventurer, could you help me with one more thing?
用这把钥匙，将深蓝星辰取出来吧。: Take this key and retrieve the Azure Star.
我把宝箱藏在墓碑的后面了。: I hid the chest behind the tombstone.
这就是深蓝星辰啊……真漂亮。: This is the Azure Star... It’s beautiful.
我想把它送给这位冒险者，可以吗？艾米丽。: I would like to give it to this Adventurer. May I? Emily.
这个宝物在尼夫海姆可是糟蹋了它。: This treasure means ruin for us.
没有它的话，我们或许已经幸福的在一起了吧……: If not for it, we might have been happily together already.
更何况，你才是我最珍贵的宝物。: Besides, you are my most precious treasure.
冒险者，谢谢你，是你让我们能在一起。: Adventurer, thank you. It is because of you that we are together.
我想不起来，只能相信你的选择。: I can't remember, so I can only trust in your choice.
既然如此，晚上的婚礼的新郎就是威尔克了。: So then, tonight I will marry Wilk.
我警告你，别再这里纠缠不清的了。: I’m warning you, don't get yourself mixed up in this.
艾米丽是我的新娘！你别想再把她抢走了！: Emily is my bride! Don't even think of stealing her!
跟我走，艾米丽，跟我走……: Come with me Emily, come with me...
呵，看来这是逼我动手了！: Ah, looks like I have no choice!
我已经答应与你结婚了，你不要再为难他了。: I already agreed to marry you. Don’t hurt him.
听到没有！艾米丽让你赶紧离开！: Did you hear? Emily told you to get out!
艾米丽不可以嫁给威尔克！！不可以……: Emily mustn't marry Wilk! She mustn’t...
艾米丽！艾米丽！！这是我对你的承诺，我父亲把蓝星戒指给我了。: Emily! Emily!! This is my promise to you. My father gave me this Azure Ring.
我要为你戴上，实现我的承诺。: I want to put it on you to realize my promise.
哼，纠缠不清，给我走开。: Hmph, stubborn fool. Get out of here.
卡森似乎失去了意识。: Carlson seems to have lost his mind.
他的戒指掉落在了地上，将它捡起来吧。: His ring fell on the ground. Pick it up.
威尔克……！又是你！！你又伤害了他！: Wilk...! You again! You hurt him again!
呵呵呵，怎么说呢，是你说要嫁给我的，怎么你又要反悔？: Heh heh heh, how do I put this. You said you would marry me, how could you back out again?
威尔克你原来是为了深蓝星辰才要娶我的！: Wilk, you only want to marry me for the Azure Star!
我告诉你！我是不会给你的！: Let me tell you! I will not give it to you!
你如果不告诉我宝箱的下落，我就让他再死一次。: If you don't tell me where the chest is, I’ll kill him again.
在尼夫海姆死去，呵呵，那可就是消散了呀。: To die in Niflheim, heh heh, that means he will disappear.
宝箱钥匙掉落在了地上，将它捡起来吧。: The key to the chest fell on the ground. Pick it up.
卡森，你别说话，我带你去治疗……你一定会好的！: Carlson, don't speak. I’m taking you to get healed... You’ll be fine!
艾米丽扶着卡森匆匆离去了。: Emily takes Carlson and leaves in a hurry.
地上留着一个宝箱，用手里的宝箱钥匙打开看看。: There’s a chest on the floor. Pick it up with the key in your hand.
是一颗有着美丽蓝色光泽的珍珠。: It’s a beautiful gleaming blue pearl.
将它收起来，等以后见到艾米丽再交给她吧。: Pick it up. You can give it to Emily when you see her again.
这是一封我写给艾米丽的情书，上面写着我们的约定。如果你能找到它，请带来给我，或许: This is a love letter I wrote for Emily. It has our agreement on it. If you can find it, please bring it to me. Perhaps it can restore Emily's memory.
我和艾米丽在一场舞会上结识，这个假面就是我当时戴着的，它见证我与艾米丽的相遇，即: Emily and I met at a dance. This is the mask I wore to it which is evidence of our encounter. Even if she doesn't regain her memory, I will wear this mask when I meet her again.
我牵着戴着头纱的艾米丽逃离了婚礼现场，她的头纱不是为我而戴上，却是我为她掀起。我: I took Emily in her wedding veil and fled the scene. She didn’t wear it for me, but I lifted it for her. I want to put on the veil for her. Could you help me find it?
这是我家祖传的戒指，在艾米丽答应和我在一起的时候，我便向父亲讨来了这枚戒指，我想: This ring is my family heirloom. When Emily agreed to be with me, I asked my father for it. I want to put this ring on her, it's my vow to her.
这封情书不知道现在变成什么样子了……还能找到它吗……: This don't know what this love letter looks like now... Can you still find it?
不知道这个假面现在在哪里了，希望还有找到它。: I don’t know where this mask is now. I hope you can still find it.
真希望这头纱不要染上尘土，永远那样洁白。: I hope this veil stays so clean and white forever.
弄丢了这个戒指，父亲和艾米丽都不会原谅我的吧。: If I lost this ring, neither my father nor Emily would ever forgive me.
你身上没有我要的东西，真的很难找是吗？: You don't have what I want. Is it that hard to find?
就是这封情书！是我亲手写的情书……我要再次交给艾米丽。: This is the love letter! I wrote it myself...I’m going to give it to Emily again.
看到这个假面让我回想起了曾经的过往，艾米丽，我的艾米丽……: Seeing this mask again reminds me of the past. Emily, my Emily...
虽然有些脏了，但是这次我会为艾米丽披上这头纱。: It’s a bit dirty, but I will put this veil on Emily this time.
蓝星戒指……经历了这么多还是那么闪耀。: The Azure Ring... It’s still so shiny after all this time.
这是一把艾米丽交给我的钥匙。这把钥匙可以打开她家的宝箱。如果我不是她的未婚夫，她: This is a key that Emily gave me. This key can open her family chest. If I wasn’t her fiancé, how could she give me such a prized possession? Please find the key and bring it to me.
我打好了领带，在门口等着艾米丽，她款款向我走来，我以为这一刻就是永恒。没想到居然: Once I'd tied my necktie, I waited at the entrance for Emily, then she gracefully walked towards me. That moment felt eternal. I didn’t expect that someone would try to steal Emily! No, I must find my necktie...and hold the wedding.
这把刺刀是我鼓起勇气拿起的，为了我心爱的艾米丽，我要保护她。只是没想到那个臭小子: This knife is one that I obtained with courage. I will protect my beloved Emily. I just never expected that wretched man would stab me with it... Find it. I must use it to protect my fiancé.
这朵玫瑰是我用自己的鲜血养成的，一朵永远不会凋谢的红玫瑰，代表着我对艾米丽的倾慕: I grew this rose with my own blood. It’s a rose that will never whither, and represents my love and devotion for Emily. Find it for me. I want to give it to Emily again.

Evil humans who were greedy, angry and jealous were prepared to betray their friends for treasure and kill their family. Archaeologist Fokine has been committed to researching the cause of the city's destruction. Just this week, Fokine’s subordinate Bailey Hull inadvertently discovered a time-space tunnel leading to the past. The secrets of this lost city are gradually coming to light...

Rules of use:
1. Turning on or off the Guild Voice Chat feature requires the Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster to grant permission. Only then may guild members use it. 
2. The Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster must edit the guild members privileges in the Edit Privileges button of the Guild Members interface. 
3. Privileges may be granted to a maximum of 9 people including the Guildmaster and the Vice Guildmaster. The default Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster of the founding guild have the privileges. 
4. The Guildmaster and Vice Guildmaster can remove the voice chat privileges of anybody, including themselves. 
5. The Guildmaster, Vice Guildmaster and any member with privileges can open a Guild Voice Channel. 
6. Members without privileges can enter this voice channel, but are unable to talk in it. 
7. Guild members who have been granted privileges will have a symbol over their name in the Member List. 
8. When a guild member’s position changes, if there are still available privileges remaining (less than 9 people), the privilege will be given to the Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster by default; If there are no remaining privileges, the privilege will not be automatically granted and the Vice Guildmaster will have to claim it manually.

[Revenant Boss Explanation]:

1. Niflheim's Revenant Gate will open on even-numbered hours every day. 
2. Every time the Revenant Gate opens, it will cause MVPs to change into Revenant Form. MVPs in Revenant Form will appear on the map in place of regular MVPs. 
3. Each time you successfully kill a Revenant MVP, the Revenant MVP level increases by 1. If you fail to kill them, their level decreases by 1. 
4. Revenant MVPs reward drop rules are the same as normal MVPs, and Revenant MVPs reward drops include those of regular MVPs. 
5. Before Revenant MVPs appear, a random summon will appear on the map with a quest. Players then need to complete the current map's quest within 15 minutes. If time runs out, the original MVPs will respawn on the map. 
6. Quest Summon key words: Orifen, dead body on the ground, guard of the dead (smart you can surely solve this puzzle!) 

[World Boss Play Rules]:

1.When the Revenant Gate opens, there is a chance that the World Boss will be summoned on the Niflheim field map. 
2. When the World Boss appears, all players will see the countdown icon on their game interface. When countdown reaches zero, the World Boss will appear. 
3. Click the countdown icon to see the spawn location of the World Boss. 
4. Players who participate in defeating the World Boss will have a chance to obtain corresponding rewards, and the World Boss level doesn’t change.
一、副本规则\n1.参赛规则\n比赛为6V6组队对抗模式，参赛成员需在90级以上:
a. Dungeon Rules
1. Entry rules
For 6v6 Party Battle Mode, participating members must be at least level 90. Parties must have 6 members in order to participate. 
2. Victory conditions
*Both teams must compete and collect resources in the dungeon. When one party reaches 4000 points, they immediately win
*The dungeon will last for 10 minutes
*If neither party reaches 4000 points within the 10 minutes, the party with the most points wins. 
3. Elemental Orb
*Elemental Orbs of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind will spawn in the four corners of the dungeon 30 seconds after beginning. Players holding Orbs will earn points for their party every 2 seconds.
*Each player can hold only one Orb. When a party has 1-4 players holding an Orb, they will correspondingly gain 10, 20, 25 and 30 points every 2 seconds.
*Players holding an Orb are afflicted with the Vulnerable debuff, and each stack increases their damage taken by 5%. The longer they hold the Orb, the debuff is continuously stacked.
*Players who are holding an Orb are affected by its power, and it becomes increasingly difficult to control. While holding an Orb, you cannot go invisible or increase speed, and abilities have a fixed CD
*2 effect based on the magic of the Orb. The weakening effects on the opponent are thus: 
Fire + Water: [Mana Burning] enemies consume 200% more mana. 
Fire + Earth: [Crumbling] Enemy physical defense is decreased by 70%. 
Wind + Fire: [Soul Shackle] Approaching enemy players are slowed continuously. 
Water + Earth: [Zone of Frost] Enemies that deal heavy damage in a single strike are frozen. 
Water + Wind: [Static Field] Enemy magic defense is decreased by 70%. 
Wind + Earth [Storm Barrier] Attack distance of ranged enemies is decreased by 60%. 
*The combination spell has a 15 second CD time. During this time, switching Orbs will not change its effect. 
*If the party grabs more than 2 balls, it will remove the magic effect. Team B can then use the [Dungeon Guardian] NPC to cast corresponding magic to counter Team A. 
*When a player holding an Orb dies, the Orb will drop to the ground and the combined magic effect will be removed. The ball will then return to the location of the altar on the map. 
4. Buff Orb 
*The Buff Orb will spawn in the center of the map 1 minute after the match begins. After this, every 30 seconds as it respawns, only Orb-holding players can compete for the Buff Orb and thereby gain 150 victory points along with a random buff. 
*Buff types include: 
[Reveal] All allied players can detect invisible enemies for 10 seconds; 
[Damage Boost] Players holding an Orb deal 50% increased damage for 10 seconds; 
[Speed Boost] Players can exceed their maximum speed limit by up to 200% for 10s. 
5. Kills
Each time you kill an enemy player, your team wins 20 victory points.

2. Ranking positions are based on high score and are divided into (from low to high) Fighter, Elite, Warlord and Legend. 
3. Each match victory will earn an Honor Proof. 
4. At each position, you will unlock corresponding pets and cosmetic rewards. 
5. At the end of the season, the top 30/60/120 Legend rank players will receive a limited mount reward.

About [Fortress City Chest]:
1. After the player's current guild captures a Stronghold, you can obtain the corresponding Stronghold Chest. There are different rewards for each Stronghold. 
2. The Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster can open the Fortress City Chest. After opening, artifact shards and materials of the corresponding Fortress City Chest will be obtained. 
About [Guild Gorgeous Chests]:
1. Each week, every guild can use Big Cat Coins (15 times) and Guild Funds (1 time) to open the Guild Gorgeous Chest. 
2. Only the Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster can use Guild Funds to open the chest. 
3. Big Cat Coins must be expended to open the Guild Gorgeous Chest, and the amount increases with each successive opening. 
4. After opening the Guild Gorgeous Chest, the guild will receive the corresponding artifact shards and materials. Each guild member will also receive a reward of gold (new members must wait for the next reset to receive). 
5. If the guild has currently captured a Stronghold, they can open the corresponding Gorgeous Chest.
1.完成魔能灌注需要一件主要装备作为容器，1-5件次要装备作为素材，同时需要部分:
1. Completing an Enchant Fusion requires a primary piece of equipment as a target, 1-5 secondary equipments as material, and some extra materials as consumables. Equipment to be used as material must reach a certain level before they can be placed in the Material column. 
2. After completing the Enchant Fusion, all equipment and material added by the player will disappear. Players will then receive a new piece of Fusion Enchantment equipment. 
3. Fusion Enchantment equipment will carry the refining, enchantments, upgrades and slots from before. 
4. Equipment that has been upgraded or card-slotted cannot be used as material. You must remove the upgrade level and cards before it can be consumed. 
5. When refining, slotting or repairing Enchant Fusion equipment, equipment of the same name is not required as material, but instead the main equipment of the formula is to be used as consumable material. 
6. Damaged equipment cannot be used as material for Enchant Fusion.

Rewards:

Clear the stage for the first time every day to receive 5x [Gift from Nebula M78]

1x [Gift from Nebula M78] for unlocking 1 headwear

跳一支华尔兹吧，咚恰恰，啪嚓嚓！这些头上顶着蜡烛的怪人将墓碑视作自己的舞伴，每天: Dance the waltz, pa cha cha! These weirdos with candles on their heads treat the tombstones like their dancing partners. They dance every day, never short of a dance partner. Meanwhile Niflheim is never short of tombstones.
这些黑乎乎的小捣蛋鬼们是尼夫海姆最臭名昭著的麻烦精之一，它们无时无刻不在恶作剧。: These cunning little fellows are the most notorious tricksters in Niflheim. They never stop pranking. As the saying goes, if a Quve isn’t playing a prank, it’s on its way to playing one.
南瓜魂的口头禅是：世上只有南瓜好！这些游荡的小家伙们可以为了南瓜和你拼命。当你对: The mantra of the Lude is: pumpkins are the only good thing in the world! These wandering little guys will fight to the death with you over a pumpkin. When you have a burning passion for something, perhaps you’ll become some sort of ghost as well.
传说中继承月神之力的强大魔女，无数人为了见到她的容颜，在月光下苦苦祈祷。月有阴晴: The mighty witch of the legendary Moon's Charm. Countless people pray before the moonlight, hoping to see her face. As the moon goes through its cycle, so Loli Ruri changes. Do not try to approach her on the night of the full moon.
曾经是夜莺剧院的吹笛人，在哈默林由于村民的毁约而心生怨恨，在受到怨灵引诱后失去了: He was a fluter player of the Nightingale Theater, he lost his heart after exacting his vengeance on the villagers of Hamelin. In life, he possessed the ability to manipulate creatures with his flute. After turning into a monster, this talent became his most terrible weapon.
死灵骑士生前是善战的骑士，也是无情的行刑者。由于无法停止对猎杀的渴望，在死后，他: The Lord of Death was a valiant knight in life, and a ruthless executioner. Because he could not contain his thirst for the hunt, after death he came to Niflheim carrying a blood-stained lance, searching for his next prey.
嗜血怪人生前是斯凯领顿的无情杀人魔，死后他受到诅咒，变为暴虐的不死恶灵。铸造恶魔: The Bloody Murderer was the ruthless killer of Skellington in life. After death, he became cursed and turned into an undying Wraith. Demons are not created by magic and witchcraft, but by loneliness and humanity.
在雾之森林中，存在着一种狡猾残暴的人狼，他们会伪装变化为人类的样子，在受害者信任: In the Misty Forest there exists a kind of cruel human-wolf. They dress up like humans to gain the trust of their victims before revealing their true face. One of the most well-known tragedies happened to a little red-hatted girl named Rocha Vera. The killer of Rocha and her grandmother - the Grandma Wolf - still roams the Misty Forest.

The seeds of the Gibbets are not self-conscious until after they grow up and sprout from the earth. As they age, they once again lose their consciousness and become trees once again. Where do the dead go when they die? 
Does Niflheim the Town of the Dead really exist? 
　There are those who live a lonesome existence, longing for that day when they can be reunited. There are also those who cross over the border of the living and the dead in pursuit of a future that doesn’t exist. The reason why the dark Niflheim is filled with emotion and longing because of the many different souls that exist there. Will we meet again? If you ask this sort of question, maybe you will hear the cold response: “Welcome to Niflheim”

这个城镇怎么阴森森的: Why is this town so gloomy?
EP1.0《古城咏叹调》，于2017年4月25日推出，作为RO的第一部资料片，它: Ep 1.0 Glast Heim’s Aria: Available from April 25th 2017, RO’s unique and charming first expansion! The ancient city of Glast Heim is situated to the west of Geffen, it can be reached from passing through the Dragon Area. It is an ancient town with a long history, but due to a mysterious power it has already turned into a ghost town. The secret organization, the [Black Army] has garrisoned this city for a long time, turning this place into a forbidden ground which people who go to never return from. Adventurers must be sure to remember to keep safe at all times, if you run into danger in the harsh city of Glast Heim, no one will be around to help you.
9月12日第二部资料片EP2.0《宠物情人》正式出现在大家面前，久负盛名的艾尔帕: On 12th September, the second expansion Ep 2.0 Pet Lover will be officially launched. The prestigious Al De Baran will be open to all. In the tranquil and beautiful Canal City will be unveiled to adventurers. With ancient clock towers, and glistening, rippling canals that surround the city...Travel through Prontera’s North Gate now and experience a rather different visual feast! With the company of cute pets and great food, your journey will certainly be filled with the sounds of laughter. But where there’s light, there is also dark, danger is lurking everywhere and could show itself at anytime, let’s break through these dangers together! And search for the truth beneath the mystery!
我要带上我的新娘参加公会战: I want to bring my bride to the Guild War
EP3.0《倾城之战》，2018年1月16日正式上线，万众期待的公会战拉开帷幕，: Ep 3.0 Battle for the City will officially come online on the 16th January 2018. The Guild War that everyone has been waiting for will be unveiled. Make strategies and work together, every companion is as important as the other. Guilds are both competitors to fight against as well as companions to progress with together! Attack the Emperium in the depths of the city with other Guild members to seize bountiful rewards! Guard your partner’s dreams!
那片云彩里隐隐有座城: There’s a city concealed in those clouds
EP4.0《梦想天空》，5月22日，让我们向着天空之城出发，一起飞翔吧！艾尔帕兰: Ep 4.0 Heaven’s Dream, on the 22nd May, let’s set off to a city in the sky and fly together! North of Al De Baran, travel through the Border Checkpoint and Einbroch Field before finally reaching that place closest to the sky - Yuno. Right by the sky and the birds, experience the floating island’s allure yourself. T3 jobs will officially be open, and what great mystery is hiding in the Reagan Baylor Laboratory? Everything must be revealed through the adventurer’s own exploration in this mysterious place!
本是普隆德拉首席锻造师忽克连最拿手的技艺之一，经由忽克连之手的强化永远不可能失败: This is one of the pieces of work made by Prontera’s master forger, Hollgrehenn, those with Hollgrehenn’s enhancements will never fail. Since Hollgrehenn has bestowed his core enhancement techniques, the weapon’s management of Prontera have fused these forging techniques with the bag. Now every adventurer can enhance their weapons in their own bags!
普隆德拉首席锻造大师忽克连最得意的锻炼技巧，是一种使用神之金属和铝对装备进行魔法: Prontera’s master forger Hollgrehenn’s proudest forge technique is a type of quenching technique that uses Oridecon and Elunium to carry out magical quenching of the equipment. As the quenching process is extremely complicated, even the greatest forging masters such as Hollgrehenn are unable to entirely master this mystery. It’s an equipment forging technique with a certain amount of danger.

这件武器上有无尽的魔力: This weapon has endless magical power.
猫小友，来自猫猫岛的顶尖附魔师，平生酷爱收集莫拉硬币，根据古籍上的记载，附魔是众: Cat Friend is a master mage from Kitty Isle, who normally likes to collect Mora Coin. According to ancient texts, enchantments were created by the Gods as a type of magic that could enhance people’s power. Basic enchantments are already enough to help you deal with most of the monsters early on.
装备制作需要汗水和耐心: Creating equipemnt takes sweat and patience
乌加特家族掌握着米尔加特大陆最顶尖的装备制作手艺，他的族人用他们的智慧和汗水凝结: The Ugarte family has mastered the most advanced equipment-making techniques in the Midgarts continent. His family members used their wisdom and hard-toil to form unmatched powerful weapons, one after another. If you pay attention, you can see them in each main city, quickly go and forge a formidable weapon with them. PS: I will have equipment recommendation above my head.
乌加特家族掌握着这个世界最先进的武器打造体系，他们的工匠在打造过程中，惊奇的发现: The Ugarte family has mastered the most advanced weapon forging techniques in the world. While the blacksmiths were forging their weapons, they discovered that some weapons were not even close to reaching their limit. Through the assistance of advanced materials to carry out smelting and extraction, greatly increasing the equipment’s capability. The quality of some of these pieces of equipment will even change. If you have any questions about upgrading equipment, remember to go and find them!
公会领地新引进一台神奇的魔法缝纫机，传说这是冒险者公会大魔法师杜赫塔和忽必连合作: A new Magic Sewing Machine has been introduced to the Guild territory, legend has it that this is a product of the Adventurer’s Guild great Mage Durta and Hubert’s cooperation. Durta imbued his own magic into it, turning it into a Mithril-consuming Magic Sewing Machine. The Magic Sewing Machine will enchant the equipment with the Mithril through magic Sewing Machine. The equipment’s fine sheen is proof of the Mithril within it.
国王波利最近迷上了收集各种各样的卡片，他在南门门口向全世界的冒险家发起了卡片兑换: The King Poring has recently become obsessed with collecting all sorts of cards. He has invited the worlds’ adventurers to exchange cards with him at the South gate. All adventurers need to do is to give Poring any three cards, King Poring will then give you a card depending on how he is feeling. Of course, if you don’t think it’s a fair trade, you can also select card customization and card Salvage. If you have extra cards, you may as well come here and try your luck.
冒险家，公会领地供奉着可供瓦尔基里女神降临的神圣雕像，向英明神武的瓦尔基里女神致: Adventurer, Guild territory has a divine consecrated statue of the Valkyrie’s arrival. If you pay tribute to the almighty goddess Valkyrie, you will obtain a divine blessing. This blessing will make you able to charge valiantly ahead, making you undefeatable.
