这块宝石可以消除所有带有森林气息的魔法。: This gem can eliminate all the magic with forest aura.
也唯有哥布灵国王才能制作出这块宝石。: Only the Goblin King can make this gem.
但如何能见到哥布灵国王，就需要你去打听一下了。: But how do we go about seeing the Goblin King, we need you to find out.
我好像知道如何见到哥布灵国王……: I think I know how to find the Goblin King...
我知道很多关于这片森林和哥布灵的事情……这是为什么？: I know a lot about the forest and Goblins... Why?
你带着四样宝物去雕像的地方，将它们分别放在雕像四周。然后对着雕塑虔诚的鞠躬，哥布: Take the four treasures to the place where the statue is located and place them around the statue. Then bow to the statue with piety, then the Goblin King will appear.
记住，见到哥布灵国王要先对它礼貌鞠躬，和它说话要坐下认真聆听: Remember, when you see the Goblin King, you must first bow to it politely, When talking to it you need to sit down and listen to it seriously.
只有这样才能得到它的帮助。: That is the only way to get help from it.
宝物发出了幽蓝色的光芒。: The treasures is glowing in blue.
别担心，我来帮你翻译。: Don't worry, I will help you translate.
感谢你集齐这些宝物，冒险者。: Thank you for collecting these treasures, Adventurer.
为了感谢你，我可以为你制作森林之心。: To thank you, I can make the Heart of Forest for you.
至于鲁特他们的情况，我想你心里应该有了答案。他们的真实身份是……: As for the situation of Rute and them, I think you should have an answer in mind. Their true identity is...
不了解真实情况，是没有办法帮助他们的。: Without understanding the actual situation, there is no way to help them.
没错，他们其实本来就是哥布灵，鲁特他们是受命为我建造雕像的。: Yes, they were originally Goblins, Rute was the one being ordered to build a statue for me.
他们的记忆受雕像的影响产生了错乱，我们也一直在寻找恢复他们记忆的方式。: Their memories are influenced and distorted by the statue, and we are always looking for ways to restore their memories.
这就是森林之心。: This is the Heart of Forest.
雕像彻底完工了。这个森林之心给你，希望能帮助到鲁特他们。: The statue is completely finished. This Heart of Forest is for you, I hope it will help you to find Rute and them.
为了感谢你提供的帮助，我要以哥布灵的礼仪像你表达感谢。: To thank you for your help, I would like to express my gratitude to you in the Goblin way.
冒险者，哥布灵表达感谢的方式是摘下面具亲吻对方！: Adventurer, the way Goblins express gratitude is to take off their masks and giving the other a kiss.
在调查中，我们发现这片森林里从来没有人类居住。: In our investigation, we found that there were never humans living in this forest.
所以我们查阅了典籍，发现不稳定的森林魔力可能导致周边生物的记忆错乱。: So we checked the ancient text and found that the unstable forest magic might have led to the memory confusion of the surrounding creatures.
解决方式其实一样的，都是使用森林之心消除鲁特他们身上的森林魔力。: The solution is the same, using the Heart of Forest to eliminate the forest magic from Rute and them.
快带着宝石去帮助他们吧，时间久了对它们的身体可不好。: Take the gems and help them. It is not good for theie bodies if this go on for a long time.
看起来魔法成功解除了！: It seems that the magic was successfully lifted!
冒险者！我想起来了我想起来了！: Adventurer! I remembered it, I remembered it!
我们不是人类！我们是哥布灵！: We are not human! We are Goblins!
我是哥布灵王手下的长老之一，受命为我们的王修建雕像。: I am one of the elders of Goblin King's subordinates, and we were ordered to build a statue for our king.
而石像在这片森林中一直吸收着森林的魔力，但这股魔力又没有得到正确的引导，使得它变: The stone statue has been standing in the forest and absorbing its magic power, but this magic has not been properly channeled, therefore it is very unstable and even affecting the completion of the statue.
就在我们准备去寻找四件森林宝物来稳定这股魔力的那天，这股魔力迸发出来的力量，将我: Just the day we were looking for the four forest treasures to stabilize this magic, this magical power stunned our builders.
醒过来之后，我们就都以为自己原本是人类，是雕像的魔力把我们变成哥布灵的模样。: After waking up, we all thought that we were human beings and it was the magic of the statue which made us looked like Goblins.
真的十分感谢你冒险者，谢谢你为我们做的一切。若不是你，我们不知还有做出什么对王不: Thank you very much, Adventurer, thank you for everything you have done for us. If it weren't for you, we'd probably have done more things that would have disrespected the king.
这个森林之心既然是王赐予给你的，你就收下吧，它会给你带去森林的祝福。: Since the Heart of Forest was given to you by the king, you should accept it, and it will bring you the blessings of the forest.
我们得回去向王请罪了。: We have to go back and apologize to our king.
你就是爷爷说来帮助我们的冒险者吧！: You must be the adventurer that my Grandpa mentioned who is here to help us!
想要得到森之虹其实很简单~: It's actually very simple to get the Forest's Rainbow!
哥布灵森林里一条河~你拿着水壶和绳子去桥上打一点河水过来吧~: There is a river in the Goblin Forest! Take a kettle and a rope to the bridge and fetch some water.
嗯~的确是哥布灵森林的河水~带着一股森林的味道~: Mm...It is indeed the river of Goblin Forest! It has the smell of a forest!
现在你含一口水在嘴里，去旁边，然后面对树林，将水从嘴里喷出来，森之虹就会出现在你: Now take a big sip of water and hold it in your mouth, go to the side, then face the woods, spray the water out of your mouth, and the Forest's Rainbow will appear in front of you!
然后你对着森之虹，念一句咒语。: Then you chant spell in front of the Forest's Rainbow.
森林之神~请将这美丽的彩虹赐予我吧！: God of the Forest. Please grant me this beautiful rainbow!
河水有点甘甜的味道。: The river water is a bit sweet.
眼前出现了一道彩虹。: A rainbow appeared in front of me.
森之虹神奇的到了你手里。: The Forest's Rainbow is magically in your hand.
怎么样~森之虹是不是很美~只有用森林的河水在森林里才能看到这样的美丽的彩虹~: See! Isn't the Forest's Rainbow beautiful? You can only see such beautiful rainbow using the river water of the forest.
以前我们可是经常打水来制作森之虹的呢~: In the past, we often used that water to make Forest's Rainbow.
你还可以尝尝它，甜甜的~可好吃了~: You can also taste the water, it's sweet and delicious~
这么说来，我以前经常会和哥布灵一起玩耍啊……: Speaking of which, I used to play with Goblins very often...
哎……先不想这个了。: Sigh...Let's not worry about this for now.
如果你把四个宝物都收集齐了~记得去找我爷爷哦！: If you collect all four treasures, remember to go find my grandfather!
去西边，采树叶。: Go west and pick the leaves.
阿榔吹起了树叶，小小的树叶居然被吹出动人的旋律。: Mallie blew the leaves, and the tiny leaves are producing a sweet melody.
木片上浮现出了一个个音符: Musical notes are appearing on the wooden chip
你得到森之音了呀！这样，把音符拿下来就可以了。: You've got the Forest's Tune! This way, you can just take the notes off.
你找哥布灵们帮忙了吗？森之音只有森林的魔物才可以制作……: Have you asked the Goblins for help? The Forest's Tune can only be produced by monsters of the forest...
唔，难道变身了之后，本身的属性也一起改变了嘛……: Hmm, have the attributes changed along with the transformation...
是你吧！来帮助我们的冒险者！: It is you! Come help our adventurers!
从今天开始我们就是朋友了！: From today on, we are friends!
有什么事你尽管来找我就是！我一定帮忙！: You can come to me if you ever need help! I'll definitely help!
你知道森之泪是什么嘛~: Do you know what the Forest's Tears are?
其实就是草叶上的露珠！: In fact, they are the dewdrops on the grass!
不过当然啦！极少的露珠才能成为森之泪。: But of course! Very few dewdrops can become the Forest's Tears.
而且森之泪必须保证绝对的纯净，力量才不会流失。: And the Forest's Tears must be absolutely pure, so the power can be maintained.
所以说，容器很重要！: So, the container is very important!
经过我们世世代代的研究！我们发现！只有哥布灵森林里的木头做的容器才可以！: After generations of research! We've discovered! Only the containers that are made of wood from the Goblin forest can be used!
去收集一些木材过来吧~我来帮你制作！: Go collect some wood and come to me! I'll help you make it!
你真是个靠谱的伙伴！这么快就收集齐全了！: You are a reliable partner! You've gathered them so quickly!
那么我要开工了！稍等一下哦~！: Then I'll start working on it! Wait a moment!
接下来你要拿这容器去寻找森之泪！将它收集在这里。: Next you have to take this container to find the Forest's Tears! Collect them in this.
这里没有森之泪。: There are no Forest's Tears here.
原来是鲁特大人派来收集森之泪的，请吧。: It turned out that Rute was sent to collect the Forest's Tears. Please.
好伙伴！你太厉害了！: What a good friend! You are too powerful!
什么！我和爷爷的名气这么大了么！哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！: What? Are my grandfather and I have that great of a reputation?! Hahahahahaha! ! !
你好~冒险者。谢谢你愿意帮助我们。: Hello, Adventurer. Thank you for your willingness to help us.
我正要告诉你关于森之花的事情呢。: I am about to tell you the details about the Forest's Flower.
森之花其实就是哥布灵森林里随处可见的野花。: The Forest's Flower is actually a type of wild flower that can be seen everywhere in the Goblin Forest.
但是要变成森之花，可是需要森林精灵的祝福。: But for it to become the Forest's Flower, it needs the blessing of the forest elves.
这样它就变成了富有魔力~永不凋谢的宝物了。: Then it'll become a treasure that is magical that will never wither.
你先去采集些野花吧~千万不要多采哦~采太多精灵可是要生气的。: You should first collect some wildflowers. Don't take many or he elves will be angry.
制作森之花只需要一朵野花~剩下的野花我会制作成花蜜。: It'll only take one wildflower to make the Forest's Flower! I'll make nectar from the remaining wildflowers.
彩蝶精灵做喜欢这种花蜜了~你放在森林的深处~她会被花蜜所吸引现身。: Menblatt loves this nectar! If you put it in the deep woods of the forest, she will be attracted by it and show herself.
但是还有别的魔物也很喜欢这种花蜜，会被吸引而来，请你千万要注意安全。: But there are other monsters who like this nectar and will be attracted by it. Please pay attention to your own safety.
花蜜做好啦~彩蝶精灵十分温和~好好和她说缘由，她一定会帮忙的~: The nectar is finished! Menblatt is very gentle! Just explain to her your situation and she'll definitely help.
这不是你制作的花蜜吧，人类。: This isn't nectar made by you, human.
我从这花蜜中感觉到制作者留下的森林气息。: In this nectar I can feel the forest air left inside it by the creator.
你找我做什么？: Why are you looking for me?
是这样啊。举手之劳。: I see. No problem at all.
拿去吧，这就是森之花。: Take it, this is a forest flower.
唔，年纪大了也不能放松啊，子子孙孙还需要我的帮助。: Being old one can't relax either, the future generations still need my help.
森林里有好多好玩的东西~我特别喜欢。: The forest has so many fun things! I enjoy it so much.
森林里的宝物你知道有哪些吗？: Do you know what treasures are in the forest?
今天又是活力满满的一天！: Today's another day full of energy!
多多查阅典籍，受益良多。: Dodo consults the ancient texts and learns a great deal.
森林赐予了我生命，我一定会保护它。: The forest gave me life, and so I must protect it.
巨大的贝壳里透着微弱但纯洁的魔力。: A weak yet pure magic emits from within the huge shell.
愿你能感受大海的赐福。: Hoping that you can feel the ocean's blessing.
我的蟹钳是全海底无敌的！: Nothing on the whole ocean floor can beat my pincers!
哎，好累哦，老子好想睡觉…: Hey, this is exhausting, I want to sleep...
咦嘿嘿，我很老实的，你要信我呀。: Hey, I'm very trustworthy, you have to believe me.
大海的一切，终究都会是属于我的！: Everything in the entire ocean belongs to me!
好心的人啊…能帮帮我么……。: Kind person... can you help me...?
我是海底神殿曾经的皇室，珍珠公主。: I am the Pearl Princess, once a royal member of the Underwater Temple.
呜呜，我是被囚禁在这个贝壳里了。: Boohoo, I was imprisoned in this shell.
你知道四海至宝么？: Do you know of the Four-Sea Treasure?
四海至宝原本是海底皇室拥有的四件宝物。: The Four-Sea Treasure were four treasures owned by the Underwater Royals.
它们都具有强大的魔力，用以稳定海底世界的平衡。: They had powerful magic that was used to pacify the underwater world and to bring balance.
千百年来，我们皇室一直守护着四海至宝。: For thousands of years, our royal family has protected the Four-Sea Treasure.
但没想到，恶海族竟然垂涎四海至宝的力量。: But we didn't expect the evil sea folk would lust after the power of the Four-Sea Treasure.
呜呜，恶海族抢走了四海至宝。: Boohoo, the evil sea folk stole the Four-Sea Treasure.
并抓了我作为人质，把我关在了这里……: And took me hostage, locking me in here...
后来它们赶走了皇室。: And then they drove the royal family away.
还将海底世界和四海至宝都占为己有。: And will take the underwater world and Four-Sea Treasure for themselves.
至宝被恶海族这样滥用，不久后一定会引发海底灾难。: If the treasure is abused in this way by the evil sea folk, it'll soon lead to an underwater disaster.
请你帮帮我，帮帮这片大海。: Please help me, and help the ocean.
四海至宝被恶海族四大首领镇守。: The Four-Sea Treasure is guarded by the four leaders of the evil sea folk.
只要你能找到那四个首领，就会找到四海至宝。: When you find these four leaders, you'll find the Four-Sea Treasure.
我已经将大海的安危都托付给你了，冒险家。: Adventurer, I entrust the safety of the ocean with you.
请先从恶海族手中夺回四海至宝吧！: First, take back the Four-Sea Treasure from the evil sea folk!
喂，小子！说你呢！: Hey, kid! I'm talking to you!
谁允许你在这里走来走去了？: Who let you wander about here?
这里是我恶海族大铡蟹将军的地盘！: This is General Crab of the evil sea folk's domain!
恶海族现在有了四海至宝，是海底最强的势力！: Right now the evil sea folk have the Four-Sea Treasure, the strongest power of the ocean!
臭人类，你要是识相就马上跪地求饶。: Stinkin' human, if you're smart about it you'll kneel.
说不定，我能收你做个小弟。: Perhaps I could accept you as a little brother.
哈哈，你的攻击太弱了，根本伤不到我。: Haha, your attack is pathetic and can't hurt me at all.
我的蟹钳上覆盖了四海至宝——梦幻海藻！: My pincers will shield the Four-Sea Treasure--Seaweed Dream!
被梦幻海藻覆盖的东西能够抵御任何攻击。: Anything covered by Seaweed Dreams is protected from any attacks.
臭人类，有胆子就再来呀！: Stinkin' human, come again, if you dare!
我才不会告诉你，我的弱点是海盐呢！: I didn't tell you, my weakness is sea salt!
附近就有一些海盐，快去采一些吧。: There's some sea salt nearby, go pick some up.
别担心，梦幻海藻虽然防御力很好，: Don't worry, even though the defense power of Seaweed Dream is good,
但是如果碰到海盐就会暂时失去效果。: but when in contact with sea salt it temporarily loses its effect.
这附近就有一些海盐，快去采一些吧。: There's some sea salt nearby, go pick some up.
受到海盐影响，梦幻海藻的防御力变弱了。: Effected by the sea salt, the Seaweed Dream's defense is weakened.
糟了！怎么会这样？: Oh no! How can this be?
大铡蟹将军屁滚尿流，丢下梦幻海藻，一溜烟逃走了。: General Crab, scared out of his mind, abandons the Seaweed Dream and disappears in an instant.
啊，我美丽的闪光珊瑚，我要为你吟诗~呱呱~: Oh, my beautiful Flash Coral, I will recite some poetry to you! Croak croak!
嗨，人类，你愿意听我新作的呱呱诗么？: Hey, human, wanna hear my new froggy poem?
我呱呱蛙元帅可是恶海族最有文采的首领，呱呱~: I am the Froggy Marshal of the evil sea folk and most talented of the leaders, croak croak!
你果然是个有品位的人类！: You really are a human with great taste!
你是四海至宝之中最美的存在~: You are the most beautiful of the Four-Sea Treasure!
啊~最美的存在啊~: Ah! The most beautiful in existance!
喂，你怎么表情这么难看？: Hey, why are you pulling that face?
难道我的诗不精彩么？: You don't think my poem is wonderful?
什么！？你居然敢鄙视我华丽的诗句！？: What?! You dare to hate upon my wonderful poem!?
看我不打死你！: See if I don't kill you!
哼，没想到你有两把刷子！溜了溜了，下次再收拾你！: Huh! I didn't think you had such skill! I'm going, I'm going, I'll deal with you next time!
哎呀，你真的觉得我的诗很精彩么？: Aah! You really thought my poem was wonderful?
太感动了，你是第一个夸我的人类！: I'm touched, you're the first human to compliment me!
我太兴奋了，我现在就要回去把这件事告诉我妈妈！: I'm so excited, I have to hurry home and tell my mom!
无尽的暗淹没大地，清澈的心沉入海底。: Endless darkness drowns the earth, clear hearts sink in the ocean.
但一切都因有了你，闪光过后，化作奇迹。: But everything is because of you, a miracle after the flash.
怎么样，要再听一遍吗？: How about it, wanna hear it again?
无尽的暗淹没大地，____的心沉入海底？: Endless darkness drowns the earth, ____ hearts sink in the ocean?
但一切都因有了你，闪光过后，化作____？: But everything is because of you, a ____ after the flash?
好像哪里念错了，还是重新念一遍吧。: There seems to be a mistake, recite it again.
我此生都没听过这么优秀的诗句！: I've never in my life heard such a wonderful verse!
啊，这首诗太好了，我可不能把它忘了，呱呱。: This poem is so great, I won't ever forget it, croak croak.
趁现在还记得住，我要回去拿本子记下来！: I remember now, I have to go back and write this down!
下次有好诗记得还要告诉我！: If you find a good poem, remember to tell me!
呱呱蛙元帅走的太快，忘记了带走闪光珊瑚。: The Froggy Marshal was in such a hurry he forgot the Flash Coral.
喂，能帮老子一个忙么，我好困啊…: Hey, can you help me? I'm so tired...
（打哈欠）族长最近叫我看管某些宝物。: (Yawn) The clan leader heard I was looking after some treasure.
说是什么四海至宝之一的玲珑水晶。: Asking what is this Exquisite Crystal of the Four-Sea Treasure?
可是老子我真的好累啊，也不安排人来换班。: But I'm so tired, I didn't arrange for anyone to take my shift.
都怪这破玲珑水晶，害的老子睡不了觉。: This damned broken crystal won't let me sleep.
我呀，一看你就是那种热心人士。: I see that you are a kind, generous person.
所以你帮我去采一株醒神草，给我提提神吧。: So, can you pick me some Awakening Grass to keep me awake?
老子可是恶海族的首领。: But I am the evil sea folk leader.
你帮我一点小忙，我不会亏待你的。: If you help me out, I won't be mean to you.
生长在海底的昏睡草和醒神草长的很相似。: Sleepy Grass and Awakening Grass look very similar growing on the ocean floor.
去采一株昏睡草给软趴趴水母，它一定会中计的。: Pick Sleepy Grass for Soft Marina, and it'll fall into the trap.
软趴趴水母是恶海族四首领中最偷懒的一个。: Soft Marina is the laziest of the four evil sea folk leaders.
它本来就耐力差，一天睡十几个小时。: It has poor endurance and will sleep for more than 10 hours a day.
现在一定是他最困的时候，我们可以趁机夺回四海至宝。: Right now is when he's at his sleepiest, let's take advantage and get back the Four-Sea Treasure.
海底的昏睡草和醒神草长的很相似。: Sleepy Grass and Awakening Grass look very similar.
你可以去采一株昏睡草给软趴趴水母，它一定会中计的。: You can pick Sleepy Grass for Soft Marina, and it'll fall into the trap.
不错，你做得很好，老子欣赏你。: Not bad, you did well, I admire you.

那可是西门传说中的食材啊，具有彩虹般绚丽的色彩与丰富的口味！是点缀甜品的梦幻配料: That's the food in the West Gate legend. It has beautiful colors and rich tastes. It's a fantastic ingredient for dessert!
哈哈哈，你问对人了，我就是那个能够制作彩虹西米露的人！: Ha-ha, you asked the right person, I am the one who can make the rainbow tapioca pudding!
只要你帮我一件小忙，我就可以制作一份彩虹西米露给你！: Just do me a favor, I'll make a rainbow tapioca pudding for you!
我小时候很喜欢吃西门的特色甜品——蛋黄糕，但是最近都没人会做这个小吃了，要是你能: When I was a child, I liked to eat the special West Gate dessert - yolk cake, but the cooking method has been lost. If you could bring me yolk cake, I would like to give you the rainbow tapioca pudding!
蛋黄糕？真是让人怀念的名字~: Yolk cake? What a name for memory!
当然啦，西门传统的甜点怎么会难倒我芭芭拉呢~: Of course, for me, traditional West Gate desserts are a piece of cake!
这可是我奶奶亲自教给我的甜点！稍等一下，我现在就做给你！: My grandmother taught me the cooking way. Wait a second, I'll do it now.
好啦，热乎乎的蛋黄糕出炉了~: Alright, now we have a fresh yolk cake!
谢谢款待！这让我想起了小时候的事，西门还是那个西门，但我已经回不到小时候了呢。: Thank you for your hospitality! This reminds me of my childhood, the West Gate remains the same, but the childhood time has gone.
按照约定我，这份彩虹西米露请你收下吧！: As agreed, please take this rainbow tapioca pudding!
传说中的彩虹蛋糕，我一定会亲手将它做出来的！: As for the legendary Rainbow Cake, I will make it by myself!
冒险者，你对甜点的感兴趣么？: Adventurer, are you interested in dessert?
那是在卢恩王国建国时期发生的事，特里斯坦大帝希望能用一个蛋糕来庆祝卢恩王国的诞生: The story happened during the founding of the Rune Kingdom. King Tristan wanted to celebrate the birth of the Rune Kingdom with a cake. He offered a reward in Prontera Square, who could make the best cake would earn the position of Royal Chef.
许多甜品大师带着自己的作品参加了比赛，黄金戚风蛋糕，玛斯黛拉果实蛋糕 …… 各种: Many dessert masters took part in the competition with their own works, such as the Golden Chiffon Cake, the Mastela Fruit Cake... Various legendary delicacies were presented.
但是一位来自西门的少女却用来自西门的5种素材做出了名留甜品界历史的梦幻甜品——仙: But a girl from West Gate used five local ingredients to make a fantastic dessert, Fairyland Cake, which enjoyed a great reputation. Her name is Orleans Jane, the first president of the Royal Cooking Association of the Rune Kingdom.
为了纪念这个传说中蛋糕，每年都会举行仙境蛋糕制作大赛！: To commemorate this legendary cake, a fairyland cake making contest is held every year.
挑战制作仙境蛋糕是每位甜点师的梦想，与奥尔里昂·简一样出身西门的我也不例外，但是: Fairyland cake challenge is a dream of every dessert, me also. Just as Orleans Jane, I came from the West Gate, but I met big troubles collecting ingredients. Can you help me?
太好了，要是你能够找到制作仙境蛋糕的所有素材，相信凭借我的技术一定能把它做出来！: Great. If you can find all the ingredients for making a fairyland cake, I'm sure I'll succeed! I'll give you the first taste!
据说在那些美味食材的所在地，生长着一种名为美食花的特别植物，只要在西门找到了美食: It is said that there is a special plant named Gourmet Flower growing in a space where the delicious food materials are located. As long as you the gourmet flowers in the West Gate, you are not far away from those materials.
没想到，这一天来得这么快！多亏了你的帮助，香蕉奶油，彩虹西米露，松果布丁，云朵酥: Unexpectedly, this came so fast! Thanks to you, banana butter, rainbow tapioca pudding, pinecone pudding, cloud crisp and dew jam are ready!
剩下的就交给我吧，我会做出一个完美的仙境蛋糕的！: Leave the rest to me. I'll make a perfect fairyland cake!
首先！用云朵酥来做蛋糕的第一层！: First! Make the first layer of cake with cloud crisp!
然后！用松果布丁来做蛋糕的第二层！: Next! Make the second layer with pinecone pudding!
接着！用浓郁的露珠果酱做蛋糕的夹心！: Then! Make the filling of cake with dew jam!
片刻之后！用加热过的香蕉奶油来浇筑蛋糕的外壳！: After a while! Decorate the cake shell with heated banana butter!
最后！将彩虹西米露倒上蛋糕，达到调味与点缀的极致！: Last step! Pour the Rainbow tapioca pudding on the cake to achieve the ultimate flavor and decoration!
终于完成啦，来来~快尝一口，这是你应得的酬劳！: It's finally done. Come and have a taste. You deserve this!
这个味道一定能感动整个普隆德拉！: This flavor will surely touch the whole Prontera!
但是这个蛋糕，我不准备拿来参赛了。: But this cake, I'm not going to bring it to the competition.
这份仙境蛋糕能够成功做出来，全靠你辛苦收集来的食材，我不能独占功劳！: I made this fairyland cake upon the ingredients you collected, I can not monopolize the credit!
下一次，我会依靠自己的力量收集食材，做出真正属于我自己的仙境蛋糕！这份蛋糕，请你: Next time, I will collect the materials by myself and make my own fairyland cake! Please take this cake!
谢谢你让我在甜品师的路上迈出了新的一步！我们后会有期！: Thank you for helping me step further on the road to be a dessert! See you!
想喝我的下午茶吗？呵呵~给我足够的费用就行~: Want my afternoon tea? Just pay me enough~
哈喽，[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]~我是枫之信使: Hello, [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]I'm Kulena, the Maple Envoy! Did you see my gorgeous clothes? Adventure in Midgarts Land would bring [c][ffff00]the Maple Mark[-][/c], once you have gathered a certain number of [c][ffff00]Maple Marks[-][/c], you can come to me to exchange Maple Leaf series dress. Adventurer, take your actions now!
初入卢恩王国的冒险者为了获得正式冒险的资格，与同为初心者的青梅竹马赛尼亚一起在南: In order to qualify for formal adventure, the adventurer who first entered the Rune Kingdom accepted the test of the Eden in the South Gate together with his novice partner Cenia.
严格的考试后，冒险者与赛尼亚都成功获得了认可，并一起结伴来到冒险的圣地普隆德拉。: After the rigorous exams, both the adventurer and Cenia were successfully recognized and went together to Prontera, the venture sanctuary.
在普隆德拉，冒险者与各式各样的人进行交流，获得了知识与情报，对这个世界有了更深入: In Prontera, adventurers communicate with a wide variety of people, collect knowledge and intelligence, and gain a deeper understanding of the world.
之后，渐入佳境的冒险者与赛尼亚加入了普隆德拉下水道讨伐队，在下水道邂逅了美丽的人: Afterwards, the adventurer and Cenia joined the Prontera sewer crusaders. In the sewer, they met the beautiful mermaid mother and son, they were suffering from human's unintentional atrocities. The adventurer and Cenia help the mermaids treat the wound and sent mermaid Lusya safely back to the sea.
接着冒险者来到西门，并从西门学者史芬斯口中了解到了大陆中最为强大的神秘力量——伊: Then the adventurer came to the West Gate and learned from scholar Sphens about the most powerful force in the mainland - the Yimir Heart.
不久，冒险者前往了普隆德拉的卫星城市，港口城市依斯鲁得。在依斯鲁得，冒险家认识了: Soon later, the adventurer went to the satellite city of Prontera, Izlude, a harbor city. In Izlude, the adventurer met Laurell Weinder, a young man who dreamed of becoming a magician, and helped him complete the first step of fulfilling his dream as joining the Magic Institute.
此后，冒险者接受了依斯鲁得城的委托，深入探索了神秘的海底洞穴和恐怖沉船，在过程中: After that, the adventurer accepted the commission of Izlude and explored the mysterious sea caves and horrible wrecks. In the process, the adventurer learned that the cause of the demon riot was related to the crystal dust of the Yimir Heart. Following this clue, the adventurer found that the pseudo-angel Baphomet was behind the riot.
在小人鱼卢西娅的帮助下，冒险者虽然修复了海底封印挽救了大海，但与此同时，邪恶的巴: Helped by mermaid Lusya, the adventurer fixed the seals and saved the sea. At the same time, the evil Baphomet was completely revived, and was certainly planning a huge conspiracy...
离开依斯鲁得的冒险者受庞德的邀请来到了伟大的魔法都市吉芬，在魔法学院院长雷藏的交: After leaving Izlude, the adventurer was invited by Laurell Weinder to the great magical city, Geffen. In the exchange with Reyen, Dean of the Magic Institute, the adventurer learned that the Goblins outside the city were launching a fierce attack on Geffen. The adventurer immediately went to the Goblin Forest and found clues in the dream of the investigators of the Magic Institute. It turned out that the man behind the scenes was the King of Goblin, but now the King is probably a counterfeit. To clarify the truth, the adventurer disguised as Jet Goblin to meet the King of Goblin. After the king's mask was smashed, the death spirit revealed its true face and attacked the adventurer. With the help of the Magic Institute, the adventurer defeated the dead spirit and restored peace to the Goblins. Unexpectedly, all this was part of the Baphomet's plan. During the chaos in Geffen, Baphomet slipped into the Morroc Pyramid and was about to destroy a dangerous seal.
为了对抗潜伏在梦罗克的伪天使巴风特，冒险者先前往了妙勒尼山脉，从女神使者处得到了: In order to fight against the Baphomet lurking in Morroc, the adventurer has come to the Mjolnir Mountains and acquired from angel the Goddess Tear which has purifying magic.
在前往梦罗克的途中，冒险者在苏克拉特沙漠与神秘的沙蜂部队相遇，并接受了来自沙蜂部: On the way to Morroc, the adventurer encountered the mysterious Desert Hornet Squad in the Sograt Desert and accepted a commission from them.
原来沙蜂部队是由生活在沙漠的原住民组成的自卫部队，他们要独自对抗来自魔物的威胁和: Actually, the Desert Hornet Squad was a self-defense force composed of the native desert residents. They had to fight alone against the devils and the hard living conditions. After completing the test of the squad, the adventurer was highly respected by the desert aborigines.
到达梦罗克后，大陆卫队的巴尔洛将军告诉了冒险者现在糟糕的情况——巴风特要破坏的封: In Morroc, General Barlaud of the Continent Guard told the adventurer that the seals which Baphomet intended to break belonged to Morroc, the devil, 600 years ago. Once Morroc recovered, not only Morroc, but the whole world would be destroyed.
情况紧急，冒险者驱赶了梦罗克周边暴乱的魔物后，找到了神工匠哈沃德，请求他为自己打: Facing such an emergency, the adventurer chased away the demons around Morroc and found the artisan Hayward, asking him to build a powerful enchantment vessel. Everything was ready, and the two altars between the seals had been activated, but it was still late for a short step. By this time, the Morroc City had been completely captured by the demons led by Baphomet, leaving ruins everywhere.
冒险者前往普隆德拉呼叫了大量援军，并在大家的掩护下闯入了封印之间，独自正面对抗邪: The adventurer went to Prontera to call for a large number of reinforcements and, under their cover, broke into the seals, confronting the evil Baphomet alone.
战斗中，冒险者多次附魔武器，但依然无法撼动强大的巴风特。冒险者最终为了守护这个世: During the battle, the adventurer had enchanted weapons many times, but still could not hurt Baphomet. Eventually, for the world peace, the adventurer sacrificed himself. He took the shard of Yimir Heart to defeat and seal off the evil Baphomet, thus refusing the revival of Devil Morroc. The brave adventurer conquered the devil. He fought for honor and love in his heart. His heroic deeds shocked the guild mentors. They perceived that the adventurer was the hero who predicted to save the world from danger. Holding admiration and hope, the mentors awakened the adventurer with the power of the Goddess Tear. The adventurer waked up and smiled. Without fear of the future darkness, he returned to where the adventure began...
梦罗克一战不久后，冒险者受到卢恩王国内务官的派遣，前往了东方的斐扬村。据派遣队队: Shortly after Morroc battle, dispatched by the Interior Officer of the Lune, King the adventurer headed for the Payon village at the east. According to the captain of the dispatch team, recently there have been attacks by Man in black and demons around Payon. Payon has been very exclusive to outsiders since ancient times, and the commander-in-chief of Payon was strongly against the arrival of the team.
为了获得统帅的认可，冒险者决定换上一身斐扬当地的服装，在此过程中，冒险者从统帅旧: To pacify the commander, the adventurer changed into a Payon local costume. In the process, the adventurer learned from Hawkham, a former fellow of the commander, that the commander had used the "power of taboo", so his personality changed greatly.
再次来到统帅府，这里却遭到了黑衣人的袭击，一番打斗后，统帅终于信任了冒险者，并透: Once again, he came to the commander's office, where he was attacked by Man in black. After a fight, the commander finally trusted the adventurer and revealed the truth that the black-clad men wanted to seize the treasure of Payon.
为了追击黑衣人，冒险者前往了斐扬森林与艾勒梅斯、迪文、大运、金胜展开了调查，终于: To trace the Man in Black, the adventurer went to the Payon Forest for investigation together with Eremes, Devine, Dawin and Kinshin. Finally, they found that the secret treasure of Payon was the Yimir Heart Shard, and the Man in Black was one of the Twelve Protectors following the Hand of Goddess, claiming to be Meimmeth.
希默梅思将金胜打伤，再次前往统帅府想夺取秘宝，虽然冒险者及时阻止了希默梅思，但伙: Meimmeth wounded Kinshin and went to the Commander's place again for treasure. Although the adventurer prevented Meimmeth in time, his partner Kinshin died unfortunately. The Commander told the truth in a complicated mood and decided to leave the Yimir Heart to Dawin.
斐扬事件后，王国内务官将冒险者派遣往兽人村进行了调查。驻扎在当地的骑士团遗失了许: After the Payon incident, the Interior Officer sent the adventurer to the Orc Village for investigation. The Knights stationed lost many weapons. After investigating, the adventurer found that the weapons had been stolen by the orcs, and the simple-minded orcs seemed to be plotting something. To disclose the truth, the adventurer and his three partners launched an in-depth exploration. During which, they rescued many human villagers imprisoned by the orcs, and found that the master behind the orcs was an unknown human being. After being defeated, the orc elder Albany told that the mastermind was the Hand of Goddess, and this time the culprit was an evil magician named Hoge, whose aimed to incite the orcs to attack the human village. After a fierce battle, the adventurer finally defeated the bewitched Orc leader and the evil wizard Hoge, temporarily repelling the Hand of Goddess, stopping their plots.
离开兽人村后，冒险者被派遣前往了不远的克特森林，调查圣歌教会在克特森林遭到犬妖袭: Leaving the orc village, the adventurer was assigned to the nearby Kordt Forest to look into the bizarre incident as Ecclesia being attacked by Kobold in the Kordt Forest. From Reyen, Dean of the Magic Institute, the adventurer learned that the Kordt seemed to be hidden with something "that shouldn't exist".
于是冒险者深入森林，与魔法师伙伴凯特莉娜和庞德会合。根据魔法学院收到的神秘信件，: So the adventurer went deep into the forest and joined his wizard partners, Katerina and Laurell Weinder. According to the mysterious letters received by the Magic Institute, the adventurer followed the clue to find that the sender was the descendant of the Kobold prophet, the kind Tyre Sabertooth. Hearing Tyer's words, the adventurer realized that it's again the play of the Hand of Goddess. They pretended to remove the curse of Morroc for the Kobold, but in fact encouraged them to revive the dead prophets, thus seizing the Kobold's treasure "Yasukaha" to achieve some undeniable purposes.
在解救了三名正义的犬妖伙伴后，冒险者在召唤祭坛见到了这次幕后主使洛斯·拉比尔。在: After rescuing three Kobold comrades, the adventurer saw the master culprit, Los Rabil, at the Summon Altar. At the instigation of Rose, the Kobold Leader revived the first Kobold prophet who had lost humanity.
虽然在魔法学院及时的救场下，先知和犬妖首领得到了控制，但没想到，“亚苏哈卡”竟然: Though with timely help of the Magic Institute, the Prophet and the Kobold Leader were under control, it was unexpected that "Yarsuharka" was a shard of the heart of Yimir! Impacted by the Prophet, Los Rabil successfully captured the activated Yimir Heart Shard and escaped under the cover of Meimmeth. Afterwards, the Magic Institute helped the Kobold lift their curse, and realized that the next target of the Hand of Goddess was Glast Heim, the dangerous ancient city.
希默梅思与女神之手盘踞在古城，集结着他们的不死军团。海陆曼决定集结各方力量组成联: Meimmeth and he Hand of Goddess retained in the ancient city, gathering their undead legions. Healueman decided to form an ally to collapse the conspiracy of the Hand of Goddess. Geffen's Magician and Payon's Hunter Association decided to join the Allied Army, Dawin also joined in to avenge Meimmeth. Healueman Ally was founded. Healueman led the whole legion as commander of the corps.
联盟军在古城郊外受到了不明袭击。根据士兵们的口供，袭击他们的人身穿黑色盔甲，使用: The Allied troops were attacked by unknown forces outside the ancient city. According to soldier witness, the attackers wore black armor and used powerful Holy Light.
这些人是瓦尔基里强大英灵组成的漆黑部队，他们夺走同盟军的物资是为了阻止人类同盟军: They are the Valkyrie's black army which are formed by powerful epic spirits. They took the Ally's material in order to prevent the Allied forces from entering the ancient city. Their mission is not to let anyone enter the city, nor to let the demons inside come out.
就在此时，希默梅思抓走庞德，并声称要将庞德作为祭品召唤沉睡已久的不死恶魔——黑暗: At this moment, Meimmeth seized Laurell Weinder and claimed that Laurell Weinder would be sacrificed to summon the sleeping immortal devil, the Dark Lord! The Black Army was chasing Meimmeth, and the adventurer joined the Allied forces in their search for Laurell Weinder.
然而，希默梅思此时已经利用庞德富含魔法潜质的身体与龙区的龙族一起作为贡品，组成了: However, Laurell Weinder's magical body and the dragons have been used by Meimmeth as tributes to form an evil summoning array. The Ally, the Black Army and the Dragons, three incompatible forces, jointly fought their common enemy and successfully saved Laurell Weinder.
但是一切已晚，庞德的灵魂已被抽离，召唤仪式也已经完成，黑暗之王再次现身于大陆。希: But it was too late, Laurell Weinder's soul had been extracted, the calling ceremony had been completed, and the Dark Lord appeared again in the world. After Meimmeth fled, the Black Army went after him, while the Ally retreated to the outskirts of the ancient city, waiting for Prontera's reinforcement.
信仰之力会守护梦罗克。: The power of faith will guard Morroc.
久仰大名，英勇的冒险家。: Nice to meet you, my dear adventurer.
你知道很久以前巴风特带领手下对梦罗克进行过一次大袭击吗？: Did you know that long ago Baphomet led his men to a major attack on Morroc?
那次的战争，造成了数以万计的民众伤亡。: The war resulted in tens of thousands of casualties.
在危难关头，有十三位勇士站了出来，就和你一样。: In times of crisis, thirteen warriors came out, just like you.
他们牺牲了自己保护了梦罗克。: They sacrificed themselves to protect Morroc.
他们留下的武器被掩藏在梦罗克的黄沙之下。: Their weapons were buried under the sands of Morroc.
最近在古迹研究者的努力下，这些武器终于被找齐了！: Recently, with the efforts of archaeologists, all these weapons were brought to light!
这些武器是梦罗克人们的信仰象征！: They symbolize the faith of the Morroc people!
铁匠们将这些破损的武器复制出了新的武器，命名为信仰之力。: The blacksmiths duplicated these broken weapons into new ones, calling them the Force of Faith.
冒险者，你是守护我们的勇士，这信仰之力是我们对你的感谢。: Adventurer, you are our guardian. The Force of Faith is our thanks to you.
如果你还需要别的信仰武器可以购买信仰之力到我这边来兑换。: If you need another weapon of faith, you can buy the Force of Faith to exchange with me.
喏，就是我旁边这位雷炽兄弟。: See, this is Reese, our friend.
你以身涉险，查到了这么多线索，我真不知该如何感谢才好。: For all the clues you've found, I have no words but thanks.
对了……这是我们特勤队员的帽子，也是勇气和力量的象征。我把它送给你，祝福你的旅途: Well... This is the hat of our Secret Service members, and a symbol of courage and strength. I give it to you. I wish you every success in your journey.
对了冒险者，能不能再帮我个忙？: By the way, adventurer, can you help me again?
我之前去依斯鲁得碰到一个卖花少女，她拜托我去找由火焰制成的红色颜料。我现在找到了: When I was in Izlude, I met a girl selling flowers, she asked me to find a red pigment made of flame. I've found it, please bring this to her.
是火焰的颜料……非常感谢！这样画家可以作出更美的画了。: It's the pigment of flame... Thank you very much. So the painter will have more beautiful paintings.
辛苦你特意跑一趟。这是以前在猎人公会的朋友给的，但我不大用的到。送给你，希望对你: Thank you for being here. This is from a friend in the Hunter Guild, but I seldom use it. Take it. I hope it will help you.
我想了想，你还是太冒失了。这样下去，以后不知道要招惹多少麻烦。: I still think you are too reckless. In this way, I can't image how many troubles you will bring in the future.
这个给你。有了它的加护，以后面对死灵这些魔物时，你可能会轻松点。: Here you go. With its help, you might feel easier dealing with Doppelganger.
并没有鼓励你去找死灵的意思哦！: It doesn't mean you have to find Doppelganger deliberately!
虽然我这次试炼失败了，但是还是得到了新的收获。: Although I failed in this trial, I still got a harvest.
之前与马克们交战，我身上沾到了他们的黏液。: In the fight with Marcs, I got mucus from them.
然后海底的那些有毒的魔物都绕着我走了！: Then all the poisonous demons in sea have avoided me!

须佐系列机甲是龙之介大叔创造出的杰作！: Ryunosuke created the great Susa Mecha!
我的父亲曾说过：“机匠的强大，并非完全取决于机甲的性能。”: My father once said, "the strength of a Mecha does not depend entirely on its performance."
但当我看到“红莲丸”的第一眼，我就明白了，它就是我所追寻的那台机甲。: But when I first saw the Honglyun's Sword, I realized that it was the Mecha I was looking for.
好消息是，须佐系列机甲是量产型的，如果你想要的话，能在艾奇那儿买到。: The good news is that the Susa series of mechas are mass-produced and can be bought from Aiky if you want.
但前提是，你是一名配得上须佐机甲的优秀机匠！: But only if you become a good mechanic first!
如果你想知道更多关于须佐系列机甲的消息，去天津町找他们的制作者嘉神龙之介大叔聊聊: If you want to know more about the Susa series, go to Amatsu and talk to their maker, Kagami Ryunosuke.
你喜欢我的创造的须佐系列机甲吗？年轻人！: Do you like the Susa series of mechas? Young man!
看来我们不是一路人，没什么好说的了。: Looks like we're not the same. There's nothing more to say.
哈哈，你很有眼光！我一直深信，天津町的工匠技术不会输给任何人！: Good! You are awesome! I have always believed that the craftsmen in Amatsu will not lose to anyone!
如果你是一名优秀的机匠，我做出的机甲一定能够让你所向披靡！: If you are a good mechanic, our armour will make you invincible!
想要的话，就来看看我的机甲商店吧！: If you want it, come and see my mecha shop!
嘿，冒险者！好久不见！: Hey! Adventurer! Yes. Long time no see.
我们这儿新到了两台手推车，有没有兴趣了解一下呀？: We have two new wheelbarrows here. Are you interested in them?
嗯哼，那我就跟你介绍介绍。: Okay, then I'll introduce them to you.
第一台是浴缸造型的泡泡鸭手推车，可以说是人见人爱~: The first one is a bubble duck trolley shaped in a bathtub, which was quite popular.
不光造型有趣，使用感也极好，非常适合可爱的你呢！: It's interesting in shape and excellent in use, which is quite suitable for you.
第二台……咳咳咳，是波利王国传说中的宝物——闪耀波利手推车！: The second one is the legendary treasure in Poring Kingdom——a shinning Poring Cart
看看！这令人目眩神迷的金色！传闻它能让使用者拥有一辈子花不完的财富……: Look at this! This dazzling gold! It is said that it will grant endless wealth for the person who uses it.
据说只有被选中的冒险者才能拥有它，嘿嘿……我觉得你就是那个人呢！: Only the chosen adventurer can have it. I think you're the one!
好啦，我就介绍到这里。如果你喜欢我们的新商品，可以随时找我购买哦！: All right, that's all I'm going to introduce. If you like our new goods, you can buy them from me at any time!
啊呀~你帮了卡希雅大忙了呢，那么这个[c][ffff00]风车头饰[-][/c]: Oh! You've helped Kassia a lot. The blueprint of [c][ffff00]Vane Hairpin[-][/c] is now available for you to buy with Eden Coins!
啊呀~你帮了古斯塔夫大忙了呢，那么这个[c][ffff00]雨伞帽[-][/c]: Oh! You've helped Gustaf a lot. The blueprint of [c][ffff00]Umbrella Hat Blueprint[-][/c] is now available for you to buy with Eden Coins!
长大以后，我要成为一名须佐机甲的驾驶员！: When I grow up, I want to be a driver of Susa Mecha!
怎么样，我戴的头盔很帅吧！: What do you say? The helmet looks good on me!
这可是我用打工存下的钱买的！: I bought this with the money saved from my part-time job!
这个头盔只是第一步，我的目标是买一台属于自己的须佐机甲！: This helmet is only the first step. My goal is to buy my own Susa Mecha!
总有一天，我会成为一名优秀的须佐机甲驾驶员，让大家记住我的名字！: One day, I will become an excellent Susa Mecha driver, making everyone remember my name!
塞壬队长是我最爱的男生！: Captain Siren is my favourite man!
塞壬队长真是集智慧和帅气与一身！: Captain Siren is really smart and handsome!
朱诺曙光队有塞壬队长真是让人放心啊！: It's really assuring to have captain Siren in Yuno Dawn Team!
呜呜呜，都怪那个可恶的宝伏让塞壬队长误杀了自己的父亲，伤心离开了朱诺。: Whoo! Bauff made captain Siren kill his father mistakenly and left Yuno.
这事情要是发生在我身上，我该多伤心啊！: How sad I would be if this had happened to me!
我现在只能靠录像来回忆我的塞壬队长了，呜呜呜。: I can only rely on video to remember my captain Siren now!
你要和一起看么？呜呜呜……: Do you want to watch it with me? *sniffle*
呜呜呜，你走开，你根本不懂塞壬队长的优秀！: Whoo, you go away! you don't know how good captain Siren is!
比起修发兹共和国，卢恩王国的大自然更加有活力呢！: The nature of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom is more dynamic than the Republic of Souffac.
跨海大桥的风景真好啊。: The scenery of the cross-sea bridge is really good.
（小声）这是我女儿莲第一次离开梦罗克，这么美的风景她却一个人在发呆，我有些担心她: (Whispering) this is the first time my daughter Lotus has left Morroc, but she is in a daze alone in such beautiful scenery. I am a little worried about her.
Can you help show her around? As her father, I'm really not sure what to do...
实在是太谢谢你啦！莲现在在跨海大桥那边发呆呢。: Thank you so much! Lotus is in a daze over the cross-sea bridge right now.
我想去跨海大桥上玩，但是那边正好有个来自修发兹共和国的旅行团……: I'd like to play on the cross-sea bridge, but there happens to be a tour group from the Republic of Souffac over there.
呜呜，我在梦罗克不太接触陌生人，更别说和外国人相处了！: I don't have many friends in Morroc, not to mention to make friends with foreigners!
不要害羞，让我们去和他们聊聊吧！: Don't be shy. Let's go talk to them!
大家好，我们是来自卢恩王国的[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-]: Hello, everyone, we are [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c] and [c][ffff00]Lotus[-][/c] from the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
你们好呀！大家感受到卢恩王国的热情了嘛？: Hello, guys! Do you feel the enthusiasm of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom?
既然这样，黛西！我们也生一个吧！: In that case, Daisy! Let's have one, too!
既然这么有缘分，我们就把这一刻用照相机拍下来做个纪念吧！: Let's use the camera to record this moment since we are fated to be together!
嚯嚯，相机是我们共和国的雷根贝勒公司最伟大的发明之一！: Ho ho, the camera is one of the greatest inventions of Rekenber Corporation in our Republic!
只要轻轻按一下，就能记录下你喜欢的东西！: Just click on it and you can record what you like!
如果你对相机有兴趣，你可以在普隆德拉国家地理特派员那领取。: If you are interested in the camera, you can pick it up at the National Geographic agent in Prontera.
哎，相机到处有，奇妙的邂逅可不是天天有的啊！: Hey, cameras are everywhere, but wonderful encounters are not easily seen every day!
我们一起在跨海大桥上拍一张照片吧，记录下这次神奇的旅行！: Let's take a picture on the cross-sea bridge and record this amazing trip!
来来来~你们两个站中间吧！记得把这美丽的跨海大桥拍全哦！: Come on, you two stand in the middle! Remember to take a whole picture of this beautiful cross-sea bridge!
看来莲开始喜欢上这里啦，替我转告巴德，我带女儿再转一会就回来~: It seems that Lotus is going to like it here. Tell Bard that I'm taking my daughter for a walk, and will return shortly.
直到今天早上，拉比丝提醒打了不少，还变得非常暴躁，我想把它关起来免得伤害到别人，: Until this morning, Rabish woke up a lot earlier and became very grumpy. I wanted to lock it up to not hurt anyone else. I didn't expect it to knock me down and run away.
我就在这等着，说不定拉比丝一会就回来了！: I'll just wait here. Maybe Rabish will be back in a minute!
（小声）太棒了，快递又有内部价了~: That's great! The courier has an internal price again.
看你光秃秃的头顶，是不是总感觉缺了点什么呢？: Look at your bare head. Do you always feel something missing?
这两位是我们乐园团的伙伴，托尼和吉娜！: These are the partners in my Eden Team, Tony and Genna!
别光顾着打招呼，看看他们的头顶上！: Don't just say hello. Look at their heads!
我头顶上的蛋壳帽是用了大嘴鸟的蛋壳制作的，坚硬无比！: The eggshell hat on my head is made of the eggshell of a big Peco Peco. It is extremely hard!
不仅材质坚硬，还十分美观！: It's not only hard but also beautiful!
喂喂喂！别看托尼了！看我！: Hey! Don't look at Tony! Look at me!
波利波利~吉娜我头上的是超级可爱的波利帽哦！: Poring poring! I have a super cute poring hat on my head!
据说所有戴上波利帽的冒险者都会受到波利的保护哦~: It is said that adventurers wearing poring hats will be protected by porings.
好啦好啦，吉娜先不要吵啦~这应该由[c][ffff00][PlayerName]: All right, Genna, don't make any noise. It's up to [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c] to choose!
但是哦，我只能提供给你相应的图纸，具体制作头饰的材料要你自己去取得哦！: But I can only provide you with the Blueprint. The specific materials for Headwear can only be obtained by you!
这也算是乐园团对你的一项考核！要加油哦！: This is also a test from the Eden Team. Come on!
我们乐园团的人就是不一样，这么快就收集齐材料了！: You are excellent as a member of Eden Team! You collected all materials in such a short time!
但是制作头饰的人可不是我哦~: But I'm not the one making the headwear.
不远处有一个叫微笑小姐的女孩子，她才是制作头饰的行家！: Not far away there is a girl called Smile Assistance, she is the expert in making headwear!
怎么样？头饰很萌吧！: How's that? Headwear is cute, isn't it?
那么恭喜你完成考试项目三啦，戴上可爱的头饰一起向未知的冒险前进吧！: Well, congrats on completing item 3 of the exam. Put on your lovely headwear and move on to the unknown adventure!
好眼光！: That's smart for you to say so!
哈哈！我就知道你会选这个！: Haha! I knew you would choose this!
普隆德拉还是一如既往地繁荣呢！: Prontera is as prosperous as it used to be!
嘿，你听说过传说中的神奇商店吗？: Hey, have you ever heard of the magic shop?
也难怪，只有拥有聪慧双眼的人才能看见这些神奇的商店。: No wonder only people with intelligent eyes can see these magic shops.
懵懂的小家伙呀，让我来赐予你一双聪慧的眼瞳，让你领略神奇商店的魅力和肆意逛街的快: Ignorant little fellow, let me give you a pair of intelligent eye contact lenses to appreciate the charm of the magic shop and the joy of shopping!
可以了，冒险者！你已经可以看见这些商店了，快去逛逛吧，说不定能碰见什么好东西呢！: All right, adventurer! Now that you've seen these shops. Go and buy something!
再考虑考虑吧！我会一直在这儿等你的！: Think about it! I'll be here waiting for you!

远远望去，这座古老的王国似乎透露着一丝生机；纵然一望无际的沙漠，也会因为有人哼着: Looking from afar, this ancient kingdom seems to reveal a glimmer of life. Even with nothing but desert in sight, someone will be humming a song full of life.
晚风中传来的，不仅仅是凉意。滑过你耳边的，是这里的亡灵们曾经呼救的哀嚎。: The night wind is not just a cold breeze. What you hear are the cries of Undead once calling for help.
你攥得住手里这滩沙么？或许吧，攥得住的都已经成为了泥块。而那流逝掉的，早已渗入这: Can you hold this beach sand in your hand? Perhaps, what you hold is already a slush. And what has slipped away has seeped into the land, silently watching everything that is happening.
经历暴雨后，朱诺第一缕阳光将城市与天空都披上了绚烂的金色。: After the torrential rain, Yuno's first ray of sun covered the city and sky in a gorgeous hue of gold.
悬浮的天空之城朱诺！手里的相机根本停不下来呢，每一处风景，都如同云端的仙境一般梦: The floating city Yuno! I can't stop using the camera! Every scene is like a dreamland in the clouds!
这里就是卢恩王国与修发兹共和国的国境线嘛？多么美妙的风景啊！这里简直就是景点摄影: Is this the border between the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and Republic of Schwartzvald? What a beautiful scene! This is a paradise for photographers! Hold on, that Highland Parasite is adorable! Just a few pictures...
身处偌大的艾因布洛克原野，迎面吹拂来一阵荒野之风~真舒服呢！真把我相机里风景与远: In the vast Einbroch Field, the wild wind blows~ Feels great! I really wish I could share the scenery pictures in my camera with you. Wait. My camera was taken by a Martin. Hey, give it back!
唔哇~这里真的好热啊，我的相机胶卷不会被烧坏吧？等等，那个岩浆结晶真好看，咔嚓咔: Whoa~ It's really hot here. Will my camera burn? Wait, that lava crystal is beautiful. Click, click!
年轻的冒险者啊，守望着朱诺的同时，是否心里会迷茫，沙漠之后，是绿洲么？也许吧，这: Oh young explorers, while watching over Yuno, have you ever wondered what is beyond the desert? Is it an oasis? Perhaps, this journey will not be without sacrifices. Where have they gone?
这是一座让人誓死想要守护的城市！: This is a city people hope to pledge to protect!
见证了梦罗克从兴盛到毁灭，见证了魔王梦罗克入侵这个世界，这段记忆终将成为生命中无: Witnessed the rise and fall of Morroc. Witnessed the demon Morroc invade this world. This will never be forgotten.
两百道荣光汇聚在一起，在这个世界上爆发出耀眼的光芒！: When glory gathers together, a dazzling light breaks out in this world!

许多年以前，兰特克利斯掌管着通往天界和人间的天国之门，可以自由往返两个世界。出于: Many years ago, Randgris controlled the Heaven Gate, which allowed people to freely move between Heaven and Earth. Out of interest, he sometimes came to Earth, becoming a warrior by the name Motley. Soon, the stories of warrior Motley's heroic acts were spread throughout the world. He killed monsters and protected the people, and was deeply loved by all. However, after he successfully slayed the monster Chimera, it dropped a piece of red gemstone. That was the Blood Curse of the vampire Dracula. The Blood Curse summoned Dracula. He knew of the people's desire for supreme power, so he sent the demonic gemstone to Randgris. Tempted by the gemstone, the desire of Randgris grew out of control. Not long after he had returned to Heaven, Ragnarok began. This battle caused the gods to fall, but the demon army that had appeared was brought upon Earth through the Heaven Gate that was secretly opened. When it was all over and peaceful, with nothing but snowy white feathers drifting in the winds, it was almost as if this was telling a legend.
在克雷斯特汉姆的新兵训练里，新加入了四位少女。热情奔放的艾思丽，刚入团就收获了隔: In the training camp of Glast Heim, there were four new ladies. After joining the army, the passionate Eisley found love with the white knight captain. The gentle and shy Amila wrote down all the details of the training in her diary. Elinise is from Prontera. She carries a Four-leaf Clover, the symbol of her home, as a protective charm. But Sumina admired Elinise's enchanting long purple hair. The four young girls slowly grew up in the army, forming a deep friendship and bond. But good times did not last long, as darkness engulfed the city. In a desperate moment, the girls listened to the teachings of their predecessor, Mimos, and formed a small team. Mimos' Robe is a symbol of honor and valor, as well as the strength to never give in even in the face of adversity. The girls put on the Robe, awaiting the battle of darkness to come.
黑暗降临，克雷斯特汉姆来到了存亡的边缘，人们都为了守卫古城努力着。艾里维奇被魔法: Darkness arrived, Glast Heim was on the edge of collapse, everyone was struggling to protect the city. Devoured by magic, Alricht became a crazy Swordsman who lost consciousness, but continued to protect the castle. Ozma brought his Gold Arrow and marched into the abyss to destroy the Dark Monster, only never to return. Ecklen was gravely injured by the Cursed Magic Bow, becoming an undead, but continued to patrol the city to resist the Darkness. Crulero was a normal young man. He wrote his last letter of love to the princess, and entered the battlefield... Darkness eventually overtook the city, but the warriors' courage combined as an invisible arrow. The Invisible Arrow, as its name suggests, is invisible, shapeless and untraceable. When faith is concentrated, it will appear by the warrior's side in a time of need, in honor of their blood and tears. Glast Heim may have fallen, but hope survives.
古书中记载，生命魔剑为战斗而生，是传说中的武器。曾有五个人拥有过这把剑。第一个是: Ancient books say that the Life Sword is a legendary weapon made only for combat. Five people once held this sword. The first was a warrior, who used the sword to chop off the head of the Yamata snake. The second was a strong man, who used the sword to kill himself and save this city. The third was a thief, who used the sword to kill witnesses, as well as spill his blood across the walls. The fourth was Susanoo, who was unable to bear the death of his wife, and used the sword to end his own life. The last was a young man called Muramasa, who used the sword to kill his mentor and friend out of envy, but he was lost to the sword as well. No one knows that the Life Sword has its own will. If the sword bearer resists, it will betray its owner. It is unsure who will die in the end...
有一名天才占卜师，他用手中的纸牌就可以窥见未来。一天，古城的国王邀请他去占卜，抽: There is a gifted fortune teller. He can use the cards in his hands to see into the future. One day, the King of Glast Heim invited him to do his work. The cards drawn were Star Coin, Power, Sword and Holy Grail. Star Coin symbolizes infinite wealth. Power is unlimited creativity. Holy Grail is a gift of love and hope. The Sword is a symbol of wisdom and might of the past. The King was delighted, but the fortune teller realized all the cards were in reverse. After rearranging, a man hanging upside down dropped out from the back. The hanging card meant everything will be flipped upside down. All of a sudden, the fortune teller foresaw the demise of Glast Heim. He advised the King to take his people and leave, but the King believed he was spreading panic, and ordered him to be executed. The fortune teller left Glast Heim in grief, leaving behind only that fateful card. Since then, no one knows where he went.
多年之前，在艾尔帕兰的路边有一块能让人忘记时间的石头。有个盗贼将它打造成了匕首，: Many years later, on the road to Al De Baran was a stone that would make people forget things in time. A thief used it to forge a dagger. When attacking, the people near the dagger would not resist. It was not long before the thief used it to accumulate much wealth. One day, he used it to rob a mechanic, but the dagger had no effect. The mechanic regained consciousness, and both died in the struggle. Their blood dripped on the dagger, awakening the asleep Time Witch. The Witch used the thief's gold to make a golden hourglass, and the mechanic's parts to make a clock. Granting them the power to travel through time, the Witch took the Time Dagger and left. Soon after, a ship captain and watchmaker found the hourglass and clock. But it was not long before the two mysteriously vanished. No one knows where they went. But in a corner of Al De Baran, a masked witch was smiling at a dagger.
诺德温是研究时间的学者。他根据黑魔女体内的魔女印记，构筑出了一套时间理论：永恒维: Nordwin is a scholar who studies time. He used the imprint in the black witch to form a theory of time: Eternal Dimension. According to the Eternal Dimension theory, humans can use magic to see the future, and perhaps change the past. However on the day of completing his theory, Nordwin saw a scene of complete annihilation. The world would be engulfed in darkness, everything we once knew would become nothing. When Nordwin woke up, in his hand was a roulette. The roulette was glowing, but no matter how Nordwin tried, it would not open. A mysterious voice spoke: "When the future you saw arrives, the Time Roulette will open again..."
阿莱斯特•克劳利是个研究星星魔法的巫师。他为了制作传说中的黄金镰刀，将自己的巫师: Aleister Crowley is a wizard who studies star magic. To create the legendary Gold Scythe, he gave his wizard hat to the possessed monk Rasputin. The Possessed Monk was deceiving, and used the Skull Pendant to put Crowley to sleep. The truth was that he wanted to sacrifice Crowley to resurrect the evil gods. He took Crowley to the Alchemist's tomb, and activated the resurrection stone. However, Crowley's star magic and the stone resonated, and created the Star Crystal. The Crystal's power woke Crowley from his sleep. He defeated the demon, but his soul was devoured by the Crystal. Not long after, an archaeologist came to the tomb, and found the Crystal. The moment he touched the Crystal, he saw Crowley's memory. But before he could react, the Crystal devoured him as well. Only the scholar's cipher disk remained in the tomb. The Star Crystal had vanished. Perhaps it returned to heaven, or perhaps it went somewhere else, waiting for its next soul to devour.
时钟守卫者的头领默斯曼·岁月为冒险者颁发的奖章，奖励冒险者在巨蛇事件中为艾尔帕兰: The clock guard leader Mosman Time granted the adventurers with awards, rewarding them for their contribution to Al De Baran in the giant snake situation. Al De Baran hosted a grand wedding. The groom is the assistant of the clock guard leader Mosman Time. The adventurers were invited to join this romantic wedding. During the wedding, the groom was poisoned to death. This tragic wedding revealed the plot of the snake Jörmungandr, involving events of the gods from thousands of years ago. The giant wolf Fenril, because of Freyra's deception, was locked on the moon. After Ragnarok, the power of the gods was severely weakened, along with the seal on Fenril. Fenril's younger brother, Jörmungandr, hoped to build a bridge to the moon to save him. But Jörmungandr was wounded in Ragnarok. The gods were only weakened a small fraction. By chance, he discovered the golden clock tower of Al De Baran contained massive power, comparable to that of the giant Yimir. He hid himself in the clock tower, waiting for the right chance. Until one day, a young merchant called Norman appeared at the clock tower, rambling about how he wanted to help Nosman. This noise interrupted his sleep, as well as gave him his chance. He gave Norman a fake memory, letting Norman believe he had a younger brother called Reed, and transformed into a human appearance, acting as Norman's brother. This allowed him to sneak inside the clock guards. He used Norman's trust in him to search for information on the golden clock, eventually leading the clock guardians into rebellion, and summoning the Ancient Baphomet to kill Mosman Time. Unexpectedly, he could not control the summoned monster -- Ancient Baphomet. Instead, it wanted to devour him. In the crisis, Norman risked his own life to save Jörmungandr, severely wounding himself. Jörmungandr was touched by Norman's act. He was always disregarded by the gods, and his ever-important brother was locked away on the moon. No one ever took him seriously. For Norman, Jörmungandr worked together with the humans to defeat the Ancient Baphomet and sent it back to where it came from. Sadly, Norman's injuries were to heavy, and he did not last long before passing away. Jörmungandr was overwhelmed in guilt. He started to wonder if using the golden clock tower to build the bridge was the right move. The development of events did not give him much time to consider his actions in the clock tower, which created a black hole in this already precarious space. A Jörmungandr from another world traveled through the black hole here. In that world, "Jörmungandr" did not choose to build the bridge and save his brother, but selfishly consumed the golden clock's power for himself. The Jörmungandr from the other timeline lost all rational thought, and became a power-hungry monster. He called himself "Recurrent Nightmare", wandering around in different worlds, consuming everything that possessed power. Recurrent Nightmare used the accidental black hole by Jörmungandr to enter this world. He sneered at the adventurers of this world, and the emotional Jörmungandr. Jörmungandr felt lost looking at the different form of himself. He realized that without Norman, he might become this type of monster. He decided to help humans defeat the form of himself from another world. With the help of Jörmungandr, the adventurers defeated Recurrent Nightmare, sending him back into the black hole and sealing it. When the dust had settled, Jörmungandr followed his promise with Norman and abandoned the plan to use the clock tower. He left Al De Baran on a new journey, in search of a new way to save his brother. All heroic adventurers from this battle were granted a Clock Guard Medal, to commemorate the crisis at Al De Baran.
腹语师查理曾是圣诞村最好的表演家。他为人亲切，技艺高超，深受孩子们的喜爱。十年之: The Ventriloquist Charlie was once the best performer in the Christmas Village. He was kind, highly skilled, and very popular among children. Ten years ago, it was the gem merchant Bellmore's daughter's birthday. He invited Charlie to perform ventriloquism. Unfortunately, Dan, Karl, Rick and Manson, these four uninvited guests broke into the party. They ransacked the rich merchant's house, and Dan killed Mr. Bellmore. Afterwards, as the robbers were afraid of being exposed, they decided to frame the ventriloquist Charlie. Due to the accusations from the four, poor Charlie was sentenced to death, and was executed the day before Christmas Eve. After Charlie's death, his Teddy Bears, angered by the injustice to their master, transformed into vengeful weapons, and endlessly attacked the people of Christmas Village.
柯莉安是位舞者，她来自梦罗克的黑天鹅舞蹈团。舞蹈团受邀来到圣诞村表演，在途中却因: Corianne is a dancer. She is from the Black Swan Dance Team of Morroc. The dance team was invited to perform at Christmas Village, but on their way there, they lost all their belongings in an incident. The other members returned to Morroc, but Corianne was unwilling to leave like this. When the adventurers heard of this, they helped her find the lost items. Finally, Corianne went on the stage at Christmas Village. She danced with a golden apple in her hand, and the bell on her wrist sent out a crisp ding-dong that swayed with the music. At the end of the dance, the people applauded and cheered. She got her wish to give the best performance to the villagers. At the end, Corianne gave her self-made handbag to the adventurers as a gift to show her appreciation, and wished them the best of luck.
天水之国是大陆上充满灵气的地方，这里生长着一种常年不谢的花——樱花。这里生长的人: The Kingdom of Heavenly Water is a place full of spiritual energy. In here, there is a flower that grows all year round -- sakura. People who live here eat the delicious food made of sakura, drink the fine wine brewed with sakura and wear clothes covered in sakura. They spend their whole lives living under a sakura tree. And the sakura tree that grows here, slowly grew in spirit, becoming a spirit that can think. She gazed at the city full of sakuras, and called herself Sakura. However, as a spirit, she could not be noticed by the humans. She could only keep living all alone in the Kingdom of Heavenly Water. Until one day, she met a boy who could see her. The boy was a descendant of a wizarding family. His name was Ida Hideaki. Hideaki, who was rejected by his peers, and Sakura, who did not exist, became mutual partners and accompanied each other in their lonely lives. The good time did not last long, as Hideaki became ill. Watching his weakening figure, Sakura made a decision in her heart. She would use her energy to restore Hideaki's health and cure his illness, but her naturally fragile soul would become even weaker. He did not know why Sakura had become unusually weak. In order to restore her strength, he tried many things. In the end, he was left with no choice but use a spell, forbidden by his family, to focus all the spiritual energy of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water on Sakura to keep her alive. But that massive power made Sakura lose her conscience and become a monster that only knew to slaughter and destroy. With the help of the adventurers, Hideaki removed the spell, making Sakura return to her gentle and kind self. Only then did Hideaki realize that the reason Sakura was weak, was for her loved one. He pleaded the adventurers to give his strength back to her and let her recover. Meanwhile, Sakura pleaded with the adventurers to give all her energy to Hideaki, to give him good health.
在许多年前，熔岩洞窟曾发生过一次魔物大暴动，灾厄之火一度逼近朱诺城，四位来自各地: Many years ago, there was a monster uprise in the Lava Cave. The disaster crept closer to Yuno City. Four warriors from different places combined as a team. As time went by, the people started to forget the acts of these heroes. Today, let us remember the four heroes, Norfa, Dolly, Wassily and Smanling Rev. Yuno will forever remember these four names.

几千年前，在这片原野上曾有一个以打猎和采集为生的部落。不知从何时开始，鸟人一族在: Thousands of years ago, there was a tribe on this field that survived on hunting and gathering. The High Priest believed this was a sign from god. By proposal of the village chief, the village will hold a large sacrificial event. The warriors were asked to go and search for the golden egg. When the golden egg was found, only five of the more than twenty warriors returned... This golden egg had the power of the Birdmen King Harley. 熔岩洞窟里的矿石很特别，这是一种天然自带火焰力量的矿石。这种矿石可以说是完全因为: The ores in the Lava Cave are very special. These ores have the Fire Force. The ores are blessed by the power of the Firelord. They are very expensive. 很久以前，有一位富豪在斯凯领顿有一座避暑山庄。每年夏天他们一家都会带着仆人来到山: A long time ago, a rich man had a summer resort in Skellington. Every summer, this family would come to the villa with their servants. The rich man learned of the matter and was outraged. He sent someone to catch the boy and personally cut out his right eye, expelling him forever. The girl was despaired, and locked herself in a room in the villa. The expelled boy was adopted by a doctor called Franken. Doctor Batescliffe had killed the wealthy owner of the villa, but did not expect his lover to die of shock. Batescliffe used exotic and evil magic to infuse a monster into her body, creating a bloodthirsty monster. Every night, the witch will enter a frenzy due to her bloodthirsty instinct. The strong men killed became food and material for the witch. This angered the master of Nefheim -- Goddess of Death Hella. She personally killed the witch and Batescliffe, and destroyed the Whispering Manor. Recently, there were rumors that the destroyed manor reappeared in Skellington. In this cursed manor, the resentment had not faded.

赠送规则：\n1.近30天内玩家每次充值都能获得等值*10000的赠送额度，每次:
Gift Rules: 
1. Within the next 30 days, players gain a value*10000 gift quota each time they recharge. Each successful gift will deduct an amount of quota equal to the price of Zeny items in value. 
2. Gifting requires a certain amount fee. The higher the value of the gift, the more the required fee.

[UnRevenant MVP Gameplay Intro]: 

1. The Undead Gate of Nefheim will open at even hours daily. 
2. Every time the Undead Gate opens, one MVP will become Dead Form. The MVP Dead Form will substitute the original MVP and appear on the map.

2. When the World MVP appears, all players will see a countdown icon on their screen. World MVP shows up at the end of the countdown.

一、副本规则\n1.参赛规则\n比赛为6V6组队对抗模式，参赛成员需在90级以上:
1. Adventure Rules 
1. Competition rules 
The competition is a 6v6 team combat mode, and the participating members must be above level 90. Teams must have 6 players to join in. 
2. To win 
*Both teams compete to collect resources in the dungeons. The first team to earn 4000 will win. 
*Adventure lasts 10 mins. 
*If no team is able to reach 4000 points within 10 mins, the team with more points will win. 
3. Elemental Orb
*Elemental Orbs of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind will spawn in the four corners of the dungeon 30 seconds after beginning. Players holding Orbs will earn points for their party every 2 seconds.
*Each player can hold only one Orb. When a party has 1-4 players holding an Orb, they will correspondingly gain 10, 20, 25 and 30 points every 2 seconds.
*Players holding an Orb are afflicted with the Vulnerable debuff, and each stack increases their damage taken by 5%. The longer they hold the Orb, the debuff is continuously stacked. 
*Players who are holding an Orb are affected by its power, and it becomes increasingly difficult to control. While holding an Orb, you cannot go invisible or increase speed, and abilities have a fixed CD
*2 Orbs will summon a Magic Effect, based on the magic of the Orb, that will weaken enemy team members. The weakening effects on the opponent are thus: 
Fire + Water: [Elemental Barrier] causes enemy attack and cast distance to reduce by 40%, Orb-holding enemies reduced by 60%.
Fire + Earth: [Lava Path] Enemies holding the Orb will lose a percentage of HP while moving. Moving faster will lose HP even faster. 
Fire + Wind: [Soul Shackle] Approaching enemy players are slowed continuously. 
Water + Earth: [Mana Burning] Enemies consume 200% more mana, and lose 1% of Max SP per second. 
Water + Wind: [Mana Leak] Causes enemies holding the Orb to deal Abnormal Status on allies. [Water]: Silences allies within 5 meters. [Earth]: Petrifies allies within 5 meters. [Wind]: Snares allies within 5 meters. [Fire]: Burns allies within 5 meters. 
Fire + Earth: [Storm Fog] causes enemies to enter Darkness state that cannot be resisted for 1.5 seconds every 5 seconds, and enemies holding the Orb are permanently in Darkness state. 
*The combination spell has a 15 second CD time. During this time, switching Orbs will not change its effect. 
*If the party grabs more than 2 Orbs, it will remove the magic effect. Team B can then use the [Dungeon Guardian] NPC to cast corresponding magic to counter Team A. 
*When a player holding an Orb dies, the Orb will drop to the ground and the combined magic effect will be removed. The ball will then return to the location of the altar on the map. 
4. Buff Orb 
*The Buff Orb will spawn in the center of the map 1 minute after the match begins. After this, every 30 seconds as it respawns, only Orb-holding players can compete for the Buff Orb and thereby gain 150 victory points along with a random buff. 
*Buff types include: 
[Reveal] All allied players can detect invisible enemies for 10 seconds; 
[Damage Boost] Players holding an Orb deal 50% increased damage for 10 seconds; 
[Speed Boost] Players can exceed their maximum speed limit by up to 200% for 10s. 
5. Kills
Each time you kill an enemy player, your team wins 20 victory points. 
b. Ranking Rules and Rewards
1. Ranking positions are based on the season system. Each season is 1 and a half months. 
2. Ranking positions are based on high score and are divided into (from low to high) Fighter, Elite, Warlord and Legend. 
3. Each match victory will earn an Honor Proof. 
4. At each position, you will unlock corresponding pets and cosmetic rewards. 
5. At the end of the season, the top 30/60/120 Legend rank players will receive a limited mount reward.

初心商店商品说明\n1.等级礼包\n在玩家达到相应等级且进行转职后，可在初心商店:
Novice Shop Item Description 
1. Level Pack 
After reaching the corresponding level and job change, players can buy Level Packs from the Novice Shop. 
Level Packs are divided into T1 Level Pack, T2 Level Pack and T2 Advanced Level Pack. After buying the Level Pack item, use the pack items to directly upgrade your Base and Job level. 
Use T1 Level Pack to upgrade your Base and Job level to T2. 
Use T2 Level Pack to upgrade your Base and Job level to T2 Advanced. 
Use T2 Advanced Level Pack to upgrade your Base and Job level to Peak level. 
*Please use the items quickly after buying the Level Pack. If your level surpasses the corresponding level, the pack will expire. 
2. Novice Order 
Players with personal Gold Medal amount smaller than 450 will undergo Novice Order exchange at the Novice Shop. 
Players can use MVP and Mini materials to exchange in the Novice Order. 1 MVP or Mini material can exchange for 1 Gold Medal + 200 Contribution. 
Max Novice Order exchange limit is 25, and disappears after reaching the limit. 
3. Kafra Order 
Novice Shop provides Kafra Orders. After buying, players can exchange the corresponding Gold Medals and Contribution, and receive the bonus Gold Medal and Contribution. 
There are three types of Kafra Orders: 
Kafra Order·Ⅰ: Players with less than 100 Gold Medals can purchase. 
Kafra Order·ⅠⅠ: Players with less than 200 Gold Medals can purchase. 
Kafra Order·ⅠⅠⅠ: Players with less than 400 Gold Medals can purchase. 
Note: 
*Before buying Kafra Order, max Order exchange limit changes based on the player's personal Gold Medal amount. After buying, max Order exchange limit remains unchanged, but will deduct outer exchange amount (e.g. Guild Exchange). 
*Order exchange amount does not stack. After purchasing one type of Order, players cannot purchase other types of Orders.
