Mother asked me to pay her a visit tomorrow with cakes, fruits, and wine. I haven't seen my dear grandma for a long time. I'll put on my favorite dress and the little red hat I have got from her to see her. Grandma will be very happy. Mom asked me to not take the forest path. She's worried too much. How could there be so many human-eating beasts in this world?" If you have this item, give it to the huntress Maria Star in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Bloodthirsty Wolf to obtain.
这个可爱的女式提包里装了可口的水果，面包，还有一瓶似乎是自家酿的葡萄酒。那女孩提: This cute handbag had delicious fruits, bread, and a bottle of homemade wine inside. The scene of a girl carrying this bag walking through the forest became more and more clear in my head like an oil painting. The bag's owner must be on her way to visit someone she cherished dearly. I wish she was only sleeping under a big tree and having a really long dream. I wish she was still in her blooming age when she woke up. If you have this item, give it to the apprentice hunter Meikao in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Evil Wolf to obtain.
一件被鲜血浸透的红色洋装，诉说着它主人的悲惨命运。据说红帽女孩罗夏薇拉被狼外婆活: A red dress soaked with blood. It's telling her owner's tragic fate. Rochas Vera the Red Riding Hood is said to have been eaten alive by a wolf in her grandma's disguise. And her favorite dress has become the wolf's trophy. Beautiful things are easily destroyed. No matter what ages we are in, the wicked always put on different disguises while the kind remain the same innocent and passionate. If you have this item, give it to the apprentice hunter Meikao in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Mad Wolf to obtain.
“玫瑰啊玫瑰，你得快快长大。”威尔克将自己的手腕割开，让鲜血流入泥土里，他嘴里叨: "Rose O Rose, please grow up quickly." Welk cut his wrist and let his blood drip into the soil, muttering, "When you grow up, I'll ask Emily to marry me." The rose bathed in the moonlight that shone through the window while he hided himself in the dark. "Azure Star... My treasure..." He withdrew his hand and wiped his wrist with a handkerchief. His wound healed miraculously and the rose was blooming in front of him slowly. If you have this item, give it to Welk in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Admiration to obtain.
卡森低头看向自己的胸口，手里还拿着艾米丽的头纱，一柄长剑从心口穿出。艾米丽就在他: Carlson looked down at his chest, still holding Emily's veil in his hand. A long sword pierced through his heart. Emily was right in front of him and the sword was very close to hurting her. Carlson took one step back and moved the sword tip away from Emily. "Carlson, Carlson..." Emily watched this happening, confused and full of fear. Then she saw the man behind Carlson, staring at her with its sharp teeth exposed. That man suddenly grabbed Emily's hand and opened her tightly clenched fingers, revealing a key. If you have this item, give it to Carlson in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Purity to obtain.
威尔克整理了一下领带，精神抖擞的站在城堡门口，看着一步一步走来的新娘。艾米丽的面: Welk fixed his necktie and stood by the castle gate in good spirits, watching his bride approaching step by step. Emily's facial expression hidden behind the veil couldn't be seen but Welk knew she was very happy. Before he could reach his hand out to hold Emily's, a young man blocked him. The young man held the bride's hand and ran out together. The bride offered little, if any, resistance. When the crowd was confused, the pair vanished. Welk took a deep breath and chased out with a long sword... If you have this item, give it to Welk in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Eternity to obtain.
一封卡森写的情书，上面写着——致亲爱的艾米丽：在上次舞会上的相遇后，我对你的思念: A love letter from Carlson. It reads, "Dear Emily, ever since our encounter at the ball, my feeling for you is growing day by day. I can barely breathe." I know you are engaged and your wedding is set tomorrow. But these can't stop my love for you. Do you remember our promise? See you tomorrow in the garden. I'll fulfill my promise by putting a ring on your finger, my love. If you have this item, give it to Carlson in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Promise to obtain.
“艾米丽，你愿意嫁给我吗？”“我愿意！”卡森小心翼翼的掀开艾米丽的头纱，两人四目: "Emily, will you marry me?" "Yes!" Carlson gently lifted Emily's veil. The pair locked eyes. They both have too many words to say." Carlson, I have something for you. "Carlson stroked Emily's face tenderly and said, "Let me show you something first." Carlson took Emily's hand, ready to put the Blue Star Ring on her finger. A sharp pain came in the chest, followed by a warm stream. Clang... The ring fell from his hand to the ground... If you have this item, give it to Carlson in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Vow to obtain.
小镇上有个城堡，主人是个优雅的绅士，他与镇上一个富裕家庭的小姐订了婚，为了宣布这: There was a castle in the little town and the owner was an elegant gentleman. He got engaged with a lady from a wealthy family. To announce this news, he hosted a masquerade. Carlson attended the ball with a mask made by himself. Hiding behind his mask, he glanced across the hall casually. A girl's appearance took all his attention. He approached and asked this masked girl for a dance. Two young and palpitating hearts danced to the music. If you have this item, give it to Carlson in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Encounter to obtain.
一把精致的金色钥匙，能打开艾米丽家的宝箱。在婚礼前一天的晚上，艾米丽的父亲将这把: An exquisite golden key to the treasure chest in Emily's home. The night before the wedding, Emily's father gave her this key and told her inside the chest was a treasure that had been passed down for generations in their family, a dark blue pearl Emily was his only child and this key was the most important trousseau he had prepared for his daughter. He wanted her to give it to her husband and wished her everlasting happiness. Emily understood her father's care and thought. She promised she would give this key to her future husband. If you have this item, give it to Welk in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Wealth to obtain.
艾米丽的双手被鲜血染红。她拿出藏在裙底的刺刀，深吸了口气，整个人猛地向前冲去。威: Emily's hands were red with blood. She pulled out the bayonet hidden under her skirt and took a deep breath before dashing forward. Gazing at the golden key in his hand, Welk was taken off guard and stabbed by the bayonet in his arm. He didn't care as such a small cut was nothing for him. However, he was stunned when he realized the bayonet was made of silver. "You know I'm a vampire!" Emily didn't answer. She pulled the long sword out of Carlson's chest and pressed it into her own. "Welk, you won't live much longer..." If you have this item, give it to Welk in the Forest of Mist (Adventurers who have reached Lv. 115 may go and exchange). Kill the Tomb Zombie - Courage to obtain.
轮回梦魇的眼球。因为耶梦加德过度使用奇点球和黄金时钟的力量，导致黄金时钟内部产生: Recurrent Nightmare's Eyeball Due to Jörmungandr's overuse of the Miracle Ball and the Golden Clock's power, a Time Rift developed inside the golden clock. The Jörmungandr from another time line came via a Black Hole and in that world, Jörmungandr didn't choose to save his brother with the golden clock; instead, he devoured the power himself and lost his mind as a result, becoming a bloodthirsty monster. He named himself the Recurrent nightmare and began to flee hither and thither from one world to another. Jörmungandr joined forces with adventurers. Together they defeated his other self from another world, the Recurrent nightmare, helped humans seal the black hole, and promised to never use the golden clock again before slipping away.
坎卜斯是个半羊半魔的魔物，常在平安夜现身，他将考察圣诞村的每一个孩子，并在坏孩子: Krampus was a half-goat half-demon monster that usually appeared on the Christmas Eve. It would inspect each and every child in the Christmas village and place a birch branch outside the bad kids' door. That night, children would check their shoes or boots outside the house, trembling with fear, to see if it was a present from Santa Clause or a branch from Krampus. The branch signaled that Krampus had its eyes on the bad kid in this house and it would whip them with the branch and bring them back to its lair. What awaited in the lair was always a special present of punishment Krampus had prepared for the bad kids.
你的剑是为了什么而挥动呢？导师的话语在诺法的脑海中回荡。出身在普隆德拉的诺法从小: What do you wield your sword for? The tutor's words echoed in Norfa's head. Born in Prontera, Norfa grew up by the royal soldiers' training grounds. When he grabbed a long sword for the very first time as a child, he became fast fascinated. At that time, he thought a long sword was a symbol of a handsome knight. During the monster riot in the Lava Cave, Norfa entered the cave with his mates to prevent disaster and suddenly came to realize that behind his long sword was his guarding will. Why are you wielding your sword? The tutor's voice sounded again. Exhausted Norfa supported his body with the sword. My sword is wielded to save the innocent and to protect my mates' smile. Even at the cost of your own life? Yes, I think it's worth it. Norfa closed his eyes with a peaceful smile.
诺法转职成骑士的那天起，他便背上了这块沉重的盾牌，他的导师说，你手上的盾牌不是为: Since Norfa became a knight, he has been carrying this heavy shield. His tutor told him that the shield in his hand was not for protecting himself. Norfa didn't understand it until he left Prontera and formed an adventurous squad with three friends he met along the way. They were completely different yet sharing the same likes and dislikes. When faced by dangers, this shield is the solid barrier to protect his friends. During the Lava Cave riot in Yuno, this shield served as the rampart that secured Yuno from disaster. When Norfa's heart stopped beating in Lava Cave, he stood there holding the shield. Behind him were his friends who were also at the end of their lives. They all had a peaceful smile around the corners of their lips.
这把斐扬古木制作的弓上，沁着淡淡的红色。即使岁月流逝它依然富有韧性，看得出来它的: This bow made of some ancient tree from Payon has a faint red color. Still strong with tenacity after such a long time, it must have been taken very good care of by its master. But now this bow has only a bare body left. No one will ever pluck its string again. No one knows that once upon a time, a young girl named Dolly fired hope and courage with it. The girl has Dead but Dolly's Bow is still telling the past stories in silence.
出生于斐扬的桃丽只是一个相貌平平的农家少女，直到某次她展显出非凡的射手天赋。成为: A native of Payon, Dolly was just another average country girl until one day she revealed her extraordinary talent in archery. Dolly became a hunter and left home to explore the world. On the way, she met three reliable friends and the four of them formed an adventurous squad of justice and bravery. Travelling through Yuno, they encountered a monster riot in the Lava Cave. The horrible scene of misery and suffering reminded Dolly of the tragedy happened in her hometown Payon. The kind-hearted Dolly decided to save Yuno with her friends. Her arrows flew far and hit the berserk monster chief one after another. Bloody blisters developed on Dolly's hands slowly. When the squad of four advanced into the depths of the Lava Cave, Dolly put this last arrow on her bow. Lord Arrow God, please help me fire the divine arrow to seal the wicked air and grudge in the Lava Cave. The young girl closed her eyes and the divine arrow flew out. Dolly made it but her smily eyes would never open again.
你为什么喜欢斧子？曾有人这样问过瓦西里。他笑着回答。因为它很像我，一板一眼，劈下: Why do you like the axe? Someone once asked Wassily. He answered with a smile. Because it is very similar to me, scrupulous and methodical. Swing and chop with no gaudy frills. Desert men from Morroc never play tricks with anyone. Wassily didn't think much when he and his friends decided to help Yuno. He saw monsters harming the innocent. He saw people in need of their help. The axe in his hand began to wield itself. As soon as you see this axe, you know its master must be a marvellous warrior.
梦罗克出身的瓦西里从小就是孩子王，小时候，他的头上戴着风滚草编织的头环，多年后，: A native of Morroc, Wassily had always been the chief of children growing up.When he was little, he had a tumbleweed circle on his head. Many years later, the circle was replaced by a solid metal crown. However, deep down Wassily was still the same chief of children, always ready with drawn swords at the sight of injustice. As the head of the adventurous squad of four, he led his friends to help Yuno settle the monster riot without hesitation. Until the last moment of his life sealing the wicked air in the cave, he was still smiling like that mischievous boy who had never forgotten why he started.
作为一百年来首个被魔法学院提前录取的学生，斯曼玲·黎风天生就注定成为一位传奇女巫: As the very first student with early admission to the Magic Academy in its one hundred years history, Smanling Rev was born to be a legendary witch. However, to everyone's surprise, at the age of 19, she and three of her friends formed an adventurous squad despite her tutor's objection and left her homeland Geffen. While passing Yuno the Sky City, an unprecedented monster riot broke out in the Lava Cave. The monsters turned the whole place into an ocean of flame. The adventurous squad decided to stay and help the civilians in Yuno. Smanling's powerful magic played a key role in suppressing the monsters. According to some elderly who claimed to have seen the entire incident, Smanling had a blinding halo around her as she chanted spells like a fabled goddess and those arrogant monsters ran in disorder. When the group of four reached the depths of the Lava Cave, Smanling's mana was pretty much exhausted. The young girl exerted her last strength and sealed the foreign rift that had turned the monsters violent and berserk. Holding tight on her wand that had accompanied her in her short life, she rested in peace on this foreign land so far away from Geffen.
每位魔法师都拥有一本记录自己魔法的典籍，斯曼玲·黎风的典籍里除了咒语还有不少日记: Every mage has a book recording his or her own spells. Smanling Rev's Book also contains her diary and doodles. Page Seven "Simple-minded Wassily, silly Dolly, and idiot Norfa! I've had enough from my teammates." Page Forty "I didn't expect these guys to be so capable. The stupid knight Norfa actually has a reliable side! Last Page "Thank you. I don't regret stopping here. Idiot Norfa, I love..."
为了纪念曾经在熔岩洞窟魔物暴动中解救朱诺的勇者，朱诺皇家颁发的纪念勋章，背面刻着: To commemorate the warriors who had fought their lives for Yuno during the monster riot in the Lava Cave, the royal family of Yuno issued a commemorative medal with four names carved in the back, Norfa, Dolly, Wassily, and Smanling Rev.
很久很久以前，鸟人一族出现了一颗黄金的鸟蛋。当时的鸟人王名为哈利，这颗鸟蛋是由它: A long, long time ago, the Harpies got a golden egg. At that time, Harley was the Harpy King and that egg was laid by his queen. A golden egg. Harley was overjoyed for this heir sent from heaven. He guarded his queen day and night as she was hatching the golden egg. Days passed. No problem. Of course the heir chosen by heaven was different from other Harpy. Years passed. My queen passed in peace as I would continue to hatch our prince. Finally, Harley's time came to the end. He closed his eyes and rested on the golden egg. I'll continue waiting for you.
夜已深了，但在村落一处的木匠们还流着汗做着工。月光朦朦胧胧的洒在地面上，他们借着: It was late at night but the carpenters was still together in the village, working hard. The moonlight shone dimly upon the ground and they worked hard by the faint light. On the other side of the ground, several finished wooden helmets were piled neatly. Simple helmets without any decoration that warriors would wear tomorrow to search for the golden egg. Carpenters dared not take it lightly. These warriors were the future of the village. That chosen one and other youths. A few more and they would be done. The carpenters didn't feel tired at all. The beams in their eyes shone more brightly than the moonlight.
铁匠端详着眼前的那把利刃，这也许是他这辈子做的最好的铁器了。怎么能不好呢？村长送: The blacksmith looked at that sharp blade carefully. That might be the best ironware he had done in his entire life. How could it be not good? The village head brought him the treasure of the village, a piece of obsidian their ancestor had obtained. That calm and shiny obsidian had always been the village's evil suppressing key. And then it was inlaid in a sharp blade. That sharp blade would be bestowed upon the chosen warrior who would be selected from the youths of the village after the sacrifice ceremony. This might be the best. The chosen warrior armed with this sharp blade would certainly lead the village out of the current predicament. This thought brought a gentle smile on the blacksmith's rough face.
在盛大的祭祀及加冕仪式之后，大祭司正在亲手制作一个陶器，回想着当日的场景——兴奋: After the grand sacrifice offering ceremony and the Coronation, the high priest was making a pottery himself. Recalling the scene on that day, thrilled children, devout villagers, chanting priests, brave warriors, and the chosen hero holding the golden egg with injuries all over his body. From that day on, the village would no longer face so many dangers anymore. From that day on, the chosen warrior would lead all of them to march forth. The high priest couldn't suppress his enthusiasm. He drew a totem on the pottery and prayed nature to grant the village everything he had foreseen. I will serve you for the rest of my life, O God. My soul also belongs to you after my death. In the totem, a bird was interlaced with the fire, bearing spirits and wishes.
祭司们带着面具安静又整齐的往祭台走去，一个村民抱着一个孩子低着头恭敬的让路给祭祀: Masked priests stepped towards the altar silently in unison. A villager with a child in his arms made way for the priests, keeping his head low in a respectful manner. The baby in his arms gazed at the priests curiously. They all wore terrifying masks that seemed to be staring at him fiercely. The child burst into a cry with fear. The villager hurried to rock him, trying to calm him down. A priest stopped and reached out his hand to caress the baby's forehead. The child felt the warmth from the palm and struggled to open his eyes filled with tears, turning to look at the priest. It was the same terrifying mask but a gentle gaze came through the eye part. Don't be scared.
老妇人接过丈夫递过来的木枝，短小的木枝的一头被打上了一个洞。她用手轻轻摩挲着，擦: The old lady accepted the twig from her husband. A hole was made on one end of the short twig. She touched it gently with her hands, wiping off the mud and dust. She knew her husband worked hard to get this twig. This was a White Sandalwood twig. White Sandalwood was a divine object that could suppress the evil and tranquilize the mind. There was only one White Sandalwood tree growing very far away from their village. She picked up the red rope she had made and pushed it through the hole on the twig before tying a solid knot. She stood up and stepped outside slowly, waving at her son who was chopping firewood. The son wiped off his sweat and put down his tools before walking to his mother. The old lady rose on the tips of her toes to put the red rope on him. "Please be safe. Be safe."
青年人举着黄金鸟蛋，一步一步的走上祭台。这是我们村的希望啊，这是大祭司梦里可以守: The young man held the golden egg and stepped up the altar. This is our village's hope. This is the holy item for our protection the high priest has dreamed about The villagers under the stage looked at this young man covered by wounds, full of expectation. These wounds were his merits. No one was worried that he might fall and he would not fall. The young man carefully placed the holy item on the table in the middle of the altar. The high priest approached with the Warrior's Crown. The young man held the white sandalwood hanging in front of his chest subconsciously and gently caressed it. In his eyes was expectation for future. "This is the Warrior's Crown!" The young man looked at the crown full of feathers taken from Harpy Kings by the previous warriors. They swayed gently in the wind. The young man felt the heaviness on his head, which quickly passed through to his shoulders. Very heavy. It will be better. Life will be better. I'll lead you forth.
弓箭手名为卡拉，它是火焰精灵一族最优秀的射手，可谓是百发百中。卡拉对自己的技艺很: Archeress Cara was the best among all the archers in the Fire Elves clan. She never missed a target. Very proud of her skills, she often showed off her bow in front of other Fire Elves. Cara sneaked into a human town and threatened a weapon craftsman to get this bow. Cara brought back the bow she had robbed and infused it with the elemental power of fire. Each arrow shot from this bow would be surrounded by flame, dealing much greater damage. She named the bow Fire Feather Bow. The Fire Feather Bow is covered by an eternal yellow flame. Those who knew no spells would be burnt by the flame if they attempted to hold it.
火晶球是火焰精灵一族唯一的预言家希尔斯的所有物。火晶球的外形和人类巫师使用的水晶: The Fire Crystal Ball was owned by Hills, the only prophet in the Fire Elves clan. Resembling the crystal ball used by human wizards, not by chance, the Fire Crystal Ball was actually made by Hills based on crystal balls. The Fire Crystal Ball's outer shell was made of a very special crystal which could stand the finest fire in this world without melting. The flame inside the Fire Crystal Ball was bestowed by the Elf Elder upon Hills's request, pure and full of energy. Hills was very pleased with this Fire Crystal Ball he had created. It was way better than those ordinary crystal balls. However, Hills's prophecy didn't need this Fire Crystal Ball at all. It was completely for decoration.
说到火焰精灵最厉害的剑士，精灵们会一致认为是克里斯。也不是因为克里斯的剑术真的有: Speaking of the most skillful swordsman in the Fire Elves clan, everyone would mention the name Chris. It was not because of Chris's own swordsmanship but for all the great swordsmen he had trained. To honor his outstanding contribution, the Elf Elder bestowed Chris the Flare Sword forged by himself. This sword made Chris a worthy master swordsman. The blade of this sword had flowing fire twining. Chris's each swing left an orange shadow in the sky, which heated up the surrounding air. Although in possession of such a marvelous sword, Chris remained cautious and conscientious in tutoring, hoping to pass this Flare Sword on to a heir he approved.
火焰精灵佩里是个自认为很有品味的收藏家，它执着于收集一些稀奇古怪的东西，比如它最: Fire Elf Perry considered himself a collector with an outstanding taste. It focused on collecting strange things such as his favorite Fire Elf Eye. It loved to stay in the dark alone, enjoying the Fire Elf Eye that gave off a faint crimson glow and marvelled on its beauty. The Fire Elf Eye was acquired by Perry from some other elf. In Perry's opinion, no one also could truly appreciate its beauty. Legend has it that there was a very powerful fire elf a long time ago who practiced the demons' magic. The fire power inside its body went beyond control and its body eventually exploded, causing its own death. However, its pair of eyeballs filled by the uncontrollable flame was left but one went missing. Perry sworn that one day he would locate the other fire elf eye.
巫术师莱德是个不合群的火焰精灵。他整天捣鼓着人类的各式火系法术，因此他被大家孤立: Wizard Ryder was a fire elf who doesn't get along with others. Busy with the humans' various fire-type spells, he was isolated as a result. The Fire Elves hated the humans and their environmental pollution. The fire elves were in possession of the purest fire elemental power. How could they ever lower themselves to learn the humans' spells? However, Ryder had a different opinion on this. He deemed the humans' spells as special and hoped to improve the fire elves' elemental power by studying the humans' spells. It devoted itself to the study of the humans' fire-type spells and kept his study result on a scroll. The Fire Spell Scroll. He knew it too well that his power had become way stronger than the elf elder
火炎宝石是宝石工匠菲尔的得意作品。它将偶然得来的红宝石原石放在自己的体内，三年后: The Flame Gem was a masterpiece of the Gem Craftsman Phil. It kept a raw ruby stone it had obtained by chance inside its body for three years and then cut it with a cutting knife filled with the flame power into its current shape. The raw stone absorbed the elemental power inside Phil's body slowly. And then it was strengthened by the elemental power of the cutting knife. This gem was indeed a Flame Gem. It was so red as if it were to catch fire but felt just like a normal ruby, hard and cold. The humans could change their spell attribute to the fire type if they held it. Phil sold the offcut of the raw stone to a human gem merchant before putting the flame gem back inside its body in hopes of further strengthening it.
鲁鲁的一生没有什么追求，就喜欢品尝各种美食，虽然火焰精灵不需要吃东西。普通的食物: Lulu had no big dreams in life. He loved to taste different food though the fire elves didn't need to eat. Ordinary food couldn't satisfy Lulu anymore. It began to eat special items. Something no one else had tried before. It turned its attention to the Fire Elf's neighbour fire bird. Lulu thought if a chicken egg could be eaten, of course a fire bird egg should be similar. Soon he put his thoughts into action and stole one fire bird egg at night. After boiling it in water, it removed the shell and took a bite. The crystal clear egg white tasted slightly sweet. Lulu felt it had just discovered its new favorite food.
一条永远不会断的绳子和一团永远不会熄灭的火焰，宝藏猎手希尔在找到这两样神奇的东西: A magical rope that would never break and an eternal fire. After its discovery of these two miraculous items, treasure hunter Hill put the fire on the rope and made it into a necklace. The eternal fire was obviously a tinder sent by heaven. Hill put on the tinder necklace devotedly. It could feel its fire power became stronger and stronger thanks to this necklace. It didn't know why it had put these two items together. Probably by intuition that he had developed through years of treasure hunting. Hill gently held the tinder necklace to feel its temperature as if it could hear a story about flame.
这枚徽章原本是小恶魔一族给予每一个小恶魔的护身符，内含着黑暗力量。这一枚火纹徽章: This insignia was a talisman given to each Deviruchi in the Deviruchi clan. It contains some dark power. This Fire Pattern Insignia is upgraded with some flame power. Its original attribute has been changed but its guardian power is still there. The Fire Pattern Insignia is surrounded by an orange flame of a very low temperature. Humans would feel the warmth but wouldn't be burnt if holding it. According to the Fiery Deviruchi who performed the modification to this insignia, it was modified to thank a human adventurer so he wouldn't feel roasted by this flame in his residence. This Fiery Deviruchi was the very first Deviruchi to have voluntorily transformed itself into a Fiery Deviruchi in the Deviruchis' history. This insignia is indeed very special.
在瘟疫爆发的第四天，村子里的大家出现了不同的症状。溃烂的脓腔与孢疹在我身上蔓延，: On the fourth day after the plague outbreak, villagers all showed some symptoms. Festered pus cavities and herpes were spreading on my skin. Some weak children have been vomiting since yesterday. The elderly are unable to get out of bed, hanging on there with their decaying health. Screams and cries are being replaced by moans. Are we getting exhausted by the plague's torture? If this continued, it wouldn't be long until the entire village was shrouded by death. I looked at the black smoke coming from the machine not far from here and sighed. O Lord, why are we having this unexpected calamity?
艾因布洛克某个村庄长老使用过的拐杖，上面满是岁月蹉跎的印记。长老作为艾因布洛克原: Crutch once used by an elder of an Einbroch village. It's covered by marks of time. As a witness of the Einbroch Field's history, the elder harbored hatred towards a company that had been developing industrial projects without restraint. The streams where their children once played in have become filthy and foul in the pollution. The docile animals have turned into fierce beasts. Isn't this resulted from that steel monster which is giving off the black smoke all the time? A sharp pain spread in his body and almost dragged him down to the ground. This plague showed no mercy to his elderliness. He clenched his teeth and supported his bent spine with a crutch. Would this village vanish from the map? The only answer he got was the wind over the field and the cries from the villagers.
曾经装着25年前原野瘟疫解药的玻璃瓶，如今已经空空如也，瓶身布满了青苔与裂痕。据: The glass bottle that once contained the plague antidote 25 years ago is now empty. The bottle is covered by moss and cracks. Allegedly one mornint, a piece of note appeared by the god statue in the village. There was only one line, "Drink it and the plague will be over." The elder volunteered to take the antidote first and verified its effect. Then all the infected villagers took it. The plague was under control within a week. Up to this day, no one knows who placed the bottle of potion. It is called the God's Mercy by the villagers.
看起来像是某种机器的一部分，由于年代久远，表面早已锈迹斑斑，但是依稀可以辨识出雷: It appears to be part of some machine. Although rusty over the years, the logo of Rekenber Corporation can still be seen. A massive machine is said to have been standing on the Einbroch Field 25 years ago, giving off black smoke day and night. Several days after the plague outbreak, someone claimed seeing a figure wearing the Rekenber Corporation uniform wandering by the machine. After, that machine stopped functioning. The company sent people to fix it several times but couldn't get the job done. In the end, they had to announce that they had abandoned it. There was no plague on the field during the 25 years after the machine's breakdown.
记载着雷根贝勒公司某个实验的机密文件，已经被某人毁坏到无法读取其中的内容。原野实: Classified document about some experiment of Rekenber Corporation. It has been damaged thus its content can't be accessed. The gas released by the field experiment machine has long been proved causing human body fester plague by experiments. But I didn't know it would be this bad... The company and the parliment have blocked the news about the antidote! Are they doing a human object experiement on this entire village? I must do something for those innocent people. After all, I'm one of the guilty men responsible for this disaster. I must take my responsibility though it might not be enough to atone for my sin. Sorry, my baby girl. Father has chosen the wrong path from the beginning. No time to waste. I must set out now. This classified document about the machine and the experiment can't be left for the company.
波利式样的粉色发卡，是20多年前流行的旧款。和往常一样，小女孩靠在窗边托着红扑扑: Pink hairpin with the pattern of Poring. It used to be very popular 20 years ago. Like usual, the little girl is standing by the window with her chin in her hands, her eyes gazing at the crowded Yuno street. She's waiting for her busy father to return and give her a hug. Knock, knock! A sudden knock at the door made her excited. She ran towards it. Father! Her childish call was responded by two tall strangers' question, "Is Mr. Ian Green home?" Their cool voice confused the little girl. "My father is not back yet. How may I help you?" "Your father will not come back again." One of the strangers announced coldly. Tears ran down the little girl's face. "Liar!" "My father promised he would come back to celebrate my birthday today!" This pink hairpin is a present from him! The strangers pushed the girl away and began searching the room. The little girl's cries vanished in the clouds above the Sky City.
25年前，艾因布洛克的某个村庄突然爆发了一场致命瘟疫。与此同时，雷根贝勒公司的执: 25 years ago, a deadly plague broke out in a village in Einbroch. At the same time, Ian Green the Executive Director of Rekenber Corporation vanished along with a classified document. To everyone's surprise, a bottle of antidote and a mysterious note emerged by the god statue in the village out of nowhere. The antidote got the plague under control quickly and the machine that was believed to be the pollution source was announced permanently damaged by Rekenber Corporation. As to the disappeared Secretary Ian, some said he escaped to a foreign country with the secret file full of proof of his guilt; while others said he died in the forest due to plague. Reap what he sows. No matter what the truth really is, the wound of the field is still healing. President Karl has given the government of June's top priority to treating the polluted field since he took the office.
这把铁镐是矿工欧尼斯特的物件，一直以来镐子都是他挖矿的唯一工具。挖矿是一件很辛苦: This pickaxe belongs to the miner Honest. It has been his only mining tool all this time. Mining is a tough job. The extreme high temperature inside the Lava Cave is a torture. However, Honest never complained. He very much enjoyed his time with this ores. Every day he would get to work with his iron pickaxe. As far as he knew, the cave was a treasury, full of high quality ores, featuring wonderful landforms and the terrifying Firelord Kaho. He felt the place with his own hands and feet every day. He knew every corner of this area and the structure of this cave through years of observation. He could hear the cave breathing, through which he could tell where the ores were and where hid the danger. He had no idea when this started but the breathing sound became heavier and heavier day by day. He could tell the pain. What is it? Why are you suffering so much? He reached out his hand to touch the stone wall but it all went black. He couldn't remember anything after.
在一群青壮的矿工之中，有一个小小的身影，他推着只比他矮一个头的推车，将矿石运到洞: Among the group of young and able miners, there was one small figure pushing a cart that was only one head shorter than himself to transport ores outside. The boy called Lanier was from a village nearby. His mother was ill most of the time and his father alone supported the entire family. An accident happened to his father in the mine. At a very young age, he came to his father's mine for a job to support the family. Everybody knew about Lanier's situation. He wasn't tall or strong enough to mine ores. The chief gave him a cart. The boy's small face was tight, his teeth clenched and sweat coming down his forehead. He pushed the cart step by step. When he finally reached the cave entrance, the bright light forced him to narrow his eyes. He took a deep breath and the air tasted metal. The chief waved at him so he stopped the cart aside and wiped his hands on his clothes. He walked back and received a bag of coins. Big pieces of rocks began to fall from the ceiling and Lanier was knocked out. His hands grabbed tight on the bag of coins.
瓦尔特是个很胆小的人，但是他仍然干了自己明知十分危险的职业，这是因为这里独一无二: Walter was a very cowardly man but he was doing a very dangerous job because the money he could make here was way better thanks to the unique flame ore. Walter cared dearly about all the safety issues. He would never take off his safety helmet despite the brutally high temperature inside the cave. His hair was thinning - another reason for him to keep the helmet on. All miners there worshipped Firelord Kaho as their guardian god because all the wealth there was his creation. However, Walter had a different opinion on this. He deemed Kaho as a horrible fire monster and a terrifying figure can't be God. Walter dug carefully every day. Other miners didn't like his over caution and decided to remove his Safety Helmet when his guard was low. The miners laughed at his bald head. Walter had a sudden uneasy feeling. He wanted to take his hat back. At the same time, the cave began to shake violently. Walter felt a pain at the crown of his head and then lost consciousness.
火焰矿石是由熔岩洞窟里的矿石吸收了炎之领主卡浩散发出来的火焰力量，在高温的环境下: The Flame Ore was a unique ore formed in a very high temperature in the Lava Cave that had absorbed Firelord Kaho's flame power. Due to the harsh working condition in the mine and the popularity of the ore among the mages, its price went very high. The miners in the Lava Cave felt very grateful towards the Firelord for creating this ore. Thanks to this, they were able to provide for their family a much better life. These miners worshipped Kaho as their guardian god and prayed for his protection. Kaho didn't care what the humans were doing. He felt kind of good that he was able to help them out. However, slowly Kaho felt something was wrong. Based on the information sent back from the Lava Cave by the flame, the cave had been severely damaged. Kaho found out that the humans' overexploitation had caused changes to the cave's base veins. He warned the humans by all means but they simply ignored. Until one day, a massive earthquake happened in the cave. Humans suffered a heavy toll of lives and the cave's base veins deformed seriously. Kaho was furious, blaming the Humans' greed and lack of appreciation for the damage and pollution of the cave's environment. Kaho kicked all the miners out of the cave. From then on, there was no more produce of the Flame Ore. Those already in the market became extremely precious treasures.
森林的至宝，只有哥布林国王才会制作，是需要融合森林的四大宝物——森之虹、森之音、: The ultimate treasure of the forest that only the Goblin King could make. The gem required the power of the forest four treasures, Forest Rainbow, Forest Tune, Forest Tear, and Forest Flower, to be combined. Bearing the power of the forest, it would only bless the one that had earned the Goblin King's approval.
森林四大宝物之一，是只有来自森林里的水在森林气息的包围下，才能产生的独特彩虹，通: One of the Forest Four Treasures, a special rainbow that can only be formed with the forest water in the forest air. It can transform into food upon prayers. Full of the power of the forest, edible, and very sweet, it is one of the favorite snacks for young Goblins.
森林的四大宝物之一，是森林中的魔物用树叶吹出的音乐，通过神奇的木片可以实体化。将: One of the Forest Four Treasures, the music is performed by forest monsters with leaves. It is objectivized into a magical wood slice. Place the Forest Tune by your ear and you'll hear this beautiful melody. It is believed that the Forest Tune can improve sleeping quality if placed by the pillow. It also grants a chance to meet the performers in your dream.
森林的四大宝物之一，其本身是吸收着森林气息自然产生的露珠，当然极少的露珠才能成为: One of the Forest Four Treasures, it was originally a dew formed naturally by absorbing the forest air. Of course only very little dew could become the Forest Tear. The Forest Tear is hard to preserve. It could only be kept in a vessel made of wood from this forest. Be very careful after acquiring this treasure.
森林的四大宝物之一，是由森林精灵赋予森林中的野花力量，从而造就的宝物。森林精灵特: One of the Forest Four Treasures, it was created from the wild flower power granted by the forest elf. The Forest Elf loved to consume honey. It is believed that if a honey is tasty enough, she would reveal herself. In general the Forest Elf was kind to the Humans. However, if you began to destroy the forest, she could be terrifying.
海底皇室世代相传的宝物，若是海底族群拥有它便可以获得永生，若是人类拥有它便可以受: A treasure that has been passed down for generations in the ocean royal family. It grants immortality to the ocean creatures and protection and shelter to the humans.
在四海至宝之中象征坚忍，拥有天然的防护能力，可抵御大部分的魔法和冲击，但惧怕海盐: One of the Four Ocean Ultimate Treasures that represents perseverance. With natural protective power, it can resist most magic and attacks. However, it is afraid of sea salt.
在四海至宝之中象征璀璨，能永恒不灭地发散光芒，无论多么黑暗的地方，都能被它照亮。: One of the Four Ocean Ultimate Treasures that represent brilliance. It gives off an everlasting glow which could illuminate even the darkest place.
在四海至宝之中象征透彻，能驱散大海深处的污浊，若长久随身携带，携带者的内心也会逐: One of the Four Ocean Ultimate Treasures that represents transparency. It can disperse the dirt at the depths of the sea. Carry it for a prolonged period and the wearer's heart will be purified slowly.
在四海至宝之中象征沉稳，能平息大海暴乱的洋流，鳞片上的图腾，蕴含着千年来所有海洋: One of the Four Ocean Ultimate Treasures that represents steadiness. It can pacify the chaotic ocean currents. The totem on the scale bears the mystery of all the ocean spells over thousands of years.
一个软绵绵的毛线球，手感非常的舒服！作为猫咪们的最爱之一，要是把它带回猫咪之家，: A soft ball of yarn with a very comfortable touch. A favorite of cats. If you bring this back to the Kitty House, those adorable meows will be back, right? After gathering enough fluff, Aunt Merry helped the adventure weave a yarn ball exclusively for the Kitty House. These little cats are really loved by the residents by the south gate.
由普隆德拉南门的渔夫比尔森制作的小鱼干，散发出香喷喷的气味，深受猫咪们的喜爱。原: Dried fish made by the fisherman Bilson at the Prontera South Gate. Its fragrant smell is loved by cats. The coast outside the south gate used to be abundant with fish but all of a sudden fishermen could no longer catch anything. The adventurer promised to help Bilson find out the truth. It was because of a gluttony sea monster. After defeating the sea monster, fish returned to the south gate. Bilson promised to supply dried fish for the Killy House. One wish on the public board is completed. Would some cats come back to the Kitty House?
不知道是谁制作的发条玩具老鼠，只要拧上发条，就会吱吱吱的快速移动。原本作为猫咪之: A spring rat toy made by someone unknown. Tighten the spring and it will move fast with a squeak. It used to be the favorite toy in the Kitty House but the little boy Tommy took it and kept it for himself. Tommy said he would return the spring squeak if the adventurer would play hide and seek with him. Tommy had an accident during the hide and seek. After freeing him from the thorns, the naughty yet lonely Tommy finally smiled.
来自猫咪们友情的证明，“谢谢你帮助猫咪之家的重建工作！喵！”在完成了猫咪之家所有: A proof of cats' friendship. "Thank you for helping rebuilt the Kitty House! Meow!" After completing all the quests of the Kitty House, these adorable cats are finally willing to return. The Kitty House has regained its liveliness. When you are tired from your adventurers, come back to check on these active kitties.
此份档案永不备份，永久封藏。犯人贝茨克里夫医生杀害低语山庄主人，并使其女过度惊吓: This file will never be copied and is sealed for every. Doctor Batescliffe is guilty of murdering the master of the Whisper Villa and responsible for his daughter's death of excessive startle. He performed some foreign evil magic to infuse a monster into her body, creating a double-faced witch who would become a bloodthirsty beast at night. At night, the doctor would lock the witch in the cellar and lure some physically able man to visit. These men were killed and they became food to strengthen the witch's body. This angered Hella the Goddess of Death. She personally killed the witch and Dr. Batescliffe, and burnt down the Whispering Manor. Recently, there were rumors that the destroyed manor reappeared in Skellington.
救命，谁来救救我。这座低语山庄里到处都是魔物!医生夫人背后的红色缎带下还有另一张: Help! Anybody, please help. This Whisper Villa is full of monsters! Under the red ribbon at the back of the doctor's wife is another woman's face! I saw with my own eyes the doctor feed the second face raw meat. He used other people's skin to stitch up his wife's putrid wound! I hope someone could discover this letter. I'm afraid the doctor has already sensed my uneasiness. If anyone finds this letter, please expose this hell villa's secret to public!
作为猎人协会著名的魔物猎手，格曼对狩猎有着与生俱来的直觉，当他听到某种满足的嚎叫: A reputed monster hunter in the Hunter's Guild, Germann was born with a great intuition about hunting. Whenever he hears a satisfied roar, a bad feeling develops in his heart. He followed the footprints all the way to the wooden cabin. The scene made this experienced hunter vomit. In awful disorder, the wolf grandma was sleeping on the bed soaked in blood, completely content. Germann pointed his gun at this beast without hesitation. However, to his surprise, the monster leaped up and grabbed the barrel. It took Germann's hunting rifle with his belly sticking out and vanished into the dark forest in a flurry. Germann's last memory about that beast was something wiggling oddly in its huge belly...
守财奴巴哈洛金库的钥匙，他曾向精灵神灯许愿，用黄金填满他的金库，但他的花销也变得: A key to Baharo the miser's treasury. He once made a wish to the Elf Lamp that he wanted his treasury to be filled with gold. However, his spending grew bigger and bigger. Soon, all the gold was gone. Blinded by his greed, Baharo again begged for the lamp spirit's help. The spirit cast a curse of greed and transformed him into a black fox. Despite all that had happened, he continued puesuing money madly. The real curse is our greed, don't you agree?
用古老的龙族骸骨雕琢而成的笛子，吹奏出的乐曲被古老的魔法加持。在梦罗克，曾有一位: A flute carved out of an ancient dragon remains. The melody performed by this is blessed by an ancient spell. In Morroc, there was once a poor bard secretly in love with his partner, the gorgeous dancer Mara. For Mara, he found the spirit lamp that was believed to be able to fulfill any wish. Madly in love with Mara, the bard wished Mara's happiness. The wish was fulfilled. Mara and a wealthy man named Porto from Morroc lived a happy life together. The bard became a lone spirit who sealed his longing in this ancient magic lamp. Love is about two people. The so-called happiness is way more complicated and brutal than poems and fairy tales.
镶嵌了蓝色宝石的扳指，戴上它后，触碰的一切都会变作黄金。这枚带着诅咒的扳指无法被: A thumb ring inlaid with a sapphire. Wear it and everything you touches will turn into gold. This cursed thumb ring can't be removed by the wearer himself. Only those who still have the beginner's mind could remove the curse. In Morroc, there was a man named Porto who wished for endless wealth to the spirit lamp. The spirit gave him this thumb ring. He put it on and everything he touched became gold! He became a wealthy man in Morroc but he couldn't touch anyone for the rest of his life. However gold he had, he couldn't get a warm hug!
曾经有一位梦罗克出身的年轻水手，在一次航行中，恋上了搁浅的人鱼，为了与人鱼恋人长: A young sailor from Morroc fell in love with a strand mermaid on one sail. To stay together with his mermaid lover, he found the lamp spirit and made a wish for a sea water oasis in the Morroc Desert. The sailor took his bride back to Morroc with wild joy and together they had a daughter. However, good things never lasted. The sailor 's family came at their door and took away the couple who had broken rules. The young hybrid was named Maiara. Her legs would transform into the mermaid's tails once they touched water. Maiara lived an isolated life in the oasis with distrust in humans... Fairy tales are just fairy tales. Not every story has a happy ending.
梦罗克传说中的古老神灯，里面寄宿的神灯精灵，可以满足使用者的一个愿望。讲述故事的: An ancient lamp in Morroc legends with a spirit dwelling inside. It will grant one wish to the user. The story teller Harkrudy was once a Minstrel in Morroc. Suffering an uncurable disease, he sought help from the lamp spirit to extend his life. Harkrudy's only wish was to continue telling stories to children. The lamp spirit granted his wish at the cost of Harkrudy's soul being chained to this land forever, telling stories until the end of time... He watched the children grow up with his stories, witnessed people made dangerous wishes to the lamp spirit to satisfy their own desire, and heard the laughter and cries of Morroc. Harkrudy used to think that nothing could change. But children could grow up and leave, and stories could be forgotten. Only the Morroc Desert screams just like before, just like the magic lamp spirit's laughter, sneering at humanities narrow vision.
人面样式的礼葬瓮，里面存放了法老王的肝脏，作为复活仪式的一部分被存放在金字塔中。: Ritual burial urn in the form of a human face. It stories the Pharaoh of Pharaohs's liver and is kept in the Pyramid as part of the Resurrection Ceremony. The Pharaoh of Pharaohs gave his words to the Doppelganger Priest that if he would help with his resurrection ceremony, the Doppelganger Priest would be given the right to revive. However, the Pharaoh of Pharaohs lied and the Doppelganger Priest's soul was trapped in the Human Face Ritual Burial Urn. Hundreds of years had passed but the trapped soul was still the same, wicked and crafty, attempting to revive through sacrifice offerings. How much evil is hidden in human nature?
胡狼头样式的礼葬瓮，里面存放了法老王的胃脏，作为复活仪式的一部分被存放在金字塔中: Ritual burial urn in the form of a Coyote head. It stories the Pharaoh of Pharaohs's stomach and is kept in the Pyramid as part of the Resurrection Ceremony. The Doppelganger Priest cast a curse on Prince Anubis for objecting his father and turned him into a bloodthirsty monster with a coyote head, wandering by the coyote ritual burial urn. Compared to monsters, sometimes humans' desire is more terrifying.
猿猴头样式的礼葬瓮，里面存放了法老王的肺脏，作为复活仪式的一部分被存放在金字塔中: Ritual burial urn in the form of an ape head. It stories the Pharaoh of Pharaohs's lung and is kept in the Pyramid as part of the Resurrection Ceremony. The Doppelganger priest had a pet Yoyo for watching this relic. However, when it came to the Yoyos, nothing couldn't be solved with a Tropical Banana. Two would definitely be enough.
鹰头式样的礼葬瓮，里面存放了法老王的肠子，作为复活仪式的一部分被存放在金字塔中。: Ritual burial urn in the form of a falcon head. It stories the Pharaoh of Pharaohs's intestine and is kept in the Pyramid as part of the Resurrection Ceremony. The Pharaoh of Pharaohs cast an evil spell to transform his royal guards into a wicked dead legion to protect this instrument. After hundreds of years, their loyal to the Pharaoh of Pharaohs never changed because of their enthusiasm or the curse.
曾经是法老王后伊西斯塔的护声符，为了死而复生而癫狂的法老王亲手杀害了想要阻止他的: Once a talisman of the Pharaoh of Pharaohs's Queen Isista. The Pharaoh of Pharaohs lost his mind for coming back to life after death and killed his queen with his own hands. To his surprise, the Reborn Cross granted her a second life but in the form of half-human half-snake monster. She could never leave the pyramid. This holy item of unknown origin is believed to be related to the god realm.
得到了永生就能得到一切吗？每个人都有自己的答案，俄赛里斯为了永恒的生命，牺牲了自: Could immortality bring everything? Everyone has his own answer. Osiris sacrificed his love, children, and heart for an everlasting life. At last, his wish became his chains. The immortal, undead Osiris lost his rights of being a human and continued on as a monster. Only he knew if his tear was out of unwillingness for the punishment from the Goddess of Death or guilt for his sins.
虽然名字叫做奶油，其实是用香蕉做成的牛奶水果酱，不知溜溜猴用了什么办法，让这奶香: Despite its name, it's actually a milky fruit jam made with bananas. It's not known how Yoyo combined banana and milk together so perfectly. A rare superb dessert ingredient. Flies at the west gate has always been the No. 1 threat to bananas. Killing flies is the best way to become closer with Yoyo.
使用普隆德拉西门的清晨露珠制作出的果酱，因为露珠很快就会在晨曦中蒸发，所以想要收: Jam made with the morning dew from the Prontera West Gate. Dew evaporate quickly under the rising sun. It's very difficult to collect dew to make this jam. 4 dew fairies are said to be collecting dew at the west gate. Pass their test to get their precious jam.
在普隆德拉西门从天而降的神奇酥饼，由于长得很像云朵，被取名为云朵酥，一口咬下去，: Miraculous pastry fallen from heaven near the Prontera West Gate. It is named the Cloud Crisp after its resemblance to the clouds. Take a bite and you'll feel how fluffy and refreshing it is. The sweet taste will linger in your mouth. Jehel the clouding chaser who discovered the Cloud Crisp is a secret admirer of Oscar Wilde the West Gate Agent of the Midgarts Geographic. But he has no courage to confess his love. Young love is like the clouds, appearing close but impossible to reach.

可以召唤出魔王梦罗克的神奇玩具，没有人知道魔王梦罗克是怎么被塞进这个小玩具里的。: Magical toy that can summon the devil lord Morroc. No one knows how the devil lord Morroc was stuffed into this little toy.

In times of rainstorm or drought, an entire family might suffer a whole year of famine. In the long snow season, going hunting would be taking a bet on one's life. After Uller taught humans hunting methods, delicious meat began to appear on humans' dining table often. (As time passed by, the effect seemed weakening)
梦罗克地区的秘制烤肉！使用后1小时内，野外击杀魔物获得的Base经验和Job经验: Roasted meat with secret spices from the Morroc Region! Gain double Base and Job Exp from killing monsters in the field within 1 hour after use! (Death and non-battle states consume Buff time. Buff time freezes when offline)

一、副本规则\n1.参赛规则\n比赛为6V6组队对抗模式，参赛成员需在90级以上:
1) Rules
1.Participation Rules
The competition is a 6V6 team battle mode, participants must be Lv.90 or above. The team needs 6 members to join. 
2.Victory
*The teams fight for resources in the map, when a team reaches 4000 points it will awarded the victory.
*The fight lasts for 10 minutes.
*If after the 10 minutes, both teams haven't reached 4000 points yet, the team with the highest score wins. 
3.Elemental Ball
*In the 4 corners of the dungeon, 30s after the start it will spawn 4 Elemental Balls: Earth, Fire, Water, Wind conquering the Elemental Ball will give points every 2s
*Each player can only hold 1 ball, when 1-4 members are holding EBs, it will gain 10, 20, 25, 30 points every 2s.
*When holding the EB, the player will receive a debuff. Each debuff will increase the damage received by the holder by 5%, the longer the player hold the EB, the higher debuff stacks he will get
*Holding EBs will make players lose control, holders cannot enter Stealth or Speed Up states and will have a CD on skills.
*Holding 2 EBs will activate a magic effect, weakening enemy players, the effects are: 
Fire+Water: [Elemental Barrier] reduce enemies' attack and cast range by 40%, EB holders will be reduced by 60%.
Fire+Earth: [Magma Road] Enemy Holders will lose a percent of HP for moving, higher MS will result in faster HP loss.
Fire+Wind: [Soul Shackles] when another player approaches, it will receive a continuous slow down effect.
Water+Earth: [Mana Burn]Enemies SP use increased by＋200%, and will lose 1% of the MAX SP every second.
Water+Wind: [Mana Leak] Cause abnormal effects to enemy Holders, "Water": cause allies within 5m to be silenced,  "Earth" : cause allies within 5m to be turned into stone, "Wind" : cause allies within 5m to be snared,  "Fire" : cause allies within 5m to receive burning effect.
Wind+Earth: [Misty Storm]Causes enemies to enter a 1.5 unavoidable darkness state every 5 seconds, enemy Holders will be in a permanent darkness state.
*Combining Elements have a 15s CD time, during this time the Elemental Ball changes will not change the effect.
*If a team acquire more than 2 EBs, the additional effects will be removed, this time the enemy team can go to the Dungeon Guard NPC to cancel the effect.
*When a Holder is defeated, the EB will be dropped, the EB combo effect will also be removed, the EB will return to its original position in the map.
4.Buff EB
*1 min after the start, there will be a Buff EB in the center of the map, after that every 30s there will be a new Buff EB, players can fight for it and obtain 150 points with a random buff
*Buff types: 
[Anti-Stealth]All allies can detect invisible units for 10s
[Damage Buff]The player that has the buff causes 50% more damage to Holders for 10s
[Speed Up] the holder can exceed the maximum MS limit and receives a 200% MS buff for10s. 
5.Slay 
When you slay an opponent, the team will get 20 points.
2) Matchmaking Rules
1.The ladder is a seasonal ranked system and each season will last 45 days.
2.The ranks are as it follows (from bottom to top) Warrior, Elite, Master, and Legend.
3.Each victory will award Honor Proof and Battle Coins that can be used to exchange for Headwears and previous 3rd Class Mounts.
4.Each Elo will Unlock the related Pets, and Accessory rewards
5. When the season ends, The top 30/60/120 players from the Legend group will be awarded with an exclusive mount.

[b]War of Crystal Rules:[/b]
1) GVG final battle starts at 21:35:00 and ends at 22:00:00.
2)Any guild that manages to defend City No.1 perfectly by 21:25:00 during Sunday’s GVG is qualified and will go to GVG final battle map at 21:32:00.

[b]Battleground rules[/b]

*Factions
4 guilds compete with each other in a free-for-all during GVG final battle.

*Winning conditions
1) The guild that manages to collect 5 [Crystal Resources] wins.
2) If no guild is able to collect 5 [Crystal Resources], than the guild with the most crystals collected wins.

*Crystal Resource
1) There are 5 Crystal Resource deposits on the battlefield for guilds to compete over.
[Central Core]: Becomes available for capture 3 minutes after the battle starts. Grants 2 crystal to the guild that captures it. But these crystals will be lost if the core is lost.
[Eastern Crystal Tower] [Western Crystal Tower]: Becomes available for capture 3 minutes after the battle starts. Grants 1 crystal to the guild that captures it. But it will be lost if the tower is lost.
[Green Crystal] [Blue Crystal] [Red Crystal] [Purple Crystal]: Worth 1 crystal when intact. Cannot be repaired if destoryed by another guild.
2) If the gorgeous of a guild is destoryed, for a time all member of that guild will be forced to respawn at the guild platform when they fall in battle.

*How to capture: The guild with most players in the capture circle will continuously gain capture points. The area will be captured by this guild when capture progress bar in full.

*Crystal shard resource
1)One MVP will be spawned on the upper/lower platform every 3 minutes. Player who delivers the killing blow will earn 1 [Crystal Shard Resource] for their guild.
2) Every 4 crystal shards collected will be converted into a [Crystal Resource] that cannot be taken.

啊……希芙大人说，她可以在你修葺房屋的时候提供便利，但需要你的帮助。: Ah... Sif says she can help make it easier for you when you need to repair your house, but she needs your help.
我因为和希芙大人的契约，没办法离开普隆德拉。维持她灵体的事情就必须拜托你了……: I can't leave Prontera because of my contract with Sif. You have to help keep her body alive...
除了修建灵基，我们还需要一些材料来制作灵魂药水。而有的材料在普隆德拉是买不到的，: In addition to building a spiritual foundation, we also need some materials to make soul potions. Some materials are not available in Prontera, so you'll have to go and find them.
跟着希芙大人的指引，相信一切都会很顺利的。: As long as we follow Sif's instruction, everything should go smoothly.
据说在梦罗克附近，有一种叫[c][ffff00]摩卡[-][/c]的生物。: They say that a kind of monster called the [c][ffff00]Muka[-][/c] can be found near Morroc.
它们的汁液吸收了太阳的能量，可以稳定灵体的温度。: Their bodily juices absorb the energy of the sun and stabilize the temperature of their bodies.
可以拜托你收集[c][ffff00]50份摩卡汁液[-][/c]吗？: Could you help me to gather [c][ffff00]50 Muka Juice[-][/c]?
你把摩卡汁液带回来了吗？: Have you brought the Muka Juice?
多谢你！这是一点心意，请收下！: Thank you so much! Here's a little gift. Please accept it!
冒险者，你有没有听说过[c][ffff00]长老树精[-][/c]？: Adventurer, have you heard of [c][ffff00]Elder Willows[-][/c]?
据我了解，它们的枝叶吸收了大地的灵气，可以延缓希芙大人的消散。: I've heard that their branches and leaves absorb the spirit of the earth... Maybe they can delay the disappearance of Sif's body.
谢谢~请收下这份礼物！: Thank you. Please accept this gift!
在斐扬附近据说飘荡着许多[c][ffff00]鬼火[-][/c]……: You may have heard of the [c][ffff00]Horong[-][/c] floating around Payon...
鬼火是由灵魂的气息所化，虽然未必纯净，但对希芙大人来说也至关重要。: Horong are formed of spiritual auras... Although they're not necessarily pure, they may prove to be essential for preserving Sif's body.
能拜托你去它们身上收集50个灵魂碎片吗？: Could you please gather 50 Soul Shards from them?
你回来了，灵魂碎片收集好了吗？: You're back! Did you get the Soul Shards?
我就知道你能做到！给，这是礼物~: I knew you could do it! Here. Please accept this gift!
冒险者，你知道妙勒尼山脉的[c][ffff00]彩蝶精灵[-][/c]吗？: Adventurer, do you know of the [c][ffff00]Menblatt[-][/c] of the Mjolnir Mountains?
他们会掉落一种闪光的磷粉，里面蕴含着自然的灵气。这对消耗很快的灵体来说，是最好的: They will drop a kind of shiny phosphorus powder containing the essence of nature. This is the best way to replenish a fast-fading soul.
希望可以有50份，能拜托你吗~: 50 should be enough. I'm counting on you!
你把磷粉带来了吗？: Did you bring the Phosphorus Powder?
非常感谢。拿好啦，这是希芙大人给你的奖励哦！: Thanks a million, adventurer. Take this. It's a reward from Sif.
等你的资金准备好，我们就可以开始建造小屋啦。: Once you have the money, we can start building the cottage.
我这有几件小事想要拜托你，不知道你有没有兴趣？作为报酬希芙大人会给你[c][ff: There are a few small things I want to ask you... I wonder if you could help me out? Sif will give you some [c][ffff00]Reward Vouchers[-][/c] in exchange.
悄悄告诉你，那个券的本质，其实是她用女神的职权更改了人类货币的规则……: The secret behind these vouchers is... Sif changed the rules of human currency using her divine power...
[c][ffff00]（小声）每一张奖励券都可以抵扣100000zeny哦！！[: [c][ffff00](Whispering) Each Reward Voucher will deduct 100,000 zeny from the final price![-][/c]
你的券越多，可以抵扣的货币也越多啦~: The more vouchers you have, the more money you can deduct!
当然，你也可以选择不用奖励券，直接支付[c][ffff00]1000000zen: Of course, you can also select Reward Vouchers you won't use and exchange them for [c][ffff00]1,000,000 zeny directly[-][/c]!
怎么样，你考虑好了吗~怎么支付这[c][ffff00]1000000zeny[-: So, what do you think? How are you gong to pay this [c][ffff00]1,000,000 zeny[-][/c]?
{不用券！,3},{要用券！,4},{暂时不支付,2}: {I won't use vouchers,3},{I'll use the vouchers,4},{I'm not going to pay right now,2}
哎呀，你的钱不够呢……: Oh... You don't have enough money...
没想到啊！这就是大人们说的有钱任性吗……: I didn't expect this to happen! Is this what they call being rich and reckless?
抱歉，你没有奖励券哦~: Sorry, you don't have any Reward Vouchers!
很遗憾，即使是用了券，你的钱依然不够呢……: Unfortunately, even with the vouchers, you still don't have enough money.
怎么样，女神的奖券是不是非常有用！: Well, were the Goddess's vouchers of any use?
好啦，现在一切就绪。你很快就可以拥有自己的小屋啦！希芙大人也会回来！: Alright! We're all set! You'll soon have your very own cottage! Sif's back, too!
没关系，等你考虑好了随时可以找我。: No problem, just call me whenever you're ready!
金字塔的附近，是不是有一种叫[c][ffff00]木乃伊[-][/c]的东西？: Isn't there some kind of [c][ffff00] Mummy[-][/c] near the pyramid...?
木乃伊是把生者的灵气用魔法封印起来，每尊身上都会有一个灵气核心。也许，它们会对灵: A mummy is the spirit of a living person, sealed with magic. Every one of us has this Aura Core inside. Maybe they'll also be helpful for preserving Sif's soul...?
你把核心带回来了吗？: Have you brought the Mummy Cores?
谢谢，真是可靠呢！这是给你的小礼物~: Thank you! You're so reliable! Here is your reward.
愚蠢的两脚兽离我远点，咩。: Stay away from me, you freakin' humans!
原野上的事没人比我更了解~: Nobody knows more about the wilderness than I do!
我不想再睡去了……: I...I don't want to sleep anymore...
哔哔哔！叽叽叽！: Beep! Beep! Beep! Chirp! Chirp! Chirp!
哈克永远为了职业坐骑团战斗！: Huck will always fight on for the Job Mount Regiment!
佩卡誓死效忠狐族！: Peka pledges loyalty to the fox clan
佩娜誓死效忠狐族！: Pella pledges loyalty to the fox clan
我吉尔斯可是神射手团最优秀的射手: I'm Jillis, the best sniper you'll ever meet!
我们斑鬣一族是大陆上最团结的种族: The Crocuta are the most united race on the continent.
嗯哼，我在这个时候找你，当然是……: Hmm... I was just looking for you, because...
当然是为了找你喝庆功酒啦！你不是刚刚转职成功吗，不跟我去喝两杯？: Because we have some serious drinking to do! Didn't you just have a successful job transfer? Why don't you come and have a couple of drinks with me?
咳咳咳……竟然毫不留情的拒绝了，真是令人伤心的成长。: *cough, cough, cough* Refusing outright... what an upsetting habit you've developed.
好啦，不喝就不喝吧。: Alright... If you're not drinking, that's the end of that, then.
你看看你，当时刚见面还是个小小的初心者，现在已经成了一名了不起的冒险者了！: Look at you, when I first met you, you were just a little Novice. Now you're a great adventurer!
嗯哼，言归正传。: All right, let's get down to business.
那当然！冒险者同盟跟我说了，你帮了他们很多忙。: Well, of course! The Adventurers League told me that you've done a lot for them.
太谦虚啦。为了祝贺你转职成功，他们委托我给你提供最棒的坐骑！: You're too modest. To congratulate you on your successful transfer, they've commissioned me to provide you with the best mount possible!
当然是真的，我卡迪尔从不说谎。: Of course it's true! Cartier never lies!
为了挑选适合你的坐骑，我三天三夜没睡好了。: I've been up for three days and nights trying to choose the right mount for you.
终于……我找到了最佳选择！: At last, I found the perfect choice!
你看！这是它的画像！: Take a look! Is this its portrait?
看这忽闪忽闪的迷人大眼睛！: Look at these big mesmerizing eyes!
正乃米德加尔特最灵巧可爱的动物——羊驼是也！！: It's the most nimble and adorable creature in all of Midgarts - the Alpaca!
怎么样，惊不惊喜？: So, what do you think? Surprised?
哎呀，你说你这孩子，干嘛一脸嫌弃嘛。羊驼其实很厉害的！: Hey, why do you look so disappointed? Alpacas are really awesome!
能跑能跳不说，放眼望去，谁的坐骑有它可爱！: Not only can they can run and jump, there's no cuter mount on the continent!
总之，它一定最适合你了！: In short, it's absolutely the best fit for you!
虽然我已经与它们沟通过，不过还需要你亲自去见见羊驼。: Although I've already spoken with them, I still need you to meet the Alpaca in person.
羊驼们生活在普隆德拉的北部，数量十分稀少。: Alpacas live in the northern part of Prontera and are quite scarce in number.
你先去找那里的魔物学者扎克雷，他会帮助你的。: Go and find Monster Scholar Jacquerie, and he'll help you out.
哎呀，是冒险者啊。找我有什么事吗？: Ah, an adventurer. Is there something you need from me?
哈哈哈，原来是要找羊驼当坐骑啊。: Ha-ha-ha! So this is about the Alpaca mount?
唉，那他给你找了个大麻烦。: Well, it seems he's gotten you into a spot of trouble.
羊驼可没有那么容易接受陌生人。: Alpacas are not so good with strangers.
办法有是有……不过得花点时间。: There is a way... But it will take some time.
羊驼这种生物处于隐居状态，如果想寻找它们的踪迹，必须要一种特殊香草制成的粉末才行: Alpacas live in seclusion. If you want to find them, you'll need a powder made of a special kind of Vanilla.
嗅嗅草，在小河的附近应该有。: Sniff Grass... There should be some by the small river.
好，快去采一些回来吧。: Alright, now go get some and come right back.
没错没错，就是这种香草！: Yes, that's it! That's the Vanilla!
稍等，我这就把它们制成粉末。: Wait a minute... I'll make it into powder.
你沿路洒下嗅嗅草的粉末，就会显示出羊驼的脚印了。: If you sprinkle Sniff Grass powder along the road, it will show the footprints of the Alpaca.
对了，别看羊驼看起来很可爱，其实对陌生人攻击性很强。: By the way, Alpacas may look cute, but they're very aggressive toward strangers.
螳螂的身上会掉落一种特殊结晶，羊驼不会攻击拥有这些结晶的人。: A special crystal is carried by the Mantis. The Alpaca will not attack those who possess this crystal.
嗯，早去早回。: Right. The sooner you go, the sooner you can return.
对对，就是这种结晶。: Yes, that's it! That's the crystal!
有了它，你就可以放心去找羊驼了。: With this, you'll have no problem finding an Alpaca.
忘了告诉你，我和一只叫毛毛的羊驼有点交情。: I forgot to tell you that I'm actually friends with an Alpaca named Maomao.
你如果跟它相遇，帮我带给它这颗糖吧。: If you see it along your way, please bring it this candy.
不知从哪里冒出了一群蝴蝶！: Where did all these butterflies come from?!
四谁打跑了我的小福蝶！！: Who's been picking on my butterflies?!
叫什么叫，是不是被我的英俊的脸蛋震慑了！: What's all the commotion about? Did my gorgeous face startle you?
等一等。你是哪里冒出来的？: Wait a moment... Where did you come from?
怎么又是你！！老追着我干嘛啦！！: It's you again! What are you chasing me for?!
你把小福蝶还给我！！: Give my little butterflies back to me!
让你走你不听，当我毛毛是吃素的吗！: Fine, if you won't listen to me... But just know this -- I'm no pushover!
唔，好像羊驼确实吃素……: Well, it seems Alpacas really are pushovers...
讨厌的两脚兽，干嘛叫我！: What do you want from me, you annoying human!
啊，你是小扎的朋友！咋不早说！: Oh, you're Jackie's friend? Why didn't you say so?!
哼，看在糖和小扎的面子上我不跟你计较了。: Hmph! I know a couple of decent humans, but I don't like the look of you.
啥，你说是卡迪尔那个小矮子让你来的？: What, mean that dwarf Cartier told you to come here?
想要羊驼当坐骑啊……也不是不行啦。: You want an Alpaca for a mount...? Hmm, not bad!
要知道，我们羊驼可是聪明伶俐机智优雅高贵迷人的生物！: You should know, we Alpacas are smart, witty, elegant, and charming creatures!
怎么会随随便便给人牵走呢！: How can you expect to just lead someone off so casually like that?
要想让我们当坐骑，必须实力上让人信服才行！: If you want to mount one of us, you'll need to show us your strength!
好，那你得通过我的两个考验！: So, you'll have to pass my two tests!
第一个嘛……我需要一些魔女星沙。: For the first test... I need some Witch Star Dust.
据说那玩意儿亮晶晶的，特别漂亮，用来装饰一定不错！: I hear they're shiny and gorgeous -- so they'd make for decorations!
也不用太多，你就弄……1000个给我吧！: I won't need too many... Just get me... 1,000 of them!
干嘛干嘛，大惊小怪。1000个很多吗？: What are you getting so excited about? Isn't 1,000 kind of... a lot?
收集完了再回来见我哦~: Just come back to me after collecting them, okay?
你把魔女星沙带来了吗？: Did you bring the Witch Star Dust?
嘿嘿，两脚兽你还要努力啊！: He-heh! You're a hard worker, human!
浑水摸鱼在毛毛这里是行不通的~: I won't have any human coming up here to take advantage of us so easily!
嗨呀，你还真弄来了。: Well, you actually gathered all that dust...
不错不错。那下面我宣布第二项考验——: Not bad. Now, let me tell you about the second test--
众所周知，羊驼们拥有其他生物难以匹敌的可爱容貌。: Alpacas are fames for their lovely features -- featured other creatures can't match!
但是遗憾的是，它们从来没办法近距离欣赏自己美丽的脸庞！！: Unfortunately, most Alpaca never get the chance to appreciate their own beautiful faces up close!
所以——请这位两脚兽带3个水晶镜子回来！救救羊驼，让它们照照镜子！: So, human, please bring back three Crystal Mirrors! Help the Alpacas see their faces!
干嘛用这种眼神看着我？: Why are you looking at me like that?
……好啦好啦，我知道水晶镜子很难弄到。: It's just... Getting a Crystal Mirror isn't easy.
不过还是那句话，如果简单的话就不是考验啦！: Again with the whining... If it were easy, it wouldn't be a test, now would it?
嘿嘿嘿，如果这次你能完成的话，我会送你个礼物哦~: But hey, if you finish this task, I'll give you a special gift!
你把水晶镜子带来了吗？: Did you bring the Crystal Mirror?
哼哼，我就知道你肯定做不到。: Hah! I knew you couldn't do it!
走开走开，两脚兽大骗子！: Get out of here, you two-legged swindler!
是我小瞧你了，两脚兽。看起来很蠢，没想到还挺能干嘛。: I underestimated you, human. Youi may look stupid, but... Well, that's why I thought you could do it.
当然准备好了！: Of course! It's right here, ready for you!
这只其貌不扬的两脚兽，通过了两项几乎不可能完成的考验！: This ugly little thing passed two almost impossible tests!
我觉得，我们羊驼以后可以帮他的忙！: I think we Alpacas can lend this human a hand in the future, eh?
现在，就让我们用歌声庆祝冒险者的胜利吧！: Now, let's celebrate this adventurer's triumph with some songs!
在这浩荡广阔的大地上，是谁最可爱！: Who's the cutest in the land?
嘟啦啦！即将跟着冒险者出发的羊驼！: La-la-la-la-la! Now we'll roam to fields afar, following this adventurer!
怎么样！喜不喜欢我的礼物！: How about that! Did you like the gift?
你用实力证明了自己，现在可以回去找卡迪尔啦！: You've really proved yourself! You can return to Cartier now!
到时候得好好对待你的羊驼哦！！: When the time comes, be sure to treat your Alpaca well!
你回来啦，怎么样了！: Welcome back! How did it go?
……你说一群羊驼给你唱歌？！: ...A herd of Alpaca sang you a song?!
真不愧是你啊，居然能抗住那么可怕的歌声。: You really do deserve a mount, having had to listen to that awful bleating!
看来它们已经认可你了，做的不错。: They seem to have accepted you into the flock... Good job!
现在就来挑一只你喜欢的羊驼吧！: Now it's time to pick out your favorite Alpaca.
愿主神保佑，我与赛依连永远在一起。: Please, by the grace of the gods, let Seyren and I be together forever.
[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]！没想到会在这里遇见: [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]! I didn't expect to meet you here.
我的老师，哈沃德，他已经失联很久了……: My master, Hayward... I haven't spoken to him in such a long time...
开始还能收到他的来信。但从三个月前，我们的通信就断了。: At first, he would still send me letters. But I haven't heard a thing from him in three months.
他走之前将一把还未完成的铁锤托付了给我，让我继续锻造。: Before he left, he entrusted me with an unfinished mace. He wanted me to continue forging it.
但这把铁锤……在锻造中出现了一些问题。: But this mace... There have been some serious problems forging it.
我有点担心，于是就调查了他来信的路径，找到了这里……: I was a little worried, so I followed the path his letters traveled and found myself here...
可是线索就在这里断了……: But this is where the trail ends...
那边怎么这么喧闹？发生了什么？: What is that awful sound? What happened?
这大嘴鸟有些眼熟……我们过去看看！: This Peco Peco seems familiar... Let's go and check it out!
是利力！它受伤了！快！帮帮它！: It's Lili! Leelee's hurt! Hurry! Please help Leelee!
它伤的很重，我来替它疗伤！: This is no minor wound... Allow me to heal it!
幸好我们赶来的及时，它应该没有大碍了。: Fortunately, we arrived just in time. Everything should be all right.
利力怎么会出现在这里？而且还受了伤……: What is Lili doing here? And how did that injury occur?
这个是赛依连的大嘴鸟，名字叫利力。: This is Seyren's Peco Peco. Its name is Lili.
看到它脖子上的铭牌了吗？: See the nameplate on its neck?
铭牌上写着：赛依连·瓦恩萨的大嘴鸟 利力。: The nameplate says: Seyren Windsor's Peco Peco - Lili.
即使没有铭牌，我也能一眼认出利力。: Even without the nameplate, I'd recognize Lili anywhere.
利力在这就说明赛依连和我老师也在这里！: If Lili's here, then surely that means Seyren and my master are here!
我果然没找错地方！: It looks like I came to the right place!
呼——呼——不愧是利力，跑得这么快……: Huff… Puff... That Lili runs so fast...
它已经跑进里希塔乐镇里了！我们得赶紧跟上！: It's already run right into Lighthalzen! We have to catch up right away!
索林小姐？！她怎么躺在这里！: Miss Thorin?! What's she doing laying here?
索林小姐怎么晕倒在这里！: How did Miss Thorin end up like this?
我的治疗术是一个兽医教的，一般就只能救治一下利力这种……: My healing is mainly for animals. It's only good for treating patients like Lili...
听说里希塔乐镇原野上有一种醒醒草，气味能令人从昏迷中醒来。: I remember hearing that Awakening Grass grows in the wilderness around Lighthalzen. It's often used to wake people up from comas.
只不过，醒醒草的周围都会长有剧毒的食人花……: But there may be Piranha Plants roaming the areas where Awakening Grass grows...
所以要采集它，一定要先将食人花消灭才行。: So, you're going to need to eliminate those Piranha Plants before you can gather the cure.
我在这边守着索林小姐，醒醒草就交给你了！: I'll stay here and watch over Miss Thorin, and I'll leave the Awakening Grass in your hands.
[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]，忽克连！你们怎么在: [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], Hollgrehenn! What are you doing here?
我刚刚是晕倒了吗……？唔……头好痛……: I was... unconscious? Ah... My head hurts…
索林小姐，你看起来脸色不太好，没事吧？: Miss Thorin, you don't look so good... Are you all right?
我没事……只是最近有点太累了……休息一下就好……: I'm fine... I've just been a little tired recently... I'll be fine after some rest...
唔，醒醒草的味道……是你们帮我采来了醒醒草！: Ah, the smell of Awakening Grass... You're the one who helped to fetch the Awakening Grass!
