呼！还以为你不会错失这么好的机会呢！真是太可惜了: Hmph! I thought you wouldn't want to miss such a good opportunity! That's too bad.
太好了，我一定说话算话！: That's great! You won't be sorry!
我之前就拜托过神射手团的哈克去斐扬树林寻找线索，不过他去了很久都一直没有消息。后: I asked Huck of the Sniper Team to look for clues in Payon Forest, but he's been there for a long time now without sending word. We've been completely out of touch!
所有的线索都汇聚在了斐扬树林，希望你去的时候也帮我们寻找一下哈克！: The clues are all gathered in Payon Forest. I hope you can help us find Huck when you go!
这颗魔物蛋你带着，路上一定要好好照顾它！: Take this monster egg with you. Take good care of it on the way!
这里似乎有一些血迹，应该是有人受伤了。: There seems to be some blood here. Someone must have been injured.
血迹越来越多，还有着打斗的痕迹。: There are more and more bloodstains and signs of a struggle.
有个人躺在那里好像受伤了，去看看是什么情况吧！: There's a man lying there as if he were injured. Go see what happened to him.
眼前的人彻底失去了意识，旁边有他的背包里面或许会有关于他的线索。: He's slipped into unconsciousness. There might be clues about who he is in his backpack.
背包里有着信件，上面的名字是哈克，他应该就是卡迪尔说的神射手团的人。: There's a letter in the backpack signed Huck. He must be the sniper Cartier mentioned.
他为什么会受这么重的伤，还有刚才说的话是什么意思？看样子要先把他救醒才能知道。: How did he get so badly injured, and what did he mean by what he said just now? It seems we won't know until he wakes up.
咳…咳咳…是你救了我么？: Cough...Cough... Are you the one who saved me?
谢谢你冒险者，要不然我可能就要命丧于此了。: Thank you, adventurer. I probably would have died here.
卡迪尔委托你来寻找关于那颗蛋的线索？: Cartier commissioned you to look for clues about that egg?
我奉劝你不要再去了！: I advise you not to go any further!
那里…太危险了！我这是侥幸才活下来的！: This place... It's too dangerous! I was lucky to escape with my life!
我跟着卡迪尔给我的地图来到了他发现那颗蛋的地方。: I followed the map Cartier gave me to the place he found the egg.
那里什么生物都没有！甚至连一只小虫子都找不到！！！: There was not a living thing there! Not even a worm!
我曾经游历过各种险地，直觉告诉我这里不能久留。: I've traveled to all kinds of dangerous places and my intuition told me that I shouldn't stay there too long.
没想到我刚走出那片区域就遇到了鬼火和魔物的围攻，我和它们战斗受了重伤只好逃走。: Unexpectedly, as soon as I stepped out of the area, I was besieged by Horong and monsters. I fought them off and was badly wounded... I had to flee.
没想到那些东西穷追不舍，直到传来了一声狐狸叫。: Those things pursued me relentlessly until a fox yelped at them.
是的，那个声音传来之后，追击我的魔物就全不见了。: Yes... When that fox's voice rang out, the creatures chasing me disappeared.
我重伤在身没坚持多久我也晕了过去，再次醒来就遇到你了。: I was badly injured and collapsed... When I woke up.. well you know the rest.
你真的要去么？那里真的很危险！: You really want to go? It's very dangerous!
呼…你知道害怕就好，这事你就不要插手了: It's okay if you're scared. You don't have to get involved in this.
好吧，卡迪尔能让你来就证明你是有实力的！: Well, if Cartier asked you to come, I guess you want to prove how strong you are!
那个地方就在树林北部的古井旁，你一定要小心！: The place is near the ancient well in the north of the woods. You must be careful!
怎么出现了两只小狐狸，去看看什么情况。: Where did these two little foxes come from? Let's see what's going on.
管他怎么来的，佩卡！: Who cares what they're doing here, Peka!
侵犯到我族的领地，直接清除就是了！: This is a direct invasion of clan territory! You'll pay for this!
佩娜，你先别冲动，看看他到底什么来意。: Don't be rash, Pella. Let's see what he wants.
蛋？蛋和我族有什么关系？别解释了！: Egg? What does this egg have to do with my clan? There's no need to explain!
很有可能！我们要带他去找族长。: That's a definite possibility! Let's take him to the Chief.
佩卡，我们不能就这样放松警惕！一起要小心！: Peka, we must be careful! Always remain vigilant!
人类，你带着魔物蛋跟我来！: Human, take the monster egg and follow us!
如果你所言属实，那么就从这古井跳下去！: If what you say is true, jump into this old well!
这是通往我们狐族领地的大门！: This is the gateway to fox clan territory!
你有这个胆量么？: Do you have the courage to take the leap?
狡猾的人类快离开，永远不要再踏入狐族的领地！: Get out of here, deceitful human and never step into fox clan territory again!
太阳的光迹与月亮的引领，在漆黑的路途上，。照耀出灿烂的黄金之道。: The light of the sun and the guidance of the moon fall upon on the darkest path... The shining, brilliant road.
流动不息的泉水阿！那绵延不止的白绢，请回应我的呼唤！: The ever-flowing spring! White silken thread of fate, please respond to my call!
族长，这个人类有关于少族长的消息。: Chief, this human has news about the young chief.
你是怎么发现的，人类！（审视）: Human, how did you find this egg? (Looking around...)
原来如此，虽然我对人类有偏见，但是还会就事论事的！: Although I do not trust human beings, we shall discuss this matter further!
你救了我的儿子，想要什么奖励可以直说！: You saved my son... What reward do you want?
加入坐骑团？这个要求恐怕我不能答应！: So you wanted to add a fox to your mounted companions? I'm afraid I can't grant this request!
我们狐族隐居于此就是为了避开人类！: We foxes live in seclusion in order to avoid human beings like you!
人类诡计多端看中我们狐族强大的力量，就对我的族人加以迫害！: Cunning humans have seen the powerful of the foxes and have persecuted my people for eons.
我的夫人带着孩子外出的时候就受到了人类的攻击。: My wife was attacked by humans when she was out with our children.
等我发现她的时候，她已经身受重伤，我的儿子也下落不明！: When I found her, she was seriously injured, and my son's whereabouts was unknown!
夫人的性命危在旦夕，族里的医师说只有用珍珠才能治好夫人。: The wife's life still hangs in the balance. The doctors of our clan say that only a Pearl can cure her.
可是我们族里并没有珍珠这种东西…: But we do not have any such things here.
交给你？人类会这么好心？: Want me to get you one? Can a human really be so kind?
族长我可以跟着他一起前去人类的世界！: Chief, I will follow him to the human world!
那就暂且相信人类一次。: Let's give the humans a chance for once.
我听医师说珍珠这种材料十分稀有，你真的有把握么？: I heard from the doctor that pearls are very rare. Are you really sure you can get some?
把珍珠带来了吗，人类？: Have you brought the Pearl, human?
这种材料果然很罕见，夫人的伤……: This kind of material is rare indeed... My wife's wounds...
狡猾的人类，果然不能相信你！: Cunning humans can indeed never be trusted!
你真的是我们狐族的救星！: You are really the savior of the fox clan!
其实族长不答应你还有一个别的原因。: In fact, there is another reason why the Chief didn't trust you...
狐族长老欲言又止的样子肯定有什么隐情！: From the way the fox elder stopped talking so abruptly, he must be holding something back!
这个问题是狐族的软肋，不能轻易的告诉别。: This problem is the true weakness of the fox clan, so it cannot be revealed so easily...
但是你都帮了狐族这么多的忙，那我就告诉你吧！: But you have helped the foxes so much... I will tell you!
我们狐族随着成长会尾巴数量会越来越多，最后上升到九尾，力量也会越来越强大。: As we grow older, we grow additional tails, and eventually reach the point of having nine tails. With each tail, we grow stronger.
但是这样会有个弊端。: But we still have a weakness.
我们所需的生存条件就越来越严格。: Our environment is changing, and it is taking its toll on us.
人类世界的冬天是我们难以适应的，寒冷的天气会导致我们的体力下降，甚至是死亡。: Winter in the human world has been difficult for us to adapt to. Cold weather can lead to debilitation, and even death.
这个问题也困扰了我们很久，我族的祭祀通过占卜知道大陆上有一种东西可以帮助我们克服: This problem has troubled us for a long time. Our oracles, through their divination, say that there is something in the human world that can help us overcome this problem.
那种材料叫炙热的毛，它可以保证我们的身体温度，让我们狐族可以抵御低温。: We need a certain material Burning Hair. It can help us maintain a high body temperature, so that we can withstand the cold.
你想的太轻松了，我们狐族人数众多！需要的可不是小数目。: It sounds easy, but we have such a large number of foxes to care for! What we need is not just a small portion.
差不多要1000根！这数量简直……: We will need around 1,000 patches! Yep, that'll do it...
一千根炙热的毛带来了吗？: Do you have the thousand patches of Burning Hair?
数量还是太多了，要不然还是算了吧: If it's too much for you to handle, just forget it.
数量还是太多了，要不然还是算了吧！: If it's too much for you to handle, just forget it!
你为我们狐族付出这么多，我们狐族是真的难以为报！: You have done so much for us foxes! How can we ever repay you?
我现在就召唤族长，老身一定为你劝诫族长！: I will call the Chief now. The old lady is sure to scold him on your behalf!
长老什么事？竟然让你动用了召唤卷轴！: What's up, elder? A summoning scroll?
是不是这个人类用了什么诡计！: What is this human up to?!
这都是这位冒险者为了我们狐族取来的啊！: This adventurer brought it for us!
族长，这份恩情！我觉得我们应该报答了！: Chief, see this act of kindness? I think it warrants rewarding!
爸爸！我想跟着他去冒险！: Father! I want to travel with you, adventurer!
一路上，他对我最好了！小九尾超喜欢他的！: Along our adventure, he was very good to me! Little Nine Tail really like him a lot!
哎…冒险者，我答应你的要求！: Ah... Adventurer, I shall grant your request!
我狐族愿为坐骑团出一份力量！: The fox clan is willing to contribute to your mounted regiment!
感谢你对我们狐族的付出！: Thank you for all you've done for the fox clan!
蛋蛋离开的日子，想他，想他！: The day the egg up and leaves home is always a sad one... I shall miss him!
哈哈哈哈！我就知道，蛋蛋绝对不是普通的魔物！: Hahahaha! I knew it! I knew it was no ordinary monster egg!
这次真是赚大了！！咳咳…这句当我没说！: This was one hell of a profitable adventure! Cough... Cough... Did I say that out loud?
以后我们坐骑团有了这种强力的坐骑，绝对会越来越强的！: In the future, with this powerful mount, our mounted regiment will become unstoppable!
我要迫不及待去联系狐族族长了，还有我可爱的蛋蛋！: I can't wait to contact the fox chief and get my hands on some more lovely fox eggs!
别担心，我答应你的不会忘的！: Don't worry, I promise you I won't forget!
坐骑绝对给你优惠！: I'll definitely give you a discount on this mount!
冒险者，你的灵魂之力已经收集到足够的亡者气息了。: Adventurer, your soul power has gathered enough Ghost Breath.
这个黑曜石魂晶对你来说已经没用了，我收回了，把它留给需要的冒险者吧。: This Obsidian Crystal is of no further use to you. Let me take it back and give it to another adventurer who might need it.
如果你想进一步突破巅峰等级，我倒是听到了一些传闻。: If you want to push your power even further, I've heard rumors of other ways.
雷根贝勒公司不久前开发出了一种药，能帮助人类大幅提高身体素质。: Rekenber Corporation has recently developed a drug that can help humans greatly improve their physical fitness.
你不妨去里希塔乐镇上看看，或许能有缘获得这种秘药。: You might as well go to Lighthalzen to see if you could get some of this secret medicine.
谢天谢地，终于来人了！你是冒险者吗？: Thank goodness! Someone finally came! You are an adventurer?
唉唉，我爸爸就是这里的医生，他现在出门了，我也不知道去了哪儿……: My father is the doctor here, but he's out now, and I don't know where he went!
爸爸说过，里希塔乐原野上长着一种醒醒草，有清醒镇静的效果。: I remember Dad said a kind of herb called Awakening Grass grows in the Lighthalzen Plains, and that it can wake people up, as well as calm them down!
把醒醒草给大姐姐闻闻看吧！: Put the Awakening Grass under sis's nose!
太好了！大姐姐，你终于醒了！: Great! Sis, you finally woke up!
我们快回去吧！不然爸爸妈妈会担心的！: Let's hurry back! Otherwise, Mom and Dad will worry!
不行……我还不能回去……我……还没查清楚……: No way... I can't go... I... I don't...
你的眼神充满着正义的力量……应该不是那里的人……: Your eyes are full of righteousness... You're not from around here...
你一定想问，在我身上发生了什么事吧。: You must want to ask what happened to me...?
老实说，我也不确定。可以明确的是，我失去了一部分记忆。: To be honest, I'm not sure. Obviously, I've lost part of my memory.
莉塔告诉我，雷根贝勒公司发生了火灾，我从那里逃了出来后，晕倒在了附近的草丛里。: Rita told me that there was a fire at Rekenber Corporation, and that I escaped and fainted in the grass.
是莉塔的爸爸救了我，之后也一直在照顾我。: Rita's dad saved me and has been taking care of me ever since.
我想，应该是那一场大火……是它让我变成了现在这样。: I think that big fire... made me who I am now.
有一个徽章，应该是很重要的东西……: I had a badge. I think it might be very important...
是一个金属徽章……不知道丢到了哪儿……: It's a metal badge... I don't know where I lost it.
徽章应该是被火烧过，痕迹焦黑，几乎看不清原来的模样。: The badge is burned and charred black. It's original appearance can barely be made out.
这可能就是白衣女子的徽章，拿回去给她看看吧。: This may be the badge belonging to the woman in white. Take it back and show it to her.
你回来了……收获如何？: You're back... How did it go?
虽然被烧焦了，但是这就是我的徽章！我不会认错的！: It's scorched, but this is my badge! There's no mistaking it!
如果它没有被烧成这样就好了……也许会有更多线索……: If only it hadn't been burned like this... it may hold more clues...
啊！如果是修复被烧焦的东西，莉塔知道方法哦！: Ah...! Rita knows how to repair burnt things.
里希塔乐原野上有一种萤光蝴蝶，它们翅膀上的磷粉可以修复焦痕！: There is a kind of fluorescent butterfly on the Lighthalzen Plains. The phosphorus powder on its wings can eradicate these scorch marks!
不过萤光蝴蝶很稀少啦，也不知道还在不在原野上了呢。: But fluorescent butterflies are rare, and I don't know if they are still in the field.
没关系，我去原野看看……有一丝希望我都不能放过！: Anyway, I must go to the field and see... It's the only hope I have!
不可以！！大姐姐，你现在身体太虚弱了！: No way! Sis, you're too weak right now!
冒险者，真不好意思。我确实有些晕，可能又得麻烦你了……: Adventurer, I'm sorry... I do feel quite dizzy. Could I ask to bother you once again?
这应该就是萤光蝴蝶了……: These should be the fluorescent butterflies...
收集到足够的磷粉了，回去吧。: That should be enough. Time to go back.
你真厉害，确实是萤光蝴蝶的磷粉！: You're the best. You go the Phosphorus Powder from the butterflies!
徽章恢复了原来的光泽，隐约可以看到上面刻了一行字。: The badge has been restored its original luster, and a line of words can be seen faintly upon it.
哇啊啊好可怕！！刚刚那是什么啊！！: Whoa! What's going on?! What was that just now?
别担心，已经没事了……莉塔，你先回家。: Don't worry. It's all right now. Rita, you go home first.
啊……大姐姐，你不跟我一起吗？: Ah... Sis, don't you want to come with me?
还有冒险者，你救了我和大姐姐，得好好谢谢你才行……: And adventurer, you saved me and my sis. Thank you so much...
莉塔，你先回家。我有点事要跟冒险者说。: Rita, head on home. I have something to tell the adventurer.
……好嘛。那我先回去了，你不要再跑掉啦……: ...Fine. Then I'll go back first. Don't wander off!
我想起来了，我的名字，我的身份，以及那场火灾……: I remember everything... My name, my identity, and the fire...
里希塔乐镇并不太平。而雷根贝勒公司，也不像表面那么光鲜。: The town of Lighthalzen is not a safe place to be... And Rekenber Corporation is not as pure as it seems...
我知道他们的秘密，这也是为什么他们要来杀我的原因……: I know their secrets, and that's why they came to kill me...
既然我想起了一切，我就不能再回莉塔家里了……: Now that I remember everything, I can't go back to Rita's home...
他们一家都是好心人，我不想连累他们……: They are such kind-hearted people. I don't want to involve them...
这是遗忘药水……拜托你……让莉塔一家忘了我吧。: This is Forgetfulness Potion that induced amnesia... Please... Make Rita and her family forget me.
啊！冒险者，你来啦！大姐姐人呢？: Ah...! Adventurer... You're here! Where's sis?
莉塔都跟我说了，谢谢您救了她。: Rita told me what happened. Thank you for saving her.
我们没什么能报答您的，请到家里坐坐吧。: We have nothing to repay you with, but please come and stay with us a while.
……咦？爸爸妈妈，为什么我们要站在门口呀？: Eh...? Mother, Father... why are we standing at the door?
好啦好啦，不要愣着了。我们快进屋吧。: There, there... No need to think on it. Let's hurry on inside.
都忘记了吗……太好了。这样他们就安全了。: They've forgotten everything? Excellent. As long as they're safe...
这个城镇发生了很多事。光靠我一个人根本做不了什么，: A lot has happened in this town. I can't do anything by myself.
不过……如果是你的话，也许可以发现真相。: But... With your help, maybe we can find out the truth.
这是一点小心意，是雷根贝勒研制出能提高人体机能的秘药。: Be careful with this. It was developed by Rekenber... a secret drug that can improve one's abilities.
看来有效果。我先走了，我们有缘再见吧。: It seems to work. I'm go on ahead. Let's say goodbye for now.
抱歉，你没有黑曜石魂晶: Sorry, you don't have an Obsidian Crystal!
咕啾，我有名字啦~: Coo-chi! I finally got a name!
咕啾~决定了，我要一直跟着你哟！: Coo-chi! That settles it! I'm going to follow you from now on!
那我就去睡一会儿吧~: Then I'll just go to sleep for a while...
哇！这是什么地方？好壮观！: Wow! What is this place? What a spectacular sight!
咕啾！我果然可以带来好运！: Coo-chi! I can bring you good luck!
咕……没事的！这回只是碰巧啦！: Coo... No problem! It was just a coincidence this time!
叼来一份小礼物~主人收好哟！: I got a little gift... Take it, master!
啾~想带着主人一起飞~: I want to fly with my master!
饿啦饿啦！我要吃东西！: Hungry, hungry! I want to eat!!!
再吃就飞不起来啦……: Forget about flying... I ate too much!
咕啾！主人，我飞过来了哟！: Coo-chi! Master, I'm flying to you!
呼呼，我要成为独当一面的狮鹫！: Whew! I want to be a Gryphon!
主人！理我一下啦！我好无聊！: Master! Look at me! I'm bored!
哇，主人越来越厉害啦！: Whoa! You're getting more amazing all the time, master!
主人主人，你怎么躺着不动了，呜呜呜……: Master, why aren't you moving... Waaaah!
咕啾，主人的抚摸真温柔呀~蹭蹭~: Coo-chi! Master's touch is so gentle!
主人，你怎么流了这么多血……快跑吧呜呜呜……: Master, you're bleeding so much... Waaaaah!
咕啾，是给我的礼物吗？真好看！: Coo-chi! Is this gift for me? It's gorgeous!
有时候想飞到更高的地方看看……: Sometimes, I wish I could fly to the top of the sky...
主人摸摸我呀！想要更蓬松的翅膀~: Pet me, master! I want fluffier wings!
好饿好饿，主人，我想吃东西……: Hungry, hungry, master! I want to eat...
主人，我想变得更帅气！: I wanna become more like you!
呜哇，是小礼物！谢谢主人，我好开心~: Wow, it's a little gift! Thank you, master! I'm so happy!
呼…这件事怎么办呢。: Huh...? What are we to do?
神射手团的好多人都被它弄伤了！: Many people in the Sniper Team were injured by it!

嘿嘿，它们生长在苏哈拉沙漠上，数量极少。: Hee-hee! They live in the Suhara Desert, and are very rare beasts.
但是它们的粗壮有力的后肢，奔走起来可以甩骑士们的大嘴鸟十个迷藏森林！: But their strong hind limbs can shake off Peco Peco cavalry across ten Labyrinth Forests!
咳咳……当然这只是一种文学上夸张的说法！: Cough... Cough... Of course, this is just hyperbole!
现在……就是……有个……问题……: There's just... a little problem... right now...
你完成转职的速度实在是太快了！我们完全没有预想到！: You completed your job transfer so quickly! We didn't expect it at all!
哎，再加上厉害的魔物越来越多，我们神射手团也有好多人因为害怕所以退出了……现在人: Alas, with so many powerful monsters appearing lately, many people have quit the Sniper Team out of fear. We don't have enough members!
优秀的出色的善良的勇敢的慷慨的正直的伟大的冒险者！: Excellent, kind, brave, generous, honest, great adventurer!
你能帮我们一起完成冒险者同盟的委托吗？: Can you help us to complete the commission of the Adventurers League?
当然啦！事成之后，我一定会给你最优惠的价格购买坐骑！: Of course! After that, I'll give you the best price for a new mount!
哎，像你这样厉害的人，一定有很多事情要忙……: Hey, there must be a lot of things occupying the time of someone amazing like you...
看来，只能委屈你再等等了……: It seems unfair to make you wait for your deserved reward...
我的搭档艾玛会陪同你一起！她现在就在苏哈拉沙漠~: My partner Emma will accompany you! She's in the Suhara Desert right now.
这是我的老鹰，它会带你找到艾玛~: This is my eagle. It will take you to Emma.
对了对了！还有一件事要拜托你！: Got it! And there's one more thing I must ask of you!
千万千万不要和冒险者同盟的那些人说这件事啊！: Don't tell anyone from the Adventurers League about this!
这不是罗嘛！卡迪尔也来了吗？: I know this bird! Did Cartier come, too?
诶？你是谁！？你怎么带着卡迪尔的老鹰！？: Ah? Who are you?! What are you doing with Cartier's eagle?!
原来是这样，谢谢你，罗，你可以回去找卡迪尔了~: I see. Thank you, Lorre. You can go back to Cartier, now.
有你来帮忙那真是太好了，我正愁没有人手。: It's great to have you helping me. I'm hurting for help right now.
这些鸵鸟跑的实在是太快了，我每次都被它们甩开。: These Ostriches run so fast that I'm thrown every which way by them every time.
幸好我灵机一动，将身上带着的荧光剂袋子用弓箭射到了一只鸵鸟的身上！: Fortunately, I had the idea to shoot a bag of fluorescent fluid onto an Ostrich with a bow and arrow.
现在只要等到晚上~~就能找到它们的栖身之所了！: Now we just have to wait till evening to find their den!
为了方便行动，我们还需要制作一些魔法药水！: We also need to make some magic potions for later!
这样我们就能听懂动物们在说什么了！: So we can understand what these animals are talking about!
就麻烦你从摩卡身上取一些仙人掌汁液过来了~: Could you go and get some Cactus Juice from the Muka?
嗯~这点量够我们两个用很久了！: Well, that's enough for us both to use for a long time!
我这边制作还需要一些时间。: I'll need some time to make it.
对啦，你可以到处转转捡一些鸟粪来~: You can gather some Guano in the meantime.
是呀，用鸟粪可以隐藏我们身上的味道，更好的接近动物们！: Yeah, we can use Guano to hide our scent and get closer to these beasts!
没想到吧，我们神射手团优秀捕猎手的小秘诀居然如此简单~: I guess the secrets of the Sniper Team are all relatively simple!
不错不错~药剂还要熬制一段时间~: It'll be fine, the potions will still take a while.
我们准备一下，等待天黑吧！: Let's get ready and wait for darkness to fall!
来，我们先往身上裸露的地方涂上鸟粪~: Come on, let's put some Guano on the exposed areas first.
别害羞~我不会笑你的！: Don't be shy... I won't laugh at you!
嘿嘿！这下可以了！我们出发！: He-he! That'll do for now! Let's go!
沿着地面上发光的荧光剂就能找到它们！: We can follow the glowing trail to find the ostriches' lair!
这里是天堂吧！我从来没见过这么多鸵鸟！: This is like ostrich heaven! I've never seen so many Ostriches!
诶？那边是怎么回事？我们过去看看！: Ah? What's going on over there? Let's go and see!
嗯，这只小鸵鸟似乎遇到了一些麻烦。: This little Ostrich seems to be in some trouble.
来，将药剂喝下，我们就知道它们在说什么了！: Come on! Drink the medicine and we'll know what they're talking about!
狼大哥们……我不是故意闯进你们的地盘的。: Brother Wolf... I didn't mean to step onto your territory.
小崽子，你们鸵鸟不是都跑的很快的吗？再逃呀！: Baby bird, don't you Ostriches all run oh-so-very fast? Well... Run!
不好，我们得帮帮那只小鸵鸟！: Oh no! We have to help that little Ostrich!
你们是谁……怎么会出现在这里？: Who are you? What are you doing here?
我们是路过的冒险者~你呢？怎么会被群狼围攻？: We just passing adventurers. How about you? How did you end up trapped by wolves?
噶几噶几……我晚上偷偷到这里来练习飞行！: Gachi-gachi... I sneaked here at night to practice flying!
但是没想到闯进了它们的地盘……: But I didn't plan on treading on their territory...
是啊！我的远方表亲们都是会飞的鸟儿！: That's right! My cousins are all flying birds!
一定是我们练习的不够努力！: It must be that we didn't train hard enough!
但是鸵鸟们都笑我，说我异想天开……: But the other Ostriches laughed at me and said I was crazy...
你们的祖先将翅膀化作了强有力的四肢，这是你的远亲鸟儿们没有的东西。: Your ancestors turned their wings into powerful limbs, something your cousins don't have.
其实我也知道……但是我就想体验一下，在空中飞行的感觉……: Actually, I know this... But I just want to experience the feeling of flying in the air...
如果只是体验的话~我们可以帮你哦！: If it's just an experience you're after, we can help you!
不骗你！只是今天已经很晚啦~小孩子要好好睡觉才能长大！: You bet! It's already very late. You'll need plenty of sleep to grow up big and strong!
明天天亮了以后，你在这里等我们~: After daybreak tomorrow, you'll find us waiting for you here.
虽然我是个半吊子神射手，但是小小的飞行魔法我还是会的~: I may be a half-baked Sniper, but I know a little flying magic!
只不过，我需要一些小道具~: But I'll need a few items!
要说会飞的魔物里，要数鸟人哈比的魔力最强~: Among all the flying monsters, the Harpy is the most powerful.
我需要它们的羽毛来协助我的飞行魔法~: I need their feathers to help me with my flying spell.
为了小鸵鸟的小心愿~我们善良的冒险者一定会帮它实现的对吧！: Good adventurers like us would surely do anything in our power, to make a little Ostrich's wish come true, right?
怎么样？哈比的羽毛收集齐了吗？: How's that? Have you collected those Harpy's Feathers for me?
加油啊~不要让阿鸵久等了~: Come on! Don't make little Toto wait too long!
哼哼~休想骗我！快去收集羽毛~: Hmph! Don't try to deceive me! Go get them, quickly!
哇！你真厉害！鸟人哈比可不好对付~: Wow! You're amazing! Harpies are some tough cookies...
噶几噶几~等你们好久啦！: Gachi-gachi! I've been waiting for you two so long!
我可是特意叫来了我的亲朋好友来见证我实现梦想的时刻！: I called my friends and relatives to come and witness my dream come true!
快开始吧！快开始吧！: Let's do this! Let's do this!
这就是魔法嘛！我好想和会魔法的人做朋友！: This is magic! I want some more magical friends!
你要不要来加入我们的坐骑团？: Well... Would you like to join our mounted regiment?
很多冒险者要比我厉害的多~他们会各式各样的魔法~: Many adventurers are much more powerful than I am, and they have all kinds of magical abilities.
成为他们的伙伴可以和他们一起去冒险！: Partner up with them and you can go on adventures together!
很厉害哦！就像[c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]一样厉: That sounds terrific! Almost as awesome as [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]!
冒险者们真的这么厉害么？我也想去了呢！: Are adventurers really that amazing? I want to go, too!
证明给俺们看看！到底有多厉害！: Prove it to us! Show us what you can really do!
听说有种超厉害的冰狼叫卡仑！: I've heard of a super-tough ice wolves called Garm!
如果你能取来它们的三颗牙齿，俺们就信你！: If you can bring back three of their teeth, we'll believe you!
嘿嘿，这对我们弓箭手来说小意思~对吧？嘿，[c][ffff00][PlayerN: He-heh, that should be nothing for us, right? Huh, [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]?
快将卡仑之牙带来~让它们瞧瞧！: Bring some Fangs of Garm back with you soon. Let them see what you're made of!
你真的带来了三颗卡仑之牙？: Did you really bring three Fangs of Garm?
你们这些冒险者都喜欢骗俺们鸵鸟吗？！: So, adventurers have nothing better to do than cheat Ostriches?!
真的是卡仑之牙！你们冒险者真是厉害！: They're really Fangs of Garm! You adventurers are incredible!
我也要和冒险者一起去冒险！: I'm going to go on an adventure, too!
俺们快回去告诉大家！好多小伙子都想出去历练呢！: Let's go back and tell everyone! Everyone want to go out and train up!
嘿嘿~一个个来~: Hee-hee! They're following one by one!
谢谢你冒险者，接下去交给我就可以了~: Thank you, adventurer. I'll take it from here!
你可以回去找卡迪尔~: You can go ahead and return to Cartier.
很快你就可以从他那里购买到你心仪的鸵鸟坐骑了~: Soon, you'll be able to buy your favorite Ostrich mount from him!
我收到艾玛的消息了！干的漂亮！不愧是你！: I just got the news from Emma! You did it, buddy! You're amazing!
红莲丸的速度可是普通机甲的三倍！: Honglyun's Sword is three times faster than normal mecha!
用不了多久大家都会明白，须佐机甲是最强的！: It won't be long before everyone knows that the Susano-o Mecha is the best!
前辈们是我学习的榜样！: Our predecessors are examples for us to learn from!
遵从主人哈沃德的一切指令！: I follow all of Master Hayward's orders to the letter!
咳…咳咳…她是我的小公主。: *cough, cough, cough* She is... my princess.
才不是他们口中所说的什么小偷。: She's not the thief they all say she is...
她是被陷害的，被冤枉的！！: She was wronged... She was framed!
所有人都是冷漠的，没有人会来帮助我这个无助的父亲。: No one cares... No one will help this poor, distraught father.
娣洁是我的女儿，是我最爱的人。: Deje is my daughter... and my entire life!
我的妻子生下她之后就不在了，一直是我们父女两个人相依为命。: My wife died after Deje was born, and it has always been just us two, depending on each other every day.
我们父女两个人的日子虽然清苦，但是却很幸福……: Although our life has been far from perfect, we are very happy.
娣洁一直很懂事……: Deje has always been a very sensible girl...
她看到别的女孩子穿着漂亮的裙子都会露出羡慕的神情。: But she looked so envious when she saw the other girls wearing their beautiful dresses.
我想努力赚钱为她也买一件漂亮的裙子，但是她总会笑着拒绝说她不喜欢。: I tried to make money and buy her a beautiful dress, but she always laughed and said she wasn't interested in dresses.
她的心思，我做父亲的又怎么会看不透呢，她不过是不想我费心罢了。: How could I, her father, not see through her pained words? She just wanted me to stop worrying.
就是这么一个善良的孩子，又怎么会是小偷！: How can such a kind child be a thief?
贝勒区贵族的珠宝丢失了，娣洁曾在贝勒区的废弃区捡到过一身贵族商人服饰。: A pearl belonging to Baylor nobility went missing... Deje found an aristocratic merchant's clothes in an abandoned area of Baylor.
就因为这个可笑的原因，他们就一口咬定珠宝是娣洁偷窃的。: For this ridiculous reason alone, they decided that she stole the jewelry!
娣洁被他们抓到了雷根贝勒研究所，我怎么样都无法联系到她。: They took her to the Rekenber laboratory, and they won't let me see her!
我偷偷跟着那些人来到了这里，但是我却找不到我的女儿！: I came here secretly with those people, but I couldn't find my daughter!
这是她最喜欢的竖笛，它的笛声很独特，她一定会听到。: This is her favorite clarinet. Its sound is unique and she will recognize it if she hears it.
但是这里好像有什么东西屏蔽了笛声，笛声根本无法传达出去。: But there seems to be something blocking the flute's sound here...
冒险者？！喂！你…你别走啊！！: Adventurer?! Hey! Hey... Where are you going?!
我叫雷诺斯，是一名消防员。: My name is Reynolds. I'm a firefighter.
前阵子雷根贝勒公司发生了一场大火，我的队长和前辈们受委托来这里灭火。: A fire broke out at Rekenber Corporation a few days ago, and my captain and teammates were commissioned to come here to put out the fire.
但是他们出任务很久都没有回信。: But they haven't responded in such a long time.
消防队的大家都很担心他们，所以让我来这里查看情况。: Everyone in the fire brigade was worried about them, so I came to check out what was going on here.
我跟随着火焰的痕迹来到了这里，但是却没有看到任何人的身影。: I followed the burn marks here, but I didn't see anyone.
恐怕前辈他们已经遭遇了不测，呜呜呜。: I'm afraid that they may have already been involved in an accident!
我不哭了，你能帮帮我么！: I won't cry... Can you help me?
你真好……我来的时候发现这里燃烧产物的异变情况很不一样。: That's very kind of you... When I came here, I found all manner of combustibles affected by mutation...
我在那些燃烧后的产物中发现了强烈的魔法元素波动。: And I detected strong magical element readings among them...
甚至有些燃烧产物都产生了活体意识，开始主动攻击人！: Some of the combustibles have even developed a consciousness and have started to attack people of their own free will!
这场发生的火灾绝对不是普通的火灾。: This fire was definitely not an ordinary one...
我一定要调查清楚真相！: I must find out the truth!
生物体离开，解除危险。: The entities have been eliminated. The threat has been neutralized.
橙色警告，生物体检测。: Orange warning, biological test in progress.
检测成功，结果判定生物体无危险。: The test was successful and the results show that the organism was not dangerous.
“虽然不熟识面前的你，但是恳求你帮我一个忙。”: "Although we have not met in person, I ask that you do a favor for me."
“我喜欢一个女孩，她叫迪文。”: "I like a girl. Her name is Deeven."
“虽然别人看到她会觉得她野蛮暴力，但是她的一举一动在我眼里都是可爱。”: "Although others see her as brutal and violent, her every move is divine in my eyes."
“我比较粗心，不太讨女孩子的喜欢。”: "I'm no great lover, and I don't like girls very much."
“但是每次看到她，我都会下意识的放轻声音，细心的观察她的喜好。”: "But every time I see her, I subconsciously soften my voice and carefully observe her preferences."
“我想，能这么默默守护她也好。”: "I thought it would be better to guard her silently, from a distance."
“这样平静的日子，直到我们来到了这个研究所后就消失不见了。”: "Such peaceful days disappeared when we came to this laboratory."
“雷根贝勒公司在这里做残酷的人体实验，我们的行踪被他们发现。”: "Rekenber Corporation is carrying out cruel human experiments here, and they've discovered our whereabouts."
“我想救迪文，但是我也被雷根贝勒的人抓住了。”: "I want to save Deeven, but the Rekenber lackeys caught me."
“是那些穿着研究服的人抓走她的！”: "The ones wearing those researcher suits took her!"
没想到你真的达成了我们的约定！: I never thought you'd really fulfill our contract!
我很高兴，你的毅力已经足够让你成为进阶初心者了。: I'm glad that you possess the perseverance to be a true Advanced Novice.
但你真的准备好了么？如果你下定了决心，目前阶段便无法再转职成其他职业了。: But are you really ready? If you're sure, you won't be able to switch to another job for now.
请你好好想一想吧，现在后悔还有机会。: Please think about it carefully. You still have a chance to back out.
我明白你的心意了，那么现在，将你的决心告诉其他6位职业导师吧。: I see that your mind has been made up. Now, tell the other six job mentors of your determination.
休朗克一直很欣赏你的天赋，从他开始吧。: Toukyou has always appreciated your talent. Start with him.
噢！年轻的初心者，你有什么事吗？: Oh! Young Novice, what can I do for you?
哈哈哈，你要知道我们商人系的职业才是最强！: Ha-ha-ha! You should know that us Merchant are the strongest adventurers around!
你可以学到神秘的炼金术，还能够使用方便的手推车，更别提驾驶那些帅气的机甲了！: You can learn mysterious alchemy, and use handcarts with increased ease, not to mention you can command a magnificent mecha!
怎么样？你想成为的职业是…？: How's that? Which job would you like to transfer to...?
我喜欢你这样慎重的孩子，好好想想再告诉我吧！: I admire your prudence, child. Think about it some more and tell me again when you're ready.
你这家伙可真固执啊，不过有自己的坚持是好事呢，我支持你！: You're a stubborn once, but it's good that you know your own mind. I support you fully!
年轻的初心者，你的心中存有什么困惑吗？: Young Novice, is there still any confusion remaining in your heart?
我们服事系职业是极为特殊的职业。: We Acolytes are a very special breed.
你可以成为牧师治愈他人的伤痛，也可以化身为武僧，用拳头贯彻自己的信仰。: You can become a Priest to heal the ailments of others, or you can become a Monk to enact your beliefs with your fists.
神一定会驱散你的迷茫，我的孩子。: God will purify you of your confusion, my child.
是吗，看来这是必然的选择，那么我会祝福你！: Really? It seems that this is the inevitable choice you must make... Then I will give you my blessing!
你为什么盯着我看？: Why are you staring at me?
你拥有成为刺客的天赋。: You possess the natural talent to be a legendary assassin.
要是成为刺客，你能成为穿行与黑夜的十字利刃，无声无息的消灭你的敌人；也可以加入流: If you become an Assassin, you can become a cross-cutting blade, stalking through the night, silently destroying your enemies. You can also join the Rogue Guild and learn to render your enemies incapable of fighting.
你想成为的职业是…？: Which job would you like to transfer to...?
你似乎还不够决绝……: You don't seem to know what you want...
哼，黑暗的道路不适合你。: Hmm... Well, perhaps the path of darkness is not for you.
初心者，找我什么事？: Novice, why were you looking for me?
你渴望成为剑与盾么？成为剑士吧！: You yearn to wield a sword shield? Become a Swordsman!
你的盾牌能为伙伴抵挡伤害，你的剑刃能刺破邪恶！你的意志将变得决绝而强大！: Your shield can protect you and your allies from harm, and your blade can pierce the heart of evil! Your heart will become more decisive and powerful!
握住剑之后，你将会明白责任与成长。: When you grasp the sword, you will understand the meaning of responsibility and inner growth.
我看到了你的决心，期待某天我们能并肩作战。: I see your determination and look forward to the day when we can fight side by side.
啊哈！年轻人，你似乎迷失了方向！: Ah-hah! Youngster, you seem to have lost your way!
你喜欢自由的味道吗？成为弓箭手吧！: Do you crave the taste of freedom? Become an Archer!
诗人舞娘能歌善舞，而搭弓射猎的游侠是米德加尔特最自由的家伙！: Bards and Dancers are the best at singing and dancing, and Rangers are Midgarts's freest fighters!
或许你的心里已经有答案了。: Perhaps you already know the answer in your heart.
哈哈，要是改变主意了的话，猎人公会随时欢迎你！: Haha! If you change your mind, the Hunters' Guild will always welcome you!
年轻的初心者，你看起来很有魔法天赋。: Young Novice, you look like one gifted with a talent for magic!
成为魔法师后，你便会知道什么是真正的力量。: Become a Mage and you will know what real power is.
探求智慧与真理的贤者，掌握元素魔法的巫师，你将会见识到一个真正的世界: Wise Sages who seek knowledge and truth, Wizards who master elemental magic -- you will see a whole new world!
可不要让机会从指尖溜走噢！: Don't let this chance slip through your fingertips!
看来你已经下定了决心，但要记住智慧才是强大的根本。: It seems you have made up your mind, but remember that wisdom is the foundation of strength.
你的决心如此的坚定，既然这样……: Your determination is resolute... In that case...

带着满腹疑惑，众人突破了看守的警戒，到达了雷根贝勒的地下研究所。在这里，他们终于: Full of doubt, they broke through the vigilant security forces and arrived at the underground laboratory of Rekenber. Here, they finally met up with Seyren. Before they has the chance to revel in the joy of their reunion, Seyren told them the cruel reality of the situation: Rekenber was experimenting on human beings there, and their friends had probably already been experimented on! Hollgrehenn refused to accept this and went ahead to find Hayward alone. The adventurers followed closely behind, but by the time they found Hayward, he had lost his mind and even knocked Hollgrehenn unconscious... Everyone was deeply shocked. To understand what led to Hayward's transformation, they began to explore the bizarre laboratory.

Seyren noticed that the mutations were very similar to Hayward's appearance before. They struggled to find clues, and finally found the truth of the experiment's results: the victims would lose their self-consciousness completely with the passage of time, divide into replicates, and eventually become soulless golems, lingering in the dark underground forever. This mutation was caused by infusing the victims with artificial Heart of Yimir shards.

The fire that broke out in the previous laboratory had something to do with Rekenber's misdeeds. In order to find more clues, they decided to split up and continue to investigate this mysterious, ominous place...

可恶，要是有证据的话…: Damn, we must find some evidence...

你准备好了就来告诉我吧！: Come and tell me when you're ready.

皮埃尔加快步伐了，糟了，跟丢了…: Pierre's quickened his pace... Oh, no! We lost him!

是啊老师！快把这个可恶的家伙交给警察局！: That's right, Master! Get this crook to the police station!

黛丽丝是不是会产生感情…？: Will Delice ever be capable of human emotion...?

哇！不愧是老师，真是又老又狡猾！: Wow! I'd expect no less! Master, you really are very cunning!

皮埃尔爸爸，谢谢你满怀关爱的培养我。: Father Pierre, thank you for nurturing me with love.
今天是实验的最后一天…: Today is the last day of the experiment...
我不会忘记皮埃尔爸爸的…: I will not forget Father Pierre...
果然还是失败了嘛？: In the end... did I fail?

感情指数明明没有变化…: Its emotional indicators clearly remain unchanged...
为什么，你明明没有那么想。: Why do you think it does?
为什么你能说的出口，明明没有感情。: How can you say so bluntly that she has no feelings?
皮埃尔爸爸，求求你，别打了。: Father Pierre, I beg you, don't hurt me.
实验个体编号3489号黛丽丝出现感情变化。: Subject No. 3489 Delice has undergone an emotional change.
这次多谢你的帮忙了，杰拉尔。: Thank you for your help, Gerald.

这次辛苦你了，请对雷根贝勒公司保密这件事。: This has been quite conflicting for you... Please keep it a secret from Rekenber Corporation.
报酬不会比公司给你的少，公司那边我去应付就好。: The remuneration will not be less than what the company gave you. I'll deal with things over there...

切，只是为了帕特先生给我更好的报酬罢了。: Hah, it's just so Mr. Pat pays me more.

我的身体某处出现了疼痛的感觉。: I felt a pain deep inside me...

里希塔乐的美食果然是一绝呀！: Lighthalzen's food must be the best around!

基础调味料，物美价廉。: Basic seasoning... Good quality, and at a low price.

中级调味料，可以发挥食材的特色。: Mid-level seasoning... Can give full play to the characteristics of the ingredients.

可是杰拉尔那边似乎没有什么进展。: But there seems to be little progress on Gerald's side.
你要是如此热心，当然是好的。: If you are so enthusiastic to help, that is of course a good thing.

你去吃一次就懂我在说什么了！: If you eat there, you will understand what I'm talking about!
记得要点肉排，五分熟！: Remember to order the steak -- medium!
您今天要吃点什么？: What would you like to eat today?

嗯…我说的就是这种水呢！: Hmm… This is the water I was talking about!

您确定要这种吗？: Are you sure that's what you want?

嗯…我说的就是这种木柴呢！: Hmm… This is the wood I was talking about!
弗利茨这个老家伙还是没有露出任何破绽，杰拉尔没有找到什么秘方的线索！: Old Fritz's cooking is still perfect, and Gerald hasn't found any clues as to the secret recipe!
这可惹恼我了！: This is really starting to get my goat!

是穷人就乖乖的待在梅尔区！: The poor should obey their betters and stay in Merl!

哎呦，这不是金嘛！今天又在玩正义游戏啊？哈哈哈，年轻人就是有活力！: Hey! This isn't gold! Are you playing vigilante again today? Ha-ha-ha! You youngsters are so full of life!
好啦好啦！我们大人在讲事情呢，到旁边去过家家！: Alright! Alright! The grown-ups are talking now. Shoo now, go and play!

每次在里希塔乐原野上看到那些脏兮兮的便宜土拨鼠，我就烦心！: Every time I see those dirty Martins on the Lighthalzen Plains, it makes me so mad!
帮我教训一下那些脏兮兮的小家伙吧！: Help me teach those dirty little rodents a lesson!
啊，真是个勤快的年轻人！: Ah, what a diligent young hero!
我本来觉得修剪花园的凡尔纳嫌疑最大，但是那天贝鲁妮.托纳的表现太奇怪的了。: I thought Verne was the most likely culprit, but Berenie Toner was acting strangely that day.
从来没有出过错的她，竟然打碎了一个花瓶！: She had never made a mistake before, but she broke a vase!
我觉得，她心里有鬼！绿宝石的失踪与她之间一定有蹊跷，: I think she's got something to hide... There must be some connection between the disappearance of the emerald and her strange behavior.

我也希望这件事能早点水落石出！: I really hope that this matter can be resolved soon!
其实，贝鲁尼·托纳是我最信任的佣人呢。: Actually, Berenie Toner is my most trusted servant...
要不是到这个地步，我也不会去怀疑她啊。: If it hadn't been for this suspicion, I would not have doubted her.
除了贝姨，她是在我家工作最久的一位了，贝姨偶尔会健忘，但是贝鲁尼·托纳却一次差错: Berenie has worked for my family the longest, but occasionally forgets things, but Berenie Toner has never made a mistake and is a very careful person.

啊，你找我有什么事？: Huh? What do you need from me?

正巧帕特先生家的活又忙。: It so happens that Mr. Pat's family is becoming increasingly busy right now...

恩？你是哪里来的家伙？: Huh? Where did you come from?

帕里斯这么慌张，真的很可疑啊。: Paris is in such a panic. It's really very suspicious...
你就眼睁睁的放他走了？还没看出猫腻来么？大少爷怎么会慌张的逃走呢？: You just let him go? You didn't see anything else suspicious? Why did the young master run away in a panic?

你还有我，我会赚钱养你的。: We'll make enough money to get it all back.
科技是第一生产力！！！: Science and technology are the way forward!

好困……好想回家睡觉……: So sleepy... I want to go home and sleep...

你的出现带给了我希望！: Your presence here gives me hope!

按我们共和国的俗语说，您拥有一颗波利心！柔软善良！: As we say back home, you have a Poring heart! Soft and kind!
如果准备好了，就来找我，我会将您送到达纳托斯之塔中。: When you are ready, come to me and I will send you to Thanatos Tower.
您准备好进入塔中了吗？: Are you ready to enter the tower?

而你，将为我们带来希望。: While you will bring us hope.

里希塔乐卫队，训练有素，刚正不阿！: A Lighthalzen guard. Well-trained and upright!
欢迎来到光影之都里希塔乐！（请小心梅尔区里那些脏兮兮的穷人！）: Welcome to Lighthalzen, the City of Light and Darkness! (Please beware the dirty poor residents of Merl!)

嘘！就当你什么都没看到！: Shh! Just when you think there's nothing in sight!

呼~！！不信上不去~~~唔唔呜~！~！~！: Phew!!! I can't believe it.... Waaah! ! !

昏迷中的玛嘉雷特迟迟没有苏醒的迹象，赛依连的治疗也于事无补，幸好他没有放弃，在医: Magaleta was in a coma and showed no sign of awakening. Seyren's treatment did not help either. Fortunately, he did not give up. They encountered Dr. Duke, an employee of the laboratory, in the medical room. After making a deal with the doctor, he checked Magaleta over. To the surprise of Seyren and our adventurer, Magaleta was caught in a nightmare. In order to save Magaleta, our adventurer resolutely entered into Magaleta's dream.
结果没有让人失望，玛嘉雷特安全的醒来，告别了医生杜克，众人继续向地下研究所所二层: The risk was well worth it, and Magaleta woke up safely. They said goodbye to Doctor Duke and went on to investigate the second floor of the underground laboratory. They met Peynaud, a ventriloquist who was confined to the prison there as a human test subject, and his teddy bear partner Hence. Peynauds condition was worsening. Fortunately, Badger appeared and told the party how to temporarily avert the mutation.
令众人惊喜的事，玩偶熊亨丝竟然知道迪文几人的下落，为了拯救伙伴，赛依连和冒险者决: To everyone's surprise, the Teddy Bear Hence knew the whereabouts of Deeven and the others. In order to save his partner, Seyren and our adventurer decided to rescue Peynaud and Hence from the prison. On the way to find the key to the prison, Magaleta fell into a nightmare again. This time, Seyren decided to go into her dream with our adventurer. When Magaleta woke up, they were all horrified to discover that what had happened in Magaleta's dream had actually happened.
毒气的出现使巴吉尔夫妇身体异变情况变得越来越剧烈，亨丝无意中唱出了巴吉尔夫妇的相: The influx of poison gas advanced Badger's mutation dramatically. Hence inadvertently sang the love song most special to Badger and restored his sanity. Just as things were looking up, Peynaud began attacking his companions. In order to free Peynaud, Magaleta performed a healing spell and Peynaud simply ceased to exist. Worse still, after Badger's final performance, he also disappeared before the eyes of our heroes.
一群人伤心的同时却更加坚定了拯救同伴的信念，在利力的提示，冒险者在录像带中发现: Our heroes were grieved, but their resolve to save their companions had been strengthened. Thanks to Lili, our heroes found out the truth behind their companions' disappearance on a videotape. While rejoicing over their new clue, our heroes were caught by the laboratory's mastermind -- Wolfchev.
在那里，他们见到了失踪的塞尼亚一行人，塞尼亚一众已经被宝勒世伏控制失去了理智开始: They soon met the missing Cenia, who was under Wolfchev's control and started attacking Seyren and our adventurer. Shortly after, the Mysterious Wing Badge restored Cenia's senses, and our team of six heroes were reunited again. However, their joy was short-lived, and Wolfchev was nowhere to be seen. The crisis was far from over.

嘿嘿嘿嘿，有了这些，我终于可以搞点事了……哦，你还在呢？谢了啊！: Hey, hey, hey, hey! With all this, I can finally get something done... Oh? Are you still there? Thanks!

嘿呀！光是看到这些小瓶子，我就打起精神了！我要好好经营我的理发店！: Hey! Just seeing these little bottles refreshes me! I want to run my barber shop as best I can!
听不懂我说的话么？我要十个！: Can't you understand what I'm saying? I want ten!
这还差不多，你可以走了！: That's about right. You can go now!

足够了，谢谢！果然拜托给你是正确的选择呢。: That's enough. Thank you! Entrusting you was really the right choice.
啊……我想你没有搞对数目。要不要再检查一下？: Ah... I don't think you have the right number. Would you like to check it again?

是吗，艾利尔让你来的啊……: Really? Eleo asked you to come here?
谢谢你，我知道了。没什么事的话，请你离开吧。: Thanks. I've got it. If you have nothing else to say, please leave.
什么？加纳少爷居然这么说？: What? Master Ghana actually say that?
哎哟喂，这算哪门子的解决啊……真叫人头疼……: Yikes! What kind of solution is that? What a pain!

请你认真一点，这件事对所有人都很重要。如果收集不到，我会拜托别人。: Please be serious... This is very important to me! If you can't do it, I'll ask someone else.
谢谢你，辛苦了。有了这些，我一定能查出真相……: Thanks for your hard work. With all this, I'm sure I can find out the truth...
什么？哥哥让你转达我的？！: What? My brother sent you to me?
我知道了。其实我也感觉到了危险，但是对地下调查，我不会停止！: I know. Actually, I also feel it's dangerous, but I won't stop the underground investigation!
请放心，我会保护好自己……: Don't worry, I will protect myself...
主人，你回来啦！见到你很开心！: Master, you're back! I'm glad to see you!
额，太累了，我想我得找个地儿休息一下！: I'm so tired... I think I need to find a place to rest.
好脏呀，得趁主人回来前赶紧打扫完！: It's dirty. You have to clean it up before the owner comes back.
看我！美少女…变变变…变出扫帚！: Watch me! Beautiful girl... Whip out the broom!
想要建造可以过来找我哦~主人~: You can come to me if you want to build, master.
嗯…让我想想今天的报纸放在哪了: Umm... Let me see where I put today's newspaper.
嗯…啊对不起，主人，我刚刚开小差了！: Umm... Oh, I'm sorry, master, I just wandered off for a while!
我想有张软绵绵的床，然后躺在上面睡觉，对，就是这样！: I want a soft bed I can lie down on and sleep in. That's it!
我想我有点累，我得小坐一小会！: I think I'm a little tired. I'm going to sit down for a while!
让我黛利拉把屋子收拾的干干净净吧！: Let me get your house spick-and-span!
地面怎么这么脏！一定是这群调皮的小家伙！: Why is the floor so dirty! It must be these rapscallions!
确定要进行一键拆卸吗？: Are you sure you want use Quick Dismantle?
这些线索还是太少，再仔细找找吧！: We need more clues! Try looking again!
那些传说随着岁月渐渐消散，如今的我们能否触摸到过去的一丝真实？: As legends fade away, can we now touch the truth hidden in the past?

年轻人，我可以确定，就是这枚碎片被赋予了时间魔法！: Adventurer, I am sure that this shard has been imbued with the magic of time!
它原本就是过去中的某段时间流，经历了剧烈的魔法冲击变为碎片，成了连接现实与过去的: It was originally from a period of time in the past, and became a shard after experiencing an intense magic shock. This altered it into a conduit, connecting the present to the past.
而我感觉到这碎片上的魔力痕迹，来自A.W400年……是那段米德加尔特最为黑暗、也: And I feel that the magic on the shard is from A.W. 400... It was Midgarts's darkest and most tragic era!
年轻人，如果打开碎片，你也许有机会亲眼见证那段历史。: Young adventurer, if you open the shard, you may have a chance to witness that time with your own eyes.
我这里刚好有一道魔力卷轴，对碎片使用的话，说不定就能开启隐藏其中的时空之门！: I happen to have a magic scroll here. If we use the shard, we may be able to open the Time Gate hidden within it.
好了，现在你试着对碎片使用这道卷轴吧！: Okay, now you try to use this scroll with the shard!
是时空之门！没想到它真的出现了……: It's the Time Gate! I never expected it to actually appear...
去吧，年轻人！去打开它，探索那段尘封的历史吧……: Go, young adventurer. Open it and explore the dust-laden annals of history...
是否确定打开过去的入口？: Are you sure to open the entrance to the past?
居然还有人类幸存么。: There are still human survivors here?
现在，没有人再能抵挡魔王梦罗克。米德加尔特，终究还是要覆灭了。: Now, nobody can stop Demon King Morroc. Midgarts will finally be destroyed.
原本奥丁陛下派遣我们到来，就是为了防止这样的事发生。: His Majesty Odin sent us here to prevent such a thing from happening.

我刚刚看到了，有个人类剑士在往塔的正门走去。: I just saw a human swordsman walking toward the main entrance of the tower.
原来如此。到现在也不肯服输吗……: So, that's it! You still refuse to lose?
人类啊，我不想再看到有人死去了。: Human, I don't want to see anybody else die.
这是我最后仅存的力量，我把它借给你。请你去阻止那个剑士吧。: This is the last of my strength. I'll lend it to you. Please stop the swordsman.
梦罗克大人的法阵已经启动，就连神族都束手无策。你居然还肖想击败他？！: Morroc's curse is in effect. Even the gods are helpless. You want still to defeat him?!
真是不知天高地厚的人类！！: This human doesn't understand his own insignificance!
不好，这个人就要去塔里了……要赶快阻止他才行！: No, this man is going to the tower... Stop him as soon as possible!
啊，我能感觉到……有谁在呼唤我离去……: Ah, I can feel... Who is calling me away?
你就是呼唤我的人吗？: Are you the one calling me?
谢谢，好心的陌生人。但我非前进不可。: Thank you, kind stranger. But I have to move forward.
哪怕将灵魂出卖给这把剑……我也必须击败梦罗克！: Even if you sell your soul to this sword... I must defeat Morroc.
就算最后我会被恶魔所吞噬，但战斗——这就是我的归宿。至于结局，就不是我能考虑的事: Even if in the end I am devoured by demons, in battle - that's where I will meet my end. As for the outcome, it's not something I care to think about.
就让我放手一搏吧。: I must give it everything I have.
谢谢。想不到在最后的时刻，还能有人和我说说话。: Thank you. I never expected that, at the final moment, I would meet someone I could relate to.

都在里面看到了什么？: What did you see in it?

看，塔边上的雕像正在发光。上面的魔力波动和时间碎片应该是相同的。: Look, the statue on the side of the tower is shining. The above magic waves and time shards should be the same.
你把碎片摆上去看看？: Place the shards and see what happens.
小心原野的那些金属波利！他们可不是南门的波利，也不知道是受了什么影响，性格极其凶: Watch out for the Metal Porings in the field! They are not the Poring of the South Gate. I don't know what is going on with them, but they are extremely ferocious!
这个研究所可不是你看到的那么简单，那些实验体又狂化了！: This laboratory is not as simple as it seems. Those experiment subjects are out of control!
在这光鲜亮丽的贝勒区之下居然有这种阴暗腐朽的地方，我只能告诉你万事小心了！: There is a dark and decadent place hiding beneath the bright exterior of Baylor. All I can tell you is... be careful!
赛伊连身上的秘密之翼徽章掉落在了地上……: Seyren's Mysterious Wing Badge fell to the ground...
和梦里一模一样的事情发生了！: The same thing happened in the dream!
这是……和玛嘉雷特梦境里一样的场景！: This is... the same scene as Magaleta's dream!

偷偷告诉你，希芙大人那里也有各种百搭的新奇家具……不过前提是，你得逗她开心~: I can tell you in secret that Sif also has a variety of fancy furniture... But you'll have to amuse her to get it.
哎呀，原来你想知道关于建造的事情吗。真没办法，那就告诉你吧~: So, what did you want to know about construction? There's no way around it, let me tell you.

尽量多的收集家具，互相搭配，打造最美丽的家园吧！: Collect as much furniture as possible and match each piece perfectly to create your dream home!

同时，多个同类型的家具也只会生效评分最高的家具！: If you have multiple pieces of furniture of the same type in your house, only the furniture with the highest rating will contribute to your Home Rating!

您是谁呀？我不认识你！: Who are you? I don't know you!

这样下去的话，我可打听不到她的下落啊！: If it goes on like this, I'll never her whereabouts!
没什么！你听错了！可靠的伙伴啊！快帮我想个办法融入这里的大家吧！: Nothing! I didn't say anything! What a reliable partner! Help me find a way to integrate into this place!

您赶紧让他换一身具有梅尔区特色的当地服装吧！: You can quickly change him into some local attire.

你说大家不和我说话是因为服装的问题？: People aren't talking to me because of my clothes?
为什么啊，华丽名贵的衣服难道不好嘛？: Why? Is it not good to have gorgeous and expensive clothes?
好吧，那我就听你的，换上破衣服！: Okay, then I'll listen to you and change into rags!
你来帮我换吧！: Come and help me get changed!
我从来没穿过这么透气贴身的衣服！这样一来，大家就不会排斥我了吧！: I've never worn such freeing clothes! They can't exclude me now!
好！我要继续我的梅尔区大冒险啦！这次也是多亏了你呀！我可靠的伙伴！: Excellent! I'll now continue my big adventure in Merl! Thanks this time, again! My a reliable partner!

哦，你们两个挺面生啊！: Oh! You two stick out like a sore thumb! Who are you?

没看出来，你做得还真不懒！ 今天起，你小子就跟着我混了！: I didn't notice, but you're really not the lazy type! From today on, our fates are entwined!

快让我看看这些璀璨的小宝贝！: Let me see these bright little babies!

我终于等到这一天了！！我要嫁给男爵了！: Finally... The day I've been waiting for! I'm going to marry a baron!
婚礼马上就开始了，我的得力助手，赶紧入座吧！: The wedding will begin soon. My friend, please take your seat.
我，梅尔区的丽安，终于成为了男爵夫人玛德琳！成为了贝勒区上流社会一份子！: I, Lianne of Merl, have finally became Baroness Madeleine! I have become a member of the upper-class of Baylor!
请玛德琳小姐与卡罗尔男爵就位，婚礼就要开始了，让我们一起见证……: Invite Miss Madeleine and Baron Carol to be seated. The wedding is about to begin. Let's witness it together.
等等！我有话要说！: Wait! I have something to say!
我调查了一下这位著名的戏剧新星！: I have looked into this famous actress's past...
我们美丽的玛德琳小姐其实来自于那个肮脏落后的梅尔区！: Our beautiful Miss Madeleine actually comes from the dirty, backward district of Merl!
诸位请看，这是玛德琳小姐的银行记录，存款是0！: Look, this is Miss Madeleine's bank account statement. She has nothing!
这样一位贫穷的明星嫁给我们的男爵先生，除了图他的钱还会为了什么呢？: Why would such a poor star marry our Baron, other than to get her hands on his money?
我的钱全转给卡罗尔男爵了啊！: All of my money has been transferred to Baron Carol!
是吗，你的意思是，我们的男爵先生吞并了一位梅尔区姑娘的钱？: Really? Do you mean to say that our Baron swallowed up all the money of a poor Merl girl?
相信诸位已经认清这个女人的真面目了！: I think we can all see the true face of this wicked woman!
玛德琳，别说了，你给我滚回梅尔区！别说了！: Madeleine! That's enough! Just go back to Merl! Quiet!
卡罗尔！别找借口了，你这个混蛋！把我的钱还给我！: Carol! Don't make excuses, you cretin! Give me my money back!
哼，这份契约可是写的一清二楚！你所有的财产都是男爵先生的了！亲口说的话，还记得吗: Well, this contract is very well written! All of your property is now the Baron's! Do you remember what you actually said?
我们走吧，卡罗尔男爵，这样的女人还是梅尔区更适合她！: Let's go, Baron Carol. Such a woman is better suited to life in Merl.
你还来找我做什么？我现在成了整个贝勒区的笑柄……一切破碎，一切成灰。: What are you doing here? I'm now the laughingstock of all Baylor... Everything is ruined.
我所有的钱都花在了男爵与这场婚礼上 ……: All of my money went to the Baron and that farcical wedding...
你能回答我几个问题么？: Can you answer me a few questions?
等你准备好了，就来找我吧。: When you're ready, come and see me.
谢谢你，或许我真的错了……: Thank you. Maybe I was wrong...
有人告诉了我，丽安...玛德琳婚变的事。: Someone told me about Lianne, or Madeleine's, marriage.
我好不容易打听到了玛德琳在贝勒区的住处，但却没人在家。: I managed to find Madeleine's residence in Baylor, but nobody was home.
我知道你和她比较熟，所以……: I know you know her well, so...
我很担心她，从前她就是个情绪很敏感的人，您能帮我找找她么？拜托了！: I'm worried about her. She was always such a sensitive person... Could you help me find her? I'm counting on you!
看来玛德琳并不在她常去的贝勒大酒店附近，这可不太对。: It seems that Madeleine is not at her favorite haunt, Baylor Hotel. This is quite strange...
她也不在珠宝店，难道真的出事了？: She wasn't in the jewelry store either... Could something really have happened to her?
那位玛德琳竟然出现在肮脏的梅尔区？！这次婚变让她疯了吧？哦呵呵呵~: That Madeleine was in the dirty Merl district?! Could the marriage have driven her crazy? Ah!
谁知道呢？反正我们过去看热闹吧，只要离那些肮脏的穷人远些应该没事。: Who knows? Anyway, let's go and see how this drama unfold. As long as we stay away from those dirty poor people, we should be all right.
怎么一脸慌张的样子？: Why do you look so flustered?
我只是想回梅尔区看看，并没有想不开。: I just wanted to go back to Merl. I'm not too broken up about all this.
这里的大家都是发自内心的喜欢我的表演呢。: Everyone here likes my heartfelt performances.
对不起，现在的我无法面对你……: Sorry, I can't face you right now...
谢谢你，冒险者大人，知道她没事就好了，我会一直等她回来。: Thank you, adventurer. Just knowing she's okay is good enough for me. I'll wait for her to come back when she's ready.
冒险者大人，有件事想找你商量……: Adventurer, there's something I want to talk to you about...
其实我对丽安，也就是玛德琳一直没有死心。: In fact, I have never given up on Lianne, well, Madeleine that is.
对于她的背叛，欺骗与舍弃，我一点都没有怪她。: I don't blame her at all for her betrayal, her deception, and her abandonment.
我希望她能自由的追求自己的梦想，也明白我并不能给她帮助……: I hope she can pursue her dream with complete freedom, and I understand that I can't help her...
呜啊！为什么突然打我？！: Aaah! Why did you just hit me like that, out of the blue?!
我，我要想办法挽回她的心！: I, I want to find a way to save her weary heart!
我需要您的协助，冒险者大人，您愿意协助我？: I need your help, adventurer. Would you like to help me?
我不像吟游诗人那么浪漫，只能想到一些笨拙的办法。: I'm not as romantic as a Wandering Bard. I can only think of clumsy, obvious ways to express myself.
您能去里希塔乐原野替我采一束名为勿忘我的花吗？一束就够了。: Can you go to Lighthalzen Plains and pick me some flowers called Forget-Me-Nots? One bunch is enough.
啊，就是它，这束不起眼的小花！: Ah, that's it. This humble bunch of flowers...
您知道勿忘我的花语么？: You know, Myosotis are also known as Forget-Me-Nots... Do you know what they say about these flowers?
你认识玛德琳对吧，之前关于她婚礼上出的事，现在整个贝勒区都知道了。: You know Madeleine, don't you? The whole of Baylor knows what happened at her wedding.
所以我暗中调查了一下卡罗尔男爵，果然有了发现！: So, I secretly investigated Baron Carol and found out something!
关于这件事的报告我整理在文件夹里了，你保管好，然后和玛德琳一起报警吧！: I've compiled a report on this matter in this folder here. Take it... I'll call the police and await them with Madeleine!
啊啊啊！那些文件被…！是谁？: Ahhh! Those documents were...! Who did this?
对了，我怎么没想到呢！将碎片搜集起来，用复原魔法说不定能恢复！: Yes, why didn't I think of this?! Collect the pieces... Maybe they can be restored with healing magic!
糟了，碎片都飘走了！我们得赶紧将它们找回来！: Oh, no! The pieces are gone! We have to get them back quickly!
这些并不是全部，但没关系，我们已经尽全力了！: This isn't all of them, but it doesn't matter. We've done our best!
那么就让我们来试试复原魔法吧！: So, let's try the healing magic!
照片有些不清楚，但还是能看清一些的……: The photos are not clear, but you can still make out some of them...
依稀可见情报上是一份名单与报告。: A list and report are faintly visible among the documents...
卡罗……男爵曾秘密举行过 12……场……婚……: Carol... has been the groom at 12... weddings...
卡罗尔这样有钱的男爵，结那么多次婚很正常啊！: It's normal for a wealthy baron to be married this many times!
但是根据我的调查，他结那么多次婚的目的恐怕都是为了骗取女方的钱……: But according to the information, the reason he was betrothed so many times was to cheat women of their money...
……我不相信，我那些小积蓄对一个男爵来说真的那么诱人吗？: ...Were my small savings really so attractive to a baron?
恐怕是的，根据我的调查，卡罗尔男爵其实早就破产了。: I'm afraid so. According to my investigation, Baron Carol went bankrupt a long time ago.
你和他交往时难道没发现什么古怪吗？: Didn't you find anything strange in your relationship with him?
唉，我也已经尽力了，希望你能继续帮助这个可怜的姑娘。: Well, I've done my best. I hope you will continue to help this poor girl.
关于金说的话，我好好思索了一下，果然有些奇怪……: As for what Kim said, I thought about it for a while, and it was a bit strange...
男爵知道我的底细后并不惊讶。: The Baron was not surprised to learn of my past.
我怀疑男爵与杰拉尔的雇主有关……: I suspect that the Baron has something to do with Gerald's employer...
拜托了，冒险者，帮我调查一下男爵吧，我觉得这场婚礼的背后有阴谋的味道……: Come on, adventurer! Help me investigate the baron. I think there's a huge conspiracy behind this whole wedding scam...
只有你，仍是我值得相信的人。: You are the only person I can trust.
我就知道计划一定会成功！: I knew the plan would succeed!
那个笨女人我早就知道她是梅尔区来的了，还真以为我会娶她！: That silly woman... I knew she was from Merl all along, and she really thought I would marry her?!
要不是为了她的钱，我堂堂男爵会看上她？: If it were not for her money, someone as noble as I would not even have looked twice at her!
哼，男爵先生，我对你做的那些肮脏勾当没兴趣，只要酬劳按时到我账户上就好。: Well, Baron... I'm not interested in the dirty things you do, as long as the money comes into my account on time.
别急嘛！等我再骗上几个梅尔区的傻姑娘，捞上一大笔钱再说。: Don't worry! Wait till I trick a couple more silly girls from Merl and make even more money.
我得把这一切告诉玛德琳！: I have to tell Madeleine all about this!
我就知道这里面一定有猫腻！！: I knew there was something fishy about this!
我还是太天真了，是我们输了……: I was so naive... We lost...
或许我真的应该回到梅尔区生活，但还会有人在乎我么？: Maybe I really should just go back to Merl. But will anyone bother with me anymore?
这一天终于来临了！我做好了准备，要狠狠教训一下这两个骗子！: The day has finally arrived! I'm ready to teach those two cheats a lesson!
你能帮我将这根血迹树枝丢在男爵家里嘛？这里面有我为他们精心准备的[c][ffff: Can you help me leave this Bloody Dead Branch at the baron's house? There's a very special [c][ffff00]surprise[-][/c] waiting for them within it!
呜哇哇哇！我的天哪这些怪物是从哪里来的？杰拉尔快救我！: Waaaah! My gosh! Where did these monsters come from? Gerald, save me!
请我做保镖，你出不起这个价钱，自己收拾烂摊子吧！我先带着报酬告辞了！: You want a bodyguard? You can't afford me! Clean up your mess by yourself! I'll take my reward and be off...
谢谢你...我的命是你救的…: Thank you. You saved my life...
什么？你要我把钱还给那个笨女人？我才不要！: What? You want me to give the money back to that silly woman? I won't do it!
拿出血迹树枝: Take Out the Bloody Dead Branch
好好好！我这就把钱还给她！可恶啊！你们这些混蛋！: Alright! I'll give her the money back! Damn it! You filth!
看来计划十分顺利！哈哈哈！: It seems the plan is going very well! Ha-ha-ha!
我想明白了一件事，我想生活的地方，是一个没有人在意家庭出身，可以随自己的意愿表演: There's one thing I want to understand. The place I want to live is somewhere where no one cares about my family background and I can perform in freedom.
没错，而且，那里还有一个人在等我……: Yes, and there's someone waiting for me there...
啊，丽安，原来你在这里！赶快回家吧，我今天做了新鲜的野菜杂烩！: Then what are you doing here? Come home quickly. I made a fresh wild vegetable chowder today.
冒险者大人，您也在这里吗~多亏了您为我采来的勿忘草，我才能和丽安重新和好！: Adventurer! You're here too? Thanks to the Forget-Me-Nots you picked for me, I have been accepted back into Lianne's arms!
好啊，希尔法，原来勿忘草是冒险者大人帮你采的！: So, Hilfa, the adventurer helped you pick the flowers...?
哈哈哈哈，被发现了！: Ha-ha-ha! The cat is out of the bag!
比起歌剧名伶玛德琳，还是穷女孩丽安更适合我。: Compared with Madeleine, a famous stage actress, the life of poor Lianne is more better-suited to me.
希尔法，我们回去吧，回到我们的梅尔区！: Hilfa, let's go back to Merl!
也谢谢你，无论贫穷还是富有都帮助着我的冒险者！或许，幸福真的与贫富无关呢！: I'd like to thank you, too... for helping me, whether rich or poor! Perhaps happiness has nothing to do with wealth or poverty.
真是的，弄了半天你就是个凑热闹的路人啊！快滚开！: Over such a long time, too.. You really love getting in the thick of things, adventurer! Get out of here!
我出生于高贵的贝勒区。: I was born in the noble Baylor district.
我猜猜……你是不是得到了新的时光碎片？: Let me guess... Did you get a new time shard?
既然有了新的碎片，我们就和之前一样，开启里面的时空之门吧。: Now we have new shards, let's open the Time Gate like before.
不知道这一次又会见到什么样的过去呢……来，给你这道魔法卷轴！: I don't know what kind of past events you will see this time. Come on, take this magic scroll!
很快就是仪式的时间了。得找一个人类来协助才行……: It will soon be time for the ceremony. You'll have to find a human to help...
嗯？那边的人，请过来一下！: Huh? You, over there! Come here, please!
你是人类对吧？怎么会出现在这里？: You are a human, correct? What are you doing here?
难道是通过彩虹桥误入的神域？: Did you accidentally cross Bifrost and wander into the divine realm?
好啦，你不要害怕。这里是神域阿斯加德，我是奥丁陛下的神官拉瑞尔。: Alright, don't be afraid. This is Asgard, the divine realm. I am Larreal, the High Priest of His Majesty Odin.
我们刚好需要一名人类帮助完成仪式，你要是乐意的话就随我走吧。: We need a human to help with this ceremony. If you're interested, follow me.
嗯……那我和你解释一下。: Umm... Let me explain it to you.
之前魔王梦罗克在人间与达纳托斯决战，达纳托斯虽然获得了胜利，但他的灵魂和魔剑已融: Long ago, Demon King Morroc and Thanatos fought in the human world, but after the war, Thanatos' soul and Magic Sword began to merge into one.
在那之后达纳托斯便失去意识，和魔剑沉睡在死亡之塔的深处。如今，塔中不稳定的巨大魔: After Thanatos lost consciousness, he began his deep sleep in the Tower of Doom, his sword by his side. Today, the great unstable magic in the tower still poses a threat to the Nine Worlds.
所以，诸神决定举办封印仪式，将这股魔力长期封印在死亡之塔里。: Therefore, the gods decided to hold a ceremony to seal this magic in the tower forevermore.
仪式的前半部分已经完成，现在正好需要你这样的中庭之人参与。: The first half of the ceremony has been completed. You are now required in the atrium.
你是否听明白了？愿意参加仪式吗？: Do you understand? Would you like to attend the ceremony?
好。那请先收下这四个元素石。: Alright. Please accept these four Element Stones first.
这附近设置了四个法阵，你将石依次摆入，仪式就会继续了。: There are four magic arrays nearby. Place the stones upon them in turn, and the ceremony will proceed.
这样我们就可以开始最后的仪式了。: Then we can begin the final ceremony.
用燃烧的火雷点燃死亡之塔: Use the Raging Thunderfire to ignite the Tower of Doom.
让流动的冰风加以封印之锁: Allow the Flowing Frostwind to solidify the seal.
跟随从未改变过的命运星辰: Follow the unchanging stars of destiny.
完成了，这就是封印那座死亡之塔的神器——奥术魔方。: It is done. This is the Tesseract, the artifact that seals the Tower of Doom.
愿它能给人间带去平静……: May it bring peace to the world...
年轻人，这次你见到了什么？: Young adventurer, what did you see this time?
原来众神为了封印达纳托斯和魔剑，还做出了这么惊人的神器……: Originally, the gods made this amazing artifact to seal Thanatos and the magic sword.
不多说了，年轻人，你看那边的雕像又在发光。: Young adventurer, look! The statue over there is shining again.
去把时间碎片放上去吧，或许会有什么意外收获。: Go and put the time shards on it. Maybe something unexpected will happen.
上面记录着一些家园的介绍。: Some Home-related details are recorded above.
……我……突然感觉不太好。: ...I... suddenly I don't feel very well.
希芙大人……怎么突然就消失了……: Sif... Why did you suddenly disappear?
等等，冒险者！我好像能感觉到希芙大人在和我说话！: Adventurer, wait! I can feel Sif speaking to me!
希芙大人说，她来到人间时过于匆忙，刚刚和奥尼尔对峙时又消耗了很多魔力……: Sif said that she was summoned to our world unexpectedly, and has just confronted O'Neill. She has consumed a lot of her magic power...
啊！她现在只能保持灵体的姿态行动，所以我们都看不见她！她说有办法可以帮她恢复原样: Ah...! She can only maintain her spirit form for now, so we can't see her! She said there was a way to help her recover her strength!
等等……我需要换个位置才能听清，冒险者，来水池旁找我！: Wait... I need to go somewhere more peaceful. Adventurer, come to the pool and find me!
希望露琪亚每天都开心。: I just wish Lucia could be happy every day.
欢迎光临，请随意试穿。: Welcome! Please feel free to try it on.
哥哥每天都在努力工作，我也要加油！: Brother is working hard every day, so I also want to do my best!
请叫我里希塔乐小帮手。: Just call me Lighthalzen's Little Helper!
冒险者，我妹妹的运动鞋丢了！: Adventurer, my sister lost her sneakers!
请一定要帮帮她。: Please be sure to help her.
这可怜的孩子过两天就是学校的运动会。: That poor girl will be at the school sports meet in two days.
我可不希望她光着脚去参加运动会。: I don't want her to go barefoot.
没有看到莱特妹妹的鞋子。: I haven't seen Wright's sister's sneakers.
一只破旧的已经穿了洞的小鞋。: A worn-out shoe with a hole in it.
这可太糟糕了，鞋破成这样，还少了一只，看来是没有办法再穿了。谢谢你帮我找鞋子，我: The shoes are worn and one is missing. It seems there's no way she can wear them again. Thank you for helping me look for the shoes. I'll try again.
可怜的孩子，我无法想象她光脚跑步的样子。: Poor child, I can't imagine her barefoot running.
如果要买一双新鞋，就必须去贝勒区买。: If you want to buy a new pair of shoes, you'll have to go to Baylor.
所有的服装和鞋都只能在贝勒区才买的到。: All new clothes and shoes can only be bought in Baylor.
真的吗？这可怎么好意思。: Really? This may be asking too much...
我是说，好心的冒险者，你有空的话。: That's to say, good-hearted adventurer, if you have time...
留在这里帮我多打一份工吧！: Could you stay here and take on another job for me?
我真不知道该如何谢谢您！: I really don't know how to thank you!
那么这一推车的货物，请您帮我送去梅尔区的飞空艇。: This cart's cargo... Please help me get it to the airship in Merl.
今天老板给我们的工作是获取一些能源。: Today, our boss tasked us with the job of getting some energy.
今天我也来帮忙！！: I'm back to help again today!
虽然不如雷根贝勒的科技能源那样耐用，: Although they're not as reliable as Rekenber's newest energy source...
但风能对于贫穷的梅尔区也是重要的能源！: Wind energy is also an important energy source for the poor of Merl!
请从飓风魔身上获得风能之心。: Please go and get some Wind Energy Hearts from Typhoons.
我也收集到了一些，不过不多呢！: I also collected some, but not many!
这样我又能多和老板要些工钱呢！: Now I can ask my boss for a raise!
今天老板给我们的工作是修理城外坏掉的升降机。: Today, our boss has tasked us with the job of repairing the broken elevator outside the city.
今天我又来帮忙啦！！: I'm back to help again today!
我知道这真的不是个容易的事。: I know it's really not easy.
你说什么呢！不要和我们见外！: What did you say?! Don't be awkward!
谢谢你们，真的，神会保佑你们这些好心人！: Thank you. Really, the gods bless the kind!
这些是这几天赚到的所有工钱！: These are all the wages earned these past few days!
不知道这些够不够在贝勒区买一双最普通的运动布鞋。: I don't know if it's enough to buy the most basic pair of sneakers in Baylor.
我亲爱的莱特，你确定就只有这些吗？: My dear Wright, are you sure that's all there is?
你确定这是你的选择吗？这将会很昂贵！: Are you sure that's what you want? That will be very expensive!

真的吗？她原谅我了？还要请我帮忙？: Really? She's forgiven me? And she wants me to help?
她需要一种非常柔软的材料来制作帽子的内衬，你知道从哪里找到这种材料么？: She needs a very soft material to make the inner lining of her hat. Do you know where to find something like that?

看起来可以收集绒毛了。: It looks like you can collect some fur from it.
啊，你回来了。找到柔软的材料了么？应该非常难找吧！: Ah! You're back? Did you find a very, very soft material? It must've been very difficult to search for such a thing!
啊，这是疯兔的绒毛么？真柔软啊，的确是制作内衬的好材料呢！: Ah! Is this Lunatic fur? It's so soft! It's perfect for the lining!
你怎么会想到用疯兔绒毛来制作内衬呢？: How did you come up with the idea of using Lunatic fur to make the lining?
啊，还要保密的啊？那我不问了。: Ah? It's a secret, huh? In that case, I won't ask.
明天贝雷帽就能做成了，明天你再过来吧。: The beret will be ready tomorrow. See you then!
这是谢礼，请收好！: Here's your thank-you gift! Take it!
你来了啊，帽子已经制作完成了。: You're here! The hat has been made!
需要我去把帽子送给捣蛋小猴么？: Need me to give the hat to the monkey?
我想拜托你帮我把捣蛋小猴喊过来，我要亲手送给它，然后跟它成为朋友。: I want you to help me call that Trick or Treat Monkey over. I want to give it the hat and become friends with it!
冒险者，是不是布兰琪又需要我的帮助了？: Adventurer, does Blanche need my help again?
布兰琪让我邀请你到她那里去一趟。: Blanche asked me to invite you over.
去她那里？！会不会很尴尬啊？她真的已经原谅我了么？: She want to see me?! Would that be embarrassing? Has she really forgiven me?
好的，我跟你去。我要亲自向她道歉！: Okay, I'll go with you. I want to apologize to her personally!
布兰琪姐姐，对不起，我再也不随便拿别人的东西了。: Blanche, I'm sorry. I won't take anything again!
嘻嘻，没关系啦，我早就原谅你了呢。: Hee-hee, that's all right. I already forgave you ages ago.
真的哦，这个海军贝雷帽送给你，希望你以后常来玩！: Really! This Navy Beret is for you! I hope you will come and play with me in the future!
真的要送给我么？！哈哈，真是太漂亮了！！谢谢布兰琪姐姐！！: Do you really want to give it to me?! Haha! It's so beautiful! Thank you, Blanche!

1.头饰、时装、部分武器、盾牌、坐骑可以存入冒险手册中，只有已存入的符合当前职业:
1. Headwear, costumes, some weapons, shields, and mounts can be stored in your Adventure Handbook. Only those relating to your current job and corresponding equipment slots can be displayed on this page. Tap to equip.
2. The headwear items on this page are for appearances only and will not grant attributes.
3. Wearing equipment on this page can still trigger Adventure Handbook deposited attributes.
4. You can wear the same headwear in a variety of colors, and any one can grant an activation and depositing reward.
5. Weapons enhancements and card restorations can be deposited in the Adventure Handbook. Only Base Lv40 characters or above, or those with an active Month Card can deposit and withdraw weapons.
1.消耗选择的3个技能符文并花费一定zeny进行融炼，随机获得一个新的技能符文；:
1. Consume 3 selected Skill Runes and spend a certain amount of zeny to smelt them and obtain a random new Skill Rune.
2. The probability of synthesizing Skill Rune of different qualities varies depending on the qualities of the Skill Runes selected. You'll even have a chance of synthesizing higher quality runes.
3. You can synthesize up to Class S Runes.
4. Skill Runes marked as favorites cannot be smelted.
1.消耗选择的5个技能符文，并花费一定zeny进行融炼，随机获得一个当前职业的技:
1. Consume 5 selected Skill Runes and spend a certain amount of zeny to smelt them and obtain a random Skill Rune for your current job.
2. When selecting skill runes of different qualities, the probability of synthesizing skill runes of different qualities will be different.
3. Synthesized runes cannot exceed the highest quality of the selected runes.
4. Skill Runes marked as favorites cannot be smelted.
1.消耗选择的3个同名技能符文并花费一定zeny进行融炼，获得一个随机属性的同名:
1. Consume 3 selected Skill Runes of the same name and spend a certain amount of zeny to smelt them and obtain a Skill Rune of the same new, with random attributes.
2. Runes of different names cannot be smelted.
3. Skill Runes marked as favorites cannot be smelted.
1.符文分为属性符文和技能符文；\n2.技能符文分为13个职业类别，每个类别含S:
1. Runes are divided into Attribute Runes and Skill Runes.
2. Skill Runes are divided into 13 Job types. Each job type consists of three quality levels: S, A, and B.
3. Attribute Runes are divided into Atk Runes, Def Runes, and Special Runes.
4. Skill Rune slots can only be inlaid with Skill Runes of your current job.
5. Each Skill Rune requires three Attribute Runes of specific types to provide it with sufficient energy. Skill Rune effects can only be activated when all three Attribute Rune requirements have been met.
6. The three dots below Skill Rune slots mark the Attribute Runes required for Skill Rune activation.
Red —> Atk Rune
Cyan —> Def Rune
Yellow —> Special Rune
White —> Any Rune
7. You cannot collocate Skill Runes and Attribute Runes of the same name.
8. When changing your job, inlaid runes will be reset.
1.可消耗属性符文，对同类型的属性符文进行升级；\n2.升级可提升属性符文的相关:
1. You can consume Attribute Runes to upgrade Attribute Runes with the same name.
2. Upgrading will increase an Attribute Rune's related attributes.
3. Inlaid Attribute Runes or those marked as favorites cannot be used as materials to upgrade other Attribute Runes.
4. When high-level Attribute Rune are used as materials to upgrade other Attribute Runes, no EXP loss will occur.
1.可消耗放大镜对未鉴定符文进行鉴定；\n2.鉴定后的技能符文无法交易。:
1. You can consume Magnifying Glasses to identify unidentified runes.
2. Identified Skill Runes cannot be traded.
1.完成魔能灌注需要一件主要装备作为容器，1-5件次要装备作为素材，同时需要部分:
1. Completing Enchantment Perfusion requires one item to be used as main equipment, and requires 1-5 items to be used as secondary equipment. Certain materials will also be consumed in the process, and some of the equipment materials need to be upgraded to a certain level before they can be placed in the material column.
2. After Enchantment Perfusion is completed, the equipment and materials used will vanish, and you'll receive brand-new Fusion Enchantment equipment.
3. Fusion Enchantment equipment will fully-inherit the main equipment's refining level, enchants, and slots. Reinforced equipment needs to be restored before it can be used as material.
4. Enhanced and card-infused equipment cannot be used as a material. Enhancement levels and cards need to be removed before equipment can be used as a material.
5. When refining, slotting, or repairing Fusion Enchantment equipment, you don't need to use equipment items of the same name as materials. The main equipment will be consumed instead.
6. Damaged equipment items cannot be used as enchantment perfusion materials.
1.玩家可随时自定义自己家园的名称和家园签名，其中家园名称不得多于八个字，家园签:
1. You can customize the name and signature of your home at any time. The name of your home can be up to eight characters long, and your signature can be up to 20 characters.
2. Improve your home rating to gain corresponding attributes. Working on your home can also help you out in combat!
3. Every time another player enters your home, the popularity of your home will increase by 1. If someone visits your home many times in a single day, popularity will not be increased repeatedly.
1.摆放在家园内的家具会生成评分，评分的值影响评分等级，评分等级的提升可为自己增:
1. Placing furniture in your home will affect its rating, which in turn affects your rating level. Increasing your rating can grant you some extra buffs.
2. When the same type of furniture is placed in more than one location, only the one with the highest rating will contribute to your overall rating. Repeatedly placing the same furniture will not increase the rating repeatedly.
3. Specific rating effects can be viewed in the Home Details interface.
玩家可以通过设置界面对以下功能分别进行设置：\n1.是否允许他人进入自己的家园；:
You can set up the following functions in the Settings interface:
1. You can control whether you want to allow others to enter your home.
2. You can choose to block the use of some furniture with special functions.
3. You can choose whether you want others to be able to use your furniture.
You can customize your settings according to your preferences.
1.玩家可将闲置的宠物放置在宠物房内进行培养；\n2.宠物的等级将会按照自身的战:
1. Pets can be left in your Pet House to automatically upgrade over time.
2. Pet level will be increased according to the percentage of combat experience gained by the pet.
3. Pet Friendship will continuously increase according to the amount of time it is in the Pet House, at a rate of 1 Friendship point per minute.
4. Pet houses of different qualities grant extra pet level and Friendship bonuses.
5. When a pet is removed from your Pet House, its level cannot be greater than your own level.
6. Pet data is shared across all Pet Houses, meaning up to three pets can be upgraded in multiple Pet House simultaneously.
7. Two vacancies will be initially available in your Pet House, and a third slot can be unlocked by spending zeny.
宠物蛋包包规则：\n1.宠物蛋包包是存放玩家已获得宠物蛋的道具。\n2.账号创建:
Pet Egg Bag Rules:
1. Pet Egg Bags are used for storing the pet eggs you acquire during your adventures.
2. You will be given one of these items the first time you enter the game.
3. This is an account-wide item, and characters on the same account will all share the same bag.
4. If a pet egg's level is higher than your character's level, the pet's level will be adjusted to match your character level, and no additional EXP will be obtainable until your character levels up. Only when your level exceeds your pet level can your pet start gaining EXP in battle or through adventuring.
特殊NPC阿斯特蕾亚会在指定时间段出现在普隆德拉广场，为前来占卜的冒险家解开塔罗:
The Special NPC Astraia will appear in Prontera Square at a certain time to unlock the secrets of Tarot Cards for all adventurers seeking divination.
1. Each time, there will be three rounds of card divination, with thirteen cards in each round. Each round has its own unique reward. You can view the initial probability of obtaining an item in the reward info display. This probability will gradually increase as the number of items in the pool decreases.
2. The three rounds of divination cost 48, 120, and 258 Big Cat Coins respectively.
3. If 13 cards are selected, you'll get all of the rewards for the round, and the next round of divination will begin.
4. All cards that have been divined will be removed from the divination display.
5. When all three rounds of divination are completed, you're guaranteed to receive a rare mount.
6. The first divination of the second and third rounds is free.
7. After each round of divination, Astraia will give you exclusive "Astraia's Boon" items, which can be used in the place of Big Cat Coins during divination.
8. After completing all three rounds of divination, Astraia will grant you the right to purchase exclusive mount skins.

隶属于卢恩王国的皇家魔物研究所是米德加尔特大陆上最著名的魔物研究机构之一，以安妮: The Kingdom of Rune's Royal Monster Laboratory is one of the most famous demon Laboratorys in all of Midgarts. The researchers, led by Annie Prusse, are constantly exploring the properties and ecology of various demons. In major cities and even in the most dangerous regions of the wilderness, you will often find these monster researchers poking their noses around. A branch of the Monster Laboratory can even be found in Yuno. In fact, this lab is very active in its research duties. Annie Prusse's recent volunteer campaign for adventurers has gained much practical data for the Monster Laboratory and received widespread praise.
在财富聚集的贝勒区，坐落着著名的黄金假日酒店，各种巴洛克主义的精美建筑矗立于此，: In the wealthy Baylor area, one can find the famous Golden Escape Hotel, among other magnificent buildings. The dignitaries of the Schwarzwald Republic sing and dance at night, and an endless party can be found in the salon. It is also the location of the governmental and Rekenber Corporation headquarters, who own a considerable portion of the land in the Baylor area, both for their research and development center, and for residential areas for their employees. The upper classes have the privilege of enjoying Rekenber Corporation's latest technology before anyone else. Forever pursuing a life of luxury, the people of Baylor have initiated a large number of specialist industries, with high-end suppliers such as Madame Velour rising to prominence among the Baylor aristocracy.
而被通称为“贫民窟”的梅尔区，主要居民则为被雷根贝勒公司所雇佣的劳工与他们的后代: The Merl district, commonly known as "The Slums", are the workers and families of those employed by Rekenber Corporation After the great technological revolution began, the logging and mining workforces were gradually replaced by the automated mechanical devices of Rekenber. After the layoffs, many unemployed workers chose not return to their homeland, thinking they could save money by building simple shacks and settling down on the peripheries of the Baylor area, eventually forming their own settlements. Undesirable elements gradually formed bands of pickpockets and thugs, and for the residents of Merl, daily survival become an ongoing war. The black market, headed by Annie Alba, is one of the mightiest forces in this war.
建立于米德加尔特大陆各地，专属于冒险者的有爱之家。由希望与收获的女神希芙亲手建造: Established throughout Midgarts, a loving home exclusively for adventurers. Whenever you return home, tired and weary, there will always be a bright light waiting for you. As more and more heroes heed the call of adventure, Sif herself will continue to lead the homebuilding efforts, and together with the housekeeper, Delilah, they wish every adventurer a wonderful journey.

辛格拉原本是个宠物训练专家。他经常出门溜溜他最得意的几只疾风小猎狐，每天都会路过: Singra used to be a pet trainer. He often goes out to walk some of his most proud little Illusion Foxes and passes through the town's Commission Board every day. When he is idle, he looks at the commissions on the Board. Not only is the reward low, but the work is always boring. That’s what he thinks anyway. Well, who would post things that really bother them at this place where everyone can see? He thinks about it and looks at his little Illusion Fox with unlimited energy. Huh? He has a flash of inspiration. How about... After that day, there has been a little Illusion Fox with a suitcase and a commissioned mailbox in Lighthalzen. Anyone can put their reward commission in the mailbox. Every day Singra will put the commissions in the little Illusion Fox’s suitcase to provide powerful but money-poor adventurers with a choice, and allow them to make money from it. It seems quite popular. Wow, the income isn’t bad. I wanna make this business bigger!
雷根贝勒公司外聘的研究者，崇尚科学的力量。相信雷根贝勒公司的科技能为人类带来新的: An external researcher of Rekenber Corporation. Advocates the power of science. Believes that Rekenber's technology can bring a new future to mankind. Blindly optimistic.

He often complains that young people nowadays cannot bear difficulties and have no perseverance. Tom Green’s wish is to repair the train in Merl District and to win materials and hope for the people living here.

这个男人永远以列车长自称，恐怕连他本人都忘记了自己的原名。从小喜欢火车的他看着火: This man always claims to be the Conductor. Maybe even he has forgotten his original name. He has liked trains ever since he was a child. He saw the railway station being built and then abandoned. After leaving home, the Conductor went to Yuno to learn how to drive vehicles. For him who always dreamed about trains, trains are his lovers and his life. When he heard that he had been transferred to his hometown, Merl District, to become the Conductor, he went back to Lighthalzen without hesitation. What we do know, is that regardless of whether the train can be repaired or not, he will be here all his life.

位于达纳托斯塔初始之地,庄严而又充满神秘气息的大厅。它拥有与破败的塔完全相反的华: A solemn and mysterious hall located at the entrance of Thanatos Tower. Its gorgeous ornamentation is the exact opposite of the dilapidated tower. It seems to have appeared with Valkyrie and the Guardian. The doors leading to the lower floor of Thanatos Tower are entangled in chains, and can only be opened with the approval of Rathgricy, the Valkyrie.
位于初始之地而后的区域，肃穆而庄重的神造大厅。似乎是先前女武神所禁忌的领地，被极: Situated in the area behind the original site lies this solemn hall of divine creation. It seems that the territory previously sealed off by the Valkyrie is enchanted by very strong magic, and the Rune Rune marks its every corner. The runic inscriptions floating on one side contain ancient magic power, resonating with the Tesseract and sealing the path to the next area.
来自神域阿斯加德的四翼女武神，隶属于英灵殿瓦尔哈拉。随着塔的异变，拉斯格瑞丝接到: The four-winged Valkyrie from Asgard, belonging to the realm of the departed, Valhalla. Following the changes to the tower, Rathgricy received orders from the divine realm to guard the Guardian's Hall of the Thanatos Tower. Leads the Blade of Order and Zealot's Blade - two elite troops clad in red and blue, respectively. Though unable to stop the growing curse, she forbade everyone from entering Thanatos Tower in order to prevent the curse from escaping. A Valkyrie versed in the art of war, she possesses a stoic and upright character and is very arrogant. She believes human power is insignificant compared to that of the gods. She only believes in her own power, and in the commands of the divine realm, but respects any capable of besting her mighty blade. Her relationship with the other Valkyries is tenuous at best. She possesses a strong sense of justice, and is prepared to ruthlessly adjudicate mankind in order to prevent the curse from spreading. However, she still possesses a virtuous heart, as a sworn Valkyrie. When the energy shield provided by the Mayhem Crystal and Order Crystal is in effect, Rathgricy is almost invincible.

拉斯格瑞丝通过守护者大厅内的【能量水晶】获得护盾。该护盾免疫一切物理和魔法攻击,: Rathgricy gains a shield from the Guardian's Hall [Energy Crystal]. This shield is immune to all physical and magical attacks, and will not be damaged by adventurers' attacks.
