失去护盾后,拉斯格瑞丝开始认真起来,使出全力攻击冒险者。: After losing her shield, Rathgricy becomes enraged and begins to attack adventurers with all her strength.
可凝聚全元素魔力的能量结晶，是诸神的造物。其核心由智慧的巨人密米尔设计，矮人工匠: Created by the gods, the Energy Crystal can absorb magic of all elements. Its core was designed by Mimir, the titan of wisdom, and forged by Hsienry, the master dwarf craftsman. The shifting outer wall of the Tesseract was engraved by dozens of priests under the guidance of Badr, the son of Odin, through powerful light magic. Forever sealed in Asgard's Golden Palace, as a forbidden divine artifact. But after Thanatos' war against Morroc, his soul and sword began to merge into one. In order to prevent the curse from bringing disaster to the Nine Worlds once more, Odin decided to use the sealed Tesseract. Shortly afterwards, the gods summoned the creatures of the Nine Worlds to preside over the inception ceremony and successfully activated the power of the Tesseract. From then on, the Tesseract enacted the will of the gods, imprisoning the Tower of Doom forever.

向9米范围内玩家释放热能，造成少量火属性魔法伤害，并且玩家受到的魔法伤害会增加，: Unleashes thermal energy upon players within 9 meters, dealing a small amount of Fire Magic Damage and increasing susceptibility to magic damage. This effect can be stacked infinitely.
吟唱1秒后，在指定范围内投掷寒冰碎片，对指定范围内玩家造成水属性魔法伤害，并留下: After chanting for 1 second, hurls ice shards at a specified area, dealing Water Magic Damage to players in range and freezing the ground. Walking on frozen ground clears the negative effects of [Thermal Radiation].
召唤一只高额生命值的巨石怪为超魔导师战斗: Summons a Golem with high HP to aid the High Wizard in battle.
雷云会持续对雷云范围内玩家造成风属性魔法伤害，累计造成3次伤害后下一次伤害会使玩: This thunder cloud deals continuous Wind Magic Damage to players in range. After dealing damage 3 times in total, the cloud's following attack stuns.
对自身2周围玩家造成物理伤害,并造成击退: Deals physical damage to 2 players around the caster and repels them.
对自身5米范围内玩家造成一次暗属性物理伤害，并造成击退和减速: Deals Dark-based physical damage once to players within 5 meters of the caster while slowing and repelling them.
蓄力1.5秒后对前方6*6矩形范围内玩家造成一次高额暗属性物理伤害: Gathers power for 1.5 seconds, then deals high Dark-based physical damage once to players in a 6x6 rectangular area in front of the caster.
召唤几个可被摧毁的剑阵，对周围的敌人造成伤害，并提升赛尼亚的攻击力: Summons several destructible sword arrays, which deal damage to enemies in range and increase Cenia's Atk.
释放剑气，对周围玩家造成小额物理伤害: Unleashes the spirit of the sword, dealing a small amount of physical damage to surrounding players.
读条1.5秒后在4个随机区域落下金币雨，造成高额物理伤害: After casting for 1.5 seconds, drops 4 golden bursts at random locations, dealing high physical damage.
召唤出一个可被摧毁的末日手推车攻击敌人，末日手推车会逐渐加速并冲向敌人自爆造成巨: Summons a destructible apocalypse cart to attack enemies. Apocalypse carts gradually accelerate and charge toward enemies, self-destructing to deal severe physical damage.
末日手推车在靠近玩家时释放自爆，对周围玩家造成巨额物理伤害: Apocalypse carts self-destruct when near players, dealing severe physical damage in the surrounding area.
读条5秒后，将水晶修复: Repairs crystals after casting for 5 seconds.
对一直线上的敌人造成范围伤害，并击退一段距离: Deals AoE damage to enemies in a straight line and repels them a certain distance.
持续施法，为女武神提供能量: Casts continuously, providing Energy to Valkyrie.
对近距离内的单体目标造成魔法伤害: Deals magic damage to a single target in close range.
近距离内没有目标时施放，每隔一秒对全场敌人造成伤害: Casts when there are no targets in close range, dealing damage to all enemies every second.
将随机两个敌人链接，被链接者将共享受到的伤害，并持续受到小额伤害，减速50%%；: Links 2 random enemies, dealing a small amount of damage to them. Linked enemies share all damage received and are slowed by 50%%. Cannot be dispelled. Can be removed using [Arcane Rend]. The more active links there are, the most damage they deal.
随机束缚两名敌人，限制其移动和普通攻击，无法被驱散，持续60秒。可被【奥术切割】: Binds 2 random enemies, restricting their movement and auto attacks for 60 seconds. Cannot be dispelled. Can be removed by [Arcane Rend].
随机点名2个目标，延迟2秒后在目标位置造成范围伤害: Marks 2 random targets, dealing AoE damage at their location after a 2-second delay.
将附近的敌人牵引到自己身边，并减速50%%。5秒后以自身为中心造成大额伤害: Pulls nearby enemies toward the caster and slows them by 50%%. Deals massive damage around the caster after 5 seconds.
获得【奥能力场】使自身免疫所有伤害，并在120秒后杀死场上的所有敌人: Grants [Arcane Force Field] granting the caster immunity against all damage and killing all enemies in the force field after 120 seconds.
场上随机刷新钥匙碎片，拾取5个后可合成奥能之钥，使【奥能力场】失效: Randomly refreshes key shards on the battlefield. After looting 5, you can combine them to create an Arcane Key, nullifying [Arcane Force Field].
被召唤次数越多，每个傀儡的伤害和血量越高: Puppet damage and HP increase the more they are summoned.

施放连锁闪电攻击敌人，会弹跳5次，造成伤害并给目标施加一个【静电场】，每2秒对附: Launches chain lightning at enemies, which jumps from target to target 5 times, dealing damage and surrounding them with an [Electrostatic Field]. This field deals damage to their surrounding allies every 2 seconds.
用蜂群保护自己，每秒对周围的敌人造成范围伤害，并将伤害值转化为自己的生命值: Grants the protection of the hive, dealing AoE damage to surrounding enemies and converting this damage dealt into self-healing.
对敌人造成范围伤害，并留下一个毒液潭，使进入的敌人中毒: Deals AoE damage to enemies and creates a toxic pool that poisons enemies who enter it.
对周围的敌人造成伤害，并施加恐惧效果: Deals damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Fear.
与敌人同归于尽，造成巨大伤害: Launches a desperate suicidal attack, dealing severe damage.
对前方敌人造成伤害，并施加石化效果: Deals damage to enemies in front of the caster and inflicts Petrify.
将周围的敌人拉到自己身边，造成伤害并施加诅咒效果: Pulls surrounding enemies to the caster, dealing damage and inflicting Curse.
对周围的敌人造成巨大伤害，并施加黑暗效果: Deals severe damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Darkness.
对目标造成伤害，并有一定概率造成眩晕: Deals damage to the target, with a chance to stun.
消灭自己并对周围的敌人造成较大伤害: Sacrifices the caster's life to deal huge damage to surrounding enemies.
当哈沃得在场时，会给迪文提供非常高额的伤害减免: When Howard is on the battlefield, grants Deeven an extremely high amount of damage reduction.
每次击杀玩家后随机召唤一个小怪，小怪存在15秒: After killing a player, summons a random Imp for 15 seconds.
召唤出4个恐怖圆环，当第五秒时若有玩家踩住，圆环会消失；若未被踩住，则每个圆环会: Summons 4 rings of dread, if a player steps on one during the fifth second, the ring will disappear. If not stepped on, each ring will summon 4 Dullahan during the sixth second. Dullahan inflict a fatal attack every 5 seconds.
在周围随机召唤多颗宝珠，一段时间后自爆，对周围的敌人造成即死伤害: Random summons pearls in the surrounding area which explode after a certain period of time, dealing fatal damage to enemies in range.
自身死亡时对亡者蚁后造成2%生命值的伤害: Upon dying, deals damage equal to 2% of HP to the Undead Maya.
生命值越低，战斗时间越长，战斗力越强: The lower the caster's HP, and the longer they're in combat, the stronger they become.
每次击杀敌人后回复生命，自身生命值越低，战斗力越强: Restores HP when killing enemies. The lower the caster's HP, the stronger they become.
召唤一个时空裂隙，会持续召唤深渊噬人花、迷失溜溜猴或扭曲气泡虫: Summons a time rift that continuously summons Abyssal Flora, Lost Yoyos, or Warped Marine Spheres.
一道切割光束随目标移动，对击中的目标造成伤害，并摧毁【奥术牢笼】和【窥秘者的锁链: A searing light beam follows the target, dealing damage upon making contact with them. Destroys both [Arcane Cage] and [Watcher's Chains].
随机选择5块区域，5秒后造成范围伤害: Deals AoE damage in 5 random areas after 5 seconds.
从场地边缘射出一排激光，沿直线扫过地图，对命中的敌人造成高额伤害: Emits a row of light beams from the sides of the zone, that scan the map and deal high damage to enemies hit.
对目标造成圣属性伤害: Deals Holy damage to the target.
任务用钓鱼技能: Fishing skill. Used for a quest.
疯兔生气时的常见反应，向前弹跳一段距离，落地时击退正前方敌人: The common reaction of an angry Lunatic, it bounces forward a distance, and repels the enemy in front of it when it lands.

对目标造成一定法术伤害: Deals a fixed amount of magic damage to the target.
使目标回复一定生命值: Restores a fixed amount of HP to the target.

众神之王奥丁为了准备诸神黄昏的到来，授命神工匠在恩德勒斯岛上建造了试炼之塔。百年: In preparation for the arrival of Ragnarok, Odin, King of the Gods, instructed his whitesmiths to build a tower of trials on Endless Island. A hundred years later, Prontera's researchers discovered a terrifying source of magic in the tower, and when they entered it, they found themselves in an endless magical void. Upon teaming up and entering the tower, adventurers must take on all kinds of ferocious monsters. The higher you go up the tower, the stronger the monsters you'll find. Only with resolute strength and courage can you reach the top.
普隆德拉的察尔斯·邦特身为首都训练场负责人，正在招募勇敢的冒险者进行培训。进入训: Prontera's Chars Bont, as head of the Capital Training Grounds, is recruiting brave adventurers for training. After entering the training grounds, adventurers can party up to train against adventurers of different jobs, and at the same time, deepen their understanding of various combat skills. One thing's for sure -- this is a the perfect place for adventurers who love to fight.
自与魔王梦罗克一战后，米德加尔特大陆各地都遭受了强烈的魔力波动，出现了许多不稳定: After the first war against Morroc, Midgarts has suffered intense magical fluctuations and many unstable time rifts. Many monsters have emerged from these rifts. If they are not eliminated in time, they will pose a threat to the innocent people of this land. For the sake of peace on the continent, the Morroc Continental Guard has dispatched a number of rift sentinels. At their behest, many adventurers have formed teams to purge the rifts of monsters and seal these rifts wherever they're found.
幻想马戏团中，纸牌屋的主人西格蒙德实力超群，却为人自负，极其狂傲。他的妹妹西格林: Sigmond, the owner of the Fantasy Circus' House of Cards, possesses superior strength, but is conceited and arrogant. His sister, Grinter, had been unable to win over her brother, and in her distress, asked for the help of willing adventurers. After adventurers find the three workers in Prontera's Fantasy Circus, they can team up and enter the House of Cards and play Sigmond's card game. As the cards change, so does the environment and the monsters within it. Beware the cards -- myriad dangers lie behind each one.
魔物研究所隶属于卢恩王国，是米德加尔特大陆上最著名的魔物研究机构之一，以严谨与专: The Kingdom of Rune's Royal Monster Laboratory is one of the most famous demon Laboratorys in all of Midgarts, renowned for its rigorous and professional scientific research work. Annie Prusse is actively recruiting volunteers in major cities on behalf of the Monster Researchers. Taking part in the Monster Laboratory's ecological investigation will greatly increase your practical experience, and is a good choice for adventurers who want to develop their abilities quickly.
为了鼓励冒险者之间的对战训练，卢恩王国开放出全新的竞技场所供其切磋。每次对战将分: In order to encourage adventurers to engage in combat training, the Kingdom of Rune has opened a new sparring arena. In each battle, adventurers are divided into two opposing teams of six adventurers on either side. In the magical arena, they must use magical Elemental Orbs to weaken enemies and earn points. When your score reaches a certain level, you'll be upgraded to a higher ranking. The kingdom will give out rewards based on the season's rankings. The higher your rank, the better the rewards will be.
随着大陆上冒险者人数的逐渐增加，MVP魔物的归属权也成了大问题。想要率先击杀MV: With the increasing number of adventurers on the continent, competition over MVP monsters has become a major problem. Adventurers who wish to kill MVP monsters can head to Altos in the capital at 7 PM every Friday and team up to defeat the rarest creatures in the land. Don't worry about having to find MVPs all over the world -- make use of your precious hunting rights and eliminate every monster that stands in your way, one by one! Here, absolute strength is the only guarantee of victory!

Following the changes to the tower, Rathgricy received orders from the divine realm to guard the Guardian's Hall of the Thanatos Tower. Leads the Blade of Order and Zealot's Blade - two elite troops clad in red and blue, respectively. Though unable to stop the growing curse, she forbade the weak from entering Thanatos Tower in order to prevent the curse from escaping. A Valkyrie versed in the art of war, she possesses a stoic and upright character and is very arrogant. She believes human power is insignificant compared to that of the gods. To their surprise, Wolfchev had set up a trap. Hayward sacrificed his own life to protect the Evening Primrose. Deeven brought the Evening Primrose back with tears. Unexpectedly, in Magaleta's dream, they saw her making a deal with Wolfchev to trade the lives of her four friends for Seyren and her freedom...
知道了真相的赛依连决定和玛嘉雷特分开，仅剩的三人继续向研究所深处调查。在实验室中: Upon learning the truth, Seyren decided to part her way with Magaleta. The remaining trio ventured further into the lab. The recording tape found in the lab revealed the cause of the machine's loss of control in front of the trio. The berserk Katerina caused a big explosion in the lab and the artificial Yimir Heart maker rose to the sky. To reach the lab, the adventurer suggested riding the airship...
几人得到飞空艇钥匙后，却发现飞空艇的燃料竟然是人造伊米尔之心。为了取得燃料，众人: They found the key to the airship but realized that the airship was powered by the artificial Yimir Heart. To get the fuel, the group made their way to the energy warehouse. Unexpectedly, the frenzied Shey exploded herself thus to destroy the energy warehouse. At that critical moment, Deeven sacrificed himself and started the airship with his blood that contained the artificial Yimir Heart power. Wolfchev knew they would come to the floating lab. He sent the soulless golems of Eremes and her friends to make the squad of six fight and kill each other. Moreover, Wolfchev made Cenia a guardian of the artificial Yimir's Heart to stop adventurers. When the group fell into despair, Siren appeared and brought Cenia back to consciousness. She chose to perish together with Wolfchev. However, the artificial Yimir Heart maker was still in existence. To atone for her sin, Magaleta decided to stay to destroy the machine. At that moment, Seyren held Magaleta's hand and chose to face the situation together. The adventurer left the lab with the responsibility to reveal the truth and bring the Rekenber Corporation's conspiracy to light...

（小声）难、难道说真的是……人造伊米尔之心的碎片激活了开关？！上次的升空到底发生: (Whispering) Could it be the artificial Yimir Heart shard that has turned on the switch? What happened during the last lift off?
……咳咳。总之，能自由使用飞空艇可是里希塔乐的大事！: ...Cough. Anyways, using the airship freely is a big deal in Lighthalzen.
你看，操纵杆就在那边。机会难得，去试试遨游天空的感觉吧！: Look! The controller is over there. It's a rare opportunity. Let's have a ride in the sky!
只要和你在一起，我什么都不怕……: I'm not afraid of anything as long as you are by my side...
你！嘎嘎！是我们的希望！: You! Quack, quack! Are our hope!
嘎嘎！利力不开心！: Quack, quack! Lili is not happy!
和利力一起再去回忆中看看他们吧！嘎~: Go with Lili to visit them in memories! Quack!
是否前往飞空的房间: Would you like to go to the flying room?
是否观看【制造器失控原因】: Would you like to watch the cause of the machine's loss of control?
当然了！我可是你永远的骑士啊！我的神官小姐！: Of course! I'm always your knight! My High Priestess!
那我们约定好了哦！我的骑士！: We have a deal! My knight!
迪文喜欢我，迪文不喜欢我，喜欢我，不喜欢我，喜欢我……: Deeven likes me. Deeven doesn't like me. Deeven likes me. Deeven doesn't like me. Like me...
呜呜呜，怎么又是不喜欢我！: Woo... He doesn't like me again.

我的天啊！我看到了什么！！: My goodness! What did I see?

哦！你真是宽容又大度呢！: Oh! You are so understanding and forgiving!
您来这里一定带了好多行李吧！我立刻把您的行李放好！: You must have brought many luggages. I'll bring your bags up right away.
我亲爱的上宾大人，全自动化行李架给您带来最高科技的服务，您满意么？: My honorable guest, this fully automatic luggage rack provides you the highest technology service. Are you satisfied?

搬好了就赶紧出去吧！碍眼的仆人们！: Get out as soon as you are done with the luggage. Annoying servants!

专门为王室准备的壁炉，让您的一年四季都温暖舒适！: A fireplace specially prepared for the royals that provides you comfortable warmth of the spring all year round!

奥雷克永远为尊贵的您效劳！: Oreck is always at your service, my lord!

还有你可不要以为只有这些内部的构建哦！: We've got more than just these inner structures.
噔噔噔！我华丽的小火车！: Dong, dong! My glorious little train!
我相信有了它，梅尔区的未来一定会变好的！: With this, Merl's future will be brighter!
你是我们梅尔区的朋友，我希望由你来给这个火车取个名字！: You are a friend of Merl. I hope you could give the train a name.

希望号吗？梅尔区的未来的希望！: Hope? The hope of Merl's future!
梅尔希望号一定会承载着梅尔区驶向美好的未来！: The Merl Hope will take Merl to a beautiful future!
想喝什么点什么吗？: What would you like to drink?

座位上的靠垫十分柔软。: The cushion on the seat is so soft.

怎么？你也想来一杯？: What's up? Do you fancy a drink?

我不能让我的伙伴白白牺牲！: I can't let my friends die in vain!
你去哪里了？我们都很担心你: Where did you go? We were all very worried about you

不可以！赛依连！索林小姐！: Don't do it! Seyren! Miss Thorin!
不好！他们三人坚持不住了！先撤退！: Damn it! The three of them can't hang on much longer! Retreat for now.
录像带编号2F0541，记录了曾经这里发生的情况。: Recording tape No. 2F0541 recorded what happened here in the past.
愿逝去烈士的灵魂，在火焰另一端的世界能够得到慰藉。: May the deceased souls find peace in the world on the other end of the flame.
呜呜呜，消防局突然离开了这么多人……: Woo... Suddenly the fire station lost so many men...
什么见鬼的雷根贝勒…我恨透了这个地方……: Bloody Rekenber... I hate this place...
真希望祖爷爷和祖奶奶也能看到这样美丽的世界啊……: I hope my great grandparents could see this beautiful world...
你，想学习飞翔么？: Would you like to learn to fly?
风真是奇妙的东西，既能救人，也能伤人。: The wind is such a magical thing. It can save you and hurt you.
指导员康尼先生的指导手册是一向都随身携带的，我希望你能帮我们找到它…: Instructor Connie always carried his handbook with him. I hope you can help us find it.

大队长莱克先生总喜欢教训人，哎，他不在了反而才感觉他是个多么负责的人啊…你能帮我: Chief Lacker loved to scold others. Sigh... We only realized how responsible he was after his passing... Could you help us find his most precious gloves?
没见到么…也是啊，毕竟火势这么大，或许烧掉了吧……: You didn't see it? Yeah, the fire was fierce. It's probably burnt.

再也没有可爱的拉瑞先生陪我聊天了……你能帮我找到他的遗物么，我会好好保存的。: I can never chat with the lovely Mr. Larry again... Could you help me find his remains? I'll take good care of it.
啊，海拉米还是个少年啊，他怎么也……求求你帮我们找到他的遗物吧，他的母亲最近非常: Ahh... Herami was still so young. How could he... Please help us find his remains. His mother has become depressed...

求求你再仔细找找吧，那些真的都是非常重要的遗物……: Please search around carefully. Those are very important remains...

不远处突然传来一阵怪异的嘶吼！: A strange roar came abruptly from a distance.

他并没有错，错的是我……是，可恶的雷根贝勒！: He was not wrong but I was... So was the goddamn Rekenber!
可恶的飓风魔·狂风…竟然抢走了我爸爸传给我的飞行眼镜…你能帮我去找回来么？: The bloody Typhoon Gale took the flight glasses I got from my father... Could you retrieve them for me?

哼，没想到外面世界的人说谎倒是很在行。: Hmm! I didn't know people from the outside world are such good liars.
感谢你，这是我家族重要的财产！: Thank you. This is an important property of my family.
哎，虽然已经坏了，但我相信未来我会修好它的！: Sigh... Although it's broken, I believe it will be fixed one day.
这枚风车，是我还活着的证明呐……: This windmill is the proof that I'm still living.

啊，长老给我保管的魔力测风仪不见了，一定又是被飓风魔·朔风偷走了，你能帮我找回来: Ahh. The magic pilot balloon the elder has entrusted in my care is missing. It must be the Typhoon North Wind! Could you retrieve it for me?
你看到我收藏的风中草了么？我怀疑是被飓风魔·阴风偷走了，你能帮我去找回来么？: Have you seen the Wind Weed in my collection? I believe the Typhoon Ill Wind has stolen it. Could you retrieve it for me?
啊，请你再仔细找一下好么，那真的对我非常重要。: Ahh. Please search again more thoroughly. That is very important for me.
呜呜，你骗人，你根本没找到我的东西！: Woo... You are a liar. You didn't find my thing.
太好了，你想听我吹这只笛子么？: Excellent. Would you like to hear a tone from my pipe?
终于找回来了，不然麻烦可就大了。: Finally I've got it back. Otherwise, it would have been a big problem.

你是报社来的新人吗？: You must be new to the newspaper.
看你的确有当记者的潜质！: You do have the potential to be a good reporter!

1.每个角色每天可以完成3次魔物研究所副本。\n2.每次副本将会消耗玩家30分钟:
1. Each character can complete the Monster Laboratory dungeon 3 times per day. 
2. Every time the dungeon will consume 30 minutes of the player's combat time. 
3. If the player goes offline or exits in the middle of the dungeon, no clearance rewards will be received and no combat time will be deducted. 
4. The dungeon lasts for 10 minutes. The more waves of monsters a player kills in the dungeon, the more rewards he will receive. 
5. Players will receive Base EXP and Job EXP according to their current level and a small amount of basic materials. 
6. Each monster a player kills in the dungeon grants 1 Investigation Credit, which can be used to purchase combat tools from the merchant in the dungeon. Use combat tools to quickly destroy monsters.
1.符文分为属性符文和技能符文；\n2.技能符文分为13个职业类别，每个类别含S:
1. Runes are grouped into the attribute runes and the skill runes. 
2. The skill runes are divided into 13 class types, each of which has 3 qualities of S, A, and B. 
3. The attribute runes are classified into ATK runes, DEF runes, and Special runes. 
4. The skill rune sockets can only accommodate skill runes of the character's class. 
5. Each skill rune needs 3 specified attribute runes for energy supply. Only when all 3 attribute runes meet the inlay requirements, the skill rune can take effect. 
6. The 3 dots under the skill rune socket are the attribute runes required to activate the skill rune: 
Red -> ATK rune 
Green -> DEF rune 
Yellow -> Special rune 
White -> Any rune 
7. Attribute runes and skill runes of the same name can't be inlaid. 
8. When a character's class changes, inlaid runes will be reset.
1. The Magnifying Glass can be used to verify unverified runes. 
2. Verified skill runes can't be traded. 
3. Some skill attributes feature special attributes. A verified rune's gray attributes are the special ones that the skill rune hasn't got. 
4. Continuous verification for your selected unverified runes can directly verify the max number of the runes that you have if you are in possession of less than 10 of it.
1. The Rune Carving can change a selected skill rune's activation condition to un-require attribute rune activation. 
2. Each skill rune can have one of its activation conditions changed. 
3. To carve repeatedly, the previous carving must be reset before you can carve again. 
4. Each time carving consumes 1 void carving knife. To reset carving doesn't consume anything. 
5. Carved skill runes will be automatically marked as your favorites, which can't be carved or reset. 
6. The void carving knife can be purchased in the Gold Coin Shop. 
7. It is not advised to choose those already with unlimited activation conditions for carving.

大队长莱克是全消防局最出名的处女座，他对所有事情一丝不苟，哪怕是已经检查过一遍的: Chief Lacker was the best known Virgo in the entire fire station. Meticulous about everything, he often repeatedly went through already inspected equipment before leading his men on operations. Lacker's gloves were left by his fire fighter father. Although they were old, he would give them a thorough clean after each mission. After being turned into a monster, he still valued these gloves more than anything else subconsciously. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Cargo at the entrance to the Underground Laboratory 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 121 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Removal Chief Lacker.
装备部长杰夫是消防队所有人坚实的后盾，他背着厚厚的装备包，里面都是可以简易替换的: Director of Ordnance Jeff was the solid backing of everyone in the fire station. He carried a thick equipment bag full of gear and emergency sets that can be easily replaced. Jeff obtained this oxygen cylinder when he first became a fire fighter. He asked many retirees to sign on it and felt much honored as if he was fighting side by side with the seniors... However, the last signature on it was the Mechanical Hound's teeth mark. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Belm at the entrance to the Underground Laboratory 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 121 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Removal Director of Ordnance Jeff.
后勤部长拉瑞原本不应该参加这次行动，他是个胆小的人，整个消防局都知道，他连老鼠都: Chief of Logistics Larry shouldn't have taken part in this operation. The entire fire station was aware of his cowardliness. He was afraid of rats; let alone those dangerous field services. However, this time upon hearing that many members were trapped in the burning building, including his old mate Jeff, he finally plucked up his courage, armed himself, and ran into the fire to Jeff's rescue. This life belt was on Jeff when discovered. However, the glorious name carved on it was Larry If you are in possession of this item, give it to Belm at the entrance to the Underground Laboratory 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 121 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Removal Chief of Logistics Larry.
志愿生海拉米来到消防局已经一周了，他还没从消防学校毕业，就急匆匆地通过申请成为了: Volunteer Herami came to the fire station a week ago. Still a student of the Fire College, he applied to serve as a volunteer fire fighter. This was his first official operation and he was totally thrilled. When he left home in the morning, he told his parents that he was to become a fire hero. He always kept this graduation certificate in his trouser pocket. How silly! He should have been afraid of damaging it at the fire scene... However, the certificate was well while Herami was gone. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Belm at the entrance to the Underground Laboratory 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 121 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Removal Volunteer Herami.
在娜乌西卡族的习俗中，13岁的男孩就会视为成年，在他们的成年礼上，族长会亲手将族: According to Nausicaa customs, boys are considered Me from the age of 13. On their coming to age ceremony, the chief would present them a pair of flight glasses made by the craftsmen of the tribe, which will accompany them for the rest of their life. They are to face unknown dangers through the glasses on each and every of their flights. "Put them on and you'll conquer your fear. You won't be afraid however fast you fly." The chieftain would often encourage the boys prior to their first flight. However, no one could promise you if they were to return alive. If you are in possession of this item, give it to the youth by the windmill at the entrance to the Lighthalzen Plain (Adventurers at Lv. 120 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Typhoon Gale.
为了对抗盘踞在山谷外部的飓风魔，娜乌西卡族尝试过很多种飞出山谷的方法。比如最初他: To deal with the Typhoons lingering outside the valley, the Nausicaa tribe has tried various methods to fly out. For instance, they made a paraglider out of some animal hide at the beginning. They also tried to craft a hot air balloon. However, all their attempts failed. Until one day, a hurricane blew a lost gang of Goblins into the valley. After a battle, the craftsmen got inspired by the Jet Goblin's gear and invented a jet pack that could fly on the wind force in the strong wind weather. If you are in possession of this item, give it to the youth by the windmill at the entrance to the Lighthalzen Plain (Adventurers at Lv. 120 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Typhoon Headwind.
为了冲出山谷，娜乌西卡族年复一年日复一日地派遣飞行队对抗飓风魔，成年的飞行队员在: To rush out of the valley, the Nausicaa tribe sent their air fleet to confront the Typhoons year after year. An adult pilot would receive a hand-made fortune windmill before his first flight. In case of misfortune, he must release the windmill at the last moment of his life and the windmill would eventually return to the valley due to the inward whirling wind. When his family receives the windmill, they would accept this heart wrenching result and stand a gravestone for him with the windmill placed in front of his name. If you are in possession of this item, give it to the youth by the windmill at the entrance to the Lighthalzen Plain (Adventurers at Lv. 120 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Typhoon Black Wind.
娜乌西卡族没见过山谷外的世界，所以鼓风笛是他们认知中唯一存在的乐器。鼓风笛演奏出: The Nausicaa tribe has never seen the world outside the valley. Hence, the bagpipes is the only instrument they know. The music performed with the bagpipes is sorrowful and drawn-out. The Nausicaa Musicians would often sigh how beautiful and tender the wind was supposed to be but their tribe was trapped by the wind due to the existence of the Typhoons and the sound of the wind became terrifying. If you are in possession of this item, give it to the maiden by the windmill at the entrance to the Lighthalzen Plain (Adventurers at Lv. 120 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Typhoon High Wind.
整个娜乌西卡族的魔力凝聚在一起，才制成了这柄可以感应风的魔力测风仪，它即是娜乌西: The entire Nausicaa tribe's magic power was gathered together to make this magic pilot balloon that could sense the wind. It became the Nausicaa tribe's biggest weapon against the Typhoons and their spiritual sustenance and belief. This hundreds of years old pilot balloon has long lost its original function. But once you touch its heavy texture, you could feel the Nausicaa tribe's passion and sorrow. If you are in possession of this item, give it to the maiden by the windmill at the entrance to the Lighthalzen Plain (Adventurers at Lv. 120 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Typhoon North Wind.
娜乌西卡族的山谷里能种植的植物很少，饲养的牛羊也远远不够支撑整个族群的消耗，于是: Very few plants could be grown in the Nausicaa's valley and the livestock they raised was far from enough for the entire tribe's consumption. As a result, this Wind Grass that flew into the valley with the wind became the Nausicaa tribe's staple. This Wind Grass is said to be growing vigorously on the cliff outside the valley except for the winter. It tastes awful but anything that could fill the stomach in difficult times brings some comfort. If you are in possession of this item, give it to the maiden by the windmill at the entrance to the Lighthalzen Plain (Adventurers at Lv. 120 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by killing the Typhoon Ill Wind.
用魔菇的肉做成的肉排，散发出诱人的香气，但是吃了会中毒吧？据说是下水道公主斯丽帕: Steak made with spore, very fragrant but probably toxic. It is allegedly liked by Nini, the pet of the sewer princess Sleepa. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Sleepa at the Sewer 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 10 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by investigating the strange lair at the Sewer 1F.
黏糊糊的网，会粘住所有接近的东西，据说是下水道公主斯丽帕的宠物——妮妮喜欢的东西: A sticky web that can keep everything approaching. It is allegedly liked by Nini, the pet of the sewer princess Sleepa. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Sleepa at the Sewer 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 10 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by investigating the strange lair at the Sewer 1F.
雷根贝勒公司根据神工匠哈沃德的设计优化过的翻译装置，使用后，能翻译出部分魔物的叫: An improved translation device developed by Rekenber Corporation based on Whitesmith Hayward's design. Use it to translate some monsters' screams. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Benster at the Sewer 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 10 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by investigating the strange lair at the Sewer 1F.
雷根贝勒公司研发的能产生能源的水晶，如果放在隧道前的灯中，似乎能被当作能源使用。: A crystal developed by Rekenber Corporation to produce energy. If placed in front of a tunnel lamp, it could probably be used as energy. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Benster at the Sewer 1F (Adventurers at Lv. 10 or higher may go and exchange) Obtain by investigating the strange lair at the Sewer 1F.
原本遭遇追捕的赛依连，利力，玛嘉雷特三人，趁着凯特莉娜引发的大火得到了逃离的机会: The trio of Seyren, Lili, and Magaleta under hot pursuit finally had a chance of escaping thanks to the fire caused by Katerina. However, Seyren decided to stay in the lab alone to stop the pursuing troops. Seyren stayed in the Biological Body Lab alone.
遭遇追捕的赛依连，利力，玛嘉雷特三人，趁着凯特莉娜引发的大火得到了逃离的机会，但: The trio of Seyren, Lili, and Magaleta under hot pursuit finally had a chance of escaping thanks to the fire caused by Katerina. However, Seyren decided to stay in the lab alone to stop the pursuing troops. Magaleta was taken out of the Biological Body Lab by Peco Peco Lili.
凯特莉娜苏醒后面前是疯狂的研究员们，他们继续对她进行着实验。由于负面情绪而暴走的: Katerina woke up and those crazy researchers were still doing experiments on her. As her negative emotions went out of control, Katerina triggered a resonance between the sorcery return circuit and the artifact heart, resulting in a huge explosion which caused a big fire in the lab. Her whereabouts remained unknown...
哈沃德在苏醒后第一时间开始寻找伙伴，不知为何没有警备队来追捕他。他遇到了正在异变: As soon as he woke up, Hayward began searching for his mates. For some reason, there was no garrison troop after him. He encountered Deeven who was undergoing mutation and managed to stop the process with the Music Box.
迪文苏醒后展示了她冷静的一面，并找到了雷根贝勒公司的机密档案，似乎记载着某种实验: Deeven regained consciousness and revealed her calm side. She found the Rekenber Corporation's classified document which contained information about some experiment. The last part of Deeven's memory showed her changes towards violent and bloodthirsty under a certain influence.
艾勒梅斯在被抓入生体研究所后苏醒较早，他凭借强大的实力与刺客的隐匿技术逃离了追捕: After being brought into the Biological Body Lab, Eremes regained consciousness quicker than others. He escaped the pursuit with his great might and concealing skills as an assassin. However, a mysterious swordsman appeared in front of him and his identity...
指导员康尼是带领志愿生海拉米成为消防员的人，如今的他四十九岁了，原本还有一年时间: Instructor Connie was the man who led the volunteer Herami onto his fire fighter career. Now he's 49, one year away from his retirement. However, after teaching so many outstanding fire fighters, he could have never guessed his own ending. Not being awarded a medal in the fire station or dead at a fire scene, he became a monster wandering aimlessly outside the fire ruins.

“你好，我们是娜乌西卡族的山谷居民，如果你收到了这块石板，那说明我们的飞行队终于: "Hello. We are the Nausicaa people living in the valley. When you are reading this slate, our air fleet has finally broken through the Typhoons' imprisonment and reached the outside world. We don't expect whoever has received our slate to understand our language; let alone coming to our rescue in the valley. All we ask is one thing. If you are also a human being like us, please cherish your free life outside the valley. If I could have another life, I wish I could enjoy the true beauty of the wind like you do. -- The Nausicaa Chief A. W. 830
出名的“强运”神器，佩戴之后玩飞行棋能一六到底，跟人划拳永远喝不到罚酒，每天会有: A well known super lucky artifact that guarantees the bearer's victory on all board games and drinking games. A group of bored fellows will gather around you daily, shouting "Suck, suck, suck..." Sigh... How lonely it is to be so lucky. I miss the golden days when I lost my every bet...
星星在苍窜闪耀，雄鹰翱翔蓝天，树木枝叶茂盛，树干连着大地，我将这最高的荣誉授予你: Stars are shining brightly in the sky and eagles soaring. Trees are luxuriant and flourishing and their trunks are connected to the ground. I bestow this highest honor on you, our hero. Please never forget the responsibilities on your shoulders. Protect the weak and defend your country! Woof!
使用后会变为暗·剑士\u00A0赛尼亚持续一定时间。注意！骑乘或阵亡时就会解除变: Use it to transform into the Dark Swordsman Cenia for some time. Attention! Transformation terminates when riding or dead in action. This item can't be cancelled once opened
肉质鲜美的斐扬嫩牛是小豆柴的最爱。: The fresh and delicious Payon tenderloin is little Mame Shiba's favorite.
散发着七色光晕的胡桃，是芙兰朵一族的最爱。: A walnut that gives off colorful rays. A favorite of the Frando clan.
一颗毛绒绒的魔物蛋，里面可以孵化出魔物顽皮小豆柴。宠物好感度10级后可解锁骑乘功: A fluffy egg from which a monster Naughty Mame Shiba can be hatched. Increase the Pet Popularity to Level 10 to unlock the riding feature and attributes
一颗毛绒绒的魔物蛋，里面可以孵化出魔物威风小豆柴。宠物好感度10级后可解锁骑乘功: A fluffy egg from which a monster Prestige Mame Shiba can be hatched. Increase the Pet Popularity to Level 10 to unlock the riding feature and attributes
一颗毛绒绒的魔物蛋，里面可以孵化出魔物神勇小豆柴。宠物好感度10级后可解锁骑乘功: A fluffy egg from which a monster Brave Mame Shiba can be hatched. Increase the Pet Popularity to Level 10 to unlock the riding feature and attributes
一颗小小的魔物蛋，里面可以孵化出魔物巨耳芙兰朵。: A tiny egg from which a monster Giant-eared Frando can be hatched.
超高温下的扭曲时空，不知会通往何处……\n使用后召唤一个裂隙，触摸裂隙后触发随机:
A distorted time and space under an ultra high temperature that leads to an unknown destination... 
Use to summon a rift. Touch the rift to trigger a random event. 
* There are 10 random events in total 
* Each account is limited to 1 use per day and it can be used forever without consumption. You may share it with your teammates.
米德加尔特大陆的夏天，怎么能少的了清凉的夏装呢！使用之后可以打开「夏日甜蜜礼特别: Who could spend the summer in Midgarts without a refreshing summer dress? Use it to open the Summer Sweet Gift Special Store and exchange for a refreshing summer dress!
使用期间，通用仓库取出道具和冒险手册存取武器、盾牌没有等级限制: While using it, there's no level limit for taking items out of the general warehouse or accessing weapons and shields in the Adventure Handbook
完成克雷斯特汉姆主线任务解锁: Complete the Glast Heim main quest to unlock
完成艾尔帕兰主线任务解锁: Complete the Al De Baran main quest to unlock
完成尼夫海姆主线任务解锁: Complete the Nefheim main quest to unlock
完成里希塔乐主线任务解锁: Complete the Lighthalzen main quest to unlock
了不起的冒险者啊，为我做件事吧，作为男爵，我一定会给你相应的好处的！: My amazing adventurer, please do me a favor. As a Baron, I'll offer you a fair pay!
太可恶了，想要得到我父亲的遗产竟然还要解开谜题？！你，快来帮我！: Bloody hell. I have to solve a puzzle to get my father's inheritance! Please help me!
关于遗嘱的谜题，我有线索了！果然还是要靠我的智慧，但我仍然需要一个家伙帮我处理麻: I've got a clue about the will puzzle! In the end, it was my intelligence. However, I still need someone to take care of the trouble for me. And you are the man!
我大哥把线索告诉你了？快来找我说说！像你这样高尚的冒险者，应该不会想私吞这笔钱遗: My brother has told you the clue? Tell me quickly! I hope a noble adventurer as you won't attempt to take possession of the inheritance privately.
啧，遗产不在大哥那儿，那么就剩下一种可能了，还想拿到你的报酬的话就来找我，冒险者: Hmm... My elder brother doesn't have the inheritance. There's only one possibility left. Adventurer, come to me if you still want your payment.
上次你说有坏消息要告诉我，到底是什么事？对于我来说，只要遗产还在就是天大的好事！: Last time you said you had some bad news for me. What is it? For me, it will be a great thing as long as the inheritance is still there!
关于卡罗尔男爵父亲遗嘱的事，我的师傅杰拉尔好像已经找到了真相，我觉得你或许也想知: About Baron Carol's father's will, my master Gerald seems to have figured out the truth. I think you might be interested.
嘿，有兴趣来搞点大事吗~？: Hey, are you interested in starting something huge?
我又掌握了独家的头条，想来看看么？: I've got some exclusive headline news again. Are you interested?
贝勒区又发生有趣的事了，你快过来瞧瞧！: Some interesting thing just happened in Baylor again. Come and have a look!
这回我绝对是第一个报道的！朋友，过来帮我个忙吧！: This time I'm for sure is the first man on this! My friend, please help me!

1.每日超过指定战斗时长，经验和掉落开始衰减。\n2.每日凌晨5点恢复150分钟:
1. EXP and loots begin to decrease during the time exceeding combat duration. 
2. Combat duration restores 300 minutes at 5 am daily. Unused combat duration can be accumulated for up to 600 minutes. 
3. PVP does not count as combat duration. MINI and MVP are not affected by the decrease rule. 
4. If you are in a party during decrease period, only yourself will be affected to the rule and your party members will not be affected. 
5. If the teammates and you are on the same map, when they fight, the combat duration will be shared with all teammates on this map.

村里不是正好有两个没爹没妈的小孩吗？: Don't we have two orphans in the village?
是他们的父母当年造了水车，我们才有今天的生活！你不能这么说啊！: Their parents built the windmill that year. That's how we can live today's life! You can's say that.
那又怎么样？水车早就不能用，而且现在他们的父母已经死了。两个小孩就是最佳人选，你: Yeah, so? The windmill has long gone out of use. And their parents are dead. The two kids are our best choice. Do you have a problem?
你在犹豫什么？难道我们要眼睁睁看着大家都饿死？: What are you hesitating about? Do you want to watch us die of hunger?
有的事你必须去做。因为你是村长，这是责任。: There's something you must do. Because you are the head of the village and this is your duty.
小、小佩姬……你怎么来啦？: Little Peggy... What are you doing here?
我想求村长爷爷一件事！: Grandpa Chief, I have a favor to ask!
您可以借一些白布和线给我吗？马上要到哥哥的生日了，我想做个布娃娃送给他！: Could you lend me some white cloth and threads? Soon it will be my brother's birthday. I want to make him a doll.
哼哼，我就知道村长爷爷人这么好，一定会借给我的！: Emm... I knew Grandpa Chief wouldn't let me down!
好啦，现在开始做娃娃……缝个什么好呢？: Okay. Let's make a doll. What shall I make?
缝一只白熊吧！圆圆的，傻乎乎的，但是非常温暖。: A white bear! Fat and silly but very warm.
好端端的怎么会着火？快去打水啊，找我有什么用？: How come? Get water! What do you expect me to do?
半个村子都被烧掉了，那个火邪的很，怎么灭都灭不掉！: Half of the village has been burnt down. This fire is wicked. We can't kill it!
这样下去会死很多人的，求求您去看看吧！: Many will die if this continues. Please come with me and take a look!
异乡的冒险者，你是来阻拦我的吗。: Foreign adventurer, are you here to stop me?
村庄已被夷为平地，熊熊火光之中，人们都尖叫着死去。: The village is gone. Everyone in the fire screamed until the last moment of their life.
这是代价，是报应！: This is the price. This is karma.
你是谁！为什么要放火烧了村子？！: Who are you! Why did you burn down the village?
嗯？只是过去了短短十年，劳伦斯叔叔就已经不认得我了吗。: Huh? It has been merely a decade and Uncle Laurence already forgot about me.
我和哥哥，小时候可没少受您的关照呢。: You took good care of us when my brother and I were little.
不可能……你、你是当年那个小女孩……: No way... You... You were the little girl...
你为什么要这么做！这是你的家乡啊！: Why did you do this? This is your home!
呵，那又如何？这里还有人把我当做家人吗？: Heh. So? Who treated me like a family here?
可到底是谁把我逼上这条路的，你我心知肚明！: But who pushed me onto this path? You and I know the answer too well.
今天就是你的死期，劳伦斯。: You are to die today, Laurence.
谢谢你没有插手。我终于了却了自己的心愿。: Thank you for not interfering. I've completed my dream finally.
你不必多说，我知道我是个罪人。: Don't say anything. I know I'm a sinner.
亲手烧了故乡，杀了所有村民，我罪无可赦。: I burnt down my own village and killed all its residents. I can't be forgiven.
可又有谁知道，我起初只是想安定的和家人过完一生……是他们亲手毁了这一切。: But does anyone know that I only wanted to live a peaceful life with my family? They ruined everything.
复仇本是我活下去的动力，但现在，一切都结束了。: Revenge has driven me to live on. Now it's over.
我毁了这片土地，为了赎罪，我会留下来。: I destroyed this land. To atone for my sin, I'll stay.
冒险者，可以帮我个忙吗？: Adventurer, could you do me a favor?
我给自己施了魔咒。很快，我的身躯将会消散，灵魂和所有的魔力则会附在这片竹叶上。: I cast a spell on myself. Soon my body will vanish but my soul and all my power will attach to this bamboo leaf.
请你将这片竹叶埋下，以后这里便会重新长出竹林了……这是我对这片土地的忏悔。: Please bury this bamboo leaf and soon a forest of bamboos will grow here... This is my repentance for this land.
你就是将我唤醒的冒险者吗？: Are you the adventurer who woke me up?
你好，我叫加洛德。你是不是找到了几样东西？那些是我的记忆。: Hello, my name is Garrod. Have you found a few items? Those are my memories.
我是一个被困在这里的亡魂，没有记忆我就无法离开此地。谢谢你帮我找回来。: I'm a trapped soul. I can never leave without my memories. Thank you for helping me get it back.
多亏了你，我全都想起来了。: Now I remember everything thanks to you.
很久以前，我的父母为村庄建造了唯一的水车，为村庄供水。村民们表面上对他们尊敬有加: Long, long time ago, my parents built the only windmill for the village's water supply. The villagers appeared to respect them but none of them attended my parents' funeral.
从此，我和妹妹就成了孤儿，受尽了村里人的白眼，只有村长关照一二。: After, my sister and I became orphans. We had all the dirty looks from the villagers. Only the chief took care of us here and there.
有一天，严重的旱灾席卷了村庄，粮食颗粒无收。受到巫师蛊惑的村长把我绑走，给了山妖: One day, a severe drought swept the village and all the crops yielded nothing. Bewitched by a wizard, the chief kidnapped me and offered me to the mountai monster...
你还是亲眼看看吧……所谓的山妖，所谓的献祭，全都不存在！: Have a look with your own eyes... The so-called mountain monster and offerings don't exist at all!
呀！！怎么这里有个人类小孩！: Ah! Why is there a human child?
我是这片土地的守护精灵斯卡莉特。小朋友，这里是不能随便乱逛的，不然会被吃掉哦。: I'm Scarlett, the Guardian Spirit of this land. Little guy, you can't just walk around here or you'll be eaten by monsters.
哎呀呀，我是不会吃人的~不过山上别的魔物会吃人哦。他们又凶又可怕！: Hah. I don't eat men but other monsters in this mountain do. They are ferocious and terrifyig!
你怎么会跑到这里来啊，我把你送回去吧。: How did you get here? Let me send you back.
我看看……怎么会这样，他们居然把你献祭给我了！: Let me see... Why did this happen? They offered you to me!
是……应该是这里的村民，用了巫术把你的身体和灵魂都献祭给我了……: Yes... I think those villagers offered your body and soul to me with some witchcraft...
为什么啊啊啊！！都说了我不吃人了！！: Why! I already said I eat no men!
难道是因为没有降雨，他们才想出这个馊主意？！: Is this because of the lack of rain?
我确实无法降雨很久了……同时也渐渐失去了这块土地的支配权……可是那是因为缺乏供奉: I have been unable to make rain for a while... And I'm slowly losing control of this land... But that's because I'm short of offerings!
简而言之，村里的人不再相信我的存在，或者说歪曲了我的存在，我就会渐渐失去力量，变: In short, when the villagers stop believing in my existence or distorting my existence, I'll slowly lose my power and downgrade to an ordinary spirit.
他们确实觉得住在荒山上的是很坏的山妖呢。: They really think there's an awful monster dwelling in the barren hill.
哼，所以说人类大多是愚蠢的。: Hmm! No wonder they say the majority of humans are stupid.
不过前两天碰到一个小姑娘，倒是对我很礼貌，也不枉我送了她紫藤花啊。: The little girl i met a few days ago was very polite. She deserved the wisteria I gifted her.
那是佩姬！那是我妹妹佩姬！！: That was Peggy! My little sister Peggy!
原来你是她的哥哥啊，果然两个都是好孩子……: You are her brother. Two good kids...
斯卡莉特小姐，我有个请求。: Miss Scarlett, I have a request.
嗯嗯？你说！只要我能做到，一定答应你！: Emm? Say it. I'll help you if I can.
我想回去见佩姬……: I want to go back to see Peggy...
爸爸妈妈都不在了，如果我也走掉，她一个人会很辛苦的……: My parents are no longer there. If I'm also gone, she will suffer...
我很想帮你，可是你现在的身体无法离开这座山……: I'd love to help you but your current body can't leave this hill...
你能接受用另一副躯体见你的妹妹吗？: Would it be okay for you to see your sister in another body?
只要能见到佩姬，怎么样都可以。: As long as I can see Peggy, any body works!
那好，我需要制造一副躯体……你想变成什么？除了人类都可以！: Okay. I need to make a body... What would you like to be? Anything but a human!
佩姬曾经送过我一个白熊布娃娃。如果是白熊的话，她会喜欢的！: Peggy once made me a white Teddy Bear. If I become a white bear, she'll like it.
好，那我要开始了。会有一点疼，可以忍受吗？: Okay. I'll start. It will be a little painful. Can you handle it?
好疼……但为了佩姬，我要忍住……: It hurts... For Peggy, I can bear this...
好孩子，快去见你的妹妹吧。: Good boy, go to visit your sister.
唉，最后我还是孤零零一个人啊……: Sigh... In the end I was all by myself.
如你所见，我变成了白熊，以另一种方式回到了佩姬身边。: As you can see, I became a white bear and returned to Peggy in a different form.
没想到，我还是没能保护她到最后。: But I couldn't protect her till the end.
后来，斯卡莉特失去了人类的信仰。她最后变成了普通的树精，一直徘徊在郊外……: Later, Scarlett lost humans' faith. She became a normal willow, lingering in the suburb...
佩姬被仇恨蒙蔽了双眼，成了黑魔女，一把火烧了村子……: Peggy was blinded by hatred and became a black witch. She burnt down the entire village...
而我，被同样的人杀死了两次。一次是作为人类，一次是作为白熊。: I was killed again by the same group of people. First as a human, then as a white bear.
佩姬，斯卡莉特，还有我……我们又做错了什么呢？: Peggy, Scarlett, and I... What did we do wrong?
佩姬化作了山间的竹林，斯卡莉特也始终留在这里。唉……: Peggy has become the bamboo forest in the mountains, and Scarlett is trapped here forever. Sigh……
哈，我就呆在这座水车边上吧。: Hah, I'll stay by this windmill.
这是我父母建造的水车，也凝聚着我和佩姬最美好的时光。: This windmill was constructed by my parents. The best time of Peggy and I was spent here.
如果可以，我想在这里一直守护它。: I'd like to guard it forever if I can.
冒险者，我再次向你道谢。: Adventurer, please allow me to thank you again.
是你让我知道，人类中不光有卑鄙愚昧之徒，也有你这样心怀光明、追求正义的人。: You taught me that there are humans bright and just besides those nasty and ignorant.
谢谢你，帮我找回了珍贵的回忆。: Thank you for helping me get back my precious memories.
一块雪白的糖糕，香气中飘散着回忆。是否拾取？: A piece of white sugar cake with memories in its fragrance. Would you like to pick it up?
池塘那儿似乎有什么动静。莫非……赶紧去看看！: There is some noisy from the pond. Could it be... Hurry!
这是一片闪闪发亮的竹叶子。要拾取吗？: This is a shiny bamboo leaf. Would you like to pick it up?
竹叶的光芒更加耀眼了，眼前出现了人影。: The bamboo leaf shone more brightly and a human figure began to appear.
已经走到了这一步吗。: Are we already at this stage?
许多过往，时间无法摧毁。: The past can't be destroyed by time.
喜欢一个人原来就是这样的心情吗？: Is this how it feels to love someone?
黑龙尼德霍格的魔剑，拥有斩裂空间的力量。: The dark dragon Nidhogg's Magic Sword. It has the power to cleave time and space.
时光含苞待放之际，从新世界的起点，我背上琴开始远游。: When time was about to bloom, I started my long journey with my instrument from the beginning of the new world.
这熟悉的魔力波动……你的身上有着某样蕴含时间魔法的东西。: This familiar magic wave... Something on you bears the time magic.
没错，是时光碎片！: That's right. It's the Time Shard.
以防万一，我还是再确认一遍……你记得时光碎片是什么吗？: Just in case, let me ask again. Do you remember what the time shard is?
给你这道魔力卷轴。用它就能开启碎片中藏着的时空之门。: Take this Magic Scroll. Use it to open the Time Gate hidden inside the shard.
给你魔力卷轴，用它开启时空之门吧。: Take this Magic Scroll and open the Time Gate with it.
……怎么会有人类来到此处？: ... How did a human get here?
我明白了。你也是那条龙的考验之一吧。: Got it. You must be one of that dragon's tests.
跟着我，这里很危险。: Follow me. This place is dangerous.
深渊之湖，黑龙的巢穴。: The abyssal lake , the dark dragon's den.
这位剑士好像并不愿意说太多，还是先跟上他吧。: This Swordsman doesn't like to talk. Follow him.
没想到，你竟真的能来到此处！: I didn't expect you to make it here.
多年前，魔王梦罗克将我龙族陷入灭顶之灾，以至于我如今只能在这阴暗之地苟延残喘。: Many years ago, the demon lord Morroc almost wiped out all the dragons. Because of him, I'm dragging my life in this dark corner.
诸神黄昏之后，我被困于此，已是强弩之末。可梦罗克仍是我心中拔不去的一根刺。: I've been trapped here since the Ragnarok, like an arrow at the end of its flight. However, I still can't get over Morroc.
你若真想杀了那魔王——我可助你一臂之力。但前提是，你须证明自己配得上我的相助。: If you really want to kill the demon lord, I'll give you a hand. However, first you must prove you are worthy of my assistance.
很好。那便沿着这条路一直走吧。: Great. Follow this road till the end.
……不行，我不能哭。一昧的哭泣不是男子汉该做的！: ... No. I can't cry! Tears are not for men.
我要快点长大，成为和爸爸一样勇敢的战士！: I want to grow up faster and become a warrior just like my father.
孩子，如果可以，我希望你永远也不要踏入战场。: My son, I hope you can stay out of the battlefield if possible.
我只求你平安长大，好好活着……: I want to to grow up safely and live a good life.
你说有事情想告诉我，是什么事呀？: You wanted to tell me something. What is it?
无论你在何方，我都会永远守护在你身边！: No matter where you are, I'll be by your side till the end.
别说什么永远，“永远”是很遥不可及的……: Don't say "till the end". That's too much...
我只希望，你能在每一个“现在”陪着我，那就足够了。: I just want to have you by my side now. That's enough.
我答应你了哦，达纳托斯！我们在一起吧！: I say yes, Thanatos. Let's be together.
……希尔斯……抱歉，你再等等我好吗。: ... Hills... Sorry... Please wait for me.
我很快就会来见你。: Soon I'll come to see you.
援兵很快就到了，亚当。你会没事的。: The reinforcements will be here any second, Adam. You'll be okay.
能不能，答应我一件事？: Could you promise me one thing?
……你去……去前面……他们都还需要你……: ... You go... Go to the front... They need you...
好……但你也要答应我一件事。: Okay. But you must promise me one thing in return.
那是我们的约定……而你从不失约。: That's our deal... And you never break your promise.
你为何不听从我的劝解，一意孤行走向你父亲的末路？: Why can't you listen to my advise? Why do you have to follow your father's path?
你为何不遵守昔日的诺言，让我独自等待在死亡的尽头？: Why don't you keep your promise, leaving me waiting till death?
你为何遗忘了过往的约定，留我一人在噩梦的深渊徘徊？: Why don't you remember our deal, leaving me wander in the abyss of nightmares alone?
你们是我无法释怀的往昔之痛。但如今我站在这里，便是做好了面对一切的觉悟。: You are my unforgettable pain... But now I'm standing here, ready to come to realization.
我将舍弃过去的所有，舍弃我全部的不甘，懊悔……和遗憾。: I'll put aside the past and all my unwillingness, pity, and regrets.
我不会再被过去束缚了，只会背负着痛苦继续前进。: I won't be trapped by the past anymore. I'll carry on with pain.
唯有痛苦，让我清醒……: Only pain can keep me sober...
是怎样的意志让你坚持于此？: What kind of will power kept you this far?
为这片大陆上，每一个无辜死去的生命复仇。: To take revenge for every innocent spirit on this land.
……哪怕你最后会变成非人的怪物？: ... Even if you will become a monster?
哪怕连死后，你的灵魂都不得安息？: Even if your spirit will have no peace after death?
……为了那些已经死掉的人放弃一切，值得吗？: ... Is it worth it to give up everything for the dead?
这就是赫格尼……矮人首领用我的血液和鳞片锻造出的魔剑。: This is Hogne... The dwarf chieftain forged this Magic Sword with my blood and scales.
刚刚魔剑出现一刹那，恍惚间，我看到了奇怪的场景。: When the Magic Sword emerged, I saw a weird scene for a moment.
我看到了一个漆黑的地方。我举着魔剑，脚下躺着梦罗克的尸体。: I saw a dark place. I raised the Magic Sword with Morroc's body lying by my feet.
而魔剑已经和我融为一体，它即将把我全部吞噬。: The Magic Sword was part of me. It was about to devour me down.
……可能这就是命运吧。但我不后悔。: ... Maybe that's my fate. But I don't regret.
为了我爱的人们和这片土地，就算是燃尽灵魂，我也在所不惜。: For my loved ones and this land, I'm willing to burn my soul down.
你的脸色看起来很差……发生什么了吗？: You don't look well. What happened?
……原来，达纳托斯是去了深渊之湖，拿到了尼德霍格的魔剑。: ... So Thanatos went to the Abyssal Lake and obtained Nidhogg's Magic Sword.
他最后用这把剑斩杀了魔王梦罗克，但也最终与剑融为一体。: He killed the demon lord Morroc with the sword and eventually became part of the sword.
先不说这些了……我感觉到时光碎片的魔力又发生了波动。你去把它放到祭坛上吧。: That's enough of it. I can feel the Time Shard's magic is changing. Place it on the altar.
嘿。初次见面，异乡的旅人。: Hey. Nice to meet you, foreign traveller.
能和你相逢即是命运的指引。要不要来听听关于此地的诗歌？: Our meeting is guided by fate. Would you like to hear a poem about this place?
那还真是遗憾。我一时还不会离开，你若改变主意，可以回来找我。: That's a pity. I will be here for a while. Come back if you change your mind.
“他迎着月光而来隐匿于一片虚无”: He walks towards the moonlight, hiding in the void
“仰望星辰的指引步入命运之深渊”: Following the stars' guide to the abyss of fate
“欢呼祈祷悲泣只为摧折灵魂的剑士”: Cheers, prayers, and cries all for the broken Swordsman
“杀戮鲜血腐朽终将魔王的魂魄撕裂”: Slaughter, blood, and corruption will tear the demon lord's soul apart
“他随着月光而去溺于寂静的高塔”: He leaves with the moonlight, drowning in the lonely high tower
“伴着星辰的哀叹陷入最后的沉眠”: Falling into his last sleep with the stars' rement
“百年岁月流转月光与星辰消逝”: One hundred years pass and the moonlight and the stars vanish
“只余时光奏响英雄的古老诗篇”: The old poem about the hero is performed by time
——这就是关于此地的歌谣。过去的传说面对时间，终究只会化作一声叹息。: This is a ballad from this region. The past legend will become a sigh over time.
我是谁呢？在很久以前的米德加尔特，也曾流传过我的故事。: Who am I? Long, long time ago in Midgard, there were stories about me.
或许多年之后，关于你的诗篇也会在这片大陆传唱。: Maybe poems about you will be popular on this land some years later.
想在这混？先问问我同不同意！: You want to stay here? Get my permission first.
好奇怪啊，这怎么可能呢？: So strange. How is it possible?
散发着能量的水晶。: A crystal that gives off energy.
哼，别看我这副样子，在小时候，我也是个温柔的孩子！: Hmm. Don't judge me by my looks now. I was once a gentle kid.
怎么！你不相信？我以前还有一只宠物呢！: Yeah? You don't believe? I once had a pet.
没错，她的名字叫做妮妮！是一只……: Yes, her name is Nini. It's a...
我也不知道妮妮是啥！反正毛茸茸的很可爱！: I don't really what Nini is! It was fluffy and cute.
可是某一天，妮妮不见了！十有八九是雷根贝勒那些家伙做的好事！: But one day, Nini was gone! Very likely Rekenber and his mates have something to do with it.
雷根贝勒的研究员们突然闯入下水道，后来又莫名奇妙的逃走了！妮妮正好是那阵子失踪的: Rekenber researchers suddenly broke into the sewer and then fled quickly. Nini went missing around the same time.

Unable to let go her grudge for the violent death, she gathered Horong souls in the forest and became a fox spirit. As her power grew, Jade lost her kind nature and the Horong souls could no longer satisfy her. She reached her evil claws to residents of Payon until her encounter with Lywight... (This quest includes nine tasks, namely the Lost Wine Jug, Naughty Chowee, Lywight's Worry, Rice Field Turmoil, Fox Jade, Persistent Yearning, Jade's Decision, Jade's Relief, and Sorrowful Payon)
那孩子叫加达尔，梦想是成为一名伟大的弓箭手，天资聪慧，目光精准，具备着成为一名绝: That child is Gadar. Blessed with  natural endowments and sharp eyes, he dreams to become a great archer and has all the talents it takes to be an exceptional archer. However, he has one serious shortcoming that he tends to quit in the face of hardships. Teacher Vicky doesn't know what to do with him. Could you help him? I believe this boy will become a brilliant hunter with the right training. He'll be a great helper to you! (This quest includes nine tasks, namely the New Apprentice, Gadar's Plan, Little Apprentice's Request, Tutor's Certificate, Capricious Apprentice, Poi's Old Trick, Trial Appointment, Rapid Growth, and Gadar's Completion of the Apprenticeship)

Please help it (This quest include 5 tasks, namely the Hunger, Duke Kitty, Down in the Dumps, Invisible Cat Flea, and Big Joke)
布兰德和布拉奇曾是一对双胞胎兄弟，当年的古城一战，两人在战乱中不幸失散，随后在不: Brand and Bracci were twin brothers. They lost touch with each other during the war at Glast Heim and died in action against the ruthless Undead Legion. Some of their wishes were incomplete thus their souls respectively attached to the long sword and bow they used to use. Brave adventurer! If you see a rusty sword and a rusty bow in Glast Heim, that would be them. Please help them complete their wishes. (This quest includes 9 tasks, namely the Cursed Sword, Elder Brother's Last Wish, Younger Brother's Whereabouts, Liquorice, Anolian's Tail, Fulfill the Wish, Younger Brother's Response, Elder Brother's Chest, and Precious Picture)
“爷爷！爷爷！怎么办，谁能来帮帮我？”小男孩无助的呼喊着，路人对小男孩的遭遇视若: "Grandfather! Grandfather! What shall I do? Can anyone help me?" A young boy cried helplessly but the passers-by ignored his misfortune. A hand reached out to him before desperation completely took over his heart. He lookd up and saw a witch standing in front of him with a smile as if a beam of light shining into a deep abyss. However, wherever there's light, there's darkness. How is the witch? An envoy of God? Or a devil from hell... (This quest includes 10 tasks, namely the Time Witch, Time Magic Wand, Ice Breaking, Rani's Harassment, Ice Melting, Every Second Counts, Refinement of Movement, Impenitent, Heeding the Well-intentioned Advice, and Zizi and Marti)

兽人村落里的图腾祭坛被人一夜之间拆解了。信仰火种被人盗走，图腾柱头也被埋在了泥土: The totem altar in the Orc Village was disassembled over one night. The faith tinder was stolen and the heads of totem columns were buried underground. During the restoration of the Totem Altar, the dust-laden past was dug out. A long, long time ago, a plague stroke the Orc Village. Warrior Ferdinand solved the disaster with a pair of deer horn with spiritual force. The deer horn belonged to his dearest one. For the safety of the village, he harmed her. The person responsible for the damage of the totem altar was the young deer saved by Ferdinand many years ago who lost its horns to him and got injured badly. Everyone thought she returned to take revenge but all she wanted was an answer. The altar was eventually restored and she set out with her memories to pursue her warrior. "Ferdinand, I don't hate you anymore..."
许多年以前，在斐扬附近的一个小村庄里，生活着加洛德和佩姬兄妹俩。村庄常年干旱，他: Many years ago, young siblings Garrod and Peggy lived in a small village near Payon. The village suffered from drought year after year. Their parents constructed the only water mill for the village so the people could have adequate food and clothing. Soon after, they passed away due to overwork. Garrod and Peggy became orphans, frequently pushed aside by other villagers. The siblings depended on each other for survival. Unfortunately, another drought befell several years later. Bewitched by a wizard, the village chief took Garrod as a sacrifice to the mountain monster for rain. Peggy lost all her blood relatives. After being sacrificed as offering, Garrod realized the so-called mountain monster was actually the guardian spirit of Payon. The spirit had pity for Garrod thus transformed him into a white bear before letting him go. Garrod returned as a white bear to keep Peggy company. The good times didn't last. During one outing, the white bear was spottd by a villager. The greedy villager killed the white bear for its precious coat, which sent Peggy into misery. Holding intense grudge towards this village, she left. A decade later, Peggy returned as a Black Mage and burnt down the entire village. After taking revenge, Peggy had no more reason to live on. She transformed herself into a bamboo leaf and exhausted her magic to restore this land. Garrod's soul was saved. He went back to the water mill full of his old memories and continued to guard his sister. Nowadays, the lush bamboo forest and the spinning water mill in Payon are telling this past story silently.

They became the first bard and the first dancer. At the beginning of the Ragnarok, Bratje, one of Almighty Odin's sons, had to return to the realm of Gods to join the battle. Edna stayed in Mjolnir alone, gazing at Bratje's gold lyre day after day... Over time, her body became Romantic Flower over the years, twining around the gold lyre. Her intense love turned the gold lyre into the Floral Lyre... The Floral Lyre's four strings slowly withered and eventually became flowers again In the meantime, Edna's four emotions lost memories and clung to four flowers. Adventurer brought the four flowers to the Fairy Mjolnir Kaisa Britney, an creation of Edna's. The Floral Lyre was fixed ad Bratje's Sheet Music was discovered in a mine. The melody from the Floral Lyre sounded in Mjolnir again. Edna was awakened by Bratje's poem. She decided to stay in Mjolnir and continue to wait for her lover Bratje...
达尔村是以狩猎闻名的村落，但是打猎不知节制的他们已经严重影响了森林的平衡，他们的: Dahl was a village widely known for its hunting tradition. Fortunately, Godley came in time to stop the hunter. To repay this kindness, Robin the guardian of the forest transformed into a scarecrow to help guard his favorite wheat field. Happy times never last. Luke's friend Perlo the crow trainer sent his crows to destroy Godley's wheat field, which were driven away by Robin. Coincidentally, Perlo fell ill due to his long-term contact with crows the cursed bird. Villagers of Dahl accused Godley, who was sealed in a sakkat to prove his innocence. Robin witness all of these, the Smile Mask couldn't be kept any longer and the soul of revenge was roused. It emerged to punish those people. Free from the trap, Godley stopped it at the cost of his own life. Grandpa's death brought Robin back to consciousness. It transformed into a happy scarecrow to guard the wheat field forever..

[b]参赛规则[/b]\n1）GVG决战于周日21:00:00开启，21:30::
[b] Participation Rules [/b]
1) GVG final starts at 21:00 and ends at 21:30 every Sunday. 
2) After the Thursday GVG, all guilds in control of City 1 are qualified for the competition and may go to the GVG final map at 20:57 on Sunday. 

[b] Battleground Rules [/b]
Faction 
Four guilds will participate in the GVG Finals. Each participant guild is an independent faction. No alliance is allowed. 

How to win 
1) The guild with 5 [Crystal Resources] win at once. 
2) If no guild has gathered 5 [Crystal Resources] by the end of the battle, the guild with the most crystals wins. 

Crystal resources 
1) There are 5 regions on the battleground producing crystals for guilds to fight. 
[Central Core]: Available for occupation from 3 minutes into the battle. Occupy to gain 2 crystals which will be deducted once lost. 
[East Crystal Tower] [West Crystal Tower]: Available for occupation from 3 minutes into the battle. Occupy to gain 1 crystal which will be deducted once lost. 
[Green Magnificence] [Blue Magnificence] [Red Magnificence] [Purple Magnificence]: Worth 1 crystal resource when not broken. It will be deducted once broken by another guild and it can't be repaired. 
2) If a guild's magnificence is broken, all guild members will be forced to revive at the guild platform once dead in action for a certain period of time. 

* How to occupy: The guild with the most members in the occupation circle continues to accumulate occupation points until the occupation progress is full and the area will become the guild's. 

* Crystal Shard resource 
1) 1 MVP is refreshed every 3 minutes on the upper/lower platform. Whichever player deals the fatal strike at the MVP earns 1 crystal shard for his guild.
2) Every 4 crystal shards can be converted into 1 Crystal Resource that can't be taken by others.
1.玩家可以通过点击激活按钮之后弹出的预设按钮进行模拟加点。\n2.模拟加点时，:
1. Players may simulate points adding on the pre-setting button after tapping the Activate button.
2. During the simulation, points adding and resetting won't consume any items or money. 
3. The simulation of points adding will create a yellow pre-setting route. 
4. Player may hide or display the simulation route by tapping the button at the bottom left corner to complete points adding by following the pre-setting route.
5. Players may search for all the key Astrolabe points by using the search bar. The results will be highlighted on the Astrolabe as well as the mini map. 
6. Players may move the Astrolabe to a specific area instantly by tapping the mini map at the top right corner.
1. Each character may obtain the Monster Laboratory dungeon reward 3 times per day with unlimited entry to the dungeon. 
2. The dungeon will consume 30 minutes of players' combat time every time. 
3. Dropping offline or exiting the dungeon before completion will not grant rewards or deduct players' combat time. 
4. The dungeon lasts for 10 minutes. The more waves of monsters players can kill in the dungeon, the more rewards. 
5. During the settlement, players will receive base EXP, job EXP, and a small amount of low class materials according to their level. 
6. For each monster killed in the dungeon, players gain 1 Investigation Credit, which can be consumed to purchase combat items from the merchant inside the dungeon. Combat items can help players to kill monsters faster.

1.强化精炼分为武器与饰品两种，可根据穿戴的装备的精炼等级给予冒险者一定的精炼攻:
1. Enhanced Refinement is divided into two types, weapons and accessories. It can provide adventurers some refine ATK bonus according to the equipped gear's refinement level. 
2. Each position has five tiers, namely elementary, intermediate, advanced, top, and ultimate, and each tier contains ten levels. Each level increases a certain amount of refine ATK bonus. 
3. When the equipped gear's refinement level meets the requirement, that level's refine ATK bonus begins to take effect. 
Elementary Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +1 or above 
Intermediate Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +5 or above 
Advanced Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +9 or above 
Top Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +13 or above 
Ultimate Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +13 or above 
4. Adventurers may choose to increase Refine ATK or Refine M. ATK at each level according to their own needs. 
5. The total refine ATK provided by Enhancement Refinement stays the same
