此戒象征着我等的赤诚之心，无论前方道路如何荆棘，我等身躯必定挡在吾王之前，以吾热: This ring symbolizes our sincere hearts. No matter how thorny the road ahead is, we must protect our king. We will use our blood to consolidate the king's territory.
这条项链送给你，我可爱的小木偶，这是对你的救赎，或许也是对我……伟大的木偶师——: This necklace is for you, my lovely little puppet. It's your redemption, maybe it's also my... The great puppeteer, Tibbers.
左，右，前，后，你的一切行为都脱离不了我提伯斯的掌控，我可爱的小木偶……: Left, right, front or back, all your actions are under my control, my lovely puppet...
皎月当空，我把它摘下佩戴在你的胸前，只愿你能记住我们相遇的时光……: I will take off the moon and wear it on your neck. I just hope you can remember the time we met.
海妖克拉肯的眼睛，被它注视的人立刻就会被寒冷和黑暗包围，这是死亡的前兆。: The eye of the North Sea Monster, the Kraken. Those who are looked at by it are immediately surrounded by cold and darkness, which are the omens of death.
恶犬之王的宝藏，想要征服它的人都成了它的奴仆，如果你的实力和你的野心不相匹的话，: The Evil Dog King’s treasure. People who wanted to conquer it have all become its slaves. If your strength is not matched with your ambition, you should not touch it.
狐王的犬齿制作而成的项链，佩戴它的人可以号令所有狐族。: A necklace made of the Fox King's canine teeth. The person who wears it can command the whole fox clan.
天空，大地，山川，河流，这世上的一切事物都逃不过它的感知……: Sky, earth, mountains, rivers... Everything in the world can't escape its perception...
不为一己之荣光，火焰所到之处既是我等守卫的疆土: This is not for one's own glory. Where the fire goes is the territory of our guards.
是尔等召唤吾现身？此戒，为你我之誓，戴上它，吾会助尔等战胜黑暗。: Did you guys summon me? This ring represents the promise between us. Put it on, I will help you overcome the darkness.
永远不会消散的戒指，力量取决于所使之人，弱者视如鸡肋，强者如虎添翼: A ring that never disappears. Its strength depends on the user. The weak thinks it’s useless while the strong thinks it’s powerful.
幸运也是实力的一种……: Luck is also a kind of strength...
精灵是不会哭泣的，更何况是精灵中的王者，这是精灵王在遇到那个他心爱的人类之前的想: Spirits never cry, let alone the king of the Spirits. This is what the Spirit King thought before he met his beloved human.
喵呜~喵呜~人类快来，啵唧！这个猫爪印是我们之间的约定哦，以后本喵会永远陪着你的: Meow, meow! Human, come on! This cat paw mark is our agreement. From now on, I’ll always be with you.
所有的时光都逃不过这三位女神的操控，过去归由兀儿德，现在归由薇儿丹蒂，未来则由诗: There are no moments that can escape these three goddesses’ control. The past is controlled by Urd, now it is controlled by Verthandi, and the future is controlled by Skuld.
信仰之束，忠诚之束，大隐隐于合，静为隐，动亦为隐，二者合一，视为隐。: We have the binding of faith and loyalty. The biggest toleration is to combine “move” and “still”.
听从自己的内心，发挥自己本我的力量，你会发现那束属于自己的光芒是多么的耀眼。: Listen to your heart, show your true strength, you will find out how dazzling you are.
为了提升冒险者在旅途中的生存几率，冒险家协会特地打造了这枚戒指。: In order to improve adventurers’ survival chances during their journeys, the Adventurers Association made this ring.
使用一千棵草中才能找到一棵的护符草制成的项链，能给人带来意想不到的好运。: A necklace made of Talisman Grass which can only be found in a whole grassy plain. It can bring people unexpected good luck.
究竟是四叶草带来好运，还是拥有好运气才能找到四叶草呢？: Is it the Four-leaf Clover that brings good luck, or is it good luck that helps us find the Four-leaf Clover?
带着大海气息的护符，不建议在吃饭时佩戴。: A talisman that smells of the sea. It is not recommended to wear it when eating.
活蹦乱跳，还带着大海气息的护符，戴着它就永远不会失去梦想。: A lively talisman that smells of the sea. Wearing it can make you remember your dreams forever.
人没有梦想，和鲔鱼有什么分别！: What’s the difference between you and a fish when you don’t have a dream?
圣音回响，神明之力伴你左右，不负神之托，应允神之誓，圣光之盔会助你在冒险中，远离: The battle chant echoes, the Gods’ power is around you. Do not bear the trust of the Gods, and obey your oath to them. The Holy Light Helm will help you stay away from all dangers and injuries during your adventures. May your clear soul remain forever.
神匠工坊邀请了卡普拉公司知名的服装设计艾诺斯，特地为机匠打造了一套万能的魔导头盔: Whitesmith workshop invited Kafra Co.'s famous designer Enos to build a Mado helm set for the Mechanics.
“我觉得这个发带很适合你。”“真的么？”微风拂过，女孩子头顶的蝴蝶结害羞的抖了抖: “I think this hair band suits you well.” “Really?” The bow above the girl's head shakes shyly as the breeze blows.
由百年红木所制，使用后可以防止脱发，是拼搏在一线的冒险者们的必备之梳。: It's made of century old Rosewood, and can prevent hair loss after use. It's a necessary comb for adventurers who are fighting hard at the front line.
“滋……滋滋……滋滋滋……”信号接收良好，天气情况正常，三，二，一，起飞！: “Bzzz... Bzzzz...” Signal reception is good, weather conditions are normal. Three, two, one, take off!
“你的灵魂，就由我收下了！”看到这句话时千万不要以为它只是玩笑，毕竟信件的前几任: “Your soul will be taken by me now!” When you see this sentence, don't think it's just a joke. After all, the previous letter’s owners have all encountered accidents. Are you sure you will be the lucky one?
你爱我吗？爱我就为我亲手带上这个发带！: Do you love me? If you do, wear this hair band on for me!
一大群喵喵朝你发射爱心~: A large group of Meows are shooting hearts at you!
和猫薄荷一样清爽的发型。: A hairstyle as cool as catnip.
和咕噜声一般萌萌的发型。: A hairstyle as cute as cats' purring.
喵喵~感受到猫咪的凝视了吗？: Meow! So you can feel a cat's gaze?
能感受到生命之力涌动的发型！: A hairstyle that can make you feel the surging of life's power!
神秘可爱的曼陀罗种子终于长大啦，炎炎夏日将它带在身边，不仅能多一个羞羞的跟班还能: The mysterious and lovely Mandragora Seed has finally grown up. Having it with you in the hot summer, you can not only have a shy attendant, but also feel the breeze from Labyrinth Forest!
她将白雪融为羽刃，伴着月光斩断深渊，羽翼飘落之处，天幕银河流淌，圣歌吟咏之际，诸: She melts the snow into a feather blade, cuts the abyss under the moonlight. The place where the feather falls, the sky and the galaxy flow. and the Gods bestow the dawn when the hymn is chanted.
波利岛寄来的奖章，这是国王波利对你的肯定，可不要辜负他的心意哦！: A medal sent from Poring Island. It's King Poring's affirmation to you. Don't let him down!
上一任森林女巫留下的烛台，巴西里斯克吐出的魔法火焰可在其中永恒燃烧。: The candlestick left by the last forest witch, in which the magic flame from the Basilisk can burn forever.
以冰狼的毛皮制作而成的披风，是雪原中最英勇战士的勋章。: A cape made of Ice Wolf's fur. It is considered as the medal of the bravest soldier in the snow field.
据说是多兰族历经成长后的最终模样。圆溜溜的眼睛里闪烁着属于王者的光辉，就连原本毛: It is said to be the final appearance of the Dorams after they grow up. Its round eyes shine with the king's glory, even the furry tail looks extraordinary.
传言DJ飞仔黄得了一种不听舞曲就会死的病，连在空中“飞翔”也要跟着复古旋律扭着屁: It's said that DJ Fizzi Huang has a disease that he will die from if he doesn't listen to dance music. Even if he is flying, he twists his butt to a retro melody. If you ask him what kind of music he likes best, his sharp eyes will penetrate the sunglasses to respond to you - "disco! How could you not know!"
狮心王的陪伴让你永远有一颗勇敢的心: With the company of Lion Heart, you will always have a brave heart.
曾是某位剑士的随身佩剑，但随着死亡之塔的诅咒日益魔化。似乎是一缕执念，让它依旧闪: It was once a swordsman's sword, but with the curse of the Tower of Doom, it became more and more demonic. It seems to be a wisp of obsession that makes it still shine like it used to.
手感很好的大猫尾巴，不过如果乱摸的话会被一爪子拍飞。: A big cat's tail which feels really good. Be careful if you want to touch it, because you may be slapped.
相当浮夸的纯金眼镜，让你的每个眼神财气飞扬。温馨提示——多摆pose少走路，不然: A pair of quite pompous pure gold glasses that make you look rich. Tip: strike more poses and walk less, or it'll be easy to bang into trees...
多年前罗扎纳健美大赛的舞台上，莱昂纳多先生在众星捧月中取走了冠军奖杯。“哦，他可: Many years ago, on the stage of the Lasagna Bodybuilding Competition, Mr. Leonardo won the championship trophy. "Oh, he's such a cool guy." Said Miss Ireta while covering her heart.
“他迎着月光而来，隐匿于一片虚无。仰望星辰的指引，步入命运之深渊。”: “He comes in the moonlight and hides in nothingness. Looks up to the guidance of the stars and steps into the abyss of destiny.”
雪原战士瓦西里的短剑，以雪原上最坚硬的冰霜融炼而成。被赋予了北风的祝福，越是寒冷: A knife belonging to Wassily, the snowfield warrior, which is made of the hardest ice on the snowfield. It is given the blessing of the north wind, the colder the place it goes, the more powerful it becomes.
带着你一起去冒险，是我对你许下的承诺。: It's my promise to take you on adventures with me.
英灵不朽，神域不朽，聆听神之歌，颂扬神之威，为神祇献上最虔诚的灵魂者方可佩戴它。: The epic spirit is immortal, and the realm of the Gods is immortal. Listen to the Gods’ songs, praise the Gods’ power. Only by offering the most devout soul to the Gods will you be able to wear it.
传言芙蕾雅曾在大陆上遗留下了几颗皎洁的珍珠，其中蕴含着无数圣灵的力量，是拉赫人趋: It is said that Freya has left several bright pearls on the continent, which contain countless Holy Spirits’ power. They are the treasure that people in Rachel are eager for.
“永恒之雪，赐予我无尽的勇气，与面对死亡的力量。”——雪原战士瓦西里的冠冕。许多: "Eternal snow gives me endless courage and strength to face death." -- Snowfield Warrior, Wassily's Crown Many years ago, he trekked into the depths of the glaciers, calming the raging storm alone.
万年的坚冰淬炼才可出一块冰域龙鳞，坚硬而强大是它的特制，是世间不可多得宝物。: One thousand-year-old hard ice can only make one Ice Dragon Scale. Its hardness and strength are its main characteristics, which make it a rare treasure in the world.
看起来非常诱人，但是一点也不甜的糖豆，还有一股苦瓜味。: It looks very attractive, but it's not sweet at all. It has a bitter melon flavor.
带来灾难和厄运的眼瞳，被它盯上的人都不会有好的下场，只能在痛苦的深渊中不断地经受: The pupil of an eye that brings disaster and doom. The person that is looked at by it will not have a good ending, and will only suffer in pain.
远星大陆随处可见的叶片，拥有和羽毛一样绒绒的触感。: Leaves that can be found everywhere on the Far Star Continent. They have the same velvety touch as feathers.
触碰它的时候一定要小心，极寒的温度随时呼将你冻伤。: Be careful when touching it. The extremely cold temperature can freeze you at any time.
散发着淡淡香气的奶酪，是在远星上常见的食品。: Cheese with a light fragrance which is a common food on the Distant Star.
米德加尔特大陆上最坚硬的金属之一,由于硬度过高不易精炼。: One of the hardest metals in Midgard, which is difficult to refine because of how hard it is.
这是来自深渊的生物，你的一举一动都逃不过它的感知，“嘘，这是它的气息，它来了。”: This is a creature from the abyss. Your every move will be under its perception. "Shh, that's its breath. It's coming."
神祇？只有愚蠢的人类才会信奉那些无用神祇？我希巴姆才是值得敬仰的人！低贱的蝼蚁们: Gods? Only stupid humans believe in useless Gods! I'm the one that should be admired!!! Inferior low beings!
希尔队长是伊达平原罕见的生物之一，传言它身上有一根羽毛拥有着强大的魔力，是世人梦: Hill Wind is one of the rare creatures from the The Plain of Ida. It is said that it has a feather which has strong magical power. Every one wants that feather!
闪烁着不可思议光芒的海星，阳光中仿佛宝石一般闪闪发亮。: A starfish that radiates incredible light. It shines like a gemstone in the sun.
以鲜血绘制出复杂的法阵，用以召唤强大的魔神，愿您听从奴仆的呼唤，让黑暗降临人间！: Draw a complex array with blood to summon powerful demons. May you listen to the call of your servants and let darkness descend on the earth!
吃起来甜滋滋的榛果，因为数量稀少，总是会被某种毛茸茸的小动物藏起来。: A kind of hazelnut which tastes sweet. It is always hidden by some small furry animals because of its scarcity.
不幸丧生的信徒骸骨，上面似乎还残留着逝者生前的痕迹。: Bones of dead believers. There seems to be some traces from before their death.
骨制的锐利牙齿，可以穿透任何硬物，是淬炼武器的材料之一。: Sharp teeth made of bone which can penetrate any hard object. They are one of the materials used for quenching weapons.
罕见的金色猫草。散发着不可思议的香气，没有猫咪能拒绝它的诱惑。: Rare Golden Catnip. It has an incredible fragrance. No cat can say no to its temptation.
所有椰果中最大最香甜的一颗，据说是被太阳直射了九十九天才有这么迷人的香气。: This is the biggest and sweetest of all coconuts. It has a charming fragrance after being exposed to the sun for 99 days.
集拉赫所有信徒信仰所制的坚钉，尖端的锋芒可以刺穿魔物最强的防御，从而驱逐一切的黑: A nail made of all the faith of believers in Rachel. Its sharp edge can pierce the strongest defenses of demons, and expel all darkness.
传言是由芙蕾雅女神留下的圣书的一角，尽管上面记载的内容已经模糊不清，但是其中蕴含: It is said that this is a part of the Sacred Book left by Freya. The contents recorded above are unclear, but the power of the Gods contained within it still can't be underestimated.
味道和外表一样甜蜜的甜甜圈，是远星大陆第一可爱的象征。七彩飞龙们经常为了争夺它闹: A donut that tastes as sweet as its appearance. It is the cutest symbol of the Far Star Continent. Rainbow Dracos often fight for it.
有着晶莹光泽的美丽珍珠，被海水冲刷后漂到了沙滩上，深受猫咪女孩们的喜爱。: Beautiful pearls with a crystal luster. They are washed up by the sea, and drift onto the beach. Cat girls love them very much.
由隶属于卢恩·米德加尔特王国的冒险者公会颁发，象征着责任和荣誉的导师资格证书，那: Issued by the Adventurer's Guild of Rune Midgard, This Mentor License has endowed responsibility and honor on an individual. From today, a cute Novice will be handed over to you for teaching!
用魔菇的肉做成的肉排，散发出诱人的香气，但是吃了会中毒吧？据说是下水道公主斯丽帕: Steak made with spore, very fragrant but probably toxic. It is allegedly liked by Nini, the pet of the sewer princess Sleepa.
雷根贝勒公司研发的能产生能源的水晶，似乎可以当作能源来启动隧道前的灯。如果你拥有: A crystal developed by Rekenber Corporation to produce energy. If placed in front of a tunnel lamp, it could probably be used as energy. If you are in possession of this item, give it to Benster at the Sewer 1F (Adventurers at Lv.10 or higher may go and exchange). Can be obtained by investigating the strange den on the Sewer 1F.
在初代法老发现了千年魔法的同时，这柄权杖就与其它三柄一起被命运赐予了他。权杖顶端: At the same time that the Pharaoh discovered this thousand-year magic, the scepter was given to him by fate along with the other three. The crown of the scepter with the jewels at its top symbolize wealth. Before he died, he passed the scepter on to his beloved younger daughter, Nefer. He hoped that the scepter, which symbolizes wealth, would protect Nefer from troubles her entire life.

At the same time that the Pharaoh discovered this thousand-year magic, the scepter was given to him by fate along with the other three. The sun on the top of the scepter symbolizes power. Before he died, he passed the scepter on to his son Ahmad, the heir to the kingdom. He hoped that the scepter, which symbolizes power, would always remind Ahmad of the obligations behind his power.

At the same time that the Pharaoh discovered this thousand-year magic, the scepter was given to him by fate along with the other three. The vivid eyes at the top of the scepter symbolize wisdom. Before he died, he passed the scepter on to his beloved eldest daughter, Cleo. He hoped that the scepter, which symbolizes wisdom, would grant Cleo endless wisdom and enable her to achieve her dreams.

At the same time that the Pharaoh discovered this thousand-year magic, the scepter was given to him by fate along with the other three. The dark snake head at the top of the scepter symbolizes eternal life. Before he died, he left a will to bury this scepter with him and to never see the sun again. It is said that he wanted eternal life after death. Regardless, this human greed was finally sealed in the coffin with him in the end.
法老艾哈迈德在继任后没多久便下令建造金字塔，将千年魔法封印，并与初代法老的棺具一: Not long after his succession, Pharaoh Ahmad gave an order to build the pyramid, and sealed the thousand-year magic in the pyramid, then made it sleep deeply with the first Pharaoh’s coffin. In order to unseal the Millennium tesseract at an important moment in the future, Ahmad left a key, which only powerful people could use to break the ancient seal. It is said that this key is guarded by some kind of monster. It has gradually been forgotten by people as time goes by...
打开就会发出尖叫的血瓶，原本属于月精灵瓦莱丽。打开血瓶会增进任何魔物的力量，是难: A Blood Bottle that will scream when you open it. It originally belonged to Valerie, the Moon Spirit. Opening the Blood Bottle will enhance the strength of any monster. It's a rare piece of treasure.
月精灵瓦莱丽的花环，在光的照射下会闪淡淡的幽光，且让周围的花草跟着一起绽放。: The wreath of Valerie, the Moon Spirit. It shines under the light, and can make the flowers and plants nearby bloom together.
月牙形状的一枚小金币，虽然不起眼，可这枚金币能吸收月光的精华，原本属于月精灵瓦莱: A small crescent shaped gold coin. It’s unremarkable, but it can absorb the essence of moonlight. It originally belonged to the Moon Spirit, Valerie.
闪着蓝色的幽光，原本属于月精灵瓦莱丽。盈盈之光虽然微弱但仍然很坚强的燃烧着，会招: It shines with a blue light. It originally belonged to the Moon Spirit, Valerie. The weak light burns firmly. It attracts the Moonlight Nightmare to guard the candle flame.
百年前，吉芬城内发生了一起骇人听闻的屠杀事件，是狼人少年斯蒂芬斯无法控制力量酿成: A hundred years ago, an appalling massacre happened in Geffen, which was caused by a power beyond the control of the werewolf boy Stephens. Valerie, the Moon Spirit, took all the charges in order to protect Stephens. She was imprisoned by magicians in a red moon, and sealed under the Geffen Tower. Stephens didn't want Valerie to suffer all the pain alone. He thus guarded the tower for a hundred years, until his last days. In the end, the seal was broken. Valerie was freed and gave Stephens his last kiss. And Stephens, bathed in her moonlight, left the world with a smile.
黏糊糊的网，会粘住所有接近的东西，据说是下水道公主斯丽帕的宠物——妮妮喜欢的东西: A sticky web that can trap everything that approaches. It was allegedly liked by Nini, the pet of the sewer princess Sleepa.
雷根贝勒公司根据神工匠哈沃德的设计优化过的翻译装置，使用后，能翻译出部分魔物的叫: An improved translation device developed by Rekenber Corporation based on Whitesmith Hayward's design. Use it to translate some monsters' screams.
雷根贝勒公司研发的能产生能源的水晶，似乎可以当作能源来启动隧道前的灯。: A crystal developed by Rekenber Corporation to produce energy. If placed in front of a tunnel lamp, it could probably be used as energy.
已捕获目标，斯丽帕的宠物蜘蛛，开始人造伊米尔之心提取物实验阶段一，代号奥拉克妮。: Target, Sleepa’s pet spider, has been captured. It’s time to start the Artificial Yimir Heart’s extract experiment phase 1, codenamed Ola Kney. After a week of mutation, the body size of the experiment subject, known as Ola Kney, became significantly larger. The other indicators are normal. Two weeks later, the target is still growing. We've changed its vessels several times. Three weeks later, the target’s mutation seems to be getting out of control! It's getting too big, we're trying to put it in the tunnel. One month later... The plan failed! We created a monster, help...
鹰，是兽人战士们最好的伙伴，它们可以跟随着战士们出生入死地战斗，也可以和战士们一: Eagles are Orc Warriors’ best companions. They can fight to the death with the warriors or hunt with them for food for the village. The Orc Warriors brought the immortal wood from Nefheim, carved them into totems, and offered them to the Totem Altar in the village. They pray to this Falcon Totem for the courage of eagles all the time.

思念花寄宿着青春女神伊多娜对布拉吉的日夜思念，“如果他还爱我，就算是经历轮回，他: This Longing Flower hosts Edna’s care of Bratje both during day and night. “If he still loves me, even if he has to be reincarnated, he will still come back to me. 羽毛是如同深渊一般浓烈的黑色，不难看出这是来自乌鸦身上的。乌鸦被称作诅咒之鸟，食: This feather is as black as the abyss. It's not hard to tell that it comes from a crow. Crows are called cursed birds. 位于达纳托斯塔初始之地，庄严而又充满神秘气息的大厅。它拥有与破败的塔完全相反的华: Located at the original place of Thanatos Tower, it is a magnificent hall filled with a mysterious breath. It features resplendent decorations in contrast to the dilapidated tower. It might have appeared together with Valkyrie and the guard. The gate to the next level of Thanatos Tower is wrapped by chains. Earn Valkyrie Rathgricy's approval to open it.
位于枷锁之间后，达纳托斯的负面精神世界。奥术魔方真正看守的区域，囚禁着达纳托斯的: Located behind the Hall of Chains, it is Thanatos's negative spiritual world. The zone guarded by the Tesseract where the will mentalists of Thanatos's four negative emotions are imprisoned. Dark and chaotic, dilapidated and rotten, full of the air of despair and death. Over here, unstable will mentalists are affecting the entire tower every second. It's extremely dangerous for those with a weak mind. Enter with caution or you might fall into disorder.
百年前达纳托斯与魔王的决战之地。位于死亡之塔的顶端，隐匿于诅咒中的最后区域，达纳: The final battlefield between Thanatos and the demon lord a century ago. At the top of the Tower of Doom, it is the last zone hidden in a curse where Thanatos and the Magic Sword of Hogne are resting. Adventurer and Siren went through hardships and dangers to reach this place in hopes of purifying the magic sword's curse and saving the legendary hero. However, in the dark shrouded by despair, behind the overflowing curse was an unknown plot...
拉斯格瑞丝通过守护者大厅内的【能量水晶】获得护盾。该护盾免疫一切物理和魔法攻击，: Rathgricy obtained a shield from the energy crystal in the Guardian's Hall. The shield is immune to all physical and magic attacks and can't be weakened by adventurer's strikes.
失去护盾后，拉斯格瑞丝开始认真起来，使出全力攻击冒险者。: After the loss of the shield, Rathgricy became serious and launched an all-out attack at the adventurer.
达纳托斯击败魔王梦罗克后，将自己囚禁于塔中，灵魂日益被魔剑所腐朽。在生命的最后，: After defeating the demon lord Morroc, Thanatos imprisoned himself in the tower. His soul was corrupted by the magic sword slowly. In the end of his life, he sighed, "Weakness troubles me, sacrifice saddens me, and slaughter brings me hatred... What makes me desperate is this brutal fate." Under the magic sword's curse, Thanatos's four negative emotions, namely worry, sorrow, hatred, and despair, gradually became Mentalist. Four Thought Polymers wandered in the Tower of Doom day and night.
绝望交织而成的壁垒之中: In the walls weaved with despair
达纳托斯的悲哀聚合体在内场迎战冒险者，需由得到悲哀共鸣的冒险者前往挑战。: Thanatos's sorrow Polymer is awaiting at the infield. Adventurers with the Sorrow Resonance may advance to challenge.
憎恨凝聚而成的魔眼之下: Under the demon eye formed by hatred
达纳托斯的苦恼聚合体在外场迎战冒险者，需由得到苦恼共鸣的冒险者前往挑战。: Thanatos's Worry Polymer is awaiting at the outfield. Adventurers with the Worry Resonance may advance to challenge.
战斗开始前场上将产生4个【守护法球】，全部拾取后刷新意念聚合体。拾取法球的玩家不: Before the battle, 4 Guardian Orbs will be created in the field. Collect them all to refresh the Mentalist. Players who have picked the orbs won't be affected by the debilitating will's Sorrow Aura or Worry Aura.
曾经拯救了米德加尔特大陆的英雄。为了击败魔王梦罗克，前往深渊之湖得到了黑龙的魔剑:
A hero who once saved Midgard. To defeat the demon lord Morroc, we travelled to the Abyssal Lake and acquired the dark dragon's Magic Sword at an irreversible dear price.
After his final battle with Morroc in the Tower of Doom, he successfully severed his soul into seven pieces. However, his own soul was corrupted by the magic sword's curse, about to become an inhuman monster. To prevent any leakage of the curse, Thanatos begged the lord of gods to seal him inside the tower at the end of his life. From then on, the magic sword and him were imprisoned in the Tower of Doom. The top of this tower became the end of this hero.
达纳托斯刚刚解除封印，正逐渐回复力量。: Thanatos has just removed the seal and is slowly regaining his power.
Thanatos pull out the magic sword and the endless nightmare devoured everything. A hero emerged in the despair...
Thanatos has fallen but darkness is still here. Persistence is the only way to the light...
本场战斗中，每个玩家将会获得【狂乱】的负面效果，依据狂乱值造成持续伤害。当狂乱值: In this battle, every player has a debuff of Frenzy, which will cause DMG over time according to the Frenzy value. When Frenzy reaches 40, a [Nightmare Guard] will be summoned during the first stage and the player will be dragged into the [Nightmare Interior] during the second stage. When Frenzy reaches 100, the player will trigger the [Nightmare Outburst].
狂乱值不会随死亡清除，只会在【清醒宝珠】周围，或触发【梦魇爆发】时清除。: The Frenzy value won't be erased by death. However, when by the Sober Bead or once the Nightmare Outburst is triggered, Frenzy will be erased.

召唤出3个【风暴信标】，可被点击移除，一定时间后在【风暴信标】处召唤【风暴之眼】: Summon 3 [Storm Beacons] which can be removed by tapping them. After a certain period of time, these [Storm Beacons] summon [Storm Eye].
施法2秒后对周围目标造成范围伤害并击退，附加3层【感电】状态。【感电】状态下风属: After casting for 2 seconds, deals ranged damage to surrounding targets and repels them. Adds 3 layers of the [Electrify] status. [Electrify] Reduces your Wind resistance and increases damage taken. Can be stacked up to 20 times.
对目标造成弹跳2次的闪电攻击，根据自身【充能】状态层数提高伤害。: Launches a lightning attack that bounces from target to target twice, dealing increased damage according to [Charge] stacks.
受到的最终伤害降低，可叠加5层，每2秒回复一层，受到攻击时减少一层。: Final damage taken is reduced. Can be stacked up to 5 times. 1 stack is restored every 2 seconds. When attacked, 1 stack is consumed.
将附近的敌人吸引到自己身边，并施加一层【感电】。: Pulls nearby enemies toward you and applies one stack of [Electrify].
对随机目标造成风属性伤害，会弹射数次。: Deals Wind damage to a random target. Can deal damage multiple times.
释放出多枚冰刺攻击随机目标，施法时自身受到伤害降低。: Launches multiple ice spikes to attack random targets. Damage taken while casting is reduced.
对前方造成水属性范围伤害，并使目标受到的魔法伤害提高。: Deals Water damage to enemies in the area in front of you and increases magic damage taken by the target.
在附近随机位置召唤3个寒冰巨人仆从。: Summons 3 Ice Titan servant at random nearby locations.
制造一块冰霜地面，降低敌人的装备攻速，延长吟唱时间，并提升自身伤害。: Creates a frost zone that reduces enemy Attack Spd, increases their Cast Time, and increases their damage taken.
使周围的敌人减速，并大幅降低水属性防御。: Slows down enemies around you and greatly reduces their Water Resistance.
对目标造成单体物理伤害，并击晕。: Deals physical single-target damage and stuns the target.
对目标周围的范围造成持续水属性伤害，有一定概率造成【冰冻】。: Deals continuous Water damage in the area around the target, with a chance of inflicting [Freeze].
对大范围内的敌人造成念属性伤害，并在一段时间内将他们的护甲属性改为念属性。: Deals damage in a huge range, dealing Ghost damage to enemies and changing their armor attributes to Ghost-type for a period of time.
对随机目标造成火属性范围伤害，并造成【灼烧】状态。: Deals AoE Fire damage to a random target and inflicts [Burn].
对当前目标造成范围伤害，并造成【恐惧】效果。: Deals AoE damage to your current target and afflicts them with [Fear].
以自身为中心造成大范围火属性伤害，距离越远伤害越低。: Deals AoE Fire damage across a huge range, with yourself as the center. The further the distance from you, the lower the damage dealt.
开启一个【噩梦节点】，每隔一段时间召唤2个【阿加波】或【艾基奥】。被消灭时移除【: Opens a [Nightmare Node] that summons 2 [Agavs] or [Echios] every other period of time. When eliminated, a stack of [Dystopia] is removed from the [Gloom Under Night].
每一层使自身受到的最终伤害和造成的最终伤害降低，最多叠加3层，每分钟回复一层，脱: Each stack reduces final damage taken and final damage dealt. Can stack up to 3 times. One stack is restored every minute, and stacks are restored to the max after leaving battle.
对目标造成火属性伤害。: Deals Fire damage to the target.
对周围的敌人造成伤害，并增强【幽暗梦魇】的攻击力。: Deals damage to surrounding enemies and increases the Gloom Under Night's Atk.
对目标造成伤害，并造成【流血】效果。: Deals damage to the target and inflicts [Bleed].
对周围敌人施加瘟疫效果，造成持续无属性伤害。: Afflicts surrounding enemies with a plague, dealing continuous Neutral damage.
生命值降低时，召唤2只【饥饿鬣狗】帮助自己。: When HP is low, summons 2 [Hungry Hyenas] to aid you.
对周围目标施加【恐惧】效果，并降低攻击力。: Inflicts [Fear] on surrounding targets and lowers their Atk.
对自身周围造成【冰冻】效果和水属性伤害。: Inflicts [Freeze] on enemies around you and deals Water damage.
对前方矩形范围造成伤害并击退。: Deals damage to targets in a rectangular area in front of you and repels them.
在自身周围设置一道冰刃之墙，对接触的敌人造成水属性伤害。: Erects a wall of ice wall around you, dealing Water damage to enemies who come into contact with it.
展开暗之障壁抵挡7次近战物理伤害。: Forms a Safety Wall that resists melee physical damage 7 times.
以随机目标为中心造成范围暗属性伤害，并施加暗属性易伤。: Deals AoE Dark damage with a random target as the center and inflicts Dark vulnerability.
施法2秒后以自身为中心对周围敌人造成暗属性范围伤害，并吸收生命值。: After casting for 2 seconds, deals Dark AoE damage to surrounding enemies with yourself as the center, and absorbs their HP.
生命值降低时，召唤2只【女妖】帮助自己。: When HP is low, summons 2 [Banshees] to aid you.
对目标造成单体无属性伤害。: Deals single-target Neutral damage to the target.
投出3道锁链，对命中的目标造成伤害和眩晕: Throws 3 chains, dealing damage and stunning targets hit.
造成高额范围伤害，并对命中的所有目标增加20点狂乱值: Deals heavy AoE damage and grants 20 Frenzy to each enemy hit.
蓄力2秒后对当前目标造成大量物理伤害: Gathers power for 2 seconds, then deals heavy physical damage to the current target.
施法1秒后对4个方向一直线上的所有目标造成范围伤害，使所有受到伤害的目标增加10: Deals AoE damage to all targets in a straight line in 4 directions after casting for 1 second, and increases the Frenzy of all targets hit by 10.
蓄力3秒后对前方一直线上所有目标造成范围伤害并击退，使所有受到伤害的目标增加10: After charging power for 3 seconds, deals AoE damage to all targets in a straight line and repels them. All targets hit gain 10 Frenzy.
随机点名2个目标，5秒后在其位置造成范围伤害，使所有受到伤害的目标增加20点狂乱: Randomly marks 2 targets, dealing AoE damage at their location after 5 seconds. All targets hit gain 20 Frenzy.
随机点名1个目标，使其在5秒内受到持续伤害，并每秒增加2狂乱值。效果结束或该玩家: Randomly marks 1 target, making them take continuous damage for 5 seconds and increasing Frenzy by 2 per second. When this effect ends or you die, summons a [Nightmare Executioner].
在随机3个位置造成范围伤害，使命中的目标增加5狂乱值: Deals AoE damage in 3 random locations, dealing AoE damage. Targets hit gain 5 Frenzy.
被击破后持续净化半径5米内的所有目标，每秒清除2点狂乱值，持续10秒；清除共计1: When destroyed, continuously purifies all targets within 5 meters, clearing 2 Frenzy per second, for 10 seconds. After clearing 100 Frenzy in total, this effect will end.
用【噩梦】覆盖整个地图，处于【噩梦】中的所有玩家，每秒增加2点狂乱值: Covers the whole map with [Nightmares]. All players caught in the [Nightmare] gain 2 Frenzy per second.
玩家狂乱值达到40时将传送进入【梦魇之核】，在梦魇之核中将不断出现黑暗怪物向中央: When a player's Frenzy reaches 40, they will be teleported to the [Nightmare Core]. In the Nightmare Core, you'll see dark monsters approaching the magic sword. [Desperate Climber] Coming into contact with the magic sword will deal a certain amount of damage to all players and increase Frenzy by 1. When the [Nightmare Lord] touches the magic sword, [Nightmare Outburst] will be triggered once. Using a hero's power can free them from the [Nightmare Core] and clear their Frenzy, but they will not be able to enter again for a certain period of time.
释放魔剑之力，对随机多个目标造成大范围的高额伤害: Unleashes the power of the magic sword to cause wide-range, severe damage to multiple random targets.
整个达纳托斯塔被魔剑的力量污染，全体玩家每秒增加3点狂乱值: The entirety of Thanatos Tower is tainted by the magic sword's power. All players gain 3 Frenzy per second.
对敌方单体造成物理攻击*[8df936]%s%%[-]的暗属性物理伤害: Deals Atk x[8df936]%s%%[-] Dark physical damage to a single enemy.
对敌方单体造成魔法攻击*[8df936]%s%%[-]的风属性伤害: Deals Wind damage equal to M.Atk x [8df936]%s%%[-] to a single enemy.
对敌方单体造成魔法攻击*[8df936]%s%%[-]的魔法伤害，有[8df93: Inflicts damage equal to M.Atk x[8df936]%s%%[-] to a single enemy with a [8df936]%s%%[-] chance of inflicting Petrify for 5 seconds.
给1个敌方单体造成魔法攻击*[8df936]%s%%[-]的火属性魔法伤害，火球: Deals Fire magic damage equivalent to M.Atk x[8df936]%s%%[-] to an enemy unit and launches fireballs that hit other targets in range. The damage dealt by each subsequent fireball increases by [8df936]%s%%[-].
当主人死亡时复活主人，并恢复其100%%HP和SP，复活之后的[8df936]%: The master is resurrected upon dying, and restores 100 %%HP and SP. Grants invincibility for [8df936]%s%%[-] seconds after resurrection.

对敌方单体造成物理攻击*[8df936]%s%%[-]的暗属性伤害: Inflicts Dark damage equal to Atk x[8df936]%s%%[-] on a single enemy unit.
宠物和主人攻击时有[8df936]%s%%[-]机率使敌人进入诅咒状态，持续4秒: When the master and pet attack, grants a [8df936]%s%%[-] chance to Curse the enemy for 4 seconds.

增加宠物和主人[8df936]%s%%[-]火属性攻击: Increases Fire damage by [8df936]%s%%[-] for the pet and its master.
主人和宠物普通攻击时附加魔法攻击*[8df936]%s%%[-]的毒属性魔法伤害: When master and pet use auto attacks, deals an additional M.Atk x[8df936]%s%%[-] Poison magic damage.
主人和宠物普通攻击时附加魔法攻击*[8df936]%s%%[-]的火属性魔法伤害: When master and pet use auto attacks, deals an additional M.Atk x[8df936]%s%%[-] Fire magic damage and has a [8df936]%s%%[-] chance to inflict Burn.
增加宠物和主人[8df936]%s%%[-]冰冻抵抗: Increases pet and master's Freeze Resist by [8df936]%s%%[-].

一、副本规则\n1.参赛规则\n比赛为6V6组队对抗模式，参赛成员需在90级以上:
A. Dungeon Rules
1. Competition Rules
Participants in 6V6 Team Battle Mode must be at least Level 90. A team of 6 is required to participate in the match.
2. Victory Conditions
*The teams of the two sides will compete to gather resources in the dungeon. The team that gains 4000 points first is the winner.
*Dungeon time is 10 minutes
*If no team accumulates 4000 points within 10 minutes, victory goes to the team with the highest score.
3. Magic Dungeon and Temple of Samsara
Elemental Orb
*Elemental orbs of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind will spawn in all 4 corners of the dungeon 30 seconds after beginning. Players holding an elemental orb will win Victory Points every 2 seconds.
*Each player can only hold 1 elemental orb at a time. When 1-4 players of the same team are holding orbs, they gain 10, 20, 25 or 30 points respectively every 2 seconds.
*Players holding an orb are afflicted by the Vulnerable debuff. Each stack increases damage of the orb-holder by 5%. The longer one holds the orb, the more the Vulnerable debuff increases.
*Players holding an orb are affected by the orb's power, which becomes increasingly uncontrollable. While holding an orb, you cannot enter stealth or gain increased speed, and skill cooldowns are fixed.
*2 elemental orbs can be combined to summon magical effects, weakening the enemy team. Specific combinations are as follows:
Fire + Water: [Elemental Barrier] Reduces enemy's attack and spellcasting range by 40%, as well as the holding player's attack and spellcasting range by 60%.
Fire + Earth: [Magma Path] While an enemy player is holding an orb, they lose a percentage of HP equivalent to their movement speed.
Fire + Wind: [Soul Shackle] When an enemy player approaches, continuously reduces movement speed.
Water + Earth: [Mana Burn] Enemy skills cost +200% SP, and they lose 1% Max Mana each second.
Water + Wind: [Mana Leak] Enemy orb-holding players apply the following status affects to their allies - [Water]: Silences all allies within a 5 meter radius, [Earth]: Petrifies all allies within a 5 meter radius, [Wind] Roots all allies within a 5 meter radius, [Fire] Burns all allies within a 5 meter radius.
Wind + Earth: [Windstorm] Enemy players suffer an unblockable Darkness status for 1.5 seconds every 5 seconds, while enemy orb-holding players suffer Darkness status permanently.
*Combined spells have a 15 second cooldown. Switching orbs during this time does not change the magic effect.
*If Team A grabs more than 2 orbs, the magic effect of that summon is removed, upon which Team B can use the [Dungeon Guardian] NPC to summon a corresponding magic counterattack against Team A.
When an orb-holding player dies, the elemental orb is dropped and the combined spell effects are removed. The elemental orb then returns to its place on the altar.
Buff Orb
*The Buff Orb spawns in the center of the battlefield 1 minute after the start of battle, after which it will respawn every 30 seconds. Only orb-holding players can claim the Buff Orb to gain 150 Victory Points and a random buff.
*Buff Orb Types:
[Anti-stealth] All allies can detect invisible units for 10 seconds.
[Attack Up] The buffed player deals +50% damage against orb-holding players for 10 seconds.
[Accelerate] The holder of the orb exceeds their maximum speed, gaining +200% speed for 10 seconds.
Kills
Each time you kill an enemy player, the team gains 20 Victory Points.
4. Black and White Chess
Map
Consists of a 3*3 chessboard. The 8 pieces except for the center piece can by occupied by moving on them or by standard chess rules. The center piece can only be occupied by standard chess rules;
Chess Rules
*The pieces in the four corners of the chessboard are the medium occupation points. Occupy them to gain 2 points per second for your team; The middle pieces on each side of the board are small occupation points. Occupy them to gain 1 point per second for your team; The center of the chessboard is the large occupation point. Occupy it to gain 3 points per second for your team.
*Defeat an enemy player to gain 1 point for your team. The first team to score 4000 points, or the team with the highest total score at the end of the dungeon, wins.
*Special Rules: If a team member occupies the two end pieces of a three-piece straight line on the board, the middle piece is immediately captured by the player (i.e. three points and one line); If a line is broken for a small piece that was occupied using the "three points and one line" rule, the current occupation status is not broken; Large occupation points can be occupied by four different straight-lines. If one of the two end points is captured, the large occupation point returns to its pre-occupied state under these rules;

Rules:

Rewards: 
1. Dungeon rewards: 
The first time you finish the event dungeon you will receive a "Kumamon's Appreciation " and 5 "Royal Celebration Medal" for that day 

2. Title rewards: 
Based on the score you got from the dungeon, you will receive the following  title and title rewards: 

When you got a score higher than 35, you will receive a title: “Kumamon Core Fans”; and title rewards: "I love Kumamon" x1,  "Kumamon Grateful Giftbox" x5

When you got a score in between 25 to 35, you will receive a title: “Kumamon Loyal Fan”; and title rewards:  "I love Kumamon" x1,  "Kumamon Grateful Giftbox" x2

When you got a score in between 15 to 25, you will receive a title: "Kumamon Fan”; and title rewards: "Kumamon Not So Grateful Giftbox" x2

一、副本规则\n1.参赛规则\n比赛为6V6组队对抗模式，参赛成员需在90级以上:
a. Dungeon Rules
1. Entry rules
For 6v6 Party Battle Mode, participating members must be at least level 90. Parties must have 6 members in order to participate. 
2. Victory conditions
*Both teams must compete and collect resources in the dungeon. When one party reaches 4000 points, they immediately win
*The dungeon will last for 10 minutes
*If neither party reaches 4000 points within the 10 minutes, the party with the most points wins. 
3. Elemental Orb
*Elemental Orbs of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind will spawn in the four corners of the dungeon 1 minute after beginning. Players holding Orbs will earn points for their party every 2 seconds.
*Each player can hold only one Orb. When a party has 1-4 players holding an Orb, they will correspondingly gain 20, 40, 50, and 60 points every 2 seconds.
*Players holding an Orb are afflicted with the Vulnerable debuff, and each stack increases their damage taken by 5%. The longer they hold the Orb, the debuff is continuously stacked.
*Players who are holding an Orb are affected by its power, and it becomes increasingly difficult to control. While holding an Orb, you cannot go invisible or increase speed, and abilities have a fixed CD
*2 effect based on the magic of the Orb. The weakening effects on the opponent are thus: 
Fire + Water: [Mana Burning] enemies consume 200% more mana. 
Fire + Earth: [Crumbling] Enemy physical defense is decreased by 70%. 
Wind + Fire: [Soul Shackle] Approaching enemy players are slowed continuously. 
Water + Earth: [Zone of Frost] Enemies that deal heavy damage in a single strike are frozen. 
Water + Wind: [Static Field] Enemy magic defense is decreased by 70%. 
Wind + Earth [Storm Barrier] Attack distance of ranged enemies is decreased by 60%. 
*The combination spell has a 15 second CD time. During this time, switching Orbs will not change its effect. 
*If the party grabs more than 2 balls, it will remove the magic effect. Team B can then use the [Dungeon Guardian] NPC to cast corresponding magic to counter Team A. 
*When a player holding an Orb dies, the Orb will drop to the ground and the combined magic effect will be removed. The ball will then return to the location of the altar on the map. 
4. Buff Orb 
*The Buff Orb will spawn in the center of the map 90 seconds after the match begins. After this, every 30 seconds as it respawns, only Orb-holding players can compete for the Buff Orb and thereby gain 400 victory points along with a random buff. 
*Buff types include: 
[Reveal] All allied players can detect invisible enemies for 10 seconds; 
[Damage Boost] Players holding an Orb deal 50% increased damage for 10 seconds; 
[Speed Boost] Players can exceed their maximum speed limit by up to 200% for 10s. 
5. Kills
Each time you kill an enemy player, your team wins 20 victory points. 
b. Ranking Rules and Rewards
1. Ranking positions are based on the season system. Each season is 1 and a half months. 
2. Ranking positions are based on high score and are divided into (from low to high) Fighter, Elite, Warlord and Legend. 
3. Each match victory will earn an Honor Proof. 
4. At each position, you will unlock corresponding pets and cosmetic rewards. 
5. At the end of the season, the top 150/300/600 Legend rank players will receive a limited mount reward.

全罗扎纳男性猫咪的梦中情人。拥有完美无缺的可爱面容和令人惊叹的料理技术。在夺得选: Dream lover of a full Lasagna male cat. Has an adorable face and astonishing cooking skills. After winning a beauty contest, used the reward to open an Oven Bar.
前·罗扎纳健美冠军。曾经是万千猫咪少女们追逐的梦想，有一天却为了甜点放弃了爱情，: Former Lasagna Bodybuilding Champion Once the object of pursuit for thousands of Cat Maidens, one day he gave up love for dessert and put on the pounds.
康奇丽娜号的船长，经验丰富的航海家。总是一脸不高兴的样子，其实是个傲娇。和多拉贡: Conchilina's captain, an experienced navigator. He always looks unhappy, but is actually very proud. An old friend of Drogon, and once one of his sea-faring partners.
蝴蝶巡守队的队长，在冒险考核中担任总考官。对待队员严厉又不失关爱。性格坚毅正直，: Captain of the Butterfly Patrol and chief examiner of the adventure assessment. Treats team members strictly, but not without love. Strong integrity coupled with a handsome appearance, he is very popular in Lasagna.
多兰族最伟大的冒险家，所有猫咪的精神导师。勇敢正直，富有领导力，充满男子气概。私: The greatest adventurer of the Dorams and spiritual guide of all the kitties. A courageous and strong leader who exudes manliness. Privately, he's not as serious as he appears. He has a prankish side. Many years ago, he traveled the human world and knew many secrets of the Doram people.
居住在罗比奥森林里的猫咪女巫，沉默寡言的冰山美喵。泪之湖的看守人，掌握着多兰族记: Kitty Witch who lives in Ravioli Forest, a "silent iceberg" cat. Caretaker of Tear Lake who holds the keys to Doram memories. Cold and indifferent, but easily made shy. She doesn't reject people much.
住在着泪之湖底的塔鲁圆皮龙，是猫猫们记忆的守护者。天然呆，平时懒洋洋的，只有食物: The Tarugan Dragon who lives at the bottom of Tear Lake. The guardian of the Kitties' memories. Naturally derpy and usually lazy. Only food can get his attention. Refers to himself as "us". Is on good terms with Carrie the Witch.
机灵活泼的猫咪少年。人缘很好，到处都有他的朋友。满怀好奇心，看起来不太稳重，但观: Nifty Kitty Youngster Very popular, and has friends everywhere. Full of curiosity and seemingly a bit unstable, but superb in observation and analysis. Specialty is baking cakes.
热爱歌唱的音乐神童托兰西，三岁时就可以自己编写乐谱，演奏出的曲子十分受人欢迎，是: Torlansie is a musical prodigy who loves singing. He has been writing songs since he was three, and his performances are very popular. He is the youngest musician in Rachel, but because of his humble background he has never been able to join Rachel's most famous choir - the Le Beta Children's Choir.

Orlando was once the confidante of the king and his most trusted priest, but for some unknown reason, Orlando suddenly disappeared. Anier misses his father and prays to the goddess that he can one day see him again.
库雷娜的记忆里有一座大船，一群孩子穿着破旧的衣服拥挤地蜷缩在甲板上，库雷娜就是其: Kurena remembers being amongst a group of children crouching on the deck of a ship in tattered clothes. A tsunami struck the ship, Kurena washed ashore, and a priest saved her. That is the light in her life, and she is dedicated to following it forever.
神历15日，教国与王国的战争再次开始了，他听从教皇的旨意前往了战场。神历27日，: Day 15: War between the Papal State and the Kingdom has broken out again. He obeyed the Pope's command and went to fight. Day 27: A white pigeon delivered a letter proving that he was alright. Day 48: It's been long since I've seen the wings of a white pigeon... Goddess Above, please hear my call and protect the one that I love so that we can be together again.

你愿意帮我把下场演唱会的票送给蛇先生一张吗？: Would you please give Mr. Snake a ticket for my next concert?
我想邀请他看我的演唱会！: I want to invite him to my concert!
别别别！她整天跑到森林里吵我睡觉就算了！: No, no, no! She'll run around the forest all day and won't let me sleep!
我不要！给别人吧！: No way! Give it to someone else!
不过我有件事要交给你办！: But I have something for you to take care of!
群叶猫身上有一种群叶，是多兰族常用的疗伤药。: There's a special kind of leaf on the heads of Leaf Cats — it's a common healing medicine of the Doram.
这样猫女郎就不会被群叶猫打伤了。: In this way, Cat-lady can't be hurt by Leaf Cats.
她经常到森林里采药，有次我差点被胡蜂蛰了。: She often goes to the forest to collect medicine. Once I almost got stung by a wasp...
是猫女郎把胡蜂赶走，还亲切的抚摸了我的叶子。: It was Cat-lady who drove away the wasps and stroked my leaves.
别废话了，快把群叶拿给猫女郎吧！: Don't talk nonsense. Take the leaves to Cat-lady!
你好喵，有什么可以帮忙的吗？: Hello, meow. Can I help you with something?
太好了！你怎么会突然送给我这个呢？: Great! Why are you giving these to me all of a sudden?
是他呀，真是有心了！: It was him? I knew it!
有了这些群叶，我可以制作跌打药送给我的心上人了！: With these leaves, I can make medicine to give to my darling!
偷偷告诉你，不要跟别人讲！: This is just between us! Don't tell anyone!
我心上人是蝴蝶巡守队的一员。: My sweetheart is a member of the Butterfly Patrols.

能为他制作一些跌打药，我已经很满足了！: I'd be satisfied just to be able to make some medicine for him!
你能帮我把这些群叶捣碎吗？: Can you mash these leaves for me?
太过用力，导致口袋里的演唱会门票掉了出来！: Huh?! A concert ticket fell out of the ticket!
这！是猫明星演唱会vip座位票！: There! It is a Cat Star concert ticket — a VIP ticket!
你怎么会有这么珍贵的东西？: How could you have something so precious?
猫公子专门跟我抱怨过这票太难买了，找黄牛都买不到！: The Master Cat complained that this ticket was too hard to come by. He couldn't even find a scalper ticket!
那可以拜托你帮我把票送给猫公子吗？: Can you please give the ticket to the Master Cat for me?
珍珠已经送给猫明星了吗？: Did you give the pearl to Cat Star?
都跟她说过，以后不要制作这种跌打药了。: I told her not to make this medicine...
每次为了跌打药都被群叶猫打伤……: I always end up getting hurt by that Leaf Cats because of that medicine...
那，猫明星有说什么吗？: So, what did Cat Star say?
这是猫明星送给我的吗？: Did Cat Star want me to have this?
我应该跟她表达心意吗？: Should I tell her how I feel?
那这张票是怎么来的呢？: Where did this ticker come from?
我会好好珍惜这次演唱会！: I'll cherish the memory of this concert forever!
你愿意帮我去泪之湖底取珍珠吗？: You're willing to help me get a pearl from the bottom of Tear Lake?
等你准备好了告诉我吧。: Let me know when you're ready.
采到珍珠了！回去找猫公子谈谈吧。: You got the pearl! Go back and talk to the Master Cat.
敲响宴会之钟~再次举办宴会吧！: Ring the banquet clock! It's time for another feast!
哎……那等你忙完！一定要回来找我呀~: Ah... Then I'll wait for you to finish! You have to come back to me, okay?
我们都在等你！: We'll all be waiting for you!
小子们！准备开宴会了！: Boys! Let's get this party started!
开宴会少了我们可就不好玩了！: We can't have fun without throwing a party!
呵呵~我把我们的大厨给带来了~: Heheh! I brought our chef here!
今天就让你们免费品尝我的手艺吧！: I'll let you enjoy my craft for free today!

我要和姐姐一起，永远侍奉女神——: I will always serve the goddess with my sister——
和姐姐在一起，最开心啦！: I'm so happy together when I'm with my sister!
我要保护妹妹一辈子。: I want to protect my sister forever.
我不是疯子！那段历史不能被遗忘！: I'm not crazy! Some things can never be forgotten!
愿阿卢纳贝兹的未来一片光明。: May the future of Arunafeltz be bright.
遵从女神的旨意。: Obey the will of the Goddess.
这里有一只可爱的小雪人，孤零零地在圣域冰洞之中，是否查看？: There's a lovely little snowman here, alone in the Holy Ice Cave. Do you want to check it out?
不知道这场寒冬什么时候会过去……: I don't know when the cold winter will pass...
姐姐不喜欢冬天吗？: Does sister not like the winter?
阿娜雅从来没有见过冬天！冬天好美呀~: Anaya has never seen the winter! Winter is so beautiful!
我看书上呀~米德加尔特王国的人在下雪的时候都会堆雪人呢！: I read that people in the kingdom of Midgard make snowmen when it snows!
好啦好啦！别唉声叹气啦！: Alright! Alright! Don't groan like that!
姐姐！快帮帮我！一个人好累呀~: Sister! Help me! I'm so tired...
嘻嘻~是吧！这可是我和姐姐的杰作呢~: Hello? Yeah! This masterpiece was made by my sister and I!
小雪人~小雪人~我想和姐姐永远在一起~: Little snowman, little snowman! I want to be with my sister forever!
傻妹妹，女神会祝福我们的。: Silly sister, the Goddess will bless us.
嗯！女神会祝福我们的~: OK! The Goddess will bless us!
两朵纠缠在一起的花朵，被冰霜所覆盖，是否查看？: Two entangled flowers, covered in ice... Do you want to check it out?
诸位，圣母诞下了双生子！: Everyone... The Holy Mother has given birth to twins!
女神赐予了我们两位教皇。: The goddess has given us two Popes.
未来她们可以相互扶持，带领阿卢纳贝兹走向辉煌！: In the future, they can carry each other and lead Arunafeltz to glory!
我们将在圣域的中心建造一个喷泉，感谢女神，祝福阿卢纳贝兹！: We will build a fountain in the center of the sanctuary. Thank you, goddess, and bless Arunafeltz!
这就是冬天呀！阿卢纳贝兹以前从来没有冬天呢！这可是第一次~: This is... winter! Arunafeltz has never experienced winter before! This is the first time!
我们这样乔装溜出来，母后会不会生气啊？: Will mother be angry if we slip out in disguise?
母后才不会真的生我们的气呢！: Mother won't be really angry with us!
姐姐不想看到新建的祈祷之泉吗？: Don't you want to see the new Fountain of Prayers?
听恩德大神官说，这个喷泉有那么那么大呢！: The High Priest says the fountain is really big!
难怪建造了这么多年。: No wonder it took so many years to build.
姐姐你看！是西丽丝神官！: Sister, look! It's High Priest Silice!
没事的，我们现在没有人认得出。: It's okay. No one can recognize us now.
这是我精心培育的双生花，代表着两位可爱的殿下。: This is my carefully cultivated twin flowers, representing the two lovely Highnesses.
女神啊！请祝福她们，健康成长，成为优秀的教皇。: My Goddess! Please bless them... May they grow up to be healthy and become excellent Popes.
一个雕琢精致的冰雕，是颗星星的样子，是否拾取？: An exquisite ice sculpture shaped like a star. Do you want to pick it up?
呼~总算做完了~冰雕可真难呀！: Finished at last! That was hard to carve!
两位殿下是女神赐予我们的礼物！: Your Highnesses are gifts from the Goddess!
不是你口中的灾难之源！: Not the source of this disaster you speak of!
这是女神的神谕!: This is the prophecy of the Goddess!
“双生双宿，异途陌路。”: "Two lives entwined, strangers on different paths."
“王无二者，唯留一人。”: "From the two, only one shall rule."
因为她们！圣域才经历了这么多年的寒灾！: It's because of them! The holy land has experienced so many years of disaster!
只有舍弃一个！才能平息女神的愤怒！: One must be given up! To calm the goddess's anger!
一派胡言！你我都知道！是圣域地下的寒冰怪物导致的！: Nonsense! You and I both know! The disaster was caused by an ice monster in the Holy Ground B1!
老师，你还是那么的单纯。: Teacher, you are still so simple.
如果不是神谕里说的那样……: If not as the prophecy said...
谁又能承受民众的怨念呢……: Who will bear the resentment of the people?
……谁又能真的听到，女神的旨意……: ...Who can really hear the will of the Goddess?
姐姐~你在这里做什么？: Sister... What are you doing here?
呀！是星星~！姐姐你雕的吗？: Ah! It's a star! Sister, did you make it?
嗯，是呀，你说你喜欢星星……: Uh... Yes.. You said you like stars...
走吧，我们一起去觐见母后。: Let's go! Let's go and see mother together.
嗯呀~母后最近为寒灾的事情烦心不已。: Well, mother has been very upset about the cold disaster recently.
哎~虽然我很喜欢冬天，但是，我希望这场寒灾早日过去，让圣域恢复往日的繁荣。: Although I like winter very much, I hope this cold disaster will pass as soon as possible and the holy land will return to its former prosperity.
我们晚些一起去祈祷之泉那，为阿卢纳贝兹祈祷吧！: Let's go to Fountain of Prayers later and pray for Arunafeltz!
……会过去的，阿娜雅……一切都会过去的。: ...It will pass, Anaya... Everything will pass.
一颗枚漂亮的戒指，但似乎只残留了些许魔力，是否拾取？: A beautiful ring, but it seems that only a little magic remains. Do you want to pick it up?
圣母做出了抉择……: The Holy Mother has made a choice...
两位殿下现在在祈祷之泉那……: The young Highnesses are at Fountain of Prayers...
圣母已经决定，遵从神谕，平息女神的愤怒。: The Holy Mother has decided to obey the prophecy to calm the Goddess's anger.
西丽丝神官 播放动作 attack: High Priest Silice Play Action Attack
阿露什殿下会是我们唯一的教皇！: Her Highness Arush will be our only Pope!
在此，让我们将充满女神力量的戒指交予阿露什殿下。: Here, let us give Her Highness Arush this ring full of the Goddess' power.
殿下，这都是为了阿卢纳贝兹。: Your Highness, this is all for Arunafeltz.
别靠近我！别想把我再关回医院里！: Don't come any closer! Don't try to lock me back up in the hospital!
这是我们家族口口相传真实的故事！: This is the true story of our family!
没想到，如今还有人能知道当年的事情……: I never expected someone to know what had happened...
恩德大神官是我的祖先，这是他要求我们代代相传，永远不能遗忘的历史。: High Priest Ender is my ancestor. This is the story he asked us to pass on from generation to generation and never forget.
如果你想知道结局的话，在那些遗物上面残留的记忆，可以给你答案。: If you want to know the ending, the memories left on those relics can give you the answer.
阿娜雅殿下，我送你去往女神的身边……: Your highness Anaya, I will take you to the Goddess.
阿露什殿下！住手啊！这是你的妹妹！: Your Highness, Arush! Stop it! That's your sister!
姐姐！你要做什么姐姐！: Sister! What are you doing, sister?
殿下这是要引来寒冰龙！！: Your Highness, this is to lure out Ktullanux!
恩德大神官，请你带着大家离开这里……: High Priest Ender, please help everyone to escape this place...
阿露什殿下发疯了！她要毁灭圣域！: Her Highness Arush has gone mad! She will destroy the sanctuary!
你就是这一切的源头……幸好是你……: You are the source of all this... fortunately...
恩德大神官，我和妹妹任何一个人的牺牲，都不会改变阿卢纳贝兹的处境。: The sacrifice of High Priest Ender, my sister and I, will not change the fate of Arunafeltz.
只有控制住它，才可以将阳光带回阿卢纳贝兹。: Only by controlling it can the sun be brought back to Arunafeltz.
殿下！这不是我们能解决的怪物！: Your Highness! This is not a monster we can defeat!
我的身躯将化作寒冰。: My body will turn into ice.
书籍上记载了这个古老的法术……: Ancient magic is recorded in this tome...
你们快带阿娜雅离开这里……: You take Anaya out of here...
往西面去，那里有适合建造新圣域的地方……: To the west, there is a place suitable for building a new holy land...
给阿卢纳贝兹的子民们，带去新的生活吧。: Found a new life for the people of Arunafeltz.
不！！姐姐！！你让我来吧！让我来吧！！: No!! Sister!!! Leave this to me! Let me do it!
求求你了！姐姐！！我不能！我不能失去你！: I'm begging you! Sister!!! I can't! I can't lose you!!
姐姐！该消失的人是我！是我啊！: Sister! I'm the one who should go! It's me!
阿露什殿下将自己化为寒冰，将寒冰巨龙冰冻了起来。: His Highness Arush turned himself into ice and frozen the ice dragon.
笼罩阿卢纳贝兹全国多年的冬天终于结束了。: The winter that enveloped Arunafeltz for many years was finally over.
原本的圣域受到了魔力的影响，成为了冰封之地，被风沙所覆盖。: The original holy land was overwhelmed by magic, and became a frozen domain, overrun by sandstorms.
阿娜雅殿下带领着的子民们往西边去，建立了现在的拉赫。: Anaya led the people to the West and founded Rachel.
但是，那该死的神谕还是流传了下来。: But the damned prophecy lived on.
经过时间的流逝，寒冰巨龙应该已经失去了生命。: After the passage of time, the ice dragon should have already perished by now.
我想，祈祷之泉的寒冰也快溶解了……: I think the cold ice of Fountain of Prayers is about to melt...
这大概就是阿露什殿下的力量结晶吧。: This is probably the crystallization of Arush's power.
这祈祷之泉，可真是漂亮啊。: This Fountain of Prayers is really beautiful.
可是，它却没有实现任何一个心愿……: However, it has not answered any prayers...
我是大家眼里快死了的老疯子。: I'm an old dying lunatic in everyone's eyes.
有人能知道这段故事，我也没什么遗憾了……: I have no regrets, now that someone knows this story...
希望我们不要再重蹈覆辙……: I hope we don't repeat the same mistakes...
这一切又能说给谁听，才会相信我呢？: Who would I tell all this to? Who would actually believe me?
这里曾经是真正的圣域。: This used to be a real sanctuary.
而眼前的这个，是过去的阿卢纳贝兹子民们建造多年的祈祷之泉。: The thing before your eyes is the Fountain of Prayers that the people of old Arunafeltz built many years ago.
是为了感谢女神的赐予所建造的。: It was built to thank the Goddess for her blessings.
可是过去的这段历史，却没有流传下来。: But the truth of the past has not been passed down.
我希望在这里能找到过去的痕迹，去证明那一切……: I hope to find traces of the past here to prove it all...
你是谁？！离我远点！我没有病！我是不会回去的！: Who are you?! Stay away from me! I'm not sick! I'm not going back!

[b]参赛规则[/b]\n1）GVG决战于周日21:00:00开启，21:30::
[b]Participation Rules[/b]
1) GVG Battle starts at 21:00 and ends at 21:30 every Sunday. 
2) At the end of GVG on Thursdays, all guilds occupying City 1 will be eligible to participate, and can go to the GVG Battle Map on Sunday at 20:57:00.

[b] Battlefield Rules[/b] 
*Camp
GVG Battles are fought between four guilds. Each guild has an independent camp and cannot form alliances.

* Victory Conditions
1) The guild that collects 5 [Crystal Resources] wins.
2) If no guild has gathered 5 [Crystal Resources] by the end of the battle, the guild with the most crystals wins. 

Crystal resources 
1) There are 5 regions on the battleground producing crystals for guilds to fight for.
[Central Core]: Available for occupation from 3 minutes into the battle. Occupy to gain 2 crystals which will be deducted once lost.
[East Crystal Tower] [West Crystal Tower]: Available for occupation from 3 minutes into the battle. Occupy to gain 1 crystal which will be deducted once lost.
[Green Magnificence] [Blue Magnificence] [Red Magnificence] [Purple Magnificence]: Worth 1 crystal resource when not broken. It will be deducted once broken by another guild and it can't be repaired. 
2) If a guild's magnificence is broken, all guild members will be forced to revive at the guild platform once dead in action for a certain period of time. 

* How to occupy: The guild with the most members in the occupation circle continues to accumulate occupation points until the occupation progress is full and the area will become the guild's. 

* Crystal Shard resource 
1) 1 MVP is refreshed every 3 minutes on the upper/lower platform. Whichever player deals the fatal strike at the MVP earns 1 crystal shard for his guild.
2) Every 4 crystal shards can be converted into 1 Crystal Resource that can't be taken by others.

1.符文分为属性符文和技能符文；\n2.技能符文分为13个职业类别，每个类别含S:
1. Runes are divided into Attribute Runes and Skill Runes.
2. Skill Runes are divided into 13 Job types. Each job type consists of three quality levels: S, A, and B.
3. Attribute Runes are divided into Atk Runes, Def Runes, and Special Runes.
4. Skill Rune slots can only be inlaid with Skill Runes of your current job.
5. Each Skill Rune requires three Attribute Runes of specific types to provide it with sufficient energy. Skill Rune effects can only be activated when all three Attribute Rune requirements have been met.
6. The three dots below Skill Rune slots mark the Attribute Runes required for Skill Rune activation.
   Red—>ATK Rune
Green—>DEF Rune
Yellow—>Special Rune
White—>Any Rune
7. Runes of the same name/attribute and Skill Runes cannot be inlaid; 
8. When your Job changes, the rune will be removed and the original job's inlaid status will be recorded. When reverting, the inlaid status that was recorded will be automatically inlaid again. Attribute Runes that undergo changes will be inlaid into the Rune of the same type that is the highest level. Runes that are not of the same type will be left empty.
为了迎接一年一度的狂欢庆典，多兰族最优秀的甜品师制作了一份巨大的庆典蛋糕。但意外: To ring in the annual joyous occasion, the most outstanding dessert chef in Doram has made a giant Celebration Cake. However, the cake's delicious fragrance unexpectedly wafted over the Rainbow Bridge and attracted the attention of greedy folk from another world...
头饰副本进入界面说明上: Headwear Dungeon Entrance Interface Description Upper
1.副本内共有15波饥饿的怪物，会前赴后继地扑向庆典蛋糕。\n2.玩家需要阻止怪:
1. There are 15 Hungry Monsters in the dungeon all advancing towards the Celebration Cake.
2. Players need to stop the monsters from reaching the cake. If the cake gets eaten by the monsters, the dungeon ends.
3. Tactical usage of the Crystal Resources will make the battle easier.
4. After the dungeon is over, players who stopped 5 or more waves of monsters will have this number of attempts and 60 minutes of Battle Time deducted, as well as receive rewards. Leaving midway will not result in deduction of attempts and Battle Time, and will not result in rewards.
5. Rewards can be checked in the Shop interface. A maximum of 4 rewards can be obtained each week. Exceeding the weekly limit will not result in rewards nor deduct Battle Time.
头饰副本进入界面说明下: Headwear Dungeon Entrance Interface Description Lower
1. At 5:00 each Monday, the Snow Marshmallow exchangeable headwear will be refreshed, and any remaining Snow Marshmallows will be removed.
2. Snow Marshmallow exchangeable headwear also triggers crafting rewards. Headwear obtained from opening the Opal Box cannot trigger crafting rewards.

藏在蛋糕里的糖果，和奶油融为一体，散发着清甜的美好香气。收集到一定数量也许会发生: A candy hidden in the cake blends with the cream to produce a fragrant and sweet aroma. Collect the specified amount and perhaps something good will happen. (Clears every Monday at 5:00)

人类真的可以反抗神的旨意么？: Can humans really go against the will of God?
不落的太阳，让拉赫重回光明。: The sun that doesn't set brings the light back to Rachel.
一个奇怪的宝箱，每隔3天可开启一次，打开后获得SP版本MVP、Mini材料*1、: A strange treasure chest which can be opened once every 3 days to obtain SP version MVP, Mini Materials *1, Rare Materials *1, Crafting Materials *1. 来自雷根贝勒研究所的机密文件，据说上面记载了终极武器的制作方式，雷根贝勒的研究员: A classified document from the Rekenber Laboratory. It's said to contain the schematics for an ultimate weapon. Rekenber researcher Franken would surely have need of it!
不负卢恩荣光的你，值得接受整个王国的祝福，打开后获得Zeny*10000、乐园币: You who live up to the glory of Rune are worthy of the blessings of the entire kingdom. Open to gain Zeny *10000, Eden Coins *200, Lightning Chain *1, Mysterious Box SP *1.
能遇见你，真是太好了，达克颂。打开后获得Zeny*30000、乐园币*500、金: Great to meet you, Taksol. Open to gain Zeny *30,000, Eden Coins *500, Gold Medal *1, Dusty Rune Bag·Ⅰ *3, Mysterious Box SP *1.
最接近神的国家——阿鲁纳贝兹，感谢你的付出。使用后获得主线头饰*1，Zeny*3: Arunafeltz, the country of the gods, thanks you for your effort. Use to gain Main Quest Headwear *1, Zeny *30,000, Gold Medal *2, Smooth Rune Stone *2, Praying Crystal Pack *2, Gorgeous Card Album *1, Mysterious Box SP *1.
你为神灵献上虔诚的信仰，神灵赐予你战胜黑暗的力量，这是神灵与你之间的契约。: If you devote yourself to the gods, then the gods will grant you the power to vanquish darkness. This is a contract between you and the gods.
一铃摇曳生，神音庇左右，双铃叮咚响，圣光照四方。金铃轻摇，愿神祇永远守护你，远离: A bell sways, a divine voice rings out, and holy light shines out in all directions. The golden bell shakes gently, and may the gods protect you forever. May darkness and decay never touch you.
大冒险家多拉贡的背包。继承这个背包的人，也会继承他的睿智、聪慧……和冷笑话。: The backpack of the great adventurer Drogon. Whoever inherits this backpack also inherits his wisdom... And sarcasm.
“迷途的人啊，你心中是否存有困惑与迷惘？将你的灵魂献祭于吾，将你的心愿在卷轴上书: Lost one, does confusion and doubt trouble your heart? Give your soul to me, write your heart's desires on this scroll, and I will guide you on the right path."
只存在于传说中的九尾猫灵，是远星大陆的丰收之神。多兰族的小猫咪们每年的狂欢节都会: The legendary Nine Tailed Cat Spirit is the god of harvest in the Far Star Continent. The Doram Kitties put on it's tail every year to celebrate and show their devotion.
古老厚重的金纹雕刻在石雕之上，传说佩戴它之人可以与神明沟通，预测一切灾害与危险，: Ancient gold carvings are engraved on this statue. Legends say that the person who wears it can communicate with the gods and predict disasters and misfortunes. Conflict accompanies any valuable treasures, however, and this statue lost its original power amidst competing human attempts to claim it.
“天惶惶，照月光 ，梦里见它莫惊慌，睁眼它不见，闭眼才出现。”这是幽灵梦魇身上遗: "The sky is dark and the moon is bright. When you see it in your dreams, don't panic. It disappears when you open your eyes and appears when you close them." 在阿卢纳贝兹，所有的信徒都要向女神祈祷，歌颂女神的事迹，教国会根据信徒为神祇做出: In Arunafeltz, all acolytes must pray to the goddess, sing her prayers. The Papal State gives this crown to acolytes who give the greatest contributions.
为了维护教国的权威，许多的勇士为女神献上了虔诚的灵魂，教国为了纪念这些勇士，将敬: To protect the authority of the Papal State, many warriors declare their pious souls to the Goddess. The Papal State grants the Worship Hat to these warriors and their descendants, giving their wearers special rights in the Papal State.
女神的神迹照耀拉赫，拿起武器与深渊一战，赢得和平与美好，自由圣鹰张开羽翼，为吾等: The goddess' miracles shine on Rachel. Take this weapon and fight against the abyss, win peace and beauty, and the Freedom Hawk will spread it's wings and guide us in our struggles, bringing Rachel on the right path.
蝴蝶巡守队队员的帽子，戴上以后英俊值上升二十个百分点。: The Butterfly Patrol Members' hat. Put it on to gain +20% handsomeness.
大冒险家多拉贡的帽子。继承这顶帽子的人，也会继承他的勇气、信念……和小肚子。: The hat of the great adventurer Drogon. Whoever inherits this hat also inherits his bravery, faith... And belly.
米德加尔特大陆的特大新闻，“雪兽一族最萌的雪兽宝宝——球球，竟然离家出走，雪兽一: Breaking news from Midgard: "The most adorable baby of the Siroma, Bobo has run away from home. The Siroma have become panic-stricken". "Gyup~ gyup~"? What's that sound? What's Bobo doing on your head!?
那位大人能够统治死者之都这么久，靠的可不是可爱的外貌和善解人意的性格，记清楚了！: The one who has ruled the Town of the Dead for so long has relied on more than just her cute appearance and charming personality to do so. Remember that!

不听话的孩子都要接受惩罚！定义不听话的最终解释权归于埃琉德尼尔宫殿的海拉女士所有: Children who don't listen must be punished! The final interpretation of disobedience belongs with Miss Hella of Eljudnir Palace.
你说这把武器的外形不适合那位大人？上一个说出这句话的鬼魂已经被吸进剑里了。: You say this weapon doesn't look like it suits Her? The last one to say that had their soul consumed by the sword.
别紧张，这玩意没有它看起来那么可怕，只要你不怕痛，只要你不怕死。: Don't worry, this thing isn't as scary as it looks - as long as you're not scared of pain or death.
那位大人并不会使用弓箭，但这把外形妖异的弓总挂在她的房间，似乎是为了纪念某个人。: She doesn't use bows, but this strange-looking bow can always be seen in her room. It seems to be a token of memory to someone.
啊哈！又到了我最喜欢的“100t大锤砸脑袋”环节，下一位幸运儿会是谁！: Ah-hah! It's time for my favorite "100t Hammer Head Smashing" again! Who will be the next lucky one?
“死者之都生存法则中最首要的一条：别惹那位大人生气，否则你就会知道她为什么被称为: "The most important rule of survival in the Town of the Dead: Don't make Her angry, or else you will find out why she is called the Queen."
复制飓风型态的巨大的双手斧，斧头中心隐藏着飓风般的力量, 据说武器越强时力量也会: A huge two-handed axe made in the shape of a hurricane. The center of the axe hides the power of a hurricane, and it's said that its power increases as the weapon becomes stronger.
埃琉德尼尔是一座漂浮在冥河之上的城堡，它拥有坚实的城防，这面盾牌就是那位大人亲自: Eljudnir is a castle that floats on the River Styx. It's defenses are formidable, and this shield is Her personal shield - a sewer manhole cover.
无尽的黑暗笼罩在这件斗篷四周. 只有完全克服恐惧的人才可以使用。: This manteau is shrouded in darkness. Only those who completely overcome their fears can use it.
可自动调整穿者大小的神秘长靴, 就好像有生命力一样。: Mysterious shoes that automatically adjust their size according to the wearer, as if they're alive.

传言是由芙蕾雅女神留下的圣书的一角，尽管上面记载的内容已经模糊不清，但是其中蕴: It is said that this is a part of the Sacred Book left by Freya. The contents recorded above are unclear, but the power of the Gods contained within it still can't be underestimated.
马克的爷爷卧床不起，病情严重，他绝望地唤出了恶魔，说若能使爷爷病愈，他便献给恶魔: Marc's grandfather was bedridden with a serious illness, so he summoned a demon out of despair. He said that if he could cure his grandfather, he would offer a kilogram of Gold Sand to the demon. The demon used magic to bring Marc's grandfather back to health. After his grandfather had recovered, Marc did not use real Gold Sand to thank the demon, but instead used ordinary yellow sand. He placed it on the altar which set alight, and he chanted: "Demon, demon, I have fulfilled my promise." The demon came to Marc in his dream and told him to go to the seaside to find real Gold Sand. Marc awoke and excitedly ran straight to the seaside. But when he got there, he encountered fierce pirates who captured and sold him into slavery. His price... A kilogram of Gold Sand. So the Baron ordered someone to cut away all the nearby bushes to find a Four-leaf Clover. A spirit living in the grass told Emma that there were no Four-leaf Clovers in this area, and pleaded with her not to destroy their home. Emma didn't care, and had all the bushes cut away anyway. But this disturbed a little ghost living in the grass. The ghost asked Emma if she wanted a Four-leaf Clover, and Emma nodded. “我也曾年少轻狂不听人言，直到与你相见。你是春风，也是雨露，是命运三女神赐予我的: "I was young, and I did not listen to anyone until I met you. You are the spring breeze, you are the dew. You are the gift from the three Goddesses of Fate. My love, I'm going to the battlefield, do not cry for me, do not grieve because of our parting. I will love you, even if Al De Baran's clock stops or Morroc is gone. I will return to your side, even if it takes a thousand years..."
阿卢纳贝兹教国下起了罕见的大雪，从来没有见过雪的阿露什与阿娜雅姐妹两一起在圣域的: A rare snowfall came over Arunafeltz States. Arush, who had never seen snow before, went with her sister Anaya to a corner of the sanctuary and made a snowman based on a picture of one in a book. They put Arush's favorite hat and Anaya's most beloved scarf on him, creating a snowman that belonged to both of them. They wanted to always be together, just like now...
神官西丽丝在阿露什与阿娜雅两姐妹出生后就一直培育着罕见的双生花。双生花会结出两花: High Priest Silice had raised the rare twins Arush and Anaya since birth. The twins would grow and bloom together, growing strong from the same source. She brought the successful twins to the Fountain of Prayers, and prayed to the goddess to protect the two of them, so that they may grow healthily together and lead the people of Arunafeltz into the future...
星星可真好看，要是能摘下星星就好了。阿娜雅无意的一句话让阿露什记在了心中。在看到: The stars are so beautiful. I wish I could pick them. Anaya's words stayed in Arush's heart. After seeing an acolyte carve a Goddess' Statue out of ice, she asked that acolyte to teach her the art of ice sculptures. After many days of practice, Arush finally carved a perfect star ice sculpture. Her hands, red with the cold, held the star, hoping that her sister would forever be happy...
圣域中有个传说，女神降临圣域这片土地之后，将一枚戒指交给了当时的教皇。这枚戒指蕴: There is a legend in the sanctuary that after the goddess descended on this land, she gave a ring to the Pope of that time. This ring contained the power of the goddess, which could give its owner powerful magic. This ring was passed down from one Pope to the next, but eventually disappeared in the cold storm disaster. Gradually, the ring was forgotten...
阿露什看着那张和自己一模一样的脸庞，用如同天空般清澈的眼睛注视着阿娜雅那如晚霞般: Arush looked at her twin's face, and saw Anaya's red eyes like a sunset against a clear sky. She drew the power of the goddess from the ring, and cast a spell of freezing which she had learned from a book. Pain shot across her skin like needles, and she gradually lost feeling in her entire body. Arush felt like her blood had stopped flowing, and the only thing left beating was her heart... Anaya, live on for Arunafeltz... I will be here forever... Forever with you...
森林女巫嘉莉提取雨的元素，使用青叶草固定形态后，制作而成的守护灵。雨之灵的力量会: A guardian spirit, made from the rain element and shaped with Green Leaf Grass by the Forest Witch Carrie. The Rain Spirit's power causes the surrounding rain. Combined with the soft Green Leaf Grass, it has a touch like a light forest breeze. The Leaf Cats in the forest avoid this rain and pray that the weather returns to normal as soon as possible.
森林女巫嘉莉提取雪的元素，使用紫蕊花固定形态后，制作而成的守护灵。雪之灵的力量会: A guardian spirit, made from the snow element and shaped with purple flowers by the Forest Witch Carrie. The Snow Spirit's power causes the surrounding snow. Combined with the fresh purple flowers, the snow has a gentle fragrance. The rare snowfall caught the attention of the Kitties of Lasagna, and scholar Sainz took his students to record this rare sight with cameras.
森林女巫嘉莉提取风的元素，使用兰翎枝固定形态后，制作而成的守护灵。风之灵的力量会: A guardian spirit, made from the wind element and shaped with orchid branches by the Forest Witch Carrie. The Wind Spirit's power causes the surrounding gusts. Combined with the unique orchid branches, the wind does not blow too strongly. The Wild Hornets became excited by the rising winds, and so started having combat competitions near the Wind Spirit.
森林女巫嘉莉提取雾的元素，使用黄金喵喵草固定形态后，制作而成的守护灵。雾之灵的力: A guardian spirit, made from the fog element and shaped with Golden Cat Grass by the Forest Witch Carrie. The Fog Spirit's power causes the surrounding mists. Combined with the shining Golden Cat Grass, a soft light illuminates the mists. The 29th Brave's Challenge was held near the Fog Spirit, with venturing into the mist being a final test.
森林女巫嘉莉提取了巨蛋中不稳定的火焰能量，在幼龙穆穆的帮助下，借助四个守护灵的力: The Forest Witch Carrie extracted the unstable flame power from the Dragon Egg. With the help of the young dragon Mumu and the four guardian spirits, she was able to guide the erupting flame power. Now, with this guardian spirit made in the form of the fallen dragon, tomorrow is bound to be a sunny day!
你以为你手中握住了一个拳套，其实你握住的是未来与希望。: You think you're holding a glove in your hand, but actually you're holding the future and hope.
尼夫海姆法令第三章第六条：在万圣夜没有捣蛋也没有要到糖的人，要接受悔罪鞭的惩罚。: Chapter 3 Article 6 of the Nefheim Act: Those who cause trouble or have no candy on Halloween must accept the punishment of the Whip of the Damned.

Poya was once the best instructor of the South Gate, leading countless Novices to become independent adventurers. In the battle against Morroc, Poya volunteered to lead the Eden Team to fight the enemy forces. Morroc was finally defeated, but Poya died bravely in battle. Her sister Vicky blamed herself for not being able to get to the battlefield in time to support her sister. She resigned from her original position and asked to take over her sister's job as the new instructor. All Novices who want to move up to a higher level need to pass Vicky's examination. LISA Support Leaderboard: 
1. LISA Support Leaderboard will only display the top 200 player. 
2. Player spends LISA Support Wand to gain more score on the leaderboard. The Leaderboard will auto refresh upon opening. 
3. For those who spending the same amount of "LISA Support Wand", the character who has the smaller numerical id will have higher rank. 
4. After the event, the top 100 on the leaderboard will receive special rewards: 
-Top 100 will receive Permanent Toy "Close Contact with LISA" and unlock LISA exclusive title. 
-Top 5 will receive Permanent Toy "Close Contact with LISA" and unlock LISA exclusive title plus a LISA autographed Music Album! 
5. After the event ends, the leaderboard will not update anymore. But you can still check the final ranking. 
6. The rewards will be sent out within 24 hours. (The top 5 players please contact in-game customers support for the Album rewards).

一、副本规则\n1.参赛规则\n比赛为6V6组队对抗模式，参赛成员需在90级以上:
a. Dungeon Rules
1. Entry rules
For 6v6 Party Battle Mode, participating members must be at least level 90. Parties must have 6 members in order to participate. 
2. Victory conditions
*Both teams must compete and collect resources in the dungeon. When one party reaches 4000 points, they immediately win
*The dungeon will last for 10 minutes
*If neither party reaches 4000 points within the 10 minutes, the party with the most points wins. 
3. Elemental Orb
*Elemental Orbs of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind will spawn in the four corners of the dungeon 1 minute after beginning. Players holding Orbs will earn points for their party every 2 seconds.
*Each player can hold only one Orb. When a party has 1-4 players holding an Orb, they will correspondingly gain 20, 40, 50, and 60 points every 2 seconds.
*Players holding an Orb are afflicted with the Vulnerable debuff, and each stack increases their damage taken by 5%. The longer they hold the Orb, the debuff is continuously stacked.
*Players who are holding an Orb are affected by its power, and it becomes increasingly difficult to control. While holding an Orb, you cannot go invisible or increase speed, and abilities have a fixed CD
*2 effect based on the magic of the Orb. The weakening effects on the opponent are thus: 
Fire + Water: [Mana Burning] enemies consume 200% more mana. 
Fire + Earth: [Crumbling] Enemy physical defense is decreased by 70%. 
Wind + Fire: [Soul Shackle] Approaching enemy players are slowed continuously. 
Water + Earth: [Zone of Frost] Enemies that deal heavy damage in a single strike are frozen. 
Water + Wind: [Static Field] Enemy magic defense is decreased by 70%. 
Wind + Earth [Storm Barrier] Attack distance of ranged enemies is decreased by 60%. 
*The combination spell has a 15 second CD time. During this time, switching Orbs will not change its effect. 
*If the party grabs more than 2 balls, it will remove the magic effect. Team B can then use the [Dungeon Guardian] NPC to cast corresponding magic to counter Team A. 
*When a player holding an Orb dies, the Orb will drop to the ground and the combined magic effect will be removed. The ball will then return to the location of the altar on the map. 
4. Buff Orb 
*The Buff Orb will spawn in the center of the map 90 seconds after the match begins. After this, every 30 seconds as it respawns, only Orb-holding players can compete for the Buff Orb and thereby gain 400 victory points along with a random buff. 
*Buff types include: 
[Reveal] All allied players can detect invisible enemies for 10 seconds; 
[Damage Boost] Players holding an Orb deal 50% increased damage for 10 seconds; 
[Speed Boost] Players can exceed their maximum speed limit by up to 200% for 10s. 
5. Kills
Each time you kill an enemy player, your team wins 20 victory points. 
b. Ranking Rules and Rewards
1. Ranking positions are based on the season system. Each season is 1 and a half months. 
2. Ranking positions are based on high score and are divided into (from low to high) Fighter, Elite, Warlord and Legend. 
3. Each match victory will earn an Honor Proof. 
4. At each position, you will unlock corresponding pets and cosmetic rewards. 
5. At the end of the season, the top 30/60/120 Legend rank players will receive a limited mount reward.

在天地树构建的九大世界里，争斗从来就不曾停歇。: In the Nine Worlds constructed by Yggdrasil, the fighting never stopped.

“回到世界的起点，寻找力量的根源。”这是先驱们给予后人们的指引。: “Go back to the beginning of the world and find the source of power.” This is the guidance the pioneers gave to the people that came after them.
后来啊……你知道是谁在波拉与嘉莉那里得知了契约魔法的存在，并踏上了寻找契约者的道: Afterwards... Do you know who learned of the existence of contract magic from Paula and Carrie, then embarked on the journey to find the contractor?
后来，大主教虔诚的祈祷得到了天神们的回应，他们接过了巴德尔之冠与霍德尔之翼，获得: Later on, Archbishop's pious prayer was answered by the Gods. They took over the Crown of Badr and the Wings of Hoddle, and gained the Power of Darkness and Light. They were called...
后来，基因学者来到雷根贝勒的地下研究所，用自己的身体作为实验体，去探究生命的奥秘: Later, Genetics came to the Underground Laboratory in Rekenber, and used their bodies as an experiment subject to explore the mysteries of life. From then on they transformed into...
对！就是他们！我已经感觉到这股力量，越来越近了……: That's right! It was them! I can feel this power, getting closer and closer...
冒险者，你对力量一无所知。: Adventurer, you know nothing of power.
自称维德，穿着打扮虽然普通，但似乎是认识你，还指名说他的这个委托是给你的。: He is called Vid, looks normal but he knows you. This is for you.

那你觉得旅行的意义是什么呢？: So do you know what is the meaning of traveling?
放松或者休息: To relax or to take a break

如果有一天我结婚的话，我也要来这里。: If I get married one day, I will come here too.

哎！看那座钟楼！那就是有着黄金时钟的钟楼了吧！: Look! Look at that Clock Tower! That must be the golden bell!
