一、副本规则\n1.参赛规则\n比赛为6V6组队对抗模式，参赛成员需在90级以上:
A. Dungeon Rules
1. Competition Rules
Participants in 6V6 Team Battle Mode must be at least Level 90. A team of 6 is required to participate in the match.
2. Victory Conditions
*The teams of the two sides will compete to gather resources in the dungeon. The team that gains 4000 points first is the winner.
*Dungeon time is 10 minutes
*If no team accumulates 4000 points within 10 minutes, victory goes to the team with the highest score.
3. Magic Dungeon and Temple of Samsara
Elemental Orb
*Elemental orbs of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind will spawn in all 4 corners of the dungeon 30 seconds after beginning. Players holding an elemental orb will win Victory Points every 2 seconds.
*Each player can only hold 1 elemental orb at a time. When 1-4 players of the same team are holding orbs, they gain 10, 20, 25 or 30 points respectively every 2 seconds.
*Players holding an orb are afflicted by the Vulnerable debuff. Each stack increases damage of the orb-holder by 5%. The longer one holds the orb, the more the Vulnerable debuff increases.
*Players holding an orb are affected by the orb's power, which becomes increasingly uncontrollable. While holding an orb, you cannot enter stealth or gain increased speed, and skill cooldowns are fixed.
*2 elemental orbs can be combined to summon magical effects, weakening the enemy team. Specific combinations are as follows:
Fire + Water: [Elemental Barrier] Reduces enemy's attack and spellcasting range by 40%, as well as the holding player's attack and spellcasting range by 60%.
Fire + Earth: [Magma Path] While an enemy player is holding an orb, they lose a percentage of HP equivalent to their movement speed.
Fire + Wind: [Soul Shackle] When an enemy player approaches, continuously reduces movement speed.
Water + Earth: [Mana Burn] Enemy skills cost +200% SP, and they lose 1% Max Mana each second.
Water + Wind: [Mana Leak] Enemy orb-holding players apply the following status affects to their allies - [Water]: Silences all allies within a 5 meter radius, [Earth]: Petrifies all allies within a 5 meter radius, [Wind] Roots all allies within a 5 meter radius, [Fire] Burns all allies within a 5 meter radius.
Wind + Earth: [Windstorm] Enemy players suffer an unblockable Darkness status for 1.5 seconds every 5 seconds, while enemy orb-holding players suffer Darkness status permanently.
*Combined spells have a 15 second cooldown. Switching orbs during this time does not change the magic effect.
*If Team A grabs more than 2 orbs, the magic effect of that summon is removed, upon which Team B can use the [Dungeon Guardian] NPC to summon a corresponding magic counterattack against Team A.
When an orb-holding player dies, the elemental orb is dropped and the combined spell effects are removed. The elemental orb then returns to its place on the altar.
Buff Orb
*The Buff Orb spawns in the center of the battlefield 1 minute after the start of battle, after which it will respawn every 30 seconds. Only orb-holding players can claim the Buff Orb to gain 150 Victory Points and a random buff.
*Buff Orb Types:
[Anti-stealth] All allies can detect invisible units for 10 seconds.
[Attack Up] The buffed player deals +50% damage against orb-holding players for 10 seconds.
[Accelerate] The holder of the orb exceeds their maximum speed, gaining +200% speed for 10 seconds.
Kills
Each time you kill an enemy player, the team gains 20 Victory Points.
4. Black and White Chess
Map
Consists of a 3*3 chessboard. The 8 pieces except for the center piece can by occupied by moving on them or by standard chess rules. The center piece can only be occupied by standard chess rules;
Chess Rules
*The pieces in the four corners of the chessboard are the medium occupation points. Occupy them to gain 2 points per second for your team; The middle pieces on each side of the board are small occupation points. Occupy them to gain 1 point per second for your team; The center of the chessboard is the large occupation point. Occupy it to gain 3 points per second for your team.
*Defeat an enemy player to gain 1 point for your team. The first team to score 4000 points, or the team with the highest total score at the end of the dungeon, wins.
*Special Rules: If a team member occupies the two end pieces of a three-piece straight line on the board, the middle piece is immediately captured by the player (i.e. three points and one line); If a line is broken for a small piece that was occupied using the "three points and one line" rule, the current occupation status is not broken; Large occupation points can be occupied by four different straight-lines. If one of the two end points is captured, the large occupation point returns to its pre-occupied state under these rules; 
B. Ranking Rules and Rewards
1. Ranking positions are based on the season system. Each season is 1 and a half months. 
2. Ranking positions are based on high score and are divided into (from low to high) Fighter, Elite, Warlord and Legend. 
3. Each match victory will earn an Honor Proof. 
4. At each position, you will unlock corresponding pets and cosmetic rewards. 
5. At the end of the season, the top 30/60/120 Legend rank players will receive a limited mount reward.

1.[无限回廊]是个随机构建地图、魔物与机关机制的副本，难度逐层增加，进入等级限:
1. Unlimited Corridor is an Dungeon with randomly generated map, monsters and device system. The difficulty level increases gradually with the minimal access level set at 80. Adventurers may not bring their pets inside. However, KittyCats are allowed and each KittyCat is counted as one team member. The Dungeon can be challenged by teams of maximum 3 players. 
2. Each level consists of 9 rooms including the entrance room, the exit room, 2 normal monster rooms, 2 chief monster rooms, 1 device room, 1 shop room, and 1 rest room. 
3. Adventurers can earn stage clearing keys in normal monster rooms, chief monster rooms, and the device room. With enough keys, they may access the next level through the exit room. 
4. Adventurers may obtain various kinds of items during the challenge to help with their exploration and battle. 
5. In the single-player mode, up to 2 files can be saved while in the multi-player mode, the number is increased to 3. The current level and obtained items will be stored in the file but the level of the Dungeon will be refreshed upon loading. Each file is kept for up to one week and all files are erased automatically every Monday at 5 am. 
6. Each account is rewarded for its first clearance of each level. However, the rewards will only be issued when adventurers have reached the exit room with enough keys from this level. Every week there is a weekly reward set based on each player's personal best record. Each ten levels are grouped into 1 tier for the weekly reward. Players who have cleared Level 10 or higher for the first time don't have any weekly reward. Each account may claim one weekly reward per week only. For Dungeon, a player reached Lv. 20 in the previous week and he's entitled to the Tier 2 Level 20 Weekly Reward when he clears Lv. 11-20. There will be no reward if he fails between Lv. 1 and 10. 
7. Monsters have different affixes, including 
Gaze: Features 10 layers of shield, each has a certain HP. Only after all 10 shields are broken, it will begin to take damage. With its eyes locked on a random player, it will deal an instant kill when it reaches the player.
 Corrosive: Upon each attack received, it spills a puff of poisonous smoke nearby which will inflict a damage on players by percentage 
Symbiotic: 3 symbiotic monsters will be refreshed in a room at the same time and launch an Advance Attack on a random player. If there is still another symbiotic monster alive 5 seconds after a symbiotic monster's death, the deceased will revive. 
 Hiding: Constantly summon Imps at random spots to attack players. The real figure is invisible for 60 seconds. Players need to find and defeat the real figure 
Enslave: As it emerges, refresh an invisible Rune Ball which will grant a powerful buff to the monster and revive rune monsters. 
 Seal: As the monster exists on the battlefield, Nether Lords will be removed on a regular basis 
Light Shelter: As the monster exists on the battlefield, its halo significantly increases other monsters' damage reduction of divine/water/fire/thought/poison attribute 
Shadow Shield: As the monster exists on the battlefield, its halo significantly increases other monsters' damage reduction of dark/wind/earth/immortal/null attribute 
Stand fast: As the monster exists on the battlefield, its halo protects other monsters from any control effect 
Division: The death of this monster will create 5 Porings, which must be killed within a certain period of time or they will merge back into the monster with full HP 
Death Talk: Upon its death, a powerful buff is cast on all its nearby monsters. You are advised to save this monster till the last to kill 
Explosion: 2 seconds after its death, a large scale explosion will take place 
Spider Web: It spurts spider web, which will reduce all players' Move SPD by 50% within 10 grids for 10 seconds.
 Arcane: It summons an Arcane Ball around it at intervals which will explode upon touch by any player and cause AOE DMG 
Curse: Its attack will reduce the target player's healing effect 
6. Chief Monster (MVP) rooms have special scene effects 
Mist: Mist is created randomly in the room. Players will suffer reduced Healing Effect upon touching the mist 
Explosive Force Field: Several explosive force fields are summoned at intervals and AOE DMG will be caused at the end of the alarm 
Wheel of Judgment: Several flying wheels will be cast out from the center of the scene and move randomly in the room, dealing damage to players it touches with a chance of removing their gear 
Dark Space: Put players in dark at intervals 
Confinement Domain: It stops players in the room from performing magic healing 
Graveyard: Unable to use skills for revival
专属于RO玩家的小游戏！\n你有没有在挂机的时候一遍又一遍翻看冒险手册里卡牌的模:
A mini game exclusively for RO players! 
 Did you ever browse the look, name, attributes, and effect of cards in the Adventure Handbook over and over again while AFK? Did you ever pray for your favorite card while using the card gashapon? If you are confident in your knowledge on RO cards and your ability to remember, come and try the mini game Card Matching! 
 In this game, your goal is to match all cards before time runs out. 
 Matching includes: front - front, front - back, front - card effect. 
 Note: Each successful match rewards time while mistakes result in punishment. 
 Players are rewarded only on their first stage clearance.
专属于RO玩家的小游戏！\n你有没有为了提高挂机的效率而详细调查过魔物的属性和种:
A mini game exclusively for RO players! 
 Did you ever carry out a thorough research on monsters' attributes and race in hopes of improving AFK efficiency? Did you ever fix your eyes on the screen, watching monster after monster turns into Zeny in your bag? If you are confident in your knowledge on RO monsters and your sharp eyes, come and try the mini game Monster Quiz! 
 In this game, your goal is to answer several questions according to the monsters in the scene before time runs out. 
 Questions include: Monster's color, monster's number of feet, monster's elemental attribute, and monster's race. 
 Note: For an "A or B" question, the monster needs to meet either A or B requirement. For an "A and B" question, the monster needs to meet both A and B requirements. 
 Players are rewarded only on their first stage clearance.
专属于RO玩家的小游戏！\n你有没有为了解锁冒险手册里的风景而手持相机穿梭世界各:
A mini game exclusively for RO players! 
 Did you ever shuttle back and forth in the world with your phone to unlock scenic spots in the Adventure Handbook? Did you ever hold your phone and wait still, looking forward to seeing a Ghostring? If you are confident in your photography and operation skills, come and try the mini game Monster Photography! 
 In this game, your goal is to take several photos as required by the system before time runs out. Pay attention to the number of monsters required. 
 Note: For monsters that are not mentioned in the requirement, it won't be a problem however many of them are captured in the photo. 
 Players are rewarded only on their first stage clearance.

随起源的传说，铭记昨日的荣耀。勇敢的冒险者，在命运之风的引领下迎接新的挑战吧！（: With the legend of origin, remember the glory of yesterday. Brave adventurer, meet the new challenge under the guidance of Wind of Fate! (Use to unlock avatar frame, Evidence of Origin)
打开后获得洛阳难度及以下区域随机MVP材料: Open to obtain Luoyang difficulty and the following regional random MVP materials.
与灵魂十分亲和的晶体，可以唤回迷失的灵魂。对已死亡的队友使用可以使其原地复活，在: A crystal that is very close to souls, and can bring back lost souls. Use on dead teammates to revive them where they are. When the whole team dies, the last dead adventurer will automatically be revived.
蕴含冲击性能量的晶体，对它不够了解的话可能会震伤自己。使用后15秒内可以令普通攻: A crystal with impact energy. If you don't know enough about it, you may hurt yourself. Use to add extra true damage to Auto Attacks within 15 seconds after use.
散发着朦胧光芒的晶体，但是却没有任何照明功效。使用后可以在15秒内令周围的隐身单: A crystal with a dim light, but without any lighting effects. After use, the stealth units around can be shown for 15 seconds.
带有净化之力的晶体，据说当护身符很灵验。使用后解除当前MVP房间的场景效果。: A crystal with the power of purification. It's said that it can be very useful as a talisman. Removes the scene effect of the current MVP room after use.
散发着阵阵寒意的晶体，在夏天很受欢迎。激活后立刻对周围一定范围的敌人冰冻，持续8: A cold crystal, which is very popular in summer. When activated, it immediately freezes enemies in a certain range around it for 8 seconds.
能够扭曲空间的神秘晶体，曾有商人把它装到相机上实现了美颜效果。使用后可以将一个敌: A mysterious crystal that can distort space. Once a businessman inlaid it on a camera to achieve the beauty filter effect. After use, you can banish an enemy to a different dimension, making it unable to move, attack or be attacked within 10 seconds.
据说远古时期的人类曾经用骨制的信物来标识领地，骨也有家的象征。使用后可以传送回本: It’s said that in ancient times, people used keepsakes made of bone to mark territory. Bones also represent home. After use, you can be sent back to the nearest lounge on this floor. If there is no unlocked lounge, you will be sent back to the spawn point on this floor.
里面藏着一个凶恶的诅咒，千万小心！使用后为当前房间内所有魔物施加收到伤害加重效果: There is a vicious curse in it. Be careful! After use, double all Monsters’ DMG taken in the current room. Lasts 10 seconds.
只有一个指针，而且转的飞快。使用后短暂提高移动速度，持续15秒。: There's only one pointer, which turns really fast. Temporarily increases Move Spd for 15 seconds after use.
这瓶药受到过最诚挚的祝福，散发着神圣的气息。使用后获得4秒的无敌效果。: This bottle of potion has received the most sincere blessing, emanating with holy essence. Get the Invincible effect for 4 seconds after use.
“魔法就是爆炸！不华丽就不能称作魔法了！”是某位著名魔法使的座右铭。对一位敌人造: “Magic is an explosion! If it's not fancy, it can't be called magic!” This is the motto of a famous magician. Deals multi-stage damage to an enemy. Each damage Stuns them for 0.1 seconds. Lasts 10 seconds.
随着冒险的不断进行，我明白了一件事：冒险者是没有极限哒！使用后下次攻击伤害翻倍。: As the adventure went on, I learned one thing: there is no limit for an adventurer! Doubles the damage of the next attack after use.
蕴含着破除迷雾的神秘力量。开启本层所有房间图标。: It contains a mysterious power that can remove fog. Unlock all room icons on this floor.
卷轴中封印着一些从别人那“借”来的力量。变身为女武神，持续20秒。: There are some “borrowed” forces sealed in the scroll. Transform into a Valkyrie for 20 seconds.
卷轴中封印着一些从别人那“借”来的力量。变身为达纳托斯，持续20秒。: There are some “borrowed” forces sealed in the scroll. Transform into Thanatos for 20 seconds.
哥布灵一族友情的证明，只有那些被哥布灵信赖的人才能得到这份馈赠。召唤大量哥布灵协: The proof of Goblins’ friendship. Only those who are trusted by Goblins can get this gift. Summon a large number of Goblins to help fight.
天使并不在虚无缥缈的天堂，他们存在于每一个坚强冒险者的内心。为全队施加增益效果，: Angels aren’t in the ethereal heaven, they exist in every strong adventurer’s heart. Cast a buff on all team members. Lasts 20 seconds.
能够带来财运的神奇存钱罐，招财效果也像存钱罐一样细水长流，不能指望一夜暴富哦~带: A magic money bank that can bring wealth. It requires time to attract money inside. You can't expect to get rich overnight. Taking it with you will increase the number of gold coins you get by 1.
虽然只是小小的一块石头，但它的气息像大地一样厚重。带在身上会在每次进入战斗房间时: Although it's just a small stone, its essence is as thick as the Earth. Bringing it with you will grant you a layer of shield each time you enter the combat room.
破破烂烂的绑带，意外拥有极佳的弹力，怎么拉都不会断。带在身上可以使装备不容易被脱: A tattered bandage. Unexpectedly, it has excellent elasticity and can't be pulled off. You can use it to make equipment difficult to unequip.
无限回廊中的稀有素材，能够在兑换商店兑换道具。黄金质感的表面上烙印着勇士之剑的徽: A rare material in Unlimited Corridor. Can be used to exchange items in the Exchange Shop. On its gold textured surface, there is an emblem of the Warrior's Sword, which is the proof of the glory of warriors who have wandered in the Unlimited Corridor.
打开箱子必定获得不定数量的七彩贝壳，并有概率获得蛇妖之瞳，燃烧的蛇鳞，冰晶琉璃，: Open the box to receive a random amount of Colorful Shells, and have a chance to obtain Snake Demon’s Pupils, Burning Snake Scale, Ice Crystal Glaze, Unreal Bone, Nightmare's Breath, Shibam's Anger, Hill's Feather, Fish Tail, Soft Silk, Pet EXP Potion (S), Pet EXP Potion (M), Pet EXP Potion (L), etc.
打开箱子必定获得不定数量的七彩贝壳，并有概率获得变身叶子，四叶幸运草，触角，宝石: Open the box to receive a random amount of Colorful Shells, and have a chance to obtain Raccoon Leaf, Four-leaf Clover, Antenna, Gem Starfish, Creamy Hazelnuts, Golden Cat Grass, Pet EXP Potion (S), Pet EXP Potion (M), Pet EXP Potion (L), etc.
打开后可获得洛阳地区所有MVP、Mini对应的枯树枝1个: Open to obtain a Dead Branch corresponding to all MVP and Mini in the Luoyang area
打开后会获得30~60个旷野之尘、4~6个远古遗骸和20000zeny，每天最多: Open to obtain 30-60 Dust in Wilderness, 4-6 Ancient Remains and 2000 Zeny. Up to 5 can be obtained per day.
忽克连为了回馈广大冒险者特意推出的礼盒，使用后可以获得Zeny*500000、「: A gift box presented by Hollgrehenn in order to thank all adventurers. Use it to obtain Zeny *500,000, Mora Coin *5, Oracle Dust *5, Oracle Crystal *5, Oridecon *10, and Elunium *10
蕴含着人造伊米尔之心力量的神秘宝石，在日光下可折射出异色光芒，拥有不可思议的魔力: A mysterious gem that contains the power of the artificial Heart of Yimir. It can reflect light with different colors under the sun, and has incredible magic power. It can be used for the synthesis and release of Vine Armor and Homunculus.
经过时光沉淀，外表如流霞般美丽的玛瑙石。是荒境上最珍贵的秘藏之一。: An agate stone with a beautiful appearance like flowing clouds after time precipitation. It is one of the most precious treasures in the Barren Land.
于花草树木中诞生的魔法光子，蕴含着自然的灵气，十分罕见。: Magic photons born in flowers, grass and trees. They contain natural energy, which is very rare.
荒境中掩埋的未知骸骨，它的主人已经不可追溯。而其中隐藏的秘密，再也无人知晓。: Unknown bones buried in the Barren Land. Their owner is no longer traceable. The hidden secret within them will no longer be known.
弥漫在时间长河中，由无数回忆构成的流沙碎屑，逝去的岁月皆潜藏于此。也唯有它的力量: Quicksand debris that fill up the long river of time and are composed of countless memories. All past times are hidden here. Only its power can awaken the ancient magic in the Divine Tree.
狩猎者专属的传送器，能准确地定位附近区域的强大而稀有的魔物的位置。: A hunter's transmitter. It can accurately locate the location of powerful and rare Monsters in the nearby area.
定向传送器可以令你实现精准降落，想去哪里就去哪里，再也不用担心迷路啦！: The directional transmitter allows you to land accurately. You can go where ever you want with it, and never worry about getting lost!
受到了风之魔法祝福的这双靴子是用来疾行赶路的上佳选择，穿上它的冒险者会健步如飞。: This pair of boots blessed by Wind Magic are a good choice for walking at high speed. Adventurers will be able to walk as if they’re on wings while wearing them.
能够探测宝藏具体方位的鹰隼之眼，发家致富全靠它！可对自身一定范围内的宝箱进行指引: Hawk Eye that can detect specific treasure locations. You can make a fortune with it! It can lead you to treasure chests within a certain range. Adventurer, take it with you and start your treasure hunt!
荒境专属的传送器，使用后可立即传送至荒境的神树附近。: It's a special transmitter in the Barren Land. It can send you to the Divine Tree in the Barren Land immediately after use.
能提供应急物资补给的补给箱，是经常进行长途旅行的冒险者们的必备之物。使用后可进行: A supply box that can provide emergency supplies. It’s very handy for adventurers who often travel long distances. After use, a supply purchase of consumables can be carried out.
能给附近的魔物们施展变形魔法的神奇绘卷。据说，无论多么凶悍的魔物也会在这幅绘卷的: A magic scroll that can cast transformation magic to nearby Monsters. It's said that no matter how fierce a monster is, it will be turned into a lovely shape under the power of this scroll!
这件斗篷会令你隐去自己的身形，感知再敏锐的魔物也不会觉察到你！不信的话就披上这件: This cloak will help you hide your body shape. No matter how sensitive a Monster is, they will not be able to notice you! If you don't believe it, put it on and go find some Monsters to have a try!
一本离奇的魔法相册，会使被记录在相册里面的魔物们互生嫌隙，陷入混乱状态。“离我远: A bizarre magic album, which makes the Monsters recorded in the album hate each other and descend into chaos. “Stay away from me, you are so annoying!”
“雨天当然是阴郁的，这是常识啦！”阴郁雨云是应对火属性魔物的上佳选择，而对高原瑞: “Of course, rainy days are depressing. It's just common sense!” Depression Rain Cloud is the best choice to deal with Fire-type Monsters. If you use it on a Highland Parasite, unexpected effects will appear!
一支诡异古怪的魔笛，能够吹奏出魅惑魔物心灵的乐曲，役使魔物们在一定时间内为你作战: A strange magic flute which can play music that can enchant Monsters’ hearts, and make Monsters fight for you for a certain period of time.
荒境的危险遗物，制作它的技艺似乎早已经失传了。布置它的时候请务必小心，哪怕经过了: A dangerous relic from the Barren Land. The skill of making it seems to have been lost for a long time. Please be careful when placing it somewhere. It’s very old, but its lethality shouldn’t be underestimated!
捣蛋小鬼会对你身边的魔物具有显著的激怒效果，所以，最好不要试着使用它—除非，你做: Troublemakers can significantly enrage Monsters around you. So, it's best not to use it, unless you're ready to take Monsters’ go into a rage.
具有强力爆破效果的魔法炸弹，试着朝敌人进行炸弹投掷攻击吧，砰砰砰！: A magic bomb with a powerful blasting effect. Try throwing it at the enemy. Bang bang bang!
一只没打开的神秘钱袋总是最诱人的—因为你总可以期待从中获得一大笔财富。试着打开它: An unopened mysterious wallet is always the most attractive thing, because you can always expect a lot of money from it. Try opening it and take a look. May good luck be with you!
荒境的珍贵遗物，熔炉中蕴藏的上古魔力使其有着强大的熔炼功效。: A precious relic from the Barren Land. The ancient magic in the furnace gives it a powerful smelting effect.
蕴含着亡灵魂魄的魔笛，可以给魔物的遗骸注入魔力使其复苏。“嘘，你看，那堆遗骸好像: A magic flute which contains the soul of the Dead. It can inject magic into the remains of Monsters to revive them. “Shh, look, the remains seem to be moving!”
想和魔物们进行亲密无间的接触和交流吗？镜像魔法满足你！想变成什么魔物的话，就把这: Do you want to have intimate contact and communication with Monsters? Mirror magic can help you! If you want to become a certain Monster, try aiming the Mirror of Imitation at it.
一只存取了人们的愿望的魔力海螺，将它放在耳畔仔细聆听，你将会听到来自远方的求助声: A magic conch that stores people's wishes. Put it next to your ear and listen carefully. You will hear the voice of asking for help from afar.
一把遗落在荒境的短刃，尽管它有些生锈并不够锋利，但偶尔拿来护身自卫还是可以的。: A short blade left in the Barren Land. Although it’s rusty and not sharp enough, it can still be used for self-defense.
开启异世界的大门的魔法钥匙，用以开启异界魔扉。: A magic key that can open the door to Another World. Use it to open the Exotic Magic Door.
在原地放置这台狸猫留声机，周围的魔物们会被留声机放送的音乐吸引并向其聚拢。此外，: Place the Smokie Phonograph and the Monsters around it will be attracted to and gather around the music coming from the gramophone. Also, Smokie Phonograph has some special magical effects on Smokies!
有了这把点石成金铲，不管你到了哪里都可以挖出宝藏！使用后召唤麦基瑟员工为你服务，: With this Midas Touch Shovel, you can dig for treasure wherever you go! After using, call Macacer Staff to serve you, and have the chance to dig out treasure chests in the current area. But if you are not lucky, you will also get something else!
金制的锁钥，上面刻有精密复杂的纹路，可以用来开启一个稀有宝箱。: A key made of gold. It is engraved with precise and complex patterns. It can be used to open a rare treasure chest.
银制的锁钥，上面刻有简单质朴的纹路，可以用来开启一个特殊宝箱。: A silver key. It is engraved with simple patterns and can be used to open a special treasure chest.

落日浅滩常见的魔物。触角上的灯笼使得它们可以放心来到岸上游逛，即便是在沉沉黑夜，: A monster commonly spotted at Sunset Beach The lantern on their Antenna allows them to go ashore and wander around at ease. Even in the darkest night, they won't lose their way home.
落日浅滩常见的魔物。似乎是印刻在它们身上的神秘的魔纹赋予了它们生命和魔力，但也有: A monster commonly spotted at Sunset Beach It seems that they've gained their life and magic from the mysterious pattern on their body. There are also rumors that they were created out of Luoyang residents' long-term book and paper worship.
来到洛阳的波利们经历悠久的时间演化成为的新品种，是风靡洛阳城的可爱魔物。: A new species derived from Porings that migrated to Luoyang a really long time ago. These adorable monsters are very popular in Luoyang.
银鱼湖底常见的魔物。与落日浅滩上提着灯笼爱四处游逛的鱼人不同，生性内向的它们在银: A monster commonly spotted at the Whitebait Lakebed. Different from their counterpart wandering with a lantern at Sunset Beach, these introvert mermen live peacefully at the Whitebait Lakebed, long forgotten by the terrestrial humans.
银鱼湖底常见的魔物。性情暴躁，攻击性强，是湖底鱼类的最致命的捕食者。: A monster commonly spotted at the Whitebait Lakebed. Irritable and aggressive, they are the most deadly predators feeding on the fish at the lake floor.
虽然长久以来只有极少的人类曾亲眼见到过红尾人鱼，但是她们美丽与优雅的形象却已经在: For a really long time, only very few humans have reported personal sightings of the Red-tailed Obeaune. However, their beauty and elegancy frequently appear in children's fairy tales on land. "Mom, are there really beautiful Mermaid sisters?"
常见的植物型魔物，因为长年在危险的荒境中生存从而进化出了如同枫叶般的保护色。会通: A commonly spotted plant-type monster. It has adapted to the dangerous Barren Land and evolved into the maple leaf tone for better protection. It uses its long stern like a whip for self protection.
由虫蛹进化而成，酷爱蜂蜜。因为在长年在危险的荒境中生存从而其小心谨慎的天性得到了: Evolved from a pupa, it adores honey dearly. For better survival in the dangerous Barren Land, it has further polished its cautious nature.
常见的植物型魔物，嘴巴一张一合就像在打呵欠，但如果放松警惕的话，会被它一口吞下去: A commonly spotted plant-type monster. Its mouth opens and closes as if it was yawning. However, the moment when you lower your guard, you will be devoured in one bite!
因为长年在危险的荒境中生存而产生变异的老鼠，有着顽强的繁殖力和生命力。: A rat mutated to better survive in th dangerous Barren Land. Its reproductive capacity and life force are impressive.
犬妖家族的一员，得意武器是刺锤。驯顺的外表有着很强的迷惑性，实则战斗力惊人。联合: A string of the Kobold family, happily armed with a Thorny Maul. Don't be fooled by its docile appearance. Its combat power will shock you. The united Kobold family is a powerful force in the Barren Land.
先天带有毒性的魔菇，常出现在阴冷的洞穴中。夜间会放出幽绿色的光。: A naturally poisonous Spore that is usually seen in cold and humid caves. It gives off a ghostly green glow at night.
栖息在湿冷环境中的蝙蝠，飞行速度快，会成群结队地攻击。夜间会放出幽蓝色的光。: A bat dwelling in the cold and humid environment. It can fly at an astonishing speed and attacks in group. It gives off a ghostly blue glow at night.
荒境亡者的幽灵之火。常常会在夜间集聚起来对活物发起攻击，遭受袭击者如果不尽快逃离: The ghost fire of the deceased in the Barren Land. They often rally at night to attack any living beings. The victims will be surrounded if they can't get out quickly.
栖息在森林里的魔物瓢虫，有着碧绿的保护色。通常是以食腐为主，但偶尔也会主动袭击。: A monster bug that lives in the forest. Its bright blue skin is a great camouflage. Usually it scavenges but sometimes it also initiates attacks. Its round shell can effectively protect its tender wings.
落日浅滩上不怀好意的一只狐妖，常常以博学的学者形象示人。时常有不明真相的游人们不: A vicious fox spirit dwelling at Sunset Beach. It often disguises itself as a well learned scholar. Ignorant travellers often ignore warnings and approach it for fate telling, which would usually result in their worst nightmare.
银鱼湖底神秘尊贵的公主，人鱼族的王者，她的魔力使她永远维持着少女的容貌和仪态。“: The mysterious and noble princess of the Whitebait Lakebed and the head of the Obeaune. Her magic grants her the ability to always appear as if a young maiden. "Annoying humans... Don't disturb me!"
堕落的枫树精灵伊斯玛已经遗忘了她的过去，那时，她常常在原野上欢歌和咏唱。如今的她: The depraved Maple Fairy Yzma has long forgotten her past. She used to sing merrily on the field. Now hiding in the Barren Land, her crispy singing in the clear sky has long been replaced by her hoarse chants of obscure wicked spells above the land.
据说，蛇妖戈耳工并不是落日浅滩的原生魔物，而是从遥远未知的地方迁徙过来的。但毫无: Rumor has it that the Snake Demon Gorgon was not originally from Sunset Beach. Instead, it travelled far from an unknown land. Without a doubt, this foreigner's might has struck fear into the local Sunset Beach monsters' mind, preventing them from any attempted offense.
银鱼湖底的守护者，周身遍布火焰色魔纹的巨蛇。对任何扰乱银鱼湖底秩序的破坏者们，波: The guardian of the Whitebait Lakebed, a giant snake covered by a fire pattern. Those who attempt to destroy the order of the Whitebait Lakebed are to be punished harshly by Poi Tata.
荒境的至高领主，似乎有着难言的过往。在可怖的魔焰的缭绕之下，在漠然空洞的眼神里，: The supreme overlord of the Barren Land with an unspeakable past. With a terrifying magic fire curling around its body, the Barren Land lord's intense hatred to the city of Luoyang presents in his cold eyes.
火焰鸟啾利天性喜爱一切闪闪发光的东西，而惯于对财宝进行掠夺盗窃的恶名却也令它难以: Fire Bird Chiri loves everything that shines. A notorious robber covetous of treasures and gems, it is not very popular with any race as expected.
历经了无尽悠长的岁月的巨牛欧德姆布拉，在创世之初的热气与寒冰的交错中诞生，是巨人: The giant bull Audhumbla has lived since forever. Created when the hot air met the cold ice at the beginning of the world, he was Giant Yimir's mount.
生前是一名实力强大的法师。遗体被复活后，选择了继续挥舞法杖战斗——只不过，他再也: He was once a powerful mage in his life time. After being resurrected, he chose to continue wielding his staff. However, his sharp mind was no longer there to distinguish good and evil.
身着华服美丽十足的佩瑞丝是荒境中耀眼夺目的存在——假如荒境有选美大赛的话，佩瑞丝: Parasite in her resplendent dress is always the brightest star in the Barren Land. If there was a beauty contest, she would for sure be one of the most competitive contestants!
荒境中罕见的可爱小兽，天性好动喜欢折腾，其喜气洋洋的神态常常会为偶然见到它的人们: A cute little monster that can be rarely seen in the Barren Land. Very energetic and active, its happy face can easily put a smile on those who are lucky to chance upon it.
荒境的原始土著民族，常常在森林，沼泽，草地等处聚族而居，身手敏捷，崇尚自然和力量: The aboriginal tribe of the Barren Land, they dwell in groups in the forest, swamp, and grassland. Swift and quick, they worship nature and power.
天生龅牙的小动物，喜欢在地底活动，因此成了负责荒境的矿工工作的最合适的魔物。: A little creature with buckteeth, it is often active under the ground thus the best monster to work as a miner in the Barren Land.
生前是一名洒脱不羁的剑客。遗体被复活后，他常常在荒境漫无目的地游荡，完成了他生前: A carefree, unrestrained swordsman in his life time. After being brought back to life, he often wanders in the Barren Land aimlessly, fulfilling his dream of becoming a lone traveller.
荒境的一种神秘的植物型魔物，个子不大，天性羞涩，擅长捉迷藏。作为体态娇小的魔物，: A mysterious plant-type monster in the Barren Land. Small and shy, it's pretty good at hide and seek. Due to its tiny size, it doesn't enjoy fighting with other monsters at all.
生活在林间的小型魔物，凭借其狡黠聪慧的神态赢得了洛阳居民们的一致喜爱。: A S-size monster living in the wood, it is very popular with the residents of Luoyang thanks to its clever, sharp looks.
堕落的蛇人魔物，邪恶魔力的腐蚀使他的体躯呈现出了不详的深紫色，危险的气息扑面而来: A depraved snake man monster. Corroded by the evil magic, its body has turned a gloomy deep purple, giving off a sense of danger.
虎中王者，它的旧式的礼帽，精巧的烟斗，银白色的毛发……这些都无疑象征着这位月下绅: The lord of tigers. It wears a classic top hat on its silver hair and an exquisite pipe... These all cry out the elegancy and blue blood of this gentleman under the moon.
剧毒的深渊蚁后，具有很强的繁殖能力——以及少有人知晓的惊人美貌。: The deadly poisonous Maya of the abyss. It is well known for her astonishing ability to reproduce while her matchless beauty remains a secret for many.
一种神秘怪诞的魔物。通常伪装成路边带野花的灌木，趁人不备时会用毒针偷袭自己的猎物: A weird, absurd monster. It often disguises itself as a bush in full bloom by the road and attacks its prey with its poisonous needle by surprise.
犬妖家族中的首领，是家族中实力最为强大的一员，相比于其他犬妖，其好斗的天性更为明: The chief of the Kobolds. Much stronger than its peers, it is also more bellicose and aggressive by nature.
生性淘气爱捉弄人的迷你魔猴，以森林里的浆果为食，常常因其过分的聒噪吵闹不受森林里: The mini magic monkey is naughty and playful. It loves to play tricks on others and feeds on berries in the forest. It is not popular with other monsters due to its constant uproar.
堕落的蜥蜴魔物，具有很强的毒性。据说与深渊蛇人有着密切的亲缘关系。: A depraved lizard monster, highly poisonous. It is believed to be closely related to the Abyssal Snake Man.
由灵性的石心所驱动，从废墟遗迹中所诞生的巨大魔物。拥有坚强的外表、魁梧的身躯还有: Driven by an intelligent stone heart, this giant monster was born in the ruins. Behind its tough look and sturdy body is a tender heart. However, once irritated, it will unleash its terrifying destructive force!
堕落的马属魔物，幽紫色的体躯，爆炸的发型以及怪异的嘶吼都是它魔化后的新特征……嘘: A depraved horse creature. The ghostly purple body, afro hair, and odd hiss are its new features after mutation. Shush... Don't invade its territory!
疯兔的变异种，因为长年在荒境中生存，耳朵逐渐变成了枫叶的颜色，脾气要比外表暴躁很: A mutated Lunatic. After years of living in the Barren Land, its ears have turned into the maple color and its temper way more fiery than it appears.
米诺斯体型巨大且拥有超强的力量，而在经历了魔化之后，不仅是力量得到了进一步增强，: Minorous is huge and powerful. After the mutation, his strength has become even greater and its messed up consciousness has made it much more dangerous than before.
这是来自深渊的冰冷注视，令人心生寒意。: This is a cold gaze from the abyss, sending a chill down your spine.
魔牛虚拟体，释放重磅践踏: Ox Monster Virtual Body, release the Heavy Trampling
魔牛*虚拟体，释放重磅践踏和召唤魔牛: Ox Monster * Virtual Body, release the Heavy Trampling and summon the magic ox
魔牛*虚拟体，释放重磅践踏和召唤魔牛弱化版: Ox Monster * Virtual Body, release the Heavy Trampling and summon the weakened magic ox
拥有罕见配色的波利，对自己的颜色很是自豪，言行中总带着一点点骄傲。: A Poring with a rare color combination. Very proud of its colors, it sounds and acts arrogantly all the time.
成天打着灯笼，迷迷糊糊的鱼人，谁也不知道它究竟在想些什么。: A confused merman carrying a lantern all day long. Nobody knows what is going on in its head.
对火光十分敏感的魔物，神奇之处在于它不怕火，反而热衷灭火，这在魔物中很罕见。: Very sensitive to fire, however, this monster is not afraid of fire but very fond of fire fighting. How rare for a monster!
冰凉，坚硬，与普通的波利差别显著，也许是受环境影响，它的性格也有些冷冰冰的。: Grim and hard, very different from a normal Poring. Probably due to the environmental influence, its personality is also pretty cold.
一柄诡异的...剑？还是其他什么生物？实在是太诡异了，有点可怕。: A strange... Sword? Or some kind of a creature? This is too odd and scary.
性格沉稳坚毅的喵咪骑士，久经战阵的他因为总是秉持着一副严肃的面孔，竟意外获得了“: A calm and resolute cat knight. After countless battles, he looks serious all the time, which has earned him the title "Scowling Knight".
尊贵慵懒的喵咪女爵，平日里最喜欢的是午后悠闲的日光浴，但在必要的时候，她也会打起: An elegant yet lazy Cat Lady. She loves nothing more than a relaxing sun bathing in the afternoon. When absolutely necessary, she will buck up and show her loyalty and bravery.
性情忧郁的喵咪男爵，“湛蓝色的忧郁”为他增添了别样的魅力，然而，在男爵的内心深处: A heavyhearted cat baron. His blue depression has become part of his charm. Deep down in his heart is his passion for food and fight.
稚气满满的仓鼠小战士，叉子武器上时常挂着奶酪，显然是做好了长途行军的准备。“一个: A childish hamster warrior often seen with a piece of cheese on its weapon fork. Apparently it's prepared for a long march. "A great hamster warrior never gives up on two things, cheese and courage!"
爱幻想的小白猫，好奇心非常旺盛，水汪汪的大眼睛滴溜溜转动时，大概是在想什么好吃好: A white kitty who loves to dream. Full of curiosity, it's probably thinking about fun and food when its big teary eyes roll.
雷根贝勒高层安德烈说让冒险者去协助杰拉尔调查，公司丢失的能源材料。但是要签署保密: Rekenber High Position Andre requested the adventurer to assist Gerald in the investigation on the company's lost energy materials. However, a non-disclosure agreement must be signed. Kim pointed out that he was suspicious of the Old Pat. You travelled to the theater to investigate but found nothing. You retreated temporarily.
冒险者一行人变装潜入剧院，跟上机器人皮埃尔，发现他在教一个叫“黛丽丝”的小女孩机: The adventurer and his mates sneaked into the theater in disguise behind Robot Pierre, discovering that it was teaching a robot girl Delice singing. The Old Pat revealed himself and declared the experimental object a failure due to the lack of emotions.
金确定是老帕特盗用了能源，并要拍黛丽丝的照片取证。但皮埃尔明知此事还帮助老帕特，: Kim was certain it was the Old Pat who stole the energy. He wanted a picture of Delice as proof. Aware of this, Pierre helped the Old Pat and sent the adventurer to get the Mutant Deposit's Energy Core. The adventurer handed it over to Pierre after.
皮埃尔将能源核用在黛丽丝身上，但是似乎无进展。皮埃尔让冒险者狠狠敲打黛丽丝，敲打: Pierre used the Energy Core on Delice but it didn't seem to work. Pierre ordered the adventurer to strike Delice with force and the experiement was finally successful. Delice was safe. Pierre was relieved.
慈善家垦丁让冒险者为他做事，他让冒险者给辛苦的贝鲁妮家送去三头小猪。贝鲁妮十分感: Philanthropist Kenting hired the adventurer to work for him. He sent the adventurer to deliver three piglets to the hardworking Berenie family. Berenie was very grateful.
垦丁让冒险者带着餐车去给梅尔区的乞丐们分发食物，大家都十分感激。: Kenting ordered the adventurer to drive the Dining Carriage to Merl and distribute food to the beggars. Everyone was grateful.
垦丁让冒险者给梅尔区的孩子们分发糖果。孩子们拿到糖果很开心。: Kenting sent the adventurer to distribute candies to the children in Merl. The children were very happy for the candies.
垦丁让冒险者收集金属波利身上的金属块作为梅尔区电力设施翻新的材料，冒险者集齐交给: Kenting ordered the adventurer to collect metal blocks from the Metal Poring as materials for the power utilities‘ renovation in Merl. The adventurer gathered enough and sent back to him. He immediately rallied a group of people to get to work.
垦丁让冒险者去帮助灭鼠，冒险者按照指示完成任务，并在完成任务后得到了报酬。: Kenting ordered the adventurer to help with deratization. The adventurer completed the task as requested and earned the payment.
垦丁让冒险者去梅尔区告诉大家这些事都是他肯定做的，并希望大家记住他。他的言辞中无: Kenting sent the adventurer to Merl to inform the people all the great deeds he had done for them and ask them to remember him. He sounded contemptuous of the people in Merl.
金因为垦丁停止资助孤儿院而找上门来讨说法。冒险者从金口中得知垦丁所做的一切都是伪: Kim came to visit and demanded an answer regarding Kenting stopping funding the orphanage. The adventurer learned from Kim that Kenting had been hypocritical. At that moment, Kenting's words left the adventurer speechless...
老帕特价的绿宝石不见了，他怀疑可能是佣人干的，于是拜托冒险者调查。: Old Pat's emerald was missing. He suspected his maid and requested the adventurer to investigate.
老帕特非常怀疑凡尔纳，冒险者问了情报通后得知凡尔纳最近有很多钱喝酒，于是逼问凡尔: Old Pat was very suspicious of Verne. The adventurer asked the Intelligence Guy and learned that Verne lately had a lot of drinking money. He questioned Verne. Verne denied the accusation and pointed his finger at the housekeeper Bette. At that moment, Kim arrived...
老帕特又让冒险者去调查贝姨，调查过程中金又冒了出来，但被无视。贝姨让冒险者消灭土: Old Pat sent the adventurer to check Bette up. During the investigation, Kim showed up again but was ignored. Bette promised the adventurer a lead as a reward if he could help eliminate the Martin. After the adventurer finished, Bette named Berenie.
老帕特又让冒险者去调查贝鲁妮，贝鲁妮说自己儿子修火车受伤了，希望冒险者送药水给儿: Old Pat ordered the adventurer to investigate Berenie. She claimed her son was injured while fixing a train and asked the adventurer to deliver potion to him. He vouchered for his mother's innocence.
三名佣人似乎都没有嫌疑，这时老帕特想起当天在家的还有自己爱乱花前摆阔气的儿子帕里: Three servants all seemed innocent. Then, Old Pat recalled his splurging son Paris was also there that day. The adventurer went on to investigate him. However, Paris refused to answer questions and ran away in confusion in the end.
冒险者绕过老帕特召集之前调查过的所有人，告诉老帕特自己已经知道了犯人。最终金出现: The adventurer gathered all the people he had investigated himself and informed Old Pat that he had found the guilty one. At last, Kim showed up and revealed Paris was the thief.
老帕特担心儿子，让冒险者去里希塔乐原野找人。找到后帕里斯说，偷宝石只是想引起父亲: Worried about his son, Old Pat sent the adventurer to look for him in Lighthalzen Plain. Paris explained that he stole the gem for his father's attention. The adventurer used his magic to retrieve the emerald. Father and son became reconciled and realized how precious their kinship was.
吉拉德告诉冒险者，自己的朋友弗利茨是梅尔镇的厨师，肉排做得很好吃。吉拉德曾请求朋: Gilad told the adventurer that his friend Fritz was a chef in Merl, with his signature dish being the Meat Steak. Gilad offered to buy the recipe but his friend refused to sell.
吉拉德觉得问题在食材，让冒险者去打一头大骨脚野猪做食材。结果吉拉德失败。: Gilad believed the ingredient was the problem. He requested the adventurer to hunt a Big Foot Boar for him. But Gilad failed.
吉拉德觉得问题在水上，让冒险者去取原野河边的清水。结果吉拉德失败。: Gilad thought the problem must be the water. He sent the adventurer to fetch some fresh water from the field river. But Gilad failed.
吉拉德觉得问题在调味料上，让冒险者去店里买最贵的调料。结果吉拉德失败。: Gilad thought his seasonings must be wrong. He asked the adventurer to purchase the most expensive seasonings from the store. But Gilad failed.
吉拉德觉得问题在火候上，让冒险者去砍里希塔乐原野早上的木柴。结果吉拉德失败。: Gilad believed he didn't get the heat right. He requested the adventurer to chop some morning wood from the Lighthalzen Plain. But Gilad failed.
连续的失败使吉拉德非常生气，于是冒险者把这件事告诉了弗利茨，这时出现了受托吉拉德: Gilad was mad after the failed attempts. The adventurer informed Fritz of what had happened. Gerald was sent by Gilad to threaten Fritz for the Meat Steak recipe. The adventurer protected Fritz.
弗利茨去见吉拉德，要给他亲手做一次肉排。一番周折后弗利茨见到了吉拉德，告诉他肉排: Fritz went to visit Gilad and offered to cook his famous Meat Steak for him. Fritz finally managed to see Gilad and told him the secret of his Meat Steak was the kitchen knife, a gift from Gilad.
卡罗尔让冒险者帮他领取过世父亲的遗嘱，冒险者签字后领取到，并将其交给卡罗尔。: Carol asked the adventurer to pick up his deceased father's death note on his behalf. The adventurer got it after signing his name and handed it to Carol.
卡罗尔的父亲在遗嘱上说遗产需要解谜才能找到，这时金发现了谜题，关键词是“年龄“。: Carol's father wrote in his death note that a puzzle must be solved to inherit. Kim found out about the puzzle and the key word was Age.
卡罗尔让冒险者向大哥卡利尔讨要遗产。卡利尔表示，如果冒险者帮他收集金属波利的齿轮: Carol sent the adventurer to ask for the inheritance from his elder brother Khelil. Khelil requested for the Metal Poring's gear in exchange for him to reveal the thing that never aged. The adventurer fulfilled the request. Khelil said it might be the shabby clock in Merl.
冒险者前往梅尔区将破钟修好，然而什么也没发生。卡罗尔觉得自己被大哥骗了。: The adventurer travelled to Merl and fixed the broken clock. However, nothing happened. Carol believed he was fooled by his elder brother.
卡罗尔让冒险者去找妹妹卡梅斯，势利眼的卡梅斯却已经打算和卡利尔联手了。: Carol then sent the adventurer to visit his younger sister Camus. The snobbish Camus had picked Khelil's side.
听闻大哥卡利尔和妹妹卡梅斯联手的卡罗尔很生气，便向二人讨要说法，但卡利尔为遗产已: The news of his brother Khelil and sister Camus's joining hands enraged Carol. He demanded an explanation from the two. For the inheritance, Khelil no longer cared about their brotherhood. He ordered his men to harm Carol, who was saved by the adventurer.
修来到一个陌生的地方，遇到了冒险者。他声称可以为人实现任何愿望，但冒险者拒绝了。: Hugh travelled to a strange place and bumped into the adventurer. He claimed he could fulfill a dream of anyone but the adventurer refused. He begged the adventurer for some water before setting out to look for someone with a wish.
修再次碰到冒险者，他总是在找人实现愿望。于是看到一个乞丐。在完成了乞丐的要求后，: Hugh met the adventurer, still looking for someone's wish to fulfill. He saw a beggar. After meeting the beggar's request, the beggar wanted to make a different wish. However, Hugh emphasized that everyone could only make one wish.
修再次遇到冒险者，他抱怨卡琳娜对他不予理睬。冒险者过去一看，卡琳娜在教育自己的儿: Hugh ran into the adventurer again and complained how Karina always ignored him. Adventurer called on Karina when she was educating her son Ron. Hugh put a spell on Ron and he was suddenly enlightened.
修碰到一个他实现不了的愿望——雷诺喜欢叫蕾娜的女孩，冒险者去打探情况后，雷诺让冒: Hugh met a wish that he was unable to fulfill - Reno was in love with a girl named Vahalla. The adventurer went to gather information. Reno asked the adventurer to deliver a lover letter to Vahalla for him. Vahalla visited Reno after reading the letter. Finally Reno's dream came true.
梅林太太向修许愿，希望找回丢失的糖罐。冒险者去帮忙，结果发现糖罐在卡尔手上。冒险: Mrs. Merlin prayed to Hugh for the retrieval of her missing candy jar. The adventurer went to help and found the candy jar at Karl's. The adventurer took the candy jar back for Hugh.
修向冒险者说自己其实是神使，需要在十天内完成100个愿望才能回去。这时一个哭泣的: Hugh revealed to the adventurer that he was actually an oracle who must fulfill 100 wishes within 10 days to be able to return to heaven. Then, a crying girl Bella wished for her deceased mother to be cured. Hugh fulfilled the wish at the cost of his own life.
修再次出现在冒险者面前，他来和冒险者道别。修似乎见到了主神。临别之际，修像初次见: Hugh showed up in front of the adventurer again to bid his farewell. Hugh saw God. Just like when they first met, Hugh asked for water from the adventurer to drink and promised their friendship will last just like the water...
贝姨对自己花100zeny领来的波斯猫皮皮喜爱有加，并向冒险者大加夸耀。但由于有: Bette was very fond of the Persian Cat Pipi she had purchased with 100 zeny and showed off to the Adventure. Due to her work, she had to request the Adventure to send Pipi to Berenie for care.
皮皮走丢，贝姨对此非常生气。贝鲁妮向金求助，金说用土拨鼠的毛做毛线球可以找回皮皮: Pipi went missing and Bette was very mad. Berenie sought help from Kim, who suggested too make a fur ball with Martin's hair to find Pipi. Pipi was found thanks to the adventurer's painstaking effort.
贝鲁妮说皮皮非波斯猫的言论让贝姨很不爽，于是贝姨让冒险者去找鞋匠希尔鉴定。鉴定后: Berenie doubted Pipi was a Persian Cat and Bette was pissed. She sent the adventurer to verify this with the Shoemaker Hill. After some test, Pipi was indeed not a Persian Cat. Bette was outrageous. She ordered the adventurer to throw Pipi away.
皮皮找了回来，可是贝姨坚决不要。贝姨找了一户富人家要把它高价卖掉。识货的买主认出: Pipi was found but Bette insisted on sending it away. Bette found a wealthy family and planned to sell it at a high price. The knowledgable buyer recognized Pipi was a Persian tiger not a cat. Bette was dumbfounded...
一个叫孟菲斯·凯撒的青年总是称自己只是个守卫，冒险者接下他的委托，去摘花给他。: A youth Memphis Caesar often claimed himself to be a Guard. The adventurer accepted his request to pick flowers.
凯撒又碰到了冒险者，他自嘲自己的委托最无聊。并要修改任务委托。: Caesar met the adventurer and joked that his request must be the most boring. He demanded to adjust the request.
冒险者再次接下凯撒的委托，他让冒险者帮自己找到黑市商人，并帮自己拿份东西。冒险者: The adventurer received another request from Caesar. He needed a Black Market Merchant to be found and something to be taken. The adventurer got the required item and handed it over to him. Caesar began to tell a story, only to leave the most of it for the next time...
和上次一样，孟菲斯·凯撒让冒险者帮忙从黑市商人手里拿点东西。: Just like last time, Memphis Caesar needed the adventurer to take something from a Black Market Merchant.
黑市商给冒险者一份凯撒留下的东西，冒险者打开后看到了凯撒的回忆，他似乎是为了某个: The Black Market Merchant gave the adventurer an item Caesar had left. The adventurer opened it and saw Caesar's memory of breaking into the enemy camp for someone where he encountered Gerald's inducing to capitulate
冒险者遇到了一个失忆的青年，他正是凯撒。凯撒陷入了混乱，不断念叨着“爱葛妮斯”的: The adventurer bumped into a young man who had lost his memory and he was none other than Caesar. Caesar was confused, crying the name Agnes. With the adventurer's help, he painfully remembered everything...
梅尔区的孤儿院发生火灾，金和冒险者赶去救里面的孩子们。所幸最终孩子们平安无事。: Fire broke out in an Orphanage in Merl. Kim and the adventurer rushed to those children's rescue. Luckily, the children were all safe in the end.
救完人后，金和冒险者努力灭火，最终成功控制住了火势的蔓延。: After the rescue mission, Kim and the adventurer made efforts to kill the fire. Eventually, the spread of fire came under control.
金表示要彻查对自己长大的孤儿院下毒手的凶手。冒险者从她口中得知孤儿院的悲惨境遇，: Kim swore that he would dig out the person responsible for this disaster in the Orphanage he had grown up. The adventurer learned about the horrible situation in the Orphanage. He set out to question the fake philanthropist Kenting. Kenting seemed totally unaware of the fire...
金提议回到案发现场查找线索。迹象表明是纵火案，冒险者发现了一枚蝴蝶发卡，于是带回: Kim suggested to return to the fire scene to search for leads. It appeared to be an arson case. The adventurer discovered a Butterfly Hairpin and brought it back to Kim.
蝴蝶发卡是不会说话的孤儿劳拉的，金让冒险者去采一些劳拉喜欢的花，想和劳拉沟通一下: The Butterfly Hairpin belonged to a mute orphan named Lara. Kim sent the adventurer to pick some of her favorite flowers and tried to communicate with her.At
金未能和劳拉成功沟通，于是让冒险者去。在冒险者的努力下，劳拉打开了一点心扉。这时: Kim failed to communicate with Lara. The adventurer was then put on the same mission. The adventurer tried hard and managed to open Lara's heart. At that moment, nun Nancy took Lara away to eat.
上次带走劳拉的修女南希引起了金的怀疑，于是金和冒险者要变装为修女，为此他们去裁缝: Kim grew suspicious of Nancy, the nun who took Lara away the last time. Kim and the adventurer decided to disguise themselves as nuns. They visited the tailor shop for a nun wear.
金要接着调查商人胡安，却被杰拉尔老师劝阻。杰拉尔老师说胡安做的是通过纵火趁乱劫走: Kim intended to look further into the merchant Juan but was stopped by his teacher Gerald. Teacher Gerald said Juan set the fire so he could take the orphans which would then be sold to other countries for labor. He reminded Kim and the adventurer to take pictures of evidence.
金和冒险者去救劳拉，危机之下劳拉开口叫冒险者名字。冒险者打败南希救出劳拉后，杰拉: Kim and the adventurer set out to Lara's rescue. Under the pressing crisis, Lara cried out the adventurer's name. The adventurer defeated Nancy and saved Lara. Gerald revealed Kim's background. Kim expressed his readiness to adopt Lara. Kim left with the adventurer.
一个自称卡利麦罗的失忆男子在梅尔区被一群保镖样的人拦住，冒险者上前解围，得到卡利: A man named Calimero lost his memory and was stopped by a group of guards in Merl. The adventurer went up to help him and became a friend of his.
卡利麦罗在梅尔区并不受待见，冒险者询问后得知，原因在于卡利麦罗身上的衣服。冒险者: Calimero was not popular in Merl. The adventurer found out the problem lay in his clothes. The adventurer helped change Calimero's clothes. Calimero felt much better after the change.
卡利麦罗让冒险者和自己一起去面试火车修理工，在成功解决荆棘后，卡利麦罗获得了这份: Calimero invited the adventurer to attend the interview for a train repairman position. After taking care of the Thorns, Calimero got the job. However, his true intention was to approach Reena...
卡利麦罗因为从小娇生惯养，工作干不好，还嫌弃芮娜做的饭，惹得芮娜很生气。在与冒险: Very much spoiled growing up, Calimero couldn't do well at work and often complained about Reena's cooking. Reena was upset. After reflecting on himself with the adventurer, he cheered up.
卡利麦罗向冒险者自白，自己没失忆，是大财团的少爷，为如何得到芮娜的心而苦恼。冒险: Calimero confessed to the adventurer that he didn't lose his memory. His family was in charge of a large financial group. He was troubled by how to win Reena's heart. The adventurer suggested cooking her a meal. Under the adventurer's guide, Calimero cooked a meal for Reena.
卡利麦罗的料理得到芮娜的赞赏，但是她要求卡利麦罗独当一面后再找她。卡利麦罗为证明: Calimero's food was praised by Reena. She told Calimero to come back when he could handle things on his own. To prove himself, Calimero challenged a monster all by himself. The adventurer set out to his rescue. After the rescue, he sent the adventurer to deliver a letter to Reena.
卡利麦罗面对现实不得不低头，表示要回去了。这时芮娜出现，表示早就知道他的身份，冒: Calimero had to give in to reality. He decided to go back. Reena showed up and revealed that she was aware of his identity all along. The adventurer gave her the letter. Calimero would give up his wealthy life to be with Reena.
明星玛德琳在公告板上发求助告示，冒险者应此而来。求助内容是调查跟踪狂，调查后锁定: Celebrity Madeleine made a post for help on the noticeboard. The adventurer went. She needed help to track down a stalker. After some investigation, the stalker was Rudolf. Rudolf claimed he was hired by someone to take pictures of Madeleine.
玛德琳找到冒险者，说路德夫的幕后主使可能是前男友希尔法——自己是梅尔区出身，怕婚: Madeleine came to the adventurer, accusing her ex-boyfriend Hilfa of being the man behind Rudolf. With a Merl background, she was afraid of losing her marriage opportunity. The adventurer visited Hilfa and took some picture for Madeleine. She noticed Hilfa had changed completely...
受玛德琳拜托，冒险者取去回路德夫收集的关于她身份的证据箱，却碰上了杰拉尔的阻挠，: On Madeleine's behalf, the adventurer set out to take back the box of evidence about her identity from Rudolf. It was not successful due to Gerald standing in the way...
未婚夫卡罗尔向玛德琳提出需要签订契约才能结婚，要求玛德琳把所有财产交给卡罗尔，玛: Madeleine was requested by her fiancée Carol to sign a contract before their marriage, stating all of Madeleine's belongings were to given to Carol. Madeleine agreed. She asked the adventurer to collect Magic Star Stones for decoration.
婚礼当天，杰拉尔爆出玛德琳的身份，并表示她身无分文。这时候玛德琳才知道之前的契约: On their wedding day, Gerald revealed Madeleine's identity and claimed that she had nothing. Madeleine realized the contract was a trap. The wedding was canceled. Madeleine with nothing left felt devastated.
希尔法担心玛德琳，于是找到冒险者，希望冒险者帮忙找找她。冒险者最终在梅尔区找到了: Hilfa was very concerned about Madeleine. He called on the adventurer, requesting him to help look for her. The adventurer eventually found Madeleine in Merl. Hilfa told Madeleine that he would wait for her forever.
希尔法并未对玛德琳死心，但是他卑微的言行让冒险者火大。于是冒险者打了他，让他重振: Hilfa still wouldn't leave Madeleine alone. His nasty behavior enraged the adventurer. The adventurer punched him and wanted him to buck up. Hilfa asked the adventurer to pick a bundle of Forget-Me-Not.
金找到冒险者，表示自己调查了那个卡罗尔。金将资料交给冒险者，但杰拉尔将文件损毁了: Kim visited the adventurer and told him that he had investigated that Carol. Kim handed some information over to the adventurer but Gerald destroyed it. Kim and the adventurer managed to retrieve some Document Shards and found out that Carol was a swindler...
玛德琳也觉得可疑，她让冒险者调查卡罗尔，冒险者偷听后得知他明知玛德琳的身份，结婚: Madeleine was also suspicious. She requested the adventurer to investigate Carol. The adventurer overheard that he was long aware of Madeleine's background and planned the wedding solely for her money.
玛德琳向卡罗尔复仇。卡罗尔遇险。冒险者救下他后逼他把钱还给玛德琳。玛德琳和希尔法: Madeleine took revenge on Carol. Carol met with a mishap. The adventurer saved him and forced him to return Madeleine's belongings. Madeleine and Hilfa got back together. She became the sweet Lian once again and returned to Merl.
莱特·托纳拜托冒险者帮忙找他妹妹丢失的鞋，运动会就要到了。冒险者找到了一只破旧的: Wright Toner requested the adventurer to look for his sister's missing shoe. The Sports Day was around the corner. The adventurer found an old shoe, in a very bad condition.
莱特·托纳拜托冒险者送货到梅尔区飞空艇。: Wright Toner asked the adventurer to deliver some goods to an Airship in Merl.
冒险者和金帮莱特·托纳去获得获得能源的工作。: The adventurer and Kim helped Wright Toner get the job that could earn him some energy.
莱特·托纳接到修理城外升降机的工作，冒险者和金一起帮他完成。: Wright Toner was tasked with the repair of an elevator outside of town. The adventurer and Kim helped him with the job.
莱特·托纳领了薪水，让冒险者去贝勒区帮妹妹买鞋，结果薪水根本不够，没买到。: Wright Toner got his pay check and requested the adventurer to buy a pair of shoes for his sister from Baylor. The money was far from enough for a pair of shoes.
莱特·托纳很自责，他拜托冒险者去陪妹妹露琪亚。懂事的露琪亚虽然伤心哭了，但是请求: Wright Toner felt awful. He requested the adventurer to keep his sister Lucia company. Sensible and understanding, Lucia shed tears but begged the adventurer to not let her brother know.
冒险者继续陪着露琪亚玩，这时候金过来说莱特·托纳继承了一位老主顾的遗产，有钱给妹: The Adventure stayed to play with Lucia. Kim came over and told the adventurer that Wright Toner had inherited an old client's money, more than enough for his sister's shoes.
苏拉告诉冒险者曾经的怪盗绮罗的伟大，并表示自己也想做绮罗。为此苏拉让冒险者帮忙去: Sula told the adventurer stories of the Phantom Thief Chiro and remarked that she would love to be Chiro. For this, Sula asked the adventurer to help gather the Phantom Thief's gear. The adventurer found it on the black market.
苏拉说又要入侵老帕特大宅，目标是一块名贵绿宝石。苏拉让冒险者在外面望风，自己则进: Sula planned to break into Old Pat's Mansion for a precious emerald. Sula asked the adventurer to keep watch outside and she would enter to replace the gem with a fake one. When she got caught, Sula gave her name on purpose in hopes of becoming famous.
冒险者担心苏拉，于是去找他。苏拉让冒险者带自己去原野看风车，并回忆起自己儿时和父: The adventurer was concerned about Sula. He set out to look for her. Sula asked the adventurer to take him to the field to see the Windmill and recalled how he had a picnic with his parents when he was little. Sula asked the adventurer to take a picture of her while murmuring to herself...
苏拉准备入侵雷根贝勒研究所，冒险者劝阻，苏拉却不听，执意闯入了研究所，却被打伤。: Sula attempted to invade the Rekenber Laboratory. The adventurer tried to talk him out of this but failed. Sula entered the Laboratory but got injured. The real Phantom Thief Chiro showed up and saved Sula.
冒险者调查后发现苏拉的爸爸莫罗就是真正的怪盗绮罗，但莫罗不承认。最终莫罗承认了。: The adventurer found out Sula's father Moreau was the real Phantom Thief Chiro but Moreau denied. In the end, Moreau admitted. He explained he owed his wife and daughter a lot and wanted his daughter to live a safe life...
杰拉尔代人包围了苏拉家，莫罗站出来并被抓走了。为了救爸爸，苏拉表示要努力修行称为: Gerald led a group of men and surrounded Sula's house. Moreau went out and got captured. To save her father, Sula was determined to train harder to become Chiro the Second...
冒险者来到鹿丹报社，记者内森让他去拍演员玛德琳约会的照片，发现对方是帕特。: The adventurer went to Loudenne Newspaper. Reporter Nathan asked him to take pictures of the actress Madeleine's date. The secret lover was Pat.
热爱八卦的内森让冒险者去拍帕特女儿莫妮卡的照片，并让冒险者探查莫妮卡去梅尔区的内: Very interested in gossips, Nathan asked the adventurer to take pictures of Pat's daughter Monica and find out the reason for her visit to Merl. The adventurer discovered that Monica was in love with a poor man in Merl.
内森让冒险者去拍钢琴家麦克拉夫人的照片，发现麦克拉夫妻二人一起入住了酒店。他们都: Nathan asked the adventurer to take pictures of the Pianist Mrs. McKellar. The adventurer discovered that Mr. and Mrs. McKellar checked in a hotel together. They were both famous.
内森让冒险者去拍雷根贝勒公司开发的能源车。冒险者拍好后将照片交给内森。: Nathan asked the adventurer to take pictures of the energy vehicle developed by Rekenber Corporation. The adventurers took the pictures and gave to Nathan.
内森发现雷根贝勒公司污染城内水源，于是让冒险者去拍公司水池的照片，但似乎并无大问: Nathan found Rekenber Corporation was polluting the city's water source. He sent the adventurer to take pictures of the company's pool. However, everything seemed normal. Nathan was confused...
内森再次查看照片后发现了可疑之处，于是让冒险者去查明真相。冒险者遇到了杰拉尔，杰: Nathan checked the pictures again and noticed something suspicious. He sent the adventurer to dig out the truth. The adventurer bumped into Gerald who threatened him to hand over the pictures or Loudenne Newspaper would be shut down.
面对雷根贝勒公司的威逼利诱，内森要做出抉择，等待着他的是两个结局：一个是他变成修: In the face of Rekenber Corporation's threat and bribe, Nathan needed to make a decision. 106522: Nordwin is a scholar who studies time. He used the imprint in the black witch to form a theory of time: Eternal Dimension. According to the Eternal Dimension theory, humans can use magic to see the future, and perhaps change the past. However on the day of completing his theory, Nordwin saw a scene of complete annihilation. The world would be engulfed in darkness, everything we once knew would become nothing. When Nordwin woke up, in his hand was a roulette. The roulette was glowing, but no matter how Nordwin tried, it would not open. A mysterious voice spoke: "When the future you saw arrives, the Time Roulette will open again..."
106523: The clock guard leader Mosman Time granted the adventurers with awards, rewarding them for their contribution to Al De Baran in the giant snake situation. Al De Baran hosted a grand wedding. The groom is the assistant of the clock guard leader Mosman Time. The adventurers were invited to join this romantic wedding. During the wedding, the groom was poisoned to death. This tragic wedding revealed the plot of the snake Jörmungandr, involving events of the gods from thousands of years ago. The giant wolf Fenril, because of Freyra's deception, was locked on the moon. After Ragnarok, the power of the gods was severely weakened, along with the seal on Fenril. Fenril's younger brother, Jörmungandr, hoped to build a bridge to the moon to save him. But Jörmungandr was wounded in Ragnarok. The gods were only weakened a small fraction. By chance, he discovered the golden clock tower of Al De Baran contained massive power, comparable to that of the giant Yimir. He hid himself in the clock tower, waiting for the right chance. Until one day, a young merchant called Norman appeared at the clock tower, rambling about how he wanted to help Nosman. This noise interrupted his sleep, as well as gave him his chance. He gave Norman a fake memory, letting Norman believe he had a younger brother called Reed, and transformed into a human appearance, acting as Norman's brother. This allowed him to sneak inside the clock guards. He used Norman's trust in him to search for information on the golden clock, eventually leading the clock guardians into rebellion, and summoning the Ancient Baphomet to kill Mosman Time. Unexpectedly, he could not control the summoned monster -- Ancient Baphomet. Instead, it wanted to devour him. In the crisis, Norman risked his own life to save Jörmungandr, severely wounding himself. Jörmungandr was touched by Norman's act. He was always disregarded by the gods, and his ever-important brother was locked away on the moon. No one ever took him seriously. For Norman, Jörmungandr worked together with the humans to defeat the Ancient Baphomet and sent it back to where it came from. Sadly, Norman's injuries were to heavy, and he did not last long before passing away. Jörmungandr was overwhelmed in guilt. He started to wonder if using the golden clock tower to build the bridge was the right move. The development of events did not give him much time to consider his actions in the clock tower, which created a black hole in this already precarious space. A Jörmungandr from another world traveled through the black hole here. In that world, "Jörmungandr" did not choose to build the bridge and save his brother, but selfishly consumed the golden clock's power for himself. The Jörmungandr from the other timeline lost all rational thought, and became a power-hungry monster. He called himself "Recurrent Nightmare", wandering around in different worlds, consuming everything that possessed power. Recurrent Nightmare used the accidental black hole by Jörmungandr to enter this world. He sneered at the adventurers of this world, and the emotional Jörmungandr. Jörmungandr felt lost looking at the different form of himself. He realized that without Norman, he might become this type of monster. He decided to help humans defeat the form of himself from another world. With the help of Jörmungandr, the adventurers defeated Recurrent Nightmare, sending him back into the black hole and sealing it. When the dust had settled, Jörmungandr followed his promise with Norman and abandoned the plan to use the clock tower. He left Al De Baran on a new journey, in search of a new way to save his brother. All heroic adventurers from this battle were granted a Clock Guard Medal, to commemorate the crisis at Al De Baran.

106536: A necklace crafted by the best dwarf jeweler in the request of the Mages Guild for the adventurers who had made outstanding contributions in the War of Glast Heim and to commemorate the war. This was a war with disparity in strength. The enemies faced by the mankind were the cold and ruthless gods above the clouds. Himmelmez, Freya's envoy, led the Hand of Goddess to summon the Dark Lord, intending to destroy the human land. The mankind had always been ants comparing to the gods, Also been a source of their power of belief. The humans were fuels, Ashes and dolls that were obedient to the gods, and humble bugs that could be sacrificed at any time. This was a war without retreat. Glast Heim was full of monsters and fog. It is the home of human prosperity. There were children, flowers, aged wines that were stored under the old castle, promises between couples and lives of brothers. The fate of mankind was in the hands of a young Mage called Laurell Weinder. Laurell Weinder was not a big man, just an ordinary boy who was born in Izlude. He had a mother who loved him, a sweetheart he loved secretly, a small dream of being a Archmage. He was used by the Hand of Goddess. They stripped his soul and gave it to the Dark Lord as a sacrifice so that this cruel and tyrannical demon lord would come to earth and trample on the dignity of mankind. For this noteless Mage, to guard the truth and eternal love, and for the dignity and freedom of mankind, adventurers from all over the land united and stood before the sinful monster, although they were shuddering. This was a war the they must win. The adventurers risked their soul being crushed, they shuttled through Laurell Weinder's spiritual world to appease his restless soul. This ordinary Mage also showed his tenacity. Although his soul was imprisoned by the Dark Lord, he still tenaciously resisted. As adventurers struggling to hold, two selfless warlocks, Reyen and Morgan, poured the magic of their whole body into Laurell Weinder's soul, helping him to break free from the chains of the Dark Lord. This soul, which was treated as a joke by classmates and teachers, sacrificed like an animal by the goddess's henchman and tortured to being split, burst forth an amazing light. This splendid light even made the Dark Lord trembled. This turmoil also attracted the attention of Valkyries. Her Einherjar, the Black Army, joined the war. With the help of the Einherjar, mankind defeated the unbeatable enemy - the Dark Lord, and sealed it in the abyss of hell and completely shattered Himmelmez's plot. This necklace, known as Soul Peace, was to commemorate this great guarding war, for the staff that was burned in Geffen, for the broken arrows in Payon, for the shattered blades in Prontera, for the warriors who lost lives in this war and to calm the anger of these souls. Hoped that all human beings would always remember this history and wouldn't forget the feats of mankind even hundreds of years later.

Mimos' Robe is a symbol of honor and valor, as well as the strength to never give in even in the face of adversity. The girls put on the Robe, awaiting the battle of darkness to come.
106676: People pursuing the Flamingo's Tear, people having Flamingo Dream, do you know immortality is a bliss or curse? Take out this bottle of Flamingo's Tear when you are confused. Look at it, and recall the real images you have seen. After all, only in a limited life that the things you have done, the people you have seen are unique, worth of remembering forever.
106678: Two hundred years ago, the little fox who left the celestial mountain was travelling in the land. It associated with Ida Chin, the witch of the Kingdom of Heavenly Water, because of a piece of sakura cake. The aura of the little fox attracted the curiosity of the Ida house. After their exploration, they discovered that the little fox was a celestial fox. The Ida house hoped to bind the soul of the little fox to the Ida house and make it the shikigami of the Ida house. While as a friend of the little fox, Ida Chin didn't allow the house to do so. For the freedom of the little fox, Ida Chin sacrificed her life. However, the little fox who lost its body could not return to the celestial mountain. In order to find his own little fox, the god of the celestial mountain came to the Kingdom of Heavenly Water from a distant place, and finally found the fox with the help of adventurers. The god used the magic to resurrect the little fox, but this action violated the rules of the celestial mountain. He lost his qualification and could not return to the celestial mountain. He chose to accompany his fox and travel around the land.
106682: 25 years ago, a deadly plague broke out in a village in Einbroch. At the same time, Ian Green, the Executive Secretary of Rekenber Corporation, disappeared mysteriously with a secret file. However, a bottle of antidote and mysterious note appeared at the Divine statue in the village later and the antidote kept the plague under control in short time. And later the suspected plague source was destroyed by Rekenber Corporation permanently. As to the disappeared Secretary Ian, some said he escaped to a foreign country with the secret file full of proof of his guilt; while others said he died in the forest due to plague. Reap what he sows.
106683: The sewer princess Sparly's pet spider Nini was taken by the Rekenber Corporation who came to study monster crystals in the sewer many years ago. Due to an accident during an experiment, the little spider Nini's body underwent mutation. Under the code name Ola Kney, she was forgotten in the abandoned tunnel. Many years later, she became a giant monster with eight feet. Thanks to Sleepa and Benster's help, she was settled in a sewer tunnel in the end and became a scenic spot, the Ola Kney Tunnel.
106686: In the mist of the Forest of Mist, the young Emily was wearing a wedding gown, waiting for her fateful wedding. She had lost her memory, and forgot who was her groom. Two young men appeared before her, both claiming to be Emily's groom. Emily did not know who to choose... Who was the one lying? Can Emily see through the fog and find her true groom?
106688: In the peaceful Halloween Town, strange murders were repeatedly happening. The scenes of these cases all had evidence that closely involved Pena the Witch. Pena the Witch and her black cat were sentenced to be burned by the villagers. What was the truth behind the matter? Was Pena the Witch really innocent? The Witch and her cat will meet their fate under the silver moon...
106689: Bells on the Christmas tree of Gingerbread City, with a crisp sound, the favorite souvenir of tourists to Gingerbread City. Children are missing in the city, adventurers accepted Santa Claus' request to find out the truth, the suspect is the circus clown, Gal. Adventurers followed little girl Jenny to watch Gale's show. Jenny was impressed by the clown's performance. She treated Gale with a candy made by her parents. Unexpectedly, Gale ate candy and shed tears of excitement. It turned out that Gal knew Jenny's grandmother Betty. Decades ago, when they were young, Betty and Gal agreed to meet in Gingerbread City every year. Betty would give Gal her favorite candy, and Gale would bring Betty a well-prepared show. Then, because of the plot of the puppet wizard Biyu, Betty's family bankrupted, Her parents died in an accident, she had no energy to to meet Gale again. So Gale, Deceived by Bijou , Lost his soul in the long waiting time. A few decades later, Betty' s daughter, Jenny, Gave his a candy that brushed his mind, and he recalled the appointment with Betty. But Gale mistook Jenny for Betty. He thought that his beloved girl finally found him, and happily invited Jenny to watch his best performance. Wonderful show kept going on on the Gingerbread City, Watching Jenny's smile, Gale found peace in heart. But this was part of Bijou's scheme, she plots to kidnap Jenny, Threatening Santa Claus to hand over Yimir Heart Shards. Through investigation and analysis, adventurers learned about Betty and Gale's story. With Betty's help, They found Jenny and other children, and crushed Bijou 's plan. And Gale, Seeing Betty, Recalled their agreement, Broke free from the control of Bijou and found his humanity back. In an auspicious light, Gale's soul was released, and Bijou was driven out of Gingerbread City. Whenever bells on the Christmas tree ring, adventurers always think of Betty and Gale, Thinking of the snow in Gingerbread City and the story about candy.

106693: The Ventriloquist Charlie was once the best performer in the Christmas Village. He was kind, highly skilled, and very popular among children. Ten years ago, it was the gem merchant Bellmore's daughter's birthday. He invited Charlie to perform ventriloquism. Unfortunately, Dan, Karl, Rick and Manson, these four uninvited guests broke into the party. They ransacked the rich merchant's house, and Dan killed Mr. Bellmore. Afterwards, as the robbers were afraid of being exposed, they decided to frame the ventriloquist Charlie. Due to the accusations from the four, poor Charlie was sentenced to death, and was executed the day before Christmas Eve. After Charlie's death, his Teddy Bears, angered by the injustice to their master, transformed into vengeful weapons, and endlessly attacked the people of Christmas Village.
106694: The totem altar in the Orc Village was disassembled over one night. The faith tinder was stolen and the heads of totem columns were buried underground. During the restoration of the Totem Altar, the dust-laden past was dug out. A long, long time ago, a plague stroke the Orc Village. Warrior Ferdinand solved the disaster with a pair of deer horn with spiritual force. The deer horn belonged to his dearest one. For the safety of the village, he harmed her. The person responsible for the damage of the totem altar was the young deer saved by Ferdinand many years ago who lost its horns to him and got injured badly. Everyone thought she returned to take revenge but all she wanted was an answer. The altar was eventually restored and she set out with her memories to pursue her warrior. "Ferdinand, I don't hate you anymore..."

At nightfall, the adventurer remembered his agreement with Hetty thus set out to Wish Square. Upon learning that the adventurer had agreed to help repair the Star Bridge, Hetty appeared very pleased. She told the player that they needed to visit the Magic Array at the sea of clouds to learn the Star Bridge's current condition. 
To sneak into the Sea of Azure Clouds, Hetty and the adventurer worked together on a Transformation Potion. However, something was wrong with the recipe. Hetty transformed into a Mimmy Monster after drinking the potion. A Spirit male named Philly stopped the pair. Possibly the chief of the Aurora Wings, he attempted to stop the suspicious pair from accessing the sea of clouds. As the adventurer fell into an awkward situation, High Priest Zanubia showed up. 
Zanubia spotted Hetty's disguise with ease and informed the pair that the repairing Magic Array was lacking magic, in need of a Snow Winged Bird's feather to stay stable. Hetty and the adventurer left for the Floating Star Rock in search of the feather. The adventurer entered another conflict with Philly and found out he was actually Hetty's elder brother. As misunderstanding between the pair grew, Hetty arrived and resolved their conflict. After, the adventurer successfully got the feather and returned to the sea of clouds with Hetty. 
Above the Sea of Azure Clouds, Zanubia praised their teamwork and tacit understanding. A moment later, the repairing Magic Array started shaking violently. A loud explosion sent off a puff of white smoke, followed by a mysterious Spirit in command of a group of Little Fairies invading the sea of clouds! To the adventurer's surprise, he was none other than the Silver Haired Youth Brandeis he had met before. The sea of clouds descended into chaos at once. Pixies and Little Fairies were at daggers drawn. Hetty and the adventurer confronted Brandeis. 
At Zanubia's command, Pixies entered battle against Little Fairies. When the two sides were in a deadlock, a strange purple magic suddenly filled the air. The entire sea of clouds was shrouded by a dense purple fog in no time. The next second an accident took place. Philly collapsed to the ground from his fight against the Little Fairies. More and more Pixies blacked out in the purple fog! Shock and panic swept across all present for a moment. Zanubia accused Brandeis of causing the accident. He escaped with the remaining Little Fairies after a failed attempt to deny and explain. 
Hetty was torn by her brother Philly and clansmen's loss of consciousness. She became determined to shoulder her responsibility as the saintess and dig out the truth. It was only a tip of the plot against the Pixies and the Star Bridge...

During the test, he got acquainted with a Little Fairy Shaman Vivita.

Brandeis told the adventurer that Pixies had been bound by their duty to defend the Star Bridge, with no freedom to explore the outside world. His determination moved the adventurer. They became partners.

In a moment of desperation, the adventurer accepted the important mission of bombing the Magic Array...

1101790:
When the adventurer met Hetty again, he was informed that the Pixies' sleeping illness didn't improve at all. They woke up but were no longer conscious, muddle-headed like the walking dead. Including Hetty's brother Philly. This gave the worn-out Hetty more anxiety. The adventurer went through what had happened and realized it was their destruction of the Manna Crystal that led to the mutation of the sleeping illness. And it was the highest priestess Zanubia who instructed them to do so. 
Zanubia couldn't be reached at the time. Hetty and the adventurer decided to visit the Time Garden again and find out the truth from Mimir. However, before they could ask anything, suddenly emerged purple butterflies took them away from the garden. Before the pair could realize, they arrived at the Birthplace of God, in front of Goddess Freya. 
After their conversation with Her Holiness, Hetty and the adventurer realized both the destruction of the Manna Crystal and the worsening of the sleeping illness were part of Goddess Freya's plan. She didn't care about the sick Pixies, watching them slowly approaching death. Faced by the angry couple, the goddess appeared rather joyful. She killed Philly before Hetty, which caused Hetty's heart to fall into the dark. 
With the great Sage Claire's help, the adventurer aroused Hetty's consciousness. Claire told them the goddess was responsible for all this and a big plot was brewing. The treasure in the prophecy must be retrieved to stop the tragedy. After, Claire died of the goddess's curse. 
Hetty was crushed by the death of her brother and master. Hetty was no longer that innocent, carefree little saintess. She shouldered hatred and responsibilities, determined to abandon her faith and confront the goddess she once adored and held dear...

After Cecelia's departure, the bracelet she had left gave off a brilliant shine. Brandeis and the adventurer followed the light and discovered a string. It was a part of the Laurel Lyre, a token of memory between Brandeis and his brother Calder. 
They solved the riddle in the bracelet and fixed the broken Laurel Lyre. Brandeis played a piece according to his memory and the pair entered a fraction of memory hidden in the lyre. Over there Brandeis saw Calder and himself in the past. Calder's final words soothed Brandeis's hidden scar left by his brother. At that very moment, Cecelia appeared. She had been cooperating with Mimir, luring the pair to this land of memory. 
Cecelia told them Goddess Freya was responsible for the death of Calder and the tragedy the Pixies were going through. To stop the goddess, they must find the treasure mentioned in Mimir's prophecy. After, Cecelia died in the goddess's curse. The death of his brother and Cecelia strengthened Brandeis's determination to fight against the goddess. The storm resulted from the Star Bridge is about to start...
