1102512: Little Bu, can you play on your own for a while? Brother has very important things to do.
1102515: That bridge looks so flashy, long and annoying! I don't understand why so many monsters want to get on it every single day. Do you know how many guard brothers have injured themselves?
1102516: ... [c][ffff00]Why do you have to guard that bridge[-][/c]?
1102517: (Sighing) ... Don't talk like that, little Bu.
1102518: (What the young man just said seemed to have touched the little boy's nerves. He stamped his feet and began sobbing.)
1102520: Woo... Wahhh! I'm no longer a child!
1102521: I know guarding that bridge is Pixies' deal with Gods...
1102522: (Taking a deep breath before yelling) But this deal... I...
1102528: Why... Why do we have to keep such a ridiculous deal? That bridge is trapping us in the Glorious Domain... I hate this! I want to see the world outside!
1102530: (Weeping) ... Big liar. You promised to spend every day with me...
1102531: (Weeping) Brother... Don't be the High Priest... Don't guard this bridge...
1102532: (Weeping) Please, let's leave this place together... Let's go see the world outside, okay?
1102533: (The purple-haired youth watched his baby brother wiping off his tears, eager to reach out to caress his head. But in the end, he didn't do anything but shook his head silently.)
1102535: Brother can't keep the promise to you.
1102536: I must lead the guards to protect the Star Bridge. This is more than just a deal, little Bu. [c][ffff00] This is a faith I will hold fast to for the rest of my life[-][/c].
1102537: You mean... You won't be there by my side like before any more?
1102538: (The little boy locked his eyes on his brother's, his tears running dry. That pair of eyes was telling him every single word his brother just said was the most earnest.)
1102539: ... If so, I won't stay in the Glorious Domain any longer.
1102540: You shut up! Don't talk like that...
1102541: Brother... No, High Priest Calder. You said I was no longer a kid. So I can make my own decision.
1102542: (Determined) [c][ffff00]I'm leaving[-][/c]. Be it the middle yard of Yggdrasil, the depths of the iron forest, or the gap of Ginunaga, I'm leaving this place!
1102543: Lord High Priest, you may be a coward who fears for the deal with Gods. You may spend the rest of your life dwelling at the crown with your clansmen.
1102545: This was a gift from you.
1102546: (Quietly) ... From now on, no more performing.
1102547: Idiot! Don't do it! You will regret!
1102548: I will throw these down the falls to feed Mimmy Monsters and Tendrilions. I don't ever want to see this lyre again!
1102549: ... Brother, there's no more promise between us.
1102550: (The boy quickly wiped his face, getting rid of all his tears and grievance. His eyes shone with new stars on fire.)
1102551: Pixies have wings, which can take us to the high sky.
1102552: The sky is free and so are we.
1102555: ... From now on, [c][ffff00]no one under heaven... Can change... My mind[-][/c].
1102556: (The young high priest looked at the end of the plain. In his eyes there was a faraway figure, the sun, the moon and the whole galaxy along with the rainbow of promise.)
1102558: Dear Brandeis. I know you might never be able to understand my decision no matter how hard I try to explain.
1102559: So I choose to tell you this from afar.
1102561: The Star Bridge is the only path to the divine realm. It's the hub of the nine worlds supported by Gods' power.
1102562: Every day, countless wicked monsters covet the Star Bridge. Some of them attempt to reach the other side of it while others hope to destroy this link of sacred forces to turn the whole Nine Worlds upside down.
1102563: (Quietly) ... In other words, the safety of the entire world lies on the Star Bridge.
1102565: For hundreds of years, we Pixies have kept the deal with Gods, protecting the Star Bridge. For this, we have sacrificed our freedom and some of our clansmen's lives.
1102566: Brandeis, you were right. For this, we have sacrificed our freedom and some of our clansmen's lives.
1102567: ... You know all this but why...
1102568: (The young high priest looked into the distance. His eyes gazed through this Silver Haired Youth, tender yet distant, bright and extensive like this vast plain.)
1102569: Dear brother... If you could here this, I'm sure you would ask why I chose to stick to it knowing all this. Am I right?
1102570: Whoever guards the Star Bridge has to face sacrifices. This can't be avoided. [c][ffff00]Someone has to do it[-][/c].
1102571: I'm willing to be this man.
1102573: As long as the majority of the population in this world can live a tranquil and peaceful life, I'm willing to accept my fate and offer myself to this deal with Gods.
1102574: You are certainly one of the majority.
1102576: I can't leave with you but I will always be here guarding the freedom you long for so badly.
1102578: (The purple-haired Spirit lost in thoughts as if he could hear his little brother's call. A smile climbed on his face.)
1102579: Little Bu, go ahead to do all the things you want to do.
1102581: (Muttering) [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]... I'm the biggest idiot in this world.
1102583: All this time I saw my brother as a kind but cowardly man... I thought he didn't have the balls to violate the deal with Gods and felt content to be tied up to the crown.
1102584: ... I had no idea so much weight he had been shouldering.
1102585: Now I think I understand why he was so determined to guard the Star Bridge.
1102586: (Brandeis lowered his head, putting on a bitter smile. His nose was slightly red and his eyes glowed with shattered light.)
1102587: I was so naive believing all things in this world were either "I want" or "I don't want" and all I needed to do was to always choose the former.
1102588: But... Brother just taught me that there are things that [c][ffff00]we must do[-][/c].
1102589: Brother sacrificed so much so I could have this freedom.
1102590: (Covering his face) I want to do something for him. But now, I can't even say a word to him...
1102591: No, there are things you can do.
1102594: Since you made up your mind to pursue the truth behind Calder's death, I have decided to help you.
1102596: Huh. Always. At the very beginning, I left the Crystal Stone bracelet deliberately.
1102597: (The comet witch looked like a dead still water as if telling a common trifle.)
1102598: Brandeis, after watching this, can you understand Calder now?
1102599: ... Mmm. I was too extreme before.
1102600: (Cecelia looked at the Silver Haired Youth, her eyes hazy but warmer than usual.)
1102601: Good. I guess you have thought it through. Mimir and I didn't rack our brains in vain.
1102603: Mimir and I worked together to guide you here step by step. This is the only place relatively safe...
1102604: (Heaving a sigh) Now it's finally time for me to reveal the last secret to you.
1102606: The lost [c][ffff00]treasure[-][/c]. This is what I need to tell you.
1102607: ... The secret Calder asked me to keep with me to my death.
1102608: (After, a purple butterfly flew to Cecelia. Her face froze before she shook her head.)
1102609: Well... Just can't get away from it.
1102610: Brandeis, [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]. We don't have much time... What I'm about to say [c][ffff00]can't be repeated[-][/c].
1102611: The spirit high priest of each generation has been guarding one treasure. It is believed to grant one wish to the user however unrealistic it is.
1102612: However, the outside world became covetous of the treasure. For the treasure, the strongest ever enemy came to the Glorious Domain.
1102613: That's [c][ffff00]Freya[-][/c], the goddess of beauty and mercy.
1102615: ... Somehow Freya altered all Pixies' memory and painted her objectors Calder and Mimir as traitors.
1102616: To prevent the goddess from getting the treasure, Calder [c][ffff00]cut it into two[-][/c] at the last second. Mimir came up with a prophecy based on this.
1102617: The Night Star in his prophecy... Among all the Pixies, only one youth was born with a meteor.
1102618: It's you, [c][ffff00]Brandeis the child of stars[-][/c].
1102619: For some special reasons, I had to conceal my true stand before. Now, I don't have much time left.
1102620: (Gradually, more and more purple butterflies gathered around Cecelia. She looked at the pair with a smile of relief for the very first time.)
1102621: Don't forget what your brother said, Brandeis. [c][ffff00] When you get the treasure, you will find out the complete truth[-][/c].
1102622: [c][ffff00]Freya[-][/c]... All of this is her plan. I have said too much. I'll soon be punished for the taboo...
1102624: (Sighing) ... Calder... Finally... I can see you again...
1102625: (A violent magic wave swept across this space. I'm afraid it will soon collapse.)
1102628: She helped me untie the knot in my mind about my brother... She sacrificed her life to reveal the secret about the prophecy...
1102629: I will not fail her final words.
1102630: (The youth's wings were shaking and crumbling but his eyes solemn and determined. After witnessing death, he struggled to keep his head collected.)
1102633: [c][ffff00]Goddess Freya[-][/c]... It has become rather clear that she's the culprit of this whole tragedy. She came to the Glorious Domain for the secret treasure that had been split into two.
1102635: ... We must find the treasure before the goddess.
1102636: Finding the treasure is the only way to stop Freya and dig out the truth.
1102637: There are still many puzzles I can't solve. Such as the Manna Stone, the sleeping illness, and the man in black...
1102638: (Frowning) Besides, there's another very important point...
1102639: Why did my brother change his position so drastically fro guarding the Star Bridge to destroying it?
1102640: That's right. Hopefully once we find the secret treasure, we'll learn the cause of all this.
1102641: This is the only thing that we can do now.
1102642: ... Brother and Cecelia have left us for good but we must move on.
1102644: We will meet again at the right moment.
1102645: At the end of the memory, the comet vanished in a purple dream.
1102646: Among the half hidden truth, the rebellious star finally found his track.
1102650: You once said you wished to hear my music every time you returned from your shift guarding the Star Bridge.
1102651: ... That figure looks like my brother!
1102658: Brother... Don't you want to see me?
1102660: ... Damn it. The magic here is extremely unstable.
1102663: I got it! This is a world of memories.
1102665: Huh. That little boy was me in my childhood. This might be the last time I saw my brother.
1102666: (What are they talking? I can't understand anything...)
1102667: Those Monsters did it. The space has been destroyed... My old memory is no longer stable.
1102668: That's right. We need to stabilize this space and hopefully my memories will restore...
1102669: Looks like this space is under the influence of different elemental magic forces.

1102688: Let's go, [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c]. This memory... It's probably the last thing brother has left for me.

On his way searching for Hetty, the adventurer was attacked by a mysterious man in black and was nearly killed. At the Floating Star Rock, he found Hetty hidden in a barrier. She had been hiding from the goddess's watch. The adventurer was certain that man in black was also sent by the goddess. After a quick discussion, the pair decided to find the treasure before the goddess.
 Hetty's Sun Magic resonated magically with the treasure. They followed the lead all the way to Mercury Palace, where they found the treasure, the ring of truth that bore the Sun Mark. Once the pair touched the ring, they were sent back to Mercury Palace in the past. They watched a shocking scene: Freya cast a soul curse on the Great Sage and ordered Zanubia to abstract vitality from Sky Elves for the Rainbow Bridge's restoration. Hetty finally realized the sleeping illness was the result of the elves' vitality being drained. And the goddess was responsible for all of this. And the goddess did all this so the Rainbow Bridge could be repaired and she could return to gods' dwelling. Over there she would launch an even more dangerous plan... 
After leaving from the memory stored inside the ring, Hetty and the adventurer were confronted by Zanubia in an ambush. She came for the treasure. No match for the flourishing Zanubia, Hetty created a barrier at the Critical Moment. She entrusted the Ring of Truth into the adventurer's care and demanded him to find the other treasure so Freya's plot could be stopped. After, Hetty sent the adventurer to safety and stayed behind alone to face Zanubia's attack...
1124407:
On his way searching for Brandeis, the adventurer was attacked by a mysterious man in black and was nearly killed. Brandeis arrived just in time to save the adventurer. The pair sensed they were being watched by Goddess Freya. The man in black was also sent by her. After a quick discussion, Brandeis and the adventurer decided to set out right away to search for the treasure.
 Brandeis's Star Magic resonated magically with the treasure. The pair tracked all the way down to the Flowery Land, where they found the treasure, the Ring of Falsehood that bore the Star Mark. Once the pair touched the ring, they were sent back to Mercury Palace in the past. Over there, the pair witnessed a shocking truth: Calder was murdered by Freya and Zanubia. The power of his soul was used by the goddess as a spell to confine the Sky Elves. Since then, the Elves lost all their memories about Mimir and Calder. The goddess became their one and only faith. And the goddess did all this so the Rainbow Bridge could be repaired and she could return to gods' dwelling. Over there she would launch an even more dangerous plan... 
After leaving from the memory stored inside the Ring of Falsehood, Brandeis and the adventurer were confronted by Arcana who had feigned death before. She came for the treasure. No match for the flourishing Arcana, Brandeis created a barrier at the Critical Moment. He entrusted the Ring of Falsehood into the adventurer's care and demanded him to find the other treasure so Freya's plot could be stopped. After, Brandeis sent the adventurer to safety and stayed behind alone to face Arcana's attack...

The Rainbow Bridge would be fully restored soon and Goddess Freya would depart shortly after. The adventurer didn't have much time left. While searching for the other treasure, he was ambushed by the goddess. At the crucial moment, Mimir saved the adventurer. He created a space using the power of the shard of Ymir's Heart, where time and karma overlapped. This became the only place where the adventurer might retrieve the two treasures that were destined to never cross paths.
 The adventurer entered the karma tangled domain. The guardian of this place was named Laplace's Demon. It told the adventurer that only intense fetters could break through the law of time and space. The adventurer must comprehend the power of his bond to acquire the other half of the treasure and meet again the person he wanted to see. Right before the adventurer left the domain, he saw a figure identical to himself at the end of the space. By the time he regained his presence of mind, he was already at the Sea of Azure Clouds with the other half of the treasure in his hand.
 Before the adventurer could figure out what had happened, a violent shake occurred at the sea of clouds. Sky Elves and Pixies all fell to the ground. Brandeis and Hetty were severely wounded by the magic array. At that very moment, Zanubia revealed herself. She saw through the adventurer's intention to damage the Rainbow Bridge and launched a deadly attack at him. A familiar figure blocked the adventurer with his own body at the last second. Shocked and confused, the adventurer watched Zanubia absorb the last magic power to complete the restoration of the Rainbow Bridge.
 Goddess Freya slowly emerged above the sea of clouds in the radiance of the rainbow. She was still covetous of the treasure. Zanubia questioned the adventurer closely for the treasure's whereabouts. A final battle broke out between the two. At the crucial moment, the adventurer's power of bond helped him defeat the nearly invincible oracle. Knowing she had no chance of getting the treasure, the goddess abandoned Zanubia and took her leave via the Rainbow Bridge.
 Brandeis and Hetty didn't give up yet. Their determination aroused the treasure's power. Two rings merged into one in the sky and formed a massive barrier all the way around the Glorious Domain. Injured by this intense magic power, Freya fell from the clouds. To continue her incomplete plan, the goddess sacrificed Zanubia's life and soul and eventually broke the barrier. She left the Glorious Domain and disappeared at the end of the Rainbow Bridge.
 After Freya's departure, the Elves would slowly return to their normal life. Brandeis and Hetty would find their path for the future. The adventurer's journey in the Glorious Domain had also come to an end. Looking into a distance towards the other end of the clouds, he realized he would cross this Rainbow Bridge one day to once again face that beautiful yet evil goddess.

1. Each character may complete the Monster Research Institute 3 times a day. 
 2. The Dungeon consumes 30 minutes of the player's combat time every time.
 3. Going offline or exiting the Dungeon in the middle of the challenge will not result in any settlement reward or combat time deduction.
 4. The Dungeon lasts for 5 minutes. The more monsters a player can kill in the dungeon, the better reward he will receive at the settlement.
 5. Before entering the dungeon, players are required to select a reward type.
 6. For every monster a player kills in the Dungeon, 1 Investigation Point will be rewarded, which can be spent at the dungeon Merchant on purchasing Combat Items that will help the player to kill monsters faster.
 7. For Adventurers whose base level is below 80, the base EXP for clearing the Monster Research Institute EXP mode is tripled.
1134056:
1. Players may consume materials to upgrade structures. A structure's different dimensions have different buff effects. 
2. The Alert Gondola has Deep Exploration and High-efficiency Dispatch two dimensions to upgrade. It's also a critical facility for sending mates out. 
3. Deep Exploration can unlock more dispatch regions for different dispatch rewards. 
4. High-efficiency Dispatch can increase your mates' daily outing attempts. Match Deep Exploration with High-efficiency Dispatch for the best result. 
5. Each dispatch lasts for 5 hours, after which you may claim the dispatch reward. 
6. Choose the right mate and operation gear to slightly increase the dispatch reward. 
7. Some dispatch regions are unlocked through special Quests. Send your mates out to unlock special quests. 
8. While dispatching, your starred mates will earn additional materials from the region while starred gear, if equipped for your dispatched mate, has a chance of getting special items.

1135412: An amulet with Comodo characteristics. Often used to protect islanders on voyages. But for some reason it was abandoned on a beach southeast of Comodo...
1135413: The suicide letter left behind by Io's mother. It reveals the truths she concealed and confessions to her daughter. But why did she bury it in such a deserted place? It's puzzling... I'm afraid the rumors of her mental breakdown before her death are true.
1135414: A Nameless Manual buried in the underbrush on Comodo. The pages are filled with strange doodles... And there are dark red smudge marks. Is it blood?
1135428: Defeated the Fantastic Dragon Galirentan in the museum hall
1135429: Defeated the Late King's Chess Knights in the Heritage Museum

1135435: Acquired orange juice for pumpkin growing
1135439: Unearthed a Painted Egg Filled with Candies!
1135499: A bird living on Comodo and its surrounding area, extremely intelligent. Most Beer Penguins live in groups on Kokomo Beach. Really good at making beer with fruits and grains, they have opened a brewery called the Penguin Workshop to carry forward their unique techniques. They sell their beer to Humans on the island of Comodo in exchange for living materials. Penguin Beer has become a local speciality. "So who can tell me how Penguins are living on a tropical island now?"
1135500: A mysterious creature that can be seen all over the Sweet Dream Field. Dressed up as a seal doll, it keeps many curious about how it really looks. "Stop it. I really am a seal. I promise!"
1135501: A sea creature living near Comodo in large clusters. It earned its name after the cracking sound from its claws. Crabs dwell on the seabed in the coastal waters but from time to time their elderly would end up on the beach and lose their bearing due to declined eyesight. These make a delicious meal for humans and other creatures alike. “What are you looking at? Never seen a Vadon walking straight before?”
1135502: Rogue Haz gathered the vagrant and marginal on Comodo and formed a gang called the Pretty Boys. These men without a legitimate profession seem to have their own ideas about fashion, resulting in their unique style. Strictly speaking, the Pretty Boys didn't do anything terrible but it's understandable if they get beat up simply for how they look!
1135503: A shellfish that can move on two legs. Its hard shell can resist most attacks. Some suspect a two-legged creature is dwelling inside the shell but it's not supported by any actual evidence. "Dangerous! Close the shell! Ah! Bit my tongue!"
1135504: A bird that dwells on the Fantasy Land but longs for the sky. Legend has it that every Nigel Bird would be pushed down from a high ground before reaching their adulthood. This brutal tradition supposed to force them to fly actually breaks their legs... "Study shows that Nigel Birds can't fly because their wings are unable to provide enough lifting force. In other words, they are too heavy."
1135505: The Crocodile Man is said to be a distant relative of the Dragon Race. Despite its ferocious looks, it actually has a very tender heart. Dressed in a striped shirt, it dreams to become a sailor and travels around the world. "In love with a big ship but there's no ocean on the Fantasy Land..."
1135506: A crustacean creature that dwells in the sea just off Comodo. The crown on its head and the pattern on its shell speak for its kingly status among the lobsters. Its powerful claws can easily crush stones. Living on the seabed all year round, it sometimes comes to the beach chasing the light. Well loved by people for its great taste. "As soon as I saw it, I knew exactly what seasonings to use!"
1135507: Originally a Crystal Ore on the Sweet Dream Field, it has come to life under the Fantastic Force's influence. Too ordinary to attract any attention, it‘s often troubled by its lack of the sense of existence. "Does this little fella like Konpeito?"
1135508: The legendary Sea Monster in Comodo folklore, crazy about sweet things. It got transferred to the Sweet Dream Field under the Book of Fantasy's influence and had enough candies for lives. Don't belittle it for its sweet tooth. It's actually an extremely dangerous creature. Its powerful tentacles can easily flip over a ship. It can easily smash rocks with a water column... "I'm also a fan of sweet food. I love food ingredients that don't need to be marinated before cooking..."
1135585: A tombstone that traps human souls.
1135587: The most devout servant of the Deceased Dark Lord, it has the ability to draw energy out of other extremely dark beings.
1135594: It moves downwards at intervals and becomes available for attack while moving. It will transform randomly into a rook, knight, bishop or the queen when it reaches the border. Only the king's Charge command can make it move. Deal a certain amount of damage to enemy units within one block every second.
1135595: Can move a random number of squares in a straight line horizonally, vertically or diagonally, dealing damage along the way. Deal a certain amount of DMG to enemy units within one block every second and cast an over-time debuff: unable to perform Auto Attack.
1135596: Can move a random number of squares in a straight line horizonally or vertically, dealing damage along the way. Deal a certain amount of DMG to enemy units within one block every second and cast an over-time debuff: slow hit and cast.

1135598: Move in the figure of the sun and deal damage along the way. Deal a certain amount of DMG to enemy units within one block every second and cast an over-time debuff: reduced max HP.
1135600: As the vanguard of the group, Joel possesses the skills of a knight and a hunter. Watch out for his bow and traps.
1135601: Pocarani plays a supporting role in the legion, specialized in priestess and sage skills. Watch out for her magic fields and dispels.
1135602: Nuka is the melee DPS of the group, skilled in both martial monk and rogue skills. Watch out for his Asura Phoenix Fist.
1135603: The magic attacker of the group, Camorra is proficient in both mage and alchemist skills. Watch out for her Hell Plant and Meteor Spell.
1135619: Not afraid of the cold and able to summon the snow blizzard, flexible and swift, the Seal Cub is answering the master's call.
1135620: The Nigel Bird is too fat to walk without a cane. But don't belittle this world class sniper.
1135621: A Penguin obsessed with beer for unknown reasons. Drunk all day every day, it will impress you with its combat power.
1135622: The fluffy Snow Beast provides a great sense of safety. In the face of any danger, bury your head in its fur and you'll be safe.
1135623: A refined, witty Flutist, one of the Adventurer's best travel buddies. He provides outstanding medical services and relieves you from boredom!
1135624: Pirate King has a very strong internal drive for excellence. For him, nothing is better than defeating a worthy rival.
1135626: A bird with a lot of dating experiences. It is believed to bring sweet love to its owner.
1135660: Comodo Group Instance Light Wall Obstacle
1135733: Dream City's 47th Sage, he has inherited the Dream Queen's Scepter and vowed to protect the Dream Citizens on her behalf. A bashful book worm, very capable but too modest to feel confident. As a child, he cried for three days in some flowering shrubs after mistaking himself as a monster because of his special appearance. He later found out he was a member of the extremely rare Pixie Race.
1135740: A bullied, excluded Comodo Girl with unusual pale skin too different from other islanders. She is considered an Ominous Child by many for her red eyes and black scales. But is it really the truth? Neula seems to be just a capricious, quick-tempered child with a heroine dream and a desire to shine. She has been helping defend Dream City from monsters using her flame... Hold on! What's this strength of hers? How could any ordinary child have such an aggressive Fantastic Force? And what is that dark light shining in her blood red eyes?
1135871: A treasury Asgard Gods created to award heroic men in the Era of the Gods. It has been opened once again, awaiting adventurers to win his rewards.
1135879: The head of the Comodo village, he's referred to as the Village Chief by the Islanders. For over 40 years as the chief, he has been working hard to develop Comodo and provide the Islanders a better life. He's well loved despite his mean tongue.
1135887: Village Chief Aloha's youngest son, passionate and kind. A history Scholar, he has an in-depth study of Comodo's history and folk custom and is currently working as the manager of Ponape Museum Island.
1135890: A Comodo Boatman. He takes passengers to and from Ponape.
1135893: The current leader of Comodo Warrior Legion, a man bright and hot like the sun.
1135895: This amiable looking grandma is actually the current Alsherjargod of Comodo, with fantastic attainments in Magic Potion and Divination.
1135971: Islander available for a photo together
1136196: The Proprietress of the Honey Tavern, a bartender well known across the Fantasy Land. Every visitor from outside the Book of Fantasy needs to try her cocktail Drunk Rhapsody. "Ahhh~ Do you want to know how your Fantastic Force looks? Take a sip of my drink and you'll see the colors of dreams!"
1136204: A well known bard in Dream City, he prefers to be called the Widely Learned. He travelled all over the Fantasy Land in his youth until he had to settle down after losing his leg on an adventure. "Yo! All my stories are real history! Not fabricated to be fancy!"
1136226: The chief of the Nutcracker Squad, a highly responsible officer. He's stationed on the main artery of Dream City all year round. If you don't have a good sense of direction, ask him for help~ "Emil from the Nutcracker Squad is happy to serve you!"

1139176:
The Adventurer woke up in Fantasy Land, a world inside the book. Sage Cenass gave the Adventurer a brief introduction and arranged him to join the Rose Drama Club‘s rehearsal. Through a script, the Adventurer learned about the Black Devil's presence. This monster damaged Fantasy Land, resulting in the Book of Fantasy's anomaly.
 While the Adventurer was chatting with Cenass a black devil suddenly attacked the city. The Adventurer helped rescue the residents but mistook a girl with black hair and red eyes as a devil in disguise. The pair fought side by side after the misunderstanding was clear but the girl held grudge towards the Adventurer. The duo parted in discord. After, the Adventurer learned from Cenass that the girl was called Neula, also a resident of Comodo.
 The Adventurer tried to make peace with Neula, during which he learned more about her that she had been deemed as an Ominous Child and bullied by other islanders for her unusual appearance. She hated those who deemed her bad and longed for approval and affection.
 With unremitting efforts, the Adventurer eventually managed to resolve Neula's grievance. The two became friends. By chance, they located the devils' den and discovered a woman in white under confinement. Neula identified the woman as an important guardian of Fantasy Land. After a bloody battle, the pair defeated the devils on guard and rescued her.
 The Guardian claimed to be Mist and mentioned things relating to a Witch and some seal. The Adventurer discussed with Cenass and figured out the full story. The prime culprit of this riot was a powerful evil spirit Witch of Calamity. She wanted to break free from the decaying seal and ordered her lackeys to do evil.
 To defend the peace of Fantasy Land, the Adventurer asked Mist for help. Mist told them a girl in the prophecy was the only way to repair the seal and stop the Witch. Neula was pleasantly surprised to find out how similar she was to the girl in the prophecy. After, she passed Mist's test thus further proved her identity as the savior.
 Mist led the party into the forbidden zone, escorting Neula to the seal. Along the way, they were accused as wicked beings and met resistance from various Living Beings. Unusual traces and Mist's increasingly odd attitude clouded this salvation journey with suspicion and misgivings... But Neula had already lost herself to vanity. She longed to become a savior, adored and praised by all.
 Finally, the party reached the seal. Neula offered her power, which Mist poured into the seal. After a loud bang, the seal was completely destroyed. The witch's power broke through the seal and penetrated Mist's body. She was never a guardian but a clown of the Witch of Calamity that had escaped the seal. The Witch laughed at the exploited people and called Neula an offering before attempting to devour her. The Adventurer waged a desperate struggle. Cenass snatched an opportunity to teleport the trio back to the fairy tale kingdom.
 Very much ashamed, Neula blamed herself and escaped to the world outside of the book in tears. Cenass had to lead the Fantasy Land in resisting the Reviving Calamity. The Adventurer was puzzled by the connection between the Witch of Calamity and Neula. The answer lay somewhere on Comodo...

I Dungeon Rules 
1. Participation Rules 
Matches are organized in a 6v6 group confrontation system. Players must be at Lv. 90 or above to participate. A team must have 6 members to take part in the competition. 
 2. Victory Conditions 
*Two teams compete with each other in collecting resources in the dungeon. The team that reaches 4,000 points first wins immediately 
*The dungeon lasts for 10 minutes 
*If neither team could reach 4,000 points by the end of the 10 minutes, the one with a higher score wins. 
 Leaderboard Rules: 
Players are ranked by their personal score from high to low. In case multiple players have the same score, the one that reaches this score first ranks higher. If a same score is reached at the same time by more than one player, the one with a higher score from the last round ranks higher.
 3. Magic Prison and Samsara Temple 
Elemental Orb 
*Elemental Balls of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind will be released at the 4 corners of the dungeon 30 seconds into the match. Players holding an elemental ball earn Victory Points every 2 seconds 
*Each player can hold up to 1 elemental ball at a time. When 1-4 players of the same team have orbs, the team gains 10, 20, 25 or 30 points respectively every 2 seconds 
*Orb bearing players are subject to a Vulnerable debuff. Each layer of the effect increases damage received by these players by 5%. The longer one holds the orb, the more layers of the Vulnerable debuff will stack 
*Orb bearing players under the orb's influence will gradually lose control, unable to stealth or speed up while holding an orb. A CD will also be imposed on their skills 
*2 elemental orbs can be combined to summon magical effects to weaken the opposing team. Available combinations include: 
Fire + Water: [Elemental Barrier] Reduces the enemy's attack and spell casting range by 30%. Orb bearing players' attack and spell casting range are reduced by 40% 
Fire + Earth: [Lava Path] The enemy orb bearing players will bleed by a certain percentage while moving. The faster they move, the more blood they lose 
Fire + Wind: [Soul Shackles] Approaching enemy players will be slowed down over time 
Water + Earth: [Mana Burn] Increases the enemy's skill SP Consumption by 200% and causes the enemy players to lose 1% of their Max Mana per second 
Water + Wind: [Mana Leak] Causes the enemy orb bearing players to cast ill effects on their teammates. [Water]: Silences all allies within a 5-meter radius. [Earth]: Petrifies all allies within a 5-meter radius. [Wind] Immobilizes all allies within a 5-meter radius, [Fire] Burns all allies within a 5-meter radius 
Wind + Earth: [Storm Mist] Drives the enemy into an irresistible Dark state for 1.5 seconds every 5 seconds. The enemy orb bearing players will be stuck in the dark state permanently 
*Combined magic has a 15-second CD. Switching orbs during this time will not affect the magic effect 
*If Team A has more than 2 orbs, the magic effects it has summoned will be removed. Then Team B can summon the corresponding magic via the [Dungeon Watchman] NPC to counterattack Team A 
*When an orb bearing player dies, the elemental orb will drop and the combined magic effect will be removed. The elemental orb will return to the altar on the map 
Buff Orb 
*A Buff Orb will be released in the center of the battlefield 1 minute into the match. After, another Buff Orb will be released every 30 seconds, which can only be taken by an orb bearing player to gain 150 Victory Points and a random buff 
*Buffs include: 
[Anti Invisibility] All allies can detect invisible units for 10 seconds 
[DMG Up] The buff orb bearer increases its damage to orb bearing players by 50% for 10 seconds 
[Accelerate] Orb bearing players may temporarily exceed their speed limit, boosting speed by 200% for 10 seconds 
Kill 
Earns 20 Victory Points for the team for each enemy player killed 
4. Reversi 
Map 
Consists of a 3*3 chessboard. Except for the one in the center, the other 8 pieces can be occupied by moving on them or following chess rules. The middle piece can only be taken following the chess rules. 
Chess Rules 
*The 4 pieces in the corners of the chessboard are medium occupation points. Occupy them to gain 4 points per second for your team. The 4 middle pieces on the sides of the board are small occupation points. Occupy them to gain 2 point per second for your team. The center of the chessboard is the large occupation point. Occupy it to gain 6 points for your team. 
*Defeat an enemy player to gain 1 point for your team. The team that reaches 4,000 points first wins. Or the team with a higher total score wins at the end of the dungeon time. 
*Special Rules: If a team has taken the two ends of a straight line on the board, the middle piece will be automatically occupied by the same team (i.e. three points on one line). A small occupation point seized by the Three Points on One Line rule won't change its occupation status when the line is broken. The large occupation point can be occupied via four straight lines. Once the piece on either end of one of the four lines is taken by the enemy team, the large occupation point will return to its previous status before being occupied by the rule.

1. Enhanced Refinement is divided into two types, weapons and accessories. It can provide adventurers some refine ATK bonus according to the equipped gear's refinement level. 
2. Each position has five tiers, namely elementary, intermediate, advanced, top, and ultimate, and each tier contains ten levels. Each level increases a certain amount of refine ATK bonus. 
3. When the equipped gear's refinement level meets the requirement, that level's refine ATK bonus begins to take effect. 
Elementary Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +1 or above 
Intermediate Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +5 or above 
Advanced Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +9 or above 
Top Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +13 or above 
Ultimate Tier: Effective when the equipped gear's refinement +13 or above 
4. Adventurers may choose to increase Refine ATK or Refine M. ATK at each level according to their own needs. 
5. The total refine ATK provided by Enhancement Refinement stays the same

Rules of use:
1. Turning on or off the Guild Voice Chat feature requires the Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster to grant permission. Only then may guild members use it. 
2. The Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster must edit the guild members privileges in the Edit Privileges button of the Guild Members interface. 
3. Privileges may be granted to a maximum of 9 people including the Guildmaster and the Vice Guildmaster. The default Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster of the founding guild have the privileges. 
4. The Guildmaster and Vice Guildmaster can remove the voice chat privileges of anybody, including themselves. 
5. The Guildmaster, Vice Guildmaster and any member with privileges can open a Guild Voice Channel. 
6. Members without privileges can enter this voice channel, but are unable to talk in it. 
7. Guild members who have been granted privileges will have a symbol over their name in the Member List. 
8. When a guild member’s position changes, if there are still available privileges remaining (less than 9 people), the privilege will be given to the Guildmaster or Vice Guildmaster by default; If there are no remaining privileges, the privilege will not be automatically granted and the Vice Guildmaster will have to claim it manually.

117557:
Novice Shop Item Description
1. Level Pack
After reaching the corresponding level and job change, players can buy Level Packs from the Novice Shop.
Level packs include T1 Level Pack, T2 Level Pack, and T2 Advance Level Pack. After buying the Level Pack item, use the pack items to directly upgrade your Base and Job level:
Use T1 Level Pack to upgrade your Base and Job level to T2.
Use T2 Level Pack to upgrade your Base and Job level to T2 Advanced.
Use T2 Advanced Level Pack to upgrade your Base and Job level to Peak level.
*Please use the items quickly after buying the Level Pack. If your level surpasses the corresponding level, the pack will expire.
2. Novice Order 
 Players with personal Gold Medal amount smaller than 450 will undergo Novice Order exchange at the Novice Shop.
Players can use MVP and Mini materials to exchange in the Novice Order. 1 MVP or Mini material can exchange for 1 Gold Medal + 200 Contribution.
Max Novice Order exchange limit is 25, and disappears after reaching the limit.
3. Kafra Order 
 Novice Shop provides Kafra Orders. After buying, players can exchange the corresponding Gold Medals and Contribution, and receive the bonus Gold Medal and Contribution.
There are three types of Kafra Orders:
Kafra Order·I: Players with less than 100 Gold Medals can purchase.
Kafra Order·II: Players with less than 200 Gold Medals can purchase.
Kafra Order·III: Players with less than 400 Gold Medals can purchase.
Note:
*Before buying Kafra Order, max Order exchange limit changes based on the player's personal Gold Medal amount. After buying, max Order exchange limit remains unchanged, but will deduct outer exchange amount (e.g. Guild Exchange).
*Order exchange amount does not stack. After purchasing one type of Order, players cannot purchase other types of Orders.

The job level carried over cannot exceed the main character’s Peak Level. If the main character hasn’t reached peak level, up to T2 Job 40 will be carried over. n3. If the secondary character shares the same job with the main characters, or is any of the T1 Job 40, the main character will receive Job Unlock Voucher for free which is used to unlock the secondary character’s 2 job branches.

After his departure from Comodo, the Adventurer once again received news on Neula: She in reality was once again disturbed by the Witch of Calamity, which led to her soul lost in an unknown space. Sacrifices were offered on the island and the Adventurer was sent to the Rift of Chaos where Neula was in. He encountered numerous hallucinations, through which he learned about Neula's painful past and crushed the Witch's plot to take her away by force.
    The rescued Neula returned to Dream City with the Adventurer. She expected resentment and disgust from others for freeing the Witch. But residents of Dream City showered her with care and understanding instead. Touched by their kindness, Neula decided to stop running and stay in Dream City to fight side by side with the residents. Cenass shared his latest discovery with the Adventurer: The late Dream Queen might have left a weapon against the Witch in the Darklight Forest.
1166374: However, at that moment, the Darklight Forest was under the Witch's Control. She had built up a fortress there, barring them from their only hope. To form a powerful team, the Adventurer and Neula sent draft orders to able beings in Dream City. There were ups and downs but in the end the pair completed the Quest. Rhona and Cliff one after another became the Adventurer's new comrades. A valiant, unified squad set out towards the Darklight Forest.
1166375: With their friends' assistance, the Adventurer and Neula breached the enemy's defense lines and pushed on towards the Time Tree Deep in the Forest. A strange mist separated them from the rest of the team. Dream Queen's remnant shadow emerged near the divine tree and revealed a treasure box where the Morning Star had been kept. It remained a myth how to use the morning star to defeat the witch.
1166376: The Adventurer returned to Dream City with the treasure box. The treasure box was opened and bright star light shot out, creating a fantastic realm. Everyone fell asleep except for Neula who was arguing and screaming her refusal... In the end, the bright morning star disappeared in Neula's body. However, there was no joy of a heroine on her face. Neula explained she didn't awaken any special power or learn how to defeat the Witch. She lost control and ran out of Dream City.
1166377:
The Adventurer caught up with her, trying to figure out what had happened to Neula but a loud bang came from the Dream City direction. A group of residents ran towards the Adventurer and Neula in a fluster and informed them of the Witch's invasion of Dream City to wipe out the potential threat Morning Star. The news devastated Neula. She ran to Dream City with some intention. The Adventurer followed closely behind, attempting to rescue the trapped residents.
    The once tranquil, beautiful city was then doomed to flames and death. The Adventurer gave all he had but some lives were lost forever. In the meantime, Cenass sacrificed himself in stopping the Witch and protecting the morning star's shine from evils... However, to everyone's surprise, Neula attacked Cenass from behind in the tangled battle and submitted to the Witch.
    The Witch of Calamity left with Neula, her hideous laughter echoing in the air. She spared the Dream City survivors for now but everyone felt shrouded by a heavy shadow. What would the Witch do to Neula? Could living beings in the book world still defeat the Calamity? What would the future of the Fantasy Land be?

1171566:
1. Players may consume materials to upgrade structures. A structure's different dimensions have different buff effects. 
2. Starburst Mine has Beehive Storage and Smelting Method two upgrade dimensions. It's the main production structure for Starshine Gem. 
3. Beehive Storage can boost Starshine Gem's yield cap while Smelting Method can improve its yield efficiency. 
4. Starshine Gem is one of the three currencies Vlefar accepts. 
5. Starburst Mine's initial yield rate is 0.125/minute and initial Yield Cap 500.
1171567:

1.During the event, adventurers with a Base Level of 12 or above can go to Prontera and accept Knight's Request from [url=31263][c][fff000][u]Crookes[/u][-][/c][/url] to start the Treasure Hunt Trio's Fantastic Journey series of quests and help Spica retrieve her dresses

2. There are a total of 11 successive quests. Their starting dates are as follows:
2021-10-01 20:00:00 Setting Forth and New Dress start
2021-10-02 10:00:00 Unknown Journey and New Discovery start
2021-10-03 10:00:00 House Master's Sorrow and Persistent Efforts start
2021-10-04 10:00:00 Playful Elf and Twin Dream start
2021-10-05 10:00:00 House Master's Worry starts
2021-10-06 10:00:00 Dream Finale starts
2021-10-07 10:00:00 Final Journey starts

3. Players will receive a Treasure Hunt Score for each quest they complete according to the order of completion within a server
The 1st to complete a quest: earn Treasure Hunt Score x100
The 2nd - 5th to complete a quest: earn Treasure Hunt Score x40
The 6th - 10th to complete a quest: earn Treasure Hunt Score x30
The 11th and after to complete a quest: earn Treasure Hunt Score x20

4. At the end of the event, adventurers will be ranked by their Treasure Hunt Score. In case several adventurers finish the event with the same score, whoever has reached the score first will be ranked higher. Detailed rewards and titles are as follows:
The 1st place: Big Cat Coin Lucky Bag - Large x1 and the exclusive achievement and title Treasure Hunt Master. Open the Lucky Bag to obtain Big Cat Coin x8,888
The 2nd - 5th places: Big Cat Coin Lucky Bag - Medium x1 and the exclusive achievement and title Treasure Hunt Elite. Open the Lucky Bag to obtain Big Cat Coin x1,688
The 6th - 10th places: Big Cat Coin Lucky Bag - Small x1 and the exclusive achievement and title Treasure Hunt Raider. Open the Lucky Bag to obtain Big Cat Coin x648
The 11th - 50th places: Mini Big Cat Coin Lucky Bag x1, which contains Big Cat Coin x 328
The 51st - 200th places: Pocket Big Cat Coin Lucky Bag x1, which contains Big Cat Coin x128
Rewards will be issued via mail

5. The first quest hint will be published on the following Monday at 10:00 (2021-10-04 10:00:00). After, 1 more hint will be released every 3 days until all hints are provided

6. For every quest completed, win Spica's Thank-you Gift x1
Complete the 1st quest for bonus Dream Sticker - Treasure Hunt x1 and Picture Book: Poring's New Clothes x1
Complete the 15th quest for bonus Princess Dress - Jasmine x1

7. This quest is limited to one character per account. The latest possible time to complete is 2021.12.01 05:00

1187381: Sea Spirit is the spirit of nature worshipped by the ancient people of Comodo but not a real existing deity. It represents four types of power, ocean, tree, stone, and wind, which are the commonly seen matters on the island. Being influenced by the witch power, the Sea Spirit Totems used for worship have turned into evil beings, who utilized the storm's power to create the Lost Isle and the mysterious ocean nearby.
1187383: Sea Spirit will activate different power marks to unleash different skills and perform a random Sacrifice action while casting the mark skills. Sea Spirit has three types of Sacrifice actions, which are clockwise rotation, counterclockwise rotation, and vertical rotation. When the adventurer is transformed into a Small Sigil by the vision of Sea Spirit, they can pick one action among the three to perform. When "Component Analysis" is ongoing, Sea Spirit will recall the sacrifice actions used while casting the different mark skills before. Only the adventurers who have performed the sacrifice actions correctly can break off from the death curse applied by Sea Spirit.
1187384: He was the pride of the younger generation in the Lugenburg family three hundred years ago. At a very young age, he had already made it to be the captain of the naval flagship - HMS King's Glory. There was already animosity between him and Bacsa when Bacsa was still serving in the Walters. The two even became nemeses with each other when Bacsa became a pirate and Nikolai joined the navy. He was lured into Lost Isle while trying to pursue Bacsa's ship - Raven, and trapped there since then. He was cursed by the frenzied Sea Spirit and transformed into a monster of half-human and half sea creature. He possesses a strong hostility against the pirates, Bacsa, and anyone else who is involved with Bacsa.
1187386: Demonic Spirit can adaptably utilize the Gunslinger skill and summon Corrupted monsters to fight. The Corrupted Whirlpools spawned during the battle will stay on the ship, and the adventurer will take constant damage if they keep standing on it. When HP is reduced to 70% and lower, Demonic Spirit can activate an invincible shield while summoning its heart and endless Corrupted hordes to fight. The Demonic Heart is protected by corrupted energy, making it invincible usually. When the adventurer defeats the MVP in the Corrupted Army (Devil Squid, Drake, or Strouf), Corrupted Energy Orbs will be spawned from some fixed locations and move towards the heart. If the adventurers defeat it, they can receive the ability to deal damage to the heart temporarily. If the heart absorbs the energy ball, it will heal the HP of all the present Corrupted units on the field. When the heart is destroyed, the Demonic Spirit's invincible shield will be disabled, and it will suffer from a massive amount of damage. After that, Demonic Spirit will transform and use even more powerful skills to fight against the adventurers.

Though unable to stop the growing curse, she forbade everyone from entering Thanatos Tower in order to prevent the curse from escaping. A Valkyrie versed in the art of war, she possesses a stoic and upright character and is very arrogant. She believes human power is insignificant compared to that of the gods. She possesses a strong sense of justice, and is prepared to ruthlessly adjudicate mankind in order to prevent the curse from spreading. 1205934:
[Ghost MVP mode introduction]: 

1. The Ghost Gate in Niflheim opens daily at even hours on the hour. 
2. Every time when the Ghost Gate opens, one MVP will transform into its ghost form and appear on the corresponding map in place of the original MVP. 
3. The Ghost MVP will level up by 1 every time it's killed. Its level will drop by 1 if players fail to kill it. 
4. Ghost MVP's drop rewards follow the original MVP's rules and include the original MVP's drop rewards. 
5. Before the Ghost MVP emerges, a random summoning game will be refreshed on the map. Players need to complete the quest on the current map within 15 minutes or the MVP will appear in its original form. 
6. Quest keywords: Olyphant, Body on the ground, Deceased Guard (The puzzle is very easy for your clever head!) 

[World MVP Mode Rules]: 

1. When the Ghost Gate opens, there's also a chance of summoning a World MVP on Niflheim Field Map. 
2. When the World MVP is approaching, all players will see a countdown icon on the screen. The World MVP will emerge at the end of the countdown. 
3. Tap the countdown icon to see the precise location of the World MVP. 
4. All players who contribute to the World MVP's kill have a chance of receiving a reward accordingly. The World MVP's level will remain the same. 

[Apocalypse MVP Mode Rules]: 

1. The MVP and Ghost MVP released at 12:00 and 22:00 will transform into an Apocalypse MVP every day. 
2. An Apocalypse MVP features higher damage and DMG reduction compared to any regular MVP. 
3. In a battle against the Apocalypse MVP, one layer of buff is granted every 10 seconds to increase your damage to the Apocalypse Boss. 
4. Apocalypse MVP's drop rewards follow the original MVP's rules and its drop rate is 3 times higher than the original version. All adventurers who contribute to the Apocalypse MVP's kill will receive a Random Boss Material as their reward.

1211394:
Tristan, the current king of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, has been missing for half a year. A huge kingdom like this cannot go without a king, so the seven most respected royal families of the kingdom decided to hold a king's selection ceremony, and each would elect a candidate for the next king. And adventurer was invited to witness this historic moment. 
However, at the gate of the royal palace, when watching the grand procession of the seven royals entering the city, the adventurer happened to meet the gaze of a royal girl. A strange picture appeared in the adventurer's mind: the palace is all over with corpses, a woman kneeling on the ground, crying, and blood dripping on the red carpet. These scenes seemed to be what the royal girl had dreamed about, but everything felt so real. Adventurer believed this dream was unusual, so he immediately entered the palace. 
In the palace, the members of the seven royals all gathered in the main hall, talking with each other. Adventurer spotted the royal girl standing alone in the corner right away. This girl's name is Agnes, and she was the young lady of the Lugenburg Family. She has been having Foreseeing Dreams since she was a child. She came to Prontera and attended the king's selection ceremony because of her dream. And Nihil, the young master of the Heine Family who had a crush on Agnes, was worried about her. 
At this time, Prince Ignatz, the son of the current King Tristan, appeared in front of everyone. In high spirits, he announced that he would inherit the throne tomorrow and asked the maid Alice to prepare the scepter that represented the kingship. This announcement displeased the royal family members present, but Ignatz forced them to attend his succession ceremony tomorrow by virtue of his command of the palace guards.
1211395:
The next day, the royal families gathered at Between Thrones one after another. After shaking hands with everyone, Prince Ignatz walked up the steps to the throne and accepted the blessing of the Bishop. That's when Alice came to Prince Ignatz with a silver box of the scepter in her hands. The prince proudly picked up the scepter, but he didn't expect that just when he was about to announce his official succession, black blood came out from the corner of his mouth, and then he fell to the ground, motionless. 
It set off chaos instantly, and the queen immediately mobilized her guards to search everyone present. After examining the prince's corpse, doctor Karl informed everyone that Prince Ignatz's palm was exposed to poison that caused immediate death upon contact. The scepter was, too, covered with the poison. The maid Alice was found to have this poison hidden in her body during a search by the guards, and she was the last person to touch the scepter. The queen immediately ordered the guards to escort Alice to the prison. 
 The case seemed to be closed, but Agnes and Nihil had questions. First of all, why would a murderer carry such important evidence on themselves after committing the crime? Secondly, Alice was timid by nature, and she couldn't be the murderer of this case. Along with Agnes and Nihil, Adventurer came to the queen and asked her to permit them to investigate freely in the palace. 
Just as their investigation was making some progress. The news came that Alice would be on trial tomorrow. The three decided to use the evidence obtained from the investigation to prove Alice's innocence tomorrow.

I Dungeon Rules 
1. Participation Rules 
Matches are organized in a 12v12 group confrontation system. Players must be at Lv. 100 or above to participate.
 2. Victory Conditions 
*Two groups fight in a church. The party wins immediately when it breaches the other's base 
*The Dungeon lasts for 15 minutes 
*In case no parties have breached the other's base by the end of the 15 minutes, the side with higher remaining Defense Tower and Base HP wins. If the two parties finish the battle with the same amount of defense tower HP, the side with higher EXP wins. If the two parties also happen to have earned a same amount of EXP, the side that reaches this EXP first wins. 
3. The dungeon has three modes: I. Groups can be paired at any time in the Casual mode. II. Groups may join the Season Mode from Saturday 8 pm to 12 am every week during the season. Complete Dungeon exclusive Quests to win the item Bishop Emblems, which can be redeemed for special rewards. Both Casual mode and Season mode have no limit on the size of participating groups. III. Cup Mode. Please refer to Help on the Cup Tournament page for details. IV. Battles are scheduled in rounds with a 30-minute interval. Once a battle starts, the participating groups won't be able to access any other dungeon. 
II. How to play 
1. Upon entering the dungeon, player characters will be randomly assigned to either the Hawk or the Dove Faction. Each faction features defense towers, barracks, a base and a Shop. There are offensive and defensive two routes to choose from. The defensive route has three defense towers while the offensive route has siege vehicles that can cause severe damage to structures.
 2. Base: Players defend their own base. Once it's destroyed, the faction loses. A player earns Base EXP by defeating enemy units. An upgraded base will produce stronger soldiers with higher Attributes. 
About EXP drops: Field area Morroc > Field area MVP > Enemy player > Ranged soldier > Online MVP > Close combat soldier. A deceased unit's EXP drops have a picking range. The more players are around a deceased unit, the higher EXP (there's a cap). If a unit is killed when there's no enemy players around, the EXP will be lost. 
3. Barracks: The defensive and offensive routes feature one each. Soldiers will be produced at intervals to attack and defense. 
4. Defense Tower: Can cause severe damage to enemy units. Only siege vehicles can cause substantial damage to it. Players can only damage a defense tower when there are siege vehicles attacking it. 
5. Siege Vehicle: It only moves forward when there are our units nearby or it will either draw back or stagnate. The vehicle itself is invulnerable. 
6. Shop: Players can earn gold coins by defeating enemy units. Tap the coin UI on the base of game page to access the shop and purchase items. 
7. Portal: Players can tap the portal on the offensive or defensive route to be teleported instantly. (On the offensive route, the portal needs to be activated after damaging the enemy defense towers) 
8. Field area: There is a large field area between the offensive and defensive routes. MVPs with different halo effects will be released in the field area. When one force kills a MVP, it will appear on their route to strengthen their combat power.
★ The center of the wilderness will spawn Morroc at the 4th, 8th, and 12th minute after the game starts. Morroc will drop Transformation Scrolls. Players using the Transformation Scroll will be able to directly attack non-invincible Defense Towers during the transformation.

The trial was held as scheduled, and the adventurer and the others revealed the truth with evidence in front of everyone. It turned out that Alice was too timid, and the palace was rumored to be haunted. She was too scared to retrieve the scepter from the cellar. Thus, she asked the palace guard captain Martin to help her retrieve the scepter in the middle of the night and place it in the bishop's silver box.  Alice didn't come in contact with the scepter the whole time and had no chance to poison it. 
The trial proved Alice's innocence, but there are still many doubts. As the poison was found on Alice, Nihil asked her if anyone had been near her on the day of the murder. Alice recalled that she had been knocked down by Par Richard on the day of the murder. This gave the investigation a new direction, and the adventurer and the party launched a series of investigations around Par, confirming that the case was Par's doing.

1222269:
The passing of Prince Ignatz has left the Kingdom of Midgards in deep grief. 
Adventurer and Agnes and others were invited to the Prince's memorial service. At the scene, a familiar figure and the turning movement made Agnes realize that the crying woman in the dream should be Queen Catherine. Then Catherine might be able to help her solve the doubt in her mind: who is the person in the dream that will die in the future? 
Just like that, Adventurer and companions found the queen in the garden and her inseparable musician Ernst. Their intimate words made the rumor that "Ernst is a minstrel on the surface but actually the lover of the Queen" even more credible. The reporter Frank tried to take the opportunity to take an intimate photo of the two but accidentally exposed himself and Adventurer's party to the public. 
Before the enraged queen could hold them accountable, the patriarch of the royal family engaged in maritime trade among the Seven Royals, Lord Ian Walter, the old king's prime minister, appeared in the garden with his sons Isenhardt and Isenhour. Ian was extremely displeased with the Queen and her musician, and this scene made him even angrier. Carried away by the strength of the alcohol, Ian got into an argument with the musician. With the help of Adventurer, the crowd was barely able to pull Ian away from the Queen and the musician. The queen was very angry and left the garden. Adventurer and the others tried to discuss with the queen about the Foreseeing Dream but failed. 
Just when the crowd was frustrated, Isenhardt Walter told Ernst and Adventurer and the others that his father was just overly sentimental about the loss of His Highness the Prince, drowned his sorrow with alcohol, which resulted in his rudeness. Ian Walter had wanted to invite Her Majesty the Queen and others to his birthday banquet, hoping to console the Queen and wish her to get over the pain of losing her son soon. For this reason, Ian also ordered the family treasure Golden-Stringed Harp to be gifted to Allen so that he can use the Golden-Stringed Harp to play for Her Majesty the Queen. 
Isenhardt's sincere apology dissolved much of the previous unpleasantness. As Ernst's only friend in the palace, Ernst expressed that he wouldn't turn down an invitation from Isenhardt. As for Adventurers and the others, everyone felt that the birthday banquet was a chance to see the Queen again, so they also accepted the invitation.
1222270:
Ian Walter's birthday banquet was held as scheduled, and the royal family members were all present. Laughter and lively atmosphere, not at all like they had just experienced the grief of death. At the banquet, Ian told the crowd that musician Ernst would perform with the Walter family's prized "Golden-Stringed Harp". As soon as the words left his mouth, Ernst's scream echoed from the restroom. The crowd rushed to see the blood splattered in the restroom: Ian Walter's favorite son - the humble and gentle Isenhardt lying in a pool of his own blood from a dagger pierced through his chest. Next to him lay a dead stranger. 
Losing his beloved son on his birthday, Ian refused to allow anyone to leave. The queen immediately ordered Adventurer and the others to aid Karl the Coroner with investigating the crime scene, hoping to find out the truth soon. 
Through the testimony of the witness Ernst, the crowd learned that the strange dead man was the murderer of Isenhardt, who killed Isenhardt and then swallowed pills to kill himself. But no one knows who this killer is and what kind of feud there could be between him and Isenhardt. 
In the process of investigating the scene, Adventurer stumbled upon the murder weapon used by the killer to kill Isenhardt, which was actually the personal belongings of Agnes' brother Helmut. Helmut flatly stated that his dagger was missing but refused to give specific information about how it went missing. Together with the testimony of Martin, the Guard Captain, Helmut became the biggest suspect in the murder of Isenhardt, and the queen had to order Helmut to be put in the dungeon. 
But Helmut and Isenhardt have never had a grudge against each other, and Agnes felt that her brother could not be behind it. She asked Adventurer and Nihil to accompany her to the dungeon where her brother was being held. She wanted to find out who was trying to frame Helmut and the Lugenburg family.
1222271:
As soon as dawn came, Adventurer and the others headed to the dungeon to meet with Helmut. When inquired about the dagger, Helmut clearly lied. Adventurer used the evidence collected to break through Helmut's lies and learned why Helmut was reluctant to state the truth: Helmut was ordered to escort an important herb called Mandrake, but it was stolen. Helmut wanted to make up for it without anyone noticing, but he was scammed by the Black Market Merchant. Not only did he not get the Mandrake, but he also lost his dagger. 
Although the truth was revealed, there's no evidence to prove Helmut was innocent unless the soldier who stole the Mandrake - Andrew, can be captured and have him testify. Helmut told Adventurer that his good friend - the Herb Merchant Dona, might be able to help them. 
Adventurer did find evidence proving Helmut lost his dagger before the murder at the residence of Dona. Aside from this, they also learned Andrew stole the Mandrake to save his own child from an illness. 
With sufficient evidence acquired, Adventurer was about to leave but found Andrew seemed to know a lot about the Walter family. Adventurer in suspicion took a piece of evidence from the crime scene to Andrew's wife and was told it belonged to Andrew. Did Adventurer and the others accidentally discover the identity of the killer? But if it was all true, then who was the mastermind behind the murder?

The trial at the court in Between Thrones goes on as scheduled. Helmut and Isenhour have been quarreling non-stop. Adventurer and the others bring out the evidence they have gathered, proving Helmut's innocence. People also learn from the trial that the murderer who killed Isenhardt is called Andrew, who is also the culprit who stole the Mandrake escorted by Helmut. But the reason why this person would murder Isenhardt has still been a mystery. 
    But there is one thing one can confirm, Andrew possesses many pieces of evidence that prove he is involved with Ian Walter. Adventurer and the others made bold speculation - Andrew took Ian's order in order to keep his wife and daughter live better: he is to kill Isenhardt Walter, and he must commit suicide after completing the mission. 
    This deduction enrages the entire Walters. None of the royal members is also willing to believe that Ian Walter would kill his favorite son. While the conflict between the two sides has been ongoing, Walter Family's butler, Pavel, stood out and confessed that it was him who killed Isenhardt, and he actively asked the Queen to throw him in jail. 
    Obviously, this result is not satisfying yet, but Her Majesty doesn't seem to care about the truth. She indicated that as long as there was a conclusion, it would be okay. Thinking of what Pavel said to the Queen before being thrown into the dungeon and the Queen's strange reaction, Adventurer and others decide to continue to search for the truth. Not willing to let injustice ruin anyone's life and make sure that Isenhardt didn't die in vain.
1227910:
The Adventurer and his friends further organize the evidence they currently have and realize that Walter was originally planning to kill Ernst, the musician, instead of Isenhardt: Walter asked Andrew to mark the target with Golden-Stringed Harp at the party. But to his surprise, this harp ended up being in the possession of Isenhardt, leading Isenhardt to be murdered. 
    If the deduction is correct, then what reason would make Walter take such a big risk to assassinate a musician hidden in the palace? Unless... Ernst has another identity. 
    With this conclusion, Adventurer and the others find Ernst to learn more information, but they notice that Ernst has changed his usual kind character and refuses to discuss this matter with others. Running into a wall during the investigation, Adventurer found some evidence with the reminder from Karl the Coroner. It is proven that the musician's arm has small bruises, and he needs to take a painkiller for the long term. Coincidently, the late Prince Ignatz grew the same scar on his body as well. 
    Later on, Adventurer discovered a few words from Queen's diary, which has almost revealed Ernst’s identity. Agnes and Nihil think it is a good time to talk to Ernst. 
    To everyone's surprise, Ernst has also been expecting them to show up. He hopes that Adventurer can help him make an important decision in life.

1230498:
Queen Catherine has called for an emergency meeting, announcing that the king election shall be carried on the next day. Such a hasty decision has caused anxiety among the nobles; Agnes has also seen the sign of misfortune through the Foreseeing Dream. In order to prevent the accident from happening, Adventurer and the other two tried to persuade the Queen to push off the king election ceremony. 
But Queen Catherine was very stubborn. Even if Adventurer has presented the threatening letter that Arish Narius received, indicating that there is a dangerous organization attempting to interfere with the king election, the Queen still won’t change her plan. In desperation, Adventurer could only go with her arrangement. On the way to resting in the guest room, Adventurer noticed two knights trying to move a storage box out of the Eternal Palace. 
In midnight, a tragedy indeed took place: Prince Ernst was burnt to death in his room. He was burnt into charcoal, going out in the most gruesome way. Adventurer and the others immediately carry out an investigation, but before they figured out the evidence at the crime scene, the murderer seemed to have already appeared - Helmut claimed that he witnessed Peter set off the fire, and Peter's defense was full of loopholes, so he was regarded as the main suspect and put in incarceration. 
With his understanding of Peter, Nihil believes that he didn't murder Ernst. But if he wants to prove this point, Adventurer and the others still need to find more evidence. Agnes took out the bronze key with the emblem of the ballroom, raising the idea to investigate further at the restaurant and the kitchen. The three agreed to meet again the next day morning.
1230499:
Adventurer headed to the ballroom to investigate, but the grand manager of the court, Fernando, refused to cooperate. Adventurer could only carry out the insight investigation first. After a thorough investigation, Adventurer and the others discovered that there were many flammable objects from the kitchen in the prince's room. After questioning Fernando, he notified Adventurer: the kitchen was burgled one day before Ernst was murdered. 
Adventurer went through the evidence at hand and restored the method the murderer used to set off a fire, proving that Ernst was not murdered by Peter's magic flame. But this conclusion was not good enough to clear off Peter's suspicion - Because Peter possesses the flame perception, he could have prevented the prince from being burnt to death. In order to figure out the possibility that Peter might have indirectly murdered the prince, Adventurer further investigated Peter. 
In the room where Peter was staying, Adventurer noticed a book applied with a magic spell and acquired a mysterious letter from within: It turns out Peter was not in his room at all during the night of the case. Instead, he was at a corner that was far away from the fire, meeting with a mysterious person. Nihil wanted to figure out who the sender was. Peter's innocence can only be proven this way.
1230500:
To figure out the identity of the sender, Adventurer followed the clue on the letter and found Ipa the Royal Knight to question. However, Ipa was acting suspiciously. He immediately ran away after meeting Adventurer. While attempting to capture Ipa, Adventurer was stopped by the Queen's guard captain. Although Adventurer managed to repel the opponent, Ipa was also lost. 
Luckily, the remaining scent on the letter could still lead a way to solve the case. With Agnes's suggestion, Adventurer headed to Rose Theater to ask about the clues from the noblewomen who know perfumes. After a thorough investigation, Adventurer and the other two came up with a conclusion - that mysterious letter was actually sent by Queen Catherine. 
Catherine is Ernst's mother. There is no way that she would hurt her son. Therefore, Nihil believes that the evidence is fully prepared. He discussed with Adventurer and Agnes to host a court trial the next day to clear the name for Peter.
