1236949:
The adventurer argued with Helmut at the trial, and Peter is proved to be innocent of murderer the Prince, by restoring how the fire started. The adventurer also presented the letters from the book to explain why Peter failed to save the Prince. The crowd made noises about Peter's private meeting with Catherine, but Catherine stopped the crowd and asks Peter to tell the truth about what really happened that night. 
After hearing Peter's words, the crowd accepted his innocence, but the trial was not yet over. Nihil suspects that the Prince was unconscious or dead before he was burned and requests a further autopsy to find clues about the real murderer, but Catherine can't bear that her son's body is going to be destroyed again. After some arguments, she forced an end to the trial and took the Prince's body for burial five days later. 
Adventurers have no way but to look for clues for the murderer elsewhere. Just then, Walter sent his men to secretly meet with the adventurers: he accused Queen Catherine of murdering the Prince and provided relevant evidence. In exchange, Walter asks the adventurers to assist him in investigating the real murderer of Isenhardt while investigating the Queen at the same time. In order to find out the truth, the adventurers have no choice but to cooperate with Walter temporarily.
1236950:
The adventurers went to inquire from Queen Catherine, but she left the palace to escort the Prince's body to the church. Moreover, the Queen instructed the royal guards to stop the adventurers from entering the Eternal Palace. For that reason, Nihil proposed to seek information from attendants first. 
From the attendant Averell, the adventurers learn of a strange incident. There was an argument between Catherine and Ernst before the night of his murder; there seems to have a third person in the room at the same time. In order to find out the truth, the adventurers knocked out the guards and forced their way into the Queen's bedroom. 
Evidence in the bedroom indicates that an argument or even a fight did take place here. What's more striking was the fact that there is a secret room in the Queen's bedroom and it has traces of strange males. The three adventurers were about to discuss it when Queen Catherine returned from church. She angrily summoned the royal guards and tried to expel the intruders from the palace. 
Adventurers defeated Catherine's royal guards and forced her into a negotiation. After questioning, Catherine confessed that she was hiding her lover in her bedroom, and had an argument with her son when Ernst found out. However, she denied that she had killed Ernst because of this. 
Catherine's confession seems to make sense, but there are still a few doubt Points. With the evidence at hand, the adventurer once again pursued Catherine. When presented with a pile of unwritten letters, a heart lock did appear on Catherine's body, but she covered it up with a smart lie. In order to discover Catherine's hidden secret, the adventurers decide to visit Walter again and ask for his help.
1236951:
The adventurers share their discovery in the Eternal Palace with Walter, who suddenly pales when sees the unwritten letter. He instructed the adventurer to spray water onto the paper, and writing did appear on the paper: It was a series of plots against the royal candidate, and even guard Martin was involved, he had paid Andrew to assassinate Isenhardt. 
Walter was so grief and indignant that he joined forces with the adventurers and lured Martin into the dungeon for questioning. Martin cannot bear the pressure and reveals his heart Lock: It turns out that the "lover" the Queen talks about is the King himself. He had not gone missing at all, but he is hiding behind the scenes to manipulate the situation and eliminate other candidates. 
Meanwhile, Martin's confession reveals a more striking detail: the King, who was supposed to be running the show in the secret room of the Eternal Palace, also disappeared, and the Queen has deliberately concealed this fact. 
All the doubt points of the case eventually converge on Queen Catherine. But the Queen was extremely resistant to the investigation, and the adventurers could not find a breakthrough for now. However, Walter was confident that he could use his eyes and ears in the palace to find that breakthrough needed. The adventurers then returned to their guest rooms to rest and prepare for the investigation next day.
1236952:
Walter found Frank, a tabloid reporter, who said he had heard strange noises in the dawn garden at midnight. The adventurers then went to the garden. After some investigation, the crowd came to a horrible conclusion: the King was most probably been pushed off the balcony of the Eternal Palace by the Prince or the Queen and died of server injury. 
However, the King's body is still unaccounted for. As the group was puzzled by the situation, the adventurer suddenly recalled a detail. Before the arson, the Queen had sent a huge storage box into the Prince's guest room; On that night, a fire broke out in the Prince's guest room, leaving only a burned body with an unrecognizable face. 
Is the King's body in the box? Was Prince Ernst really the victim? The group's mind is full of puzzles. Only more evidence could solve them. So the adventurers broke through the Queen's blockade, defeated the royal guard captain and arrived at the coffin of the "Prince". A further autopsy by the coroner confirmed that the deceased man was not Ernst but King Tristan Gaebolg. 
Hearing of the King's death, Walter laughed maniacally. He seems to have had his wish fulfilled and is ready to leave Prontera. The adventurers, however, still have the responsibility of royal detectives: They must clarify the identity of the victim and make sure that the murderers receive the punishment they deserve. 
With mixed emotions, the adventurers left the cemetery. Behind them, the defeated Queen's guard captain came back. His guardianship of the Queen does not seem to be purely out of loyalty...
1236953:
The adventurers entered Between the Thrones, interrupting the mourning ceremony held by Queen Catherine. Nihil reveals the victim in fact the King, but the Queen still refuses to admit her crime. But with more evidence presented, she is finally stopped argue and reveals her secret. 
In order to find out Catherine's motives for murdering King Tristan, the adventurers enter her World of Heart. In there, the adventurers see the tragic past of the Queen: Her marriage with the King was purely political, and the King never showed her love and respect. In her tragic life, Ernst is the last thing that supports her broken heart. She expects nothing more than to stay together with her son, even if Allen is forced to become a musician and cannot call her mother again. However, Isenhardt's death caused conflict between the Prince and the King. During the fight, the Prince pushed the King off the balcony by accident. To save her son from the death penalty of regicide, Catherine had plotted the arson herself. 
Knowing that there is nothing she can do, Queen Catherine decided to sacrifice herself. She pleaded with the adventurers to conceal part of the truth to avoid any further judgment of Ernst who has already escaped, and she is willing to take trial for the murder of the King instead.  However, such a humble wish was not able to be fulfilled. Walter suddenly appeared with a large group of royal nobles, who had hidden and listened to this special "trial" from the shadow. 
Despite the circumstances of the case, those strict and cold-hearted royals intend to defend the authority and dignity of the crown after the deaths of Ernst and Catherine. The Queen lets out a desperate sob, but she was saved by the suddenly appeared royal guard captain. It turns out to be Ernst. Worrying about his mother, he never fled Rune as planned. He kept hiding in the church instead. And Walter revealed his plan. He has sent all his private soldiers with the intention of killing the Queen and Prince on the spot, as atonement for his beloved son Isenhardt. 
Out of justice and sympathy for the Queen and Prince, the adventurers stepped out to stop Walter and his men. Ernst also fought bravely and try to escape the palace with Catherine. All of a sudden, an arrow struck towards Ernst from behind. Catherine try to cover for her son subconsciously and the arrow pierced her heart. 
The mother who is imprisoned all her life was not able to escape the palace in the last. The child who is left alone has lost his meaning in life. With a broken heart, Ernst scoops up Catherine's body and took one step towards the palace gates against the rain of arrows. In the end, either of them is able to embrace the freedom within reach.

1242220:
A strange phenomenon has appeared outside Luoyang. Fa Hai tasked the adventurer to reinforce the Wasteland. But as soon as the adventurer arrived in the Wasteland, they were dragged into a battle: The Fallen Maple Leaf Spirit Yzma is leading a swarm of monsters on an assault of the Divine Tree that has regressed into the form of a seed. 
Adventurer and Romani and the Wasteland Patrol Unit worked together and defeated Yzma, but the paranoid Maple Leaf Spirit will not retreat, planning to use its final strength to perish with the Divine Tree - At that critical moment, the sound of a flute is heard. Upon hearing the sound of the flute, Yzma regained some sanity and chattered “Brother...” and left. The Divine Tree also reacted to the sound of the flute, scattering a faint glow. 
Afterwards, the adventurer found out from Romani that the Divine Tree is closely tied to the barrier of Luoyang. The only way to completely remove the monster threat to Luoyang is to hold a Spirit Summoning Ceremony to revive the weakened Divine Tree. Thus, the adventurer helped Romani collected the materials needed for the Spirit Summoning Ceremony and agreed to attend.
1242221:
The preparation for the ceremony has been completed. The head priest Elly began the Spirit Summoning Ceremony. Just before everyone thought it was successful, the light of the Divine Tree Seed dimmed. The Spirit Summoning Ceremony failed. 
Elly expressed that she felt the will of the Divine Tree rejected the awakening. Whilst investigating the Divine Tree, the adventurer heard the flute from the day before again. The adventurer told Romani about the sound of the flute. The latter didn’t hear it but agreed that it might be a clue leading to the awakening of the Divine Tree. 
Thus, the adventurer began to look for the source of the sound independently and found the blinded Maple. After a talk, Maple agreed to help the adventurer in awakening the Divine Tree and expressed that he is currently extremely weak and needs to rest for a while. The two agreed to head to the Divine Tree in the following day.
1242222:
Adventurer brought Maple before the Divine Tree. Maple found that he could feel the light. After he played his flute, the seed of the Divine Tree indeed changed. Romani thanked him but the adventurer found that Romani could not see Maple. 
This causes Maple to doubt his identity, thus the adventurer brought Maple to visit Elly for an answer. Maple could not withstand the pain from the spirit search and fell unconscious. Elly told the adventurer sadly that Maple is a phantom on the verge of dissipation. 
To save Maple, the adventurer began to search for the Soul Binding Grass In the process, the adventurer was threatened by an eerie and hoarse voice that bears great malice towards Maple and the Divine Tree. 
The adventurer returned with the Soul Binding Grass and eventually healed Maple. He peacefully came to terms with the fact he was already dead but wished to find his lost memory. Considering the connection between Maple and the Divine Tree, the adventurer began to help him find his memory.
1242223:
The adventurer looked for clues leading to Maple’s memory in the Wasteland, but was unexpectedly ambushed by the Wraith. He knows something about Maple and expressed his disgust with Luoyang. 
After a tough battle, the Wraith retreated. The adventurer could sense the magical powers of the Wraith and pursued, discovering that the Wraith was plotting with a mysterious woman in secret. They plan to destroy the barrier of Luoyang. They were the cause of the monsters’ mutation and responsible for the attack on the Divine Tree. Whilst eavesdropping, the adventurer was discovered. The mysterious woman was Bijou. She attacked with the Wraith. Luckily, Maple appeared just in time to fight alongside the adventurer. 
The Wraith lost control after seeing Maple and escaped without fighting. But Bijou ambushed Maple when the adventurer was distracted and left after. The adventurer was worried about Maple’s wounds, but Maple expressed that he was fine. He told the adventurer he just need to rest, and something had changed about the Divine Tree, asking the adventurer to go check it out.
1242225:
The adventurer found Maple near the Divine Tree and told him of the encounter in the Moonlight Grotto. Maple seemed to have regained more of his memory after picking up the scroll. In the sound of his flute, the Divine Tree changed once more, becoming a massive tree. Then, Maple said his farewells to the adventurer and disappeared without a trace. 
The Divine Tree has grown, and the adventurer returned to Fa Hai, reporting everything that happened. After receiving the scroll, Fa Hai explained the origin of Maple to the adventurer and what happened a hundred years ago to Luoyang. It turns out that during the war all those years ago, Vana Tribe, the leader of the Venom Fang Tribe, sacrificed himself, causing the barrier to be unable to open. The leader of the Fana Tribe, Gunn had to transform into a massive dragon and become the barrier to protect Luoyang. 
Fa Hai also mentioned the Wraith had the same appearance as Uruk. He’s worried the Wraith and the power behind it is aiming to stir up an even greater storm in the Wasteland, thus asking the adventurer to return to the Wasteland. At the same time, he gave the adventurer an Invisible Scroll to counter the dangers in the future.
1242226:
The adventurer returned to the Wasteland to investigate the anomaly, but found Maple was trapped by the Wraith and Bijou. The adventurer prepared to help Maple but didn’t think that it was a trap set by the Wraith and Bijou. The two worked together to trap the adventurer in the Dreamland, seemingly planning to do something else too. 
When the adventurer left the Dreamland, the Wasteland is already in chaos with monsters roaming everywhere. The adventurer saved Romani and other members of the Wasteland Patrol Unit, finding out where the Wraith is from. Then they pursued it to the Moonlight Grotto. 
Yet the entrance of the Grotto has been sealed by a Barrier. The adventurer could not enter. Wasteland Sacrifice Elly appeared just in time. She expressed that she could Break the Barrier and asked the adventurer to wait patiently.
1242228:
After Uruk’s phantom falls into slumber, the Wasteland Patrol Unit continues to search for Bijou. They found an entrance formed by Magic Power beneath the Divine Tree. The heavily wounded Bijou seemed to have escaped through it. 
The adventurer is entrusted to enter the entrance to check it out, and accidentally saves Yzma, a young girl who is surrounded by green serpents. The world connected to this entrance is similar to the Wasteland, but with some minor differences. Through a talk with Yzma, the adventurer found out Maple is still alive and the Divine Tree is still a seed. The adventurer wants to continue to collect clues and verify the situation of this world but heard a cold voice issuing a warning. 
The adventurer and Yzma investigate the location of the Divine Tree and reunited with Uruk, but they don’t recognize the adventurer. Through talking to Uruk, the adventurer found out this world is the Wasteland from a thousand years ago - The Maple Leaf Faramita. 
Uruk is currently troubled with the Divine Tree’s inability to grow. The adventurer advised him from experience to play the flute. The Divine Tree grew from the sound of the flute. Uruk was about to thank the adventurer when suddenly, magical miasma fills the air of the Maple Leaf Faramita and the monsters begin to enter a frenzy.  Uruk entrusted the adventurer with the task of taking care of the monsters and hurried to discuss with Gunn to hatch a solution.
1242229:
The adventurer found out the source of the Magical Miasma appeared because Bijou applied a curse. In the process of pursuing Bijou, the adventurer was fooled by Bijou’s deception, encountered an ambush and was heavily wounded. In the time of crisis, a Vana youth appeared and saved the adventurer. The Vana youth advised the adventurer to leave the Maple Leaf Faramita immediately and then left. 
The adventurer was extremely confused. Under the leadership of Yzma, the adventurer met Uruk and the Vana youth who saved them earlier. This Vana youth was the Giant Dragon Gunn. 
After Gunn saw the adventurer, he turned around and left again. Uruk apologized to the adventurer in Gunn’s place. The adventurer told Uruk about Gunn saving them and Uruk gave the adventurer a compass that can find Gunn’s trail.
1242230:
Adventurer sensed from Gunn’s words that Gunn seemed to know where they came from, deciding to use the compass to find Gunn and find the truth. In the process of the search, the adventurer surprisingly found that Yzma was meeting Bijou. 
Bijou used Yzma’s love for Uruk and fooled her into complying. The adventurer immediately intervened to stop it. Bijou summoned monsters to delay the adventurer and escaped the scene.  Gunn appeared again. He told the adventurer that using the compass is enough to find the truth. 
Through hard work in the Frost Domain, the adventurer found Gunn’s notes, finding out the Maple Leaf Faramita is not real. The Wasteland from a thousand years ago was just a dream world for Gunn. Gunn told the adventurer about what happened years ago. Suddenly, the entire dream world experienced a massive shock. Gunn sent the adventurer away from Maple Leaf Faramita.
1242231:
The adventurer woke up and spoke to Fa Hai at Maple Leaf Faramita, finding out that Bijou’s goal was to defeat Gunn’s will in the dream world to ensure the collapse of Luoyang’s barrier. 
Fa Hai expressed that Gunn has always blamed himself for the death of Uruk, and was full of guilt. Perhaps the only way to liberate Gunn from the dream world is to find out the truth from the past. Thus, the adventurer entered the Maple Leaf Faramita once again. The flames of war already sparked here at that time. 
Through a conversation, the adventurer found that Yzma was fooled by Bijou into giving Uruk poison. Bijou appeared at this time, she told Yzma: Uruk didn’t need to die, but to protect Yzma, he used the power of the Divine Tree on her and lost his life. 
Yzma could not accept the harsh truth. In her final moments of near-madness and depravity, she chose to go toward her own demise. At the same time, Bijou also let Gunn witness Uruk’s death, driving Gunn insane and the Maple Leaf Faramita began to collapse. 
To stop Bijou’s plan, the adventurer came all the way before the Divine Tree and began their final battle against Bijou with the blessing of the Divine Tree. 
After a difficult battle, the adventurer defeated Bijou and told the truth about Uruk’s death to Gunn. Meanwhile, Uruk who was supposed to be dead appeared once again - It turned out that he was not the Uruk from Gunn’s dream, but the real Uruk that the adventurer encountered in the Wasteland. 
The phantom of Uruk expressed that his consciousness has merged with the Divine Tree. He will now protect Gunn in his dreams and protect Luoyang.

1260421:
The Book of Yimir, a sacred work full of heroic power, has disappeared from the Unlimited Library. Meanwhile, the remnant soul in the Sealed Magic Sword has escaped the Thanatos Tower and is nowhere to be found. When Valkyrie Rathgricy perceived the breath of Magic Sword left in the Unlimited Library, she realized the Book of Yimir had been stolen by Magic Sword. Rathgricy then commissioned the adventurer to guard a gem, which should have been inlaid on the title page of the Book of Yimir. This gem is the only key to opening the book and utilizing the heroes' power inside. If Magic Sword seeks to leverage the power of the Book of Yimir, the Fate Gem is crucial. And the gem has been kept by the maiden who is dormant in the fountain at the root of the Yggdrasil. The adventurer accepted the critical mission and embarked on the journey to find the gem and the Book of Yimir.
When the adventurer came to Hvergelmir looking for the Fate Gem, Nidhogg was fairly wary of the adventurer's arrival. Just as the two sides were confronting each other, Thanatos showed up and prevented the conflict. The weird thing was, Nidhogg called Thanatos her sister. Nidhogg told the adventurer that the wandering spirit of Thanatos appeared in her dream not long ago. From Thanatos's breath, Nidhogg perceived the power of her little sister, Widfleurnier. So she was very sure that Thanatos must be her sister's reincarnation. Although she had no idea why Thanatos's wandering spirit would appear in her dream world, Nidhogg, missing her little sister too much, brought Thanatos out of the dream world with her power against all odds. But as a wandering spirit, Thanatos lost her previous power and memory, and even his mind was kinda deranged. As a result, he could only barely survive with the support of Nidhogg's power. When Nidhogg learned the adventurer's purpose, she said she didn't mind giving the gem to the adventurer. But she hoped the adventurer would help her escort Thanatos's wandering soul to Niflheim. Only Hela, the Goddess of Death, knows how to save a wandering soul that would perish at any moment. And as Nidhogg had just consumed too much power shortly after waking up, she needed the adventurer's company to head to that land of Doppelganger.
1260422: So the group of three came to the Niflheim, Town of the Dead. But the aura of death here made Nidhogg very uncomfortable because the force of life in her would be rejected here and may even cause chaos. After some investigation in the tavern, the group of three got the Wine of the Doppelganger that could hide their breaths and learned how to meet Hela. To cultivate Hela's favorite pumpkin, Nidhogg even took down a dragon scale on herself to speed up the pumpkin's ripening without hesitation.
1260423: After the pumpkin matured, three of them drank down the Wine of Doppelganger, dressed up like Doppelgangers, and managed to get inside Hela's palace. Hela was very interested in Thanatos's wandering spirit as she hadn't seen a human on the brink like this for a long time. She intended to keep Thanatos as a plaything, but when she actually touched the wandering spirit, tears streamed down her face. She saw Siren in Thanatos's soul. After Hela fixed Thanatos's spirit, sanity came back to Thanatos's eyes. Although he still couldn't recall most of the things, he remembered a girl named Hills, who he must return to. According to Hela, memories are essential for a soul to last, and without memories, one's spirit, sooner or later, would stray and become a wandering spirit again. A wandering spirit can only survive in the dream world and cannot exist in the world nor reincarnate. And as the undisputed greatest hero of humans, Thanatos perhaps can recover his memories in the Book of Yimir.
1260424: So no matter whether it was for the sake of world peace or Thanatos, it was extremely urgent to retrieve the Book of Yimir. Nidhogg also told the adventurer that the Fate Gem was created by Yimir with her dragon scales and the blood of his own. Hence, the Fate Gem can perceive where the Book of Yimir is as it also contains Yimir's blood. Following the Fate Gem's guidance, the team of three found that Magic Sword, carrying the Book of Yimir, was actually hiding in the Dragon Race's Secret Realm that only the Dragon Race knew. And the seal at the secret realm's entrance, only Nidhogg and her sister Widfleurnier know how to unlock it. Too many coincidences, a way too smooth search, and other oddities around Dragon Race's Secret Realm all put Thanatos on alert.
1260425:
Nidhogg, however, was oblivious to all of those. She proposed to use the Fate Gem as bait to lure the book thief into the trap after entering the secret realm and then capture him in one fell swoop. Her strategy successfully lured a weird black shadow who wanted to grab the Fate Gem. After getting defeated by the adventurer and Thanatos, the black shadow revealed her true self: A maiden who looked exactly like Nidhogg! By that time, Nidhogg finally realized Thanatos was indeed not her little sister, and the maiden in front was the real Widfleurnier. Wid begged for her sister's forgiveness and salvation, but Thanatos managed to point out the lie between Widfleurnier's words. However, though Nidhogg was totally shocked that her little sister was still alive, she still chose to help her sister. Regardless of the adventurer and Thanatos's objection, Nidhogg activated the Book of Yimir with the Fate Gem to restore her little sister's strength.
Nidhogg concentrated all her power on maintaining the Fate Gem, cutting off all her perception of the surroundings outside. Meanwhile, Widfleurnier was stopping the adventurer and Thanatos from getting close to Nidhogg. And as her power gradually recovered, Widfleurnier revealed her true nature. It turned out that since Thanatos's wandering spirit entered Nidhogg's dream, all of this was her scheme, taking advantage of her sister's love for her to seize the power of Yimir Heart. However, just as she was about to slay the two opponents smugly, Nidhogg's closely shut eyes suddenly opened. Then she closed up the Book of Yimir, and the light from the Book of Yimir disappeared. Widfleurnier turned her face around in shock and looked at her big sister. Nidhogg held out her hand and cast a golden beam of light on Thanatos. Then, after rushing out of the golden light, Thanatos picked up his weapon and continued charging at Widfleurnier. Widfleurnier threatened Thanatos that if she died, Thanatos's wandering spirit that depends on the Magic Sword's breath to survive would also perish. But Thanatos's sword still ran through Widfleurnier mercilessly. Widfleurnier screamed in pain, questioning why her sister would do this to her. Nidhogg said that she considered her little sister equally important with her own life, but so do all beings in the world. As Widfleurnier was killed, the power of heroes she had absorbed turned back into book pages, which fluttered in the air and then scattered around the world with the shock wave. Everything finally got back in peace. Thanatos, who nearly vanished, reached out to Nidhogg sitting on the ground, trying to help her stand up. However, he turned into a page of the Book of Yimir in Nidhogg's palm.
Nidhogg broke down and wept hysterically. She saw Thanatos's memories in the Book of Yimir. Turned out Widfleurnier allied with Morroc back in those years and betrayed her big sister Nidhogg. After Nidhogg discovered their ploy and defeated her, Wid's soul lost its vessel and came to the Lake of the Abyss before parasitizing in the Magic Sword Hogne. After that, Widfleurnier was not dormant as she said. Instead, she, as Magic Sword, devoured Thanatos bite by bite. So she closed the Book of Yimir and passed her memories to Thanatos. But to her surprise, Thanatos chose to sacrifice himself for the world again even after fully recovering his memories. Nidhogg thought she nearly made a horrible mistake due to her selfishness and was no longer qualified to be the Fate Gem's guardian. So she handed the Fate Gem to the adventurer and commissioned the adventurer to retrieve all the pages. Nidhogg is once again dormant now. Perhaps in her dreams, she will reunite with Thanatos.

1261914:
1. Only adventure series, wasteland series, ancient series equipment can do Refinement Transfer or get Transferred. Adventure series includes equipment prefixed with "Adventure Novice", "Adventure Elite", "Adventure Hero" and "Adventure Master". Wasteland series includes equipment prefixed with "Dusted Mythic" and "Brilliant Reappearance". Ancient series are equipment dropped in the two instances of "Ponape Museum Island" and "Exploring the Lost Isle"
2. In Refinement Transfer, you can only transfer a higher refining level equipment (source equipment) to a lower refining level equipment (target equipment).
3. In refinement Transfer process, the refining level of adventure series equipment can be transferred to other equipment that meet the conditions. Wasteland series equipment can not be transferred to adventure series equipment. Ancient series equipment can only be transferred to ancient series equipment.
4. The refinement transfer will cover the target equipment's refining level, and the source equipment's refining level will be reset. (refining level won't be exchanged).
5. Broken equipment can not do Refinement Transfer or get Transferred.
6. Refinement Transfer can only be done between equipment of the same parts.

Welcome to the Desert Wolf Arena.
Two teams of adventurers will fight here.
Score Rules:
Each time a team member knocks down a hostile adventurer, the team can get 1 score, and the team that gets 30 scores first wins.
15 mins after the combat begins, if there is no 30-scores team, then the team with higher scores wins.
How to be the MVP:
The team member in the victory team with the highest KDA (Kill Death/Assist) will be the MVP. When there is two or more highest KDA, the one with higher combos will be the MVP. When there are two or more highest combos, randomly pick one to be the MVP;
In a draw, there are no winning teams, and the MVP will be selected from the two participating teams.

1 Star: 50 Points
2 Stars: 125 Points
3 Stars: 200 Points
4 Stars: 300 Points
5 Stars: 500 Points

1. Calculation rules for group summit of the current GVG season: total summit points/(number of summits +1)
In each GVG Summit, guilds that win the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th place can get 7/5/3/1 summit point(s).
In GVG, occupy cities to qualify for the summit. By the end of a week's summit, number of summits +1.
2. Grouping and points calculation:
Team Star: [1,3)
Team Moon: [3,5)
Team Sun: [5,7)
For example, a guild won the 1st and the 4th place in the first two weeks of summits of a new GVG season, the points calculation would be (1+7+1)/(2+1)=3. The guild would go to Team Moon.

1298928:
1. Equipment with Phantom progress can be fitted into Side Equipment Slots.
2. The attributes of Phantom Equipment are converted based on the percentage of Phantom progress, with card effects disabled when used as Phantom Equipment. n3. Phantom Equipment primarily consists of the following two types of equipment: Infused Equipment and Comodo Ancient Equipment.
4. The same part of the Main Equipment Slot and Side Equipment Slot can only be equipped with different types of equipment.
5. The Side Equipment Slots contain a total of five parts, including Off-hand/Armor/Cloak/Footgear/Accessory.
6. Crafting Phantom Equipment requires the consumption of respective Phantom Magic Ore, a rare material that can be found in the Secret Realm of Shadow.
7. Equipment with Phantom progress can not be listed on the exchange unless it is restored through the Pyrolising Stove. When a piece of equipment with Phantom progress is restored, 80% of the consumed Phantom Magic Ore will be refunded.
1298929:
1. You can consume specific items to upgrade the attributes on Warrior/Epic Spirit Ancient Equipment.
2. Attributes will not be reduced and have a chance to be upgraded by one or more levels when randomized. The attributes are guaranteed to be perfectly upgraded after a certain number of attempts.
3. The two random attributes of the Epic Spirit Series of Ancient Equipment can be upgraded separately.
1298931:
[Instance Flow]
By touching the Witch’s Mirror, Adventurers can now enter the ancient Ponape Secret Realm and challenge the resurrected Fantastic Dragon in its complete form.
[Reward Rules]
The drop rewards of each MVP can only be obtained by one account once a week. The drop rewards will be refreshed at 05:00 every Monday. After defeating the MVP monsters and earning weekly rewards, you can also spend Fortune Coins to obtain additional rewards. Each MVP additional reward obtained through Fortune Coins can only be obtained by one account once a week. The additional rewards will be reset at 05:00 every Monday.
[Revival Rules]
When fighting MVP monsters in Instances, the battle area is restricted, and resurrecting consumes a resurrection count. When the resurrection count is used up, adventurers can no longer resurrect.
[Death Blow Protection Restriction] The entire Ponape secret realm is overwhelmed by the power of witches, and the "Death Blow Protection" effect from adventurers will only take effect no more than once during a battle.\ 
Note: It has a chance to drop headwear/Military Exploit Chests.
1298933:
1. The refinement level of both main and side equipment of the same part is capped at 15, which means the maximum damage reduction is 13.5%.
2. When the same part (refinement level of the main equipment +refinement level of the side equipment x phantom progress) >15, the portion over 15 will be converted to 4,000 base HP per level (base HP is a fixed value and is not subject to the percentage bonuses from equipment and cards).
3. The bonus refinement level boost from ancient relic [Dvalin's Jade], item [Lucky Alloy], and Hollgrehenn's class skill [The Best Blacksmith on the Continent] are not subject to the above rules and will still be settled at 0.9% damage reduction per level.

1303612: This is strange... Why is nobody here? They say that residents of Alberta are well-informed. They know me, don't they?

1303614: Of course, Hollgrehenn's hug is the warmest! Does anyone want to try?
1303615: Do you think the pretty girl over there is checking on me?
1303617: Hmm! Did you eat too many carps in Alberta? You are so carping!

1303622: Hey! Why are you looking at me like that? Forget it! I never said that! You are so stingy! I could pay you back with my work.

1303625: Haha, I must be imagining it. Besides, Hollgrehenn will be the main character even in games!

1303628: Later, I took a closer look at it and realized that I made it a few years ago as a gift to others. However...he was right about the super Whitesmith part. He-heh.
1303629: I read the notes and books my teacher left every night, and I have learned a lot!
1303630: Also, I've been sleeping very well. Reading makes me so sleepy...
1303631: I hope the sea breeze in Alberta can be stronger!
1303632: If so, it may bring a pretty lady to me by accident.
1303634: It's so cold lately, and everything is so expensive. I can't even afford fuel for my furnace.
1303635: Buddy, is there anything you'd like to forge? Let me earn some money with my hard work.
1303636: There are so many experts in Alberta, but I can barely understand the things they talk about.
1303637: When can the experts talk about things that normal people can understand?

1303640: If the teacher is still alive, would he have the courage to express his feelings to Miss Deeven? I don't think so... Ha... He is a coward when it comes to this.
1303642: There are a lot of highly respected seniors in the Blacksmith Guild. They are awesome.
1303643: It's okay. I'm still young! As long as I live long enough, I will become a senior someday.
1303644: The menu of the tavern here changes frequently. People seem to enjoy strong drinks lately.
1303645: The last time I was drunk, I had this dream where I forged an artifact. It was such a sweet dream.
1303646: The teacher took me in as his apprentice. It's time for me to have an apprentice. Emm...

1303652: It appears that I am destined to live a down-to-earth life.

172261:
[ffc53a]A comforting yet forgotten song,

With the Earth in its mother’s arms,

A true blessing to the world[-]
172262:
[ffc53a]Photos that carry memories,
They lie silently strong

These priceless moments captured,
Being true treasures of the past

"Satisfied?",
That word screams inside me

Hitting me like waves,
Over and over again,
Waves against the shore,
Slowly tearing it down[-]
172263:
[ffc53a]A promise made through smiles,
A promise to never be alone

A familiar street,
Hearts connecting us all

An empty jewelry box,
Filled with gems shining bright like stars

These we should treasure,
As love binds us together[-]
172264:
[ffc53a]Myths waiting to be discovered,

Talked about for generations,

Like puzzles waiting to be solved,

Held deep within our hearts,

Guarded safe from harm[-]
172265:
[ffc53a]Never forget your oath,

“No matter how far apart”,

“Love holds us together”[-]
172266:
[ffc53a]The old photos,
The the first love letters

The grandfather clock,
Time froze as we stepped apart

Poor excuses,
Broken promises shown to be lies

Evil created from good,
A loveless heart, a wilting flower in the rain[-]
172267:
[ffc53a]A simple “I’m back”,
A gentle “Welcome home”

Like a lighthouse at night,
A true guide for my heart

A beautiful new world,
People smiling up towards the sky

Immersed in the moment

Making it last for forever[-]
172268:
[ffc53a]The world has been cleansed of evil,

A story that has yet to be told,

We will write this story forever,

Letting this new hope grow on and on[-]
172269:
[ffc53a]A diary filled with thousands of stories,

Gently turn to the next page,

Here lies a poem you wrote together[-]
172270:
[ffc53a]Forgotten brought sadness among us
Shaking lips are like falling wings in the blizzard

Waking up in the morning
The tears on the pillow are still warm

The promise when we're children
They’re all that I have left

Alone in this strange world,
That’s full of strange people[-]
172271:
[ffc53a]An oath buried deep in the words,

Pause time, so we’re always together,

“I’ll wait for you forever”[-]
172272:
[ffc53a]As moonlight once again covers us,

Adventurers floating on silver wings,

The forgotten ancient legends,

Buried beneath black statues[-]
172273:
[ffc53a]Unleashing the truth,

Revealing it to young adventurers,

Runes covered in blood and tears,

Letting all be told,

Letting the truth be spread again[-]
172274:
[ffc53a]The light of dawn drowns out the darkness,

The future was worth the fight,

A familiar voice rings deep within me,

“No matter how far apart”,

“Love holds us together”[-]
172275:
[ffc53a] “Have we forgotten?”,
That faint call returns,

Just as grains in an hourglass,
Pass by without a sound,

Time, pure and beautiful,
Drains so quickly

From the fields where we ran together,
To the seas where we held each other[-]
172276:
[ffc53a]What I need to tell you,
A thousand words cannot express

I want to be with you forever,
On this journey called life

Here we open our eyes
To the true reality ahead[-]

[Featured Cards]: 50.0%

2826197: I remembered. The old man forced me to bathe in the sun. It was excruciating when my injuries were scorched under the sun.
2826198: The old man explained, "The power acquired by yourself is more reliable. But perhaps you can treat the innate power as a gift that can protect the people you care about when it matters." I stood silent for a long time...
2826199: I finally remembered the name of the old man. He was Quiller.
2826200: He was a guiding light that I desperately wanted to protect. It seemed that in the end, he shielded us and stayed in the center of the storm.
2826201: I remembered. I asked Quiller this repeatedly. Why do we must save humanity?
2826202: He must have answered me, but I can't remember.
2826203: I remembered the night with the ravaging storm and snow. Maybe it was not a night, and the sun was just blocked by the ice and snow.
2826204: The old man led the clan to worship the gods' decision before making his own. I felt a peculiar emotion, perhaps sadness, or sorrow, but I cannot recall what happened afterwards.
2826205: I remembered. After being enlightened by the old man, I realized that...
2826206: I never wanted my people to use the power. I wanted everyone to be alive. The old man being alive and well was much more important than everything.
2826207: I remembered about Heimdallr, the God of Protection that our people believe in! The old man told us to always respect it.
2826208: But our God failed to protect the old man... Guess it's my responsibility now.
2826209: I remembered. Before I became an adult, I used to look at the stars at night and throw rocks into the distant sea.
2826210: All those questions that confused me then were swallowed by the waves without answers.
2826211: I remembered. Our chief, Quiller, who held the highest power, was more tolerant and caring than other clan folks, and his words were more touching.
2826212: It would be nice if this could go on forever...
2826213: "I swear to protect this land and the soul of our clan chief eternally."
2826214: This sentence suddenly appeared in my mind... But who was the clan chief?
2826215: The old man asked himself, "While I am willing to sacrifice myself when the time comes, how can I impose that same sacrifice on others?"
2826216: I was happy that he cared for everyone, but it made me angry that he didn't care about himself.
2826217: I remembered. The night when everyone left, I finally understood what it felt like to be afraid.
2826218: Small fears can be unsettling, but facing great fears can make people stronger and more courageous. I've made my decision!
2826219: Cracks had appeared on the barrier, but the old man said that hope would eventually leak through them. I'll believe what he believed.
2826220: I remembered. I, Dylan, eventually became Quiller's guard and was gradually accepted by others in the clan.
2826221: I don't fight anymore, but I never stopped training myself because I had a faith to protect.
2826222: I remembered the destination for my people and I, but I seemed to be caged in a body that had lost its faculties.
2826223: If you can, Adventurer, please defeat me.
2826224: I remembered... When the old man Quiller "sacrificed" himself to become the carrier, he didn't die, but he wasn't truly alive either.
2826225: It's time for me to make a wish.
2826226: I've forgotten how I preserved myself, but I remembered where the clan chief that I respected and cared for came from and where he was going.
2826227: Adventurer, I remembered the wise words spoken by the clan chief, "Whether the future is the darkness before the dawn, or the darkness before the darkest hour. It's up to you to make the decision."
2826228: I remembered that the whole universe resonated with his murmurings and anticipations.
2826229: I remembered. I was overly focused on the present moment, only trying to be happy.
2826230: Perhaps, I can look forward to a beautiful future a millennium later.

2831449:
The adventurer who first entered the kingdom of Rune met Cenia, who was also a novice, at the Prontera South Gate. As the "Wind of Destiny" adventurer, they were about to embark on an extraordinary legendary adventure on the vast and mysterious MeadGale continent.

In order to gain the qualification for formal adventuring, the adventurer and Cenia together took the Paradise Group exam at the South Gate.

The Paradise Group exam had three parts. In each test, the adventurer truly felt their growth. After passing the rigorous exams, the adventurer and Cenia successfully gained recognition and traveled together to the holy land of adventure: Prontera.

In Prontera, the adventurer was able to interact with people of all kinds, gaining a deeper understanding of the world and becoming aware that the world was gradually falling into crisis, as dark forces returned. As the "Wind of Destiny" adventurer, they might play an essential role in stopping the crisis.
2831450: Under Cenia's guidance, the adventurers came to the West Gate and learned from the scholar Sphens about the most powerful mysterious force in the continent - the Heart of Yimir. They also heard about the heroic deeds of Dana Toss, the hero who once saved the world. However, after obtaining this information, the heaven and earth suddenly trembled, and the evil forces appeared in the Rift of time and space. The adventurer rushed into the Rift and eliminated the crisis with the help of Dana Toss's soul fragments.
2831451:
Then, the Adventurer obtained the Heart's Origin from Thanatos. It could resonate with shards of Yimir's heart and give the Adventurer Yimir the jötunn's blessing, so that he could repel evil.
After the crisis at the West Gate was removed, the Adventurer bid Sphens farewell and accepted the quest to go to Izlude the harbor town, a satellite city of Prontera.
There, the Adventurer met Laurell Weinder, a boy who aspired to become a mage, and helped him be admitted to the Magic Academy.
2831452: After saying goodbye to Laurell Weinder, the adventurer delved into the mysterious Underwater Cave to continue their unfinished mission. During the process of completing the mission, the adventurer learned the reason for the monster's rampage. With the help of everyone and little Obeaune Lusya, the adventurer repaired the underwater seal, stopping the engulfing Rift, and saving the ocean.
2831453:
But meanwhile, the evil Baphomet revived completely, and it obviously had a formidable plan...
To prevent Baphomet's revival, the Adventurer, who left Izlude, was invited by Laurell Weinder to Geffen the great city of magic. During a conversation with Reyen the headmaster of the Magic Academy, the Adventurer learned that Baphomet had taken advantage of the chaos in Geffen to sneak into the Morroc Pyramid and was going to destroy a dangerous seal.
To confront Baphomet the fallen angel lurking in Morroc, Reyen requested the Adventurer to go to the Mjolnir Mountains and get Brísingamen the real Rainbow Necklace with Morgan the mage!
With the help of the goblins living on the Mjolnir Mountains, the Adventurer gathered all the elements needed to wake the Rainbow Necklace, but another time rift appeared during the ritual, the power within which obstructed Brísingamen's awakening! Finally, the Adventurer managed to remove the time rift crisis and the ritual was completed.
However, that was by no means the last crisis. More undercurrents of chaos were merging under the illusion of peace. How would things turn out?
2831454:
"You want to go on an adventure with us? Firstly you need to learn to meow!" The kittens said as they blinked.
On the Malangdo Cloud Island of the Far Star Continent, there was a rainbow that stretched across the sky. The Dolan cats accidentally discovered that the rainbow was actually a bridge connected to the continent of humans, and they named it the Candy Slide. To enhance the Dolans' understanding of the otherworld, the Butterfly Rangers were recruiting cat adventurers willing to go to the human world.
The Adventurer took the Rangers' test at the Pancake Sentry Box, where he met Abby the kitten who also wanted to venture to the otherworld. During the test, Abby accidentally discovered traces of dark magic. He and the Adventurer followed the traces to the Candy Slide, only to be attacked by a mysterious shadow. Just then, a mysterious cat showed up and saved them.
The Adventurer talked to the mysterious cat, and found that he was Dorado, a renowned Dolan adventurer. Dorado made an arrangement with the two kittens to meet on the second day, but the next day, the Adventurer found that time was rewound to the first day. Only Abby and the Adventurer, the most determined ones among all the kittens in Rozana, managed to notice the time loop.
2831455:
The two cats went to Dorado to ask about the cause. The great adventurer told them that time at the Far Star Continent was pushed forward by the accumulation of memories. The Tear Lake, where memories of all cats were stores, was located deep in the Ravioli Forest, and the traces of black magic that Abby was tracking also led there...
In the forest, the Adventurer and Abby met Carrie the cat witch. Carrie told them that the Tear Lake had been polluted. Whenever a day passed, an unknown shadow would come to devour new shards in the lake. As a result, all cats kept losing memories of the previous day, and the time at Far Star kept being rewound. To make things worse, the shadow was spreading in the lake. If this went on, all the cats' memories would be eaten up, the time at Far Star would stop forever, and the entire continent would stop functioning.
Carrie led the Adventurer and Abby to the bottom of the Tear Lake, where all memory shards of the cats were stored. Taluemp the dragon, guardian of the Far Star Continent, also lived there. Memories were the source of this small dragon's vitality. Due to memories being devoured by the shadow, it had weakened significantly.
Just then, the shadow burst in and attacked the Adventurer's crew, kidnapping Abby, while the dragon fell into a coma trying to protect the Adventurer. To save Abby and wake the small dragon, the Adventurer and Carrie followed the shadow to the Ice Cream Cave near the forest.
2831456:
In the Ice Cream Cave, the adventurer and Carly found the shadow, and Abby was also bound by it. After rescuing Abby, the adventurer reclaimed the devoured memory fragments, and the shadow took the opportunity to escape. The adventurer wanted to investigate, but to no avail.

Under Carly's guidance, the adventurer awakened the little dragon by restoring the memory fragments. Then, the three cats held a purification ceremony to try to completely eliminate the remaining shadows at the bottom of the lake. However, just as the ceremony was about to be completed, Abby attacked the adventurer and Carly, almost destroying the ceremony.

At the last moment, the little dragon saved the adventurer again. Abby was defeated and began to flee, when the familiar shadow appeared behind him. It turned out that as early as when Abby was saved by the adventurer, he had already become a puppet of the shadow...

Discovering that Abby was controlled by the shadow, the adventurer and Carly were extremely anxious. At this time, the little dragon had regained its strength through the purification ceremony. It helped the adventurer track down the traces of the shadow, which turned out to be on Dorado Island.
2831457:
The adventurers and Carrie hurried to the island and discovered Abby, who was being controlled. With their efforts, Abby regained her self-awareness. As the shadow lost its attachment, it gradually revealed its true appearance - the Shadow of Morroc, the Demon King from another world.

It turned out that Morroc's main body was imprisoned in the human continent, and the opening of the Candy Slide resonated with its magic. This enabled the Shadow of Morroc to sneak into the distant star and try to absorb the power necessary to break the seal of its main body.

Seeing its plan exposed, the Shadow of Morroc quickly left the distant star continent through the Candy Slide. Carrie then restored all the devoured memory fragments. Time continued to flow on the far star, and the adventurers decided to stop the demon king from causing more harm. They went to the MeadGale continent through the Candy Slide.

At Prontera South Gate, the adventurers met Cenia. At this time, the seal of Morroc on the human continent had loosened, and Baphomet, the demon, wanted to destroy the seal to revive the demon king. It became crucial to eliminate Baphomet, and Cenia was investigating the matter. Realizing that the two had a common goal - to prevent Morroc's resurrection, the adventurer decided to help the humans and eliminate the demon Baphomet. So, the adventurers followed Cenia to Payon, where they had the latest clue about Baphomet...
2831458:
A shaky barrier, ancient goat-horned monsters, and abnormal happenings brought the Adventurer, a newcomer, to the Louen Kingdom. Your allies will become your strength, and your faith will support you, but what is it that you want to protect?
After meeting with Morgan, the Adventurer set off for Morroc. General Barlaud stationed in Morroc told the Adventurer about the crisis they were facing — Baphomet planned to destroy the seal of Morroc the Demon King from six hundred years ago. If Morroc woke up, the world would be destroyed. Since it was an emergency, after repelling monsters causing trouble around Morroc, the Adventurer went to Hayward the Whitesmith and requested him to forge a powerful vessel for enchantment.
When everything was ready, the Adventurer had Greta guide him to the pyramid to meet Healueman.
2831459:
At the dim pyramid, Healueman told the Adventurer that to stop Baphomet, he needed to go to the Sealed Room at once.
The Adventurer thus started to prepare for wakening the altar, and his assistant was his friend Cenia, who only reunited with him recently. After the two struggled to defeat the Orc Hero and Molina, they could finally enable the altar of the Sealed Room. Still, they were too late. The city of Morroc was already captured by monsters led by Baphomet, and much of the city had been reduced to ruins.
To fight a final battle, the Adventurer went to Prontera and called for a large number of reinforcements, and decided to break into the Sealed Room covered by everyone to face Baphomet the evil fallen angel alone.
2831460:
What surprised the adventurer was that his companions had accompanied him to the final battlefield. Although the crisis had come, none of them backed down. They would accompany the adventurer until the last moment of the war. In the battle, the adventurer enchanted his weapon several times but still couldn't defeat the powerful Baphomet. 

In the end, to protect the world, the adventurer decided to use An Yimir's Heart Shards, sacrificing himself to defeat and seal the evil Baphomet and preventing the resurrection of the Demon Lord Morroc. The brave adventurer defeated the demon, fighting for honor and love. His heroic actions shocked the guild masters, who confirmed once again that the adventurer was the "Wind of Fate" prophesied to save the world.

With admiration and hope, the masters used the power of the Goddess's Tears to revive the sacrificed adventurer.

Awakened, the adventurer showed a smile, fearless of the future darkness, and with his courage, returned to where his adventure began.
2831461:
Soon after the battle at Morroc, the Adventurer was sent by Louen Kingdom's official of internal affairs to the eastern village of Payon. According to the leader of the dispatched team, a mysterious man in black and monsters had been launching attacks near Payon. Because the villagers of Payon had always rejected outsiders, the commander of Payon refused to cooperate with the dispatched team.
To gain the commander's acknowledgement, the Adventurer changed into Payon clothes. Then he heard from Hawkham, a former subordinate of the commander, that the commander had used "the forbidden power," which caused a dramatic change in his personality.
They went to the commander's residence again, only to find the place attacked by the man in black. After a fight, the commander finally agreed to trust the Adventurer, and told him that the cause of the string of incidents was the man in black trying to rob Payon's treasure.
2831462:
To hunt down the man in black, the Adventurer went to the Payon Forest and carried out an investigation with Eremes, Deeven, Dawin, and Kinshin, and finally found that the treasure of Payon was actually a shard of the mythic Yimir's heart, while the man in black was actually one of the twelve saints of "Hand of Goddess," Himmelmez, as he called himself.
Himmelmez injured Kinshin, and headed for the commander's residence in another attempt to rob the treasure. Although the Adventurer managed to stop Himmelmez in time, their companion Kinshin unfortunately died. With mixed feelings, the commander revealed the truth, and decided to leave Yimir's heart in the care of Dawin.
After the incidents at Payon, the kingdom's official of internal affairs sent the Adventurer to check out the village of orcs. Many weapons of the knight order stationed there were missing. The Adventurer found that the weapons were actually stollen by orcs. The usually innocent orcs seemed to be conspiring something. To find out the truth, the Adventurer and the three Starlight brothers launched a thorough investigation, during which they rescued many human villagers imprisoned by orcs, and found that the culprit behind orcs was actually a certain human. After they defeated Albany, an elderly of the orc village, the latter disclosed that the guilty party was no other than Hand of Goddess, and the culprit this time was an evil mage named Hoge. His purpose was actually to persuade the orcs to attack human villages. After a tough battle, the Adventurer defeated the bewitched orc leader and Hoge the evil mage, and repelled Hand of Goddess, temporarily preventing their conspiracy from bearing more fruits.
2831463:
After leaving the orc village, the Adventurer was sent to the Kordt Forest a short distance away to investigate the weird incident where the Ecclesia was attacked by a kobold at Kordt Forest. According to Reyen, headmaster of the Magic Academy, there seemed to be something that "shouldn't be there" in the Kordt Forest…
Therefore, the Adventurer went deep into the forest to meet fellow mages Katerina and Laurell Weinder. Following the clues in a mysterious letter sent to the Magic Academy, the Adventurer identified its sender as a descendant of the kobold seer, the kind Tyre. Tyre told the Adventurer that Hand of Goddess was responsible for the case here too. They offered to remove Morroc's curse for the kobolds, but what they really did was to persuade the kobolds to revive the dead seer, so as to take "Yasuhakka," treasure of the kobolds for some secret aim.
After rescuing three righteous kobold allies, the Adventurer found Los Rabil, this time's culprit, at the altar. Persuaded by Los, the kobold leader revived the first kobold seer, who had lost his humanity.
Although the seer and the kobold leader were brought under control thanks to the timely help from the Magic Academy, "Yasuhakka" was actually a shard of Yimir's heart! Assisted by the seer, Los Rabil managed to take the activated shard of Yimir's heart, and escaped the scene covered by Himmelmez. The Magic Academy removed the curses on kobolds, and realized that the next target of Hand of Goddess was actually the dangerous ancient city Glast Heim...!?
Himmelmez and Hand of Goddess captured the ancient city, and were rallying their undead legion. Healueman decided to assemble numerous forces and build an alliance to thwart Hand of Goddess's scheme. Mages of Geffen and the hunter guild of Payon decided to join the alliance. So did Dawin, who wanted to revenge on Himmelmez. Crest Alliance Army was thus formed, led by Healueman the army commander.
2831464:
The alliance was attacked by unknown enemies in the Glast Heim outskirt. The soldiers testified that the attackers wore black armor and used powerful holy light.
They were the Black Army consisting of formidable Valkyrie epic spirits. They took supplies of the alliance to stop the human alliance from entering Glast Heim. Their task was to stop anyone from entering Glast Heim and monsters inside from getting out.
Just then, Himmelmez seized Laurell Weinder, and claimed that he would use Laurell Weinder as a sacrifice to wake up Dark Lord, the undead demon long asleep! The Black Army pursued Himmelmez, and the Adventurer and the alliance looked for Laurell Weinder together.
However, Himmelmez had already used Laurell Weinder's magic-abundant body and dragons in the Dragon Area as sacrifices to produce an evil magic array for summoning. The alliance, the Black Army, and dragons, three parties usually incompatible with each other, joined hands at this moment and rescued Laurell Weinder.
However, it was too late. Laurell Weinder's soul had been extracted, and the summoning rite was completed. Dark Lord reappeared on the continent. Himmelmez escaped amid the chaos. The Black Army pursued, while the alliance retreated to the edge of the Glast Heim outskirt, waiting for Prontera to send them more reinforcements to attack the city again.
2831465:
Laurell Weinder's soul is several times purer than that of ordinary people, making it a feast for the King of Darkness and the King of Illusion.
Laurell Weinder's soul was divided into three parts by them, and if these three parts of the soul cannot be rescued in time, Laurell Weinder will be in danger of losing his life!
On the other hand, LISA is looking for an object filled with the foul smell of the sewer, she wants to use it to sense the specific location of the sewer and establish a teleportation channel.
2831466: The adventurer accidentally obtained the item LISA needed and helped her establish a connection to the sewer, opening the teleportation channel. However, during the process of securing the teleportation channel, the adventurer was targeted by the King of Illusions for his pure soul. If it wasn't for LISA teleporting the adventurer out in time, he might have become the second Laurell Weinder. Unafraid of danger, the adventurer continued to help LISA open teleportation channels to other areas of the ancient city. However, gradually, LISA discovered that the magical fluctuations she was transmitting were cut off in a certain area, as if they had been swallowed up.
2831468:
The Gold Clock that contained the power of Yimir's shard had maintained order of time and space in Al De Baran for a hundred years.
However, peace was disrupted by an unknown party, who stole the Secret Book, the only item that could unlock the Gold Clock. The incident put Mosman, leader of Clock Guardians, on high alert. He sent two excellent Clock Guards: Norman and his brother Reed, as well as the Adventurer to look into it together.
The Adventurer found that the guardian of the Secret Book died from an ancient snake venom. A series of investigation gradually brought the truth to light...
The culprit behind all the incidents was actually Jörmungandr, the mythic Serpent of World! He was determined to get the Gold Clock and use its tremendous power to free his brother, Fenrir the monstrous wolf, who was confined on the moon.
Jörmungandr had long been lurking among the Clock Guards. He sowed the seeds for the battle among the Clock Guards with schemes.
2831469:
Norman, who was looking for Reed, sneaked into the stronghold of the rebels on the bottom floor of the clock tower with the Adventurer. After a fierce battle, Norman managed to free Reed, at the cost of being badly injured himself.
However, the situation then got worse. Jörmungandr attempted to seize the Miracle Ball, a treasure invented by Weekes, and use it to create a huge wormhole to cause more chaos. More shockingly, the Adventurer investigated Reed and found that he was actually Jörmungandr — Serpent of World himself.
After he successfully laid his hands on the Miracle Ball, Jörmungandr broke the time and space barrier to the past, and summoned the horrible Ancient Baphomet. However, not even himself had expected that the Ancient Baphomet would ignore orders and attack its summoner! Despite being deceived, Norman had always regarded Jörmungandr as his younger brother, and protected him with his own body.
This action caused Jörmungandr to waver. He joined the Adventurer in defeating the Ancient Baphomet, and promised the dying Norman that he would protect the Gold Clock. But the story wasn't going to end there, because Al De Baran's nightmare showed no sign of finishing...
Norman's death prompted Jörmungandr to give up the Gold Clock, but the distortion of time and space was worsening. The Miracle Ball lost control and opened a wormhole to an otherworld, causing Jörmungandr to meet himself of another worldline.
The Jörmungandr from another worldline managed to seize the Gold Clock. Indulged in his power, he forgot his purpose of saving his brother. In the end, he abandoned his old name and renamed himself as Recurrent Nightmare! Longing for even more power, he invaded the human world…
To honor the promise between him and Norman, Jörmungandr refused to team with Recurrent Nightmare, and formed an alliance with his old enemies: the Clock Guardians and the Alchemist Guild. They traveled to the worldline of Recurrent Nightmare and found him before the clock tower collapsed. A battle was imminent!
2831470:
At the critical moment when the Al De Baran united front was at a disadvantage, Norman's Pocket Watch emitted a dazzling light, which gave Yemengade and the adventurers the courage to repel the nightmare of reincarnation. Everyone used the power of space and time debris to permanently seal the black hole. The melodious bell once again echoed in the streets and alleys, and Al De Baran regained its peace.

After the dust settled, the alliance between Clock Guard and Yemengade also came to an end. Mersman did not stop him from taking away the singularity ball. Yemengade showed an elusive smile and disappeared into the crowd by the canal. "I think he's not that bad." Faced with questioning voices, Mersman pondered.

But who can really guess his true intentions? Closing the pocket watch in his hand, Yemengade looked up at the lonely moon in the sky, and the righteous and evil deity continued on his journey to save his elder brother.
2831471:
Adventurers came to the fantasy land - Gingerbread City with full of expectations, but at this moment, Gingerbread City was in crisis. The children in the city were missing one by one...

In order to find out the truth of the incident, the adventurer accompanied the little girl Jenny to watch the circus performance and met the Red Nose Clown Gale from the circus troupe. They joined forces to defeat the suddenly enchanted performers.

The adventurer and Santa Claus, after analyzing the clues, realized that these circus performers were the missing children of Gingerbread City! And behind everything that is happening now, there is the puppet wizard of the Goddess - Bijou.

Sixty years ago in winter, the young Gale was brought to Gingerbread City by Bijou. Since then, Bijou has been planning to use Gale to snatch the An Yimir's Heart Shards in Gingerbread City.
2831472:
Santa Claus told the truth to Gingerbread City's residents, and had everyone assemble to confront Gale and Bijou together. Just then, the Adventurer noticed that Jenny was also missing!
The Adventurer asked Jenny's family at once, but unexpectedly heard from Betty, Jenny's grandmother, that Jenny and Gale used to be good friends when they were little.
Familiar with Gale, Betty helped the Adventurer discover him in the circus tent, but Jenny was still nowhere to be found, and Gale actually escaped with the help of Bijou.
2831473:
After some adjustments and preparations, the adventurer decided to go to the circus again to rescue the children. This time the operation was successful, but Jenny was taken away by Gale before the adventurer arrived. 

The rescued children told the adventurer that Gale was not as bad as everyone thought. He had never hurt the children, and everything he did was under Bijou's instigation to attract Betty's attention. 

Santa Claus guessed that Gale took Jenny away because he mistook her for Betty, as that was the most unforgettable beautiful memory in his mind. 

At this moment, Bijou realized that Betty was the only one who could stop Gale and destroy her plan. So she hurriedly sent puppets to attack Betty, trying to drive Betty out of Gingerbread City.
2831474:
However, during the attack, Betty regained her lost memory and insisted on going to the circus with the adventurers and found Gale with the help of her memory. Finally recognizing her from Betty's calling out, Gale apologized for not being able to fulfill their childhood promise, and told her about how Bijou had killed her parents, causing her to be unable to return to Gingerbread City.

Gale then realized that it was all Bijou's scheme and finally came to his senses. Angrily and embarrassed, Bijou attacked, but the adventurers helped them defeat Bijou and protect Gingerbread City. 

Everything was over, the crisis was successfully resolved, and the children returned to their homes. Gale and Betty left together, and no one knew where they went. However, it was certain that, as they had promised when they were children, they would hold hands, accompany each other, and never be apart.
2831475:
The captain of Byalan Island has opened a new route to the Land of Heavenly Water, and adventurers are longing for the beautiful Cherry Blossom City and take a boat to Amatsu. 

Upon arriving in Amatsu, the adventurer encounters an old acquaintance - the mage Morgan. At this time, Morgan amazes the adventurer as he is drunk, wearing a female kimono, and dancing in the Cherry Blossom Miss Selection Competition. 

While talking to Morgan, a young man named Ida Hideaki appears, stopping Morgan's commotion. Morgan, however, is frightened by the sudden appearance of a "female ghost" and faints. Knowing that the adventurer and Morgan are not ordinary people, Hideaki asks for their help.
2831476:
Just as the Adventurer was talking to Morgan, a boy called Ida Hideaki showed up and tried to quiet the loud Morgan, but Morgan fainted upon seeing the "female ghost" that popped up. Knowing that the Adventurer and Morgan were no ordinary people, Hideaki asked them for a favor.
However, the scroll was kept by the shrine maiden, which was Hideaki's elder sister Ida Chiyoko. Hideaki was the last person she wanted to lend the scroll to.
Morgan went to borrow the spell scroll, disguised as a shrine maiden, but Chiyoko recognized him. Hideaki had to find another way. He used the Adventurer to distract Chiyoko when he stole the scroll. Only then did the Adventurer realize that Hideaki had been deceiving him, but fate had already started to move in the direction Chiyoko tried to avoid...
After Hideaki ran away with the scroll, Sakura appeared, and told the Adventurer that she was losing her power and would soon vanish, and that Hideaki did all of this to protect her.
Hideaki wanted to use a large-scale spirit gathering spell in the scroll to gather all the spirits across Heavenwater to replenish Sakura's power.
However, the kind Sakura didn't want to sacrifice those spirits to extend her own life. She hoped Chiyoko and the Adventurer could stop Hideaki from gathering the spirits.
2831477:
Meanwhile, Hideaki was preparing for the massive spirit-gathering ritual. With the help of Chiyoko, the Adventurer destroyed Hideaki's magic array, but it was a fake. Hideaki used the real spell in a barrier!
Chiyoko and the Adventurer were too late. The ritual had already begun! However, Sakura couldn't absorb so much power. Overloaded with spirits, she lost her mind and turned into a horrible monster. Chiyoko and the Adventurer were no longer able to stop her.
The gathered spirits returned to the afterworld with the help of the Adventurer, and the withered sakura trees blossomed one after another. Heavenwater regained its previous beauty.
It turned out that Hideaki had been sickly since he was young, and Sakura drained her power to treat him. Only then did Hideaki realize how naive he was. He thought he was doing the right thing, but he ended up turning Sakura into what she was then.
Morgan was carrying a magic orb that could grant the two a wish. Sakura hoped to heal Hideaki with what remained of her power, and make him forget her so that he could embrace a bright future, while Hideaki wanted to give his power back to Sakura. Even if he would die in five years, it would be the happiest five years in his life.
Both looked eagerly at the Adventurer, who had the right to decide... Let the two lovers enjoy momentary happiness and a known future, or erase their memories and leave them in wait for an unguaranteed reunion? Which one would you choose?
2831478:
After accepting the quest to escort the Book of Yimir from Siv the sage, Cenia and the Adventurer set out for Yuno, but a mutated monster called Soth popped up. Capable of commanding monsters, he attempted to kidnap the Adventurer!
Just as everyone was engaged in a tough battle against Soth, Yuno's special guards — the Twilight Squad arrived. Siren, captain of the Twilight Squad, drew his sword and drove Soth away. Then, Siren was surprised to discover that the necklace his father left him was emitting light. Before he could figure out why, Soth got up in pain and escaped the Border Checkpoint.
After the Book of Yimir arrived in Yuno safely, worried about Soth's threatening power, Karl the president of Yuno ordered Siren to activate the Crystal of Heimdall at the center of the plaza — the power of this crystal could protect Yuno against monster assaults.
Cenia and the Adventurer got the key to the crystal from Rekenber Co., but to their surprise, the Heimdall couldn't be activated! And to make things worse, when everyone was at a loss about what to do with the crystal, an alarm went off outside of the city — a large army of monsters were attacking, led by no other than the dreadful Soth! Tasked with handling this crisis, the Adventurer repelled the monsters invading Yuno, while Siren launched a duel with Soth. Weirdly, Soth and his monsters left Yuno in a hurry without resisting Siren.
This strange action of Soth aroused doubt in Siren. To reveal the truth, Cenia and the Adventurer took the hair dropped by Soth to the Monster Laboratory. With the technology of Rekenber Co., they peeped into Soth's memories, and were surprised to find that Soth used to be an ordinary human! If so, how did he end up like this? And more mysteriously, who created Soth the monster? What was this culprit secretly conspiring?
2831479:
The investigation on Soth had just seen some progress when President Karl placed the whole city under martial law. The clever Cenia sneaked through all the passes into the Magma Dungeon to look for the missing Adventurer. They unexpectedly discovered that the confined hostages were not only unharmed, but also given adequate food.
President Karl back in the city of Yuno secretly handed Siren a note with an encrypted message. It turned out that Rekenber's influence in Yuno was so great that he could only summon his hidden force with encrypted messages to rescue the hostages. That hidden force was the Wing of Secret, an underground opposition group consisting of elite adventurers from the Louen Kingdom and Republic of Schwartzvald. The adventurer assembled Seyren and his squad — reinforcement under Wing of Secret, and the secret operation of hostage rescuing at the Magma Dungeon was fully prepared!
Although the hostage rescuing went smoothly, Soth the key enemy was nowhere to be found. Siren thought that his missing father was among the hostages kidnapped by Soth, and he regained hope of reuniting with his father. The team of six did a covert investigation and all clues suggested that the secret research of Bauff, a researcher of Rekenber was deeply connected with Soth. Soth had probably kidnapped the innocent hostages following Bauff's order. Enraged, Siren went to Rekenber's lab to condemn Bauff, only to get an unbelievable answer: Siren's father was killed by Soth long ago. Eager to avenge his father, Siren headed to Soth's nest alone.
When the rest of the crew arrived at Soth's nest, they found the battle one-sided. No matter how Siren attacked, the powerful Soth showed no willingness to fight back. Overwhelmed by anger and hatred, though, Siren drew the dagger his father left him, and landed the final blow on Soth without hesitation. Soth, gravely injured, let out a painful cry and dropped heavily onto the ground. A familiar necklace fell from Soth. Siren was confused to find it exactly the same as the one around his own neck. In his last moment, Soth's words shocked everyone present: "Siren… my son..." Siren hit Soth crazily as he murmured, but Soth would never wake up again. He couldn't accept the fact that Soth was actually his long-missing father himself!
2831480:
Siren went to Bauff's office, only to find it abandoned. His only discovery was an empty notebook. Siv, headmaster of the Sage Academy, helped to reveal invisible words in the notebook. The clue suggested that Bauff had Siren's father abduct numerous adventurers to experiment on, but after Soth met Siren, he regained his conscious as a human, and freed the captured adventurers without permission. To get rid of the then worthless Soth, the vicious Bauff took advantage of how Siren missed his father and sowed discord, so that Siren would kill his father.
Just then, the observant team of six found a hidden entrance to Bauff's underground laboratory. To figure out the conspiracy that threatened Yuno, the crew entered Bauff's underground laboratory together. However, the cunning Bauff was already waiting for them. He released many mutated monsters. Siren and the team of six focused fire and broke through the monsters' encirclement, landing a fatal strike on Bauff. Before he died, Bauff clamored arrogantly that he was but one of the countless illusions.
Everyone had thought that once Bauff was defeated, the monsters would have no one to lead them and retreat. However, the monsters actually started to gather again, loyally carrying out Bauff's final order — destroy the Crystal of Heimdall! A myriad of monsters ran rampant over Yuno's streets, turning the city of sky into a horrible hell.
Outnumbered, the people could only stare as the monsters flocked to the crystal. Would the last hope of Yuno break apart just like the crystal? Just before their claws landed on the crystal, the Adventurer finally activated the crystal completely! The dazzling holy light emitted by Heimdall formed a white barrier over Yuno, felling mutated monsters in it one after another, restoring them to humans. The monsters' siege against Yuno was finally ended!
Although the crisis in Yuno was removed, the president's hypothesis remained unproved. Was the guilty party hiding in Rekenber Co.? To reveal the dark truth most deeply hidden, Cenia and the team of six set out for Rekenber's lab.
When Siren bid goodbye to the Adventurer, Katerina, who had long left the team of six, suddenly appeared. She whispered something to Siren and went off in a hurry. Siren's face distorted, and repeatedly told the Adventurer that he was going to save his father. The next moment, he leaped off Yuno, a city high in the air... Although the incident at Yuno was solved, those deeply involved didn't expect that an even larger storm of fate was yet to come.
2831481:
Warlocks of Louen Kingdom found that, for some unknown reason, souls at Niflheim, Town of the Dead, were stuck and could not reincarnate, which severely undermined balance of the world. The Adventurer was tasked with its investigation. He went to Umbala, and obtained Yggdrasil's Force of Life with the help of Rainwood's chief. He leaped off the tree hole without hesitation, and entered an unknown world...
The Adventurer woke up at Niflheim, where he unexpectedly reunited with the missing Siren, and got to know Wallace the bar owner and Vik the witch. Siren was here to save his father's soul. Since they shared the purpose of freeing trapped souls, they decided to cooperate again.
