To bring all the six knight commanders together, the crew decided to go to the Merit Sanctuary for Lichtenlade the Guard Order commander, only to find Curse Orbs there too. This meant that the capital city may have been infiltrated. After removing the Curse Orbs, Lichtenlade told Heinrich and Schmidt that he heard weird noises near the Merit Sanctuary when patrolling, and the Curse Orbs were already there when he arrived. That was all he knew.
After thinking for a while, Heinrich said that the area was equipped with "Kingdom Eyes," the latest monitoring devices developed by the empire. If they retrieve these devices and watch the footages recorded, they might find the truth. However, soon after the Adventurer retrieved all the Kingdom Eyes in the area and handed them to Heinrich, corrupted imperial guards popped up from nowhere and attempted to destroy the Kingdom Eyes.
Although the crew managed to defeat the corrupted imperial guards together, they were sent away by a magic array in the last moment, and the Kingdom Eyes were also affected, leaving the footages incomplete. The footages showed Amdarais appearing at the Merit Sanctuary, placing the Curse Orbs, and disappearing after called by Himmelmez. However, how Amdarais broke into the empire and where it had been hiding remained unknown.
Heinrich then recalled the Merit Sanctuary to be the venue of Schmidt's military parade. It might provide clues to how Schmidt went missing. Schmidt recalled that Mana Sniffers, who fed on magic power, appeared there during the parade. Heinrich thus deemed time-and-space magic the cause of Schmidt's disappearance. The culprit made a precise calculation for the magic to be triggered exactly when the clock struck. The crew followed the traces of magic to the clock tower of Louen, where ominous black smoke was rising, and corrupted knights surrounded innocent civilians...
When removing the Curse Orbs, a knight suffered fatal injuries to protect civilians. In his final moments, he begged the king to send his child out of this dangerous place, saddening Schmidt. Too much blood had been shed. The only thing he could do was to find all six knight commanders as soon as possible and open the Room of Throne. Knight Commander Lichtenlade agreed to sit on the throne, but requested the king to restore the clock tower first, because it meant a lot to him. Schmidt accepted the condition.
They somehow gathered the tools and parts, and Heinrich repaired the clock in person. The imposing tune ringed again, only to attract corrupted royal guards. Before he was defeated, a royal guard who seemed to have some conscious left tried to say something, but a magic array appeared beneath him and he also disappeared right in front of everyone. It enraged Heinrich. In addition, Heinrich found when repairing the clock tower that the used magic talisman on the movement was developed by Battmond the great sage. It turned out that someone sneaked into Battmond's lab the day before the military parade. They may be the traitor hiding in the capital city.
Schmidt found Lichtenlade and asked him to go to the Room of Throne as promised, when he saw a sorrowful young man beside Lichtenlade. He was the son of the knight who died saving civilians. Schmidt had to make a decision: Whether to follow the final words of the knight and send his son away from the battlefield, or let the child follow in his father's footsteps and become a knight as he wished? The decision would apparently change the young man's fate. After the Adventurer helped Schmidt make the decision, Lichtenlade went to the Room of Throne, and sat on the throne.
The next knight to be found was Stetin Richard, who was assisting the church in building makeshift shelters at the Holy Spring Chapel. Schmidt and the Adventurer went to the chapel and saw the sarcastic Stetin. As a typical noble, Stetin frowned upon the commoner-favoring Schmidt, and refused to listen to what Schmidt had to say until the shelters were finished.
 The Adventurer and Schmidt had to run around to open the doors to the underground shelter. After the shelter was ready, Schmidt negotiated with Stetin, asking him to sit on the throne. However, a researcher eavesdropping on the side suddenly lashed out at Schmidt, accusing him of letting the Dark Legion in. He claimed that by opening Room of Throne's gate, Schmidt was trying to unleash a horrible forbidden power and kill everyone. The uninformed people were incited and began to call Schmidt a tyrant. Even the high priest asked Schmidt to kneel down in front of the god statue and pray for leniency at once.
Hardly had the high priest finished when black aura started to come out of him, indicating that he was also infected. Schmidt's crew had to eliminate him, but just like those before him, the corrupted high priest was teleported away right before the final blow landed on him. The civilians interpreted this sight as Schmidt silencing the high priest. The crowd shouted "tyrant" repeatedly at Schmidt. Just then, Stetin stepped up and stood in front of Schmidt with a sword, demanding that the crowd see what Schmidt had done for them.
Out of fear, the people fell silent temporarily, when a scout knight brought news about a large force of the Dark Legion gathering in front of the city gate, seemingly for a siege. Schmidt, Heinrich and Stetin headed to the city gate to confront them. The Adventurer helped them with the preparation, getting abundant ammo and pacifying children in the city. They fought a hard battle defending the city, and managed to repel the Dark Legion. The knights cheered in joy, and Schmidt smiled.
Just then, however, a knight stationed in the city came with the news of a large Dark Legion force appearing inside the city. Stetin and the Adventurer hurried to handle it. They followed the traces of the Dark Legion to the floodgates of the moat, and found Amdarais and the royal guards, imperial guards and high priest being teleported away earlier, who have completely turned into monsters. The Adventurer and Stetin defeated Amdarais together, but the latter somehow managed to get away in the end, leaving only a mess and a little girl whose arm was corrupted by the power of death.
It was only when treating the little girl that the Adventurer recognized her as the sinful Bijou. Schmidt and Stetin had different attitudes. Stetin thought that people shouldn't be punished for crimes they hadn't committed yet, while Schmidt wanted to avoid risk so that innocent lives wouldn't be lost in the future. After the Adventurer helped Schmidt make the future-changing decision, Stetin went to the Room of Throne and sat on the throne.
Stetin warned the rest against setting their hopes completely on "Alice," and suggested attacking instead of waiting passively for the enemies to make a move. Schally, commander of the Scout Order, was on the outskirts trying to recapture the watchtower and messenger station. Schmidt agreed with Stetin, and went to the outskirts with the Adventurer, where they met Schally, who was just like a younger brother to Schmidt.
The crew managed to defeat the monsters and the Dark Legion at the city gate and reopen the Triumphal Arch gate. Just as the defense barriers were reactivated, Corruption Root — a monster with eyes and tentacles all over it — appeared and attacked the piers roaring. Although the Adventurer and the others managed to heavily injure and repel the Corruption Root, the sight of its back seemed to remind Schmidt of something, and the Adventurer also saw a curious vision: Exhausted workers collapsing at the foot of Glast Heim's walls...
The Adventurer told Schally and Schmidt about the vision. Schally didn't comment on it, while Schmidt told Adventurer frankly that it was all his fault, and Glast Heim was built on flesh, blood and sacrifice. The conversation depressed Schmidt. After a discussion with Schally, the Adventurer began to restore the outskirts and place Kingdom Eyes around the watchtower to collect more intel about the Dark Legion. Then, the Corruption Root attacked again, as if to destroy both the Kingdom Eye terminal and the Watchtower of Wind.
Defeated again, the Corruption Root fled once more. Schally analyzed with the terminal and concluded that the Corruption Root headed to Dragonslumber Hill, where the Dark Legion was also hiding. They must recapture Dragonslumber Hill.
To be prudent, the Scout Order knights changed into the mimicry armor with the help of the Adventurer. The armor was developed by Battmond and could disguise them as Dracos. They then went to the cemetery at Dragonslumber Hill, and found the shrunken and weak Corruption Root. Just when the Adventurer was about to kill the Corruption Root, he heard countless resentful curses, and the crew saw visions of the deceased.
It turned out that the Corruption Root was born from the grudge of workers died building Glast Heim. Back then, Schmidt and Heinrich were away fighting wars. Nobles back in the kingdom seized the chance to embezzle funds, causing a large number of workers to die from exhaustion. When Schmidt found out what was going on, it was too late. Schmidt blamed the tragedy on himself, but to protect those still alive, he decided to face the situation and even request assistance from the nobles he hated, in order to save the civilians of Glast Heim.
Led by the resolute and silent Schmidt, the knights pushed forward to the messenger station of the capital city, where they would pick the best scout knights to deliver the request for reinforcements to Prontera. The Adventurer helped the three messenger knights get ready, but the Dark Legion noticed their intention, and blocked roads to the outside. Schmidt decided to be the bait so that the messenger knights could get through. The knights, however, refused to risk their king. Instead, they passed on hope with their own lives.
Schmidt and the knights fought the Dark Legion, and opened a path for the messenger knights. The Corruption Root appeared again, but Schmidt was no longer at a loss. "I'll shoulder my previous sins, but I must guide everyone to the future!" He whispered this to himself, as he penetrated the Corruption Root with his sword. The Corruption Root finally disappeared, and the three messenger knights seized the opportunity to get through.
The knights had kept the messenger station, recaptured the outskirts, and sent the reinforcement request. Schally followed Schmidt back to the Room of Throne. Now that all the six knight commanders were present, Schmidt ordered to open the gate of hope. However, the gate remained shut while all the knight commanders were trapped on their thrones. Himmelmez, who had long been missing, showed up and killed two knight commanders with her sword. The crew roared but couldn't do anything about it. Himmelmez laughed at Schmidt's powerlessness.
Just then, Heinrich came and defeated Himmelmez with the Adventurer. Although Himmelmez left, the Room of Throne couldn't be opened now that they'd lost two knight commanders. Everyone was about to succumb to despair when Schmidt and Heinrich exchanged a look and shouted in sync — "Honore!"

2. Valhalla Ruins has 6 levels, each with two difficulties: Warrior and Elite. Five new monsters spawn in each level once a week.

3449641: Kelly was the youngest, but quite brave. She had much explosive strength.
3449643: Cindy was a new recruit of the Khalitzburg Knights, but she fought so resolutely...
3449645: Dera's sword was always faster than her words. Her moves were the swiftest!
3449648: Thank you for everything you did...
3449649: Sharelle is never afraid. If you find me one day, please write an epitaph for me as well.
3449651: Don't tell me yet... Save it for that day. The finale of a knight's life should be set on the battlefield. Goodbye.

3449654: After that, I joined the Khalitzburg Knights under her influence and became the lieutenant of the 3rd Division.
3449655: Louen's pride and flowers... It was my moral support. Commander Khalitzburg gave me life and faith.
3449656: But recently, Himmelmez came to me... and asked me to betray the Khalitzburg Knights!
3449658: Yes, she restored my memories... and I found out that I was a trusted subordinate Himmelmez trained... and my real name is Casey.
3449659: I used to serve Himmelmez. It... caused me to waver.
3449660: The superior who I was trained by and served, and the benefactor who gave me moral support. Who should I choose?
3449662: When the commander gave me a name, she also gave me a blue rose. It's right there. Please bring it back to me.
3449663: When Commander Khalitzburg gave me this petal, we had a match, and she named me "Cristine."
3449665: If only I was so resolute back then.
3449666: I betrayed the Khalitzburg Knights I led... They were killed by Himmelmez's powers and became zombies.
3449667: I know I deserve death... Kill me!
3449669: Right... I can still do something for them to make up for my mistake.
3449670: The only thing possible now is to bid them farewell properly.
3449672: I won't kill you. If you believe that you're Cristine, die on the battlefield fighting Himmelmez's force!
3449675: Help me... I'm surrounded by zombies.
3449676: This undeserved disaster should end here!
3449678: Recently, Himmelmez's force encircled the Khalitzburg Knights' 4th Division!

3449685: "Expel darkness, and clear up the confusion. Open your eyes and face the light."
3449687: There are traitors among the Khalitzburg knights. Protect Alice! Protect...

3449694: I never thought about her before, because I hated her.
3449695: She took away my right to become a knight...

3449697: She left a letter, saying that I should stay safe and she will be the one risking her life. What right did she have to decide for me? Being a knight was our shared wish.
3449698: How could she force her decision on me in the name of love... Of course, I still became a Khalitzburg knight after trying various means.
3449699: But why am I missing her now? And my heart aches so much when I think about her.

3449701: I rushed over and saved her from a monster. That was the only time.

3449717: Grainger is my elder sister's name, while I am Gwendolyn.
3449718: But I didn't expect her to find another way to become a Khalitzburg knight.
3449720: To be honest, I've been regretting. I wasn't protecting her. I was making her a deserter.
3449721: Because... The battlefield is extending before both of us. I can't pretend forever, can I? I was such a fool.

3449744: I miss him a lot, but I'm still on a mission.

3501014:
1. You can spend specified refinement materials and Zeny to increase Refine Lv. of equipment and boost refinement attributes.
2. Refine Lv. caps at 15. Refine Lv. of equipment from rifts cap at 12.
3.Refinement success rate: 
Lv.1–4: 100%
Lv.5–6: 50%
Lv.7–15: 40%
4. Upon failure, Refine Lv. reduces by 1. Equipment at Refine Lv.4–9 has a 50% chance of being damaged when refinement fails. Equipment at Refine Lv.10–14 is always damaged when refinement fails. You can only refine damaged equipment after repairing it with specified equipment, but damaged equipment can be used normally.
5. For equipment at Refine Lv.4, you can use [Reliable Refinement] (spend a specified number of items, materials and Zeny to guarantee one successful refinement).
6. [Reliable Refinement] requires a certain amount of [Refine Value] to guarantee a Refine Lv. increase for the current equipment.
7. After a reliable refinement, if the Refine value of equipment you put in exceeds the reliable refinement's cost, the exceeded part will be recorded for this equipment.
8. When a piece of equipment reaches Refine+15, its [Refine Value] resets.
9. [Skyfire Shard - Sharp] can be used to repair any weapon.
10. When your home reaches Lv.9, Zeny cost of refinement is reduced by 5%.
3501015:
1. You can spend specified materials and Zeny to upgrade equipment and boost attributes.
2. When upgrading a piece of equipment to T2, the Refine Lv. will drop by 2, the remaining Refine value will be cleared and the equipped card will be removed.
3. Some T2 equipment can be upgraded to T3 equipment. Refining, enchantment and socket stats of the T2 equipment will be carried over to the T3 equipment. Damaged T2 equipment needs to be repaired before tier-up.
4. Refining, repairing, and creating sockets on T3 equipment consume not duplicate equipment, but T2 equipment of the same name.

2. If the purchase fails, Zeny will be returned. 
3. During the pre-order period, the item can't be removed from the Exchange.

1. Combat attempts are shared by all characters on your account.

3501032:
Area 1 - Guardian's Hall
A majestic yet mysterious hall at the starting area of Thanatos Tower. Although the tower is dilapidated, the hall still features magnificent decorations, as if it appeared at the same time as the Valkyrie and the guards. The gate to the next floor of Thanatos Tower is sealed with layers of chains. Rathgricy the Valkyrie's permission is needed to open it.
Area 2 - The Hall of Chains
A region beyond the starting area, it's a solemn hall built by gods. Reportedly a former forbidden territory of the Valkyries, this place is permeated by dense magic, and Louen runes can be seen everywhere. The rune imprints floating on the side contain ancient divine power. They resonate with Tesseract and jointly block the path to the next area.
Area 3 - Will Cage
Lying beyond the Hall of Chains, this area is the manifestation of Thanatos' negative emotions, and what Tesseract truly guards. Will Mentalists representing Thanatos' four negative feelings are trapped here. It's a gloomy, chaotic, and run-down place filled with the smell of despair and death and inhabited by unstable Will Mentalists that constantly affect the entire tower, thus deadly for humans with a weak mind. They may lose their mind the moment they enter.
Area 4 - Sealed Room
The stage of the showdown between Thanatos and the demon king a century ago. As the last region, it sits on top of this tower of doom, hidden in curses. It's the resting place of both Thanatos and Hogne the magic sword. The Adventurer and Siren ventured here through thick and thin to purify the magic sword's curse and save the legendary hero. However, more unknown schemes lie behind the curses permeating this darkness of despair...
Note: Enchantment Vouchers, headwear, mounts, pets, and toys are random drops.

I. Instance Rules
1. Participation rules
It's a 6v6 competition. Participants must be above Lv.90, and each team must have 6 members. 
2. Victory conditions
*The two teams will be collecting resources and competing in a dungeon. The side that gets 4000 Victory Pts first wins right away.
*The instance will last 10 minutes.
*If neither team manages to get 4000 points in 10 minutes, the team with the higher score wins. 
Leaderboard rules:
Players are ranked by Personal Pts (descending). When the scores are the same, the player who achieves the score first ranks higher. When both the score and the achievement time are the same, the player who had a higher score in the last match ranks higher. 
3. Magical Dungeon and Reincarnation Temple
Element Orb
*4 Element Orbs (Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind) will spawn on the 4 corners of the dungeon 30s into the match. Players holding an Element Orb get Victory Pts every 2s.
*Each player can hold up to one Element Orb. A team gets 10, 20, 25, and 30 Victory Pts every 2s when 1, 2, 3, and 4 of its members are holding Element Orbs respectively.
*Orb holders take increased DMG. Each stack increases DMG taken by 5%. The effect stacks up as the player holds on to the orb.
*Orbs undermine their holders' self-control. Orb holders cannot gain invisibility or speed up, and their skills will have CDs.
*Every 2 orbs can be combined to trigger a magic effect that weakens members of the enemy team. The combinations are:
Fire+Water: [Elemental Barrier] Shortens the attack and casting ranges of ordinary enemies by 30%, and attack and casting ranges of enemy orb holders by 40%.
Fire+Earth: [Lava Path] Enemy orb holders lose HP proportionally as they move. The higher their movement speed, the faster they lose HP.
Fire+Wind: [Soul Shackle] Enemy players are constantly slowed down when they approach you.
Water+Earth: [Burn Mana] Enemy skills cost 200% more SP, and enemies lose 1% of their Max SP every 1s.
Water+Wind: [Mana Leak] Enemy orb holders inflict debuffs on their teammates. [Water]: Silences teammates within 5m. [Earth]: Petrifies teammates within 5m. [Wind]: Immobilizes teammates within 5m. [Fire]: Burns teammates within 5m. 
Wind+Earth: [Storm Haze] Inflicts irresistible Dark on the enemies for 1.5s every 5s. Enemy orb holders always have Dark.
*Each combined magic has a 15s CD, during which switching orbs will not change the magic effect.
*Once Team A captures more than 2 orbs, the magic effect it triggered is removed, and Team B can summon the corresponding magic via the [Dungeon Keeper] NPC to counterattack Team A.
*When an orb holder dies, they drop their orb. The magic effect of the combination is removed and the orb is returned to the altar on the map.
Buff orb
*A buff orb spawns at the center of the map 1 minute into the match. After that, it refreshes every 30s. Only orb holders can seize the buff orb and receive 150 Victory Pts and a random buff.
*Possible buffs include:
[Reveal] All allies can detect invisible units. Lasts 10s.
[Damage Boost] The buff holder deals 50% more DMG to orb holders. Lasts 10s
[Speed Up] Orb holders can break speed limit and have their speed increased to 200%. Lasts 10s.
Kill
Whenever an enemy player is killed, the team gets 20 Victory Pts.
4. Go Board
Map
A 3 square by 3 square board. The 8 pieces other than the center piece can be captured by stepping on them or according to piece rules, while the center piece can only be captured according to piece rules.
Piece rules
*Pieces on the four corners are medium capture spots that provide 4 points to their capturer per sec. The pieces at the center of the sides are minor capture spots that provide 2 points to their capturer per sec. The center of the board is a major capture spot that provides 6 points to its capturer per sec.
*Defeating an enemy member earns your team 1 point. The team that scores 4000 points first or has the higher score when the instance closes wins.
*Special rules: For any three pieces in a row, the team that captures the two pieces on the ends automatically captures the piece at the center (the three-in-a-row rule). Minor capture spots captured via the three-in-a-row rule are not lost when the three-in-a-row state is disrupted. The major capture spot can be captured by capturing any of the four rows centered by it, but once any one end of the row is captured by another team, the major capture spot is restored to the state before its latest capture.
Personal Pt
*Defeating an enemy player grants 10 points.
Participating in capturing neutral spots and enemy-captured spots grant 1 point per sec.
II. Ranked Mode Rules and Rewards
1. The Ranked Mode is a season mode. Each season lasts for 5 weeks. In the first four weeks, players earn points from free matchmaking. In the fifth week, players create their own teams to join the Tournament.
2. The ranks are Fighter, Elite, War God, and Legend (ascending order). Each rank unlocks different purchasable headwear items.
3. Winning a match earns you Honor Proofs and Through-war Coins that can be exchanged for headwear, tier-3 mounts of previous sessions, etc.
4. Season results will be calculated after the matches in the fifth week end, and reward tiers will be decided based on Tournament rankings and scores. 
Tier-1 rewards go to the champion team.
Tier-2 rewards go to the runner-up team.
Tier-3 rewards go to the No. 3–No. 8 teams.
Tier-4 rewards go to the No. 9–16 teams.
Tier-5 rewards go to the No. 17–32 teams and players who rank 200 or higher but fail to get the rewards above.
5. Season mode matchmaking rules:
*One matchmaking rank is created every 200 points. A team is first matched against teams of their rank, based on its average score. If no suitable team is found after a while, it will be matched with teams of neighboring ranks. For example, a team with 1900 points will first be matched against teams with 1800 to 2000 points. If failed, it will be matched against teams with 1600 to 2200 points. 
*Teams with 3000+ points belong to the same matchmaking rank. Therefore, once a team's average score reaches 3000 points, it will only be matched against teams with 2800+ points. If no suitable team is found in 30 minutes (max matchmaking time), the matchmaking fails. 
*Quitting the team after the team is matched against an opponent means forfeiting the match. A player who does so loses 100 Season Pts and is banned from matchmaking for 5 minutes. 
*Matchmaking is unavailable when more than 2 players in the team share the same job. Job change is unavailable once matchmaking starts.
6. Season mode score rules:
*Under the season mode, each victory/defeat increases/reduces personal season score accordingly.
*Before your season score reaches 2000, you don't lose points upon failure. As your score increases, you lose more points upon failure. 
*Upon a victory/defeat, if your personal score is beyond 3000, you will only gain/lose 1/10 of the points you are supposed to gain/lose. For example, if you start at 3005 points and win a match, you are supposed to gain 100 points, but you will actually only gain 1/10 of it, making your final score 3015. If you start at 3005 points and lose a match, you will first lose 1/10 of 50 points, which is just enough to bring you down to 3000, and then lose the remaining 50 points, making your final score 2950. If you start at 2950 points and are supposed to gain 100 points, you will gain 50 points first, bringing you up to 3000, and then get 1/10 of the remaining 50 points, making your final score 3005.

3502352:
Even in this ideal world, there are some residents suffering from sanguivoriphobia. They would attack one another out of fear and paranoia.
After the situation was brought under control, an elder reassured everyone that all vampires had been eliminated from this ideal world. However, a boy stood out and objected.
The boy was Woolf. He clearly sensed the existence of vampires. His words caused another commotion. The elder scolded Woolf, and forbade him from ever bringing it up again.
Woolf asked the Adventurer to help him search for vampires. When they did find one, Woolf killed the young vampire brutally, revealing his strong hatred towards vampires.
Woolf took proofs of vampires' existence to the elder, but they turned to dust before the elder could see them. The elder accused Woolf of disrupting order. During their argument, Woolf's face mask fell to the floor. The elder wanted to approach him, but was stopped by Ron, an elderly hunter.
After Ron mediated in the dispute, he warned Woolf not to remove his mask until he earned everyone's respect, because Woolf was a child between a vampire and a human, and his fangs would reveal his problematic identity. Woolf could only prove his stance through revenging.
Ron died all of a sudden. Woolf and the Adventurer buried him together. Woolf inherited Ron's sword, and decided to find the cause of his death alone.
Meanwhile, Geffen saw a large number of deaths. All those people suffered accelerated aging before they died. The Mages' Union at Geffen finally noticed that something was wrong, and tasked the Adventurer with the investigation.
Just then, an intense earthquake happened in Geffen.
The Adventurer went to the epicenter and found a giant dreamcatcher there, guarded by vampires.
Woolf showed up again and brought an astonishing presumption — everyone in Geffen was trapped in a dream. The earthquake was probably a result of the large number of deaths, which drained energy in the dream and rendered the dream unstable.
When another earthquake happened, the Mages' Union decided to find a way out of the dream as soon as possible. The Adventurer offered to look for clues at the location he entered the dream from.
There, the Adventurer met the pale man again, and identified him to be the Deliverer, who kept bringing more healthy people into the dream to fuel the dream. However, the Deliverer didn't know where the exit was, because vampires could enter and exit the dream from anywhere. It was created by Freya using Dracula's blood as the key.
The batch of newcomers temporarily restored stableness for the dream, but Geffen launched another fight against Dracula's forces to leave the dream.
Woolf founded the Hunters' League to hunt vampires. However, they were overpowered by the vampires, because the civilians refused to join the war, not believing they were in a dream. Woolf was stuck.
Just when Woolf's revenge was going to fail, someone offered to give Woolf the power of doom.
3502353:
The power boosted Woolf's combat competence. Under his leadership, the Hunters' League slayed many vampires.
With the help of his secret backer, Woolf found where Dracula was hiding, and asked the Adventurer to join him in investigating the place. On the way, Woolf told the Adventurer why he resented vampires — Dracula killed his mother. He also tasked the Adventurer with distracting Dracula.
Woolf met Dracula for the first time at Dracula's castle. Dracula warned Woolf not to get in his way, while Woolf provoked a fight between the two sides in order to carry out a secret mission. He soon came back in disappointment, and escaped the castle with the Adventurer.
Because Woolf failed to complete the mission, he was pursued by Morroc, and finally confessed to the Adventurer that his power was from Morroc. Woolf then told Morroc about how he infiltrated Dracula's castle during the commotion to steal the shard of Yimir's Heart, but couldn't take it away no matter how many times he tried. Morroc inferred that Woolf was a member of Dracula's family. Dracula's family was responsible for guarding the shard of Yimir's Heart, so they couldn't move it. In other words, no member of Dracula's family can pick up the shard of Yimir's Heart. In addition, there were rumors about Dracula falling in love with a human during the years he vanished.
Morroc spread the rumors about Woolf being related to Dracula, causing Woolf to lose the Hunters' League's trust. However, he was instead supported by civilians he once helped, since being a half-vampire wouldn't undermine his determination to protect humans. Woolf's resolution to take revenge grew even firmer, as he planned to break free from Morroc's control with the help of the Adventurer.
The Adventurer lured Dracula's forces to Morroc and defeated Morroc with Dracula's power, forcing Morroc to give up on stealing the shard of Yimir's Heart for his own comeback. After handling Morroc, Woolf decided to sneak into Dracula's castle for the truth of his past. There, he met the person he'd been missing this whole time.
Woolf found his "deceased" mother Helena in the castle, but she looked lifeless, and only returned to consciousness shortly because of Woolf's tears. She told Woolf the whole story — Dracula was indeed Woolf's father. Five years ago, a traitor among vampires barged into their home to kill Dracula. Helena tried to protect Dracula, but got killed by the traitor instead. Dracula took out Helena's heart to preserve it with potion until he found a way to revive Helena. Preoccupied with the resurrection, he didn't notice that Woolf was taken by his grandfather Ron. Dracula tried to look for Woolf, but had no clues. In order to revive Helena, Dracula formed a contract with Freya to use his own blood as the key to put all residents of Geffen in Freya's dream, which turned Geffen into an ideal world overnight. The resurrection would take ten years, and the five years so far was only enough for Helena to regain consciousness from time to time. Dracula believed that the scheme could also bring peace to vampires, but the price of reviving Helena would be killing all people of Geffen and letting Freya have the shard of Yimir's Heart that Dracula's family had been guarding.
Helena hoped that Woolf could stop Dracula, and if possible, without killing him. The conversation was interrupted by Dracula.
It was a conundrum for Woolf. In the end, he chose the people over his mother.
A war between humans and vampires was brewing.
3502354:
Woolf defeated Dracula, and kept his promise to Helena about not killing him.
However, Dracula had another decision for Woolf to make. Defeating vampires alone wouldn't free humans from the dream. They needed Woolf's blood as the key. Woolf had to choose whether to sacrifice himself and his mother for the people.
Finally, Woolf decided to stab his own heart with Dracula's weapon and guild the people out of the dream with his blood.
Dracula's plan ended up fruitless, but he used what power was left in him to turn Woolf into a Doppelganger.

42530491: Are... Are you here to help me?
42530493: I wandered into a dream. When I woke up, I found myself in an abandoned toy factory, and the toys told me about themselves...
42530494: But I went too far... Those stories might have triggered a certain power when I was exploring the depths of the factory, which is now preventing me from proceeding.
42530495: Could you listen to the rest of the stories and learn about their past for me?
42530497: Alright. I'll be waiting for you here.
42530499: Well, I was only trying to look for inspirations. It would soon be New Year, but I was in a slump...
42530500: (murmuring to self) I haven't been coming up with anything. Maybe I should take a walk and get some air...
42530501: The scenery beyond the forest may inspire me.
42530502: Perhaps I will get some ideas from the sight of snow? Or from a stroll in the forest...
42530503: If only I could capture the mysteriousness of this forest in my painting.
42530504: Just then, Dunka accidentally slipped on a block of ice and fell on snow.
42530506: There was a teddy bear beside her. It looked worn, with faded fabric and missing one eye, but the remaining eye still had a faint gloss.
42530507: Why are you here? Who left you in such a cold place...
42530508: Dunka gently swept snow off the teddy bear, and held the stuffed animal in her arms. It was shabby, but somehow reassuring. She sat down against a pine tree to rest, and soon fell asleep in the afternoon sun.
42530509: I saw a towering building decorated by colorful lights, and heard delightful music and laughter from all directions. Countless cheerful toys were working and playing there. The place was bustling with energy and joy.
42530511: I've never seen a place that lovely... I wish I could draw the whole scene...
42530512: Sigh, I slept for too long...
42530514: I certainly can, but not everyone can hear me.
42530515: Only children that long for fantasy can hear my voice.
42530516: What about that dream... I never know a better place...
42530517: That was the toy factory I came from. It used to be full of happiness and laughter.
42530518: But evilness has reduced the factory to ruins and corrupted the once adorable toys, leaving them crazy and dangerous.
42530520: (sighs) It happened a long time ago. The factory was flourishing, and our days were full of delight, but an evil power came from nowhere, swept the factory, and eroded our minds.
42530521: Many toys became aggressive, marking the end of our good old days. In the end, guards of Gingerbread City had to close the factory for safety concerns, and we got stuck in it.
42530522: That's horrible... Can I help in any way?
42530523: Maybe you can. You feel special. It's been a while since I last met a kid who could hear me. Come with me. I'll show you to the factory.
42530524: Then, I followed the teddy bear and heard many stories. Those toys... You'll know when you see them.
42530525: Thank you for offering to help... The teddy bear will be your guide from now on.
42530526: Hi, Adventurer! Is Dunka getting better?
42530527: That clown feels off. One minute, he's weeping, and the next minute, he's laughing. Let's have a closer look!
42530529: Teehee! It's me, the toy clown! Boohoo... haha!
42530530: You know... I used to be the happiest toy, always putting a smile on Lucy's face. Back then, my hat was fresh, and my clothes were neat. Whenever Lucy was down, I would make funny moves to cheer her up.
42530532: (eyes turn dull) Lucy... was a kind little girl, and we were best friends. I used to amuse her with my best clown performance when she felt upset or lonely, and she used to knit little hats and scarves to dress me up like a prince...
42530533: However, Lucy grew up day by day... She spent more and more time on stuff other than playing with me.
42530534: One day, she told me that she was leaving for a faraway place, because she had adult business there. I hoped she could take me with her, but she just smiled and waved me goodbye.
42530535: As days went by, I began to feel like I was disappearing. Without Lucy's laughter, even my existence seemed to have lost its purpose.
42530536: After that, evilness permeated the factory. And then? It brought endless darkness and agony and turned our once happy daily life upside down. Toys in the factory became weird and aggressive, including myself.
42530538: It is gone at last... Evilness corrupted me and consumed my happiness and joy. They magnified the loneliness and fear in me, turning me into a horrible shadow.
42530539: I could no longer amuse others, or even stay cheerful myself. I had the impulse to hurt people... I was not the merry clown any more.
42530540: So... do you have any wish at the moment?
42530541: (shows a hint of eagerness) I wish... that Lucy still remembers me, and the time we spent together. I don't expect her to come back. I just hope she still vaguely remembers her old friend. That idea may cheer me up a bit.
42530542: I will bear your story in mind, and tell more people about it. Lucy must still remember you!
42530543: Thank you. As long as I'm remembered... I'm content.
42530544: The moment he finishes speaking, the clown starts to disappear. His eyes glitter, and he smiles faintly.
42530545: (rushes over happily, spins and wags his tail madly) You're back! At last! I missed you so much!
42530546: I'm afraid you've got the wrong person. I'm not your master.
42530547: You're... not? But you look like him....
42530548: (confused, but still a bit hopeful) Are you really not?
42530549: You've been waiting for your master?
42530550: Yup! My master's a brave explorer named Arno. His dream was to travel the world! We used to explore the garden, and he would call me the best companion. Before he set out for a new adventure, he always trained with me. We would run and climb, just like real explorers.
42530551: Arno used to say, "Babe, once I've learned all the exploration skills, we will go to the end of the world and find the lost treasure!" Nothing could intimidate him, and I always followed him around, wherever he went.
42530552: You must have gone through many wonderful adventures. What happened after that?
42530553: One day, Arno received a mysterious invitation to something he had always dreamed of — a real exploration. He said, "Babe, I must go alone this time. It's an opportunity for me to become a great explorer. I will come back to you once I find the treasure!"
42530554: (Babe's eyes go dull and tail stops wagging) Arno set out with his backpack and the invitation. He promised me he would come back, but... that was a long time ago. I've been here staring at the gate of the factory, waiting for him to push the door open and come in with treasure and a big smile.
42530555: You've been waiting for him all this time?
42530556: Right, Arno will never forget me. He must have gone lost somewhere out there, and is still looking for a way back.
42530557: Babe, how long have you been waiting?
42530558: I don't know... I've lost track of time. The evil power has settled down in my heart, and is whispering to me all the time about how Arno will never come back...
42530559: But whenever I was about to give up, I would hear a faint voice in me, saying that Arno would come back, because he had promised to never leave me alone...
42530560: Arno will definitely feel touched if he finds you still waiting for him.
42530561: But I don't want to make him upset... I want him to stay happy. As long as he will come back someday, I can wait. We had so much fun together. I know he will return...
42530562: Babe, I believe Arno knows your feeling.
42530563: Thank you... I just want to see Arno's smile again.
42530564: Both Babe's voice and its body start to disappear. The dog gradually turns into bits of light.
42530565: Beep beep! Who are you? Are you here to watch me dance?
42530566: Story? Well... I'm a ballerina doll and I used to belong to Amy, a little girl who wanted to be a professional dancer.
42530567: We used to dance together. She would hold my hands and teach me every move. We would turn and jump together, as if we were stars on the stage.
42530568: It sounds like you and Amy had a great time together. You must have enjoyed it a lot.
42530569: Right, we danced every day, her holding me and telling me how to turn. She said that I danced even better than she did.
42530570: Whenever music was played, I would turn to it, and Amy would look at me affectionately, with a smile on her face.
42530572: (switches to a low and sad tone) One day, Amy became sick. She could no longer dance with those weak legs. Still, she would hold me and play the familiar melody. She said that she would recover soon and dance with me again.
42530573: But... She never recovered. I kept showing her the moves she taught me, trying to brighten her up, but all she did was to stare at me, and she talked less and less.
42530574: Her family decided to take her somewhere for treatment. She didn't take me with her. Instead, she told me that we would dance again when she returned, and left me in her room.
42530575: It must have been hard for her to leave you...
42530576: I suppose so, but I've never seen her ever since. I stood in her room, waiting for her to come back, while practicing the moves she taught me, until evilness permeated the factory.
42530577: Corrupted by evilness, I can no longer turn or perform the dance Amy taught me. Whenever I try, my body makes harsh noises and my stiff joints hinder my movements. I've become a broken, worthless ballerina doll.
42530578: Amy won't want me back, because I can't bring her joy any more.
42530579: You are not worthless. You used to fill Amy's days with endless happiness. The memories will go on... You remember how she smiled when she watched you turn, don't you?
42530580: I do... Her smile, and her passionate eyes... That was the best part of my life.
42530581: Cherish those memories then. Amy's love for you will never be erased.
42530582: You may have a point. I can no longer dance, but I was her best companion. That's absolute truth.
42530583: The ballerina doll's body starts to glow. Her joints stop squeaking, and the skirt of her dress seems to have regained its former gloss. She makes a gentle turn, and a smile returns to her face.
42530584: Thank you, [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], you've reminded me of my true worth.
42530585: Sigh... Stories of the toys are all alike. I wonder if Amy has gotten better...
42530586: The area ahead is full of an evil power not even I can resist.
42530587: You're back. How was it in the factory?
42530588: (sighs) The toy factory... It used to be such a lovely place, but it has been destroyed by evilness. And those stories are depressing.
42530590: There was a lonely clown, waiting for his master Lucy, who never came back. He used to be a cheerful toy, but he became a shadow of his former self, thoroughly destroyed by evilness.
42530591: This entire town... is like that clown. It has been forgotten after so many years. Fortunately, a revival is still possible.
42530592: And there was Babe, Arno's toy puppy. They were always together, until Arno had to leave him. Without the company of his master, Babe was corrupted by evilness. He lost joy and warmth, and wandered the factory forever.
42530593: Those toys don't deserve such sufferings.
42530594: And the ballerina doll, the favorite toy of Amy. Amy left the doll after illness took dancing from her. The doll then became heartbroken, because her parts were destroyed by the evil power, rendering her unable to turn elegantly.
42530595: Those toys were the soul of the factory, carrying the dreams of countless children. When evilness took over the factory, it destroyed both their bodies and their minds.
42530596: I can't allow those stories to be forgotten. I will depict them in my painting, and give them happy endings. I want to remind others of them with this art work, so that the stories will be passed on.
42530597: Come on, [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], let's draw it together!
42530598: Gingerbread City is a place of miracles... Everything may literally be possible here.
42530599: I'm glad to have met you, Adventurer. Take this painting and be as happy as those in it!
42530600: Hi there! Do you know that the snowman at the center of the village comes to life for a short period every midwinter?
42530601: This year, the snowman has a special wish. It wants to fly! It sounds crazy? But I want to grant it!
42530602: I'm going to develop a jetpack, but my schedule is tight and some crucial materials are missing. Could you lend me a hand? I can realize the snowman's dream once I've got all the materials!
42530603: The snowman will appreciate it, just like I do! Now, let's go for it. Everything is possible at Christmas!
42530605: You've come at the perfect time! We've got a bit of a problem...
42530606: At this time every year, people give each other "apples of good luck" to wish them peace and happiness, but this year, we are losing a large batch of apples we set aside for the celebration every weekend!
42530607: We've identified the culprits to be monsters. They didn't receive any apples and felt left out, so they stole the apples! Could you defeat those troublemakers and retrieve the apples for me?
42530608: Great! As far as I know, they appear between 16:00 and 24:00 every Saturday and Sunday around the toy factory! Good luck!
42530609: Thank you so much. The apples are back!
42530610: Here's a little gift from me. I hope you like it. Thank you for restoring happiness and peace for Gingerbread City's Christmas!
42530611: There's a young painter at Gingerbread City called Dunka. When she was out seeking inspirations, she found a worn teddy bear. That night, she had a dream about a toy factory in the depth of Gingerbread City, populated by teddy bears and fairytale characters... Join Dunka in gathering old stories in the toy factory to draw the old days paradise in dream!

42530632: Whoa! A flying snowman sounds so cool!
42530633: Ahem, peace is the best blessing!
42530634: Now, I've got a gift from another Adventurer for you — a cocreated avatar drawn by [c][ffff00][Cybee][-][/c]!
42530635: Sigh... The "evil" power does live up to its name. Adventurer, be careful!
42530636: (coughing) I... I suspect that this is another of the shadows' attacks.
42530637: They are part of the evilness. Whenever I recall Lucy, they show up and mess with my memories, leaving me unable to tell my story. That they may devour my memories scares me.
42530638: [c][ffff00][PlayerName][-][/c], there you are! Let's get even further today!
42530639: And then... Hm? I can't seem to remember. Whenever Arno went on a trip, I would bury my favorite bone, so that we could dig it out together when he came back...
42530640: The bone... Right, the bone! Arno's been away for so long this time that I can hardly recall the place I buried the bone...
42530641: I probably buried it under a Christmas tree, but trees here all look alike... Could you find it for me?
42530642: Thank you!! You've got my bone back! It feels like Arno has come back and once again found the bone I hid.
42530643: This must be the bone! Give it to Babe!
42530644: Adventurer, could you take a photo of me?
42530645: It's a keepsake. If... by any chance... you meet Amy, please give it to her.
42530646: So much for our trip. Thank you for listening to our stories!

42534687:
Notes: 
1) Adventurers that don't belong to any guild can also participate in Guild Wars, but they cannot deal any DMG to City Emperium or capture any base.
2) A guild can only attack cities of their worldline's battle line. Guild members cannot deal DMG to City Emperium or capture bases of wrong battle lines.
3) When all bases of a city belong to the defending party, the city's City Emperium is invincible and cannot be damaged. 
When any base is taken by the attacking party, the invincibility state is canceled. 
When the bases are neutral, whether City Emperium is invincible depends on the bases' last capturer. 
If a neutral city's bases haven't been captured by the attacking party in this match, City Emperium is invincible.
In base mode, bases No.1 to 5 are assigned to large and medium cities, and bases No.1 to 3 are assigned to small cities. In classic mode, each city has only one base. 
4) Each guild can temporarily capture multiple cities, but it can only keep one when Guild War ends.
42534690:
1. When City Settlement ends, leader of a guild that has captured a base-mode city can set a defensive scheme for the city and deploy roadblocks. The classic mode doesn't support defensive schemes at the moment.
2. Roadblocks can be deployed at 1 location from each group. The defensive scheme can be saved after any deployment.
3. The saved defensive scheme takes effect 10 min before the next GvG starts, and expires when City Settlement ends. It can't be changed when in effect.
4. Roadblocks in effect cannot be destroyed. City attackers cannot enter areas blocked off, while defenders are not affected.
5. When [Consecutive Captures] is achieved, the defensive scheme will be carried over even if it's not the same city, but it will reset otherwise.
42534691:
1. [Constellation Chart] is a season progression system that offers new progression options as [Constellation Tower] enters new seasons. You can view Constellation Chart progression of all previous seasons.
2. Some of the current season's progression nodes only unlock after you beat a certain number of [Constellation Tower] towers of the current season. All progression nodes of a previous season unlock automatically after two new seasons.
3. Progression nodes of the current season can only be unlocked with [Constellation Badge], while those of previous seasons can be unlocked with [Constellation Badge] or [Constellation Badge - Previous]. [Constellation Badge - Previous] is prioritized.
4. Unused [Constellation Badge] automatically turns into [Constellation Badge - Previous] when the next season begins.
5. Cost for unlocking a previous [Constellation Chart] reduces after three seasons. The discount increases up to 3 times as more seasons pass by.

1. Each guild can employ up to 20 mercenaries. Each player can only be employed by 1 guild.
During GvG, a mercenary and their employee guild count as the same faction.
The employment relationship exists in the GvG context only.
2. A mercenary gets the same personal weekly rewards as members of the employee guild, but they don't get season rewards as the employee guild.
3. During GvG, when a mercenary is in the battle preparation area or on the GvG map, they are displayed under random names to enemies.
4. During GvG, mercenaries can teleport from GvG teleporters in guild territory to the battle preparation area in the employee guild's city.
5. The employment relationship is fixed from 30 min before GvG to the end of City Settlement.
6. The employee guild can assign artifacts to mercenaries, but not to dispatched guild members.
Guild mercenaries can only use artifacts during Guild War and at their Preparation Camp.

[Instance Walkthrough]
Even now, the old nightmare still haunts Sakray. To rid him of his trauma so that he no longer punishes himself for it, the Adventurer needs to stand up to Sakray's Inner Demon and defeat it.
[Reward Rules]
Each account can get Equipment's Memory instance loot 5 times a week. Attempts are shared across all difficulties, and reset at 5:00 every Monday. Every week, you can unlock the raid of each difficulty by beating the instance on this difficulty and completing the settlement.
[Revival Rules]
A combat area is specified when you fight monsters in the instance. Reviving the Adventurer consumes revival attempts. Revival is impossible without revival attempts.
[Death Negation Restriction] Since the instance is under the influence of the magic sword, the Adventurer's dishes can only negate death once every boss fight.

42536879: So, this was the rumored Whispering Mountain Villa? The single-eyed Baron Batescliff, the baroness wrapped in ribbons, and the scarred servants... All of them were unnerving. Nevertheless, the guest room was cozier than I'd expected. Just when I closed my eyes for a good night of sleep, however, I heard the window bashed open by a violent gale. I walked over to close the window, when suddenly, my wrists were gripped by a pair of freezing hands. I screamed in panic. The hands let go of me at once and disappeared into the darkness. The butler, who came to check on me, dismissed the happening as my hallucination from exhaustion. But was it? I felt an impulse to put it down in my diary. I needed to record what happened in this mysterious Whispering Mountain Villa... Wait, is that a message on the window! "The secret lies in the basement." What could the secret be? Finally, I chose curiosity over fear, and decided to explore the basement! (The writing was interrupted here) ... Whisper, whisper, whisper, hell, hell, hell! If you have this item, go to Skellington and give it to Zila the maid. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Vengeful Hylozoist.
42536880: Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man who owned a summerhouse at Skellington. Every summer, his family would stay at this villa with servants. His daughter was a tomboy fond of adventures. One summer, she met a wandering boy. They fell in love on first sight and decided to marry each other. When the father found out, he furiously ordered the boy's capture, gouged his right eye out, and forbade him from ever approaching the girl again. The heartbroken girl then locked herself up in the villa's guest room. Years later, the villa was visited by a foreign doctor, who had only one eye. The girl — she had grown into a young woman — heard the familiar voice and opened the door in ecstasy to find none other than her long-gone lover. He handed her a large gift box tied with a ribbon, which she opened with excitement. In the giftbox was her father's freshly cut-off head. If you have this item, go to Skellington and give it to Zila the maid. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Sorrowful Hylozoist.
42536881: Rumor has it that there is a haunting villa at Skellington, owned by a foreign doctor. After his lover was scared to death, the bereaved doctor froze her body, and abruptly opened the villa to visitors while he himself never came out of the basement. Whenever darkness fell, the guests would hear eerie chewing noises coming from underground, until one day, the door to the basement finally opened, out of which emerged the baron and a woman wrapped in crimson ribbons. "I'd like you to meet the new Baroness Batescliff," announced the overjoyed doctor. After the new baroness appeared, guests staying at the villa started to go missing one after another. Nobody know what happened in the villa, but even now, chewing noises can still be heard in the basement at night. If you have this item, go to Skellington and give it to Zila the maid. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Lamenting Hylozoist.
42536882: This case will be sealed forever, and relevant files shall never be backed up. After the culprit, Doctor Batescliff, killed the owner of Whispering Mountain Villa and shocked his daughter to death, he used outrageous medical practices from another country to merge the woman's body with monsters, creating a two-faced witch who would turn into a bloodthirsty monster at night. After dark, the doctor would lock the witch up in the basement, lure robust visitors over to kill them, and use their bodies as enhancement materials and feed for the witch. Offended by his conduct, Hela the goddess of death eliminated the monster and Docter Batescliff in person, and burned down the Whispering Mountain Villa. However, words are now going around that the reportedly destroyed villa has reappeared in Skellington. If you have this item, go to Skellington and give it to Joseph the manservant. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Desperate Hylozoist.
42536883: Elderly Franken was a renowned surgeon. One day, when he was burying a deceased patient in the graveyard, he found a boy in rags. The boy's right eye was missing, and the wound was oozing pus. The childless surgeon took the kid home to treat his wound, and later adopted him. The smart boy was a promising heir, as he learned after the excellent surgeon and made rapid progress. Franken was relieved, until he found the boy experimenting on patients without permission. Disappointed and angry, the elderly doctor kicked his foster son out. That night, depressed old Franken had a sleepless night from losing the son he cherished so much. Suddenly, he heard a familiar voice. "Thank you for everything you've taught me. It's time for me to return and take revenge." The boy turned away from his bedside in his white coat. Franken looked down at his chest, only to find a bloody hollow. His heart had been gorged out by the boy. If you have this item, go to Skellington and give it to Joseph the manservant. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Bloody Hylozoist.
42536884: Help! Someone help me! This Whispering Mountain Villa is overrun by monsters! The doctor's wife has another woman's face in her back, hidden beneath those red ribbons! I saw him feeding raw meat to that face, and patching his wife's rotten wounds with someone else's skin! Someone find this letter please. I have the feeling that the doctor has noticed my uneasiness. Whoever gets to read this letter, do reveal the secret of this hellish villa to the public! If you have this item, go to Skellington and give it to Joseph the manservant. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Crazy Hylozoist.
42536885: Someone was knocking on the door. It was earlier than expected, but it must be her beloved granddaughter. Although the old lady wasn't feeling well, she pulled her favorite wrap around her shoulders and went to answer the door with joy. She only opened the door a few inches when a pair of huge paws stretched in... The next time the wrap was seen, it was around the shoulders of a horrible beast in disguise, eyes wide open, quietly waiting for its prey. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Maria Estrella the huntress. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Dictator Wolf.
42536886: As a famed monster hunter of the Hunter Association, Bergman was born with a sharp sixth sense, and had a bad feeling the moment he heard that satisfied roar. He followed the footprints to the wooden cottage, only to find a sight too brutal for even a veteran hunter. Amid the mess, the grandma wolf was sound asleep on a blood-soaked bed. Bergman raised his gun at the beast without second thought, but to his surprise, the monster jumped out of bed, grabbed the gun barrel, snatched the weapon from him and fled into the dark woods, leaving Bergman only enough time to notice its big belly. There seemed to be something wobbling in it... If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Maria Estrella the huntress. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Cunning Wolf.
42536887: The diary has the name "Rocha Vera" written neatly on the cover. It probably belongs to a young girl. Although it is rude to read someone else's diary, this one seems to have ended abruptly. The last entry says, "Granny, who lives alone, isn't feeling well. Mom asks me to visit her tomorrow with cakes, fruits and wine. It's been a while since I last saw my dear granny. I'm gonna wear my favorite dress and put on the red riding hood she gave me, so that I would look great. She will surely be happy to see me. Mom says I shouldn't take the path in the woods. She's such a worrywart. There aren't so many man-eating beasts, are there?" If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Maria Estrella the huntress. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Murderous Wolf.
42536888: The cute women's handbag contains delicious fruits, bread, and a bottle of assumably homemade wine. In my mind's eye, I can see the girl navigating the woods, the bag hanging from her arm, just like an old oil painting. It must have been a visit to someone precious. How I wish she were just having a long and nice nap under a tree, and her rosy life would continue when she woke up. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Mary the hunter apprentice. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Vicious Wolf.
42536889: A blood-soaked red dress that speaks the miserable end of its owner. They say the girl in the red riding hood — Rocha Vera was her name — was eaten alive by the grandma wolf, who then took her favorite dress. Beautiful things tend to be vulnerable. The evil always has plenty of ways to disguise itself, while the kind is always too innocent and unsuspecting. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Mary the hunter apprentice. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Mad Wolf.
42536890: Lovely rose, grow quickly. Wilk cut his wrist open and watered the rose with his blood, as he mumbled, "I can propose to Emily once you bloom." The rose bathed in the moonlight pouring in from the window, while he hid in the shadow. "Azure Star... my treasure..." He took back his arm and wiped his wrist with a handkerchief. The wound had magically healed, and the rose was slowly blooming before his eyes. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Wilk. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Admiration.
42536891: Carlson looked down at his chest, Emily's veil still held in his hand. A sword had pierced him, its tip only a few inches away from Emily, who was standing before him. Carlson took a step back to keep the blade from Emily. "Carlson, Carlson..." Emily looked on in a daze, fear filling her eyes. Then, she saw the person behind Carlson staring at her, his fangs exposed. He suddenly grabbed Emily's hand and forcefully took the key she was holding in her tight fist. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Carlson. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Purity.
42536892: Wilk straightened his tie and stood at the castle gate in high spirits, as he watched the approaching bride. Emily's expression was concealed by a veil, but Wilk assumed that it was a smile. Just when he stretched out his hand for Emily's, a young man stepped in between. He grabbed the bride's hand and rushed away, while she didn't show a single hint of resistance. The two disappeared before anyone could react. Wilk took a deep breath, picked up a sword, and went after them... If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Wilk. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Eternity.
42536893: A love letter written by Carlson. It says: Dear Emily, since our meeting at that ball, I've been missing you more intensely every day, to the point that I can hardly breathe. Although I'm aware that you are engaged, and your wedding is scheduled tomorrow, it will prove a minor obstacle in the face of our love. Do you still remember our promise? Meet me in the garden tomorrow morning, and I will put the ring on your finger, my love. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Carlson. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Promise.
42536894: Emily, will you marry me? "I will!" Carlson gently lifted Emily's veil. The two gazed at each other, their hearts overflowing with words of love. "Carlson, I've got something for you." "Let me give you something first," said Carlson, as he stroked Emily's face. He picked up Emily's hand and was going to put the Azure Ring on her finger, when he felt a sting in his chest, followed by a warm flow. The ring he was holding in his hand fell onto the ground with a clink... If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Carlson. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Oath.
42536895: There was a castle in the town, owned by a graceful gentleman. After he became engaged with a local young lady from a prominent family, he held a masquerade ball to announce the news. Carlson attended the ball at the castle, wearing a mask he made himself. He looked around the venue nonchalantly from behind the mask, until a certain girl's arrival attracted all his attention. He walked over to invite the girl, who was also in a mask, for a dance. They danced to the music, and to the melody of love produced by their young hearts. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Carlson. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Meeting.
42536896: The elaborate golden key to the treasure chest at Emily's house. The night before the wedding, Emily's father handed the key to her, and told her about the heirloom kept in the chest — a dark-blue pearl. She was his only child, and the key was her most valuable piece of dowry. He wanted her to give it to her future husband, and live a happy life. The grateful Emily promised to make sure her future husband received the key. If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Wilk. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Wealth.
42536897: Emily's hands were covered in blood. She pulled out a dagger hidden under her dress, took a deep breath, and darted forward. She managed to stab Wilk in the arm, because the latter was focused on the golden key in his hand. At first, he wasn't bothered, thinking that it was a minor wound for him, but to his shock, he then discovered it was a silver blade. "You knew I was a vampire!" Instead of replying, Emily pulled out the sword in Carlson's chest, and pointed it towards herself. "Wilk, you won't last for long..." If you have this item, go to Misty Forest and give it to Wilk. (Available to Lv.110+ Adventurers.) Obtained by killing Tomb Zombie - Courage.

42622176:
1. Combat attempts are shared by all characters on your account.
2. You will not receive EXP or loot from monsters if your combat attempts run out.
3. You begin with 3500 combat attempts per day. Reach the following character tier to increase this limit: T2 - 5,500; Advancing T2 - 7,500; T3 - 10,000.
4. This limit resets daily at 5:00. Unused combat attempts will be converted to rewards.
5. PvP, Mini and MVP combats are not affected by this limit.
6.If a teammate is on the same map as you, the teammate will consume the combat attempts of all team members on the same map. All team members will receive the loot for the killed monster.
7. When a common monster is killed, only the first two players who dealt damage to the monster can receive the loot.
8. A monster will take less damage and deal more damage as the level difference between the monster and the character increases, starting from a level difference of 20.
9. When you kill a common monster 30 levels higher than you, the EXP you receive will be reduced by a certain percentage.
10. Disabling the "Consume combat attempts" toggle is the same as having zero combat attempt. In this state, you consume no combat attempt when killing world map monsters. You can only change this option once every 5 minutes.
11. The voice technology is powered by iFlytek.
42622178:
[Instance Rules]
After the battle starts, random card effects appear in each round, affecting both monsters and the player. The player wins if they can survive fixed waves of monsters. 
After the battle starts, players outside the instance cannot join the battle. 
[Reward Rules]
Reward attempts refresh at 5:00 every Monday. Whenever the player clears the instance and gets rewards, a reward attempt and some time are consumed. 
An account's first clearance of a level (regardless of the difficulty) costs no time and earns rewards right away. 
When the player raids a level (and the levels below it) that has been cleared in the week, they consume an attempt and get the rewards right away. (First-completion Nolan Cards not included)
Card album items are random drops.
42622180:
1. When your T3 job reaches Lv.60, master skills are unlocked and your job level cap raises. Upgrade your job and get skill points to enhance master skills.
2. Master skill upgrades consume skill points and Zeny.
3. Master skills cannot reset.
[c][4059A8]4. Drag a master skill into the skill socket/tap the switch button to enable it. The corresponding passive skills will come into effect automatically.[-][/c]
5. When a master skill is enabled, Job EXP you obtain will increase the level of its corresponding job.
6. Job levels and skill points aren't shared across different master skills.

[b]1. Objectives[/b]

①Group objectives
At the start of a Guild War, each guild receives four group objectives. Completing the objectives earn each guild member [Praying Card Pack] x4 when the City Settlement ends. (Mercenaries employed by the guild also receive the rewards, but guild members employed by another guild do not.)
Each Adventurer gets extra rewards upon fulfilling group objectives and personal objectives based on the size of the city captured by the guild when GvG starts.
Guild members will receive extra rewards based on the largest city their guild has occupied: Medium City: 25%; Small City: 50%; No City: 50%.
★This bonus does not apply to [Base Honor of Personal Objective].

[b]2. Settlement[/b]

If the following point acquisition conditions are fulfilled, the guild leader gets [Post-War Reconstruction Red Packet] randomly after City Settlement of this GvG. Each fulfillment grants up to 1 red packet.
When in season mode, fulfilling the following conditions also grants corresponding points. Points will be used to calculate guild rankings of the GvG season.

★Defend City: Keep the City Emperium of the city owned at the start of GvG from being destroyed. Reward: 1 point. Cap: 1 point.
★Attack City: Any guild gets 4 points for destroying the City Emperium of a large city. Guilds owning a small city or no city can get 2 points for destroying the City Emperium of a medium city. Cap: 4 points.
★Perfect Defense: Achieve perfect defense for any of your city to get 2 points. Cap: 2 points.
Perfect defense is achieved for your City Emperium if it doesn't take DMG during the 15 min countdown.
If a City Emperium takes DMG during the countdown, the countdown will only restart 60s after its HP is fully restored.
★Capture City: A guild gets 8/5/3 points for owning a large/medium/small city upon City Settlement. Cap: 8 points.
★Consecutive Captures: A guild gets 2 points for owning a city at the start of GvG and upon City Settlement. Cap: 2 points.
★MVP Kill: Land the last hit on the [Shadow of Morroc] MVP summoned to a large city. Reward: 3 points. Cap: 12 points.

[Instance Walkthrough]
As the guardian of time and space, Spacetime Dragon manages various worldlines with its copies. One of the copies, however, was corrupted by otherworld powers during a task. It has taken up Space of Time and is trying to disrupt orders of all worldlines. The Adventurer is going to handle this crisis and stop its wrongdoings.
[Reward Rules]
Each account can get Equipment's Memory instance loot 5 times a week. Attempts are shared across all difficulties, and reset at 5:00 every Monday. Every week, you can unlock the raid of each difficulty by beating the instance on this difficulty and completing the settlement.
[Revival Rules]
A combat area is specified when you fight monsters in the instance. Reviving the Adventurer consumes revival attempts. Revival is impossible without revival attempts.
[Death Negation Restriction] Since the instance is under the influence of time and space, the Adventurer's dishes can only negate death once every boss fight.

When a kind spirit offers itself, it restores some HP for Taratanos. When an evil spirit offers itself, it deals DMG to all players once. All skills of Taratanos inflict "Demonsoul" on the players, slowing them down.

The tides of Abyssal Lake began to grow chaotic, and the keen Space-time dragon, Oscar, noticed an anomaly—someone had escaped from the Space-time garbage recycling station. As the space designated for reclaiming the "errors of existence" in this world, the recycling station is vital to maintaining balance, which is why the task of guarding it has always been borne by the Dragon people.  

Oscar quickly summoned adventurers to venture into the heart of Abyssal Lake's secret zone. This location was not only home to the Space-time garbage recycling station but also the dwelling place of the Dragon people—untouched by Mankind until now. However, upon arrival, the scene was alarming: a brutal civil war among the dragons had just ended, and suspicious Human footprints were plainly visible in the blood-stained ground of Scabbers. Following the tracks led them under the world tree, which had been damaged, seemingly by a mysterious Mankind beneath it.  

Events unfolded unexpectedly smoothly. Oscar discovered information on the mysterious person that matched that of the escapee from the Space-time garbage recycling station, and he decided to bring the person back to the station for interrogation. Luckily, with the adventurers’ explanations, the misunderstanding was cleared—the mysterious person was The Nameless, leader of the Assassin guild. He had been drawn to Abyssal Lake after sensing the destruction of its balance. Nevertheless, Oscar remained cautious, believing the issue was far from resolved.  

As they worked to extinguish the raging Flames devouring the world tree, the trio realized that the fire was merely the tip of the iceberg of Abyssal Lake's turmoil. Once the fire subsided, more problems surfaced: the red flame dragon and the black flame dragon were locked in violent disputes over whether to lead the Dragon people away from Abyssal Lake. Moreover, the force truly damaging the world tree wasn’t the fire, but rather a corrupted power infecting its roots, caused by the escapee.  

Searching for clues, the three delved into the infected roots, but The Nameless succumbed to the influence of the escapee’s power, falling into a chaotic state of memories. This led Oscar to suspect some connection between the escapee and The Nameless. When Oscar and the adventurers entered The Nameless’s memories, they saw a silhouette bring those memories into a temple. However, the temple was shrouded in thick mist, obscuring the figure’s identity. Yet, the appearance of the temple reminded Oscar that it was once guarded by the gods, and it might hold a way to heal the world tree.  

As The Nameless and the adventurers reached the temple, they discovered it had long since become ruins and that the Divine Shadow no longer manifested there. Nevertheless, after much effort, the duo succeeded in summoning the Divine Shadow, which revealed how to heal the world tree—a Dragon Breath Altar must be visited to unlock the Dragon Breath Seal to obtain the primal power stored in the Time Rift. Only the primal power could restore the world tree.  

However, when they finally unlocked the Dragon Breath Seal, they discovered that the so-called primal power did not exist. It was revealed that everything, starting with the Divine Shadow’s appearance, was a deception orchestrated by the escapee. His true goal was to take over Oscar’s true body and use its immense power to activate the space-time matrix, fully opening the Space-time garbage recycling station to release all its contents, thereby unleashing an even greater catastrophe.  

At the critical moment, Oscar arrived with crucial information—healing the world tree required the collection of four Dragon Stars, which belonged to himself, the red flame dragon Leticia, the black flame dragon Betelgeuse, and Nidhogg. The first Dragon Star was hidden within Oscar’s true body; the Oscar they knew was merely an avatar.  

Thus, the trio set out to the space-time matrix to find Oscar’s true body, shut down the matrix, and obtain the first Dragon Star.  

After breaking the escapee’s control over Oscar’s true body, the real Oscar awakened and solemnly entrusted the first Dragon Star to the group. As the Dragon Star’s power infused the roots of the world tree, a faint glimmer began to flicker, instilling a sense of hope in all. At that moment, the world tree received its first healing, marking only the beginning of the battles yet to come.
