1.[Giffen Battlefield (PVP)] supports up to 48 Adventurers joining the [Silverfang Hunter] and [Blood Clan] factions respectively for PVP battles (24v24). [Giffenia (PVE)] supports up to 12 Adventurers fighting against the Blood Clan as the [Silverfang Hunter] side.
2.[Lightbringer Prestige] can be obtained by completing the [Giffenia Typhoon Kaemi Pure Land] main quest, [Giffen Battlefield (PVP)]/[Giffenia (PVE)] Adventure Quests, and participating in [Giffen Battlefield (PVP)]/[Giffenia (PVE)] map events.
Obtaining [Lightbringer Prestige] can increase a character's [Light Chaser merit rank]. Merit rank advancement rewards can only be claimed once per account.
3.In the [Giffen Battlefield (PVP)] map, winning/drawing/losing in [Ultimate Ghost Hunt] grants Prestige*100/60/30 respectively, and winning/drawing/losing in other events grants Prestige*20/15/10 respectively.
In the [Giffenia (PVE)] map, winning in [Ultimate Ghost Hunt] grants Prestige*50, and winning in other events grants Prestige*10.
A character can obtain at most Prestige*200 per day by participating in map events.
4.Daily [Adventure Quests] can be completed in both the [Giffen Battlefield (PVP)] and [Giffenia (PVE)] maps. Completing each [Adventure Quest] grants Prestige*25, and completing 4 per day grants an additional Prestige*100. (Not counted toward the daily limit.)

47136768:
【Dungeon Process】
The turmoil in Isgard awakened the consciousness maze that Jörmungandr left in the head of its shed skin. Adventurers were drawn into the Hot Sand Maze it created to relieve Winterchill and loneliness. Only by defeating the Guardian and the Ancient Egyptian King can they return to reality.

【Reward Rules】
Rewards can be obtained only once per account per week. All difficulties share the reward attempts, and drop rewards refresh at 5 AM every Monday.

【Revival Rules】
While battling MVP monsters within the dungeon, the combat area is restricted, and reviving adventurers consumes revival attempts. When revival attempts are exhausted, adventurers can no longer be revived.

【Dungeon Rules】
Kades will use Nether Fire to freeze adventurers into Ice Cubes. Teammates can kick them out to Impact the Horong and reduce the charge of Kades' ultimate skill.
The Ancient Egyptian King will steal Shields and use Clearance to remove buffs. After being Hit multiple times, an adventurer may be Sealed into Rock. Sealed adventurers can be launched by Teammates to Impact the Ancient Egyptian King, weakening its Shield.
Defeat the Ghost Guardian Kades and the Ancient Egyptian King to obtain dungeon rewards.

48066890:
【Crown of Snowflakes】
1. The Crown of Snowflakes is an Artifact - Headgear. Each account can only obtain it once through the main storyline quest, and it can be transferred between characters via the warehouse.
2. Like ordinary Equipment, Adventurers can freely equip and unequip the Crown of Snowflakes. The Crown of Snowflakes cannot be Enhanced, Refined, Enchanted, Traded, or Sold, but it has a unique development system.
3. After an Adventurer obtains the Crown of Snowflakes, the appearance option for the Crown of Snowflakes will automatically unlock in the Transmogrification - Headgear interface.
【Crown Development】
1. The Crown of Snowflakes has 3 selectable modes, and only one of the 3 can be active at a time.
2. Completing daily quests in various regions of Isgard and exploring the continent of Isgard grants Power of Frost. Consuming Power of Frost can increase the level of the Crown of Snowflakes.
3. When the Crown of Snowflakes levels up, each mode gains 1 attribute point. In the attribute unlock interface, attribute points can be consumed to activate any unlocked entry. Point allocation for the 3 modes is independent.
4. The appearance of the Crown of Snowflakes can be changed in the Appearance Customization interface. More appearances will gradually unlock during the main storyline of the Land of Snowflakes.
5. Note: The development attributes of the Crown of Snowflakes only take effect when it is equipped, and none of the attributes will take effect in PVP, GVG, or similar environments.
【Regional Attributes】
1. As the Crown of Snowflakes levels up, Regional Attribute bonuses will gradually become available. Materials can be consumed to increase each Regional Attribute bonus.
2. The Regional Attribute bonuses of the Crown of Snowflakes only take effect in Isgard, and they remain continuously active regardless of whether the Crown is equipped. This effect is account-wide.
3. The Global section under the same tab is divided into three rings: First Snow, Deep Cold, and Eternal Silence. Each ring has 8 nodes; the first 6 are base attributes, and the last 2 are special attributes for that ring. Base attribute nodes have a maximum level of 50, and special attribute nodes have a maximum level of 20.
4. Upgrading base attributes consumes Starlight Shards, and upgrading special attributes consumes Starlight Crystals.
5. Global attributes take effect without equipping the Crown of Snowflakes and are not limited to any map. Development progress follows the character, not a specific Crown of Snowflakes.
【Accessory System】
1. Snowflake Equipment can be stored in the Accessory System. Once stored, the specified attribute entries of that equipment will be activated and take effect.
2. The attribute bonuses of the Accessory System are always active, and they remain continuously active regardless of whether the equipment is equipped. This effect is not account-wide.
3. Snowflake Equipment for the same slot can only be either stored in the Accessory System or equipped on a character; its Attr Effects cannot be active simultaneously.
4. Frostcores can be stored in the Accessory System. After Snowflake Equipment is stored in the corresponding equipment slot, the Frostcore attributes will be activated and take effect.
5. In the Frostcore Codex, Extreme Cold Essence can be consumed to increase Frostcore levels. After leveling up, the corresponding base attribute bonuses can be obtained.
6. Each type of Frostcore can be obtained at most 1 time; when the same Frostcore is obtained repeatedly, it will automatically convert into Star-Up Exp for that Frostcore; when Star-Up Exp reaches the cap, the Frostcore will automatically increase its star level. If the Frostcore has already reached the maximum star level, duplicates obtained will automatically convert into Frostcore Crystal Remnant Soul.
7. In the Frostcore Collection, Frostcores are categorized into different groups. Collecting an entire group of Frostcores and completing the corresponding Frostcore development both grant permanent collection reward attributes.

1. Requirements for becoming a mentor: Adventurers that have upgraded the base level to 130 and completed the mentor quest. 
2. Requirements for becoming a student: Adventurers between Lv. 10 and 90 without a mentor. 
3. Mentor quest: Players without a mentor that have upgraded the base level to 130 may claim the mentor quest from the Adventurer's Guild Senior Mentor Terch. 
4. Number of Students: Each mentor may have up to 3 adventurers as students. 
5. Student Graduation: Students may go to Prontera to claim the graduation ceremony quest from the Adventurer's Guild Senior Mentor Tataji at Lv. 90. 
6. If a player's adjusted level doesn't meet the requirement, the mentor-student relation will be retained. However, once all mentor-student relations are severed, the player can no longer be a mentor.

1. This is an online multi-player role-playing game, suitable for gamers 12 years or older. Minors are advised to use under parents' supervision. 

2. The game is developed based on the Ragnarok Online. All characters and classes are adjusted based on history, different from reality. The game features group competitions that involves multiple players and requires logical judgement and operation to a certain degree. Players are encouraged to communicate, think and train to achieve goals. The game has a voice and text based social system between strangers, which is managed following relevant laws and regulations.

 3. The game features a real name verification system. Unverified users have no access to the game. Verified minors are subject to additional restrictions: 
Some game modes and items involve payment. Users under 8 years old are not allowed to pay. Minors between 8 and 16 years old may top up no more than ￥50 per transaction and are subject to a monthly top-up cap of ￥200. Minors over 16 years old may top up no more than ￥100 per transaction and are subject to a monthly top-up cap of ￥400.
 Underage users only have access to the game on weekends and national holidays between 20:00 and 21:00.

 4. The operation and exercise in this game is designed to help develop players' hand-eye coordination and quick reaction capability. The group based gameplay will improve players' communication skills, teamwork and ability to see the big picture. The game's animation, character settings and costume designs have adopted many traditional cultural elements, such as the Han Chinese clothing in hopes of rousing young players' interest in outstanding traditional culture and strengthening their recognition of cultural identity.
